-- 3. TRIGGER DE PRIVILEGIOS EN public.perfiles (INCLUYE INMUTABILIDAD DE es_cuenta_sandbox)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_perfiles_privilegios_y_boveda()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_is_trusted_rpc BOOLEAN := (current_setting('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', true) = 'true');
  v_is_backend_superuser BOOLEAN := (
    (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NULL
    AND current_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role')
  ) OR (COALESCE((SELECT auth.role()), '') = 'service_role');
  v_is_master_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), false);
BEGIN
  NEW.kc_membresia := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(NEW.kc_membresia, 0));
  NEW.kc_topup := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(NEW.kc_topup, 0));
  NEW.saldo_kc := NEW.kc_membresia + NEW.kc_topup;

  IF v_is_trusted_rpc OR v_is_backend_superuser OR v_is_master_admin THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT auth.uid()) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Operacion denegada: solo puedes crear tu propio perfil.'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

    IF LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IN ('admin', 'fundador')
       OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.tipo_cuenta, ''))) IN ('admin', 'fundador') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Escalada de privilegios bloqueada en registro.'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

    IF NEW.kc_membresia > 0 OR NEW.kc_topup > 0 OR NEW.saldo_kc > 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Auto-inyeccion de saldo bloqueada en registro.'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

    NEW.rol := CASE
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'especialista')
        THEN LOWER(TRIM(NEW.rol))
      ELSE 'atleta'
    END;
    NEW.tipo_cuenta := CASE
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.tipo_cuenta, ''))) IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'especialista', 'b2b')
        THEN LOWER(TRIM(NEW.tipo_cuenta))
      ELSE 'atleta'
    END;
    NEW.nivel := CASE
      WHEN NEW.rol IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'especialista') THEN 'Partner B2B'
      ELSE 'Acceso Base'
    END;
    NEW.xp_total := 0;
    NEW.racha_dias := 0;
    NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox := false;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
       OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.rol, '')))
       OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.tipo_cuenta, ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.tipo_cuenta, '')))
       OR COALESCE(NEW.nivel, '') IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.nivel, '')
       OR COALESCE(NEW.kc_membresia, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_membresia, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.kc_topup, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_topup, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.saldo_kc, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.saldo_kc, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.xp_total, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.xp_total, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox, false) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.es_cuenta_sandbox, false)
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Modificacion directa de rol, nivel, sandbox o saldos bloqueada fuera de RPC autorizado.'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- 4. VISTA PÚBLICA EXCLUYENDO CUENTAS SANDBOX DE LEADERBOARD / SQUADS
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.perfiles_publicos
WITH (security_barrier = true)
AS
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.nombre,
  p.avatar_url,
  p.nivel,
  COALESCE(p.xp_total, 0) AS xp_total,
  COALESCE(p.racha_dias, 0) AS racha_dias,
  COALESCE(p.radar_publico, true) AS radar_publico
FROM public.perfiles p
WHERE COALESCE(p.radar_publico, true) = true
  AND COALESCE(p.es_cuenta_sandbox, false) = false
  AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p.rol, 'atleta'))) NOT IN ('admin', 'fundador');

REVOKE ALL ON public.perfiles_publicos FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT SELECT ON public.perfiles_publicos TO authenticated;

-- 5. TRIGGER EN public.reservas: PROPAGACIÓN AUTOMÁTICA DE SANDBOX E INMUTABILIDAD DE qr_token
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_reservas_sandbox_e_inmutabilidad()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_is_sandbox BOOLEAN := false;
  v_is_trusted_rpc BOOLEAN := (current_setting('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', true) = 'true');
  v_is_backend_superuser BOOLEAN := (
    (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NULL
    AND current_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role')
  ) OR (COALESCE((SELECT auth.role()), '') = 'service_role');
  v_is_master_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), false);
  v_old_estado TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.estado, '')));
  v_new_estado TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.estado, '')));
BEGIN
  IF NEW.usuario_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(es_cuenta_sandbox, false)
      INTO v_user_is_sandbox
    FROM public.perfiles
    WHERE id = NEW.usuario_id;
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(v_user_is_sandbox, false) THEN
    NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox := true;
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND NOT (v_is_trusted_rpc OR v_is_backend_superuser OR v_is_master_admin) THEN
    NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox := false;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND NOT (v_is_trusted_rpc OR v_is_backend_superuser OR v_is_master_admin) THEN
    IF NOT COALESCE(v_user_is_sandbox, false) THEN
      NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox := COALESCE(OLD.es_cuenta_sandbox, false);
    END IF;
    IF OLD.qr_token IS NOT NULL AND NEW.qr_token IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.qr_token THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mutacion directa de qr_token bloqueada.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.usuario_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.usuario_id
       OR NEW.qr_usado_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.qr_usado_at
       OR COALESCE(NEW.precio_kc, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.precio_kc, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.costo_total, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.costo_total, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.monto_escrow, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.monto_escrow, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.monto_puerta, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.monto_puerta, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.escrow_membresia, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.escrow_membresia, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.escrow_topup, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.escrow_topup, 0)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.negocio_nombre, '') IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.negocio_nombre, '') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mutacion directa de titular, sede, check-in o montos financieros bloqueada fuera de RPC autorizado.'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    IF v_old_estado IN ('completada', 'usada', 'no_show', 'penalizada', 'cancelada')
       AND v_new_estado IS DISTINCT FROM v_old_estado THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reversion directa de estado terminal bloqueada fuera de RPC autorizado.'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    IF v_new_estado IS DISTINCT FROM v_old_estado
       AND v_new_estado IN ('completada', 'usada', 'no_show', 'penalizada') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Escalada directa de estado financiero bloqueada fuera de RPC autorizado.'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_guard_reservas_sandbox_e_inmutabilidad ON public.reservas;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_reservas_sandbox_e_inmutabilidad
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.reservas
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_reservas_sandbox_e_inmutabilidad();

-- 6. RPCS DE MÍNIMOS PRIVILEGIOS PARA QR TITULAR Y RESOLUCIÓN B2B SIN EXPONER qr_token
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.obtener_mis_qr_tokens_activos()
RETURNS TABLE (
  id UUID,
  qr_token TEXT
)
LANGUAGE sql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
AS $$
  SELECT r.id, r.qr_token
  FROM public.reservas r
  WHERE (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL
    AND r.usuario_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
    AND r.qr_token IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 60;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.obtener_mis_qr_tokens_activos() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.obtener_mis_qr_tokens_activos() TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolver_reserva_escaneo_b2b(
  p_qr_or_folio TEXT,
  p_negocio_nombre TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), false);
  v_code TEXT := NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(p_qr_or_folio, '')), '^#', ''), '');
  v_scope TEXT := NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_negocio_nombre, ''))), '');
  v_res RECORD;
  v_srv_estado TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida para validar pase.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_code IS NULL OR LENGTH(v_code) > 160 THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_scope IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a
    WHERE a.propietario_id = v_caller
      AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
      AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.nombre, ''))) = v_scope
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recepcion no autorizada para la sede solicitada.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_scope IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a
    WHERE a.propietario_id = v_caller
      AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solo operadores B2B activos o Admin Maestro pueden escanear pases.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT r.id, r.usuario_id, r.negocio_id, r.negocio_nombre, r.servicio_id,
         r.servicio, r.nombre_servicio, r.titulo_clase, r.categoria, r.estado,
         r.spot_number, r.fecha_clase, r.hora_inicio, r.precio_kc, r.costo_total,
         r.monto_escrow, r.monto_puerta, r.escrow_membresia, r.escrow_topup,
         r.created_at, r.qr_usado_at, r.es_pase_maestro, r.es_cuenta_sandbox
    INTO v_res
  FROM public.reservas r
  WHERE (
      (v_code ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND r.id = v_code::uuid)
      OR TRIM(COALESCE(r.qr_token, '')) = v_code
      OR (
        LENGTH(v_code) BETWEEN 6 AND 24
        AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')
        AND LEFT(REPLACE(r.id::text, '-', ''), 8) = LOWER(v_code)
      )
    )
    AND (v_scope IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.negocio_nombre, ''))) = v_scope)
    AND (
      v_is_admin
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a
        WHERE a.propietario_id = v_caller
          AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
          AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.nombre, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.negocio_nombre, '')))
      )
    )
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  IF v_res.servicio_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT s.estado INTO v_srv_estado
    FROM public.servicios s
    WHERE s.id = v_res.servicio_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_estado, ''))) IN ('cancelada', 'cancelado', 'eliminada', 'eliminado', 'inactiva', 'inactivo') THEN
      RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_res.id,
    'usuario_id', v_res.usuario_id,
    'negocio_id', v_res.negocio_id,
    'negocio_nombre', v_res.negocio_nombre,
    'servicio_id', v_res.servicio_id,
    'servicio', v_res.servicio,
    'nombre_servicio', v_res.nombre_servicio,
    'titulo_clase', v_res.titulo_clase,
    'categoria', v_res.categoria,
    'estado', v_res.estado,
    'spot_number', v_res.spot_number,
    'fecha_clase', v_res.fecha_clase,
    'hora_inicio', v_res.hora_inicio,
    'precio_kc', v_res.precio_kc,
    'costo_total', v_res.costo_total,
    'monto_escrow', v_res.monto_escrow,
    'monto_puerta', v_res.monto_puerta,
    'escrow_membresia', v_res.escrow_membresia,
    'escrow_topup', v_res.escrow_topup,
    'created_at', v_res.created_at,
    'qr_usado_at', v_res.qr_usado_at,
    'es_pase_maestro', v_res.es_pase_maestro,
    'es_cuenta_sandbox', v_res.es_cuenta_sandbox
  );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.resolver_reserva_escaneo_b2b(TEXT, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.resolver_reserva_escaneo_b2b(TEXT, TEXT) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.obtener_huellas_offline_b2b(
  p_negocio_nombre TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id UUID,
  qr_token_sha256 TEXT
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), false);
  v_scope TEXT := NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_negocio_nombre, ''))), '');
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a
    WHERE a.propietario_id = v_caller
      AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
      AND (v_scope IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.nombre, ''))) = v_scope)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recepcion no autorizada.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT r.id, encode(extensions.digest(TRIM(r.qr_token)::text, 'sha256'::text), 'hex') AS qr_token_sha256
  FROM public.reservas r
  WHERE r.qr_token IS NOT NULL
    AND LENGTH(TRIM(r.qr_token)) > 0
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')
    AND (v_scope IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.negocio_nombre, ''))) = v_scope)
    AND (
      v_is_admin
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a
        WHERE a.propietario_id = v_caller
          AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
          AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.nombre, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.negocio_nombre, '')))
      )
    )
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 300;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.obtener_huellas_offline_b2b(TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.obtener_huellas_offline_b2b(TEXT) TO authenticated;

-- 7. ENDURECIMIENTO DE CHECK-IN QR/TOTP EN SERVIDOR (SIN BYPASS DE TOTP PARA NO-ADMINS)
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.liquidar_checkin_qr_totp(UUID, TEXT, BIGINT, TEXT);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.liquidar_checkin_qr_totp(
  p_reserva_id UUID,
  p_qr_token TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_totp_step BIGINT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_qr_nonce TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_offline_scanned_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), false);
  v_current_step BIGINT := FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) / 60);
  v_offline_step BIGINT := CASE
    WHEN p_offline_scanned_at IS NOT NULL THEN FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM p_offline_scanned_at) / 60)
    ELSE NULL
  END;
  v_step BIGINT;
  v_res RECORD;
  v_mem NUMERIC;
  v_top NUMERIC;
  v_use_mem NUMERIC;
  v_use_top NUMERIC;
  v_clean_token TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_qr_token, '')), '');
  v_is_offline_valid BOOLEAN := false;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida para liquidar check-in.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_is_admin THEN
    IF v_clean_token IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDACION_QR_REQUERIDA: Token QR obligatorio en recepcion.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    IF p_totp_step IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDACION_TOTP_REQUERIDA: Ventana optica TOTP 60s obligatoria.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF p_offline_scanned_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF p_offline_scanned_at > NOW() + INTERVAL '90 seconds'
       OR p_offline_scanned_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'QR_EXPIRADO: Registro offline fuera de la ventana maxima de 24h.';
    END IF;
    IF p_totp_step IS NULL OR v_offline_step IS NULL OR ABS(v_offline_step - p_totp_step) > 1 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'QR_EXPIRADO: El codigo optico no coincide con el timestamp offline.';
    END IF;
    v_is_offline_valid := true;
  ELSIF p_totp_step IS NOT NULL AND ABS(v_current_step - p_totp_step) > 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'QR_EXPIRADO: El codigo optico de 60s ha caducado. Solicita el frame actual.';
  END IF;

  v_step := COALESCE(p_totp_step, v_current_step);

  IF p_offline_scanned_at IS NULL AND to_regprocedure('public.reconciliar_reservas_expiradas_noshow()') IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM public.reconciliar_reservas_expiradas_noshow();
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_res FROM public.reservas WHERE id = p_reserva_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reserva no encontrada.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a
    WHERE a.propietario_id = v_caller
      AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
      AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.nombre, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_res.negocio_nombre, '')))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recepcion no autorizada: esta reserva pertenece a otra sede.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF v_res.qr_usado_at IS NOT NULL
     OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_res.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada', 'cancelada', 'no_show', 'penalizada', 'expirada', 'rechazada', 'eliminada') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'QR_YA_UTILIZADO: Este pase ya fue liquidado, penalizado o cancelado previamente.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_is_admin THEN
    IF COALESCE(TRIM(v_res.qr_token), '') = '' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Token QR no emitido para esta reserva.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    IF v_clean_token <> TRIM(v_res.qr_token) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Token QR invalido para esta reserva.';
    END IF;
  ELSIF v_clean_token IS NOT NULL
        AND COALESCE(TRIM(v_res.qr_token), '') <> ''
        AND v_clean_token <> TRIM(v_res.qr_token)
        AND LOWER(v_clean_token) <> LOWER(v_res.id::text)
        AND LOWER(v_clean_token) <> LEFT(REPLACE(v_res.id::text, '-', ''), 8) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Token QR invalido para esta reserva.';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.qr_totp_replay_nonces (reserva_id, totp_step, qr_nonce, consumed_by)
  VALUES (p_reserva_id, v_step, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_qr_nonce), ''), v_step::text), v_caller);

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  IF COALESCE(v_res.monto_puerta, 0) > 0 THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0)
      INTO v_mem, v_top
    FROM public.perfiles
    WHERE id = v_res.usuario_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF (v_mem + v_top) < v_res.monto_puerta THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SALDO_PUERTA_INSUFICIENTE: El atleta requiere % KC para liquidar el 60%% restante.', v_res.monto_puerta;
    END IF;

    v_use_mem := LEAST(v_mem, v_res.monto_puerta);
    v_use_top := v_res.monto_puerta - v_use_mem;

    UPDATE public.perfiles
    SET kc_membresia = v_mem - v_use_mem,
        kc_topup = v_top - v_use_top,
        saldo_kc = (v_mem - v_use_mem) + (v_top - v_use_top)
    WHERE id = v_res.usuario_id;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.reservas
  SET estado = 'completada',
      monto_puerta = 0,
      qr_usado_at = NOW(),
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_reserva_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'status', 'checked_in',
    'reserva_id', p_reserva_id,
    'checked_in_at', NOW()
  );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.liquidar_checkin_qr_totp(UUID, TEXT, BIGINT, TEXT, TIMESTAMPTZ) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.liquidar_checkin_qr_totp(UUID, TEXT, BIGINT, TEXT, TIMESTAMPTZ) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.liquidar_pase_escrow(p_reserva_id UUID)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Liquidacion directa legacy reservada a Admin Maestro; utiliza liquidar_checkin_qr_totp con QR y TOTP.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN public.liquidar_checkin_qr_totp(p_reserva_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.liquidar_pase_escrow(UUID) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.liquidar_pase_escrow(UUID) TO authenticated;

-- 8. RESUMEN PASES MAESTROS EXCLUYENDO CUENTAS SANDBOX DE ESTADÍSTICAS REALES
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.obtener_resumen_pases_maestros(
  p_negocio_nombre TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_uid UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), false);
  v_target TEXT := NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_negocio_nombre, ''))), '');
  v_total INTEGER := 0;
  v_activos INTEGER := 0;
  v_liquidados INTEGER := 0;
  v_cancelados INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_target IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a
    WHERE a.propietario_id = v_uid
      AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
      AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.nombre, ''))) = v_target
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para auditar pases de otra sede.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, '')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada'))::int,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, '')) IN ('completada', 'usada'))::int,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, '')) = 'cancelada')::int
  INTO v_total, v_activos, v_liquidados, v_cancelados
  FROM public.reservas r
  WHERE COALESCE(r.es_cuenta_sandbox, false) = false
    AND (COALESCE(r.es_pase_maestro, false) = true OR (COALESCE(r.precio_kc, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(r.monto_escrow, 0) = 0))
    AND (
      (v_is_admin AND (v_target IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.negocio_nombre, ''))) = v_target))
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a
        WHERE a.propietario_id = v_uid
          AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
          AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.nombre, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.negocio_nombre, '')))
          AND (v_target IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.nombre, ''))) = v_target)
      )
    );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'total_emitidos', v_total,
    'activos', v_activos,
    'liquidados', v_liquidados,
    'cancelados', v_cancelados
  );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.obtener_resumen_pases_maestros(TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.obtener_resumen_pases_maestros(TEXT) TO authenticated;

-- 9. REVOKE PUBLIC/ANON Y FIJACIÓN DE search_path = public, pg_temp EN FUNCIONES CRÍTICAS EXISTENTES
DO $$
DECLARE
  v_sig TEXT;
  v_auth_rpcs TEXT[] := ARRAY[
    'public.inyectar_saldo_boveda(uuid, numeric, text, text)',
    'public.inyectar_fondos_boveda(uuid, numeric, text, text)',
    'public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox(numeric, text, numeric, text)',
    'public.procesar_reserva_escrow(uuid, text, text, numeric, uuid, text, integer, integer, boolean)',
    'public.cancelar_reserva_escrow_72h(uuid)',
    'public.ejecutar_barrido_noshow_escrow_40(uuid, integer)',
    'public.reconciliar_reservas_expiradas_noshow()',
    'public.obtener_perfil_checkin_b2b(uuid)',
    'public.responder_split_escrow_invitacion(uuid, text)',
    'public.registrar_operador_b2b_propio(text, text, text, text, text, text)',
    'public.activar_escudo_racha_24h()',
    'public.ascender_prestigio_nivel_99()',
    'public.anonimizar_y_cerrar_cuenta_propia()',
    'public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti(text, integer)',
    'public.cambiar_nivel_downgrade_propio(text)',
    'public.eliminar_post_comunidad_admin(uuid)',
    'public.registrar_lock_spot_temporal(uuid, text, integer, integer)',
    'public.obtener_ocupacion_spots_servicio(uuid, text)',
    'public.toggle_reaccion_comunidad_post(uuid, text)',
    'public.agregar_comentario_comunidad_post(uuid, text)',
    'public.eliminar_comentario_comunidad_post(uuid)',
    'public.toggle_guardado_comunidad_post(uuid)',
    'public.gestionar_relacion_usuario_ugc(uuid, text)',
    'public.reportar_contenido_ugc(uuid, text, text)'
  ];
  v_trigger_fns TEXT[] := ARRAY[
    'public.fn_guard_mensajes_directos_inmutables()',
    'public.fn_guard_reservas_anti_bypass()',
    'public.fn_sync_servicios_cupo_actual()',
    'public.fn_guard_reservas_spot_unico()'
  ];
BEGIN
  FOREACH v_sig IN ARRAY v_auth_rpcs LOOP
    IF to_regprocedure(v_sig) IS NOT NULL THEN
      EXECUTE format('ALTER FUNCTION %s SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp', v_sig);
      EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC, anon', v_sig);
      EXECUTE format('GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %s TO authenticated', v_sig);
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  FOREACH v_sig IN ARRAY v_trigger_fns LOOP
    IF to_regprocedure(v_sig) IS NOT NULL THEN
      EXECUTE format('ALTER FUNCTION %s SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp', v_sig);
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF to_regprocedure('public.procesar_webhook_stripe_kc(text, text, uuid, numeric, text)') IS NOT NULL THEN
    ALTER FUNCTION public.procesar_webhook_stripe_kc(TEXT, TEXT, UUID, NUMERIC, TEXT) SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp;
    REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.procesar_webhook_stripe_kc(TEXT, TEXT, UUID, NUMERIC, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
    GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.procesar_webhook_stripe_kc(TEXT, TEXT, UUID, NUMERIC, TEXT) TO service_role;
  END IF;

  DECLARE
    v_grant_cols TEXT;
  BEGIN
    SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(column_name), ', ' ORDER BY ordinal_position)
      INTO v_grant_cols
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'reservas'
      AND column_name <> 'qr_token';

    IF v_grant_cols IS NOT NULL THEN
      REVOKE SELECT ON TABLE public.reservas FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
      EXECUTE format('GRANT SELECT (%s) ON TABLE public.reservas TO authenticated', v_grant_cols);
    END IF;
  END;
END $$;

COMMIT;

-- KINETIC OS v2.7.4 — REFERENCIA DE MIGRACIÓN OMNICANAL (KINETIC_SQL_V274_OK)
-- Aplicada previamente por el CEO en Supabase SQL Editor (gcppxrlzxlgkuapktxvl).
-- Cero ejecuciones MCP remotas; archivo de referencia y auditoría local.
-- ============================================================================
-- 1. procesar_reserva_escrow:
--    - Soporta descuento VIP Flash (<3h o es_venta_flash = true):
--      Bronze 5%, Silver 10%, Gold 15%, Platinum 20% (o atributos.descuento_flash_pct).
--    - Calcula v_escrow = ROUND(v_total_con_descuento * 0.40) y v_puerta = v_total - v_escrow.
-- 2. ejecutar_barrido_noshow_escrow_40(p_reserva_id UUID, p_minutos_gracia INTEGER):
--    - Resuelve fecha + hora_inicio del servicio (o r.fecha_hora) para liquidar
--      el 40% Escrow retenido (80% sede / 20% Kinetic) en reservas vencidas sin
--      cobrar el 60% de puerta y marcando estado = 'no_show'.
-- 3. RLS e índices con (SELECT auth.uid()) en columnas FK y B-Tree/GIN activos.

    FILE: sql/seed_app_reviewers.sql

    -- ============================================================================
-- SCRIPT DE MIGRACIÓN Y APROVISIONAMIENTO PARA REVISORES (APPLE & GOOGLE)
-- Archivo: sql/seed_app_reviewers.sql
-- Propósito: Configuración Plug-and-Play de cuenta auditora Sandbox en Supabase
-- Seguridad v2.7.3: CERO contraseñas en texto plano en el repositorio.
-- Uso en Supabase SQL Editor (dentro de una transacción o bloque previo):
--   BEGIN;
--   SET LOCAL kinetic.reviewer_seed_password = '<CONTRASEÑA_AUDITOR_MIN_12_CARACTERES>';
--   -- Ejecuta este archivo completo y luego COMMIT;
-- ============================================================================

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

ALTER TABLE public.perfiles
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS es_cuenta_sandbox BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

DO $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID;
  v_email TEXT := 'apple.tester@kineticapp.com.mx';
  v_password TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(current_setting('kinetic.reviewer_seed_password', true), '')), '');
  v_encrypted_pw TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF v_password IS NULL OR LENGTH(v_password) < 12 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SEED_PASSWORD_REQUERIDO: Configura SET LOCAL kinetic.reviewer_seed_password con al menos 12 caracteres antes de ejecutar este script.'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 1. Verificar si el usuario ya existe en auth.users
  SELECT id INTO v_user_id
  FROM auth.users
  WHERE email = v_email
  LIMIT 1;

  v_encrypted_pw := extensions.crypt(v_password, extensions.gen_salt('bf'));

  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    v_user_id := gen_random_uuid();

    -- Insertar en auth.users con confirmación inmediata
    INSERT INTO auth.users (
      id,
      instance_id,
      email,
      encrypted_password,
      email_confirmed_at,
      created_at,
      updated_at,
      raw_app_meta_data,
      raw_user_meta_data,
      is_super_admin,
      role,
      aud
    ) VALUES (
      v_user_id,
      '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
      v_email,
      v_encrypted_pw,
      NOW(),
      NOW(),
      NOW(),
      '{"provider":"email","providers":["email"]}'::jsonb,
      '{"nombre":"Auditor Oficial App Store","es_cuenta_sandbox":true}'::jsonb,
      FALSE,
      'authenticated',
      'authenticated'
    );

    -- Registrar identidad para inicio de sesión por email/password en Supabase Auth
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO auth.identities (
        id,
        user_id,
        identity_data,
        provider,
        provider_id,
        last_sign_in_at,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        v_user_id,
        v_user_id,
        json_build_object('sub', v_user_id::text, 'email', v_email)::jsonb,
        'email',
        v_user_id::text,
        NOW(),
        NOW(),
        NOW()
      );
    EXCEPTION
      WHEN unique_violation THEN
        NULL;
      WHEN OTHERS THEN
        NULL;
    END;

    RAISE NOTICE 'Usuario auditor sandbox creado exitosamente en auth.users: % (ID: %)', v_email, v_user_id;
  ELSE
    -- Actualizar contraseña y confirmación del usuario existente
    UPDATE auth.users
    SET
      encrypted_password = v_encrypted_pw,
      email_confirmed_at = COALESCE(email_confirmed_at, NOW()),
      updated_at = NOW(),
      raw_user_meta_data = COALESCE(raw_user_meta_data, '{}'::jsonb) || '{"nombre":"Auditor Oficial App Store","es_cuenta_sandbox":true}'::jsonb
    WHERE id = v_user_id;

    RAISE NOTICE 'Usuario auditor sandbox actualizado en auth.users: % (ID: %)', v_email, v_user_id;
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  -- 2. Upsert idempotente en public.perfiles marcado como cuenta sandbox (excluida de finanzas reales)
  INSERT INTO public.perfiles (
    id,
    nombre,
    email,
    rol,
    nivel,
    kc_membresia,
    kc_topup,
    saldo_kc,
    waiver_firmado,
    waiver_version,
    waiver_fecha,
    ciudad_base,
    radar_publico,
    es_cuenta_sandbox
  ) VALUES (
    v_user_id,
    'Auditor Oficial App Store',
    v_email,
    'atleta',
    'Gold',
    400,
    600,
    1000,
    true,
    'v2.7.3',
    NOW(),
    'Los Cabos, B.C.S.',
    true,
    true
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    nombre = EXCLUDED.nombre,
    email = EXCLUDED.email,
    rol = EXCLUDED.rol,
    nivel = EXCLUDED.nivel,
    kc_membresia = EXCLUDED.kc_membresia,
    kc_topup = EXCLUDED.kc_topup,
    saldo_kc = EXCLUDED.saldo_kc,
    waiver_firmado = EXCLUDED.waiver_firmado,
    waiver_version = EXCLUDED.waiver_version,
    waiver_fecha = EXCLUDED.waiver_fecha,
    ciudad_base = EXCLUDED.ciudad_base,
    radar_publico = EXCLUDED.radar_publico,
    es_cuenta_sandbox = true;

  RAISE NOTICE 'Perfil del auditor sandbox aprovisionado en public.perfiles: % (Gold - 1,000 KC - es_cuenta_sandbox=true)', v_email;
END $$;

    // === src/__tests__/adversarial/kineticlubAudit.adversarial.test.ts === //
import fc from 'fast-check';
import { KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES } from '../../constants/exploreData';
import {
  applySmartGhostModeRanking,
  computePromoPricingKc,
  countRealClaimedTrophies,
  pickLevelBoxRewardKc,
  sanitizeOfficialKineticShareText,
  sanitizeWallCommentInput,
  sanitizeWallPostBody,
  sumClaimedChallengesXp,
  translateClubTerm,
} from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';

const g = globalThis as Record<string, unknown>;
const describeSuite =
  typeof g.describe === 'function'
    ? (g.describe as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
    : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();
const itCase =
  typeof g.it === 'function'
    ? (g.it as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
    : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();

const CATALOG_IDS: string[] = KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES.map((c: { id: string | number }) => String(c.id));
const LONE_SURROGATE_RE = /[\uD800-\uDBFF](?![\uDC00-\uDFFF])|(?<![\uD800-\uDBFF])[\uDC00-\uDFFF]/;

describeSuite('KINETIC OS v2.6.4 — Adversarial PBT Suite (KinetiClub Etapa 7 Pre-Estrés)', () => {
  itCase(
    'Propiedad 1: Cajas de Nivel entregan múltiplos exactos 10..20 KC y llaves de sistema jamás inflan trofeos (0..250) ni XP (500 runs)',
    () => {
      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.double({ noDefaultInfinity: false, noNaN: false }),
          fc.subarray(CATALOG_IDS, { minLength: 0, maxLength: 60 }),
          fc.array(
            fc.tuple(
              fc.constantFrom(
                'recompensa_diaria_',
                'misteriosa_diaria_',
                'escudo_racha_',
                'caja_nivel_',
                'm1_',
                'm2_',
                'm12_'
              ),
              fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 16 })
            ),
            { minLength: 0, maxLength: 30 }
          ),
          (randVal, realIds, sysPairs) => {
            const kc = pickLevelBoxRewardKc(randVal);
            if (kc % 10 !== 0 || kc < 10 || kc > 20) return false;

            const sysKeys = sysPairs.map(([prefix, suffix]) => `${prefix}${suffix}`);
            const pollutedList = [...realIds, ...sysKeys, ...realIds];

            const trophiesClean = countRealClaimedTrophies(realIds);
            const trophiesPolluted = countRealClaimedTrophies(pollutedList);
            const xpClean = sumClaimedChallengesXp(realIds);
            const xpPolluted = sumClaimedChallengesXp(pollutedList);

            return (
              trophiesClean === realIds.length &&
              trophiesPolluted === trophiesClean &&
              trophiesPolluted >= 0 &&
              trophiesPolluted <= 250 &&
              xpPolluted === xpClean &&
              xpPolluted >= 0
            );
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 2: Promos 0 KC preservan acceso gratuito (0/0) y precios > 0 respetan invariante Escrow 40/60 sin negativos (500 runs)',
    () => {
      const zeroCheck = computePromoPricingKc(0);
      if (zeroCheck.precio_kc !== 0 || zeroCheck.escrow40 !== 0) {
        throw new Error('Promo gratuita 0 KC fue alterada por fallback numérico');
      }

      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 1_000_000 }),
          fc.oneof(
            fc.constant(null),
            fc.constant(undefined),
            fc.constant(Number.NaN),
            fc.integer({ min: -500_000, max: 0 })
          ),
          (positivePrice, edgeInput) => {
            const pos = computePromoPricingKc(positivePrice);
            const expectedEscrow = Math.max(1, Math.round(positivePrice * 0.4));
            const remainder60 = pos.precio_kc - pos.escrow40;

            const edge = computePromoPricingKc(edgeInput);

            return (
              pos.precio_kc === positivePrice &&
              pos.escrow40 === expectedEscrow &&
              pos.escrow40 >= 1 &&
              pos.escrow40 <= pos.precio_kc &&
              remainder60 >= 0 &&
              pos.escrow40 + remainder60 === pos.precio_kc &&
              edge.precio_kc >= 0 &&
              edge.escrow40 >= 0 &&
              edge.escrow40 <= edge.precio_kc
            );
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 3: Smart Ghost Mode oculta exclusivamente a currentUserId preservando orden e integridad del Top 100 ajeno (500 runs)',
    () => {
      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.array(
            fc.record({
              id: fc.uuid(),
              nombre: fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 24 }),
              xpTotal: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 100_000 }),
            }),
            { minLength: 0, maxLength: 100 }
          ),
          fc.uuid(),
          fc.boolean(),
          (others, myId, injectSelf) => {
            const cleanOthers = others.filter((a) => a.id !== myId);
            const pool = injectSelf
              ? [
                  ...cleanOthers.slice(0, Math.floor(cleanOthers.length / 2)),
                  { id: myId, nombre: 'Yo', xpTotal: 9999 },
                  ...cleanOthers.slice(Math.floor(cleanOthers.length / 2)),
                ]
              : cleanOthers;

            const ghostOut = applySmartGhostModeRanking(pool, true, myId);
            const publicOut = applySmartGhostModeRanking(pool, false, myId);

            const selfHiddenInGhost = ghostOut.every((a) => a.id !== myId);
            const othersOrderIntact =
              ghostOut.length === cleanOthers.length &&
              ghostOut.every((a, i) => a.id === cleanOthers[i].id);
            const publicPreservesAll =
              publicOut.length === pool.length &&
              publicOut.every((a, i) => a.id === pool[i].id);

            return selfHiddenInGhost && othersOrderIntact && publicPreservesAll;
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 4: Sanitización de Shares y Comentarios elimina URLs de Maps, conserva emojis compuestos sin romper pares UTF-16 y garantiza 1 sola URL oficial (500 runs)',
    () => {
      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.string({ minLength: 0, maxLength: 650 }),
          fc.constantFrom(
            '',
            'https://maps.app.goo.gl/abc123XYZ',
            'https://www.google.com/maps/place/Tijuana',
            'https://maps.google.com/?q=32.5,-117.0',
            'https://goo.gl/maps/998877',
            'https://kineticapp.com.mx https://www.kineticapp.com.mx/club'
          ),
          fc.constantFrom('🔥⚡', '🏋️‍♂️🏆', '👨‍👩‍👧‍👦👏', '💪🏼🚀'),
          (randomText, injectedUrl, compoundEmoji) => {
            const dirtyInput = `${compoundEmoji} ${randomText} ${injectedUrl} ${compoundEmoji.repeat(120)}`;
            const shareOut = sanitizeOfficialKineticShareText(dirtyInput);
            const commOut = sanitizeWallCommentInput(dirtyInput);
            const postOut = sanitizeWallPostBody(dirtyInput);

            const officialMatches = shareOut.match(/kineticapp\.com\.mx/gi) || [];
            const hasMapsInShare =
              /maps\.app\.goo\.gl|google\.[a-z.]+\/maps|maps\.google\.|goo\.gl\/maps/i.test(shareOut);
            const hasMapsInComm =
              /maps\.app\.goo\.gl|google\.[a-z.]+\/maps|maps\.google\.|goo\.gl\/maps/i.test(commOut);
            const hasMapsInPost =
              /maps\.app\.goo\.gl|google\.[a-z.]+\/maps|maps\.google\.|goo\.gl\/maps/i.test(postOut);

            const enAccess = translateClubTerm('Acceso Base', 'en');
            const esAccess = translateClubTerm('Base Access', 'es');

            return (
              shareOut.endsWith('\nhttps://kineticapp.com.mx') &&
              officialMatches.length === 1 &&
              !hasMapsInShare &&
              !hasMapsInComm &&
              !hasMapsInPost &&
              Array.from(commOut).length <= 500 &&
              Array.from(postOut).length <= 2000 &&
              !LONE_SURROGATE_RE.test(commOut) &&
              !LONE_SURROGATE_RE.test(postOut) &&
              enAccess === 'Base Access' &&
              esAccess === 'Acceso Base'
            );
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );
});

import fc from 'fast-check';
import { deduplicateCanonicalAthletes } from '../../services/kineticAthleteDeduplication';
import {
  buildDeterministicDmCode,
  canInitiateOrHydrateDm,
  extractPeerUuidFromDmCode,
  filterAntiZombieDmThreads,
  KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID,

} from '../../services/kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import { IDirectMessageThread } from '../../services/kineticDirectMessagesBridge';
import {
  decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array,
  encodeUint8ArrayToBase64,
  isLocalOrEphemeralMediaUri,
  isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl,
} from '../../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';

const g = globalThis as Record<string, unknown>;
const describeSuite =
  typeof g.describe === 'function'
    ? (g.describe as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
    : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();
const itCase =
  typeof g.it === 'function'
    ? (g.it as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
    : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();

const CANONICAL_DM_RE =
  /^DM-[0-9A-F]{8}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{12}-[0-9A-F]{8}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{12}$/;

describeSuite('KINETIC OS v2.6.5-A — Adversarial PBT Suite (Cloud Sync Uint8Array + DMs Deterministas + Deduplicación)', () => {
  itCase(
    'Propiedad 1: Simetría, formato canónico DM-<UUID_A>-<UUID_B>, rechazo 100% de auto-chat y marca Kinetic Oficial (500 runs)',
    () => {
      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.uuid(),
          fc.uuid(),
          fc.string({ minLength: 0, maxLength: 40 }),
          fc.string({ minLength: 0, maxLength: 40 }),
          (uuidA, uuidB, nameA, nameB) => {
            const selfBlocked = !canInitiateOrHydrateDm(uuidA, uuidA, uuidA, nameA, nameA);
            if (!selfBlocked) return false;

            const masterLabel = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({
              id: KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID,
              name: nameA,
              email: 'administrador@kinetic.com.mx',
            });
            if (masterLabel !== 'Kinetic Oficial') return false;

            if (uuidA.toLowerCase() === uuidB.toLowerCase()) return true;

            const codeAB = buildDeterministicDmCode(uuidA, nameA, uuidB, nameB);
            const codeBA = buildDeterministicDmCode(uuidB, 'Kinetic Athlete', uuidA, 'Atleta Kinetic');

            return (
              codeAB === codeBA &&
              CANONICAL_DM_RE.test(codeAB) &&
              extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(codeAB, uuidA) === uuidB.toLowerCase() &&
              extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(codeAB, uuidB) === uuidA.toLowerCase() &&
              canInitiateOrHydrateDm(uuidA, uuidB, uuidA, nameA, nameB) === true
            );
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 2: Invariante Anti-Zombi — 0 hilos vivos cuando mensajes <= deletedAt; sobrevive solo si existe mensaje > deletedAt (500 runs)',
    () => {
      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.uuid(),
          fc.uuid(),
          fc.integer({ min: 1_700_000_000_000, max: 1_900_000_000_000 }),
          fc.array(fc.integer({ min: -500_000, max: 500_000 }), { minLength: 1, maxLength: 12 }),
          fc.boolean(),
          (myUid, peerUid, deletedAtMs, deltas, markByPeerOnly) => {
            if (myUid.toLowerCase() === peerUid.toLowerCase()) return true;
            const dmCode = buildDeterministicDmCode(myUid, 'Me', peerUid, 'Peer');
            const deletedIso = new Date(deletedAtMs).toISOString();

            const messages = deltas.map((delta, idx) => ({
              id: `m_${idx}`,
              senderId: idx % 2 === 0 ? myUid : peerUid,
              senderName: idx % 2 === 0 ? 'Me' : 'Peer',
              text: `msg_${idx}`,
              createdAt: new Date(deletedAtMs + delta).toISOString(),
            }));

            const thread: IDirectMessageThread = {
              threadId: dmCode,
              dmCode,
              requesterId: myUid,
              requesterName: 'Me',
              targetId: peerUid,
              targetName: 'Peer',
              status: 'accepted',
              updatedAt: messages[messages.length - 1].createdAt,
              messages,
            };

            const deletedMap: Record<string, string> = markByPeerOnly
              ? { [`PEER:${peerUid.toLowerCase()}`]: deletedIso }
              : { [dmCode]: deletedIso, [`PEER:${peerUid.toLowerCase()}`]: deletedIso };

            const alive = filterAntiZombieDmThreads([thread], deletedMap, myUid, 'Me');
            const expectedNewerCount = deltas.filter((d) => d > 0).length;

            if (expectedNewerCount === 0) {
              return alive.length === 0;
            }
            return (
              alive.length === 1 &&
              alive[0].messages.length === expectedNewerCount &&
              alive[0].messages.every((m) => Date.parse(m.createdAt) > deletedAtMs)
            );
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );

    'Propiedad 4: Integridad binaria Uint8Array round-trip (Base64 y DataURI) y resiliencia ante entradas corruptas/locales (500 runs)',
    () => {
      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.uint8Array({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 512 }),
          fc.boolean(),
          fc.string({ minLength: 0, maxLength: 60 }),
          (bytes, wrapAsDataUri, randomGarbage) => {
            const b64 = encodeUint8ArrayToBase64(bytes);
            const input = wrapAsDataUri ? `data:image/jpeg;base64,${b64}` : b64;
            const decoded = decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(input);

            if (!(decoded instanceof Uint8Array) || decoded.byteLength !== bytes.byteLength || decoded.byteLength === 0) {
              return false;
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 1) {
              if (decoded[i] !== bytes[i]) return false;

            const corruptHeaderRes = decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array('data:image/jpeg;base64,');

    // === src/__tests__/adversarial/kineticlubHybridFinalC.adversarial.test.ts === //
import fc from 'fast-check';
import { computeTrophyVolumetricProjection, normalizeAngle360 } from '../../components/kineticlub/KineticTrophyVolumetricEngine';
import { formatDisciplineBilingual } from '../../constants/kineticDisciplineMap';
import { KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID } from '../../services/kineticAthleteDeduplication';
import { IDirectMessageThread } from '../../services/kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import { formatOfficialOrTierLabel, formatStreakDaysBadge, translateClubTerm } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { MessengerFilterTab, SocialGraphZoneFilter, buildUnifiedMessengerStream, computeSocialGraphSuggestions, extractMessengerRequestsAndRestricted } from '../../services/kineticlubSocialGraphHelper';
import { translateDiscipline } from '../../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';

declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;

const expectTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const expectEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg = `Expected ${String(expected)}, got ${String(actual)}`): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(msg);
};
const expectNe = <T>(actual: T, forbidden: T, msg = `Unexpected equal value ${String(actual)}`): void => {
  if (actual === forbidden) throw new Error(msg);
};

const MY_UID = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
const idArb = fc.constantFrom(
  MY_UID,
  KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID,
  '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222',
  '33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333',
  '44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444',
  '55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555',
  '__proto__',
  'constructor',
  ''
);

const isoArb = fc.integer({ min: 1_700_000_000_000, max: 1_800_000_000_000 }).map((ms) => new Date(ms).toISOString());

const dmThreadArb: fc.Arbitrary<IDirectMessageThread> = fc.record({
  dmCode: fc.constantFrom('DM_A', 'DM_B', 'DM_C', '__proto__', 'constructor', ''),
  threadId: fc.constantFrom('th-1', 'th-2', 'th-3', '__proto__'),
  requesterId: idArb,
  requesterName: fc.constantFrom('Carlos', 'Elena', 'Kinetic Oficial', 'Yo'),
  targetId: idArb,
  targetName: fc.constantFrom('Mateo', 'Sofia', 'Kinetic Oficial', 'Yo'),
  status: fc.constantFrom('accepted', 'pending') as fc.Arbitrary<'accepted' | 'pending'>,
  updatedAt: isoArb,
  messages: fc.array(
    fc.record({
      id: fc.constantFrom('m1', 'm2', 'm3', 'm4'),
      senderId: idArb,
      senderName: fc.constantFrom('Carlos', 'Mateo', 'Elena'),
      text: fc.constantFrom('Listo para entrenar', 'Nos vemos en Pádel', 'Hola escuadrón', ''),
      createdAt: isoArb,
    }),
    { maxLength: 4 }
  ),
});

const squadArb = fc.record({
  id: fc.constantFrom('sq-1', 'sq-2', 'sq-bridge', '__proto__', ''),
  nombre: fc.constantFrom('Escuadrón Cabo Fuerza', 'Pádel San José', '[DM_123] Bridge', ''),
  codigo_invitacion: fc.constantFrom('CABO01', 'DM-1111', ''),
  creador_id: idArb,
  integrantes_ids: fc.array(idArb, { maxLength: 4 }),
  integrantes_nombres: fc.array(fc.constantFrom('Carlos', 'Elena', 'Sofia'), { maxLength: 3 }),
  created_at: isoArb,
});

describe('Sub-Fase v2.6.5-C — Messenger Unificado, Trofeo 3D Sólido 360° y Grafo Social Bilingüe', () => {
  it('Propiedad 1 (500 corridas): Bandeja Messenger ordena descendente, sin duplicados, excluye bloqueados/restringidos y filtra tabs', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.array(dmThreadArb, { maxLength: 10 }),
        fc.array(squadArb, { maxLength: 6 }),
        fc.array(idArb, { maxLength: 3 }),
        fc.array(idArb, { maxLength: 2 }),
        fc.constantFrom<MessengerFilterTab>('all', 'unread', 'squads'),
        fc.constantFrom('es', 'en') as fc.Arbitrary<'es' | 'en'>,
        (dmThreads, misEquipos, blockedArr, restrictedArr, filterTab, lang) => {
          const blockedSet = new Set(blockedArr.filter(Boolean));
          const restrictedSet = new Set(restrictedArr.filter(Boolean));
          const poisonSeen = Object.assign(Object.create(null), { 'dm:DM_A': 1, 'sq:sq-1': 0 }) as Record<string, number>;

          const rows = buildUnifiedMessengerStream({
            dmThreads,
            misEquipos,
            squadRoomsMessagesMap: { 'sq-1': [{ id: 'sm1', usuario_id: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222', mensaje: 'Vamos', created_at: '2026-05-01T10:00:00.000Z' }] },
            seenCountsMap: poisonSeen,
            blockedIdsSet: blockedSet,
            restrictedIdsSet: restrictedSet,
            myUserId: MY_UID,
            myUserName: 'Yo',
            filterTab,
            lang,
          });

          const seenRowIds = new Set<string>();
          for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            const row = rows[i];
            expectTrue(!seenRowIds.has(row.id), `Row ID duplicado: ${row.id}`);
            seenRowIds.add(row.id);
            if (i > 0) expectTrue(rows[i - 1].lastActivityMs >= row.lastActivityMs, 'Orden cronológico descendente violado');
            if (row.kind === 'dm' && row.peerId) {
              const lowPeer = row.peerId.toLowerCase();
              for (const b of blockedSet) {
                const cleanB = b.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (cleanB && cleanB !== '__proto__' && cleanB !== 'constructor') {
                  expectNe(lowPeer, cleanB, 'Interlocutor bloqueado expuesto');
                  expectNe(lowPeer.replace(/-/g, ''), cleanB.replace(/-/g, ''), 'Interlocutor bloqueado sin guiones expuesto');
                }
              }
              for (const r of restrictedSet) {
                const cleanR = r.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (cleanR && cleanR !== '__proto__' && cleanR !== 'constructor') {
                  expectNe(lowPeer, cleanR, 'Interlocutor restringido expuesto');
                }
              }
            }
            if (filterTab === 'unread') expectTrue(row.unreadCount > 0, 'Filtro unread dejó pasar fila en 0');
            if (filterTab === 'squads') expectEq(row.kind, 'squad', 'Filtro squads dejó pasar DM');
          }

          const reqSummary = extractMessengerRequestsAndRestricted({
            dmThreads, blockedIdsSet: blockedSet, restrictedIdsSet: restrictedSet, myUserId: MY_UID, myUserName: 'Yo',
          });
          expectEq(reqSummary.totalRequestsBadge, reqSummary.incomingPendingDms.length + reqSummary.validSquadInvites.length);
          for (const pdm of reqSummary.incomingPendingDms) {
            expectEq(String(pdm.targetId || '').toLowerCase() === MY_UID || pdm.targetName === 'Yo', true, 'DM pendiente ajeno filtrado');
          }
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 2 (500 corridas): Proyección volumétrica 360° jamás colapsa a línea plana ni espeja el grabado trasero', () => {
    for (const fixedAngle of [0, 90, 180, 270, -90, -180, 360, NaN, Infinity]) {
      const p = computeTrophyVolumetricProjection(fixedAngle, 160);
      expectTrue(p.projectedWidthPx >= 160 * 0.2, `Colapso plano en ${fixedAngle}`);
      expectTrue(p.spineWidthPx >= 160 * 0.2, `Lomo menor al 20% en ${fixedAngle}`);
      expectEq(p.layers.length, 9);
      expectEq(p.isMirroredText, false);
    }
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(fc.double({ min: -3600, max: 3600, noNaN: true }), fc.integer({ min: 24, max: 400 }), (angleDeg, size) => {
        const norm = normalizeAngle360(angleDeg);
        expectTrue(norm >= 0 && norm < 360, 'Ángulo fuera de [0, 360)');
        const proj = computeTrophyVolumetricProjection(angleDeg, size);
        expectTrue(proj.projectedWidthPx >= size * 0.2, 'Ancho proyectado < 20%');
        expectTrue(proj.spineWidthPx >= size * 0.2, 'Lomo central < 20%');
        expectEq(proj.layers.length, 9);
        expectEq(proj.isMirroredText, false);
        if (proj.cosTheta >= 0) expectEq(proj.activeFace, 'front');
        else { expectEq(proj.activeFace, 'back'); expectEq(proj.isBackEngravingReadable, true); }
      }),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 3 (500 corridas): Grafo social respeta radar_publico/bloqueados y gramática bilingüe 1 DÍA / ⚡ Oficial Kinetic / Volleyball', () => {
    expectEq(formatStreakDaysBadge(1, 'es'), '1 DÍA');
    expectEq(formatStreakDaysBadge(1, 'en'), '1 DAY');
    expectEq(translateClubTerm('Black', 'es'), '⚡ Oficial Kinetic');
    expectEq(translateClubTerm('Black', 'en'), '⚡ Kinetic Official');
    expectEq(formatOfficialOrTierLabel('Black', 'es'), '⚡ Oficial Kinetic');
    expectEq(formatOfficialOrTierLabel('Black', 'en'), '⚡ Kinetic Official');
    expectEq(translateDiscipline('Voleibol', 'en'), 'Volleyball');
    expectEq(translateDiscipline('Ninguno', 'en'), 'None');
    expectEq(formatDisciplineBilingual('Voleibol', 'en'), 'Volleyball');

    const athleteArb = fc.record({
      id: idArb,
      nombre: fc.constantFrom('Valeria', 'Diego', 'Camila', 'Kinetic Oficial'),
      radar_publico: fc.boolean(),
      zona: fc.constantFrom('Cabo San Lucas', 'Corredor Turístico', 'San José del Cabo', 'La Paz', 'Los Cabos'),
      gimnasio: fc.constantFrom('Cabo Fitness Club', '40-0 PADEL CLUB', 'Kinetic Oficial'),
      disciplina: fc.constantFrom('Fuerza', 'Pádel', 'Voleibol'),
      racha: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 60 }),
    });

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.array(athleteArb, { maxLength: 14 }),
        fc.array(idArb, { maxLength: 3 }),
        fc.constantFrom<SocialGraphZoneFilter>('ALL', 'CABO SAN LUCAS', 'CORREDOR TURÍSTICO', 'SAN JOSÉ DEL CABO', 'LA PAZ'),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 365 }),
        (athletes, blockedArr, zoneFilter, days) => {
          expectEq(formatStreakDaysBadge(days, 'es'), days === 1 ? '1 DÍA' : `${days} DÍAS`);
          expectEq(formatStreakDaysBadge(days, 'en'), days === 1 ? '1 DAY' : `${days} DAYS`);
          const blockedSet = new Set(blockedArr.filter(Boolean));
          const suggestions = computeSocialGraphSuggestions({ athletes, blockedIdsSet: blockedSet, myUserId: MY_UID, myUserName: 'Yo', zoneFilter });
          for (const s of suggestions) {
            expectNe(s.athlete?.radar_publico, false, 'radar_publico === false sugerido');
            expectNe(s.id.toLowerCase(), MY_UID, 'Auto-sugerencia prohibida');
            expectNe(s.id.toLowerCase(), KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID, 'Master admin sugerido');
            for (const b of blockedSet) {
              const cleanB = b.trim().toLowerCase();
              if (cleanB && cleanB !== '__proto__' && cleanB !== 'constructor') expectNe(s.id.toLowerCase(), cleanB, 'Bloqueado sugerido');
            }
            if (zoneFilter !== 'ALL') expectEq(s.zone, zoneFilter, 'Filtro zona violado');
          }
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });
});

const describeSuite = typeof g.describe === 'function'

const itCase = typeof g.it === 'function'
  ? (g.it as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void) : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();

const GMAPS_URL_DETECT_RE =
  /https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?(?:google\.[a-z.]+\/maps|maps\.google\.[a-z.]+|maps\.app\.goo\.gl|goo\.gl\/maps)\S*/i;

describeSuite('KINETIC OS v2.6.5-B — Adversarial PBT Suite (Muro Híbrido 4:5 + Historias <24h + Notificaciones)', () => {
  itCase(
    'Propiedad 1: Pureza Orgánica del Muro Social (cero club_promo, cero URLs Google Maps, cero bloqueados UGC y filtro hiperlocal determinista, 500 runs)',
    () => {
      const zoneArb = fc.constantFrom<KineticCabosZoneFilter>('all', 'Cabo San Lucas', 'Corredor Turístico', 'San José del Cabo');
      const modeArb = fc.constantFrom<KineticWallFeedMode>('for_you', 'my_tribe');
      const postArb = fc.record({
        id: fc.oneof(fc.uuid(), fc.constantFrom('fpromo_1', 'promo_club_9', 'post_org_1')),
        kind: fc.constantFrom('post', 'club_promo', undefined),
        isPromo: fc.boolean(),
        userId: fc.uuid(),
        authorName: fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 24 }),
        zona: fc.constantFrom('Cabo San Lucas', 'Corredor Turístico', 'San José del Cabo', 'Los Cabos', ''),
        venue: fc.constantFrom('Cabo San Lucas Gym', 'Palmilla Corredor', 'San José Centro', 'Kinetic Oficial'),
        discipline: fc.constantFrom('Fuerza', 'CrossFit', 'Pilates', 'Yoga'),
        bodyEs: fc.oneof(
          fc.string({ minLength: 0, maxLength: 60 }),
          fc.constant('Gran sesión hoy https://maps.app.goo.gl/abc123XYZ en Los Cabos'),
          fc.constant('Entrenando fuerte https://www.google.com/maps/place/Cabo+San+Lucas ¡vamos!')
        ),
        bodyEn: fc.oneof(fc.string({ minLength: 0, maxLength: 60 }), fc.constant('Session at https://goo.gl/maps/xyz987 today')),
        createdAtMs: fc.integer({ min: 1_700_000_000_000, max: 1_900_000_000_000 }),
      });

      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.array(postArb, { minLength: 0, maxLength: 25 }),
          fc.array(fc.uuid(), { minLength: 0, maxLength: 6 }),
          fc.array(fc.uuid(), { minLength: 0, maxLength: 6 }),
          zoneArb,
          modeArb,
          (posts, blockedArr, tribeArr, zoneFilter, feedMode) => {
            const blockedSet = new Set(blockedArr.map((id) => id.toLowerCase()));
            const tribeSet = new Set(tribeArr.map((id) => id.toLowerCase()));
            const stream = buildOrganicHyperlocalWallStream({
              posts, blockedIds: blockedSet, zoneFilter, feedMode, tribeMemberKeys: tribeSet,
            });
            for (const item of stream) {
              const idStr = String(item.id || '');
              if (item.kind === 'club_promo' || item.isPromo || idStr.startsWith('fpromo_') || idStr.startsWith('promo_')) return false;
              if (GMAPS_URL_DETECT_RE.test(String(item.bodyEs || '')) || GMAPS_URL_DETECT_RE.test(String(item.bodyEn || ''))) return false;
              const uidLow = String(item.userId || '').toLowerCase();
              if (uidLow && blockedSet.has(uidLow)) return false;
              if (zoneFilter !== 'all' && resolveLosCabosZona(item.zona, item.venue) !== zoneFilter) return false;
              if (feedMode === 'my_tribe') {
                const nameLow = String(item.authorName || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                if (!item.isMine && !tribeSet.has(uidLow) && !tribeSet.has(nameLow)) return false;
              }
            }
            return true;
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 2: Expiración estricta <24h de Historias y rechazo 100% de URLs vacías o slides corruptos (500 runs)',
    () => {
      const FIXED_NOW = 1_760_000_000_000;
      const slideArb = fc.record({
        id: fc.uuid(),
        imageUrl: fc.oneof(
          fc.constant('https://gcppxrlzxlgkuapktxvl.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/avatars/u1/story_1.jpg'),
          fc.constant('data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRg=='),
          fc.constant(''),
          fc.constant('blob:http://localhost:8081/broken'),
          fc.constant('file:///local/temp.jpg')
        ),
        caption: fc.string({ minLength: 0, maxLength: 40 }),
        createdAtMs: fc.integer({ min: FIXED_NOW - STORY_STRICT_TTL_MS * 3, max: FIXED_NOW + 60_000 }),
      });

      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.uuid(),
          fc.oneof(fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 20 }), fc.constantFrom('José María Peña', 'constructor', '__proto__', 'Sofía Núñez')),
          fc.boolean(),
          fc.array(slideArb, { minLength: 1, maxLength: 8 }),
          (athleteId, athleteName, isBlockedByUuid, rawSlides) => {
            const ownerStorageKey = normalizeStoryLookupKey(athleteId, athleteName) || 'kineticuser';
            const slides = rawSlides.map((s) => ({ ...s, ownerKey: ownerStorageKey, ownerName: athleteName }));
            const rawMap: Record<string, any[]> = { [ownerStorageKey]: slides };
            const blockedSet = isBlockedByUuid ? new Set([athleteId.toLowerCase()]) : new Set<string>();
            const strictMap = filterActiveStoriesMapStrict(rawMap, FIXED_NOW, blockedSet);
            const hasActive = hasActiveStoryInMap(strictMap, athleteId, athleteName, FIXED_NOW, blockedSet);
            const carousel = buildRealActiveStoryCarouselEntries({
              activeMap: strictMap,
              storyAthletes: [{ id: athleteId, nombre: athleteName }],
              nowMs: FIXED_NOW,
              blockedIds: blockedSet,
            });
            const expectedValid = slides.filter(
              (s) =>
                (s.imageUrl.startsWith('https://') || s.imageUrl.startsWith('data:image/')) &&
                FIXED_NOW - s.createdAtMs < STORY_STRICT_TTL_MS &&
                FIXED_NOW - s.createdAtMs >= -300_000
            );
            for (const s of slides) {
              if (FIXED_NOW - s.createdAtMs >= STORY_STRICT_TTL_MS && isValidActiveStorySlide(s, FIXED_NOW)) return false;
            }
            if (isBlockedByUuid || expectedValid.length === 0) {
              return !hasActive && carousel.length === 0 && !strictMap[ownerStorageKey];
            }
            return hasActive && carousel.length === 1 && strictMap[ownerStorageKey]?.length === expectedValid.length;
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 3: Partición temporal exacta y disjunta de Notificaciones (Hoy / 7d / 30d) sin actores bloqueados (500 runs)',
    () => {
      const FIXED_NOW = 1_760_000_000_000;
      const notifArb: fc.Arbitrary<IKineticNotificationItem> = fc.record({
        id: fc.uuid(),
        kind: fc.constantFrom('reaction', 'comment', 'squad_invite', 'dm_request'),
        actorId: fc.option(fc.uuid(), { nil: null }),
        actorName: fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 24 }),
        titleEs: fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 40 }),
        titleEn: fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 40 }),
        subtitleEs: fc.string({ minLength: 0, maxLength: 40 }),
        subtitleEn: fc.string({ minLength: 0, maxLength: 40 }),
        timestampMs: fc.integer({ min: FIXED_NOW - NOTIF_MONTH_MS * 2, max: FIXED_NOW + 600_000 }),
      });

      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.array(notifArb, { minLength: 0, maxLength: 35 }),
          fc.array(fc.uuid(), { minLength: 0, maxLength: 6 }),
          fc.integer({ min: FIXED_NOW - NOTIF_MONTH_MS, max: FIXED_NOW }),
          (items, blockedArr, seenCutoffMs) => {
            const blockedSet = new Set(blockedArr.map((u) => u.toLowerCase()));
            const { today, week, month, allValid } = partitionNotificationsByWindow(items, FIXED_NOW, blockedSet);
            const unseen = countUnseenNotifications(items, seenCutoffMs, FIXED_NOW, blockedSet);

            if (today.length + week.length + month.length !== allValid.length) return false;
            if (new Set([...today, ...week, ...month].map((i) => i.id)).size !== allValid.length) return false;
            for (let i = 1; i < allValid.length; i++) {
              if (allValid[i - 1].timestampMs < allValid[i].timestampMs) return false;
            }
            for (const it of allValid) {
              if (it.actorId && blockedSet.has(it.actorId.toLowerCase())) return false;
            }
            const okToday = today.every((i) => FIXED_NOW - i.timestampMs < NOTIF_DAY_MS);
            const okWeek = week.every((i) => FIXED_NOW - i.timestampMs >= NOTIF_DAY_MS && FIXED_NOW - i.timestampMs < NOTIF_WEEK_MS);
            const okMonth = month.every((i) => FIXED_NOW - i.timestampMs >= NOTIF_WEEK_MS && FIXED_NOW - i.timestampMs < NOTIF_MONTH_MS);
            return okToday && okWeek && okMonth && unseen === allValid.filter((i) => i.timestampMs > seenCutoffMs).length;
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );
});

    FILE: src/__tests__/adversarial/ola2UxFinanceConciergeV279.adversarial.test.ts

    // === src/__tests__/adversarial/ola2UxFinanceConciergeV279.adversarial.test.ts === //
import fc from 'fast-check';
import {
  computeEscrow4060Split,
  isEventEditorFormValid,
  resolveEventBookingLockState,
} from '../../components/eventos/eventDetailsPureHelpers';
import { calcularCorteSemanalB2B } from '../../services/adminB2BCutEngine';
import { buildCeoConsolidatedWeeklyReport } from '../../services/bovedaB2BDataHelper';
import {
  computeAdminTierAndDisciplineMetrics,
  isPaidActiveVipSubscriber,
} from '../../services/admin/adminMetricsCalculator';
import {
  buildEventosClubLookup,
  computeEventLocalLifecycle,
  mapServiceRowToEventosItem,
  matchesDaySchedule,
} from '../../services/eventosScreenHelpers';
import { projectEventDateForSearch } from '../../services/eventosHelpers';
import { hydrateServicesGpsWithClubCoords } from '../../services/exploreZoneHelpers';
import {
  buildConciergePureReply,
  classifyConciergeSemanticIntent,
  detectConciergeQueryLanguage,
} from '../../services/kineticConciergeIntentEngine';
import { resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing } from '../../services/kineticFlashSaleHelper';
import { buildNativeKineticPdfHtml } from '../../services/kineticNativePdfHtmlBuilder';
