  computeCanonicalVenueDistanceKm,
  evaluateVenueOpenStatusMazatlan,
  getMazatlanNowParts,
  getMazatlanWeekAndDayBounds,
  mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs,
  resolveCanonicalVenueCoordinates,
  setCanonicalUserGpsOrigin,
} from '../../services/kineticVenueCanonicalGeoAndHours';
import {
  computePrestigeInfo,
  resolveUnifiedAthleteProgression,
} from '../../services/kineticlubLevelsEngine';
import { computeHasKinetiClubTabAlert } from '../../services/kineticlubTabAlertStore';

const g = globalThis as Record<string, unknown>;
const describeSuite =
  typeof g.describe === 'function'
    ? (g.describe as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
    : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();
const itCase =
  typeof g.it === 'function'
    ? (g.it as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
    : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();

const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string) => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const assertEq = (a: unknown, b: unknown, msg: string) => {
  if (a !== b) throw new Error(`${msg} (expected ${String(b)}, got ${String(a)})`);
};

describeSuite('KINETIC OS v2.7.9 — Ola 2 UX, Finanzas, GPS/Mazatlán, Concierge y Progresión', () => {
  itCase('Propiedad 1: GPS canónico único sede/evento, ● ABIERTO/OPEN en Mazatlán, recurrencia, candado y 200 KC 40/60', () => {
    setCanonicalUserGpsOrigin({ latitude: 22.8905, longitude: -109.9167 }, true);
    const fixedNow = new Date(mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(2026, 11, 18, 10, 30, 0, 0));
    const mzNow = getMazatlanNowParts(fixedNow);
    assertEq(mzNow.isoDate, '2026-11-18', 'Mazatlan isoDate exact');

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.double({ min: 22.85, max: 23.09, noNaN: true }),
        fc.double({ min: -109.96, max: -109.68, noNaN: true }),
        fc.constantFrom('es', 'en') as fc.Arbitrary<'es' | 'en'>,
        fc.constantFrom('Diario', 'Semanal', 'Mensual'),
        fc.constantFrom('inactivo', 'activo', 'cancelado'),
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 100 }).map((n) => n * 10),
        (venueLat, venueLon, lang, freq, rawEstado, validPriceKc) => {
          const club = {
            id: 'af-canon-1',
            nombre: 'Sede Canonica Cabo',
            latitud: Number(venueLat.toFixed(6)),
            longitud: Number(venueLon.toFixed(6)),
            estado: 'activo',
            horarios: 'Lunes a Sábado • 06:00 a 21:00',
          };
          const canon = resolveCanonicalVenueCoordinates(club, club, 0);
          assertTrue(Number.isFinite(canon.latitud) && Number.isFinite(canon.longitud), 'canonical finite coords');
          const dClub = computeCanonicalVenueDistanceKm(canon.latitud, canon.longitud);
          assertTrue(Number.isFinite(dClub) && dClub >= 0.1, 'positive bounded club distance');
          assertEq(computeCanonicalVenueDistanceKm(canon.latitud, canon.longitud, { latitude: 0, longitude: 0 }), dClub, 'rejects (0,0) userOrigin');
          assertEq(computeCanonicalVenueDistanceKm(canon.latitud, canon.longitud, { latitude: 95, longitude: 200 }), dClub, 'rejects out-of-range userOrigin');

          const evDrifted = {
            id: 'srv-canon-1',
            nombre_servicio: 'Session Test',
            negocio_nombre: 'Sede Canonica Cabo',
            categoria: 'Fuerza',
            estado: 'aprobado',
            latitud: 23.15,
            longitud: -109.6,
            es_sede_externa: false,
            frecuencia: freq,
            fecha: '2026-11-01',
            hora_inicio: '09:00',
            cupo_maximo: 12,
            cupo_actual: 2,
          };
          const hydrated = hydrateServicesGpsWithClubCoords([evDrifted], [club]);
          const lookup = buildEventosClubLookup([club]);
          const mapped = mapServiceRowToEventosItem(hydrated[0], 0, lookup, computeCanonicalVenueDistanceKm, 2, fixedNow);
          assertTrue(Boolean(mapped), 'non-deleted active recurring event mapped');
          assertEq(mapped?.distNum, dClub, 'Eventos distance equals Explorar canonical distance');

          const openSt = evaluateVenueOpenStatusMazatlan(club.horarios, fixedNow, lang);
          assertEq(openSt.isOpen, true, '10:30 Mazatlan Wednesday must be OPEN');
          assertEq(openSt.badgeText, lang === 'en' ? '● OPEN' : '● ABIERTO', 'open badge localized');

          const closedSt = evaluateVenueOpenStatusMazatlan('Lunes a Viernes • 06:00 a 08:00', fixedNow, lang);
          assertEq(closedSt.isOpen, false, '10:30 Mazatlan outside 06-08 window');

          const satLate = new Date(mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(2026, 11, 21, 22, 30, 0, 0));
          const satMid = new Date(mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(2026, 11, 21, 10, 0, 0, 0));
          const sunMid = new Date(mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(2026, 11, 22, 10, 0, 0, 0));
          assertEq(evaluateVenueOpenStatusMazatlan('Lun a Sáb • 06:00 a 24:00', satLate, lang).isOpen, true, '24:00 & abbr open Sat 22:30');
          assertEq(evaluateVenueOpenStatusMazatlan('Lun a Sáb • 06:00 a 24:00', sunMid, lang).isOpen, false, 'Lun a Sab closed Sunday');
          assertEq(evaluateVenueOpenStatusMazatlan('Lunes a Viernes 06:00-21:00, Sábado 08:00-14:00', satMid, lang).isOpen, true, 'comma multi-range Sat open');
          assertEq(evaluateVenueOpenStatusMazatlan('Lunes a Viernes 06:00-21:00, Sábado 08:00-14:00', sunMid, lang).isOpen, false, 'comma multi-range Sun closed');

          const life = computeEventLocalLifecycle(evDrifted, club, fixedNow);
          assertTrue(life.fechaProyectada >= mzNow.isoDate, 'projected recurring date never in past');
          const novStart = new Date(mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(2026, 11, 20, 10, 0, 0, 0));
          const m31Ev = { ...evDrifted, frecuencia: 'Mensual', fecha: '2026-10-31', hora_inicio: '09:00' };
          assertEq(computeEventLocalLifecycle(m31Ev, club, novStart).fechaProyectada, '2026-11-30', 'monthly 31st clamps to Nov 30');
          assertEq(matchesDaySchedule(m31Ev, '2026-11-30', '2026-11-20', { nowRef: novStart }), true, 'matchesDaySchedule agrees on Nov 30');
          const searchProj = projectEventDateForSearch({ ...evDrifted, fecha: '2026-10-01' }, mzNow.isoDate);
          assertTrue(searchProj >= mzNow.isoDate, 'search projection >= Mazatlan today');

          const recExpiredFin = resolveEventBookingLockState({ ...evDrifted, fecha_fin: '2026-11-10' }, 'Semanal', '2026-11-18', '09:00', lang, fixedNow);
          assertEq(recExpiredFin.isLocked, true, 'recurring past fecha_fin must lock');
          assertEq(recExpiredFin.isExpiredOneTime, true, 'recurring past fecha_fin shows ended');

          const lockedState = resolveEventBookingLockState({ ...evDrifted, estado: rawEstado }, 'Única Vez', '2026-11-10', '08:00', lang, fixedNow);
          assertEq(lockedState.isLocked, true, 'inactive or past one-time event must lock');
          if (rawEstado !== 'activo') {
            assertEq(lockedState.label, lang === 'en' ? 'UNAVAILABLE' : 'NO DISPONIBLE', 'inactive label');
          } else {
            assertEq(lockedState.label, lang === 'en' ? 'SESSION ENDED' : 'SESIÓN FINALIZADA', 'expired label');
          }

          assertTrue(
            isEventEditorFormValid({ titleVal: 'Box Session', discVal: 'Fuerza', dateVal: '2026-11-22', timeVal: '08:00', priceVal: '200', cupoVal: '12' }),
            '200 KC creator default must be valid'
          );
          const defSplit = computeEscrow4060Split(200, false);
          assertEq(defSplit.escrow40, 80, '200 KC 40% = 80 KC');
          assertEq(defSplit.puerta60, 120, '200 KC 60% = 120 KC');
          const dynSplit = computeEscrow4060Split(validPriceKc, false);
          assertEq(dynSplit.escrow40 + dynSplit.puerta60, validPriceKc, '40/60 exact sum');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  itCase('Propiedad 2: Conciliación Bóveda Maestra <-> Admin Hub, Kinetic Oficial, exclusión 0 KC/Sandbox y MRR real pagado', () => {
    const mz = getMazatlanWeekAndDayBounds(new Date(mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(2026, 11, 18, 12, 0, 0, 0)));
    const week0 = { startMs: mz.startMs, endMs: mz.endMs, inicioIso: mz.periodoInicio, finIso: mz.periodoFin, strictWindow: true };
    const inWeekIso = new Date(mz.startMs + 3600_000).toISOString();
    const lastWeekIso = new Date(mz.startMs - 86_400_000).toISOString();

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.array(
          fc.record({
            id: fc.uuid(),
            negocio_nombre: fc.constantFrom('Alpha Gym', 'Kinetic Oficial'),
            estado: fc.constantFrom('completada', 'no_show', 'activa', 'cancelada'),
            precio: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 50 }).map((n) => n * 10),
            inCurrentWeek: fc.boolean(),
            isSandbox: fc.boolean(),
            isZeroMaster: fc.boolean(),
          }),
          { minLength: 1, maxLength: 18 }
        ),
        fc.array(
          fc.record({
            id: fc.uuid(),
            nivel: fc.constantFrom('Platinum', 'Gold', 'Silver', 'Bronze', 'Acceso Base'),
            kc_membresia: fc.constantFrom(0, 0, 600, 1500, 2500, 3600),
            es_cuenta_sandbox: fc.boolean(),
            rol: fc.constantFrom('atleta', 'atleta', 'admin', 'club'),
          }),
          { minLength: 1, maxLength: 15 }
        ),
        fc.boolean(),
        (rawBookings, rawProfiles, isEn) => {
          const clubs = [{ id: 'af-alpha', nombre: 'Alpha Gym', estado: 'activo', regimen_fiscal: 'persona_moral' }];
          const bookings = rawBookings.map((b) => {
            const p = b.isZeroMaster ? 0 : b.precio;
            const esc = Math.round(p * 0.4);
            return {
              id: b.id,
              negocio_nombre: b.negocio_nombre,
              servicio: 'Class Test',
              estado: b.estado,
              precio_kc: p,
              costo_total: p,
              monto_escrow: esc,
              monto_puerta: Math.max(0, p - esc),
              es_pase_maestro: b.isZeroMaster,
              es_cuenta_sandbox: b.isSandbox,
              updated_at: b.inCurrentWeek ? inWeekIso : lastWeekIso,
              fecha_clase: (b.inCurrentWeek ? inWeekIso : lastWeekIso).slice(0, 10),
            };
          });

          const adminRep = calcularCorteSemanalB2B(clubs, bookings, week0);
          const vaultRep = buildCeoConsolidatedWeeklyReport(clubs, bookings, week0);
          assertEq(adminRep.total_volumen_bruto_mxn, vaultRep.total_volumen_bruto_mxn, 'Admin Hub vs Boveda Maestra gross match');
          assertEq(adminRep.total_neto_dispersar_spei_mxn, vaultRep.total_neto_dispersar_spei_mxn, 'Admin Hub vs Boveda Maestra SPEI match');

          const validSvcIds = new Set(['valid-svc-1']);
          const withOrphan = [
            ...bookings.map((b) => ({ ...b, servicio_id: 'valid-svc-1' })),
            { id: 'orph-1', servicio_id: 'deleted-svc-999', negocio_nombre: 'Alpha Gym', estado: 'activa', precio_kc: 200, costo_total: 200, monto_escrow: 80, monto_puerta: 120, updated_at: inWeekIso, fecha_clase: inWeekIso.slice(0, 10) },
          ];
          const orphanFilteredRep = buildCeoConsolidatedWeeklyReport(clubs, withOrphan, week0, validSvcIds);
          const sumCustodia = (rep: typeof vaultRep) => rep.cortes_por_afiliado.reduce((s, c) => s + c.en_custodia_escrow_kc, 0);
          assertEq(sumCustodia(orphanFilteredRep), sumCustodia(vaultRep), 'CEO report excludes orphan active custody when validServiceIds given');

          const futureNonFlash = resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing({
            event: { precio_kc: 200, fecha: '2026-11-28', fecha_proyectada: '2026-11-28', fecha_clase: '2026-11-28', hora_inicio: '09:00', nextTimestamp: undefined, es_venta_flash: false, isFlashSale: false, isFlashUrgent3h: false, descuento_flash_pct: 0 },
            vipLevel: 'Platinum', kcMembresia: 3600, nowMs: mz.startMs, isEn,
          });
          assertEq(futureNonFlash.hasFlashDiscount, false, 'custom future date must not carry today flash discount');
          assertEq(futureNonFlash.discountedTotalKc, 200, 'custom future date charges full 200 KC rate');

          const expectedGross = Number(
            bookings
              .filter((r) => !r.es_cuenta_sandbox && !r.es_pase_maestro && r.precio_kc > 0 && r.updated_at === inWeekIso)
              .reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.estado === 'completada' ? r.precio_kc : r.estado === 'no_show' ? r.monto_escrow : 0), 0)
              .toFixed(2)
          );
          assertEq(adminRep.total_volumen_bruto_mxn, expectedGross, 'Kinetic Oficial + Alpha Gym week0 strict gross');

          const bookingsWithCat = [
            ...bookings.map((b) => ({
              ...b,
              categoria: b.es_pase_maestro || b.es_cuenta_sandbox ? 'HiddenDisc' : 'Fuerza',
            })),
            { id: 'adm-skip', categoria: 'AdminDisc', estado: 'completada', precio_kc: 200, perfiles: { rol: 'admin' } },
          ];
          const expectedTopCount = bookings.filter(
            (r) => !r.es_cuenta_sandbox && !r.es_pase_maestro && r.precio_kc > 0 && r.estado !== 'no_show' && r.estado !== 'cancelada'
          ).length;

          const { distribucionNiveles, topDisciplinas } = computeAdminTierAndDisciplineMetrics(rawProfiles, bookingsWithCat, isEn);

import fc from 'fast-check';
import {
  computeTrophyVolumetricProjection,
  normalizeAngle360,
} from '../../components/kineticlub/KineticTrophyVolumetricEngine';
import {
  assertValidKcMultipleOfTen,
  evaluateProductionAuthAccess,
  isSyntheticOrDemoToken,
  isValidKcMultipleOfTen,
  maskClabeAccount,
  resolveCanonicalCheckoutPlan,
} from '../../services/kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import {
  buildMfaSecuritySnapshotFromResponses,
  shouldRetainAtMfaAal2Gate,
} from '../../services/kineticSecurityMfaService';
import {
  computeDragReleaseOmega,
  computeSlidingWindowVx,
  computeTrophyRevolutionGeometry,
  stepTrophySpinPhysics,
  TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S,
  TROPHY_MAX_TILT_Z_DEG,
  TROPHY_SETTLE_OMEGA_DEG_S,
} from '../../services/kineticTrophyPhysicsEngine';
import { computeTactilePressFrame, type KineticPhysicsPresetName } from '../../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';
import { encodeUint8ArrayToBase64 } from '../../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';

declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;

const expectTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const expectEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
};
const toBase64Url = (obj: unknown): string => {
  const raw = JSON.stringify(obj);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i += 1) bytes[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i) & 0xff;
  return encodeUint8ArrayToBase64(bytes).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
};
const makeJwt = (payload: Record<string, unknown>): string => `${toBase64Url({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' })}.${toBase64Url(payload)}.sig270`;
const FUTURE_EXP = 4_102_444_800; // 2100-01-01
const VALID_AAL2_JWT = makeJwt({ sub: 'user-v270', aal: 'aal2', exp: FUTURE_EXP });
const VALID_AAL1_JWT = makeJwt({ sub: 'user-v270', aal: 'aal1', exp: FUTURE_EXP });
const NO_EXP_JWT = makeJwt({ sub: 'user-v270', aal: 'aal2' });
const EXPIRED_JWT = makeJwt({ sub: 'user-v270', aal: 'aal2', exp: 1_700_000_000 });
const CORRUPT_JWT = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.not_valid_json.sig';

describe('KINETIC OS v2.7.0 — Física 3D de Trompo, Escultura 360°, Blindaje Fintech & CLABE/Resorte (500x)', () => {
  it('Propiedad 1: Física 3D de trompo conserva signo inicial, decae monótonamente sin NaN y converge al reposo', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.double({ min: -3600, max: 3600, noNaN: true }),
        fc.integer({ min: -180, max: 180 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 8, max: 56 }),
        fc.double({ min: -40, max: 40, noNaN: true }),
        fc.double({ min: -TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S, max: TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S, noNaN: true }),
        fc.double({ min: 4, max: 64, noNaN: true }),
        (angleDeg, dragDeltaPx, winDtMs, dragVx, omega0, dtMs) => {
          const now = 10_000;
          const winVx = computeSlidingWindowVx([{ dx: 0, t: now - winDtMs }, { dx: dragDeltaPx, t: now }], now, 60);
          expectTrue(Number.isFinite(winVx) && Math.abs(winVx) <= 12, 'winVx acotada');
          expectEq(Math.sign(winVx), Math.sign(dragDeltaPx), 'Ventana 60ms conserva signo');
          const releaseOmega = computeDragReleaseOmega(dragVx, 1150);
          expectTrue(Number.isFinite(releaseOmega) && Math.abs(releaseOmega) <= TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S, 'Omega acotada');
          const step = stepTrophySpinPhysics({ angleDeg, omegaDegPerSec: omega0, isSpinning: true }, dtMs);
          expectTrue(Number.isFinite(step.angleDeg) && Number.isFinite(step.omegaDegPerSec) && Number.isFinite(step.tiltZDeg), 'Sin NaN');
          expectTrue(step.angleDeg >= 0 && step.angleDeg < 360 && Math.abs(step.tiltZDeg) <= TROPHY_MAX_TILT_Z_DEG + 1e-6, 'Ángulo/tilt acotados');
          if (step.isSpinning && Math.abs(omega0) >= TROPHY_SETTLE_OMEGA_DEG_S) {
            expectEq(Math.sign(step.omegaDegPerSec), Math.sign(omega0), 'Signo conservado');
            expectTrue(Math.abs(step.omegaDegPerSec) < Math.abs(omega0), 'Decaimiento monótono estricto');
          }
          let cur = { angleDeg, omegaDegPerSec: omega0, isSpinning: true, tiltZDeg: 0 };
          let frames = 0;
          while (cur.isSpinning && frames < 600) { cur = stepTrophySpinPhysics(cur, 16.6667); frames += 1; }
          expectEq(cur.isSpinning, false, 'Converge al reposo');
          expectEq(cur.omegaDegPerSec, 0, 'Omega reposo = 0');
          expectEq(cur.tiltZDeg, 0, 'Tilt reposo = 0');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 2: Geometría 3D de revolución 360° mantiene orden Z, espesor sólido >= 0.22*size y cero espejo', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.double({ min: -3600, max: 3600, noNaN: true }),
        fc.double({ min: 48, max: 280, noNaN: true }),
        (angleDeg, size) => {
          const norm = normalizeAngle360(angleDeg);
          expectTrue(Number.isFinite(norm) && norm >= 0 && norm < 360, 'normalizeAngle360 [0,360)');
          const proj = computeTrophyVolumetricProjection(angleDeg, size);
          expectTrue(proj.projectedWidthPx >= size * 0.22 - 1e-6 && proj.spineWidthPx >= size * 0.22 - 1e-6, 'Espesor >= 0.22*size');
          expectEq(proj.isMirroredText, false, 'Sin inversión en espejo');
          const geo = computeTrophyRevolutionGeometry(angleDeg, size);
          expectTrue(geo.bowlScaleX >= 0.76 && geo.rimRx >= 15.5 && geo.frontScaleX >= 0.24 && geo.backScaleX >= 0.28, 'Volumen sólido');
          expectEq(geo.handlesOrdered.length, 2, '2 asas orbitales');
          expectTrue(geo.handlesOrdered[0].zDepth <= geo.handlesOrdered[1].zDepth, 'Z-order consistente');
          for (const h of geo.handlesOrdered) expectEq(h.isFront, h.zDepth >= 0, 'isFront consistente con zDepth');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 3: Cero puertas traseras en producción + retención obligatoria en compuerta AAL2 / fallo parcial MFA', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.oneof(
          fc.constant(VALID_AAL2_JWT), fc.constant(VALID_AAL1_JWT), fc.constant(NO_EXP_JWT),
          fc.constant(EXPIRED_JWT), fc.constant(CORRUPT_JWT), fc.constant(''),
          fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 18 }).map((s) => `kinetic-${s}`)
        ),
        fc.constantFrom('aal1', 'aal2', undefined, null),
        fc.constantFrom('aal1', 'aal2', undefined, null),
        fc.boolean(),
        fc.boolean(),
        fc.boolean(),
        fc.boolean(),
        fc.oneof(fc.boolean(), fc.constant(null)),
        fc.oneof(fc.constantFrom('topup_50', '500', 'constructor', 'toString', '__proto__', ''), fc.string({ maxLength: 20 })),
        (token, curLvl, nxtLvl, hasVerifiedTotp, errF, errA, mfaFail, emailOk, fuzzPlanId) => {
          expectEq(shouldRetainAtMfaAal2Gate(curLvl, nxtLvl), nxtLvl === 'aal2' && curLvl !== 'aal2', 'Gate AAL2 estricto');
          const mfaSnap = buildMfaSecuritySnapshotFromResponses(
            errF ? { data: null, error: new Error('f') } : { data: { totp: hasVerifiedTotp ? [{ id: 'f1', factor_type: 'totp', status: 'verified' }] : [] }, error: null },
            errA ? { data: null, error: new Error('a') } : { data: { currentLevel: curLvl, nextLevel: nxtLvl }, error: null },
            false
          );
          if (errF || errA) {
            expectTrue(Boolean(mfaSnap.checkFailed && mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge), 'Fallo parcial/total MFA debe fallar cerrado');
          }
          expectTrue(isSyntheticOrDemoToken(`kinetic-${String(token)}`), 'Token kinetic- bloqueado');
          const res = evaluateProductionAuthAccess({ token, aal: curLvl, hasVerifiedTotp, emailConfirmed: emailOk, mfaCheckFailed: mfaFail, isDevRuntime: false });
          const jwtValid = token === VALID_AAL2_JWT || token === VALID_AAL1_JWT;
          if (!jwtValid) expectEq(res.allowed, false, 'Token sin exp/expirado/corrupto bloqueado');
          else if (mfaFail) expectEq(res.allowed, false, 'MFA fallido bloqueado');
          else if (hasVerifiedTotp && (token === VALID_AAL1_JWT || curLvl === 'aal1')) {
            expectEq(res.allowed, false, 'No puede elevar JWT aal1 mediante input.aal=aal2');
            expectEq(res.reason, 'aal2_required', 'Razón aal2_required');
          } else if (emailOk === false) expectEq(res.allowed, false, 'Email sin confirmar bloqueado');
          else expectEq(res.allowed, true, 'JWT válido + AAL correcto permitido');

          const normPlan = fuzzPlanId.trim().toLowerCase();
          const isOfficial = ['100', '250', '500', '1000', 'topup_100', 'topup_250', 'topup_500', 'topup_1000'].includes(normPlan);
          let threw = false;
          try {
            const p = resolveCanonicalCheckoutPlan({ tipo: 'topup', planId: fuzzPlanId, currentLevel: 'Gold' });
            expectTrue(typeof p.kcOtorgados === 'number' && Number.isFinite(p.kcOtorgados) && isValidKcMultipleOfTen(p.kcOtorgados), 'Top-Up canónico');
            expectEq(assertValidKcMultipleOfTen(p.kcOtorgados, 'pbt'), p.kcOtorgados, 'Múltiplo de 10 exacto');
          } catch { threw = true; }
          expectEq(threw, !isOfficial, 'Solo planId oficial permitido; prototype keys rechazadas');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 4: Enmascaramiento bancario CLABE (14 "•" + 4 dígitos) y límites táctiles/reposo del motor de resortes', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.array(fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 9 }), { minLength: 18, maxLength: 18 }),
        fc.string({ minLength: 0, maxLength: 24 }),
        fc.constantFrom<KineticPhysicsPresetName>('tactileChip', 'cardFloat', 'dockTab', 'primaryAction'),
        fc.boolean(),
        fc.boolean(),
        (clabeArr, junk, preset, pressed, disabled) => {
          const clabe18 = clabeArr.join('');
          const masked = maskClabeAccount(clabe18);
          expectEq(masked, `•••• •••• •••• ••${clabe18.slice(-4)}`, 'CLABE 18 dígitos = 14 "•" + últimos 4');
          expectEq((masked.match(/•/g) || []).length, 14, 'Exactamente 14 "•"');
          expectTrue(maskClabeAccount(junk).includes('•'), 'Entrada arbitraria nunca fuga texto plano');
          const frame = computeTactilePressFrame(preset, pressed, disabled);
          expectTrue(frame.scale >= 0.925 && frame.scale <= 1.0 && frame.translateY >= 0 && frame.translateY <= 2.5, 'Límites físicos seguros');
          if (!pressed && !disabled) { expectEq(frame.scale, 1, 'Reposo scale=1'); expectEq(frame.translateY, 0, 'Reposo translateY=0'); }
          if (pressed && !disabled) expectTrue(frame.scale < 1 && frame.translateY > 0, 'Compresión táctil real');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }

  });

    // === src/components/kineticlub/InspectedAthleteModal.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import ReactNativeModal from 'react-native-modal';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { resolveCategoryImage } from '../../constants/exploreData';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { formatOfficialOrTierLabel, formatStreakDaysBadge } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { hasActiveStoryInMap } from '../../services/kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
import { buildDeterministicDmCode, IDirectMessageThread, loadLocalDmThreads } from '../../services/kineticRealtimeChatBridge';
import { getActiveStoriesMapSync } from '../../services/kineticStoriesService';
import { COLORS, globalStyles } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { createSwipeDownToCloseHandlers } from '../../utils/kineticEliteHelpers';
import { GpuProgressBar, KineticLoader, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { KineticFullscreenLightboxModal } from '../shared/KineticFullscreenLightboxModal';
import { KineticListFilterSortBar } from '../shared/KineticListFilterSortBar';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from '../shared/KineticModalHeader3D';
import { IA_MEDIA_LOCK_KEYS, getLocalizedRpgPillars, iaStyles as baseIaStyles, resolveProfileLightAura } from './KinetiClubRpgConstants';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;

const InspectBar = ({ progress, color, isLightMode }: { progress: number; color: string; isLightMode: boolean }) => {
  if (!isLightMode) return <GpuProgressBar progress={progress} color={color} height={7} />;
  const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(progress) || 0));
  return (
    <View style={{ width: '100%', height: 7, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <View style={{ width: `${pct}%`, height: '100%', borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: color }} />
    </View>
  );
};

export const InspectedAthleteModal = React.memo(
  ({
    inspectedAthlete,
    onClose,
    linkingId,
    isAlreadyInMySquad = false,
    onOpenTeamChat,
    onOpenDirectChat,
    onLink,
    myStats,
    inlineOverlayMode = false,
  }: any) => {
    const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    const { user: authUser, profile: authProfile } = useAuth();
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const iaStyles = useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseIaStyles, resolvedTheme, IA_MEDIA_LOCK_KEYS),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );

    const lastValidDataRef = useRef<any>(null);
    if (inspectedAthlete) lastValidDataRef.current = inspectedAthlete;
    const ath = inspectedAthlete || lastValidDataRef.current;

    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'rpg' | 'versus'>('rpg');
    const [versusSort, setVersusSort] = useState<'default' | 'my_best' | 'their_best' | 'gap'>('default');
    const [photoOverlayOpen, setPhotoOverlayOpen] = useState(false);
    const [isOpeningDm, setIsOpeningDm] = useState(false);
    const teamChatTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => () => {
      if (teamChatTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(teamChatTimerRef.current);
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
      setActiveTab('rpg');
      setVersusSort('default');
      setPhotoOverlayOpen(false);
      setIsOpeningDm(false);
    }, [inspectedAthlete?.id, inspectedAthlete?.nombre]);

    const pillars = useMemo(() => getLocalizedRpgPillars(language, isLightMode), [language, isLightMode]);

    const sortedVersusPillars = useMemo(() => {
      const list = [...pillars];
      if (versusSort === 'default' || !ath) return list;
      const myVal = (k: string) => Number(myStats?.[k] ?? 47);
      const theirVal = (k: string) => Number(ath?.stats?.[k] ?? ath?.[k] ?? 45);
      return list.sort((a, b) => {
        if (versusSort === 'my_best') return myVal(b.key) - myVal(a.key);
        if (versusSort === 'their_best') return theirVal(b.key) - theirVal(a.key);
        return Math.abs(myVal(b.key) - theirVal(b.key)) - Math.abs(myVal(a.key) - theirVal(a.key));
      });
    }, [pillars, versusSort, myStats, ath]);

    const rawAura = ath?.auraColor || COLORS.cyan;
    const { ringColor, textColor, pillBg } = resolveProfileLightAura(rawAura, isLightMode);
    const theirOvr = Number(ath?.ovr || 47);
    const myOvr = Number(myStats?.ovr || 47);
    const athName = String(ath?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')).trim();
    const bannerUri = ath?.callingCard || resolveCategoryImage(ath?.categoria || ath?.disciplina, ath?.disciplina);
    const hdPhotoUri = ath?.avatar_url || ath?.avatar || bannerUri;
    const roleLabel = formatOfficialOrTierLabel(String(ath?.titulo || ath?.rango || 'ATLETA ACTIVO').toUpperCase(), language);
    const rankValue = formatOfficialOrTierLabel(ath?.nivel || 'Bronze', language);
    const hasActiveStory = hasActiveStoryInMap(getActiveStoriesMapSync(), ath?.id, athName);

    if (!ath || (inlineOverlayMode && !inspectedAthlete)) return null;

    const lightCard3D = isLightMode
      ? { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8', shadowOpacity: 0.09 }
      : undefined;

    const handleDirectMessage = async () => {
      if (isOpeningDm) return;
      triggerHaptic('Selection');
      setIsOpeningDm(true);
      try {
        const realMyId = String(myStats?.userId || authUser?.id || 'me').trim();
        const realMyName = String(myStats?.userName || authProfile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')).trim();
        const realMyAvatar = myStats?.userAvatar || authProfile?.avatar_url || null;
        const targetId = String(ath.id || athName).trim();
        const dmCode = buildDeterministicDmCode(realMyId, realMyName, targetId, athName);
        const existingList = await loadLocalDmThreads(realMyId, realMyName);
        const existing = existingList.find((t) => t.dmCode === dmCode || t.threadId === dmCode);
        const draftThread: IDirectMessageThread = existing || {
          threadId: dmCode,
          dmCode,
          requesterId: realMyId,
          requesterName: realMyName,
          requesterAvatar: realMyAvatar,
          targetId,
          targetName: athName,
          targetAvatar: ath.avatar_url || ath.avatar || null,
          status: 'pending',
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          messages: [],
        };
        if (onOpenDirectChat) {
          onOpenDirectChat(draftThread);
        } else {
          onClose?.();
        }
      } finally {
        setIsOpeningDm(false);
      }
    };

    const sheetBody = (
      <View
        style={[
          globalStyles.bottomSheet,
          KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS,
          inlineOverlayMode && { marginTop: 0, height: '100%', maxHeight: '100%' },
          {
            backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : '#050505',
            borderTopColor: isLightMode ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)',
            width: '100%',
            paddingHorizontal: 0,
            paddingTop: 0,
            paddingBottom: insets.bottom > 0 ? insets.bottom + 12 : 20,
            overflow: 'hidden',
          },
        ]}
      >
        <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={onClose} style={{ paddingTop: 8, marginBottom: 8 }} />
        <ScrollView
          style={{ flex: 1 }}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          nestedScrollEnabled={true}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"

    // === src/components/kineticlub/KineticLootBoxStage.tsx === //
import { Feather, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Easing, Platform, Text, TouchableOpacity, View, useWindowDimensions } from 'react-native';
import Svg, { Circle, Defs, LinearGradient, Path, Polygon, Stop } from 'react-native-svg';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { formatNextMidnightCountdown, formatStreakDaysBadge, resolveMysteryBoxTierConfig } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { baseLootStageStyles as baseStStyles } from '../../styles/kineticLootBoxStage.styles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { triggerArcadeHaptic, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { KineticLootArtworkSvg } from '../shared/KineticSolidChest3DEngine';
import { KineticVolumetricChest3D, clampChestSquashX } from '../shared/KineticVaultAndChest3D';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as Record<string, string>) : undefined;
const DARK_INK_PROPS: Record<string, unknown> = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } } : {};

export { KineticLootArtworkSvg, clampChestSquashX };

export interface ILootDropItem {
  id: string;
  type: 'xp' | 'kc' | 'streak';
  kcAmount?: number;
  title: string;
  amountLabel: string;
  subtitle: string;
  rarityTag: string;
}

/** Burbuja dorada KC exclusiva para premios con kc > 0 (#22); +XP usa insignia energetica sin moneda KC. */
export function resolveLootRewardVisualKind(item: Partial<ILootDropItem> & { kc?: unknown } | null | undefined): 'kc' | 'xp' {
  if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return 'xp';
  if (typeof item.kcAmount === 'number') return item.kcAmount > 0 ? 'kc' : 'xp';
  if (typeof item.kc === 'number') return item.kc > 0 ? 'kc' : 'xp';
  const lbl = String(item.amountLabel || '');
  const m = lbl.match(/([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*kc\b/i);
  if (m) return Number(m[1]) > 0 ? 'kc' : 'xp';
  return 'xp';
}

export const KineticInteractiveLootBoxStage = React.memo(
  ({
    mode, isActive = true, dailyClaimedToday, disabled, rachaActual = 1, prestigeLevel = 1, nivelRaw, isAdmin,
    onExecuteClaim, onDragActiveChange, onContinueToVault,
  }: {
    mode: 'daily' | 'crate'; isActive?: boolean; dailyClaimedToday: boolean; disabled: boolean;
    rachaActual?: number; prestigeLevel?: number; nivelRaw?: string | null; isAdmin?: boolean;
    onExecuteClaim: () => Promise<number | boolean | void> | number | boolean | void;
    onDragActiveChange?: (active: boolean) => void;
    onContinueToVault?: () => void;
  }) => {
    const { user: authUser, profile: authProfile } = useAuth();
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const { height: winH } = useWindowDimensions();
    const isCompactH = winH < 800;
    const stStyles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStStyles, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
    const effectiveNivel = nivelRaw ?? authProfile?.nivel ?? null;
    const authMail = String(authUser?.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const pMail = String(authProfile?.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const pRol = String(authProfile?.rol || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const pTipo = String(authProfile?.tipo_cuenta || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const appRol = String(authUser?.app_metadata?.rol || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const adminMails = ['administrador@kinetic.com.mx', 'administrador@kinetic.com', 'admin@kinetic.com', 'kinetic@kinetic.com'];
    const authIsAdmin = Boolean(authUser?.id) && (adminMails.includes(authMail) || adminMails.includes(pMail) || ['admin', 'fundador'].includes(pRol) || ['admin', 'fundador'].includes(pTipo) || ['admin', 'fundador'].includes(appRol));
    const effectiveIsAdmin = isAdmin === false ? false : Boolean(typeof isAdmin === 'boolean' ? (isAdmin && authIsAdmin) : authIsAdmin);
    const tierCfg = useMemo(() => resolveMysteryBoxTierConfig(effectiveNivel), [effectiveNivel]);

    const TAPS_REQUIRED = 3;
    const [tapCount, setTapCount] = useState(0);
    const [stagePhase, setStagePhase] = useState<'closed' | 'tapping' | 'revealing' | 'summary'>(
      dailyClaimedToday && mode === 'daily' ? 'summary' : 'closed'
    );
    const [lootItems, setLootItems] = useState<ILootDropItem[]>([]);
    const [currentRevealIdx, setCurrentRevealIdx] = useState(0);
    const [isProcessingOpen, setIsProcessingOpen] = useState(false);
    const [isDemoReplayMode, setIsDemoReplayMode] = useState(false);
    const [countdownLabel, setCountdownLabel] = useState(() => formatNextMidnightCountdown(language));

    const floatAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const scaleBounceAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
    const shakeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const revealPopAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0.6)).current;
    const revealSlideY = useRef(new Animated.Value(22)).current;
    const isBoxClaimingRef = useRef(false);
    const isDemoReplayRef = useRef(false);
    const isActivelyOpeningRef = useRef(false);
    const prevModeRef = useRef(mode);

    const buildDailyLootItems = useCallback((): ILootDropItem[] => {
      const streakBadge = formatStreakDaysBadge(Math.max(1, rachaActual), language);
      return [
        {
          id: 'xp_daily',
          type: 'xp',
          kcAmount: 0,
          title: tx(`${tierCfg.labelEs.toUpperCase()} • ${streakBadge}`, `${tierCfg.labelEn.toUpperCase()} • ${streakBadge}`),
          amountLabel: `+${tierCfg.xpReward} XP`,
          subtitle: tx(
            `${tierCfg.labelEs}: sumados a tu Nivel ${prestigeLevel}/99 • Racha activa`,
            `${tierCfg.labelEn}: added to Level ${prestigeLevel}/99 • Streak synced`
          ),
          rarityTag: tx(tierCfg.pillEs, tierCfg.pillEn),
        },
      ];
    }, [rachaActual, tierCfg, prestigeLevel, language, tx]);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (prevModeRef.current !== mode) {
        prevModeRef.current = mode;
        isDemoReplayRef.current = false; isActivelyOpeningRef.current = false;
        setIsDemoReplayMode(false); setTapCount(0); setCurrentRevealIdx(0);
        setStagePhase(mode === 'daily' && dailyClaimedToday ? 'summary' : 'closed');
      }
    }, [mode, dailyClaimedToday]);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (!effectiveIsAdmin && (isDemoReplayMode || isDemoReplayRef.current)) {
        isDemoReplayRef.current = false; isActivelyOpeningRef.current = false; setIsDemoReplayMode(false);
        if (mode === 'daily' && dailyClaimedToday) setStagePhase('summary');
      }
    }, [effectiveIsAdmin, isDemoReplayMode, mode, dailyClaimedToday]);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (mode === 'daily' && dailyClaimedToday) {
        setLootItems(buildDailyLootItems());
        if (!isDemoReplayMode && !isDemoReplayRef.current && !isActivelyOpeningRef.current) setStagePhase('summary');
      }
    }, [mode, dailyClaimedToday, isDemoReplayMode, buildDailyLootItems]);

    useEffect(() => {
      setCountdownLabel(formatNextMidnightCountdown(language));
      if (stagePhase !== 'summary' || mode !== 'daily') return;
      const timer = setInterval(() => setCountdownLabel(formatNextMidnightCountdown(language)), 30000);
      return () => clearInterval(timer);
    }, [stagePhase, mode, language]);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (isActive === false) return;
      const floatLoop = Animated.loop(
        Animated.sequence([
          Animated.timing(floatAnim, { toValue: -7, duration: 900, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.sin), useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(floatAnim, { toValue: 0, duration: 900, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.sin), useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
        ])
      );
      floatLoop.start();
      return () => floatLoop.stop();
    }, [floatAnim, isActive]);

    const triggerRevealAnimation = useCallback(() => {
      revealPopAnim.setValue(0.45);
      revealSlideY.setValue(24);
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.spring(revealPopAnim, { toValue: 1, friction: 5, tension: 105, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
        Animated.spring(revealSlideY, { toValue: 0, friction: 6, tension: 100, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
      ]).start();
    }, [revealPopAnim, revealSlideY]);

    const handleBoxTap = async () => {
      if ((!isDemoReplayMode && !isDemoReplayRef.current && disabled) || isProcessingOpen || isBoxClaimingRef.current) return;
      isActivelyOpeningRef.current = true;
      const nextTap = tapCount + 1;
      setTapCount(nextTap);
      if (stagePhase === 'closed') setStagePhase('tapping');

      if (nextTap < TAPS_REQUIRED) {
        triggerHaptic(nextTap === 1 ? 'Light' : 'Medium');
        const amp = nextTap === 1 ? 0.65 : 1;
        scaleBounceAnim.setValue(0.86);
        Animated.parallel([
          Animated.spring(scaleBounceAnim, { toValue: 1 + nextTap * 0.055, friction: 4, tension: 130, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.sequence([
            Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: -amp, duration: 42, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
            Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: amp, duration: 42, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
            Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: -amp * 0.7, duration: 38, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
            Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: 0, duration: 38, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          ]),
        ]).start();
        return;
      }

      triggerHaptic('Heavy');
      if (isDemoReplayRef.current || (mode === 'daily' && dailyClaimedToday)) {
        triggerHaptic('Success');
        triggerArcadeHaptic('levelUp');
        setLootItems(buildDailyLootItems());
        setCurrentRevealIdx(0);
        setStagePhase('revealing');
        triggerRevealAnimation();
        return;
      }

      isBoxClaimingRef.current = true;
      setIsProcessingOpen(true);
      try {
        let wonKc = 0;
        let claimFailed = false;
        let alreadyClaimedCrate = false;
        try {
          const res = await onExecuteClaim();
          if (res === -1 && mode === 'crate') {
            alreadyClaimedCrate = true;
          } else if (res === false) {
            claimFailed = true;
          } else if (typeof res === 'number' && res > 0) {
            wonKc = res;
          } else if (mode === 'crate') {
            claimFailed = true;
          }
        } catch {
          claimFailed = true;
        }
        if (alreadyClaimedCrate) {
          isActivelyOpeningRef.current = false;
          setTapCount(0);
          scaleBounceAnim.setValue(1);
          setStagePhase('closed');
          onContinueToVault?.();
          return;
        }
        if (claimFailed) {
          isActivelyOpeningRef.current = false;
          triggerHaptic('Warning');
          setTapCount(0);
          scaleBounceAnim.setValue(1);
          setStagePhase('closed');
          return;
        }
        triggerHaptic('Success');
        triggerArcadeHaptic('levelUp');
        const generatedItems: ILootDropItem[] =
          mode === 'crate' || wonKc > 0
            ? [
                {
                  id: 'loot_kc',
                  type: 'kc',
                  kcAmount: wonKc,
                  title: tx('KINETICOINS TOP-UP + 30 XP', 'TOP-UP KINETICOINS + 30 XP'),
                  amountLabel: `+${wonKc} KC`,
                  subtitle: tx(
                    `Acreditados en tu Billetera Top-Up • +30 XP hacia Nivel ${Math.min(99, prestigeLevel + 1)}`,
                    `Credited to Top-Up Wallet • +30 XP toward Level ${Math.min(99, prestigeLevel + 1)}`
                  ),
                  rarityTag: tx('BOTÍN DE NIVEL', 'LEVEL LOOT'),
                },
              ]
            : buildDailyLootItems();
        setLootItems(generatedItems);
        setCurrentRevealIdx(0);
        setStagePhase('revealing');
        triggerRevealAnimation();
      } finally {
        isBoxClaimingRef.current = false;
        setIsProcessingOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleNextRevealTap = () => {
      triggerHaptic('Medium');
      if (currentRevealIdx + 1 < lootItems.length) {
        setCurrentRevealIdx((prev) => prev + 1);
        triggerRevealAnimation();
      } else {
        triggerArcadeHaptic('checkIn');
        isDemoReplayRef.current = false;
        isActivelyOpeningRef.current = false;
        setIsDemoReplayMode(false);
        if (mode === 'crate' && onContinueToVault) {
          onContinueToVault();
          return;
        }
        setStagePhase('summary');
      }
    };

    const handleReplayDemo = () => {
      if (!effectiveIsAdmin) return;
      triggerHaptic('Selection');
      isDemoReplayRef.current = true; isActivelyOpeningRef.current = false; isBoxClaimingRef.current = false;
      setIsDemoReplayMode(true); setIsProcessingOpen(false); setTapCount(0);
      scaleBounceAnim.setValue(1); setCurrentRevealIdx(0); setStagePhase('closed');
    };

    const shakeRotate = shakeAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [-1, 1], outputRange: ['-10deg', '10deg'] });
    const remainingTaps = Math.max(0, TAPS_REQUIRED - tapCount);
    const activeItem = lootItems[currentRevealIdx] || lootItems[0];
    const rewardVisualKind = resolveLootRewardVisualKind(activeItem);
    const cyanText = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;
    const purpleText = isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : COLORS.purpleLight;
    const lockedTierVal = mode === 'daily' ? tierCfg.key : undefined;
    const lockedPillVal = mode === 'daily' ? tx(tierCfg.pillEs, tierCfg.pillEn) : undefined;

    return (
      <View
        style={[
          stStyles.mysteryStageCard,
          isCompactH && { paddingTop: 10, paddingBottom: 10, marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 4 },
          NO_SEL,
          isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#7DD3FC', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#7C3AED', shadowColor: '#0284C7', shadowOpacity: 0.16 },
        ]}
      >
        {(stagePhase === 'closed' || stagePhase === 'tapping') && (
          <View style={[stStyles.lootInteractiveTouchArea, NO_SEL]}>
            <View style={[stStyles.giftTapZone, isCompactH && { minHeight: 205, paddingTop: 4, paddingBottom: 2 }]}>
              <Animated.View style={{ overflow: 'visible', transform: [{ translateY: floatAnim }, { scale: scaleBounceAnim }, { rotateZ: shakeRotate }] }}>
                <KineticVolumetricChest3D
                  tapCount={tapCount} chargeStage={tapCount} isOpened={false} isActive={isActive} isAdmin={effectiveIsAdmin}
                  lockedTier={lockedTierVal} lockedPillLabel={lockedPillVal} rewardVisualKind={rewardVisualKind}
                  onTapChest={(!isDemoReplayMode && disabled) ? undefined : handleBoxTap}
                  onDragActiveChange={onDragActiveChange} compactMode={isCompactH}
                />
              </Animated.View>
            </View>
            <View style={[stStyles.chargeNodesRow, isCompactH && { marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 8 }]}>
              {[1, 2, 3].map((step) => {
                const filled = tapCount >= step;
                return (
                  <View
                    key={step}
                    style={[
                      stStyles.chargeNodeDot,
                      isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' },
                      filled && (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#00E5FF', borderColor: '#0284C7' } : stStyles.chargeNodeDotActive),
                    ]}
                  />
                );
              })}
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity
              activeOpacity={0.9}
              disabled={!isDemoReplayMode && disabled}
              onPress={handleBoxTap}
              style={[stStyles.tapCalloutPill, NO_SEL]}
              {...DARK_INK_PROPS}
            >
              <Ionicons name="flash" size={13} color="#050505" />
              <Text selectable={false} style={stStyles.tapCalloutPillText}>
                {remainingTaps === 3
                  ? tx('¡TOCA! ¡TOCA! (3 TOQUES PARA ABRIR)', 'TAP! TAP! (3 TAPS TO OPEN)')
                  : remainingTaps === 2
                    ? tx('¡SIGUE TOCANDO! (2 TOQUES MÁS)', 'KEEP TAPPING! (2 MORE TAPS)')
                    : tx('¡ÚLTIMO TOQUE PARA LIBERAR BOTÍN!', 'FINAL TAP TO UNLEASH LOOT!')}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}

        {(stagePhase === 'revealing' || stagePhase === 'summary') && (
          <View style={[stStyles.lootInteractiveTouchArea, NO_SEL]}>
            <View style={[stStyles.openedChestZone, isCompactH && { minHeight: 190, paddingTop: 2, paddingBottom: 2 }]}>
              <KineticVolumetricChest3D
                tapCount={3} chargeStage={3} isOpened={true} isActive={isActive} isAdmin={effectiveIsAdmin}
                lockedTier={lockedTierVal} lockedPillLabel={lockedPillVal} rewardVisualKind={rewardVisualKind}
                onDragActiveChange={onDragActiveChange} compactMode={isCompactH}
              />
            </View>

            {stagePhase === 'revealing' && activeItem ? (
              <>
                <Animated.View style={[stStyles.revealCenterBox, isCompactH && { paddingVertical: 4 }, { transform: [{ translateY: revealSlideY }, { scale: revealPopAnim }], marginTop: 2 }]}>
                  <View style={[stStyles.rarityTopPillPurple, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F3E8FF', borderColor: '#8B5CF6' }]}>
                    <Text selectable={false} style={[stStyles.rarityTopPillPurpleText, { color: purpleText }]}>{activeItem.rarityTag}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <Text selectable={false} style={[stStyles.revealAmountBig, isCompactH && { fontSize: 27 }, { color: cyanText }]}>{activeItem.amountLabel}</Text>
                  <Text selectable={false} style={[stStyles.revealItemTitle, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>{activeItem.title}</Text>
                  <Text selectable={false} style={[stStyles.revealItemSub, isLightMode && { color: '#334155' }]} numberOfLines={2}>{activeItem.subtitle}</Text>
                </Animated.View>
                <TouchableOpacity {...DARK_INK_PROPS} activeOpacity={0.86} onPress={handleNextRevealTap} style={[stStyles.tapCalloutPill, NO_SEL, { marginTop: 8 }]}>
                  <Text selectable={false} style={stStyles.tapCalloutPillText}>{tx('CONTINUAR ✓', 'CONTINUE ✓')}</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Text selectable={false} style={[stStyles.summaryTitle, { marginTop: 4 }, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>
                  {tx('¡RECOMPENSAS OBTENIDAS!', 'REWARDS CLAIMED!')}
                </Text>
                <View style={stStyles.summaryCardsRow}>
                  {lootItems.map((it) => (
                    <View key={it.id} style={[stStyles.summaryMiniCard, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#7DD3FC', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}>
                      <Text selectable={false} style={[stStyles.summaryMiniAmount, { color: cyanText }]}>{it.amountLabel}</Text>
                      <Text selectable={false} style={[stStyles.summaryMiniLabel, isLightMode && { color: '#334155' }]} numberOfLines={1}>{it.title}</Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </View>
                {mode === 'daily' && (
                  <View style={[stStyles.countdownInfoBar, isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9', borderColor: '#94A3B8', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#64748B' } : { backgroundColor: '#0B101B', borderColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35)', borderTopColor: 'rgba(184, 255, 255, 0.42)', borderBottomColor: '#04070D' }]}>
                    <Text selectable={false} style={[stStyles.countdownInfoTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#E2E8F0' }]}>{countdownLabel}</Text>
                  </View>
                )}
                {effectiveIsAdmin === true ? (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[stStyles.replayAnimBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#F0F9FF', borderColor: '#0284C7', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#0369A1' } : { backgroundColor: '#0B101B', borderColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45)', borderTopColor: 'rgba(184,255,255,0.5)', borderBottomColor: '#006B78' }]}
                    activeOpacity={0.85}
                    onPress={handleReplayDemo}
                  >
                    <Feather name="refresh-cw" size={12} color={isLightMode ? '#0369A1' : COLORS.cyan} />
                    <Text selectable={false} style={[stStyles.replayAnimBtnText, { color: isLightMode ? '#0369A1' : COLORS.cyan }]}>
                      {tx('🔄 VOLVER A REPRODUCIR ANIMACIÓN', '🔄 REPLAY ANIMATION')}
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                ) : null}
              </>
            )}
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    );
  }
);

    FILE: src/components/kineticlub/KinetiClubCommentsAndSendSheets.tsx

    // === src/components/kineticlub/KinetiClubCommentsAndSendSheets.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { KeyboardAvoidingView, Modal, Platform, Pressable, ScrollView, Share, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { sendCloudDirectMessage } from '../../services/kineticDirectMessagesBridge';
import { formatPostRelativeTime } from '../../services/kineticlubFeedAndSquadHelpers';
import { sanitizeOfficialKineticShareText } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { manageUgcUserRelation, reportUgcContent } from '../../services/kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import { IWallComment } from '../../services/kineticlubWallCloudService';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { sheetsStyles as sh } from '../../styles/kineticlubHybridWall.styles';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;
const DARK_INK_PROPS: any = { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };

export const KinetiClubCommentsSheetModal = memo(
  ({ post, comments, currentUserId, currentUserName, isMasterAdminUser, onClose, onAddComment, onDeleteComment }: {
    post: any | null; comments: IWallComment[]; currentUserId?: string | null; currentUserName?: string | null;
    isMasterAdminUser: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onAddComment: (postId: string, text: string) => void;
    onDeleteComment: (postId: string, commentId: string) => void;
  }) => {
    const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    const { isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const isEn = language === 'en';
    const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
    useEffect(() => { if (!post) setDraft(''); }, [post]);
    if (!post) return null;

    const ink = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
    const muted = isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8';
    const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;
    const myNameLow = String(currentUserName || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const quickChips = [
      tx('¡Máquina! 🔥', 'Beast mode! 🔥'),
      tx('¡Vamos con todo! ⚡', 'Let’s go! ⚡'),
      tx('¡Puro respeto! 👏', 'Pure respect! 👏'),
    ];

    const submitNow = (raw: string) => {
      const clean = raw.trim();
      if (!clean) return;
      onAddComment(String(post.id), clean);
      setDraft('');
    };

    return (
      <Modal visible={Boolean(post)} transparent animationType="slide" onRequestClose={onClose} statusBarTranslucent>
        <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined} style={sh.overlay}>
          <Pressable style={sh.backdropTap} onPress={onClose} />
          <View
            style={[
              sh.sheet60,
              { paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom + 10, 14) },
              isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#06B6D4' },
            ]}
          >
            <View style={sh.grabber} />
            <View style={sh.sheetHeader}>
              <Text style={[sh.sheetTitle, { color: ink }]}>
                {`${tx('COMENTARIOS', 'COMMENTS')} (${comments.length})`}
              </Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={onClose} hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }} style={NO_SEL}>
                <Feather name="x" size={19} color={ink} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View style={sh.quickRow}>
              {quickChips.map((chip) => (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={chip}
                  style={[sh.quickChip, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}
                  onPress={() => submitNow(chip)}
                >
                  <Text selectable={false} style={[sh.quickChipTxt, { color: cyanInk }]}>{chip}</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              ))}
            </View>

            <ScrollView style={{ flex: 1 }} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 9, paddingVertical: 6 }}>
              {comments.length === 0 ? (
                <Text style={[sh.emptyTxt, { color: muted }]}>
                  {tx('Sé el primero en comentar este entreno ⚡', 'Be the first to comment on this workout ⚡')}
                </Text>
              ) : (
                comments.map((c) => {
                  const canDel = Boolean(
                    isMasterAdminUser ||
                    (currentUserId && c.userId && String(c.userId) === String(currentUserId)) ||
                    (!c.userId && myNameLow && String(c.author || '').trim().toLowerCase() === myNameLow)
                  );
                  return (
                    <View key={c.id} style={[sh.commentCard, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
                      <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                          <Text style={[sh.commentAuthor, { color: ink }]}>{c.author}</Text>
                          <Text style={[sh.commentTime, { color: muted }]}>{formatPostRelativeTime(c.created_at || c.id, isEn)}</Text>
                        </View>
                        <Text style={[sh.commentBody, { color: isLightMode ? '#334155' : '#E2E8F0' }]}>{c.text}</Text>
                      </View>
                      {canDel && (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          onPress={() => onDeleteComment(String(post.id), c.id)}
                          hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
                          style={NO_SEL}
                        >
                          <Feather name="trash-2" size={13} color="#FF3B5C" />
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      )}
                    </View>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </ScrollView>

            <View style={[sh.inputRow, isLightMode && { borderTopColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
              <TextInput
                value={draft}
                onChangeText={setDraft}
                maxLength={520}
                onSubmitEditing={() => submitNow(draft)}
                placeholder={tx('Escribe un comentario...', 'Write a comment...')}
                placeholderTextColor={isLightMode ? '#64748B' : '#94A3B8'}
                style={[sh.commentInput, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', color: '#0F172A' }]}
              />
              <TouchableOpacity {...DARK_INK_PROPS} style={[sh.sendBtn, NO_SEL, !draft.trim() && { opacity: 0.5 }]} disabled={!draft.trim()} onPress={() => submitNow(draft)}>
                <Feather name="send" size={15} color="#0F172A" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </KeyboardAvoidingView>
      </Modal>
    );
  }
);

export const KinetiClubSendToSheetModal = memo(
  ({
    post,
    user,
    profile,
    misEquipos = [],
    athletes = [],
    onSendToSquad,
    onClose,
  }: {
    post: any | null;
    user: any;
    profile: any;
    misEquipos?: any[];
    athletes?: any[];
    onSendToSquad?: (squadId: string, message: string) => Promise<unknown> | void;
    onClose: () => void;
  }) => {
    const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    const { isLightMode, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const [sentKeys, setSentKeys] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
    const sendingSetRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
    useEffect(() => {
      if (!post) { sendingSetRef.current.clear(); setSentKeys({}); }
    }, [post]);
    if (!post) return null;

    const ink = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
    const muted = isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8';
    const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;
    const snippet = String(post.bodyEs || post.discipline || 'Entrenamiento Kinetic').slice(0, 90);
    const shareMsg = sanitizeOfficialKineticShareText(`⚡ ${post.authorName}: ${snippet}`);
    const peers = athletes.filter((a) => a?.id && String(a.id) !== String(user?.id || '')).slice(0, 10);

    const handleOneTapSquad = async (sq: any) => {
      const k = `sq_${sq.id}`;
      if (sendingSetRef.current.has(k) || sentKeys[k]) return;
      sendingSetRef.current.add(k);
      triggerHaptic('Success');
      setSentKeys((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: true }));
      await Promise.resolve(onSendToSquad?.(String(sq.id), shareMsg)).catch(() => {});
    };

    const handleOneTapPeer = async (atl: any) => {
      const k = `dm_${atl.id}`;
      if (sendingSetRef.current.has(k) || sentKeys[k]) return;
      sendingSetRef.current.add(k);
      triggerHaptic('Success');
      setSentKeys((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: true }));
      await sendCloudDirectMessage({
        senderId: String(user?.id || ''),
        senderName: String(profile?.nombre || 'Atleta Kinetic'),
        senderAvatar: profile?.avatar_url || null,
        targetId: String(atl.id),
        targetName: String(atl.nombre || 'Atleta Kinetic'),
        targetAvatar: atl.avatar_url || null,
        text: shareMsg,
      }).catch(() => {});
    };

    return (
      <Modal visible={Boolean(post)} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose} statusBarTranslucent>
        <View style={sh.overlay}>
          <Pressable style={sh.backdropTap} onPress={onClose} />
          <View style={[sh.compactSheet, { paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom + 14, 20) }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#06B6D4' }]}>
            <View style={sh.grabber} />
            <View style={sh.sheetHeader}>
              <Text style={[sh.sheetTitle, { color: ink }]}>{tx('ENVIAR PUBLICACIÓN A', 'SEND POST TO')}</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={onClose} style={NO_SEL}><Feather name="x" size={18} color={ink} /></TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 12, paddingVertical: 8 }}>
              {misEquipos.map((sq) => {
                const done = Boolean(sentKeys[`sq_${sq.id}`]);
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity key={`send_sq_${sq.id}`} style={[sh.avatarTarget, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => handleOneTapSquad(sq)}>
                    <View style={[sh.targetRing, { borderColor: done ? '#10B981' : '#A855F7' }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF' }]}>
                      <Feather name={done ? 'check' : 'users'} size={18} color={done ? '#10B981' : '#A855F7'} />
                    </View>
                    <Text style={[sh.targetLbl, { color: ink }]} numberOfLines={1}>{sq.nombre}</Text>
                    <Text style={[sh.targetSub, { color: done ? '#10B981' : muted }]}>{done ? tx('Enviado ✓', 'Sent ✓') : tx('Equipo', 'Team')}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
              {peers.map((atl) => {
                const done = Boolean(sentKeys[`dm_${atl.id}`]);
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity key={`send_dm_${atl.id}`} style={[sh.avatarTarget, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => handleOneTapPeer(atl)}>
                    <View style={[sh.targetRing, { borderColor: done ? '#10B981' : cyanInk }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF' }]}>
                      {atl.avatar_url && !done ? (
                        <Image source={{ uri: atl.avatar_url }} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }} contentFit="cover" transition={0} />
                      ) : (
                        <Feather name={done ? 'check' : 'user'} size={18} color={done ? '#10B981' : cyanInk} />
                      )}
                    </View>
                    <Text style={[sh.targetLbl, { color: ink }]} numberOfLines={1}>{String(atl.nombre || '').split(' ')[0]}</Text>
                    <Text style={[sh.targetSub, { color: done ? '#10B981' : muted }]}>{done ? tx('Enviado ✓', 'Sent ✓') : 'DM'}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[sh.extShareBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}
              onPress={async () => {
                triggerHaptic('Selection');
                try { await Share.share({ message: shareMsg }); } catch {}
                onClose();
              }}
            >
              <Feather name="share-2" size={15} color={cyanInk} />
              <Text selectable={false} style={[sh.extShareTxt, { color: ink }]}>{tx('Compartir externo', 'Share externally')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    );
  }
);

export const KinetiClubUgcSheetModal = memo(
  ({
    post,
    currentUserId,
    canDelete,
    onDeletePost,
    onModerationApplied,
    onClose,
  }: {
    post: any | null;
    currentUserId?: string | null;
    canDelete: boolean;
    onDeletePost: (postId: string) => void;
    onModerationApplied?: (msgEs: string, msgEn: string) => void;
    onClose: () => void;
  }) => {
    const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    const { isLightMode, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    if (!post) return null;
    const ink = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
    const targetUid = String(post.userId || post.authorId || '').trim();
    const isOwn = Boolean(post.isMine || (currentUserId && targetUid === String(currentUserId)));

    const handleReport = async (cat: string) => {
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      await reportUgcContent({ targetUserId: targetUid || null, targetPostId: String(post.id), contentType: 'post', reasonCategory: cat, currentUserId });
      onModerationApplied?.('Reporte enviado al equipo de moderación Kinetic.', 'Report submitted to Kinetic moderation.');
      onClose();
    };

    const handleRelation = async (action: 'restrict' | 'block') => {
      if (!targetUid) { onClose(); return; }
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      await manageUgcUserRelation({ targetUserId: targetUid, action, reason: 'wall_menu', currentUserId });
      onModerationApplied?.(
        action === 'block' ? 'Usuario bloqueado. Su contenido ya no aparecerá.' : 'Usuario restringido.',
        action === 'block' ? 'User blocked. Their content is now hidden.' : 'User restricted.'
      );
      onClose();
    };

    return (
      <Modal visible={Boolean(post)} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose} statusBarTranslucent>
        <View style={sh.overlay}>
          <Pressable style={sh.backdropTap} onPress={onClose} />
          <View style={[sh.compactSheet, { paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom + 14, 20) }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}>
            <View style={sh.grabber} />
            <Text style={[sh.sheetTitle, { color: ink, marginBottom: 10 }]}>{tx('OPCIONES DE PUBLICACIÓN', 'POST OPTIONS')}</Text>

            {canDelete && (
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[
                  sh.ugcRow,
                  {
                    borderColor: isLightMode ? '#FECACA' : 'rgba(255,59,92,0.4)',
                    backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#FEF2F2' : 'rgba(255,59,92,0.1)',
                  },
                  NO_SEL,
                ]}
                onPress={() => { onDeletePost(String(post.id)); onClose(); }}
              >
                <Feather name="trash-2" size={16} color={isLightMode ? '#B91C1C' : '#FF3B5C'} />
                <Text selectable={false} style={[sh.ugcTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#B91C1C' : '#FF3B5C' }]}>{tx('Eliminar publicación', 'Delete post')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}

            {!isOwn && (
              <>
                {[
                  { k: 'spam', l: tx('Reportar: Spam o promoción engañosa', 'Report: Spam or misleading promo') },
                  { k: 'inapropiado', l: tx('Reportar: Contenido inapropiado', 'Report: Inappropriate content') },
                  { k: 'acoso_seguridad', l: tx('Reportar: Acoso o seguridad', 'Report: Harassment or safety') },
                ].map((r) => (
                  <TouchableOpacity key={r.k} style={[sh.ugcRow, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => handleReport(r.k)}>
                    <Feather name="flag" size={15} color={isLightMode ? '#B45309' : '#FBBF24'} />
                    <Text selectable={false} style={[sh.ugcTxt, { color: ink }]}>{r.l}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                ))}
                {Boolean(targetUid) && (
                  <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={[sh.ugcRow, { flex: 1 }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => handleRelation('restrict')}>
                      <Feather name="eye-off" size={15} color={ink} />
                      <Text selectable={false} style={[sh.ugcTxt, { color: ink }]}>{tx('Restringir', 'Restrict')}</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={[sh.ugcRow, { flex: 1, borderColor: 'rgba(255,59,92,0.4)' }, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => handleRelation('block')}>
                      <Feather name="slash" size={15} color="#FF3B5C" />
                      <Text selectable={false} style={[sh.ugcTxt, { color: '#FF3B5C' }]}>{tx('Bloquear', 'Block')}</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    );
  }
);
