    // === src/components/kineticlub/KinetiClubFeedCard.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Platform, ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { IKineticAffiliateCatalogItem } from '../../constants/affiliatesCatalog';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { formatPostRelativeTime } from '../../services/kineticlubFeedAndSquadHelpers';
import { matchVerifiedAffiliateForPost } from '../../services/kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { feedCardStyles as fc } from '../../styles/kineticlubHybridWall.styles';
import { translateDiscipline } from '../../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';
import { getAvatarUrl } from '../../utils/supabaseImage';
import { KineticSmartImage, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const KINETIC_OFFICIAL_LOGO = require('../../../assets/logo.png') as number;

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as unknown as ViewStyle) : null;
const ON_MEDIA_PROPS: Record<string, unknown> = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } : {};

export type KinetiClubCardEntry = Record<string, unknown> & {
  id?: string | number;
  userId?: string | null;
  authorId?: string | null;
  authorName?: string | null;
  authorAvatar?: string | null;
  authorRank?: string | null;
  authorAthlete?: { avatar_url?: string | null; [k: string]: unknown } | null;
  mediaUris?: string[];
  mediaUri?: string | null;
  bodyEn?: string | null;
  bodyEs?: string | null;
  created_at?: string | null;
  createdAt?: string | null;
  createdAtMs?: number | null;
  discipline?: string | null;
  disciplina?: string | null;
  venue?: string | null;
  sede?: string | null;
  baseFire?: number | null;
  isMine?: boolean;
  canDelete?: boolean;
  isSavedByMe?: boolean;
};

export interface KinetiClubFeedCardProps {
  entry: KinetiClubCardEntry;
  isFiredByMe: boolean;
  isSavedByMe: boolean;
  commentsCount: number;
  hasActiveStory: boolean;
  onToggleFire: (postId: string, forceAddOnly?: boolean) => void;
  onToggleSave: (postId: string) => void;
  onOpenComments: (post: KinetiClubCardEntry) => void;
  onOpenSendSheet: (post: KinetiClubCardEntry) => void;
  onOpenContextMenu: (post: KinetiClubCardEntry) => void;
  onOpenLightbox: (photos: string[], initialIndex: number, caption?: string) => void;
  onOpenStory: (athlete: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onInspectAthlete: (athlete: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onOpenPromoClub?: (affiliate: IKineticAffiliateCatalogItem) => void;
}

export const KinetiClubFeedCard: React.FC<KinetiClubFeedCardProps> = memo(
  ({
    entry, isFiredByMe, isSavedByMe, commentsCount, hasActiveStory,
    onToggleFire, onToggleSave, onOpenComments, onOpenSendSheet, onOpenContextMenu,
    onOpenLightbox, onOpenStory, onInspectAthlete, onOpenPromoClub,
  }) => {
    const { isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const isEn = language === 'en';
    const [slideIdx, setSlideIdx] = useState(0);
    const [mediaWidth, setMediaWidth] = useState(340);
    const [captionExpanded, setCaptionExpanded] = useState(false);
    const [avatarFailed, setAvatarFailed] = useState(false);

    const pulseScale = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const pulseOpacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const singleTapTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
    const lastTapMsRef = useRef(0);

    useEffect(() => () => { if (singleTapTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(singleTapTimerRef.current); }, []);

    const cardPhotos: string[] = Array.isArray(entry.mediaUris) && entry.mediaUris.length > 0
      ? entry.mediaUris : entry.mediaUri ? [entry.mediaUri] : [];
    const rawBody = String((isEn ? entry.bodyEn || entry.bodyEs : entry.bodyEs || entry.bodyEn) || '').trim();
    const timeTxt = formatPostRelativeTime(entry.created_at || entry.createdAt || entry.createdAtMs || entry.id, isEn);
    const discLabel = translateDiscipline(entry.discipline || entry.disciplina || 'Fuerza', language);
    const matchedAffiliate = matchVerifiedAffiliateForPost(entry);
    const venueRaw = String(entry.venue || entry.sede || '').trim();
    const venueDisplay = matchedAffiliate?.nombre || (venueRaw && venueRaw !== 'Kinetic Oficial' ? venueRaw : '');
    const isOfficialKineticActor = Boolean(
      !matchedAffiliate &&
        (String(entry.userId || entry.authorId || '') === '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' ||
          /^kinetic\s+(oficial|official)$/i.test(String(entry.authorName || '').trim()))
    );
    const isOfficialBadge = Boolean(
      isOfficialKineticActor || String(entry.userId || '') === '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' || matchedAffiliate
    );
    const rawAvatar = String(
      entry.authorAvatar || entry.authorAthlete?.avatar_url || matchedAffiliate?.avatar_url || matchedAffiliate?.imagen_url || ''
    ).trim();
    const resolvedAvatarUri = rawAvatar ? getAvatarUrl(rawAvatar, 160) : '';
    useEffect(() => {
      setAvatarFailed(false);
    }, [resolvedAvatarUri]);
    const totalFire = Math.max(0, Number(entry.baseFire || 0)) + (isFiredByMe ? 1 : 0);
    const ink = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
    const muted = isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8';
    const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;

    const triggerFireBurst = useCallback(() => {
      triggerHaptic('Medium');
      onToggleFire(String(entry.id), true);
      pulseScale.setValue(0.35); pulseOpacity.setValue(1);
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.spring(pulseScale, { toValue: 1.15, useNativeDriver: true, friction: 5 }),
        Animated.sequence([Animated.delay(320), Animated.timing(pulseOpacity, { toValue: 0, duration: 240, useNativeDriver: true })]),
      ]).start();
    }, [entry.id, onToggleFire, pulseScale, pulseOpacity]);

    const handlePhotoTap = useCallback((idx: number) => {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastTapMsRef.current < 270) {
        lastTapMsRef.current = 0;
        if (singleTapTimerRef.current) { clearTimeout(singleTapTimerRef.current); singleTapTimerRef.current = null; }
        triggerFireBurst();
        return;
      }
      lastTapMsRef.current = now;
      if (singleTapTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(singleTapTimerRef.current);
      singleTapTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        singleTapTimerRef.current = null; triggerHaptic('Selection'); onOpenLightbox(cardPhotos, idx, rawBody);
      }, 270);
    }, [cardPhotos, rawBody, onOpenLightbox, triggerFireBurst]);

    const authorTarget = entry.authorAthlete || {
      id: entry.userId || entry.authorId || entry.id,
      nombre: entry.authorName,
      avatar_url: resolvedAvatarUri || rawAvatar || null,
      disciplina: entry.discipline || entry.disciplina || 'Fuerza',
      nivel: entry.authorRank || 'Acceso Base',
    };
    const subtitleParts = [discLabel, venueDisplay, timeTxt].filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
    const needsMoreToggle = rawBody.length > 105 || rawBody.includes('\n');

    return (
      <View style={[fc.card, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }]}>
        <View style={fc.headerRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            style={[
              fc.avatarBox, NO_SEL,
              hasActiveStory ? { borderColor: isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : '#00F0FF', borderWidth: 2.2 } : { borderColor: isLightMode ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', borderWidth: 1.2 },
              { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#E2E8F0' : '#0F172A' },
            ]}
            onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); if (hasActiveStory) onOpenStory(authorTarget); else onInspectAthlete(authorTarget); }}
          >
            {resolvedAvatarUri && !avatarFailed ? (
              <KineticSmartImage uri={resolvedAvatarUri} fallbackCategory={String(entry.discipline || 'Fuerza')} transition={180} style={fc.fullImg} />
            ) : isOfficialKineticActor ? (
              <KineticSmartImage source={KINETIC_OFFICIAL_LOGO} transition={180} style={fc.fullImg} />
            ) : (
              <Feather name="user" size={16} color={cyanInk} />
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <View style={fc.headerCenter}>
            <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.8} style={[fc.nameLineRow, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => onInspectAthlete(authorTarget)}>
              <Text selectable={false} style={[fc.authorName, { color: ink }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                {entry.authorName}
              </Text>
              {isOfficialBadge && (
                <View style={[fc.officialBadge, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4' }]}>
                  <Text selectable={false} style={[fc.officialBadgeTxt, { color: cyanInk }]}>
                    {tx('⚡ Oficial Kinetic', '⚡ Kinetic Official')}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <View style={fc.subMetaRow}>
              <Text selectable={false} style={[fc.subMetaTxt, { color: muted }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                {subtitleParts}
              </Text>
              {matchedAffiliate && onOpenPromoClub && (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  activeOpacity={0.8}
                  style={NO_SEL}
                  hitSlop={{ top: 6, bottom: 6, left: 6, right: 6 }}
                  onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onOpenPromoClub(matchedAffiliate); }}
                >
                  <Text selectable={false} style={[fc.venueLinkTxt, { color: cyanInk }]}>
                    {tx('Conocer Sede ›', 'View Venue ›')}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
            </View>
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}
            accessibilityLabel={tx('Opciones de publicación', 'Post options')}
            style={[fc.moreBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}
            onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onOpenContextMenu(entry); }}
          >
            <Feather name="more-horizontal" size={17} color={muted} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {cardPhotos.length > 0 ? (
          <View
            style={fc.stage4x5}
            onLayout={(e) => setMediaWidth(Math.max(1, e.nativeEvent.layout.width))}
          >
            {cardPhotos.length === 1 ? (
              <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.96} style={[fc.fullImg, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => handlePhotoTap(0)}>
                <KineticSmartImage uri={cardPhotos[0]} fallbackCategory={String(entry.discipline || 'Fuerza')} transition={180} style={fc.fullImg} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ) : (
              <ScrollView
                horizontal
                pagingEnabled
                showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
                scrollEventThrottle={16}
                onScroll={(e) => {
                  const n = Math.max(0, Math.min(cardPhotos.length - 1, Math.round(e.nativeEvent.contentOffset.x / mediaWidth)));
                  if (n !== slideIdx) setSlideIdx(n);
                }}
              >
                {cardPhotos.map((uri, i) => (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={`${uri.slice(-24)}_${i}`}
                    activeOpacity={0.96}
                    style={[{ width: mediaWidth, height: '100%' }, NO_SEL]}
                    onPress={() => handlePhotoTap(i)}
                  >
                    <KineticSmartImage uri={uri} fallbackCategory={String(entry.discipline || 'Fuerza')} transition={180} style={fc.fullImg} />
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                ))}
              </ScrollView>
            )}

            <View style={fc.countBadge} pointerEvents="none" {...ON_MEDIA_PROPS}>
              <Text selectable={false} style={fc.countBadgeTxt}>{`${slideIdx + 1}/${cardPhotos.length}`}</Text>
            </View>

            {cardPhotos.length > 1 && (
              <View style={fc.dotsRow} pointerEvents="none">
                {cardPhotos.map((_, i) => (
                  <View key={`f45_dot_${i}`} style={[fc.dot, i === slideIdx && fc.dotActive]} />
                ))}
              </View>
            )}

            <Animated.View
              pointerEvents="none"
              style={[fc.fireBurstWrap, { opacity: pulseOpacity, transform: [{ scale: pulseScale }] }]}
            >
              <Text selectable={false} style={fc.fireBurstEmoji}>🔥</Text>
            </Animated.View>
          </View>
        ) : (
          Boolean(rawBody) && (
            <View style={[fc.textOnlyStage, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
              <Text style={[fc.textOnlyBody, { color: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#F1F5F9' }]}>{rawBody}</Text>
            </View>
          )
        )}

        <View style={[fc.actionsRow, isLightMode && { borderTopColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
          <View style={fc.actionsLeft}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              activeOpacity={0.8}
              accessibilityLabel={tx('Fuego', 'Fire')}
              style={[
                fc.actionBtn,
                NO_SEL,
                isLightMode && !isFiredByMe && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' },
                isFiredByMe && (isLightMode
                  ? { backgroundColor: '#FEF3C7', borderColor: '#F59E0B' }
                  : { backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,107,53,0.18)', borderColor: '#FF6B35' }),
              ]}
              onPress={() => onToggleFire(String(entry.id))}
            >
              <Text selectable={false} style={[fc.actionTxt, { color: isFiredByMe ? (isLightMode ? '#B45309' : '#FF8C42') : ink }]}>
                {`🔥 ${totalFire}`}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity
              activeOpacity={0.8}
              accessibilityLabel={tx('Comentarios', 'Comments')}
              style={[fc.actionBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}
              onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onOpenComments(entry); }}
            >
              <Feather name="message-circle" size={15} color={ink} />
              <Text selectable={false} style={[fc.actionTxt, { color: ink }]}>{commentsCount}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity
              activeOpacity={0.8}
              accessibilityLabel={tx('Enviar a', 'Send to')}
              style={[fc.actionBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}
              onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onOpenSendSheet(entry); }}
            >
              <Feather name="send" size={14} color={cyanInk} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityLabel={tx('Guardar publicación', 'Save post')}
            style={[
              fc.bookmarkBtn,
              NO_SEL,
              isLightMode && !isSavedByMe && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' },
              isSavedByMe && (isLightMode
                ? { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#0284C7' }
                : { backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,240,255,0.18)', borderColor: '#00F0FF' }),
            ]}
            onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onToggleSave(String(entry.id)); }}
          >
            <Feather name="bookmark" size={15} color={isSavedByMe ? cyanInk : muted} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {cardPhotos.length > 0 && rawBody.length > 0 && (
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.88}
            disabled={!needsMoreToggle}
            style={[fc.captionWrap, NO_SEL]}
            onPress={() => setCaptionExpanded((v) => !v)}
          >
            <Text style={[fc.captionTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#1E293B' : '#E2E8F0' }]} numberOfLines={captionExpanded ? undefined : 2}>
              <Text style={[fc.captionAuthor, { color: ink }]}>{`${entry.authorName} `}</Text>
              {rawBody}
            </Text>
            {needsMoreToggle && !captionExpanded && (
              <Text selectable={false} style={[fc.moreInlineTxt, { color: muted }]}>{tx('… más', '… more')}</Text>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>
    );
  }
);

    // === src/components/kineticlub/KinetiClubMessagesInlineView.tsx === //
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, ScrollView, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { normalizeChatIdentity } from '../../services/kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import {
  getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot,
  getSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot,
  setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot,
} from '../../services/kineticDirectMessagesBridge';
import {
  DM_SEEN_COUNTS_STORAGE_PREFIX, IDirectMessageThread, acceptCloudDirectMessage, deleteDirectMessageThread, deleteSquadCloud,
  isStrictDmParticipant, isUuid, leaveSquadCloud, loadLocalDmThreads, markDmSeenCountInStorage, matchesUserIdentity, syncDirectMessagesFromCloud,
} from '../../services/kineticRealtimeChatBridge';
import { getActiveStoriesMapSync } from '../../services/kineticStoriesService';
import { useKineticLivePresence } from '../../services/kineticRealtimePresenceService';
import { hasActiveStoryInMap } from '../../services/kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
import {
  IUnifiedMessengerRow, MessengerFilterTab, SocialGraphZoneFilter,
  buildUnifiedMessengerStream, computeSocialGraphSuggestions, expandSocialIdSet, extractMessengerRequestsAndRestricted, isSocialIdMatched,
} from '../../services/kineticlubSocialGraphHelper';
import { GLOBAL_SHARED_MESSAGES_KEY, fetchSquadMessagesForTeam, subscribeSquadsDataChanged } from '../../services/kineticlubSquadsService';
import { getBlockedUserIdsSet, getRestrictedUserIdsSet, hydrateUgcModerationState, subscribeUgcModerationChanged } from '../../services/kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import { subscribeKinetiClubChatsRealtimeAndFocus } from '../../services/kineticlubWallCloudService';
import { messengerStyles as ms } from '../../styles/kineticlubMessenger.styles';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { KineticListFilterSortBar } from '../shared/KineticListFilterSortBar';
import { KinetiClubMessengerSheets } from './KinetiClubMessengerSheets';

const NO_SEL: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;
const DARK_INK_PROPS: any = { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };
const SEEN_COUNTS_KEY_PREFIX = DM_SEEN_COUNTS_STORAGE_PREFIX;

const buildThreadsSig = (threads: IDirectMessageThread[]): string =>
  (threads || []).map((t) => `${t.dmCode}:${t.status}:${t.messages?.length || 0}:${t.updatedAt}`).join('|');

const formatShortRelative = (msTs: number, isEn: boolean): string => {
  if (!msTs || msTs <= 10) return '';
  const s = Math.max(1, Math.floor((Date.now() - msTs) / 1000));
  return s < 60 ? (isEn ? 'now' : 'ahora') : s < 3600 ? `${Math.floor(s / 60)}m` : s < 86400 ? `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h` : `${Math.floor(s / 86400)}d`;
};

export interface KinetiClubMessagesInlineViewProps {
  user: any; profile: any; misEquipos: any[]; athletes: any[];
  solicitudesEquipoPendientes?: any[]; activeStoriesMap?: Record<string, any[]>;
  onResponderSolicitud?: (inviteId: string, accept: boolean) => Promise<void> | void;
  onOpenStory?: (athleteOrOwner: any) => void;
  onOpenSquadsModal: (section: 'hub' | 'invitar' | 'chat') => void;
  onOpenSquadGroupChat: (squad: any) => void;
  onOpenDirectThread: (thread: IDirectMessageThread) => void;
  onOpenDmWithAthlete: (athlete: any) => void;
}

export const KinetiClubMessagesInlineView = React.memo((props: KinetiClubMessagesInlineViewProps) => {
  const {
    user, profile, misEquipos = [], athletes = [], solicitudesEquipoPendientes = [],
    activeStoriesMap, onResponderSolicitud, onOpenStory,
    onOpenSquadsModal, onOpenSquadGroupChat, onOpenDirectThread, onOpenDmWithAthlete,
  } = props;

  const { isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const { onlineUserIds } = useKineticLivePresence(user, profile);
  const isEn = language === 'en';
  const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : '#00F0FF';
  const purpleInk = isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#E0AAFF';
  const primaryInk = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#F8FAFC';
  const mutedInk = isLightMode ? '#64748B' : '#94A3B8';

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterTab, setFilterTab] = useState<MessengerFilterTab>('all');
  const [zoneFilter, setZoneFilter] = useState<SocialGraphZoneFilter>('ALL');
  const [dmThreads, setDmThreads] = useState<IDirectMessageThread[]>(() => getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot(user?.id, profile?.nombre));
  const [squadRoomsMessagesMap, setSquadRoomsMessagesMap] = useState<Record<string, any[]>>(() => getSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot());
  const [seenCountsMap, setSeenCountsMap] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [ugcTick, setUgcTick] = useState(0);
  const [showNewMsgSheet, setShowNewMsgSheet] = useState(false);
  const [showPrivacySheet, setShowPrivacySheet] = useState(false);
  const [privacyInitialTab, setPrivacyInitialTab] = useState<'requests' | 'blocked'>('requests');
  const [contextRow, setContextRow] = useState<IUnifiedMessengerRow | null>(null);

  const sigRef = useRef(buildThreadsSig(dmThreads));
  const lastCloudSyncRef = useRef(0);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const misEquiposRef = useRef(misEquipos);
  misEquiposRef.current = misEquipos;

  useEffect(() => { mountedRef.current = true; return () => { mountedRef.current = false; }; }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSeenCountsMap({});
    const uid = String(user?.id || '').trim();
    if (!uid) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    AsyncStorage.getItem(`${SEEN_COUNTS_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`)
      .then((raw) => { if (!cancelled && mountedRef.current && raw) { const p = JSON.parse(raw); if (p && typeof p === 'object') setSeenCountsMap(p); } })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [user?.id]);

  const markRowSeen = useCallback((rowKey: string, altKey: string, totalCount: number) => {
    const uid = String(user?.id || '').trim();
    setSeenCountsMap((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev, [rowKey]: totalCount, ...(altKey ? { [altKey]: totalCount } : {}) };
      if (uid) AsyncStorage.setItem(`${SEEN_COUNTS_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`, JSON.stringify(next)).catch(() => {});
      return next;
    });
  }, [user?.id]);

  const syncAllChannels = useCallback(async (forceCloud = false) => {
    const uid = String(user?.id || '').trim(), myName = String(profile?.nombre || '').trim();
    if (!uid) { if (mountedRef.current) { sigRef.current = ''; setDmThreads([]); setSquadRoomsMessagesMap({}); } return; }
    try {
      const [localDms, rawSharedMsgs, rawSeenCounts] = await Promise.all([
        loadLocalDmThreads(uid, myName),
        AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_MESSAGES_KEY).catch(() => null),
        AsyncStorage.getItem(`${SEEN_COUNTS_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`).catch(() => null),
      ]);
      if (rawSeenCounts && mountedRef.current) {
        try { const parsedSeen = JSON.parse(rawSeenCounts); if (parsedSeen && typeof parsedSeen === 'object') setSeenCountsMap(parsedSeen); } catch {}
      }
      if (rawSharedMsgs && mountedRef.current) {
        try {
          const p = JSON.parse(rawSharedMsgs);
          if (p && typeof p === 'object') {
            setSquadRoomsMessagesMap((prev) => {
              const merged = { ...prev, ...p };
              setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot(merged);
              return merged;
            });
          }
        } catch {}
      }
      const strictLocal = localDms.filter((t) => isStrictDmParticipant(uid, myName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName));
      const localSig = buildThreadsSig(strictLocal);
      if (mountedRef.current && localSig !== sigRef.current && (strictLocal.length > 0 || forceCloud)) {
        sigRef.current = localSig; setDmThreads(strictLocal);
      }
      const now = Date.now();
      if ((!forceCloud && lastCloudSyncRef.current > 0 && now - lastCloudSyncRef.current < 90_000) || (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.hidden)) return;
      lastCloudSyncRef.current = now;

      const [cloudDms, ...squadResults] = await Promise.all([
        syncDirectMessagesFromCloud(uid, myName),
        ...(misEquiposRef.current || []).slice(0, 8).map(async (sq: any) => {
          if (!sq?.id) return null;
          const msgs = await fetchSquadMessagesForTeam(String(sq.id), sq.creador_nombre || myName, sq.nombre).catch(() => []);
          return [String(sq.id), msgs] as const;
        }),
      ]);
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      const strictCloud = cloudDms.filter((t) => isStrictDmParticipant(uid, myName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName));
      const nextSig = buildThreadsSig(strictCloud);
      if (nextSig !== sigRef.current) { sigRef.current = nextSig; setDmThreads(strictCloud); }
      const nextSqMap: Record<string, any[]> = {};
      squadResults.forEach((pair) => { if (pair) nextSqMap[pair[0]] = pair[1]; });
      if (Object.keys(nextSqMap).length > 0) {
        setSquadRoomsMessagesMap((prev) => {
          const merged = { ...prev, ...nextSqMap };
          setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot(merged);
          return merged;
        });
      }
    } catch {}
  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre]);

  useEffect(() => { syncAllChannels(false); }, [syncAllChannels]);
  useEffect(() => subscribeSquadsDataChanged(() => { syncAllChannels(true); }), [syncAllChannels]);
  useEffect(() => subscribeKinetiClubChatsRealtimeAndFocus(user?.id, () => { syncAllChannels(true); }), [user?.id, syncAllChannels]);
  useEffect(() => {
    hydrateUgcModerationState(user?.id).catch(() => {});
    return subscribeUgcModerationChanged(() => { setUgcTick((n) => n + 1); syncAllChannels(true); });
  }, [user?.id, syncAllChannels]);
  useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { syncAllChannels(true); }, [syncAllChannels]));

  const blockedSet = useMemo(() => { void ugcTick; return getBlockedUserIdsSet(); }, [ugcTick]);
  const restrictedSet = useMemo(() => { void ugcTick; return getRestrictedUserIdsSet(); }, [ugcTick]);
  const storiesMap = activeStoriesMap || getActiveStoriesMapSync();

  const allStream = useMemo(() => buildUnifiedMessengerStream({
    dmThreads, misEquipos, squadRoomsMessagesMap, seenCountsMap, blockedIdsSet: blockedSet, restrictedIdsSet: restrictedSet,
    myUserId: user?.id, myUserName: profile?.nombre, lang: isEn ? 'en' : 'es',
  }), [dmThreads, misEquipos, squadRoomsMessagesMap, seenCountsMap, blockedSet, restrictedSet, user?.id, profile?.nombre, isEn]);

  const unifiedRows = useMemo(() => buildUnifiedMessengerStream({
    dmThreads, misEquipos, squadRoomsMessagesMap, seenCountsMap, blockedIdsSet: blockedSet, restrictedIdsSet: restrictedSet,
    myUserId: user?.id, myUserName: profile?.nombre, filterTab, searchQuery, lang: isEn ? 'en' : 'es',
  }), [dmThreads, misEquipos, squadRoomsMessagesMap, seenCountsMap, blockedSet, restrictedSet, user?.id, profile?.nombre, filterTab, searchQuery, isEn]);

  const totalUnreadCount = useMemo(() => allStream.filter((r) => r.unreadCount > 0).length, [allStream]);

  const { incomingPendingDms, restrictedThreads, validSquadInvites, totalRequestsBadge } = useMemo(
    () => extractMessengerRequestsAndRestricted({ dmThreads, solicitudesEquipoPendientes, blockedIdsSet: blockedSet, restrictedIdsSet: restrictedSet, myUserId: user?.id, myUserName: profile?.nombre }),
    [dmThreads, solicitudesEquipoPendientes, blockedSet, restrictedSet, user?.id, profile?.nombre]
  );

  const suggestions = useMemo(() => computeSocialGraphSuggestions({
    athletes, misEquipos, dmThreads, blockedIdsSet: blockedSet, restrictedIdsSet: restrictedSet,
    myUserId: user?.id, myUserName: profile?.nombre, myEmail: user?.email || profile?.email,
    myVenue: profile?.gimnasio || profile?.sede, myDiscipline: profile?.disciplina, zoneFilter, lang: isEn ? 'en' : 'es', limit: 18,
  }), [athletes, misEquipos, dmThreads, blockedSet, restrictedSet, user?.id, user?.email, profile?.nombre, profile?.email, profile?.gimnasio, profile?.sede, profile?.disciplina, zoneFilter, isEn]);

  const activeConnections = useMemo(() => {
    const out: { id: string; nombre: string; avatar: string | null; rawAthlete: any; hasStory: boolean }[] = [];
    const seen = new Set<string>(), myUid = String(user?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase(), squadSlugs = new Set<string>();
    const blockedExp = expandSocialIdSet(blockedSet), restrictedExp = expandSocialIdSet(restrictedSet);
    (misEquipos || []).forEach((sq: any) => { if (Array.isArray(sq?.integrantes_nombres)) sq.integrantes_nombres.forEach((n: any) => squadSlugs.add(normalizeChatIdentity(n))); });
    const fbAthlete = isEn ? 'Athlete' : 'Atleta';
    for (const dm of dmThreads) {
      if (dm.status !== 'accepted') continue;
      const iAmReq = matchesUserIdentity(myUid, profile?.nombre, dm.requesterId, dm.requesterName);
      const pid = String((iAmReq ? dm.targetId : dm.requesterId) || '').trim(), pLow = pid.toLowerCase();
      const pname = String((iAmReq ? dm.targetName : dm.requesterName) || '').trim();
      if (!pLow || pLow === myUid || isSocialIdMatched(blockedExp, pLow) || isSocialIdMatched(restrictedExp, pLow) || seen.has(pLow)) continue;
      const hitAth = (athletes || []).find((a) => String(a?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase() === pLow);
      if (hitAth?.radar_publico === false) continue;
      seen.add(pLow);
      const av = (iAmReq ? dm.targetAvatar : dm.requesterAvatar) || hitAth?.avatar_url || null;
      out.push({ id: pid, nombre: pname || hitAth?.nombre || fbAthlete, avatar: av, rawAthlete: hitAth || { id: pid, nombre: pname, avatar_url: av }, hasStory: hasActiveStoryInMap(storiesMap, pid, pname, Date.now(), blockedExp) });
    }
    for (const a of athletes || []) {
      if (!a || a.radar_publico === false) continue;
      const aid = String(a?.id || '').trim(), aLow = aid.toLowerCase();
      if (!aLow || aLow === myUid || isSocialIdMatched(blockedExp, aLow) || isSocialIdMatched(restrictedExp, aLow) || seen.has(aLow) || !squadSlugs.has(normalizeChatIdentity(a?.nombre))) continue;
      seen.add(aLow);
      out.push({ id: aid, nombre: String(a.nombre || fbAthlete), avatar: a.avatar_url || null, rawAthlete: a, hasStory: hasActiveStoryInMap(storiesMap, aid, a.nombre, Date.now(), blockedExp) });
    }
    return out.slice(0, 16);
  }, [dmThreads, misEquipos, athletes, user?.id, profile?.nombre, blockedSet, restrictedSet, storiesMap, isEn]);

  const handleOpenRow = useCallback((row: IUnifiedMessengerRow) => {
    triggerHaptic('Selection');
    if (row.kind === 'dm' && row.rawThread) {
      markRowSeen(row.id, row.dmCode || '', row.rawThread.messages?.length || 0);
      void markDmSeenCountInStorage(user?.id, row.rawThread);
      onOpenDirectThread(row.rawThread);
    } else if (row.kind === 'squad' && row.rawSquad) {
      const sqId = String(row.rawSquad.id || '');
      markRowSeen(row.id, sqId, squadRoomsMessagesMap[sqId]?.length || 0);
      onOpenSquadGroupChat(row.rawSquad);
    }
  }, [markRowSeen, onOpenDirectThread, onOpenSquadGroupChat, squadRoomsMessagesMap, user?.id]);

  const handleAcceptDm = useCallback(async (thread: IDirectMessageThread): Promise<IDirectMessageThread> => {
    triggerHaptic('Success');
    const updated = await acceptCloudDirectMessage(thread.dmCode, user?.id, profile?.nombre, thread);
    const nextThread: IDirectMessageThread = updated ? { ...updated, status: 'accepted' } : { ...thread, status: 'accepted' };
    const iAmReq = matchesUserIdentity(user?.id, profile?.nombre, nextThread.requesterId, nextThread.requesterName);
    const peerLow = String((iAmReq ? nextThread.targetId : nextThread.requesterId) || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const rowKey = isUuid(peerLow) ? `dm:peer:${peerLow}` : `dm:${nextThread.dmCode.toLowerCase()}`;
    markRowSeen(rowKey, nextThread.dmCode, nextThread.messages?.length || 0);
    setDmThreads((prev) => {
      const has = prev.some((t) => t.dmCode === nextThread.dmCode || t.dmCode === thread.dmCode);
      const next = has
        ? prev.map((t) => (t.dmCode === thread.dmCode || t.dmCode === nextThread.dmCode ? nextThread : t))
        : [nextThread, ...prev];
      sigRef.current = buildThreadsSig(next);
      return next;
    });
    return nextThread;
  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre, markRowSeen]);

  const handleDeleteDm = useCallback(async (dmCode: string) => {
    await deleteDirectMessageThread(dmCode, user?.id, profile?.nombre);
    setDmThreads((prev) => { const next = prev.filter((t) => t.dmCode !== dmCode); sigRef.current = buildThreadsSig(next); return next; });
  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre]);

  const zoneChips: { key: SocialGraphZoneFilter; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'ALL', label: tx('Todo Los Cabos', 'All Los Cabos') },
    { key: 'CABO SAN LUCAS', label: 'Cabo San Lucas' },
    { key: 'CORREDOR TURÍSTICO', label: tx('Corredor Turístico', 'Tourist Corridor') },
    { key: 'SAN JOSÉ DEL CABO', label: 'San José del Cabo' },
  ];
  const lightBox = isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' } : null;
  const privacyCount = totalRequestsBadge + restrictedSet.size + blockedSet.size;

  return (
    <View style={ms.root}>
      <KineticListFilterSortBar
        searchQuery={searchQuery}
        onChangeSearch={setSearchQuery}
        searchPlaceholder={tx('Buscar conversación o equipo...', 'Search chat or team...')}
        filterChips={[
          { key: 'all', label: tx('💬 Todos', '💬 All') },
          { key: 'unread', label: totalUnreadCount > 0 ? `${tx('🔔 No leídos', '🔔 Unread')} (${totalUnreadCount})` : tx('🔔 No leídos', '🔔 Unread') },
          { key: 'squads', label: tx('⚡ Equipos', '⚡ Teams') },
        ]}
        activeFilter={filterTab}
        onSelectFilter={(k) => setFilterTab(k as MessengerFilterTab)}
        hideSort
        rightSlot={
          <TouchableOpacity {...DARK_INK_PROPS} activeOpacity={0.86} style={[ms.newMsgCyanBtn, NO_SEL, { minHeight: 44 }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#00D8E8', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#CFFAFE', borderBottomColor: '#0284C7' }]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setShowNewMsgSheet(true); }}>
            <Feather name="edit" size={14} color="#050505" />
            <Text selectable={false} style={ms.newMsgCyanTxt}>{tx('Nuevo', 'New')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        }
      />

      {activeConnections.length > 0 && (
        <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={ms.activeStripScroll}>
          {activeConnections.map((conn) => {
            const isPeerLive = onlineUserIds.has(String(conn.id || '').trim());
            return (
              <TouchableOpacity key={conn.id} activeOpacity={0.85} style={[ms.activeNodeWrap, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); if (conn.hasStory && onOpenStory) onOpenStory(conn.rawAthlete); else onOpenDmWithAthlete(conn.rawAthlete); }}>
                <View style={[ms.activeRingOuter, isLightMode && { borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }, conn.hasStory && ms.activeRingStory]}>
                  {conn.avatar ? <Image source={{ uri: conn.avatar }} style={ms.activeAvatarImg} contentFit="cover" transition={0} /> : <View style={[ms.activeAvatarFallback, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}><Feather name="user" size={17} color={cyanInk} /></View>}
                  {isPeerLive && <View style={[ms.greenOnlineDot, isLightMode && { borderColor: '#FFFFFF' }]} />}
                </View>
                <Text selectable={false} style={[ms.activeNodeName, { color: primaryInk }]} numberOfLines={1}>{conn.nombre.split(' ')[0]}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            );
          })}
        </ScrollView>
      )}

      <View style={ms.inboxListWrap}>
        {unifiedRows.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={[ms.emptyInboxCard, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
            <Feather name="message-circle" size={22} color={cyanInk} />
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800', color: primaryInk, textAlign: 'center' }}>
              {filterTab === 'unread' ? tx('Todo al día • 0 mensajes sin leer', 'All caught up • 0 unread messages')
                : filterTab === 'squads' ? tx('Aún no perteneces a un Equipo activo', 'No active Teams yet')
                : tx('Tu bandeja está lista para conectar', 'Your inbox is ready to connect')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 11.5, color: mutedInk, textAlign: 'center' }}>{tx('Toca Nuevo o elige una sugerencia de tu zona.', 'Tap New or pick a local suggestion below.')}</Text>
          </View>
        ) : unifiedRows.map((row) => (
          <TouchableOpacity key={row.id} activeOpacity={0.86} style={[ms.threadRow, NO_SEL, lightBox, row.unreadCount > 0 && { borderColor: isLightMode ? '#06B6D4' : 'rgba(0,240,255,0.42)' }]} onPress={() => handleOpenRow(row)} onLongPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Medium'); setContextRow(row); }}>
            <View style={ms.avatarBox}>
              {row.avatarUrl ? <Image source={{ uri: row.avatarUrl }} style={ms.avatarImg} contentFit="cover" transition={0} /> : <View style={[ms.avatarPlaceholder, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#7DD3FC' }]}><Feather name={row.kind === 'squad' ? 'users' : 'user'} size={19} color={row.kind === 'squad' ? purpleInk : cyanInk} /></View>}
              {(row.kind === 'squad' || row.isOfficialKinetic) && (
                <View style={[ms.cornerMiniBadge, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF' }, row.kind === 'squad' && { borderColor: purpleInk }]}>
                  {row.isOfficialKinetic ? <Text style={{ fontSize: 9 }}>⚡</Text> : <Feather name="users" size={9} color={purpleInk} />}
                </View>
              )}
              {row.kind === 'dm' && row.peerId && onlineUserIds.has(String(row.peerId).trim()) && (
                <View style={[ms.greenOnlineDot, isLightMode && { borderColor: '#FFFFFF' }]} />
              )}
            </View>
            <View style={ms.rowCenterCol}>
              <View style={ms.rowTopLine}>
                <Text style={[ms.rowTitle, { color: primaryInk }, row.unreadCount > 0 && ms.rowTitleUnread, isLightMode && row.unreadCount > 0 && { color: '#0F172A' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                  {row.isOfficialKinetic ? `⚡ ${row.title}` : row.title}
                </Text>
                <Text style={[ms.rowTimeTxt, { color: row.unreadCount > 0 ? cyanInk : mutedInk }]}>{formatShortRelative(row.lastActivityMs, isEn)}</Text>
              </View>
              <Text style={[ms.rowPreviewTxt, { color: mutedInk }, row.unreadCount > 0 && (isLightMode ? { color: '#0F172A', fontWeight: '800' } : ms.rowPreviewUnread)]} numberOfLines={1}>{row.subtitlePreview}</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={ms.rowRightActions}>
              {row.unreadCount > 0 && <View {...DARK_INK_PROPS} style={ms.unreadBadge}><Text style={ms.unreadBadgeTxt}>{row.unreadCount > 99 ? '99+' : row.unreadCount}</Text></View>}
              <TouchableOpacity style={ms.dotsBtn} hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }} accessibilityLabel={tx('Opciones de conversación', 'Conversation options')} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setContextRow(row); }}>
                <Feather name="more-horizontal" size={17} color={mutedInk} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}
      </View>

      <View style={ms.suggSectionWrap}>
        <Text style={[ms.suggHeaderTxt, { color: mutedInk }]}>{tx('CONEXIONES SUGERIDAS (< 40 KM)', 'SUGGESTED CONNECTIONS (< 40 KM)')}</Text>
        <KineticListFilterSortBar
          searchQuery=""
          onChangeSearch={() => {}}
          hideSearch
          hideSort
          filterChips={zoneChips.map((zc) => ({ key: zc.key, label: `📍 ${zc.label}` }))}
          activeFilter={zoneFilter}
          onSelectFilter={(k) => setZoneFilter(k as SocialGraphZoneFilter)}
        />
        {suggestions.length > 0 && (
          <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 9, paddingTop: 2 }}>
            {suggestions.slice(0, 12).map((sug) => (
              <View key={sug.id} style={[ms.suggCard, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }]}>
                {sug.avatarUrl ? <Image source={{ uri: sug.avatarUrl }} style={ms.suggAvatar} contentFit="cover" transition={0} /> : <View style={[ms.suggAvatar, { alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#ECFEFF' : '#1E293B' }]}><Feather name="user" size={17} color={cyanInk} /></View>}
                <Text style={[ms.suggName, { color: primaryInk }]} numberOfLines={1}>{sug.nombre}</Text>
                <Text style={[ms.suggReason, { color: cyanInk }]} numberOfLines={1}>{sug.reasonLabel}</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity {...DARK_INK_PROPS} activeOpacity={0.86} style={[ms.dmQuickPill, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onOpenDmWithAthlete(sug.athlete); }}>
                  <Feather name="send" size={10} color="#050505" />
                  <Text selectable={false} style={ms.dmQuickPillTxt}>{tx('Mensaje', 'Message')}</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            ))}
          </ScrollView>
        )}
      </View>

      <View style={ms.bottomPrivacyRow}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.86}
          style={[ms.bottomPrivacyBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF', borderColor: '#C4B5FD' }]}
          onPress={() => {
            triggerHaptic('Selection');
            setPrivacyInitialTab(totalRequestsBadge > 0 ? 'requests' : 'blocked');
            setShowPrivacySheet(true);
          }}
        >
          <Feather name="shield" size={13} color={purpleInk} />
          <Text selectable={false} style={[ms.requestsPillTxt, { color: purpleInk }]}>
            {tx('Solicitudes y Restringidos', 'Requests & Restricted')}
          </Text>
          {privacyCount > 0 && (
            <View style={ms.reqCountBadge}>
              <Text style={ms.reqCountTxt}>{privacyCount}</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <KinetiClubMessengerSheets
        myUserId={user?.id} myUserName={profile?.nombre} athletes={athletes} dmThreads={dmThreads} suggestions={suggestions}
        incomingPendingDms={incomingPendingDms} restrictedThreads={restrictedThreads} validSquadInvites={validSquadInvites}
        blockedIds={Array.from(blockedSet)} restrictedIds={Array.from(restrictedSet)}
        showNewMsgSheet={showNewMsgSheet} onCloseNewMsgSheet={() => setShowNewMsgSheet(false)}
        showPrivacySheet={showPrivacySheet} initialPrivacyTab={privacyInitialTab} onClosePrivacySheet={() => setShowPrivacySheet(false)}
        contextRow={contextRow} onCloseContextRow={() => setContextRow(null)}
        onOpenSquadsModal={onOpenSquadsModal} onStartDmWithAthlete={onOpenDmWithAthlete}
        onAcceptDm={handleAcceptDm} onDeclineDm={handleDeleteDm} onResponderSolicitud={onResponderSolicitud}
        onOpenDirectThread={onOpenDirectThread} onDeleteDm={handleDeleteDm}
        onDeleteSquad={async (id) => { await deleteSquadCloud(id, String(user?.id || '')); }}
        onLeaveSquad={async (id) => { await leaveSquadCloud(id, String(user?.id || ''), profile?.nombre); }}
      />
    </View>
  );
});

    // === src/components/kineticlub/KinetiClubMessengerSheets.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, ScrollView, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import ReactNativeModal from 'react-native-modal';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete } from '../../services/kineticAthleteDeduplication';
import { isUuid } from '../../services/kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import { IDirectMessageThread, matchesUserIdentity } from '../../services/kineticRealtimeChatBridge';
import { ISocialGraphSuggestion, IUnifiedMessengerRow, expandSocialIdSet, isSocialIdMatched } from '../../services/kineticlubSocialGraphHelper';
import { isUserSquadLeader } from '../../services/kineticlubSquadsService';
import { manageUgcUserRelation, reportUgcContent } from '../../services/kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import { messengerStyles as ms } from '../../styles/kineticlubMessenger.styles';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from '../shared/KineticModalHeader3D';

const NO_SEL: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;
const DARK_INK_PROPS: any = { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };
type ReportReason = 'spam' | 'acoso' | 'inapropiado' | 'suplantacion';

export interface KinetiClubMessengerSheetsProps {
  myUserId?: string | null; myUserName?: string | null;
  athletes: any[]; dmThreads: IDirectMessageThread[]; suggestions: ISocialGraphSuggestion[];
  incomingPendingDms: IDirectMessageThread[]; restrictedThreads: IDirectMessageThread[]; validSquadInvites: any[];
  blockedIds: string[]; restrictedIds: string[];
  showNewMsgSheet: boolean; onCloseNewMsgSheet: () => void;
  showPrivacySheet: boolean; initialPrivacyTab?: 'requests' | 'blocked'; onClosePrivacySheet: () => void;
  contextRow: IUnifiedMessengerRow | null; onCloseContextRow: () => void;
  onOpenSquadsModal: (section: 'hub' | 'invitar' | 'chat') => void;
  onStartDmWithAthlete: (athlete: any) => void;
  onAcceptDm: (thread: IDirectMessageThread) => Promise<IDirectMessageThread | void> | void;
  onDeclineDm: (dmCode: string) => Promise<void> | void;
  onResponderSolicitud?: (inviteId: string, accept: boolean) => Promise<void> | void;
  onOpenDirectThread: (thread: IDirectMessageThread) => void;
  onDeleteDm: (dmCode: string) => Promise<void> | void;
  onDeleteSquad: (squadId: string) => Promise<void> | void;
  onLeaveSquad: (squadId: string) => Promise<void> | void;
}

export const KinetiClubMessengerSheets = memo((props: KinetiClubMessengerSheetsProps) => {
  const {
    myUserId, myUserName, athletes, dmThreads, suggestions, incomingPendingDms, restrictedThreads,
    validSquadInvites, blockedIds, restrictedIds, showNewMsgSheet, onCloseNewMsgSheet,
    showPrivacySheet, initialPrivacyTab = 'requests', onClosePrivacySheet, contextRow, onCloseContextRow,
    onOpenSquadsModal, onStartDmWithAthlete, onAcceptDm, onDeclineDm, onResponderSolicitud,
    onOpenDirectThread, onDeleteDm, onDeleteSquad, onLeaveSquad,
  } = props;

  const { isLightMode, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [recipientQuery, setRecipientQuery] = useState('');
  const [privacyTab, setPrivacyTab] = useState<'requests' | 'blocked'>(initialPrivacyTab);
  const [confirmKind, setConfirmKind] = useState<null | 'delete_dm' | 'delete_squad' | 'leave_squad' | 'block' | 'report'>(null);
  const [reportReason, setReportReason] = useState<ReportReason>('inapropiado');
  const [statusFeedback, setStatusFeedback] = useState('');
  const busyRef = useRef(false);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const deferUi = (fn: () => void, delay = 130) => {
    if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    timerRef.current = setTimeout(fn, delay);
  };
  useEffect(() => () => { if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { if (showPrivacySheet) setPrivacyTab(initialPrivacyTab); }, [showPrivacySheet, initialPrivacyTab]);
  useEffect(() => { setConfirmKind(null); setReportReason('inapropiado'); setStatusFeedback(''); }, [contextRow]);

  const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : '#00F0FF';
  const purpleInk = isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#E0AAFF';
  const primaryInk = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#F8FAFC';
  const mutedInk = isLightMode ? '#64748B' : '#94A3B8';
  const sheetSurface = isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#7DD3FC', borderTopColor: '#0284C7' } : null;
  const lightRow = isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' } : null;

  const recipientResults = useMemo(() => {
    const q = recipientQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return suggestions.slice(0, 14).map((s) => ({ athlete: s.athlete, sub: s.reasonLabel }));
    const blockedExpanded = expandSocialIdSet([...blockedIds, ...restrictedIds]);
    const uidLow = String(myUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return (athletes || [])
      .filter((a) => {
        if (!a || a.radar_publico === false) return false;
        const aid = String(a?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!aid || aid === uidLow || isSocialIdMatched(blockedExpanded, aid)) return false;
        if (isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete(a, myUserId, undefined, myUserName, blockedExpanded)) return false;
        return `${a?.nombre || ''} ${a?.gimnasio || ''} ${a?.disciplina || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      })
      .slice(0, 18)
      .map((a) => ({ athlete: a, sub: String(a?.gimnasio || a?.disciplina || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')) }));
  }, [recipientQuery, suggestions, athletes, blockedIds, restrictedIds, myUserId, myUserName, tx]);

  const resolveUserLabel = (uid: string): string => {
    const low = uid.toLowerCase();
    const hitA = (athletes || []).find((a) => String(a?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase() === low);
    if (hitA?.nombre) return String(hitA.nombre);
    for (const dm of dmThreads || []) {
      if (String(dm.requesterId || '').trim().toLowerCase() === low && dm.requesterName) return dm.requesterName;
      if (String(dm.targetId || '').trim().toLowerCase() === low && dm.targetName) return dm.targetName;
    }
    return `${tx('Usuario', 'User')} #${uid.slice(0, 6)}`;
  };

  const runGuarded = async (fn: () => Promise<void> | void) => {
    if (busyRef.current) return;
    busyRef.current = true;
    try { await fn(); } finally { busyRef.current = false; }
  };

  const isSquadLeader = Boolean(contextRow?.kind === 'squad' && contextRow.rawSquad && isUserSquadLeader(contextRow.rawSquad, myUserId || ''));
  const canModeratePeer = Boolean(contextRow?.kind === 'dm' && !contextRow.isOfficialKinetic && isUuid(contextRow.peerId));
  const reportReasons: { key: ReportReason; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'inapropiado', label: tx('Contenido inapropiado', 'Inappropriate content') },
    { key: 'acoso', label: tx('Acoso o conducta abusiva', 'Harassment or abuse') },
    { key: 'spam', label: tx('Spam o enlaces no solicitados', 'Spam or unsolicited links') },
    { key: 'suplantacion', label: tx('Suplantación de identidad', 'Impersonation') },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <ReactNativeModal isVisible={showNewMsgSheet} onBackdropPress={onCloseNewMsgSheet} onBackButtonPress={onCloseNewMsgSheet} style={{ margin: 0, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }} backdropOpacity={isLightMode ? 0.5 : 0.85} animationInTiming={190} animationOutTiming={170} backdropTransitionOutTiming={0} backdropTransitionInTiming={0} hideModalContentWhileAnimating={false} useNativeDriver={Platform.OS !== 'web'} useNativeDriverForBackdrop={Platform.OS !== 'web'}>
        <View style={[ms.sheetBox, KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, sheetSurface, NO_SEL]}>
          <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={onCloseNewMsgSheet} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }} />
          <Text style={[ms.sheetTitle, { color: primaryInk }]}>{tx('Nuevo Mensaje', 'New Message')}</Text>
          <View style={[ms.toInputRow, lightRow]}>
            <Text style={[ms.toLabel, { color: cyanInk }]}>{tx('Para:', 'To:')}</Text>
            <TextInput value={recipientQuery} onChangeText={setRecipientQuery} placeholder={tx('Buscar atleta o sede...', 'Search athlete or venue...')} placeholderTextColor={mutedInk} style={[ms.recipientInput, { color: primaryInk }]} />
            {Boolean(recipientQuery) && (
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setRecipientQuery('')} hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}>
                <Feather name="x-circle" size={16} color={mutedInk} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.86} style={[ms.createSquadRow, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF', borderColor: '#C4B5FD' }]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onCloseNewMsgSheet(); deferUi(() => onOpenSquadsModal('hub')); }}>
            <Feather name="users" size={17} color={purpleInk} />
            <Text style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: '900', color: purpleInk }}>{tx('Crear Equipo o Unirse con Código ›', 'Create Team or Join with Code ›')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <ScrollView style={{ maxHeight: 320 }} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
            {recipientResults.length === 0 ? (
              <Text style={{ color: mutedInk, fontSize: 12, textAlign: 'center', paddingVertical: 18 }}>{tx('Sin atletas públicos con ese nombre.', 'No public athletes matching your search.')}</Text>
            ) : recipientResults.map(({ athlete, sub }) => (
              <TouchableOpacity key={String(athlete.id || athlete.nombre)} style={[ms.sheetListRow, isLightMode && { borderBottomColor: '#E2E8F0' }]} onPress={() => runGuarded(() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onCloseNewMsgSheet(); setRecipientQuery(''); deferUi(() => onStartDmWithAthlete(athlete)); })}>
                <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  {athlete?.avatar_url ? <Image source={{ uri: athlete.avatar_url }} style={ms.suggAvatar} contentFit="cover" transition={0} /> : <View style={[ms.suggAvatar, { alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }]}><Feather name="user" size={16} color={cyanInk} /></View>}
                  <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800', color: primaryInk }} numberOfLines={1}>{athlete?.nombre}</Text>
                    <Text style={{ fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '700', color: cyanInk }} numberOfLines={1}>{sub}</Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
                <Feather name="send" size={15} color={cyanInk} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </ScrollView>
        </View>
      </ReactNativeModal>

      <ReactNativeModal isVisible={showPrivacySheet} onBackdropPress={onClosePrivacySheet} onBackButtonPress={onClosePrivacySheet} style={{ margin: 0, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }} backdropOpacity={isLightMode ? 0.5 : 0.85} animationInTiming={190} animationOutTiming={170} backdropTransitionOutTiming={0} backdropTransitionInTiming={0} hideModalContentWhileAnimating={false} useNativeDriver={Platform.OS !== 'web'} useNativeDriverForBackdrop={Platform.OS !== 'web'}>
        <View style={[ms.sheetBox, KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, sheetSurface, NO_SEL]}>
          <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={onClosePrivacySheet} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }} />
          <Text style={[ms.sheetTitle, { color: primaryInk }]}>{tx('Solicitudes y Privacidad UGC', 'Requests & UGC Privacy')}</Text>
          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, marginBottom: 12 }}>
            {(['requests', 'blocked'] as const).map((tb) => {
              const active = privacyTab === tb;
              const cnt = tb === 'requests' ? incomingPendingDms.length + validSquadInvites.length : restrictedIds.length + blockedIds.length;
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity key={tb} {...(active ? DARK_INK_PROPS : {})} style={[ms.filterChip, { flex: 1, alignItems: 'center' }, isLightMode && !active && { backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }, active && ms.filterChipActive]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setPrivacyTab(tb); }}>
                  <Text style={[ms.filterChipTxt, isLightMode && !active && { color: '#334155' }, active && { color: '#050505', fontWeight: '900' }]}>
                    {tb === 'requests' ? `${tx('Solicitudes', 'Requests')} (${cnt})` : `${tx('Restringidos / Bloqueados', 'Restricted / Blocked')} (${cnt})`}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              );
            })}
          </View>
          <ScrollView style={{ maxHeight: 340 }} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
            {privacyTab === 'requests' ? (
              incomingPendingDms.length === 0 && validSquadInvites.length === 0 && restrictedThreads.length === 0 ? (
                <Text style={{ color: mutedInk, fontSize: 12, textAlign: 'center', paddingVertical: 22 }}>{tx('No tienes solicitudes pendientes.', 'You have no pending requests.')}</Text>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {incomingPendingDms.map((dm) => {
                    const iAmReq = matchesUserIdentity(myUserId || '', myUserName, dm.requesterId, dm.requesterName);
                    const pName = (iAmReq ? dm.targetName : dm.requesterName) || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
                    const lastTxt = dm.messages?.[dm.messages.length - 1]?.text || tx('Solicitud de mensaje 1 a 1', '1-on-1 message request');
                    return (
                      <View key={dm.dmCode} style={[ms.sheetListRow, isLightMode && { borderBottomColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
                        <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800', color: primaryInk }} numberOfLines={1}>{pName}</Text>
                          <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: mutedInk }} numberOfLines={1}>{lastTxt}</Text>
                        </View>
                        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 6 }}>
                          <TouchableOpacity {...DARK_INK_PROPS} style={ms.acceptCyanBtn} onPress={() => runGuarded(async () => { const next = await onAcceptDm(dm); onClosePrivacySheet(); deferUi(() => onOpenDirectThread((next as IDirectMessageThread) || { ...dm, status: 'accepted' }), 180); })}>
                            <Text style={{ color: '#050505', fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Aceptar', 'Accept')}</Text>
                          </TouchableOpacity>
                          <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.declineGhostBtn, isLightMode && { borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]} onPress={() => runGuarded(() => onDeclineDm(dm.dmCode))}>
                            <Text style={{ color: mutedInk, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Ignorar', 'Ignore')}</Text>
                          </TouchableOpacity>
                        </View>
                      </View>
                    );
                  })}
                  {validSquadInvites.map((inv: any) => (
                    <View key={String(inv.id)} style={[ms.sheetListRow, isLightMode && { borderBottomColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
                      <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800', color: primaryInk }} numberOfLines={1}>{`🛡️ ${inv?.equipo_nombre || tx('Invitación de Equipo', 'Team Invite')}`}</Text>
                        <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: purpleInk }} numberOfLines={1}>{inv?.invitador_nombre || tx('Equipo Kinetic', 'Kinetic Team')}</Text>
                      </View>
                      <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 6 }}>
                        <TouchableOpacity {...DARK_INK_PROPS} style={ms.acceptCyanBtn} onPress={() => runGuarded(async () => { await onResponderSolicitud?.(String(inv.id), true); })}>
                          <Text style={{ color: '#050505', fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Unirse', 'Join')}</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                        <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.declineGhostBtn, isLightMode && { borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]} onPress={() => runGuarded(async () => { await onResponderSolicitud?.(String(inv.id), false); })}>
                          <Text style={{ color: mutedInk, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Rechazar', 'Decline')}</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      </View>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                  {restrictedThreads.map((dm) => (
                    <TouchableOpacity key={`res_${dm.dmCode}`} style={[ms.sheetListRow, isLightMode && { borderBottomColor: '#E2E8F0' }]} onPress={() => { onClosePrivacySheet(); deferUi(() => onOpenDirectThread(dm)); }}>
                      <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: mutedInk, flex: 1 }} numberOfLines={1}>{`🔇 ${dm.requesterName || dm.targetName || tx('Chat restringido', 'Restricted chat')} (${tx('Silenciado', 'Silenced')})`}</Text>
                      <Text style={{ fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '800', color: cyanInk }}>{tx('Ver ›', 'View ›')}</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  ))}
                </>
              )
            ) : restrictedIds.length === 0 && blockedIds.length === 0 ? (
              <Text style={{ color: mutedInk, fontSize: 12, textAlign: 'center', paddingVertical: 22 }}>{tx('No tienes cuentas restringidas ni bloqueadas.', 'No restricted or blocked accounts.')}</Text>
            ) : (
              [...restrictedIds.map((id) => ({ id, mode: 'restricted' as const })), ...blockedIds.map((id) => ({ id, mode: 'blocked' as const }))].map(({ id, mode }) => (
                <View key={`${mode}_${id}`} style={[ms.sheetListRow, isLightMode && { borderBottomColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
                  <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800', color: primaryInk }} numberOfLines={1}>{resolveUserLabel(id)}</Text>
                    <Text style={{ fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '700', color: mode === 'blocked' ? '#EF4444' : purpleInk }}>
                      {mode === 'blocked' ? tx('Bloqueado', 'Blocked') : tx('Restringido (Silenciado)', 'Restricted (Silenced)')}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <TouchableOpacity {...DARK_INK_PROPS} style={ms.acceptCyanBtn} onPress={() => runGuarded(async () => { triggerHaptic('Success'); await manageUgcUserRelation({ targetUserId: id, action: 'unblock', currentUserId: myUserId }); })}>
                    <Text style={{ color: '#050505', fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '900' }}>{mode === 'blocked' ? tx('Desbloquear', 'Unblock') : tx('Quitar restricción', 'Unrestrict')}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              ))
            )}
          </ScrollView>
        </View>
      </ReactNativeModal>

      <ReactNativeModal isVisible={Boolean(contextRow)} onBackdropPress={onCloseContextRow} onBackButtonPress={onCloseContextRow} style={{ margin: 0, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }} backdropOpacity={isLightMode ? 0.5 : 0.85} animationInTiming={180} animationOutTiming={160} backdropTransitionOutTiming={0} backdropTransitionInTiming={0} hideModalContentWhileAnimating={false} useNativeDriver={Platform.OS !== 'web'} useNativeDriverForBackdrop={Platform.OS !== 'web'}>
        <View style={[ms.sheetBox, KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, sheetSurface, NO_SEL]}>
          <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={onCloseContextRow} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }} />
          <Text style={[ms.sheetTitle, { color: primaryInk }]} numberOfLines={1}>{contextRow?.title || tx('Opciones de Conversación', 'Conversation Options')}</Text>
          {Boolean(statusFeedback) && <Text style={{ color: cyanInk, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800', textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 10 }}>{statusFeedback}</Text>}
          {confirmKind === 'report' ? (
            <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
              <Text style={{ color: primaryInk, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: '800', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                {tx('Selecciona el motivo del reporte:', 'Select the report reason:')}
              </Text>
              {reportReasons.map((item) => {
                const active = reportReason === item.key;
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={item.key}
                    style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, lightRow, active && { borderColor: '#F59E0B', backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#FFFBEB' : 'rgba(245,158,11,0.14)', elevation: 0 }]}
                    onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setReportReason(item.key); }}
                  >
                    <Feather name={active ? 'check-circle' : 'circle'} size={15} color={active ? '#F59E0B' : mutedInk} />
                    <Text style={{ color: primaryInk, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: active ? '800' : '600' }}>{item.label}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, { backgroundColor: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.16)', borderColor: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.5)', justifyContent: 'center', elevation: 0 }]}
                onPress={() => runGuarded(async () => {
                  triggerHaptic('Success');
                  await reportUgcContent({ targetUserId: contextRow?.peerId, contentType: 'dm', reasonCategory: reportReason, currentUserId: myUserId });
                  setConfirmKind(null);
                  setStatusFeedback(tx('Reporte enviado a Moderación ✓', 'Report sent to Moderation ✓'));
                })}
              >
                <Text style={{ color: isLightMode ? '#B45309' : '#FBBF24', fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Confirmar Reporte', 'Confirm Report')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, lightRow, { justifyContent: 'center' }]} onPress={() => setConfirmKind(null)}>
                <Text style={{ color: primaryInk, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Cancelar', 'Cancel')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          ) : confirmKind ? (
            <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
              <Text style={{ color: primaryInk, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: '700', textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 4 }}>
                {confirmKind === 'delete_dm' ? tx('¿Eliminar esta conversación de tu bandeja?', 'Delete this conversation from your inbox?')
                  : confirmKind === 'delete_squad' ? tx('¿Eliminar permanentemente este Equipo?', 'Permanently delete this Team?')
                  : confirmKind === 'leave_squad' ? tx('¿Salir de este Equipo?', 'Leave this Team?')
                  : tx('¿Bloquear a este usuario en KinetiClub?', 'Block this user across KinetiClub?')}
              </Text>
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, { backgroundColor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.14)', borderColor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.45)', justifyContent: 'center', elevation: 0 }]} onPress={() => runGuarded(async () => {
                triggerHaptic('Success');
                if (confirmKind === 'delete_dm' && contextRow?.dmCode) await onDeleteDm(contextRow.dmCode);
                else if (confirmKind === 'delete_squad' && contextRow?.rawSquad?.id) await onDeleteSquad(String(contextRow.rawSquad.id));
                else if (confirmKind === 'leave_squad' && contextRow?.rawSquad?.id) await onLeaveSquad(String(contextRow.rawSquad.id));
                else if (confirmKind === 'block' && contextRow?.peerId) await manageUgcUserRelation({ targetUserId: contextRow.peerId, action: 'block', currentUserId: myUserId });
                onCloseContextRow();
              })}>
                <Text style={{ color: '#EF4444', fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Confirmar Acción', 'Confirm Action')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, lightRow, { justifyContent: 'center' }]} onPress={() => setConfirmKind(null)}>
                <Text style={{ color: primaryInk, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Cancelar', 'Cancel')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          ) : contextRow?.kind === 'squad' ? (
            <>
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, lightRow]} onPress={() => { onCloseContextRow(); deferUi(() => onOpenSquadsModal('hub')); }}>
                <Feather name="settings" size={16} color={cyanInk} />
                <Text style={{ color: primaryInk, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Administrar Equipo / Código', 'Manage Team / Invite Code')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FEF2F2', borderColor: '#FECACA' }]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Warning'); setConfirmKind(isSquadLeader ? 'delete_squad' : 'leave_squad'); }}>
                <Feather name={isSquadLeader ? 'trash-2' : 'log-out'} size={16} color="#EF4444" />
                <Text style={{ color: '#EF4444', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800' }}>{isSquadLeader ? tx('Eliminar Equipo', 'Delete Team') : tx('Salir del Equipo', 'Leave Team')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, lightRow]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Warning'); setConfirmKind('delete_dm'); }}>
                <Feather name="trash-2" size={16} color={primaryInk} />
                <Text style={{ color: primaryInk, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Eliminar conversación', 'Delete conversation')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              {canModeratePeer && (
                <>
                  <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, lightRow]} onPress={() => runGuarded(async () => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); await manageUgcUserRelation({ targetUserId: String(contextRow?.peerId), action: 'restrict', currentUserId: myUserId }); onCloseContextRow(); })}>
                    <Feather name="volume-x" size={16} color={purpleInk} />
                    <Text style={{ color: primaryInk, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Restringir (Mover a Solicitudes)', 'Restrict (Move to Requests)')}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, lightRow]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Warning'); setStatusFeedback(''); setConfirmKind('report'); }}>
                    <Feather name="flag" size={16} color="#F59E0B" />
                    <Text style={{ color: primaryInk, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Reportar usuario', 'Report user')}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.ctxOptionRow, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FEF2F2', borderColor: '#FECACA' }]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Warning'); setConfirmKind('block'); }}>
                    <Feather name="slash" size={16} color="#EF4444" />
                    <Text style={{ color: '#EF4444', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Bloquear usuario', 'Block user')}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </View>
      </ReactNativeModal>
    </>
  );
});

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
