import {
  IKineticNotificationItem,
  NOTIF_SEEN_KEY_PREFIX,
  partitionNotificationsByWindow,
  stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost,
} from '../../services/kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
import { getBlockedUserIdsSet } from '../../services/kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import { requestContextualAndroidNotificationsOnce } from '../../services/kineticAndroidNotificationsHelper';
import { IDirectMessageThread } from '../../services/kineticRealtimeChatBridge';
import { patchKinetiClubTabAlertState } from '../../services/kineticlubTabAlertStore';
import { getMemoryWallSnapshot } from '../../services/kineticlubWallCloudService';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from '../shared/KineticModalHeader3D';
import { SplitEscrowInboxSection } from '../eventos/SplitEscrowInboxSection';
import { SkeletonPulse, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;

export function buildUserNotificationsList(params: {
  userId?: string | null;
  userName?: string | null;
  squadInvites?: any[];
  pendingDms?: IDirectMessageThread[];
  wallPosts?: any[];
  commentsMap?: Record<string, any[]>;
}): IKineticNotificationItem[] {
  const uid = String(params.userId || '').trim();
  const uNameLow = String(params.userName || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const out: IKineticNotificationItem[] = [];
  const snap = getMemoryWallSnapshot(params.userId);
  const posts = Array.isArray(params.wallPosts) && params.wallPosts.length > 0 ? params.wallPosts : snap.posts;
  const commsByPost = params.commentsMap || snap.commentsMap || {};

  for (const p of posts) {
    const pOwnerId = String(p?.userId || p?.authorId || '').trim();
    const isMyPost = Boolean(
      p?.isMine ||
      (pOwnerId ? uid && pOwnerId === uid : uNameLow && String(p?.authorName || '').trim().toLowerCase() === uNameLow)
    );
    if (!isMyPost || !p?.id) continue;
    const pid = String(p.id);
    const postTs = Number(p.createdAtMs || Date.parse(String(p.created_at || p.createdAt || '')) || 1);
    const comms = Array.isArray(commsByPost[pid]) ? commsByPost[pid] : [];
    for (const c of comms) {
      const cUid = String(c?.userId || '').trim();
      const cAuthor = String(c?.author || '').trim();
      if (cUid ? Boolean(uid && cUid === uid) : Boolean(uNameLow && cAuthor.toLowerCase() === uNameLow)) continue;
      const cTs = Number(Date.parse(String(c?.created_at || '')) || postTs);
      const cleanComment = stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost(String(c?.text || '')).slice(0, 70);
      out.push({
        id: `notif_cm_${pid}_${c.id}`,
        kind: 'comment',
        actorId: cUid || null,
        actorName: cAuthor || 'Atleta Kinetic',
        titleEs: `${cAuthor || 'Un atleta'} comentó tu publicación`,
        titleEn: `${cAuthor || 'An athlete'} commented on your post`,
        subtitleEs: `💬 "${cleanComment}"`,
        subtitleEn: `💬 "${cleanComment}"`,
        timestampMs: cTs,
        postId: pid,
      });
    }
    const otherReactions = Math.max(0, Number(p.baseFire || 0)) + Math.max(0, Number(p.basePower || 0)) + Math.max(0, Number(p.baseRespect || 0));
    if (otherReactions > 0) {
      out.push({
        id: `notif_rx_${pid}_${otherReactions}`,
        kind: 'reaction',
        actorId: null,
        actorName: 'Comunidad Kinetic',
        titleEs: `Tu publicación recibió ${otherReactions} reacción${otherReactions === 1 ? '' : 'es'} 🔥`,
        titleEn: `Your post received ${otherReactions} reaction${otherReactions === 1 ? '' : 's'} 🔥`,
        subtitleEs: stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost(String(p.bodyEs || p.discipline || 'Muro Social')).slice(0, 68),
        subtitleEn: stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost(String(p.bodyEn || p.discipline || 'Social Wall')).slice(0, 68),
        timestampMs: postTs,
        postId: pid,
      });
    }
  }

  for (const inv of Array.isArray(params.squadInvites) ? params.squadInvites : []) {
    const invTs = Number(Date.parse(String(inv?.created_at || '')) || 1);
    const rawInviter = String(inv?.invitado_por_nombre || '').trim();
    const rawEqName = String(inv?.equipo_nombre || inv?.equipos_kinetic?.nombre || '').trim();
    const inviterEs = rawInviter || 'Líder Kinetic';
    const inviterEn = rawInviter || 'Kinetic Leader';
    const eqNameEs = rawEqName || 'Equipo';
    const eqNameEn = rawEqName || 'Team';
    out.push({
      id: `notif_sq_${inv?.id || eqNameEn}`,
      kind: 'squad_invite',
      actorId: inv?.invitado_por_id ? String(inv.invitado_por_id) : null,
      actorName: inviterEs,
      titleEs: `${inviterEs} te invitó a unirte a "${eqNameEs}"`,
      titleEn: `${inviterEn} invited you to join "${eqNameEn}"`,
      subtitleEs: '🤝 Invitación pendiente de Equipo',
      subtitleEn: '🤝 Pending Team invitation',
      timestampMs: invTs,
      rawPayload: inv,
    });
  }

  for (const dm of Array.isArray(params.pendingDms) ? params.pendingDms : []) {
    const dmTs = Number(Date.parse(String(dm?.updatedAt || dm?.messages?.[dm.messages.length - 1]?.createdAt || '')) || 1);
    const rawSender = String(dm?.requesterName || '').trim();
    const senderEs = rawSender || 'Atleta Kinetic';
    const senderEn = rawSender || 'Kinetic Athlete';
    const lastTxt = String(dm?.messages?.[dm.messages.length - 1]?.text || '').slice(0, 65);
    out.push({
      id: `notif_dm_${dm.dmCode}`,
      kind: 'dm_request',
      actorId: dm.requesterId || null,
      actorName: senderEs,
      actorAvatar: dm.requesterAvatar || null,
      titleEs: `${senderEs} te envió una solicitud de mensaje`,
      titleEn: `${senderEn} sent you a message request`,
      subtitleEs: lastTxt || '✉️ Toca para revisar el chat 1-a-1',
      subtitleEn: lastTxt || '✉️ Tap to review 1-on-1 chat',
      timestampMs: dmTs,
      rawPayload: dm,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

export interface KinetiClubNotificationsModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  userId?: string | null;
  items: IKineticNotificationItem[];
  onMarkedSeen?: (seenTsMs: number) => void;
  onSelectNotification?: (item: IKineticNotificationItem) => void;
  onSplitInvitesCountChange?: (count: number) => void;
}

export const KinetiClubNotificationsModal: React.FC<KinetiClubNotificationsModalProps> = memo(
  ({ visible, onClose, userId, items, onMarkedSeen, onSelectNotification, onSplitInvitesCountChange }) => {
    const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    const router = useRouter();
    const [splitCount, setSplitCount] = useState(0);
    const [splitLoading, setSplitLoading] = useState(() => Boolean(visible && userId));
    const prevVisibleRef = useRef(false);
    const { isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const isEn = language === 'en';
    const ink = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
    const muted = isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8';
    const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : COLORS.cyan;

    useEffect(() => {
      const justOpened = Boolean(visible && !prevVisibleRef.current);
      prevVisibleRef.current = Boolean(visible);
      if (!visible) {
        setSplitLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      if (justOpened) {
        setSplitLoading(Boolean(userId));
      }
      const maxItemTs = (Array.isArray(items) ? items : []).reduce(
        (acc, it) => Math.max(acc, Number(it?.timestampMs) || 0),
        0
      );
      const seenTs = Math.max(Date.now(), maxItemTs) + 1;
      const key = `${NOTIF_SEEN_KEY_PREFIX}${String(userId || 'anon').toLowerCase()}`;
      AsyncStorage.setItem(key, String(seenTs)).catch(() => {});
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        try { window.localStorage.setItem(key, String(seenTs)); } catch {}
      }
      patchKinetiClubTabAlertState({ unseenNotificationsCount: 0, pendingSplitInvitesCount: 0 }, userId);
      onMarkedSeen?.(seenTs);
      if (justOpened) {
        void requestContextualAndroidNotificationsOnce();
      }
    }, [visible, userId, items, onMarkedSeen]);

    const isSplitPending = splitLoading;

    const buckets = useMemo(
      () => partitionNotificationsByWindow(items, Date.now(), getBlockedUserIdsSet()),
      [items, visible]
    );

    if (!visible) return null;

    const sections: { key: string; title: string; data: IKineticNotificationItem[] }[] = [
      { key: 'today', title: tx('Hoy', 'Today'), data: buckets.today },
      { key: 'week', title: tx('Últimos 7 días', 'Last 7 days'), data: buckets.week },
      { key: 'month', title: tx('Últimos 30 días', 'Last 30 days'), data: buckets.month },
    ].filter((sec) => sec.data.length > 0);

    const iconForKind = (kind: IKineticNotificationItem['kind']): any =>
      kind === 'reaction' ? 'zap' : kind === 'comment' ? 'message-circle' : kind === 'squad_invite' ? 'users' : 'mail';

    return (
      <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="slide" onRequestClose={onClose} statusBarTranslucent>
        <View style={ns.overlay}>
          <Pressable
            style={[ns.backdropTap, { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45)' : 'rgba(5, 7, 12, 0.72)' }]}
            onPress={onClose}
          />
          <View style={[ns.sheet, KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, { paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom + 16, 22) }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#0284C7' }]}>
            <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={onClose} style={{ paddingTop: 4, marginBottom: 8 }} />
            <View style={ns.headerRow}>
              <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                <Feather name="bell" size={17} color={cyanInk} />
                <Text style={[ns.title, { color: ink }]}>{tx('CENTRO DE ACTIVIDAD', 'ACTIVITY CENTER')}</Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 16, gap: 12 }}>
              {visible ? (
                <SplitEscrowInboxSection
                  userId={userId}
                  onCountChange={(c) => {
                    setSplitCount(c);
                    onSplitInvitesCountChange?.(c);
                  }}
                  onLoadingChange={setSplitLoading}
                  onAcceptInvite={() => {
                    onClose();
                    router.push('/(tabs)/eventos');
                  }}
                />
              ) : null}
              {sections.length === 0 && splitCount === 0 && isSplitPending ? (
                <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                  <SkeletonPulse style={{ width: '100%', height: 62, borderRadius: 14 }} />
                  <SkeletonPulse style={{ width: '100%', height: 62, borderRadius: 14 }} />
                </View>
              ) : sections.length === 0 && splitCount === 0 && !isSplitPending ? (
                <View style={[ns.emptyCard, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}>
                  <Feather name="bell" size={28} color={cyanInk} />
                  <Text style={[ns.emptyTitle, { color: ink }]}>{tx('Todo al día', 'All caught up')}</Text>
                  <Text style={[ns.emptySub, { color: muted }]}>
                    {tx('Aquí verás reacciones, comentarios, invitaciones de equipo y solicitudes de mensaje.', 'Reactions, comments, team invites, and message requests will appear here.')}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ) : (
                sections.map((sec) => (
                  <View key={sec.key} style={{ gap: 7 }}>
                    <Text style={[ns.sectionHeader, { color: cyanInk }]}>{sec.title.toUpperCase()}</Text>
                    {sec.data.map((it) => (
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        key={it.id}
                        activeOpacity={0.85}
                        style={[ns.rowCard, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }]}
                        onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onSelectNotification?.(it); onClose(); }}
                      >
                        <View style={[ns.iconCircle, { borderColor: cyanInk }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF' }]}>
                          {it.actorAvatar ? (
                            <Image source={{ uri: it.actorAvatar }} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }} contentFit="cover" transition={0} />
                          ) : (
                            <Feather name={iconForKind(it.kind)} size={15} color={cyanInk} />
                          )}
                        </View>
                        <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          <Text style={[ns.rowTitle, { color: ink }]} numberOfLines={2}>{isEn ? it.titleEn : it.titleEs}</Text>
                          <Text style={[ns.rowSub, { color: muted }]} numberOfLines={1}>{isEn ? it.subtitleEn : it.subtitleEs}</Text>
                        </View>
                        <Text style={[ns.timeTxt, { color: muted }]}>{formatPostRelativeTime(it.timestampMs, isEn)}</Text>
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    ))}
                  </View>
                ))
              )}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    );
  }
);

const ns = StyleSheet.create({
  overlay: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'flex-end' },
  backdropTap: { position: 'absolute', top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0 },
  sheet: { maxHeight: '76%', backgroundColor: '#080C14', borderTopLeftRadius: 26, borderTopRightRadius: 26, borderWidth: 1.2, borderTopWidth: 2, borderTopColor: '#00F0FF', borderColor: 'rgba(0,240,255,0.28)', paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 14 },
  headerRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 12 },
  title: { fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 0.7 },
  closeBtn: { width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 12, backgroundColor: '#0E1522', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', elevation: 0 },
  sectionHeader: { fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 0.8, marginTop: 2 },
  rowCard: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: 11, borderRadius: 14, backgroundColor: '#0B101B', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)', borderTopWidth: 1.5, borderTopColor: 'rgba(184,255,255,0.28)', borderBottomWidth: 3.6, borderBottomColor: '#020408', elevation: 0 },
  iconCircle: { width: 38, height: 38, borderRadius: 13, borderWidth: 1.4, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,240,255,0.1)', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', overflow: 'hidden', elevation: 0 },
  rowTitle: { fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: '800', lineHeight: 17 },
  rowSub: { fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '600', marginTop: 2 },
  timeTxt: { fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: '700', marginLeft: 4 },
  emptyCard: { alignItems: 'center', paddingVertical: 34, paddingHorizontal: 20, borderRadius: 16, backgroundColor: '#0B101B', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', gap: 8 },
  emptyTitle: { fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '900' },
  emptySub: { fontSize: 12, textAlign: 'center', lineHeight: 18 },
});

    // === src/components/kineticlub/KinetiClubPostComposer.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import * as ImagePicker from 'expo-image-picker';
import React, { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Platform, ScrollView, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES } from '../../constants/affiliatesCatalog';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { resolveLosCabosZona } from '../../services/kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
import { composerStyles as cs } from '../../styles/kineticlubHybridWall.styles';
import { translateDiscipline } from '../../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';
import { KineticSmartImage, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

export const MAX_POST_PHOTOS = 5;
const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as unknown as ViewStyle) : null;
const DARK_INK_PROPS: Record<string, unknown> = { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };

const COMPOSER_DISCIPLINES = [
  'Fuerza', 'CrossFit', 'Pilates', 'Yoga', 'Barre', 'HIIT', 'Boxeo', 'Voleibol', 'Indoor Cycling', 'Fisioterapia', 'Running',
];

export interface IComposerPostMeta {
  discipline: string;
  venue: string;
  sedeId: string | null;
  zona: 'Cabo San Lucas' | 'Corredor Turístico' | 'San José del Cabo' | 'Los Cabos';
}

const revokeWebBlobUri = (uri?: string | null) => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && uri && uri.startsWith('blob:')) {
    try { URL.revokeObjectURL(uri); } catch {}
  }
};

export const KinetiClubPostComposer = memo(
  ({ onPublish, userAvatarUrl, forceExpandedSignal = 0 }: {
    onPublish: (text: string, mediaUris: string[], meta?: IComposerPostMeta) => Promise<unknown> | void;
    userAvatarUrl?: string | null;
    forceExpandedSignal?: number;
  }) => {
    const { isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
    const [text, setText] = useState('');
    const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [selectedDiscipline, setSelectedDiscipline] = useState('Fuerza');
    const [selectedAffiliateId, setSelectedAffiliateId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [showDiscPicker, setShowDiscPicker] = useState(false);
    const [showVenuePicker, setShowVenuePicker] = useState(false);
    const [discQuery, setDiscQuery] = useState('');
    const [venueQuery, setVenueQuery] = useState('');
    const [isPicking, setIsPicking] = useState(false);
    const [isPublishing, setIsPublishing] = useState(false);
    const isPublishingRef = useRef(false);
    const inputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);
    const photosRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
    photosRef.current = photos;

    useEffect(() => () => { photosRef.current.forEach(revokeWebBlobUri); }, []);
    useEffect(() => {
      if (forceExpandedSignal > 0) setExpanded(true);
    }, [forceExpandedSignal]);

    const verifiedVenues = useMemo(
      () =>
        KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES.filter(
          (a) =>
            (a.esClubActivo || a.verificado) &&
            !/kinetic[-_\s]*(oficial|official|terminal)/i.test(`${a.id || ''} ${a.nombre || ''}`)
        ),
      []
    );
    const filteredDisciplines = useMemo(() => {
      const q = discQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!q) return COMPOSER_DISCIPLINES;
      return COMPOSER_DISCIPLINES.filter(
        (d) => d.toLowerCase().includes(q) || translateDiscipline(d, language).toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }, [discQuery, language]);

    const filteredVenues = useMemo(() => {
      const q = venueQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!q) return verifiedVenues;
      return verifiedVenues.filter(
        (a) => String(a.nombre || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(a.ubicacion || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }, [venueQuery, verifiedVenues]);

    const activeAffiliate = useMemo(
      () => (selectedAffiliateId ? verifiedVenues.find((a) => a.id === selectedAffiliateId) || null : null),
      [selectedAffiliateId, verifiedVenues]
    );
    const canPublish = (Boolean(text.trim()) || photos.length > 0) && !isPublishing && !isPicking;
    const isFull = photos.length >= MAX_POST_PHOTOS;
    const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : '#00F0FF';

    const handlePickPhotos = useCallback(async () => {
      if (isPicking || isPublishing || isFull) return;
      triggerHaptic('Selection');
      setExpanded(true);
      setIsPicking(true);
      try {
        if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
          const perm = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
          if (!perm.granted) return;
        }
        const remaining = MAX_POST_PHOTOS - photos.length;
        const res = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
          mediaTypes: ['images'],
          allowsMultipleSelection: true,
          selectionLimit: remaining,
          quality: 0.62,
        });
        if (res.canceled || !res.assets?.length) return;
        const picked = res.assets.map((a) => a.uri).filter(Boolean).slice(0, remaining);
        setPhotos((prev) => [...prev, ...picked].slice(0, MAX_POST_PHOTOS));
        triggerHaptic('Success');
      } catch {
        triggerHaptic('Error');
      } finally {
        setIsPicking(false);
      }
    }, [isPicking, isPublishing, isFull, photos.length]);

    const handleRemovePhoto = useCallback((idx: number) => {
      if (isPublishingRef.current) return;
      triggerHaptic('Light');
      revokeWebBlobUri(photosRef.current[idx]);
      setPhotos((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
    }, []);

    const handlePublish = useCallback(async () => {
      if (!canPublish || isPublishingRef.current) return;
      const cleanText = text.trim();
      const snapshotPhotos = [...photos];
      if (!cleanText && snapshotPhotos.length === 0) return;
      const meta: IComposerPostMeta = {
        discipline: selectedDiscipline || 'Fuerza',
        venue: activeAffiliate?.nombre || 'Red Kinetic',
        sedeId: activeAffiliate?.id || null,
        zona: activeAffiliate ? resolveLosCabosZona(activeAffiliate.ubicacion, activeAffiliate.latitude, activeAffiliate.longitude) : 'Los Cabos',
      };
      isPublishingRef.current = true;
      setIsPublishing(true);
      try {
        await Promise.resolve(onPublish(cleanText, snapshotPhotos, meta));
        snapshotPhotos.forEach(revokeWebBlobUri);
        photosRef.current = [];
        setText('');
        setPhotos([]);
        setSelectedAffiliateId(null);
        setShowDiscPicker(false);
        setShowVenuePicker(false);
        setDiscQuery('');
        setVenueQuery('');
        setExpanded(false);
      } finally {
        isPublishingRef.current = false;
        setIsPublishing(false);
      }
    }, [canPublish, onPublish, text, photos, selectedDiscipline, activeAffiliate]);

    if (!expanded && photos.length === 0 && !text.trim()) {
      return (
        <View style={[cs.compactBar, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }]}>
          <View style={[cs.avatarMini, { borderColor: isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : '#00F0FF' }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9' }]}>
            {userAvatarUrl ? (
              <KineticSmartImage uri={userAvatarUrl} fallbackCategory="Fuerza" transition={180} style={cs.fullImg} />
            ) : (
              <Feather name="user" size={16} color={cyanInk} />
            )}
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            style={[cs.compactPromptBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}
            onPress={() => {
              triggerHaptic('Light');
              setExpanded(true);
            }}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={[cs.compactPromptTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {tx('¿Qué entrenaste hoy?', 'What did you train today?')}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            style={[cs.quickPhotoBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4' }]}
            accessibilityLabel={tx('Adjuntar foto', 'Attach photo')}
            onPress={handlePickPhotos}
          >
            <Feather name="camera" size={16} color={cyanInk} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      );
    }

    const lightDropdownStyle = isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' } : null;
    const lightSearchStyle = isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', color: '#0F172A' } : null;

    return (
      <View style={[cs.card, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }]}>
        <View style={cs.expandedHeader}>
          <Text selectable={false} style={[cs.expandedTitle, { color: cyanInk }]}>{tx('NUEVA PUBLICACIÓN', 'NEW POST')}</Text>
          {!isPublishing && (
            <TouchableOpacity
              hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
              style={NO_SEL}
              onPress={() => {
                setShowDiscPicker(false);
                setShowVenuePicker(false);
                if (!text.trim() && photos.length === 0) setExpanded(false);
                else { setText(''); photos.forEach(revokeWebBlobUri); setPhotos([]); setExpanded(false); }
              }}
            >
              <Feather name="chevron-up" size={18} color={isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8'} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
        </View>

        <TextInput
          ref={inputRef}
          value={text}
          onChangeText={setText}
          editable={!isPublishing}
          multiline
          autoFocus={false}
          placeholder={tx('¿Qué entrenaste hoy? (Opcional si subes foto)', 'What did you train today? (Optional with photo)')}
          placeholderTextColor={isLightMode ? '#64748B' : '#94A3B8'}
          style={[cs.input, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8', color: '#0F172A' }]}
        />

        <View style={cs.tagSelectorsRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[cs.metaPill, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }, showDiscPicker && { borderColor: '#00F0FF' }]}
            onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setShowDiscPicker((v) => !v); setShowVenuePicker(false); }}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={[cs.metaPillTxt, { color: cyanInk }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {`🏋️ ${translateDiscipline(selectedDiscipline, language)} ▾`}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[cs.metaPill, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }, (showVenuePicker || activeAffiliate) && { borderColor: '#00F0FF' }]}
            onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setShowVenuePicker((v) => !v); setShowDiscPicker(false); }}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={[cs.metaPillTxt, { color: activeAffiliate ? cyanInk : (isLightMode ? '#334155' : '#CBD5E1') }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {`📍 ${activeAffiliate ? activeAffiliate.nombre : tx('Etiquetar Sede ▾', 'Tag Venue ▾')}`}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {showDiscPicker && (
          <View style={[cs.dropdownBox, lightDropdownStyle]}>
            <TextInput
              value={discQuery}
              onChangeText={setDiscQuery}
              autoFocus={false}
              placeholder={tx('Buscar disciplina...', 'Search discipline...')}
              placeholderTextColor={isLightMode ? '#64748B' : '#94A3B8'}
              style={[cs.dropdownSearchInput, lightSearchStyle]}
            />
            <ScrollView style={cs.dropdownList} nestedScrollEnabled keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" showsVerticalScrollIndicator={true}>
              {filteredDisciplines.map((d) => {
                const active = selectedDiscipline === d;
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={d}
                    style={[cs.dropdownRow, NO_SEL, active && (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#0284C7' } : cs.dropdownRowActive)]}
                    onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setSelectedDiscipline(d); setShowDiscPicker(false); setDiscQuery(''); }}
                  >
                    <Text selectable={false} style={[cs.dropdownRowTxt, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }, active && { color: cyanInk, fontWeight: '900' }]}>
                      {translateDiscipline(d, language)}
                    </Text>
                    {active && <Feather name="check" size={14} color={cyanInk} />}
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        )}

        {showVenuePicker && (
          <View style={[cs.dropdownBox, lightDropdownStyle]}>
            <TextInput
              value={venueQuery}
              onChangeText={setVenueQuery}
              autoFocus={false}
              placeholder={tx('Buscar sede afiliada...', 'Search partner club...')}
              placeholderTextColor={isLightMode ? '#64748B' : '#94A3B8'}
              style={[cs.dropdownSearchInput, lightSearchStyle]}
            />
            <ScrollView style={cs.dropdownList} nestedScrollEnabled keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" showsVerticalScrollIndicator={true}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[cs.dropdownRow, NO_SEL, !selectedAffiliateId && (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#0284C7' } : cs.dropdownRowActive)]}
                onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setSelectedAffiliateId(null); setShowVenuePicker(false); setVenueQuery(''); }}
              >
                <Text selectable={false} style={[cs.dropdownRowTxt, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }, !selectedAffiliateId && { color: cyanInk, fontWeight: '900' }]}>
                  {tx('Ninguno • Red Kinetic', 'None • Kinetic Network')}
                </Text>
                {!selectedAffiliateId && <Feather name="check" size={14} color={cyanInk} />}
              </TouchableOpacity>
              {filteredVenues.map((aff) => {
                const active = selectedAffiliateId === aff.id;
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={aff.id}
                    style={[cs.dropdownRow, NO_SEL, active && (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#0284C7' } : cs.dropdownRowActive)]}
                    onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setSelectedAffiliateId(aff.id); setShowVenuePicker(false); setVenueQuery(''); }}
                  >
                    <Text selectable={false} style={[cs.dropdownRowTxt, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }, active && { color: cyanInk, fontWeight: '900' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                      {aff.nombre}
                    </Text>
                    {active && <Feather name="check" size={14} color={cyanInk} />}
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        )}

        {photos.length > 0 && (
          <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} style={{ flexGrow: 0, marginTop: 9 }} contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 8 }}>
            {photos.map((uri, idx) => (
              <View key={`${uri.slice(-24)}_${idx}`} style={[cs.thumbWrap, isLightMode && { borderColor: '#CBD5E1', backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9' }]}>
                <KineticSmartImage uri={uri} fallbackCategory={selectedDiscipline} transition={180} style={cs.fullImg} />
                <TouchableOpacity
                  disabled={isPublishing}
                  style={[cs.thumbRemove, NO_SEL]}
                  hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
                  accessibilityLabel={tx('Quitar foto', 'Remove photo')}
                  onPress={() => handleRemovePhoto(idx)}
                >
                  <Text selectable={false} style={cs.thumbRemoveTxt}>✕</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            ))}
          </ScrollView>
        )}

        <View style={cs.footer}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            disabled={isFull || isPicking || isPublishing}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            style={[cs.photoBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4' }, (isFull || isPicking || isPublishing) && { opacity: 0.55 }]}
            onPress={handlePickPhotos}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={[cs.photoBtnTxt, { color: cyanInk }]}>{`📷 ${tx('Fotos', 'Photos')} (${photos.length}/${MAX_POST_PHOTOS})`}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            {...DARK_INK_PROPS}
            style={[cs.publishBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#00D8E8', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#CFFAFE', borderBottomColor: '#0284C7' }, !canPublish && { opacity: 0.5 }]}
            disabled={!canPublish}
            onPress={handlePublish}
          >
            {isPublishing ? <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#0F172A" /> : <Feather name="zap" size={13} color="#0F172A" />}
            <Text selectable={false} style={cs.publishTxt}>{isPublishing ? tx('SUBIENDO...', 'POSTING...') : tx('PUBLICAR', 'POST')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }
);

    // === src/components/kineticlub/KinetiClubProgressHubModal.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import ReactNativeModal from 'react-native-modal';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { formatOfficialOrTierLabel, formatStreakDaysBadge } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { COLORS, RADIUS, globalStyles } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { RewardModalBody } from '../KinetiClubModals';
import { AttentionShakeView, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { KineticDeepParallaxCard3D } from '../shared/KineticDeepParallaxCard3D';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from '../shared/KineticModalHeader3D';
import { RpgModalBody } from './RpgModal';
import { StreakModalBody } from './StreakModal';

const NO_SEL: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;
const DARK_INK_PROPS: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } } : {};

const resolveTierXp = (raw?: string | null): number => {
  const s = String(raw || '').toLowerCase();
  if (s.includes('platinum') || s.includes('platino') || s.includes('leyenda') || s.includes('black')) return 25;
  if (s.includes('gold') || s.includes('oro')) return 20;
  if (s.includes('silver') || s.includes('plata')) return 15;
  return 10;
};

export interface KinetiClubProgressHubModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  nivelRaw?: string | null;
  prestigeInfo: any;
  rachaActual: number;
  isStreakFrozenToday: boolean;
  dailyClaimedToday: boolean;
  claimableCount: number;
  claimedTotal: number;
  onSelectCard?: (target: 'rpg' | 'streak' | 'mystery' | 'retos') => void;
  inSheetProps?: {
    userStats: any;
    seasonInfo: any;
    completedSessionsCount: number;
    onCongelarRacha: () => Promise<{ ok: boolean; errorMsg?: string }>;
    isFreezing: boolean;
    onAscendPrestige?: () => Promise<boolean>;
    onGoToTrain: () => void;
    claimingId?: string | null;
    claimedChallengeIds?: string[];
    activeReservationsCount?: number;
    uniqueDisciplinesCount?: number;
    uniqueClubsCount?: number;
    maxDisciplineSessionsCount?: number;
    sessionsByDiscipline?: Record<string, number>;
    hasConfiguredSquad?: boolean;
    onAbrirCajaNivel?: () => Promise<number>;
    onReclamarRecompensa?: (id: string, kc: number, xp: number, isUnlocked: boolean) => void;
  };
}

export const KinetiClubProgressHubModal = memo(
  ({
    visible, onClose, nivelRaw, prestigeInfo, rachaActual, isStreakFrozenToday,
    dailyClaimedToday, claimableCount, claimedTotal, onSelectCard, inSheetProps,
  }: KinetiClubProgressHubModalProps) => {
    const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, language, themeColors, t, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const s = useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme, ['cardCyanSolid', 'iconBoxCyanSolid', 'cardTitleDarkInk', 'cardDescDarkInk']),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );

    const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<'hub' | 'rpg' | 'streak' | 'mystery' | 'retos'>('hub');
    useEffect(() => { if (visible) setActiveView('hub'); }, [visible]);

    const cyanText = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : themeColors.cyanText;
    const purpleText = isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : themeColors.purpleText;
    const localizedNivel = formatOfficialOrTierLabel(nivelRaw, language);
    const tierXp = resolveTierXp(nivelRaw);
    const safeLvl = Math.max(1, Number(prestigeInfo?.prestigeLevel) || 1);
    const prestigioNivel = Number(prestigeInfo?.prestigioNivel || 0);
    const safeRacha = Math.max(1, Number(rachaActual) || 1);
    const safeClaimed = Math.max(1, Number(claimedTotal) || 1);

    const handlePick = (target: 'rpg' | 'streak' | 'mystery' | 'retos') => {
      if (!visible) return;
      triggerHaptic('Selection');
      if (inSheetProps) setActiveView(target);
      else onSelectCard?.(target);
    };

    const rpgLabel =
      prestigioNivel > 0
        ? tx(`EXPEDIENTE RPG • PRESTIGIO NIVEL ${prestigioNivel}`, `RPG DOSSIER • PRESTIGE LEVEL ${prestigioNivel}`)
        : tx(`EXPEDIENTE RPG • NIVEL ${safeLvl}/99`, `RPG DOSSIER • LEVEL ${safeLvl}/99`);

    return (
      <ReactNativeModal
        isVisible={Boolean(visible)}
        onBackdropPress={onClose}
        onBackButtonPress={() => (activeView !== 'hub' ? setActiveView('hub') : onClose())}
        onSwipeComplete={activeView === 'hub' ? onClose : undefined}
        swipeDirection={activeView === 'hub' ? ['down'] : undefined}
        propagateSwipe={true}
        animationInTiming={200}
        animationOutTiming={180}
        useNativeDriver={Platform.OS !== 'web'}
        useNativeDriverForBackdrop={Platform.OS !== 'web'}
        backdropOpacity={0.82}
        backdropTransitionOutTiming={0}
        backdropTransitionInTiming={0}
        hideModalContentWhileAnimating={false}
        style={{ margin: 0, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}
      >
        <View
          style={[
            globalStyles.bottomSheet,
            KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS,
            { backgroundColor: themeColors.background, paddingHorizontal: 18, paddingTop: 8, paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom + 18, 26) },
            NO_SEL,
          ]}
        >
          <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={onClose} style={{ marginBottom: 8 }} />

          {activeView !== 'hub' && inSheetProps ? (
            <>
              <TouchableOpacity
                activeOpacity={0.84}
                onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setActiveView('hub'); }}
                style={[
                  s.backHubPill,
                  isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' },
                ]}
              >
                <Feather name="arrow-left" size={14} color={cyanText} />
                <Text selectable={false} style={[s.backHubTxt, { color: cyanText }]}>
                  {tx('VOLVER AL CENTRO TÁCTICO', 'BACK TO TACTICAL HUB')}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>

              {activeView === 'rpg' && (
                <RpgModalBody
                  onGoToTrain={() => { onClose(); inSheetProps.onGoToTrain(); }}
                  nivel={nivelRaw}
                  rachaDias={rachaActual}
                  userStats={inSheetProps.userStats}
                  seasonInfo={inSheetProps.seasonInfo}
                  prestigeInfo={prestigeInfo}
                  onAscendPrestige={inSheetProps.onAscendPrestige}
                />
              )}
              {activeView === 'streak' && (
                <StreakModalBody
                  rachaDias={rachaActual}
                  completedSessionsCount={inSheetProps.completedSessionsCount}
                  isStreakFrozenToday={isStreakFrozenToday}
                  onCongelarRacha={inSheetProps.onCongelarRacha}
                  isFreezing={inSheetProps.isFreezing}
                  prestigeInfo={prestigeInfo}
                />
              )}
              {(activeView === 'mystery' || activeView === 'retos') && (
                <RewardModalBody
                  activeRewardModal={activeView === 'mystery' ? 'misteriosa' : 'retos'}
                  claimingId={inSheetProps.claimingId}
                  dailyClaimedToday={dailyClaimedToday}
                  claimedChallengeIds={inSheetProps.claimedChallengeIds}
                  completedSessionsCount={inSheetProps.completedSessionsCount}
                  activeReservationsCount={inSheetProps.activeReservationsCount}
                  uniqueDisciplinesCount={inSheetProps.uniqueDisciplinesCount}
                  uniqueClubsCount={inSheetProps.uniqueClubsCount}
                  maxDisciplineSessionsCount={inSheetProps.maxDisciplineSessionsCount}
                  sessionsByDiscipline={inSheetProps.sessionsByDiscipline}
                  hasConfiguredSquad={inSheetProps.hasConfiguredSquad}
                  rachaActual={rachaActual}
                  prestigeInfo={prestigeInfo}
                  nivelRaw={nivelRaw}
                  onAbrirCajaNivel={inSheetProps.onAbrirCajaNivel}
                  onReclamarRecompensa={inSheetProps.onReclamarRecompensa}
                />
              )}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <KineticDeepParallaxCard3D
                isLightMode={isLightMode}
                accentColor={COLORS.cyan}
                secondaryColor={COLORS.purple}
                maxOffsetPx={5}
                style={{
                  paddingHorizontal: 14,
                  paddingVertical: 11,
                  borderRadius: 16,
                  marginBottom: 12,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderColor: isLightMode ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25)',
                  backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : '#080C16',
                }}
              >
                <Text style={[s.kicker, { color: cyanText }]}>{tx('CENTRO TÁCTICO GAMIFICADO', 'GAMIFIED TACTICAL HUB')}</Text>
                <Text style={[s.title, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>{tx('PROGRESO, RETOS & RECOMPENSAS', 'PROGRESS, CHALLENGES & REWARDS')}</Text>
                <Text style={[s.sub, { color: themeColors.textMuted, marginBottom: 0 }]}>
                  {tx('Selecciona una bóveda para consultar tu rango RPG, proteger tu racha o reclamar recompensas.', 'Select a module to inspect your RPG rank, shield your streak, or claim rewards.')}
                </Text>
              </KineticDeepParallaxCard3D>

              <View style={s.gridWrap}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  activeOpacity={0.86}
                  style={[s.cardBase, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4' }]}
                  onPress={() => handlePick('rpg')}
                >
                  <View style={[s.iconBox, { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#ECFEFF' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.14)', borderColor: COLORS.cyan }]}>
                    <Feather name="award" size={18} color={cyanText} />
                  </View>
                  <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <Text style={[s.cardLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{rpgLabel}</Text>
                    <Text style={[s.cardValue, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>{localizedNivel} • {tx('NIVEL', 'LVL')} {safeLvl}/99</Text>
                  </View>
                  <Feather name="chevron-right" size={18} color={cyanText} />
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <TouchableOpacity
                  activeOpacity={0.86}
                  style={[
                    s.cardBase,
                    isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4' },
                    isStreakFrozenToday && (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF', borderColor: '#C4B5FD', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#7C3AED' } : { backgroundColor: '#140B24', borderColor: COLORS.purple, borderTopColor: '#E0AAFF', borderBottomColor: '#4A1478' }),
                  ]}
                  onPress={() => handlePick('streak')}
                >
                  <View style={[s.iconBox, { backgroundColor: isStreakFrozenToday ? (isLightMode ? '#F3E8FF' : 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.16)') : isLightMode ? '#ECFEFF' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.14)', borderColor: isStreakFrozenToday ? COLORS.purple : COLORS.cyan }]}>
                    <Feather name={isStreakFrozenToday ? 'shield' : 'zap'} size={18} color={isStreakFrozenToday ? purpleText : cyanText} />
                  </View>
                  <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <Text style={[s.cardLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{isStreakFrozenToday ? t('club.active_shield') : t('club.active_streak')}</Text>
                    <Text style={[s.cardValue, { color: isStreakFrozenToday ? purpleText : cyanText }]}>{`${formatStreakDaysBadge(safeRacha, language)} 🔥`}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <Feather name="chevron-right" size={18} color={isStreakFrozenToday ? purpleText : cyanText} />
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <AttentionShakeView active={!dailyClaimedToday}>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    activeOpacity={0.86}
                    style={[s.cardPurple, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF', borderColor: '#C4B5FD', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#7C3AED' }]}
                    onPress={() => handlePick('mystery')}
                  >
                    <View style={[s.iconBox, { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F3E8FF' : 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.22)', borderColor: COLORS.purple }]}>
                      <Feather name="package" size={18} color={purpleText} />
                    </View>
                    <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                      <Text style={[s.cardValue, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>{t('club.mystery_box')}</Text>
                      <Text style={[s.cardSub, { color: purpleText }]}>
                        {dailyClaimedToday ? tx('Reclamada Hoy ✓', 'Claimed Today ✓') : tx(`Suministro Diario +${tierXp} XP Disponible`, `Daily Supply +${tierXp} XP Ready`)}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                    <Feather name="chevron-right" size={18} color={purpleText} />
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </AttentionShakeView>

                <AttentionShakeView active={claimableCount > 0}>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    {...(!isLightMode ? DARK_INK_PROPS : {})}
                    activeOpacity={0.86}
                    style={[
                      isLightMode ? s.cardBase : s.cardCyanSolid,
                      isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4' },
                    ]}
                    onPress={() => handlePick('retos')}
                  >
                    <View style={isLightMode ? [s.iconBox, { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4' }] : s.iconBoxCyanSolid}>
                      <Feather name="award" size={18} color={isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : '#050505'} />
                    </View>
                    <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                      <Text style={isLightMode ? [s.cardValue, { color: '#0F172A' }] : s.cardTitleDarkInk}>{t('club.trophy_showcase')}</Text>
                      <Text style={isLightMode ? [s.cardSub, { color: '#006B82' }] : s.cardDescDarkInk}>
                        {claimableCount > 0
                          ? tx(`¡${claimableCount} Retos Por Reclamar (+XP y Cajas KC)!`, `${claimableCount} Challenges To Claim (+XP & KC Chests)!`)
                          : tx(`${safeClaimed} Trofeos Desbloqueados ✓`, `${safeClaimed} Trophies Unlocked ✓`)}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                    <Feather name="chevron-right" size={18} color={isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : '#050505'} />
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </AttentionShakeView>
              </View>
            </>
          )}
        </View>
      </ReactNativeModal>
    );
  }
);

const baseStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  kicker: { fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 1.3, marginBottom: 2 },
  title: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '900', marginBottom: 4 },
  sub: { fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 17, marginBottom: 14 },
  gridWrap: { gap: 10 },
  backHubPill: {
    flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', alignSelf: 'flex-start', gap: 6,
    paddingHorizontal: 12, paddingVertical: 6, borderRadius: 999, marginBottom: 10,
    backgroundColor: '#0A0D14', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35)', borderBottomWidth: 3, borderBottomColor: '#03060B',
  },
  backHubTxt: { fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 0.5 },
  cardBase: {
    flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, padding: 13, borderRadius: RADIUS.lg,
    backgroundColor: '#090C12', borderWidth: 1.2, borderColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35)',
    borderTopWidth: 1.8, borderTopColor: 'rgba(184, 255, 255, 0.5)', borderBottomWidth: 4, borderBottomColor: '#005A66',
  },
  cardPurple: {
    flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, padding: 13, borderRadius: RADIUS.lg,
    backgroundColor: '#140B24', borderWidth: 1.2, borderColor: 'rgba(199, 125, 255, 0.45)',
    borderTopWidth: 1.8, borderTopColor: '#E0AAFF', borderBottomWidth: 4, borderBottomColor: '#4A1478',
  },
  cardCyanSolid: {
    flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, padding: 13, borderRadius: RADIUS.lg,
    backgroundColor: COLORS.cyan, borderWidth: 1.2, borderColor: '#70F8FF',
    borderTopWidth: 1.8, borderTopColor: '#B8FFFF', borderBottomWidth: 4.2, borderBottomColor: '#007B8A',

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { resolveCategoryImage } from '../../constants/exploreData';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { formatOfficialOrTierLabel, formatStreakDaysBadge, translateClubTerm } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { COLORS, KINETIC_THEME } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { baseRankingCardStyles as baseStyles } from '../../styles/kineticlubRankingCards.styles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { translateDiscipline } from '../../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';
import { getAvatarUrl, getCoverUrl } from '../../utils/supabaseImage';
import { KineticLoader, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;

export const resolveStandardizedClubAccent = (rawAura?: string, rankIndex = 0, isLightMode = false) => {
  const upper = String(rawAura || '').toUpperCase();
  const isPurpleTier = upper === '#9D4EDD' || upper === '#B026FF' || upper === '#00FF66' || rankIndex % 2 === 1;
  if (isLightMode) {
    return {
      isPurpleTier,
      borderAccent: isPurpleTier ? '#7C3AED' : '#0284C7',
      textAccent: isPurpleTier ? '#6D28D9' : '#006B82',
    };
  }
  return {
    isPurpleTier,
    borderAccent: isPurpleTier ? KINETIC_THEME.palette.secondaryAccent : KINETIC_THEME.palette.primaryAccent,
    textAccent: isPurpleTier ? KINETIC_THEME.palette.secondaryAccentText : KINETIC_THEME.palette.primaryAccent,
  };
};

const computeDefaultFireCount = (atl: any): number =>
  Math.max(4, Math.round((Number(atl?.xpTotal) || 150) / 90) + Math.max(1, Number(atl?.racha) || 1));

export const EliteTop10Card = memo(
  ({
    athlete, rankIndex, onInspect, onOpenStory, onOpenDm, onLink, isInMySquad = false, isPendingInvite = false, onToggleFire, fireCount, isFiredByMe = false, hasActiveStory = false,
  }: {
    athlete: any; rankIndex: number; onInspect: (a: any) => void; onOpenStory: (a: any) => void;
    onOpenDm?: (athlete: any) => void; onLink?: (athlete: any) => void; isInMySquad?: boolean; isPendingInvite?: boolean;
    onToggleFire?: (athlete: any) => void; fireCount?: number; isFiredByMe?: boolean; hasActiveStory?: boolean;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const styles = React.useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
    const { isPurpleTier, borderAccent, textAccent } = resolveStandardizedClubAccent(athlete?.auraColor, rankIndex, isLightMode);
    const totalFires = (fireCount ?? computeDefaultFireCount(athlete)) + (isFiredByMe ? 1 : 0);
    const squadTone = isInMySquad
      ? (isLightMode ? '#047857' : COLORS.purpleLight)
      : isPendingInvite
        ? (isLightMode ? '#B45309' : COLORS.yellow)
        : (isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan);

    const cardLightStyle = isLightMode
      ? {
          backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
          borderColor: rankIndex === 0 ? '#06B6D4' : isPurpleTier ? '#C4B5FD' : '#CBD5E1',
          borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
          borderBottomColor: rankIndex === 0 ? '#00B8D4' : isPurpleTier ? '#7C3AED' : '#94A3B8',
          shadowColor: rankIndex === 0 ? '#00B8D4' : isPurpleTier ? '#7C3AED' : '#0F172A',
          shadowOpacity: rankIndex === 0 || isPurpleTier ? 0.2 : 0.12,
        }
      : rankIndex === 0
        ? { borderColor: COLORS.cyan, borderBottomColor: '#006B78', shadowColor: COLORS.cyan }
        : { borderColor: `${borderAccent}55`, shadowColor: isPurpleTier ? COLORS.purple : COLORS.cyan };

    const pillDynamicStyle = rankIndex === 0
      ? { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#00E5FF' : COLORS.cyan, borderWidth: isLightMode ? 1 : 0, borderColor: '#0284C7' }
      : isLightMode
        ? { backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }
        : { backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' };

    return (
      <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.top10Card, cardLightStyle, NO_SEL]} activeOpacity={0.85} onPress={() => onInspect(athlete)}>
        <View style={styles.top10TopRow}>
          <View style={[styles.top10RankPill, pillDynamicStyle]}>
            <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.top10RankPillText, rankIndex === 0 ? { color: '#050505' } : isLightMode ? { color: '#0F172A' } : undefined]}>
              #{rankIndex + 1}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.top10RpgHint, { color: textAccent }]}>RPG</Text>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[
            styles.top10AvatarBox, { borderColor: hasActiveStory ? COLORS.cyan : borderAccent }, NO_SEL,
            isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0', borderBottomColor: hasActiveStory ? '#0284C7' : isPurpleTier ? '#6D28D9' : '#0284C7' },
          ]}
          activeOpacity={0.85}
          onPress={(e) => {
            e?.stopPropagation?.();
            if (hasActiveStory) onOpenStory(athlete);
            else onInspect(athlete);
          }}
        >
          {athlete?.avatar_url ? (
            <Image
              source={{ uri: getAvatarUrl(athlete.avatar_url, 140) }}
              recyclingKey={`top10_${athlete?.id || athlete?.nombre || rankIndex}_${athlete.avatar_url}`}
              cachePolicy="memory-disk"
              transition={0}
              style={styles.fullImg}
              contentFit="cover"
            />
          ) : (
            <Feather name="user" size={18} color={borderAccent} />
          )}
          {hasActiveStory && <View style={[styles.storyDotCyan, isLightMode && { borderColor: '#FFFFFF', backgroundColor: '#0284C7' }]} />}
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.top10NameText, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
          {athlete?.nombre || tx('Atleta', 'Athlete')}
        </Text>
        <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.top10XpText, { color: textAccent }]} numberOfLines={1}>
          {athlete?.xpTotal || 150} XP • {athlete?.ovr || 45} OVR
        </Text>
        <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.top10SubMeta, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
          🏆 {athlete?.trofeosCount || 2} • ⚡ {athlete?.checkinsCount || 1} ✓
        </Text>

        <View style={styles.top10MiniActions}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              styles.top10MiniPill,
              NO_SEL,
              isFiredByMe
                ? (isLightMode
                  ? { backgroundColor: '#FEF3C7', borderColor: '#D97706', borderTopColor: '#FFFBEB', borderBottomColor: '#B45309' }
                  : { backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,204,0,0.18)', borderColor: '#FFCC00', borderBottomColor: '#8A6D00' })
                : (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' } : undefined),
            ]}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityLabel={tx('Dar Fuego', 'Give Fire')}
            onPress={(e) => {
              e?.stopPropagation?.();
              triggerHaptic('Light');
              onToggleFire?.(athlete);
            }}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.top10MiniPillText, isLightMode && { color: isFiredByMe ? '#B45309' : '#334155' }, !isLightMode && isFiredByMe && { color: '#FFCC00' }]}>
              🔥 {totalFires}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              styles.top10MiniPill,
              NO_SEL,
              isLightMode
                ? { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4' }
                : { borderColor: 'rgba(0,240,255,0.42)', borderTopColor: '#B8FFFF', borderBottomColor: '#006B78', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,240,255,0.1)' },
            ]}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityLabel={tx('Enviar Mensaje 1 a 1', 'Direct Message')}
            onPress={(e) => {
              e?.stopPropagation?.();
              triggerHaptic('Light');
              onOpenDm?.(athlete);
            }}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.top10MiniPillText, { color: isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan }]} numberOfLines={1}>💬</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              styles.top10MiniPill,
              NO_SEL,
              isLightMode
                ? { backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF', borderColor: '#C4B5FD', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#7C3AED' }
                : { borderColor: 'rgba(157,78,221,0.45)', borderTopColor: '#E0AAFF', borderBottomColor: '#4A1478', backgroundColor: 'rgba(157,78,221,0.12)' },
            ]}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityLabel={tx('Invitar a Equipo', 'Add to Team')}
            onPress={(e) => {
              e?.stopPropagation?.();
              triggerHaptic('Light');
              onLink?.(athlete);
            }}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.top10MiniPillText, { color: squadTone }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {isInMySquad ? '✓' : isPendingInvite ? '⏳' : '+'}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  }
);

export const CommunityRankCard = memo(
  ({
    item, rankPos, isLinking, isInMySquad, isPendingInvite, onInspect, onOpenStory, onLink,
    onOpenDm, onToggleFire, fireCount, isFiredByMe = false, hasActiveStory = false,
  }: {
    item: any; rankPos: number; isLinking: boolean; isInMySquad: boolean; isPendingInvite?: boolean;
    onInspect: (a: any) => void; onOpenStory: (a: any) => void; onLink: (a: any) => void;
    onOpenDm?: (athlete: any) => void; onToggleFire?: (athlete: any) => void; fireCount?: number; isFiredByMe?: boolean; hasActiveStory?: boolean;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const styles = React.useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme, [
        'rankPosPill', 'rankPosPillText', 'streakBadgeDark', 'streakBadgeText', 'rpgMediaPill', 'rpgMediaText',
      ]),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );
    const { isPurpleTier, borderAccent } = resolveStandardizedClubAccent(item?.auraColor, rankPos - 1, isLightMode);
    const bannerUri = resolveCategoryImage(item?.disciplina || 'Fuerza', item?.nombre);
    const streakDays = Math.max(1, Number(item?.racha) || 1);
    const badgeRoleText = formatOfficialOrTierLabel(String(item?.titulo || item?.rango || 'ATLETA ÉLITE').toUpperCase(), language);
    const venueLabel = translateClubTerm(item?.gimnasio || tx('Kinetic Oficial', 'Kinetic Official'), language);
    const totalFires = (fireCount ?? computeDefaultFireCount(item)) + (isFiredByMe ? 1 : 0);
    const onMediaProps: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } : {};

    const btnIconColor = isInMySquad
      ? isLightMode ? '#047857' : COLORS.purpleLight
      : isPendingInvite
        ? isLightMode ? '#B45309' : COLORS.yellow
        : isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;

    const connectBtnVariant = isInMySquad
      ? isLightMode
        ? { backgroundColor: '#D1FAE5', borderColor: '#10B981', borderTopColor: '#ECFDF5', borderBottomColor: '#059669' }
        : styles.squadConnectBtnPurple
      : isPendingInvite
        ? isLightMode
          ? { backgroundColor: '#FEF3C7', borderColor: '#F59E0B', borderTopColor: '#FFFBEB', borderBottomColor: '#D97706' }
          : styles.squadConnectBtnYellow
        : isLightMode
          ? { backgroundColor: '#F0F9FF', borderColor: '#38BDF8', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#0284C7' }
          : styles.squadConnectBtnCyan;

    const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;

    return (
      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={0.92}
        onPress={() => onInspect(item)}
        style={[
          styles.rankCardContainer,
          NO_SEL,
          isLightMode
            ? {
                backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
                borderColor: rankPos === 1 ? '#06B6D4' : '#CBD5E1',
                borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
                borderBottomColor: rankPos === 1 ? '#00B8D4' : '#94A3B8',
                shadowColor: rankPos === 1 ? '#00B8D4' : '#0F172A',
                shadowOpacity: rankPos === 1 ? 0.24 : 0.12,
              }
            : {
                borderColor: rankPos === 1 ? COLORS.cyan : `${borderAccent}44`,
                borderBottomColor: rankPos === 1 ? '#00838F' : '#03060B',
                shadowColor: rankPos === 1 ? '#00F0FF' : borderAccent,
                shadowOpacity: rankPos === 1 ? 0.26 : 0.16,
              },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={styles.rankBannerTop}>
          <Image source={{ uri: getCoverUrl(bannerUri, 640, 360) }} recyclingKey={`${item?.id || item?.nombre || rankPos}_${bannerUri}`} style={styles.fullImg} contentFit="cover" cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} />
          <View style={styles.rankBannerTopBadges}>
            <View style={[styles.rankPosPill, { borderColor: isPurpleTier ? COLORS.purple : COLORS.cyan }]} {...onMediaProps}>
              <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.rankPosPillText, { color: isPurpleTier ? COLORS.purpleLight : COLORS.cyan }]}>
                #{rankPos} • {badgeRoleText}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[styles.rpgMediaPill, NO_SEL]}
                activeOpacity={0.85}
                onPress={(e) => { e?.stopPropagation?.(); onInspect(item); }}
                {...onMediaProps}
              >
                <Text selectable={false} style={styles.rpgMediaText}>RPG ⚡</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <View style={styles.streakBadgeDark} {...onMediaProps}>
                <Text selectable={false} style={styles.streakBadgeText}>{formatStreakDaysBadge(streakDays, language)} 🔥</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={[styles.rankDarkFooter, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderTopWidth: 1, borderTopColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
          <View style={styles.rankIdentityRow}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[
                styles.bridgeAvatarBox, NO_SEL, { borderColor: hasActiveStory ? COLORS.cyan : borderAccent },
                isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0', borderBottomColor: hasActiveStory ? '#0284C7' : isPurpleTier ? '#6D28D9' : '#0284C7' },
              ]}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
              onPress={(e) => {
                e?.stopPropagation?.();
                if (hasActiveStory) onOpenStory(item);
                else onInspect(item);
              }}
            >
              {item?.avatar_url ? (
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: getAvatarUrl(item.avatar_url, 140) }}
                  recyclingKey={`rank_${item?.id || item?.nombre || rankPos}_${item.avatar_url}`}
                  cachePolicy="memory-disk"
                  transition={0}
                  style={styles.fullImg}
                  contentFit="cover"
                />
              ) : (
                <Feather name="user" size={20} color={borderAccent} />
              )}
              {hasActiveStory && <View style={[styles.storyDotCyan, isLightMode && { borderColor: '#FFFFFF', backgroundColor: '#0284C7' }]} />}
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, marginLeft: 10 }}>
              <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.rankAthleteName, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                {item?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')}
              </Text>
              <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.rankAthleteMeta, { color: isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : themeColors.purpleText }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                ⚡ {item?.xpTotal || 150} XP • {item?.ovr || 45} OVR • 🏆 {item?.trofeosCount || 2} {tx('Trofeos', 'Trophies')}
              </Text>
              <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.rankWorkoutSub, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                🏋️ {translateDiscipline(item?.disciplina || 'Fuerza', language)} • 📍 {venueLabel}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={[styles.actionClusterRow, isLightMode && { borderTopColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[
                styles.socialActionBtn,
                NO_SEL,
                isFiredByMe
                  ? (isLightMode
                    ? { backgroundColor: '#FEF3C7', borderColor: '#F59E0B', borderTopColor: '#FFFBEB', borderBottomColor: '#D97706' }
                    : { backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,204,0,0.16)', borderColor: '#FFCC00', borderBottomColor: '#8A6D00' })
                  : (isLightMode
                    ? { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }
                    : undefined),
              ]}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
              accessibilityLabel={tx('Dar Fuego', 'Give Fire')}
              onPress={(e) => {
                e?.stopPropagation?.();
                triggerHaptic('Light');
                onToggleFire?.(item);
              }}
            >
              <Text
                selectable={false}
                style={[
                  styles.socialActionText,
                  isLightMode ? { color: isFiredByMe ? '#B45309' : '#334155' } : { color: isFiredByMe ? '#FFCC00' : '#E2E8F0' },
                ]}
              >
                🔥 {totalFires}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[
                styles.socialActionBtn,
                NO_SEL,
                isLightMode
                  ? { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4' }
                  : styles.squadConnectBtnCyan,
              ]}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
              accessibilityLabel={tx('Enviar Mensaje 1 a 1', 'Direct Message')}
              onPress={(e) => {
                e?.stopPropagation?.();
                triggerHaptic('Light');
                onOpenDm?.(item);
              }}
            >
              <Feather name="message-circle" size={12} color={cyanInk} />
              <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.socialActionText, { color: cyanInk }]} numberOfLines={1}>{tx('DM 1 a 1', '1-on-1 DM')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.squadConnectBtn, NO_SEL, connectBtnVariant]}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
              disabled={isLinking}
              onPress={(e) => { e?.stopPropagation?.(); onLink(item); }}
            >
              {isLinking ? (
                <KineticLoader size={14} color={btnIconColor} />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Feather name={isInMySquad ? 'check' : isPendingInvite ? 'clock' : 'user-plus'} size={12} color={btnIconColor} />
                  <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.squadConnectBtnText, { color: btnIconColor }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                    {isInMySquad ? tx('✓ Equipo', '✓ Team') : isPendingInvite ? tx('Pendiente', 'Pending') : tx('+ Equipo', '+ Team')}
                  </Text>
                </>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  }
);

export const getLocalizedRpgPillars = (language: string = 'es', isLightMode: boolean = false) => {
  const isEn = language === 'en';
  return RPG_PILLARS_META.map((p) => ({
    ...p,
    displayTitle: isEn ? p.titleEn : p.title,
    displayShortTitle: isEn ? p.shortTitleEn : p.shortTitle,
    displayDetail: isEn ? p.detailEn : p.detail,
    displayColor: isLightMode ? p.lightColor : p.color,
  }));
};

export const getLocalizedPrestigeLadder = (language: string = 'es') => {
  const isEn = language === 'en';
  return PRESTIGE_RANKS_LADDER.map((b) => ({ ...b, displayTitle: isEn ? b.titleEn : b.title }));
};

export const getLocalizedSeasonSteps = (language: string = 'es') => {
  const isEn = language === 'en';
  return MONTHLY_SEASON_STEPS.map((st: any) => ({
    ...st,
    displayTitle: isEn && st.titleEn ? st.titleEn : st.title,
    displayReward: isEn && st.rewardLabelEn ? st.rewardLabelEn : st.rewardLabel,
    displayDesc: isEn && st.descEn ? st.descEn : st.desc,
  }));
};

export const resolveProfileLightAura = (rawAura?: string, isLightMode: boolean = false) => {
  const clean = String(rawAura || '#00F0FF').toUpperCase();
  if (!isLightMode) {
    return {
      ringColor: clean,
      textColor: clean === '#9D4EDD' ? '#E0AAFF' : clean,
      pillBg: clean === '#9D4EDD' ? 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.14)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.08)',
    };
  }
  if (clean === '#00FF66') return { ringColor: '#059669', textColor: '#059669', pillBg: '#ECFDF5' };
  if (clean === '#9D4EDD' || clean === '#B026FF' || clean === '#E0AAFF') return { ringColor: '#7C3AED', textColor: '#6D28D9', pillBg: '#F3E8FF' };
  if (clean === '#FFCC00' || clean === '#F59E0B') return { ringColor: '#D97706', textColor: '#B45309', pillBg: '#FEF3C7' };
  if (clean === '#E2E8F0') return { ringColor: '#64748B', textColor: '#334155', pillBg: '#F1F5F9' };
  return { ringColor: '#0284C7', textColor: '#006B82', pillBg: '#F0F9FF' };
};
