export const KinetiClubSocialFeedView = React.memo(
  ({ user, profile, athletes = [], misEquipos = [], onOpenPromoClub, onInspectAthlete, onOpenStory, onSendToSquad }: {
    user: FeedUserLike; profile: FeedProfileLike; athletes: FeedRecord[]; clubPromos?: FeedRecord[]; misEquipos?: FeedSquadLike[];
    onOpenPromoEvent?: (event: FeedRecord) => void; onOpenPromoClub?: (affiliate: FeedRecord) => void;
    onOpenDm?: (athlete: FeedRecord) => void; onInspectAthlete: (athlete: FeedRecord) => void; onOpenStory: (athlete: FeedRecord) => void;
    onScrollByDelta?: (dy: number) => void; isPromoReserved?: (promo: FeedRecord) => boolean;
    onOpenActivePass?: () => void; onSendToSquad?: (squadId: string, msg: string) => Promise<unknown> | void;
  }) => {
    const { isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const isEn = language === 'en';
    const isMasterAdminUser = useMemo(() => isMasterAdmin(user, profile), [user, profile]);

    const [userPosts, setUserPosts] = useState<WallPostRow[]>(() => getMemoryWallSnapshot(user?.id).posts);
    const [hasHydratedWallInitial, setHasHydratedWallInitial] = useState<boolean>(
      () => Boolean(user?.id && getMemoryWallSnapshot(user?.id).posts.length > 0)
    );
    const [reactionsMap, setReactionsMap] = useState<Record<string, Partial<Record<WallReactionKey, boolean>>>>(() => getMemoryWallSnapshot(user?.id).reactionsMap);
    const [commentsMap, setCommentsMap] = useState<Record<string, IWallComment[]>>(() => getMemoryWallSnapshot(user?.id).commentsMap);
    const [savedMap, setSavedMap] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() => getMemoryWallSnapshot(user?.id).savedMap);

    const [zoneFilter, setZoneFilter] = useState<KineticCabosZoneFilter>('all');
    const [feedMode, setFeedMode] = useState<KineticWallFeedMode>('for_you');
    const [viewLayout, setViewLayout] = useState<'wall' | 'mosaic'>('wall');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

    const [activeCommentsPost, setActiveCommentsPost] = useState<KinetiClubCardEntry | null>(null);
    const [activeSendPost, setActiveSendPost] = useState<KinetiClubCardEntry | null>(null);
    const [activeUgcPost, setActiveUgcPost] = useState<KinetiClubCardEntry | null>(null);
    const [lightboxState, setLightboxState] = useState<{ images: string[]; index: number; caption?: string } | null>(null);
    const [toastBanner, setToastBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [storyTick, setStoryTick] = useState(0);
    const [ugcTick, setUgcTick] = useState(0);
    const [nowTick, setNowTick] = useState(() => Date.now());

    const reactionsMapRef = useRef(reactionsMap); reactionsMapRef.current = reactionsMap;
    const commentsMapRef = useRef(commentsMap); commentsMapRef.current = commentsMap;
    const savedMapRef = useRef(savedMap); savedMapRef.current = savedMap;
    const athletesRef = useRef(athletes); athletesRef.current = athletes;
    const reactionBusyRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
    const commentBusyRef = useRef(false);
    const publishingPostRef = useRef(false);
    const deletingPostRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
    const isMountedRef = useRef(true);
    const wallLoadSeqRef = useRef(0);
    const prevWallUidRef = useRef<string>(String(user?.id || '').trim());
    const toastTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      isMountedRef.current = true;
      const ticker = setInterval(() => setNowTick(Date.now()), 30000);
      const unsubStories = subscribeKineticStoriesUpdated(() => setStoryTick((v) => v + 1));
      return () => {
        isMountedRef.current = false;
        clearInterval(ticker);
        unsubStories();
        if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
      };
    }, []);

    const loadWallPosts = useCallback(async () => {
      const seq = ++wallLoadSeqRef.current;
      const reqUid = String(user?.id || '').trim();
      try {
        const res = await fetchHydratedWallPostsAndCloudState({
          realWallPostsKey: REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY, userId: user?.id, fallbackAuthor: tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'),
          isMasterAdminUser, athletes: athletesRef.current || [],
        });
        if (!isMountedRef.current || seq !== wallLoadSeqRef.current || reqUid !== String(user?.id || '').trim()) return;
        reactionsMapRef.current = res.reactionsMap; commentsMapRef.current = res.commentsMap; savedMapRef.current = res.savedMap;
        setReactionsMap(res.reactionsMap); setCommentsMap(res.commentsMap); setSavedMap(res.savedMap); setUserPosts(res.posts);
      } catch {
      } finally {
        if (isMountedRef.current && seq === wallLoadSeqRef.current && reqUid === String(user?.id || '').trim()) {
          markWallInitialHydrated(true);
          setHasHydratedWallInitial(true);
        }
      }
    }, [user?.id, isMasterAdminUser, tx]);

    useEffect(() => {
      let active = true;
      const curUid = String(user?.id || '').trim();
      if (prevWallUidRef.current !== curUid) {
        prevWallUidRef.current = curUid;
        const scoped = getMemoryWallSnapshot(user?.id);
        reactionsMapRef.current = scoped.reactionsMap;
        commentsMapRef.current = scoped.commentsMap;
        savedMapRef.current = scoped.savedMap;
        setUserPosts(scoped.posts);
        setReactionsMap(scoped.reactionsMap);
        setCommentsMap(scoped.commentsMap);
        setSavedMap(scoped.savedMap);
        setHasHydratedWallInitial(Boolean(curUid && scoped.posts.length > 0));
      }
      if (getMemoryWallSnapshot(user?.id).posts.length === 0) {
        primeWallSnapshotFromStorage(REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY, user?.id).then((snap) => {
          if (!active || !isMountedRef.current || snap.posts.length === 0 || String(user?.id || '').trim() !== curUid) return;
          setUserPosts((p) => (p.length > 0 ? p : snap.posts));
          setReactionsMap((p) => (Object.keys(p).length > 0 ? p : snap.reactionsMap));
          setCommentsMap((p) => (Object.keys(p).length > 0 ? p : snap.commentsMap));
          setSavedMap((p) => (Object.keys(p).length > 0 ? p : snap.savedMap));
          setHasHydratedWallInitial(true);
        });
      }
      loadWallPosts();
      const u1 = subscribeCommunityWallUpdated(loadWallPosts);
      const u2 = subscribeWallPostsRealtimeAndFocus(loadWallPosts);
      const u3 = subscribeUgcModerationChanged(() => { setUgcTick((v) => v + 1); loadWallPosts(); });
      return () => { active = false; u1(); u2(); u3(); };
    }, [loadWallPosts, user?.id]);

    const handlePublishPost = useCallback(async (clean: string, mediaUris: string[], meta?: IComposerPostMeta) => {
      if ((!clean && mediaUris.length === 0) || publishingPostRef.current) return;
      const ugcCheck = validateKineticUgcPayload(clean, { allowEmptyText: mediaUris.length > 0, extraFields: [meta?.discipline, meta?.venue] });
      if (!ugcCheck.allowed) {
        triggerHaptic('Warning');
        if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
        setToastBanner(getKineticUgcBlockedMessage(ugcCheck.reasonCode, isEn));
        toastTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setToastBanner(null), 3200);
        return;
      }
      publishingPostRef.current = true;
      try {
        triggerHaptic('Success');
        const created = await publishCommunityWallPostEverywhere({
          user, profile, cleanText: ugcCheck.cleanedText || clean, mediaUris, fallbackAuthorLabel: tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'),
          discipline: meta?.discipline, venue: meta?.venue, sedeId: meta?.sedeId, zona: meta?.zona,
        });
        setUserPosts((prev) => [created, ...prev.filter((p) => String(p.id) !== String(created.id))].slice(0, 40));
      } finally { publishingPostRef.current = false; }
    }, [user, profile, tx, isEn]);

    const handleDeleteOwnPost = useCallback(async (postId: string) => {
      const pid = String(postId || '');
      if (!pid || deletingPostRef.current.has(pid)) return;
      deletingPostRef.current.add(pid);
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      setUserPosts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => String(p.id) !== pid));
      try { await deleteCommunityWallPostEverywhere(pid, user?.id, isMasterAdminUser); }
      finally { deletingPostRef.current.delete(pid); }
    }, [user?.id, isMasterAdminUser]);

    const handleToggleFire = useCallback((itemId: string, forceAddOnly = false) => {
      const lockKey = `${itemId}:fire`;
      if (reactionBusyRef.current.has(lockKey)) return;
      const cur = Boolean(reactionsMapRef.current[itemId]?.fire);
      if (forceAddOnly && cur) return;
      reactionBusyRef.current.add(lockKey);
      triggerHaptic('Light');
      const next = { ...reactionsMapRef.current, [itemId]: { ...(reactionsMapRef.current[itemId] || {}), fire: !cur } };
      reactionsMapRef.current = next; setReactionsMap(next);
      toggleWallPostReactionCloud(itemId, 'fire', next, user?.id).finally(() => reactionBusyRef.current.delete(lockKey));
    }, [user?.id]);

    const handleToggleSave = useCallback((itemId: string) => {
      const next = { ...savedMapRef.current, [itemId]: !savedMapRef.current[itemId] };
      savedMapRef.current = next; setSavedMap(next);
      toggleWallPostSavedCloud(itemId, next, user?.id).catch(() => {});
    }, [user?.id]);

    const handleAddComment = useCallback((itemId: string, rawText: string) => {
      const clean = sanitizeWallCommentInput(rawText);
      const ugcCheck = validateKineticUgcPayload(clean, { allowEmptyText: false });
      if (!ugcCheck.allowed) {
        triggerHaptic('Warning');
        if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
        setToastBanner(getKineticUgcBlockedMessage(ugcCheck.reasonCode, isEn));
        toastTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setToastBanner(null), 3200);
        return;
      }
      if (!clean || commentBusyRef.current) return;
      commentBusyRef.current = true; triggerHaptic('Success');
      const tempId = `cm_${Date.now()}`;
      const newComm: IWallComment = {
        id: tempId, userId: user?.id ? String(user.id) : null,
        author: profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'), text: clean, created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      const next = { ...commentsMapRef.current, [itemId]: [...(commentsMapRef.current[itemId] || []), newComm] };
      commentsMapRef.current = next; setCommentsMap(next);
      addWallPostCommentCloud(itemId, newComm, next, user?.id)
        .then((cloudSaved) => {
          if (cloudSaved && cloudSaved.id !== tempId) {
            const patched = { ...commentsMapRef.current, [itemId]: (commentsMapRef.current[itemId] || []).map((c) => (c.id === tempId ? cloudSaved : c)) };
            commentsMapRef.current = patched; setCommentsMap(patched);
          }
        })
        .finally(() => { commentBusyRef.current = false; });
    }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre, tx]);

    const handleDeleteComment = useCallback((itemId: string, commentId: string) => {
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      const next = { ...commentsMapRef.current, [itemId]: (commentsMapRef.current[itemId] || []).filter((c) => String(c.id) !== String(commentId)) };
      commentsMapRef.current = next; setCommentsMap(next);
      deleteWallPostCommentCloud(itemId, commentId, next, user?.id).catch(() => {});
    }, [user?.id]);

    const tribeMemberKeys = useMemo(() => {
      const set = new Set<string>();
      if (user?.id) set.add(String(user.id).toLowerCase());
      if (profile?.nombre) set.add(String(profile.nombre).trim().toLowerCase());
      (misEquipos || []).forEach((sq: FeedSquadLike) => {
        if (sq?.creador_id) set.add(String(sq.creador_id).toLowerCase());
        if (sq?.creador_nombre) set.add(String(sq.creador_nombre).trim().toLowerCase());
        (Array.isArray(sq?.integrantes_nombres) ? sq.integrantes_nombres : []).forEach((nm: string) => {
          const clean = String(nm || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          if (clean) set.add(clean);
        });
      });
      return set;
    }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre, misEquipos]);

    const organicStream = useMemo(() => {
      void ugcTick;
      return buildOrganicHyperlocalWallStream({
        posts: userPosts,
        blockedIds: getBlockedUserIdsSet(),
        zoneFilter,
        feedMode,
        tribeMemberKeys,
        searchQuery,
      });
    }, [userPosts, zoneFilter, feedMode, tribeMemberKeys, searchQuery, ugcTick]);

    const activeStoriesMap = useMemo(() => { void storyTick; void nowTick; return getActiveStoriesMapSync(); }, [storyTick, nowTick]);
    const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;
    const ink = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
    const muted = isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8';
    const activeZoneLabel = useMemo(() => {
      if (zoneFilter === 'all') return 'Los Cabos';
      const opt = ZONE_OPTIONS.find((z) => z.key === zoneFilter);
      return opt ? (isEn ? opt.en : opt.es) : String(zoneFilter);
    }, [zoneFilter, isEn]);

    return (
      <View style={sf.root}>
        <KinetiClubPostComposer onPublish={handlePublishPost} userAvatarUrl={profile?.avatar_url} />

        <KineticListFilterSortBar
          searchQuery={searchQuery}
          onChangeSearch={setSearchQuery}
          searchPlaceholder={tx('Buscar atleta o disciplina...', 'Search athlete or discipline...')}
          filterChips={ZONE_OPTIONS.map((z) => ({ key: z.key, label: `📍 ${isEn ? z.en : z.es}` }))}
          activeFilter={zoneFilter}
          onSelectFilter={(k) => setZoneFilter(k as KineticCabosZoneFilter)}
          sortOptions={[
            { key: 'for_you', label: tx('⚡ Para Ti', '⚡ For You') },
            { key: 'my_tribe', label: tx('♡ Mi Equipo', '♡ My Team') },
          ]}
          activeSort={feedMode}
          onSelectSort={(k) => setFeedMode(k as KineticWallFeedMode)}
          rightSlot={
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[sf.iconToggleBtn, NO_SEL, { minHeight: 44, minWidth: 44, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', elevation: 0 }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }, viewLayout === 'mosaic' && { borderColor: COLORS.cyan }]}
              accessibilityLabel={tx('Alternar vista mosaico', 'Toggle mosaic view')}
              onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setViewLayout((v) => (v === 'wall' ? 'mosaic' : 'wall')); }}
            >
              <Feather name={viewLayout === 'wall' ? 'grid' : 'square'} size={16} color={viewLayout === 'mosaic' ? cyanInk : ink} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          }
        />
        {Boolean(toastBanner) && (
          <View style={[sf.toastBox, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4' }]}>
            <Text selectable={false} style={[sf.toastTxt, { color: cyanInk }]}>{toastBanner}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
        {!hasHydratedWallInitial && organicStream.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
            {[0, 1].map((skIdx) => (
              <View key={`wall_sk_${skIdx}`} style={[sf.emptyCard, { alignItems: 'stretch', padding: 14, elevation: 0 }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}>
                <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, marginBottom: 10 }}>
                  <SkeletonPulse style={{ width: 40, height: 40, borderRadius: 20 }} />
                  <View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 6 }}>
                    <SkeletonPulse style={{ width: '54%', height: 13, borderRadius: 6 }} />
                    <SkeletonPulse style={{ width: '38%', height: 10, borderRadius: 5 }} />
                  </View>
                </View>
                <SkeletonPulse style={{ width: '100%', height: 185, borderRadius: 14, marginBottom: 10 }} />
                <SkeletonPulse style={{ width: '82%', height: 12, borderRadius: 6 }} />
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
        ) : organicStream.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={[sf.emptyCard, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}>
            <Feather name="camera" size={28} color={cyanInk} />
            <Text style={[sf.emptyTitle, { color: ink }]}>{tx('Sin publicaciones en este filtro', 'No posts match this filter')}</Text>
            <Text style={[sf.emptySub, { color: muted }]}>{tx('Comparte tu entrenamiento de hoy o explora Todo Los Cabos.', 'Share today’s workout or switch to All Los Cabos.')}</Text>
          </View>
        ) : viewLayout === 'mosaic' ? (
          <View style={sf.mosaicGrid}>
            {organicStream.map((entry) => {
              const photos: string[] = Array.isArray(entry.mediaUris) ? entry.mediaUris : [];
              const txt = String(isEn ? entry.bodyEn || entry.bodyEs : entry.bodyEs || entry.bodyEn || '').trim();
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={entry.id}
                  activeOpacity={0.9}
                  style={[sf.mosaicCell, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}
                  onPress={() => {
                    triggerHaptic('Selection');
                    if (photos.length > 0) setLightboxState({ images: photos, index: 0, caption: `${entry.authorName}${txt ? ` • ${txt}` : ''}` });
                    else setActiveCommentsPost(entry);
                  }}
                >
                  {photos.length > 0 ? (
                    <KineticSmartImage uri={photos[0]} fallbackCategory={String(entry.discipline || 'Fuerza')} transition={180} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }} />
                  ) : (
                    <View style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                      <Text style={{ color: ink, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '700' }} numberOfLines={5}>{txt}</Text>
                    </View>
                  )}
                  <View style={sf.mosaicFooter}>
                    <Text selectable={false} style={sf.mosaicAuthor} numberOfLines={1}>{entry.authorName}</Text>
                  </View>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        ) : (
          organicStream.map((entry) => {
            const blockedSet = getBlockedUserIdsSet();
            const visibleCommsCount = (commentsMap[entry.id] || []).filter((c) => !c?.userId || !blockedSet.has(String(c.userId).toLowerCase())).length;
            return (
              <KinetiClubFeedCard
                key={entry.id} entry={entry} isFiredByMe={Boolean(reactionsMap[entry.id]?.fire)}
                isSavedByMe={Boolean(savedMap[entry.id] ?? entry.isSavedByMe)} commentsCount={visibleCommsCount}
                hasActiveStory={hasActiveStoryInMap(activeStoriesMap, entry.userId || entry.authorId, entry.authorName, nowTick, blockedSet)}
                onToggleFire={handleToggleFire} onToggleSave={handleToggleSave}
                onOpenComments={setActiveCommentsPost} onOpenSendSheet={setActiveSendPost} onOpenContextMenu={setActiveUgcPost}
                onOpenLightbox={(imgs, idx, cap) => setLightboxState({ images: imgs, index: idx, caption: cap })}
                onOpenStory={onOpenStory} onInspectAthlete={onInspectAthlete} onOpenPromoClub={onOpenPromoClub}
              />
            );
          })
        )}

        <KinetiClubCommentsSheetModal
          post={activeCommentsPost}
          comments={activeCommentsPost?.id ? (commentsMap[String(activeCommentsPost.id)] || []).filter((c: IWallComment) => !c?.userId || !getBlockedUserIdsSet().has(String(c.userId).toLowerCase())) : []}
          currentUserId={user?.id} currentUserName={profile?.nombre} isMasterAdminUser={isMasterAdminUser}
          onClose={() => setActiveCommentsPost(null)} onAddComment={handleAddComment} onDeleteComment={handleDeleteComment}
        />
        <KinetiClubSendToSheetModal
          post={activeSendPost} user={user} profile={profile} misEquipos={misEquipos}
          athletes={athletes} onSendToSquad={onSendToSquad} onClose={() => setActiveSendPost(null)}
        />
        <KinetiClubUgcSheetModal
          post={activeUgcPost} currentUserId={user?.id}
          canDelete={Boolean(activeUgcPost && (activeUgcPost.isMine || activeUgcPost.canDelete || isMasterAdminUser))}
          onDeletePost={handleDeleteOwnPost}
          onModerationApplied={(es, en) => {
            if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
            setToastBanner(isEn ? en : es);
            toastTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setToastBanner(null), 2600);
          }}
          onClose={() => setActiveUgcPost(null)}
        />
        <KineticFullscreenLightboxModal
          visible={Boolean(lightboxState)} images={lightboxState?.images || []}
          initialIndex={lightboxState?.index || 0} caption={lightboxState?.caption}
          onClose={() => setLightboxState(null)}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }
);

    // === src/components/kineticlub/KinetiClubTopDashboard.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Easing, Platform, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View, useWindowDimensions } from 'react-native';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { getAvatarUrl } from '../../utils/supabaseImage';
import { buildRealActiveStoryCarouselEntries } from '../../services/kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
import { useKineticLivePresence } from '../../services/kineticRealtimePresenceService';
import { getBlockedUserIdsSet, subscribeUgcModerationChanged } from '../../services/kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import {
  getActiveStoriesMapSync,
  getSyncStoriesForOwner,
  readLocalStoriesMap,
  subscribeKineticStoriesUpdated,
  syncStoriesFromCloud,
} from '../../services/kineticStoriesService';
import { COLORS, SPACING } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { KineticPhysicsPressable } from '../../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';
import { AttentionShakeView, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { KineticListFilterSortBar } from '../shared/KineticListFilterSortBar';

export type KinetiClubSocialTab = 'muro' | 'ranking' | 'messages';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;
const DARK_INK_PROPS: any = { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };

export const KinetiClubStickyBar = React.memo(
  ({
    pendingDmCount,
    pendingSquadInvitesCount,
    hasPendingRewards = false,
    unseenNotificationsCount = 0,
    activeSocialTab = 'muro',
    onSelectSocialTab,
    onOpenNotifications,
    userAvatarUrl,
    storyAthletes = [],
    clubPromos = [],
    onOpenProgressHub,
    onOpenMyProfile,
    onOpenMyStory,
    onOpenAthleteStory,
    onOpenPromoStory,
  }: {
    misEquiposCount?: number;
    pendingDmCount: number;
    pendingSquadInvitesCount: number;
    hasPendingRewards?: boolean;
    unseenNotificationsCount?: number;
    activeSocialTab?: KinetiClubSocialTab;
    onSelectSocialTab?: (tab: KinetiClubSocialTab) => void;
    onOpenNotifications?: () => void;
    userAvatarUrl?: string | null;
    storyAthletes?: any[];
    clubPromos?: any[];
    onOpenSquadsHub?: () => void;
    onOpenProgressHub: () => void;
    onOpenMyProfile?: () => void;
    onOpenMyStory?: () => void;
    onOpenAthleteStory?: (atl: any) => void;
    onOpenPromoStory?: (promo: any) => void;
    onOpenPromoEvent?: (promo: any) => void;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, t, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const { width: winW } = useWindowDimensions();
    const isNarrow = winW < 390;
    const { user: authUser, profile: authProfile } = useAuth();
    const { onlineUserIds, onlineCount } = useKineticLivePresence(authUser, authProfile);
    const tdStyles = useMemo(
      () =>
        adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseTdStyles, resolvedTheme, [
          'promoPillBadge', 'promoPillText', 'storyPlusBadge', 'storyPlusText',
          'socialTabActive', 'socialTabTextActive', 'unreadPill', 'unreadPillText',
        ]),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );
    const totalChatAlertsCount = pendingSquadInvitesCount + pendingDmCount;
    const cyanText = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : themeColors.cyanText;
    const purpleText = isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : COLORS.purpleLight;
    const [storyTick, setStoryTick] = useState(0);

    useEffect(() => {
      const bump = () => setStoryTick((v) => v + 1);
      readLocalStoriesMap().then(bump).catch(() => {});
      syncStoriesFromCloud(true).then(bump).catch(() => {});
      const unsub = subscribeKineticStoriesUpdated(bump);
      const unsubUgc = subscribeUgcModerationChanged(bump);
      const expiryTimer = setInterval(bump, 60_000);
      const onWinEvt = () => { syncStoriesFromCloud(false).then(bump).catch(bump); };
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') {
        window.addEventListener('kinetic:stories-updated', onWinEvt);
      }
      return () => {
        unsub();
        unsubUgc();
        clearInterval(expiryTimer);
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.removeEventListener === 'function') {
          window.removeEventListener('kinetic:stories-updated', onWinEvt);
        }
      };
    }, []);

    const onMediaProps: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } : {};

    const liveStories = useMemo(() => {

      return buildRealActiveStoryCarouselEntries({

        blockedIds: getBlockedUserIdsSet(),

    }, [storyAthletes, clubPromos, storyTick, authUser?.id, authProfile?.nombre]);

    const myActiveSlides = useMemo(() => {

      const avRaw = String(userAvatarUrl || authProfile?.avatar_url || '').trim();

      { key: 'ranking', icon: 'award', label: tx('RANKING', 'RANKING'), a11y: tx('Ranking', 'Ranking') },
      { key: 'messages', icon: 'message-circle', label: tx('MENSAJES', 'MESSAGES'), a11y: tx('Mensajes', 'Messages'), badge: totalChatAlertsCount },
    ];

    return (
      <View style={[tdStyles.stickyBarWrap, { backgroundColor: themeColors.background, borderBottomColor: isLightMode ? '#E2E8F0' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' }]}>
        <View style={tdStyles.topHeader}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, paddingRight: isNarrow ? 4 : 6 }}>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: isNarrow ? 4 : 6 }}>
              <Text style={[tdStyles.logoSubtext, { color: cyanText, flexShrink: 1 }]} numberOfLines={1}>{t('club.sub')}</Text>
              {onlineCount > 0 && (
                <View style={[tdStyles.liveCountPill, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFDF5', borderColor: '#10B981' }]}>
                  <View style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: 3, backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#10B981' : '#00FF66' }} />
                  <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[tdStyles.liveCountTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#047857' : '#00FF66' }]}>
                    {tx(`${onlineCount} EN VIVO`, `${onlineCount} LIVE`)}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>
            <Text style={[tdStyles.logoText, isNarrow && { fontSize: 18 }, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>{t('club.title')}</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[tdStyles.headerActionsRow, isNarrow && { gap: 4 }]}>
            <KineticPhysicsPressable
              preset="tactileChip"

                      {pr?.portada_url ? <Image source={{ uri: pr.portada_url }} recyclingKey={String(pr.portada_url)} cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} style={tdStyles.fullImg} contentFit="cover" /> : <Feather name="zap" size={18} color={ringCol} />}

export const KinetiClubTopDashboard = React.memo(
  ({
    activeSocialTab = 'muro',
    rankingSearchQuery = '',
    onChangeRankingSearch,
    rankingFilterKey = 'all',
    onSelectRankingFilter,
    rankingSortKey = 'trofeos',
    onSelectRankingSort,
    refreshing = false,
  }: {
    pendingDmCount?: number;
    pendingSquadInvitesCount?: number;
    activeSocialTab?: KinetiClubSocialTab;
    onSelectSocialTab?: (tab: KinetiClubSocialTab) => void;
    rankingSearchQuery?: string;
    onChangeRankingSearch?: (q: string) => void;
    rankingFilterKey?: string;
    onSelectRankingFilter?: (key: string) => void;
    rankingSortKey?: string;
    onSelectRankingSort?: (key: string) => void;
    refreshing?: boolean;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const tdStyles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseTdStyles, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
    const spinVal = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;

    useEffect(() => {
      if (!refreshing) {
        spinVal.stopAnimation();
        spinVal.setValue(0);
        return;
      }
      spinVal.setValue(0);
      const loop = Animated.loop(
        Animated.timing(spinVal, { toValue: 1, duration: 760, easing: Easing.linear, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' })
      );
      loop.start();
      return () => loop.stop();
    }, [refreshing, spinVal]);

    const clockwiseSpin = spinVal.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: ['0deg', '360deg'] });

    return (
      <View style={tdStyles.dashboardHeaderWrap}>
        {refreshing && (
          <View style={[tdStyles.refreshBanner, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4' }]}>
            <Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ rotate: clockwiseSpin }] }}>
              <Feather name="zap" size={15} color={isLightMode ? '#006B82' : '#00F0FF'} />
            </Animated.View>
            <Text selectable={false} style={[tdStyles.refreshBannerTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#006B82' : '#00F0FF' }]}>
              {tx('Actualizando red en vivo...', 'Refreshing live network...')}
            </Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {activeSocialTab === 'ranking' && onChangeRankingSearch && (
          <View style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
            <KineticListFilterSortBar
              searchQuery={rankingSearchQuery}
              onChangeSearch={onChangeRankingSearch}
              searchPlaceholder={tx('Buscar atleta o disciplina...', 'Search athlete or discipline...')}
              filterChips={[
                { key: 'all', label: tx('👥 Todos los Atletas', '👥 All Athletes') },
                { key: 'hoy', label: tx('🔥 Entrenaron Hoy', '🔥 Trained Today') },
                { key: 'racha3', label: tx('⚡ En Racha (3+ días)', '⚡ Active Streak (3+d)') },
              ]}
              activeFilter={rankingFilterKey}
              onSelectFilter={onSelectRankingFilter}
              sortOptions={[
                { key: 'trofeos', label: tx('🏆 Más Trofeos / XP', '🏆 Top Trophies / XP') },
                { key: 'checkins', label: tx('⚡ Más Check-Ins', '⚡ Most Check-Ins') },
                { key: 'ovr', label: tx('📊 Mayor OVR RPG', '📊 Highest OVR') },
                { key: 'racha', label: tx('🔥 Mayor Racha', '🔥 Longest Streak') },
              ]}
              activeSort={rankingSortKey}
              onSelectSort={onSelectRankingSort}
            />
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    );
  }
);

    // === src/components/kineticlub/KinetiClubTrophyVaultView.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { FlatList, Platform, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { baseTrophyVaultStyles as baseTvStyles } from '../../styles/kineticlubTrophyVault.styles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { AttentionShakeView, GpuProgressBar, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { KineticTrophy3DModal, KineticTrophy3DSculpture } from './KineticTrophy3DModal';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;
const DARK_INK_PROPS: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } } : {};

const translateDivisionLabel = (raw: string, language: string): string => {
  if (language !== 'en' || !raw) return raw;
  return String(raw)
    .replace(/DIVISI[ÓO]N F[ÁA]CIL/gi, 'EASY DIVISION')
    .replace(/DIVISI[ÓO]N INTERMEDI[OA]/gi, 'INTERMEDIATE DIVISION')
    .replace(/DIVISI[ÓO]N AVANZAD[OA]/gi, 'ADVANCED DIVISION')
    .replace(/DIVISI[ÓO]N PRO/gi, 'PRO DIVISION')
    .replace(/DIVISI[ÓO]N LEYENDA/gi, 'LEGEND DIVISION')
    .replace(/\bF[ÁA]CIL\b/gi, 'EASY')
    .replace(/\bINTERMEDIO\b/gi, 'INTERMEDIATE')
    .replace(/\bAVANZADO\b/gi, 'ADVANCED')
    .replace(/\bLEYENDA\b/gi, 'LEGEND');
};

export const KinetiClubTrophyVaultView = React.memo(
  ({
    all250Enriched, claimingId, prestigeInfo, onOpenLevelCrateStage, onClaimChallenge,
  }: {
    all250Enriched: any[]; claimingId?: string | null; prestigeInfo?: any;
    onOpenLevelCrateStage: () => void; onClaimChallenge: (reto: any) => void;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, language, tx, tChallenge } = useKineticPreferences();
    const tvStyles = useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseTvStyles, resolvedTheme, ['openCrateCyanBtn', 'openCrateCyanBtnText', 'trophyActionBtnReady', 'pillChipActive', 'pillChipActiveTxt']),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );
    const [selectedDivision, setSelectedDivision] = useState<'todas' | 'facil' | 'intermedio' | 'avanzado' | 'pro' | 'leyenda'>('todas');
    const [selectedFamily, setSelectedFamily] = useState<'todas' | 'sesiones' | 'clubes' | 'experto'>('todas');
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'todos' | 'por_reclamar' | 'desbloqueados' | 'por_desbloquear'>('todos');
    const [activeFilterKey, setActiveFilterKey] = useState('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'claimable' | 'progress' | 'xp_desc' | 'xp_asc'>('claimable');
    const [openMenu, setOpenMenu] = useState<'filter' | 'sort' | null>(null);
    const [viewStyle, setViewStyle] = useState<'vitrina' | 'misiones'>('vitrina');
    const [selectedTrophyId, setSelectedTrophyId] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const unclaimedTrophiesCount = useMemo(() => all250Enriched.filter((r: any) => r.isUnlocked && !r.isClaimed).length, [all250Enriched]);
    const claimedTrophiesCount = useMemo(() => all250Enriched.filter((r: any) => r.isClaimed).length, [all250Enriched]);
    const totalUnlockedGlobal = useMemo(() => all250Enriched.filter((r: any) => r.isUnlocked).length, [all250Enriched]);
    const selectedTrophyForModal = useMemo(
      () => (selectedTrophyId ? all250Enriched.find((r: any) => r.id === selectedTrophyId) || null : null),
      [all250Enriched, selectedTrophyId]
    );

    const handleSelectVaultFilter = useCallback((key: string) => {
      setActiveFilterKey(key);
      if (key === 'all') {
        setStatusFilter('todos'); setSelectedDivision('todas'); setSelectedFamily('todas');
      } else if (key.startsWith('status:')) {
        setStatusFilter(key.replace('status:', '') as any); setSelectedDivision('todas'); setSelectedFamily('todas');
      } else if (key.startsWith('div:')) {
        setSelectedDivision(key.replace('div:', '') as any); setStatusFilter('todos'); setSelectedFamily('todas');
      } else if (key.startsWith('fam:')) {
        setSelectedFamily(key.replace('fam:', '') as any); setStatusFilter('todos'); setSelectedDivision('todas');
      }
      setOpenMenu(null);
    }, []);

    const vaultFilterChips = useMemo(() => [
      { key: 'all', label: `${tx('Todos', 'All')} (${all250Enriched.length})` },
      { key: 'status:por_reclamar', label: `${tx('⚡ Por Reclamar', '⚡ Ready to Claim')} (${unclaimedTrophiesCount})` },
      { key: 'status:desbloqueados', label: `${tx('Desbloqueados', 'Unlocked')} (${totalUnlockedGlobal})` },
      { key: 'status:por_desbloquear', label: `${tx('Pendientes', 'Locked')} (${all250Enriched.length - totalUnlockedGlobal})` },
      { key: 'div:facil', label: tx('División: Fácil (50)', 'Division: Easy (50)') },
      { key: 'div:intermedio', label: tx('División: Intermedio (50)', 'Division: Intermediate (50)') },
      { key: 'div:avanzado', label: tx('División: Avanzado (50)', 'Division: Advanced (50)') },
      { key: 'div:pro', label: tx('División: Pro (50)', 'Division: Pro (50)') },
      { key: 'div:leyenda', label: tx('División: Leyenda (50)', 'Division: Legend (50)') },
      { key: 'fam:sesiones', label: tx('Tipo: ⚡ Sesiones Verificadas', 'Type: ⚡ Verified Sessions') },
      { key: 'fam:clubes', label: tx('Tipo: 📍 Clubes Visitados', 'Type: 📍 Venues Visited') },
      { key: 'fam:experto', label: tx('Tipo: ★ Disciplinas', 'Type: ★ Disciplines') },
    ], [all250Enriched.length, unclaimedTrophiesCount, totalUnlockedGlobal, tx]);

    const vaultSortOptions = useMemo(() => [
      { key: 'claimable', label: tx('⚡ Por Reclamar Primero', '⚡ Ready to Claim First') },
      { key: 'progress', label: tx('📊 Mayor % de Avance', '📊 Highest % Progress') },
      { key: 'xp_desc', label: tx('🏆 Mayor Recompensa XP', '🏆 Highest XP Reward') },
      { key: 'xp_asc', label: tx('🎯 Misiones Rápidas (Menor XP)', '🎯 Quick Quests (Lowest XP)') },
    ], [tx]);

    const activeFilterLabel = useMemo(
      () => vaultFilterChips.find((c) => c.key === activeFilterKey)?.label || tx('Todos', 'All'),
      [vaultFilterChips, activeFilterKey, tx]
    );
    const activeSortLabel = useMemo(
      () => vaultSortOptions.find((o) => o.key === sortBy)?.label || tx('Por Reclamar', 'Ready First'),
      [vaultSortOptions, sortBy, tx]
    );

    const filteredChallenges = useMemo(() => {
      const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
      const base = all250Enriched.filter((r) => {
        if (selectedDivision !== 'todas' && r.division !== selectedDivision) return false;
        if (selectedFamily !== 'todas' && r.familia !== selectedFamily) return false;
        if (statusFilter === 'por_reclamar' && (!r.isUnlocked || r.isClaimed)) return false;
        if (statusFilter === 'desbloqueados' && !r.isUnlocked) return false;
        if (statusFilter === 'por_desbloquear' && r.isUnlocked) return false;
        if (!q) return true;
        const loc = tChallenge(r);
        return `${loc.titulo || ''} ${loc.requisitoCorto || ''} ${loc.desc || ''} ${r.divisionLabel || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      });
      return [...base].sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortBy === 'progress') return (Number(b.pct) || 0) - (Number(a.pct) || 0) || (Number(b.recompensaXp) || 0) - (Number(a.recompensaXp) || 0);
        if (sortBy === 'xp_desc') return (Number(b.recompensaXp) || 0) - (Number(a.recompensaXp) || 0) || (Number(b.pct) || 0) - (Number(a.pct) || 0);
        if (sortBy === 'xp_asc') return (Number(a.recompensaXp) || 0) - (Number(b.recompensaXp) || 0) || (Number(b.pct) || 0) - (Number(a.pct) || 0);
        const aRank = a.isUnlocked && !a.isClaimed ? 2 : a.isUnlocked ? 1 : 0;
        const bRank = b.isUnlocked && !b.isClaimed ? 2 : b.isUnlocked ? 1 : 0;
        return bRank - aRank || (Number(b.pct) || 0) - (Number(a.pct) || 0);
      });
    }, [all250Enriched, selectedDivision, selectedFamily, statusFilter, searchQuery, sortBy, tChallenge]);

    const availableCrates = Number(prestigeInfo?.availableBoxesCount || 0);
    const prestigioNivel = Number(prestigeInfo?.prestigioNivel || 0);
    const prestigeLvl = Number(prestigeInfo?.prestigeLevel || 1);
    const xpInCurr = Number(prestigeInfo?.xpInCurrentPrestige || 0);
    const xpPerLvl = Number(prestigeInfo?.xpPerPrestigeLevel || 100);
    const xpRem = Number(prestigeInfo?.xpRemainingForNext || 100);
    const prestigePct = Math.min(100, Math.round((xpInCurr / xpPerLvl) * 100));
    const cyanText = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;
    const purpleText = isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#E0AAFF';
    const progressHeadline =
      prestigioNivel > 0
        ? tx(`★ PRESTIGIO ${prestigioNivel} • NV. ${prestigeLvl}/99 (${xpInCurr}/${xpPerLvl} XP)`, `★ PRESTIGE ${prestigioNivel} • LVL ${prestigeLvl}/99 (${xpInCurr}/${xpPerLvl} XP)`)
        : tx(`★ NIVEL ${prestigeLvl}/99 (${xpInCurr}/${xpPerLvl} XP)`, `★ LEVEL ${prestigeLvl}/99 (${xpInCurr}/${xpPerLvl} XP)`);

    const listHeaderElement = useMemo(
      () => (
        <View style={{ paddingBottom: 4 }}>
          <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <Text style={[tvStyles.modalBigTitle, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>
              {tx('VITRINA DE TROFEOS Y RETOS', 'TROPHY & QUEST VAULT')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={[tvStyles.modalSubDesc, isLightMode && { color: '#334155' }]}>
              {tx(
                'Explora tus 250 trofeos 3D interactivos. Toca cualquier trofeo para girarlo en 3D y ver cómo desbloquearlo.',
                'Explore all 250 interactive 3D trophies. Tap any trophy to rotate it in 3D and inspect how to unlock it.'
              )}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View style={tvStyles.kpiStripRow}>
            {[
              { lbl: tx('TOTAL', 'TOTAL'), val: all250Enriched.length, col: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF' },
              { lbl: tx('DESBLOQ.', 'UNLOCKED'), val: totalUnlockedGlobal, col: cyanText },
              { lbl: tx('POR RECLAMAR', 'TO CLAIM'), val: unclaimedTrophiesCount, col: isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : COLORS.cyan },
              { lbl: tx('RECLAMADOS', 'CLAIMED'), val: claimedTrophiesCount, col: purpleText },
            ].map((k, idx) => (
              <View key={idx} style={[tvStyles.kpiMiniBox, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }]}>
                <Text style={[tvStyles.kpiValTxt, { color: k.col }]}>{k.val}</Text>
                <Text style={[tvStyles.kpiLblTxt, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }]} numberOfLines={1}>{k.lbl}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>

          <View style={[tvStyles.prestigeLiveBox, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF', borderColor: '#A855F7', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#7C3AED', shadowColor: '#7C3AED', shadowOpacity: 0.2 }]}>
            <View style={tvStyles.rowBetween}>
              <Text style={[tvStyles.cyanSectionLabel, { color: isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : COLORS.cyan }]}>{progressHeadline}</Text>
              <Text style={[tvStyles.whiteBoldSmall, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>
                {tx(`PRÓXIMA CAJA EN ${xpRem} XP`, `NEXT CHEST IN ${xpRem} XP`)}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
              {isLightMode ? (
                <View style={{ height: 7, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                  <View style={{ width: `${prestigePct}%`, height: '100%', borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: '#7C3AED' }} />
                </View>
              ) : (
                <GpuProgressBar progress={prestigePct} color={COLORS.purple} height={7} />
              )}
            </View>
            {availableCrates > 0 && (
              <AttentionShakeView active={true} style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
                <TouchableOpacity {...DARK_INK_PROPS} style={[tvStyles.openCrateCyanBtn, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Medium'); onOpenLevelCrateStage(); }}>
                  <Feather name="gift" size={14} color="#050505" />
                  <Text selectable={false} style={tvStyles.openCrateCyanBtnText}>
                    {tx('ABRIR CAJA DE RETO DE NIVEL (10 A 20 KC) + 30 XP', 'OPEN LEVEL CHALLENGE CHEST (10 TO 20 KC) + 30 XP')}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </AttentionShakeView>
            )}
          </View>

          <View style={[tvStyles.searchBarWrap, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#94A3B8', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#64748B' }]}>
            <Feather name="search" size={16} color={cyanText} />
            <TextInput
              value={searchQuery}
              onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
              placeholder={tx('Buscar trofeo, misión o disciplina...', 'Search trophy, quest, or discipline...')}
              placeholderTextColor={isLightMode ? '#64748B' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)'}
              style={[tvStyles.searchInput, { color: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF' }]}
              autoCorrect={false}
              autoCapitalize="none"
              returnKeyType="search"
            />
            {searchQuery.length > 0 && (
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSearchQuery('')} hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}>
                <Feather name="x-circle" size={16} color={isLightMode ? '#64748B' : COLORS.textMuted} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>

          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, marginBottom: openMenu ? 6 : 8 }}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              activeOpacity={0.86}
              onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setOpenMenu((m) => (m === 'filter' ? null : 'filter')); }}
              style={[
                tvStyles.pillChip,
                { flex: 1, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingVertical: 8, borderRadius: 12 },
                isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: openMenu === 'filter' ? '#0284C7' : '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: openMenu === 'filter' ? '#0284C7' : '#94A3B8' },
                !isLightMode && openMenu === 'filter' && { borderColor: COLORS.cyan },
                NO_SEL,
              ]}
            >
              <View style={{ flex: 1, paddingRight: 6 }}>
                <Text selectable={false} style={[tvStyles.mutedTinyText, { color: cyanText }]}>{tx('FILTRAR', 'FILTER')}</Text>
                <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[tvStyles.pillChipTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF', fontWeight: '900' }]}>{activeFilterLabel}</Text>
              </View>
              <Feather name={openMenu === 'filter' ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'} size={15} color={cyanText} />
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity
              activeOpacity={0.86}
              onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setOpenMenu((m) => (m === 'sort' ? null : 'sort')); }}
              style={[
                tvStyles.pillChip,
                { flex: 1, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingVertical: 8, borderRadius: 12 },
                isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: openMenu === 'sort' ? '#7C3AED' : '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: openMenu === 'sort' ? '#7C3AED' : '#94A3B8' },
                !isLightMode && openMenu === 'sort' && { borderColor: COLORS.purple },
                NO_SEL,
              ]}
            >
              <View style={{ flex: 1, paddingRight: 6 }}>
                <Text selectable={false} style={[tvStyles.mutedTinyText, { color: purpleText }]}>{tx('ORDENAR', 'SORT')}</Text>
                <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[tvStyles.pillChipTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF', fontWeight: '900' }]}>{activeSortLabel}</Text>
              </View>
              <Feather name={openMenu === 'sort' ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'} size={15} color={purpleText} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          {openMenu !== null && (
            <View
              style={[
                tvStyles.prestigeLiveBox,
                { padding: 6, marginBottom: 8, borderRadius: 14 },
                isLightMode
                  ? { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: openMenu === 'filter' ? '#06B6D4' : '#C4B5FD', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: openMenu === 'filter' ? '#00B8D4' : '#7C3AED', shadowOpacity: 0.12 }
                  : { backgroundColor: '#0A0D14', borderColor: openMenu === 'filter' ? 'rgba(0,240,255,0.45)' : 'rgba(157,78,221,0.5)', borderBottomColor: '#03060B' },
              ]}
            >
              {(openMenu === 'filter' ? vaultFilterChips : vaultSortOptions).map((opt) => {
                const active = openMenu === 'filter' ? activeFilterKey === opt.key : sortBy === opt.key;
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={opt.key}
                    activeOpacity={0.84}
                    onPress={() => {
                      triggerHaptic('Selection');
                      if (openMenu === 'filter') handleSelectVaultFilter(opt.key);
                      else { setSortBy(opt.key as any); setOpenMenu(null); }
                    }}
                    style={{
                      flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: 10, paddingVertical: 8, borderRadius: 10,
                      backgroundColor: active ? (isLightMode ? (openMenu === 'filter' ? '#ECFEFF' : '#F3E8FF') : 'rgba(0,240,255,0.12)') : 'transparent',
                    }}
                  >
                    <Text style={{ fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: active ? '900' : '700', color: active ? (openMenu === 'filter' ? cyanText : purpleText) : isLightMode ? '#334155' : '#E2E8F0' }}>
                      {opt.label}
                    </Text>
                    {active ? <Feather name="check" size={14} color={openMenu === 'filter' ? cyanText : purpleText} /> : null}
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          )}

          <View style={tvStyles.rowBetween}>
            <Text style={[tvStyles.cyanSectionLabel, { color: cyanText }]}>
              {tx(`⚡ MOSTRANDO ${filteredChallenges.length} DE ${all250Enriched.length} TROFEOS`, `⚡ SHOWING ${filteredChallenges.length} OF ${all250Enriched.length} TROPHIES`)}
            </Text>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[tvStyles.viewModeBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4', shadowColor: '#00B8D4', shadowOpacity: 0.2 }]}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
              onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setViewStyle((p) => (p === 'vitrina' ? 'misiones' : 'vitrina')); }}
            >
              <Feather name={viewStyle === 'vitrina' ? 'list' : 'grid'} size={13} color={cyanText} />
              <Text selectable={false} style={[tvStyles.filterToggleText, { color: cyanText }]}>{viewStyle === 'vitrina' ? tx('LISTA', 'LIST') : '2X2'}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      ),
      [
        tvStyles, isLightMode, tx, all250Enriched.length, totalUnlockedGlobal, unclaimedTrophiesCount,
        claimedTrophiesCount, cyanText, purpleText, progressHeadline, xpRem, prestigePct, availableCrates,
        onOpenLevelCrateStage, searchQuery, openMenu, activeFilterLabel, activeSortLabel, vaultFilterChips,
        activeFilterKey, handleSelectVaultFilter, vaultSortOptions, sortBy, filteredChallenges.length, viewStyle,
      ]
    );

    const renderTrophyCard = useCallback(
      ({ item: rawReto }: { item: any }) => {
        const reto = tChallenge(rawReto);
        const canClaimNow = reto.isUnlocked && !reto.isClaimed;
        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              viewStyle === 'vitrina' ? tvStyles.trophyCard2x2 : tvStyles.trophyCardFullWidth,
              NO_SEL,
              isLightMode && {
                backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: reto.isUnlocked ? '#06B6D4' : '#CBD5E1',
                borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: reto.isUnlocked ? '#00B8D4' : '#94A3B8',
                shadowColor: reto.isUnlocked ? '#00B8D4' : '#0F172A', shadowOpacity: reto.isUnlocked ? 0.18 : 0.1,
              },
              !isLightMode && reto.isUnlocked && { borderColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45)', borderBottomColor: '#00838F' },
            ]}
            activeOpacity={0.88}
            onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setSelectedTrophyId(rawReto.id); }}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={[tvStyles.trophyDivLabel, { color: cyanText }]}>{translateDivisionLabel(reto.divisionLabel, language)}</Text>
            <View style={{ marginVertical: 4, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              <KineticTrophy3DSculpture tier={reto.division || reto.divisionLabel} size={viewStyle === 'vitrina' ? 58 : 66} unlocked={reto.isUnlocked} category={reto.familia} />
            </View>
            <Text selectable={false} style={[tvStyles.trophyTitleText, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]} numberOfLines={2}>{reto.titulo}</Text>
            <Text selectable={false} style={[tvStyles.trophyReqText, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }]}>{reto.requisitoCorto}</Text>
            <View style={{ width: '100%', marginVertical: 6 }}>
              <View style={tvStyles.rowBetween}>
                <Text selectable={false} style={[tvStyles.mutedTinyText, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }]}>{tx('PROGRESO', 'PROGRESS')}</Text>
                <Text selectable={false} style={[tvStyles.mutedTinyText, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }, reto.isUnlocked && { color: cyanText, fontWeight: '900' }]}>
                  {reto.currentVal}/{reto.meta} ({reto.pct}%)
                </Text>
              </View>
              <View style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                {isLightMode ? (
                  <View style={{ height: 5, borderRadius: 3, backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                    <View style={{ width: `${reto.pct}%`, height: '100%', borderRadius: 3, backgroundColor: reto.isUnlocked ? '#7C3AED' : '#0284C7' }} />
                  </View>
                ) : (
                  <GpuProgressBar progress={reto.pct} color={reto.isUnlocked ? COLORS.purple : COLORS.cyan} height={5} />
                )}
              </View>
            </View>
            <Text selectable={false} style={[tvStyles.trophyXpRewardText, { color: purpleText }]}>
              +{reto.recompensaXp} XP • {tx('Suma a Caja KC', 'Counts toward KC Chest')}
            </Text>
            <AttentionShakeView active={canClaimNow} style={{ width: '100%', marginTop: 6 }}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                {...(canClaimNow ? DARK_INK_PROPS : {})}
                disabled={Boolean(claimingId)}
                style={[
                  tvStyles.trophyActionBtn,
                  NO_SEL,
                  isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8', shadowOpacity: 0.08 },
                  reto.isClaimed && (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF', borderColor: '#A855F7', borderBottomColor: '#7C3AED' } : { borderColor: COLORS.purple, backgroundColor: '#170E29', borderBottomColor: '#5B21B6' }),
                  canClaimNow && (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#00E5FF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#B8FFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00838F' } : tvStyles.trophyActionBtnReady),
                ]}
                onPress={() => (canClaimNow ? onClaimChallenge(reto) : setSelectedTrophyId(rawReto.id))}
              >
                <Text selectable={false} style={[tvStyles.trophyActionBtnText, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }, reto.isClaimed && { color: purpleText }, canClaimNow && { color: '#050505' }]}>
                  {reto.isClaimed ? tx('INSPECCIONAR 3D ✓', 'INSPECT 3D ✓') : canClaimNow ? tx(`RECLAMAR +${reto.recompensaXp} XP`, `CLAIM +${reto.recompensaXp} XP`) : tx('VER TROFEO 3D ›', 'VIEW 3D TROPHY ›')}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </AttentionShakeView>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        );
      },
      [tChallenge, viewStyle, tvStyles, isLightMode, cyanText, language, tx, purpleText, claimingId, onClaimChallenge]
    );

    return (
      <>
        <FlatList
          key={viewStyle === 'vitrina' ? 'vault-grid-2' : 'vault-list-1'}
          style={{ flex: 1 }}
          data={filteredChallenges}
          numColumns={viewStyle === 'vitrina' ? 2 : 1}
          columnWrapperStyle={viewStyle === 'vitrina' ? tvStyles.vitrinaRowWrap : undefined}
          keyExtractor={(item: any) => String(item.id)}
          renderItem={renderTrophyCard}
          ListHeaderComponent={listHeaderElement}
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View style={{ paddingVertical: 32, alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <Text style={[tvStyles.modalSubDesc, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }]}>
                {tx('No se encontraron trofeos con ese filtro.', 'No trophies matched your current filter.')}
              </Text>
            </View>
          }
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          initialNumToRender={12}
          maxToRenderPerBatch={14}
          windowSize={7}
          contentContainerStyle={{ paddingTop: 4, paddingBottom: 24, rowGap: 10 }}
        />

export const KineticTrophy3DSculpture = React.memo(({

const getQuestStepByStepGuide = (trophy: any, locDesc: string, tx: (es: string, en: string) => string): string[] => {
  const tipo = String(trophy?.tipo || ''), meta = Math.max(1, Number(trophy?.meta) || 1);
  if (tipo === 'equipo') return [
    tx('1. Abre la sección Equipos en KinetiClub.', '1. Open the Teams section inside KinetiClub.'),
    tx('2. Crea tu propio equipo o únete con código de invitación.', '2. Create your own team or join via invite code.'),
    tx('3. Regresa a esta vitrina para reclamar tu XP.', '3. Return to this vault to claim your XP.'),
  ];
  if (tipo === 'racha') return [
    tx('1. Ingresa diario a Kinetic o valida tu Identidad Activa en tu club.', '1. Open Kinetic daily or verify your Active Identity at your venue.'),
    tx(`2. Mantén tu constancia hasta sumar ${meta} días consecutivos (usa Escudo 24h en días de descanso).`, `2. Keep your streak alive up to ${meta} consecutive days (use the 24h Shield on rest days).`),
    tx('3. Reclama este trofeo para sumar XP a tus Cajas de Nivel.', '3. Claim this trophy to add XP toward your Level Chests.'),
  ];
  if (tipo === 'clubes_visitados') return [
    tx('1. Explora sedes afiliadas en el Radar Kinetic.', '1. Explore partner venues on the Kinetic Radar.'),
    tx(`2. Reserva y valida tu asistencia en ${meta} ${meta === 1 ? 'club verificado' : 'clubes distintos'}.`, `2. Book and verify your check-in at ${meta} ${meta === 1 ? 'verified venue' : 'distinct venues'}.`),
    tx('3. Reclama tu recompensa directa en esta vitrina.', '3. Claim your direct reward right inside this vault.'),
  ];
  if (tipo === 'disciplinas' || tipo === 'disciplina_especifica' || tipo === 'experto_disciplina') return [
    tx(`1. Revisa el objetivo: ${locDesc}`, `1. Check the target requirement: ${locDesc}`),
    tx(`2. Completa check-ins reales verificados hasta alcanzar ${meta} en el contador.`, `2. Complete verified check-ins until reaching ${meta} on the counter.`),
    tx('3. Toca Reclamar para acreditar tu XP de Nivel.', '3. Tap Claim to credit your Level XP.'),
  ];
  return [
    tx(`1. Objetivo: ${locDesc}`, `1. Objective: ${locDesc}`),
    tx(`2. Valida tus asistencias en recepción hasta completar ${meta} ${meta === 1 ? 'sesión' : 'sesiones'}.`, `2. Verify your check-ins at reception to complete ${meta} ${meta === 1 ? 'session' : 'sessions'}.`),
    tx('3. Reclama tu trofeo 3D y desbloquea Cajas de Nivel con KC.', '3. Claim your 3D trophy and unlock Level Chests with KC.'),
  ];
};

export const KineticTrophy3DModal = React.memo(({

    // === src/components/kineticlub/KineticTrophyVolumetricEngine.tsx === //
import React, { memo, useMemo } from 'react';
import { StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Svg, { Circle, Defs, Ellipse, G, Path, Polygon, RadialGradient, Stop } from 'react-native-svg';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { buildVolumetricChaliceManifold } from '../../services/kinetic3DChaliceMeshBuilder';
import { computeTrophyRevolutionGeometry } from '../../services/kineticTrophyPhysicsEngine';

export type TrophyTierType = 'bronze' | 'silver' | 'gold' | 'pro' | 'diamond';

export interface SculpturePalette {
  main: string; bevel: string; dark: string; glow: string; core: string; wing: string; text: string; label: string;
}

export const resolveTrophyTier = (divisionOrTier?: string): TrophyTierType => {
  const d = String(divisionOrTier || '').toLowerCase();
  if (d.includes('leyenda') || d.includes('legend') || d.includes('diamond') || d.includes('diamante')) return 'diamond';
  if (d.includes('pro') || d.includes('platin')) return 'pro';
  if (d.includes('avanzad') || d.includes('advanc') || d.includes('gold') || d.includes('oro')) return 'gold';
  if (d.includes('intermed') || d.includes('silver') || d.includes('plata')) return 'silver';
  return 'bronze';
};

export const getTierPalette = (tier: TrophyTierType, unlocked: boolean, isLight: boolean, isEn: boolean): SculpturePalette => {
  if (!unlocked) {
    return {
      main: isLight ? '#64748B' : '#94A3B8', bevel: isLight ? '#F8FAFC' : '#E2E8F0', dark: isLight ? '#475569' : '#334155',
      glow: isLight ? 'rgba(100,116,139,0.16)' : 'rgba(148,163,184,0.24)', core: isLight ? '#CBD5E1' : '#64748B',
      wing: isLight ? '#94A3B8' : '#64748B', text: isLight ? '#475569' : '#CBD5E1',
      label: isEn ? 'IN PROGRESS • FROSTED' : 'EN PROGRESO • ESCARCHADO',
    };
  }
  switch (tier) {
    case 'diamond':
      return { main: '#00F0FF', bevel: '#F5D0FE', dark: '#1E1B4B', glow: 'rgba(0,240,255,0.38)', core: '#B8FFFF', wing: '#9D4EDD', text: isLight ? '#0369A1' : '#70F8FF', label: isEn ? 'OBSIDIAN DIAMOND • LEGEND' : 'DIAMANTE OBSIDIANA • LEYENDA' };
    case 'pro':
      return { main: '#10B981', bevel: '#A7F3D0', dark: '#064E3B', glow: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.34)', core: '#D1FAE5', wing: '#059669', text: isLight ? '#047857' : '#34D399', label: isEn ? 'ELITE EMERALD • PRO' : 'ESMERALDA ÉLITE • PRO' };
    case 'gold':
      return { main: '#FFD700', bevel: '#FEF08A', dark: '#92400E', glow: 'rgba(255,215,0,0.38)', core: '#FFFBEB', wing: '#D97706', text: isLight ? '#B45309' : '#FBBF24', label: isEn ? 'IMPERIAL GOLD • ADVANCED' : 'ORO IMPERIAL • AVANZADO' };
    case 'silver':
      return { main: '#C77DFF', bevel: '#F3E8FF', dark: '#4C1D95', glow: 'rgba(199,125,255,0.34)', core: '#E0AAFF', wing: '#7E22CE', text: isLight ? '#6D28D9' : '#D8B4FE', label: isEn ? 'PURPLE SILVER • INTERMEDIATE' : 'PLATA PÚRPURA • INTERMEDIO' };
    default:
      return { main: '#00F0FF', bevel: '#CFFAFE', dark: '#0E4E5E', glow: 'rgba(0,240,255,0.3)', core: '#B8FFFF', wing: '#00838F', text: isLight ? '#006B82' : '#00F0FF', label: isEn ? 'CYAN BRONZE • EASY' : 'BRONCE CIAN • FÁCIL' };
  }
};

export interface ITrophyExtrusionLayer {
  index: number;
  z: number;
  offsetX: number;
  depthOrder: number;
  tone: 'dark' | 'bevel' | 'main';
}

export interface ITrophyVolumetricProjection {
  thetaDeg: number; cosTheta: number; sinTheta: number; absCos: number; absSin: number;
  activeFace: 'front' | 'back'; depthPx: number; spineWidthPx: number; faceScaleX: number;
  projectedWidthPx: number; specularOffsetPx: number; isBackEngravingReadable: boolean;
  isMirroredText: boolean; layers: ITrophyExtrusionLayer[];
}

const EXTRUSION_Z_STEPS = [-1, -0.75, -0.5, -0.25, 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] as const;

export function normalizeAngle360(angleDeg: number): number {
  const safe = Number.isFinite(Number(angleDeg)) ? Number(angleDeg) : 0;
  const mod = ((safe % 360) + 360) % 360;
  return mod === 0 ? 0 : mod;
}

export function computeTrophyVolumetricProjection(angleDeg: number, size: number = 140): ITrophyVolumetricProjection {
  const safeSize = Math.max(24, Number.isFinite(Number(size)) && Number(size) > 0 ? Number(size) : 140);
  const thetaDeg = normalizeAngle360(angleDeg);
  const rad = (thetaDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const rawCos = Math.cos(rad);
  const rawSin = Math.sin(rad);
  const cosTheta = Math.abs(rawCos) < 1e-9 ? 0 : rawCos;
  const sinTheta = Math.abs(rawSin) < 1e-9 ? 0 : rawSin;
  const absCos = Math.abs(cosTheta);
  const absSin = Math.abs(sinTheta);
  const activeFace: 'front' | 'back' = cosTheta >= 0 ? 'front' : 'back';
  const depthPx = safeSize * 0.24;
  const spineWidthPx = Math.max(safeSize * 0.22, absSin * depthPx);
  const faceScaleX = Math.max(0.22, absCos);
  const projectedWidthPx = Math.max(safeSize * 0.22, absCos * safeSize * 0.78 + absSin * depthPx);
  const specularOffsetPx = sinTheta * safeSize * 0.2;
  const zSign = cosTheta >= 0 ? 1 : -1;

  const layers: ITrophyExtrusionLayer[] = EXTRUSION_Z_STEPS.map((z, index) => {
    const tone: 'dark' | 'bevel' | 'main' = z * zSign < -0.35 ? 'dark' : z * zSign > 0.35 ? 'bevel' : 'main';
    return { index, z, offsetX: -sinTheta * (depthPx * 0.5) * z, depthOrder: z * zSign, tone };
  }).sort((a, b) => a.depthOrder - b.depthOrder);

  return {
    thetaDeg, cosTheta, sinTheta, absCos, absSin, activeFace,
    depthPx, spineWidthPx, faceScaleX, projectedWidthPx, specularOffsetPx,
    isBackEngravingReadable: activeFace === 'back',
    isMirroredText: false,
    layers,
  };
}

export const KineticVolumetricTrophy360 = memo(({
  angleDeg = 0, pitchDeg = -13, tier = 'bronze', size = 144, unlocked = true, category,
}: {
  angleDeg?: number; pitchDeg?: number; tier?: TrophyTierType | string; size?: number; unlocked?: boolean; category?: string;
}) => {
  const { isLightMode, language } = useKineticPreferences();
  const normalizedTier = resolveTrophyTier(tier);
  const p = useMemo(() => getTierPalette(normalizedTier, unlocked, isLightMode, language === 'en'), [normalizedTier, unlocked, isLightMode, language]);
  const geom = useMemo(() => computeTrophyRevolutionGeometry(angleDeg, size), [angleDeg, size]);
  const cat = String(category || '').toLowerCase();
  const gradKey = `vol_${normalizedTier}_${unlocked ? 'u' : 'l'}_${isLightMode ? 'lt' : 'dk'}`;

  const meshData = useMemo(
    () =>
      buildVolumetricChaliceManifold({
        yawDeg: angleDeg,
        pitchDeg,
        tierMain: p.main,
        tierBevel: p.bevel,
        tierDark: p.dark,
        tierWing: p.wing,
        unlocked,
        size,
      }),
    [angleDeg, pitchDeg, p, unlocked, size]
  );

  return (
    <View style={{ width: size, height: size, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
      <Svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 120 120">
        <Defs>
          <RadialGradient id={`cg_${gradKey}`} cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <Stop offset="0%" stopColor="#FFFFFF" stopOpacity={unlocked ? 0.92 : 0.45} />
            <Stop offset="60%" stopColor={p.main} stopOpacity={unlocked ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
            <Stop offset="100%" stopColor={p.dark} stopOpacity={0} />
          </RadialGradient>
        </Defs>

        <Ellipse cx="60" cy="112" rx={geom.baseRx * 1.38} ry={geom.baseRy * 1.02} fill={isLightMode ? 'rgba(15,23,42,0.12)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.48)'} />
        <Ellipse cx="60" cy="110" rx={geom.baseRx * 1.08} ry={geom.baseRy * 0.75} fill={p.glow} />
        <Ellipse cx="60" cy="110" rx={meshData.pedestalRingRx} ry={meshData.pedestalRingRy} fill="none" stroke={p.main} strokeOpacity={unlocked ? 0.55 : 0.22} strokeWidth={1.1} />

        {meshData.polys.map((poly, i) => (
          <Polygon key={i} points={poly.points} fill={poly.fill} stroke={poly.fill} strokeWidth={0.55} strokeLinejoin="round" />
        ))}

        {unlocked && (
          <G transform={`translate(${(meshData.frontScreen.x - 60) * 0.25}, 0) scale(${Math.max(0.28, geom.absCos).toFixed(3)}, 1)`}>
            <Polygon
              points={normalizedTier === 'diamond' || normalizedTier === 'pro' ? '0,14 5,25 14,21 9,32 -9,32 -14,21 -5,25' : '0,19 7,31 -7,31'}
              transform="translate(60, 0)"
              fill={p.bevel} stroke={p.main} strokeWidth={0.8}
            />
          </G>
        )}

        {geom.isFrontVisible && meshData.frontScreen.z > 4 && (
          <G transform={`translate(${meshData.frontScreen.x.toFixed(1)}, ${meshData.frontScreen.y.toFixed(1)}) scale(${geom.frontScaleX.toFixed(3)}, 1) translate(-60, -56)`}>
            {unlocked ? (
              <G>
                <Circle cx="60" cy="56" r="10.2" fill={p.dark} stroke={p.bevel} strokeWidth={1.3} />
                {cat.includes('club') ? (
                  <Path d="M60 48 C56.5 48, 54 50.6, 54 54 C54 58.2, 60 63, 60 63 C60 63, 66 58.2, 66 54 C66 50.6, 63.5 48, 60 48 Z" fill={p.main} stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth={0.6} />
                ) : cat.includes('expert') || cat.includes('disc') ? (
                  <Polygon points="60,48 62.4,53 68,53.6 63.8,57.2 65,62.6 60,59.6 55,62.6 56.2,57.2 52,53.6 57.6,53" fill={p.main} stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth={0.6} />
                ) : (
                  <Path d="M63 49 L54 59 H61 L58 65 L67 55 H60 Z" fill={p.main} stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth={0.8} />
                )}
              </G>
            ) : (
              <G>
                <Circle cx="60" cy="56" r="10.2" fill={isLightMode ? '#F1F5F9' : '#1E293B'} stroke={p.bevel} strokeWidth={1.3} />
                <Path d="M57 53 V50 C57 48.3, 58.3 47, 60 47 C61.7 47, 63 48.3, 63 50 V53 M55 53 H65 V61 H55 Z" fill={p.text} />
              </G>
            )}
          </G>
        )}
      </Svg>

      {geom.isBackVisible && meshData.backScreen.z > 4 && (
        <View
          pointerEvents="none"
          style={[
            vs.backSealOverlay,
            {
              top: (meshData.backScreen.y / 120) * size - 14,
              borderColor: p.main,
              transform: [{ translateX: (meshData.backScreen.x - 60) * (size / 120) * 0.45 }, { scaleX: geom.backScaleX }],
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Text selectable={false} style={[vs.backSealBrand, { color: p.bevel }]}>⚡ KINETIC</Text>
          <Text selectable={false} style={[vs.backSealSub, { color: p.main }]}>{language === 'en' ? 'TROPHY' : 'TROFEO'}</Text>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
});
