    // === src/components/kineticlub/myPersonalWallHelpers.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import React from 'react';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {
  LEGACY_WALL_POSTS_KEYS,
  REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY,
  formatPostRelativeTime,
} from '../../services/kineticlubFeedAndSquadHelpers';
import { stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost } from '../../services/kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
import { getBlockedUserIdsSet } from '../../services/kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import { FEED_SAVED_KEY, WALL_COLS_FULL, WALL_COLS_LEGACY } from '../../services/kineticlubWallCloudService';
import { resolvePeerUuidForThread, syncDirectMessagesFromCloud } from '../../services/kineticDirectMessagesBridge';
import { myWallStyles as ms } from '../../styles/kineticlubHybridWall.styles';
import { SmartImage } from '../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL: any = { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' };

export interface IPersonalWallCacheEntry {
  myPosts: any[];
  savedPosts: any[];
  alliesList: Array<{ id: string; name: string; avatar?: string | null }>;
}

const _personalWallCache = new Map<string, IPersonalWallCacheEntry>();

export const getCachedPersonalWallData = (userId?: string | null): IPersonalWallCacheEntry | null => {
  const key = String(userId || 'anon').trim().toLowerCase();
  return _personalWallCache.get(key) || null;
};

export const setCachedPersonalWallData = (
  userId: string | null | undefined,
  patch: Partial<IPersonalWallCacheEntry>
): void => {
  const key = String(userId || 'anon').trim().toLowerCase();
  const prev = _personalWallCache.get(key) || { myPosts: [], savedPosts: [], alliesList: [] };
  _personalWallCache.set(key, {
    myPosts: patch.myPosts ?? prev.myPosts,
    savedPosts: patch.savedPosts ?? prev.savedPosts,
    alliesList: patch.alliesList ?? prev.alliesList,
  });
};

export async function fetchPersonalWallSnapshot(
  userId: string | undefined,
  profileName: string | undefined,
  tx: (es: string, en: string) => string
): Promise<IPersonalWallCacheEntry | null> {
  try {
    const myId = String(userId || '').trim();
    const normalizeRow = (row: any) => ({
      id: String(row.id),
      isMine: Boolean(myId && String(row.usuario_id || '') === myId),
      userId: row.usuario_id,
      authorName: row.autor_nombre || profileName || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'),
      discipline: row.disciplina || 'Fuerza',
      venue: row.sede || 'Red Kinetic',
      bodyEs: stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost(row.contenido || ''),
      bodyEn: stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost(row.contenido || ''),
      mediaUris: Array.isArray(row.galeria) && row.galeria.length > 0 ? row.galeria : row.imagen_url ? [row.imagen_url] : [],
      guardados_json: Array.isArray(row.guardados_json) ? row.guardados_json.map(String) : [],
      created_at: row.created_at,
      createdAtMs: row.created_at ? new Date(row.created_at).getTime() : Date.now(),
    });
    const fetchOwnCloud = async () => {
      if (!myId) return { data: [], error: null };
      const r1 = await supabase.from('comunidad_posts').select(WALL_COLS_FULL).eq('usuario_id', myId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(60);
      if (!r1.error) return r1;
      return supabase.from('comunidad_posts').select(WALL_COLS_LEGACY).eq('usuario_id', myId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(60);
    };
    const fetchRecentForSaved = async () => {
      const r1 = await supabase.from('comunidad_posts').select(WALL_COLS_FULL).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(60);
      if (!r1.error) return r1;
      return supabase.from('comunidad_posts').select(WALL_COLS_LEGACY).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(60);
    };
    const [rawArr, rawSavedMap, ownCloudRes, recentCloudRes, dmThreads] = await Promise.all([
      Promise.all([REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY, ...LEGACY_WALL_POSTS_KEYS].map((k) => AsyncStorage.getItem(k))),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(FEED_SAVED_KEY),
      fetchOwnCloud(),
      fetchRecentForSaved(),
      myId ? syncDirectMessagesFromCloud(myId, profileName).catch(() => []) : Promise.resolve([]),
    ]);
    const alliesMap = new Map<string, { id: string; name: string; avatar?: string | null }>();
    (dmThreads || []).forEach((dm: any) => {
      if (dm?.status !== 'accepted') return;
      const pId = resolvePeerUuidForThread(dm, myId);
      const iAmReq = String(dm?.requesterId || '').trim().toLowerCase() === myId.toLowerCase();
      const name = String(iAmReq ? dm?.targetName : dm?.requesterName || '').trim();
      const avatar = iAmReq ? dm?.targetAvatar : dm?.requesterAvatar;
      const key = (pId || name).toLowerCase();
      if (key && name && key !== myId.toLowerCase()) alliesMap.set(key, { id: pId || key, name, avatar });
    });
    let savedLocalMap: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    try { if (rawSavedMap) savedLocalMap = JSON.parse(rawSavedMap) || {}; } catch {}
    const blockedSet = getBlockedUserIdsSet();
    const ownDedup = new Map<string, any>();
    const savedDedup = new Map<string, any>();
    if (!ownCloudRes.error && Array.isArray(ownCloudRes.data)) {
      ownCloudRes.data.forEach((row: any) => {
        if (!row?.id || (myId && String(row.usuario_id || '').trim() !== myId)) return;
        const norm = normalizeRow(row);
        ownDedup.set(norm.id, norm);
      });
    }
    if (!recentCloudRes.error && Array.isArray(recentCloudRes.data)) {
      recentCloudRes.data.forEach((row: any) => {
        if (!row?.id) return;
        const norm = normalizeRow(row);
        const rowUidLow = String(norm.userId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const isSavedCloud = Boolean(myId && norm.guardados_json.includes(myId));
        if ((isSavedCloud || savedLocalMap[norm.id]) && !(rowUidLow && blockedSet.has(rowUidLow))) savedDedup.set(norm.id, norm);
      });
    }
    rawArr.forEach((rawStr) => {
      if (!rawStr) return;
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawStr);
        if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return;
        parsed.forEach((p: any) => {
          if (!p?.id) return;
          const pid = String(p.id);
          const pUid = String(p.authorId || p.userId || p.usuario_id || '').trim();
          const pUidLow = pUid.toLowerCase();
          const idMatch = myId ? pUid === myId : Boolean(p.isMine);
          const sanitized = { ...p, bodyEs: stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost(p.bodyEs ?? p.contenido ?? ''), bodyEn: stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost(p.bodyEn ?? p.bodyEs ?? p.contenido ?? '') };
          if (idMatch && !ownDedup.has(pid)) ownDedup.set(pid, sanitized);
          if (savedLocalMap[pid] && !(pUidLow && blockedSet.has(pUidLow)) && !savedDedup.has(pid)) savedDedup.set(pid, sanitized);
        });
      } catch {}
    });
    const tsOf = (x: any) => Number(x.createdAtMs || Date.parse(String(x.created_at || '')) || 0);
    const sortByDate = (arr: any[]) => arr.sort((a, b) => tsOf(b) - tsOf(a));
    const result: IPersonalWallCacheEntry = {
      alliesList: Array.from(alliesMap.values()),
      myPosts: sortByDate(Array.from(ownDedup.values())),
      savedPosts: sortByDate(Array.from(savedDedup.values())),
    };
    setCachedPersonalWallData(myId, result);
    return result;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export const SelectedGridPostDetailSheet: React.FC<{
  post: any;
  user: any;
  profile: any;
  isLightMode: boolean;
  isEn: boolean;
  bottomInset: number;
  confirmDeleteId: string | null;
  setConfirmDeleteId: (id: string | null) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenLightbox: (payload: { images: string[]; index: number; caption?: string }) => void;
  onConfirmDeletePost: (id: string) => void;
  tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
}> = ({
  post,
  user,
  profile,
  isLightMode,
  isEn,
  bottomInset,
  confirmDeleteId,
  setConfirmDeleteId,
  onClose,
  onOpenLightbox,
  onConfirmDeletePost,
  tx,
}) => {
  if (!post) return null;
  const ink = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const delInk = isLightMode ? '#B91C1C' : '#FF3B5C';
  const photos: string[] = Array.isArray(post.mediaUris) && post.mediaUris.length ? post.mediaUris : post.mediaUri ? [post.mediaUri] : [];
  const bodyTxt = String(isEn ? post.bodyEn || post.bodyEs : post.bodyEs || post.bodyEn || '').trim();
  const canDel = Boolean(post.isMine || (user?.id && String(post.userId || '') === String(user.id)));

  return (
    <View style={[ms.detailOverlay, { backgroundColor: 'transparent' }]}>
      <Pressable
        style={[
          StyleSheet.absoluteFill,
          { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45)' : 'rgba(5, 7, 12, 0.78)' },
        ]}
        onPress={onClose}
      />
      <View
        style={[
          ms.detailSheet,
          { paddingBottom: Math.max(bottomInset + 14, 20) },
          isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={ms.topBarRow}>
          <Text style={[ms.topTitle, { color: ink }]} numberOfLines={1}>
            {`${post.authorName || profile?.nombre || 'Kinetic'} • ${formatPostRelativeTime(post.created_at || post.createdAtMs, isEn)}`}
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={onClose} style={NO_SEL}>
            <Feather name="x" size={19} color={ink} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
        {photos.length > 0 && (
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.92}
            style={[ms.detailMedia, NO_SEL]}
            onPress={() => onOpenLightbox({ images: photos, index: 0, caption: bodyTxt })}
          >
            <SmartImage uri={photos[0]} fallbackCategory={post.discipline} style={ms.fullImg} />
            <View style={ms.expandHintPill} {...({ dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } as any)}>
              <Text selectable={false} style={ms.expandHintTxt}>
                {tx('⤢ Pantalla completa', '⤢ Fullscreen')}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
        {Boolean(bodyTxt) && <Text style={[ms.detailBody, { color: ink }]}>{bodyTxt}</Text>}
        {canDel &&
          (confirmDeleteId === post.id ? (
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[ms.secActionBtn, { flex: 1 }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}
                onPress={() => setConfirmDeleteId(null)}
              >
                <Text selectable={false} style={[ms.secActionTxt, { color: ink }]}>
                  {tx('Cancelar', 'Cancel')}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.confirmDelBtn, { flex: 1 }]} onPress={() => onConfirmDeletePost(post.id)}>
                <Feather name="trash-2" size={13} color="#FFFFFF" />
                <Text selectable={false} style={ms.confirmDelTxt}>
                  {tx('Confirmar eliminar', 'Confirm delete')}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[
                ms.delRowBtn,
                isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FEF2F2', borderColor: '#FECACA' },
                NO_SEL,
              ]}
              onPress={() => setConfirmDeleteId(post.id)}
            >
              <Feather name="trash-2" size={14} color={delInk} />
              <Text selectable={false} style={[ms.delRowTxt, { color: delInk }]}>
                {tx('Eliminar publicación', 'Delete post')}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;
const DARK_INK_PROPS: any = { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };
const VIP_LEVEL_HINTS = ['gold', 'oro', 'platin', 'black', 'leyenda', 'elite', 'élite', 'vip'];

export interface MyPersonalWallModalProps {
  visible: boolean; onClose: () => void; user: any; profile: any;
  prestigeInfo?: any; userStats?: any; rachaActual?: number;
}

export const MyPersonalWallModal: React.FC<MyPersonalWallModalProps> = ({
  visible, onClose, user, profile, prestigeInfo,
}) => {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const { refreshProfile } = useAuth();
  const { isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const isEn = language === 'en';

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'posts' | 'saved'>('posts');
  const [myPosts, setMyPosts] = useState<any[]>(() => {
    const cached = getCachedPersonalWallData(user?.id);
    if (cached?.myPosts?.length) return cached.myPosts;
    const uid = String(user?.id || '').trim();
    const mem = getMemoryWallSnapshot()?.posts || [];
    return uid ? mem.filter((p: any) => String(p?.userId || p?.authorId || '') === uid || Boolean(p?.isMine)) : [];
  });
  const [savedPosts, setSavedPosts] = useState<any[]>(() => getCachedPersonalWallData(user?.id)?.savedPosts || []);
  const [alliesList, setAlliesList] = useState<Array<{ id: string; name: string; avatar?: string | null }>>(
    () => getCachedPersonalWallData(user?.id)?.alliesList || []
  );
  const [showAlliesDrawer, setShowAlliesDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [shareToast, setShareToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedGridPost, setSelectedGridPost] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [confirmDeleteId, setConfirmDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [composerSignal, setComposerSignal] = useState(0);
  const [isEditingProfile, setIsEditingProfile] = useState(false);
  const [editNameDraft, setEditNameDraft] = useState('');
  const [isSavingProfile, setIsSavingProfile] = useState(false);
  const [isMyStoryOpen, setIsMyStoryOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lightboxState, setLightboxState] = useState<{ images: string[]; index: number; caption?: string } | null>(null);
  const deletingPostRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const toastTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => () => { if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current); }, []);

  const loadPostsAndSaved = useCallback(async () => {
    const snap = await fetchPersonalWallSnapshot(user?.id, profile?.nombre, tx);
    if (!snap) return;
    setAlliesList(snap.alliesList);
    setMyPosts(snap.myPosts);
    setSavedPosts(snap.savedPosts);
  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre, tx]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) {
      setConfirmDeleteId(null);
      setSelectedGridPost(null);
      setIsEditingProfile(false);
      setShowAlliesDrawer(false);
      setShareToast(null);
      return;
    }
    const cached = getCachedPersonalWallData(user?.id);
    if (cached) {
      if (cached.myPosts?.length) setMyPosts(cached.myPosts);
      if (cached.savedPosts?.length) setSavedPosts(cached.savedPosts);
      if (cached.alliesList?.length) setAlliesList(cached.alliesList);
    } else {
      const uid = String(user?.id || '').trim();
      const mem = getMemoryWallSnapshot()?.posts || [];
      if (uid && mem.length > 0) {
        const mineMem = mem.filter((p: any) => String(p?.userId || p?.authorId || '') === uid || Boolean(p?.isMine));
        if (mineMem.length > 0) setMyPosts(mineMem);
      }
    }
    setEditNameDraft(String(profile?.nombre || '').trim());
    loadPostsAndSaved();
    const unsub = subscribeCommunityWallUpdated(loadPostsAndSaved);
    return () => unsub();
  }, [visible, user?.id, profile?.nombre, loadPostsAndSaved]);

  const handlePublishNewPost = useCallback(
    async (cleanText: string, mediaUris: string[], meta?: IComposerPostMeta) => {
      if (!cleanText && mediaUris.length === 0) return;
      triggerHaptic('Success');
      const created = await publishCommunityWallPostEverywhere({
        user, profile, cleanText, mediaUris,
        fallbackAuthorLabel: tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'),
        discipline: meta?.discipline, venue: meta?.venue, sedeId: meta?.sedeId, zona: meta?.zona,
      });
      setMyPosts((prev) => [created, ...prev.filter((p) => String(p.id) !== String(created.id))]);
    },
    [user, profile, tx]
  );

  const handleSaveQuickProfile = useCallback(async () => {
    const cleanName = editNameDraft.trim();
    if (!cleanName || !user?.id || isSavingProfile) return;
    if (!isMasterAdmin(user, profile) && /\b(kinetic\s*oficial|kinetic\s*official|kineticapp|terminal\s*global|master\s*admin)\b/i.test(cleanName)) {
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      return;
    }
    setIsSavingProfile(true);
    try {
      triggerHaptic('Success');
      await supabase.from('perfiles').update({ nombre: cleanName }).eq('id', user.id);
      await refreshProfile?.();
      setIsEditingProfile(false);
    } finally {
      setIsSavingProfile(false);
    }
  }, [editNameDraft, user, profile, isSavingProfile, refreshProfile]);

  const handleShareProfile = useCallback(async () => {
    triggerHaptic('Selection');
    const nm = profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
    const rk = formatOfficialOrTierLabel(String(profile?.nivel || 'Acceso Base'), language);
    try {
      await Share.share({ message: sanitizeOfficialKineticShareText(`⚡ ${nm} • ${rk} en KinetiClub`) });
      setShareToast(tx('✓ Tarjeta de perfil lista para compartir', '✓ Profile card ready to share'));
      if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
      toastTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setShareToast(null), 2600);
    } catch {}
  }, [profile?.nombre, profile?.nivel, language, tx]);

  const handleConfirmDeletePost = useCallback(
    async (postId: string) => {
      const pid = String(postId || '');
      if (!pid || deletingPostRef.current.has(pid)) return;
      deletingPostRef.current.add(pid);
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      setConfirmDeleteId(null);
      setSelectedGridPost(null);
      setMyPosts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => String(p.id) !== pid));
      setSavedPosts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => String(p.id) !== pid));
      try { await deleteCommunityWallPostEverywhere(pid, user?.id); }
      finally { deletingPostRef.current.delete(pid); }
    },
    [user?.id]
  );

  const gridItems = useMemo(() => (activeTab === 'posts' ? myPosts : savedPosts), [activeTab, myPosts, savedPosts]);
  if (!visible) return null;

  const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;
  const ink = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const muted = isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8';
  const rawLevel = String(profile?.nivel || 'Acceso Base');
  const userRank = formatOfficialOrTierLabel(rawLevel, language);
  const isVip = VIP_LEVEL_HINTS.some((h) => rawLevel.toLowerCase().includes(h));
  const totalXp = Number(prestigeInfo?.totalXp ?? profile?.xp_total ?? 0);

  const myHasActiveStory = visible ? hasActiveStoriesForOwner(user?.id, profile?.nombre) : false;
  const resolvedAvatarUrl = profile?.avatar_url ? getAvatarUrl(String(profile.avatar_url), 180) : '';

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="slide" onRequestClose={onClose} statusBarTranslucent>
      <View style={[ms.backdrop, { paddingTop: Math.max(insets.top + 6, 36), backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : '#05070C' }]}>
        <View style={[ms.headerCard, isLightMode && { borderBottomColor: '#E2E8F0', backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF' }]}>
          <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={onClose} />
          <View style={ms.topBarRow}>
            <Text style={[ms.topTitle, { color: ink }]}>{tx('MI PERFIL DEPORTIVO', 'MY ATHLETE PROFILE')}</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={ms.profileHeaderRow}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              activeOpacity={0.85}
              disabled={!resolvedAvatarUrl && !myHasActiveStory}
              style={[
                ms.avatarBox,
                { borderColor: myHasActiveStory ? COLORS.cyan : cyanInk, borderWidth: myHasActiveStory ? 2.4 : 1.5 },
                NO_SEL,
                isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderBottomColor: '#00838F' },
              ]}
              onPress={() => {
                if (myHasActiveStory) {
                  triggerHaptic('Selection');
                  setIsMyStoryOpen(true);
                } else if (resolvedAvatarUrl) {
                  triggerHaptic('Selection');
                  setLightboxState({ images: [String(profile.avatar_url || resolvedAvatarUrl)], index: 0, caption: profile?.nombre || '' });
                }
              }}
            >
              {resolvedAvatarUrl ? (
                <Image source={{ uri: resolvedAvatarUrl }} style={ms.fullImg} contentFit="cover" cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} />
              ) : (
                <Feather name="user" size={26} color={cyanInk} />
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <View style={ms.kpiCountersRow}>
              <View style={ms.kpiCol}>
                <Text style={[ms.kpiVal, { color: ink }]}>{myPosts.length}</Text>
                <Text style={[ms.kpiLbl, { color: muted }]}>
                  {myPosts.length === 1 ? tx('Publicación', 'Post') : tx('Publicaciones', 'Posts')}
                </Text>
              </View>
              <View style={ms.kpiCol}>
                <Text style={[ms.kpiVal, { color: cyanInk }]}>{totalXp}</Text>
                <Text style={[ms.kpiLbl, { color: muted }]}>XP</Text>
              </View>
              <TouchableOpacity
                activeOpacity={0.8}
                onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setIsEditingProfile(false); setShowAlliesDrawer((v) => !v); }}
                style={[ms.kpiCol, NO_SEL]}
              >
                <Text style={[ms.kpiVal, { color: isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#E0AAFF' }]}>{alliesList.length}</Text>
                <Text style={[ms.kpiLbl, { color: isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#E0AAFF', fontWeight: '900' }]}>
                  {`${alliesList.length === 1 ? tx('Aliado', 'Ally') : tx('Aliados', 'Allies')} ${showAlliesDrawer ? '▴' : '▾'}`}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={{ marginTop: 8, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            <Text style={[ms.userName, { color: ink }]} numberOfLines={1}>{profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')}</Text>
            {isVip && <View style={ms.vipPill}><Text selectable={false} style={ms.vipPillTxt}>★ VIP</Text></View>}
            <Text style={[ms.userRank, { color: cyanInk }]} numberOfLines={1}>{`• ⚡ ${userRank}`}</Text>
          </View>

          {showAlliesDrawer && (
            <View style={{ marginTop: 8, padding: 9, borderRadius: 11, backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : '#0B101B', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: isLightMode ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(192,132,252,0.35)' }}>
              {alliesList.length === 0 ? (
                <Text style={{ color: muted, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: '700' }}>
                  {tx('Aún no tienes aliados activos. Conecta en Equipos o Mensajes.', 'No active allies yet. Connect in Teams or Messages.')}
                </Text>
              ) : (
                <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 8 }}>
                  {alliesList.map((al) => (
                    <View key={al.id} style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, paddingHorizontal: 9, paddingVertical: 5, borderRadius: 9, backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#FFFFFF' : '#111827', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: isLightMode ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)' }}>
                      <Feather name="user-check" size={12} color={cyanInk} />
                      <Text style={{ color: ink, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: '800' }} numberOfLines={1}>{al.name}</Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </ScrollView>
              )}
            </View>
          )}

          {isEditingProfile && (
            <View style={ms.editInlineRow}>
              <TextInput
                value={editNameDraft} onChangeText={setEditNameDraft} autoFocus={false}
                placeholder={tx('Tu nombre de atleta', 'Your athlete name')} placeholderTextColor={muted}
                style={[ms.editInput, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', color: '#0F172A' }]}
              />
              <TouchableOpacity {...DARK_INK_PROPS} style={[ms.saveProfileBtn, NO_SEL]} disabled={isSavingProfile} onPress={handleSaveQuickProfile}>
                <Text selectable={false} style={ms.saveProfileTxt}>{tx('Guardar', 'Save')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          )}

          {Boolean(shareToast) && (
            <View style={{ marginTop: 7, paddingVertical: 6, paddingHorizontal: 10, borderRadius: 9, backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#ECFEFF' : 'rgba(0,240,255,0.12)', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: cyanInk, elevation: 0 }}>
              <Text style={{ color: cyanInk, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '900', textAlign: 'center' }}>{shareToast}</Text>
            </View>
          )}

          <View style={ms.profileActionRow}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[ms.secActionBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}
              onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setShowAlliesDrawer(false); setIsEditingProfile((v) => !v); }}
            >
              <Feather name="edit-2" size={12} color={ink} />
              <Text selectable={false} style={[ms.secActionTxt, { color: ink }]}>{tx('Editar Perfil', 'Edit Profile')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.secActionBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]} onPress={handleShareProfile}>
              <Feather name="share-2" size={12} color={ink} />
              <Text selectable={false} style={[ms.secActionTxt, { color: ink }]}>{tx('Compartir Perfil', 'Share Profile')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity
              {...DARK_INK_PROPS} style={[ms.plusPostBtn, NO_SEL]}
              onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); setIsEditingProfile(false); setShowAlliesDrawer(false); setActiveTab('posts'); setComposerSignal((v) => v + 1); }}
            >
              <Text selectable={false} style={ms.plusPostTxt}>{tx('+ Publicar', '+ Post')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <View style={[ms.tabsRow, isLightMode && { borderTopColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>
            <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.tabBtn, activeTab === 'posts' && { borderBottomColor: cyanInk, borderBottomWidth: 2.4 }, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setActiveTab('posts'); }}>
              <Text selectable={false} style={[ms.tabTxt, { color: activeTab === 'posts' ? cyanInk : muted }]}>{tx('▦ Publicaciones', '▦ Posts')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity style={[ms.tabBtn, activeTab === 'saved' && { borderBottomColor: cyanInk, borderBottomWidth: 2.4 }, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setActiveTab('saved'); }}>
              <Text selectable={false} style={[ms.tabTxt, { color: activeTab === 'saved' ? cyanInk : muted }]}>{tx('🔖 Guardados', '🔖 Saved')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>

        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: insets.bottom + 36 }} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
          <View style={{ padding: 12 }}>
            <KinetiClubPostComposer onPublish={handlePublishNewPost} userAvatarUrl={profile?.avatar_url} forceExpandedSignal={composerSignal} />
          </View>
          {gridItems.length === 0 ? (
            <View style={[ms.emptyBox, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]}>
              <Feather name={activeTab === 'posts' ? 'grid' : 'bookmark'} size={30} color={cyanInk} />
              <Text style={[ms.emptyTitle, { color: ink }]}>{activeTab === 'posts' ? tx('Sin publicaciones aún', 'No posts yet') : tx('Sin guardados aún', 'No saved posts yet')}</Text>
              <Text style={[ms.emptyDesc, { color: muted }]}>
                {activeTab === 'posts' ? tx('Publica tu primer entrenamiento o foto arriba para estrenar tu cuadrícula 3x3.', 'Share your first workout or photo above to start your 3x3 grid.') : tx('Toca el ícono 🔖 en cualquier publicación del Muro para guardarla de forma privada.', 'Tap 🔖 on any Social Wall post to save it privately here.')}
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={ms.grid3x3}>
              {gridItems.map((post) => {
                const photos: string[] = Array.isArray(post.mediaUris) && post.mediaUris.length ? post.mediaUris : post.mediaUri ? [post.mediaUri] : [];
                const bodyTxt = String(isEn ? post.bodyEn || post.bodyEs : post.bodyEs || post.bodyEn || '').trim();
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={`${activeTab}_${post.id}`} activeOpacity={0.88}
                    style={[ms.gridCell, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}
                    onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setConfirmDeleteId(null); setSelectedGridPost(post); }}
                  >
                    {photos.length > 0 ? (
                      <SmartImage uri={photos[0]} fallbackCategory={post.discipline} style={ms.fullImg} />
                    ) : (
                      <View style={[ms.textCell, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF' }]}>
                        <Text style={[ms.textCellBody, { color: ink }]} numberOfLines={4}>{bodyTxt || '⚡ Kinetic'}</Text>
                      </View>
                    )}
                    {photos.length > 1 && <View style={ms.multiLayerBadge} pointerEvents="none"><Feather name="layers" size={12} color="#FFFFFF" /></View>}
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>

        <SelectedGridPostDetailSheet
          post={selectedGridPost}
          user={user}
          profile={profile}
          isLightMode={isLightMode}
          isEn={isEn}
          bottomInset={insets.bottom}
          confirmDeleteId={confirmDeleteId}
          setConfirmDeleteId={setConfirmDeleteId}
          onClose={() => setSelectedGridPost(null)}
          onOpenLightbox={setLightboxState}
          onConfirmDeletePost={handleConfirmDeletePost}
          tx={tx}
        />

        <KineticStoriesModal
          visible={isMyStoryOpen}
          inlineOverlay={true}
          onClose={() => setIsMyStoryOpen(false)}
          owner={{
            id: user?.id || 'me',
            type: 'athlete',
            name: profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'),
            subtitle: userRank,
            avatarUrl: resolvedAvatarUrl || profile?.avatar_url || null,
            canUpload: true,
          }}
        />

        <KineticFullscreenLightboxModal
          inlineOverlay={true}
          visible={Boolean(lightboxState)} images={lightboxState?.images || []}
          initialIndex={lightboxState?.index || 0} caption={lightboxState?.caption}
          onClose={() => setLightboxState(null)}
        />
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
};

    // === src/components/kineticlub/RpgModal.tsx === //
import { Feather, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import ReactNativeModal from 'react-native-modal';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { PRESTIGE_GRADES_META, formatOfficialOrTierLabel, formatStreakDaysBadge, getLevelTitleIn99Ladder } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { COLORS, globalStyles } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { GpuProgressBar, KineticLoader, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { ShareRpgDossierButton } from '../shared/KineticDisruptiveWidgets';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from '../shared/KineticModalHeader3D';
import { getLocalizedPrestigeLadder, getLocalizedRpgPillars, getLocalizedSeasonSteps, rpgStyles as baseRpgStyles } from './KinetiClubRpgConstants';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;

const ThemeBar = ({ progress, color, isLightMode, height = 7 }: { progress: number; color: string; isLightMode: boolean; height?: number }) => {
  if (!isLightMode) return <GpuProgressBar progress={progress} color={color} height={height} />;
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(progress) || 0));
  return (
    <View style={{ width: '100%', height, borderRadius: height / 2, backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <View style={{ width: `${clamped}%`, height: '100%', borderRadius: height / 2, backgroundColor: color }} />
    </View>
  );
};

export const RpgModalBody = React.memo(
  ({ onGoToTrain, nivel = 'Acceso Base', rachaDias = 1, userStats, seasonInfo, prestigeInfo, onAscendPrestige }: any) => {
    const { user, profile } = useAuth();
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const rpgStyles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseRpgStyles, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);

    const myReferralCode = useMemo(() => {
      if (profile?.codigo_referido) return String(profile.codigo_referido).trim().toUpperCase();
      return `KNT-${String(user?.id || 'KNT100').replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 6).toUpperCase()}`;
    }, [profile?.codigo_referido, user?.id]);

    const [showPrestigeBreakdown, setShowPrestigeBreakdown] = useState(false);
    const [showSeasonSteps, setShowSeasonSteps] = useState(true);
    const [expandedStepLvl, setExpandedStepLvl] = useState<number | null>(1);
    const [expandedPillarKey, setExpandedPillarKey] = useState<string | null>('fuerza');
    const [isAscending, setIsAscending] = useState(false);

    const pillars = useMemo(() => getLocalizedRpgPillars(language, isLightMode), [language, isLightMode]);
    const ladder = useMemo(() => getLocalizedPrestigeLadder(language), [language]);
    const seasonSteps = useMemo(() => getLocalizedSeasonSteps(language), [language]);

    const ovr = Number(userStats?.ovr || 45);
    const totalXp = Number(prestigeInfo?.totalXp || 0);
    const prestigioNivel = Number(prestigeInfo?.prestigioNivel ?? (profile as any)?.prestigio_nivel ?? 0);
    const prestigeGrade = Number(prestigeInfo?.prestigeGrade || Math.max(1, prestigioNivel));
    const prestigeLvl = Number(prestigeInfo?.prestigeLevel || 1);
    const maxPrestigeLvl = Number(prestigeInfo?.maxPrestigeLevel || 99);
    const canAscendPrestige = Boolean(prestigeInfo?.canAscendPrestige || prestigeLvl >= 99);
    const prestigeRankTitle = getLevelTitleIn99Ladder(prestigeLvl, prestigeGrade, language);
    const xpInCurr = Number(prestigeInfo?.xpInCurrentPrestige || 0);
    const xpPerLvl = Number(prestigeInfo?.xpPerPrestigeLevel || 100);
    const xpRem = Number(prestigeInfo?.xpRemainingForNext || 100);
    const prestigePct = Number(prestigeInfo?.prestigeProgressPct || 0);
    const qrXp = Number(prestigeInfo?.qrXp || 0);
    const streakXp = Number(prestigeInfo?.streakXp || 25);
    const challengesXp = Number(prestigeInfo?.challengesXp || 0);
    const seasonXp = Number(seasonInfo?.seasonXp || 0);
    const maxSeasonXp = Number(seasonInfo?.maxSeasonXp || 2500);
    const seasonPct = Number(seasonInfo?.progressPct || 0);
    const daysLeftInMonth = Number(seasonInfo?.daysLeftInMonth || 7);
    const safeRacha = Math.max(1, Number(rachaDias) || Math.round(streakXp / 25) || 1);
    const displayNivel = formatOfficialOrTierLabel(nivel, language);
    const cyanTxt = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;
    const purpleTxt = isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#D8B4FE';

    const levelHeadline =
      prestigioNivel > 0
        ? tx(`★ PRESTIGIO NIVEL ${prestigioNivel} • NIVEL ${prestigeLvl}/${maxPrestigeLvl}`, `★ PRESTIGE LEVEL ${prestigioNivel} • LEVEL ${prestigeLvl}/${maxPrestigeLvl}`)
        : tx(`★ NIVEL ${prestigeLvl}/${maxPrestigeLvl}`, `★ LEVEL ${prestigeLvl}/${maxPrestigeLvl}`);

    const handleAscendPress = async () => {
      if (!canAscendPrestige || isAscending || !onAscendPrestige) return;
      triggerHaptic('Heavy');
      setIsAscending(true);

                      activeOpacity={0.85}
                      onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setExpandedStepLvl(isExp ? null : st.level); }}
                    >
                      <View style={rpgStyles.rowBetween}>
                        <View style={{ flex: 1, paddingRight: 8 }}>
                          <Text style={[rpgStyles.seasonStepTitle, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }, unlocked && { color: cyanTxt }]}>
                            {unlocked ? '✅ ' : '🔒 '}{st.displayTitle} ({st.requiredXp} XP)
                          </Text>
                          <Text style={[rpgStyles.seasonStepReward, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }]}>{st.displayReward}</Text>
                        </View>
                        <Feather name={isExp ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'} size={15} color={unlocked ? cyanTxt : isLightMode ? '#64748B' : COLORS.textMuted} />
                      </View>
                      {isExp && <Text style={[rpgStyles.seasonStepDesc, isLightMode && { color: '#334155', borderTopColor: '#E2E8F0' }]}>{st.displayDesc}</Text>}
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  );
                })}
              </View>
            )}
          </View>

          <Text style={[rpgStyles.sectionMicroHeader, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }]}>
            {tx('ATRIBUTOS RPG (TOCA CADA BARRA PARA VER DETALLE)', 'RPG ATTRIBUTES (TAP EACH BAR FOR DETAILS)')}
          </Text>
          <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
            {pillars.map((pillar) => {
              const val = Number(userStats?.[pillar.key] || 40);
              const isExp = expandedPillarKey === pillar.key;
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={pillar.key}
                  style={[rpgStyles.rpgPillarCard, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8', shadowOpacity: 0.09 }, isExp && { borderColor: pillar.displayColor }]}
                  activeOpacity={0.88}
                  onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setExpandedPillarKey(isExp ? null : pillar.key); }}
                >
                  <View style={[rpgStyles.rowBetween, { marginBottom: 8 }]}>
                    <Text style={[rpgStyles.rpgPillarTitle, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>{pillar.displayTitle}</Text>
                    <Text style={[rpgStyles.rpgPillarScore, { color: pillar.displayColor }]}>{val}/99 {isExp ? '▲' : '▼'}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <ThemeBar progress={val} color={pillar.displayColor} isLightMode={isLightMode} height={7} />
                  {isExp && <Text style={[rpgStyles.rpgPillarDetail, isLightMode && { color: '#334155' }]}>{pillar.displayDetail}</Text>}
                </TouchableOpacity>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </ScrollView>

        <ShareRpgDossierButton
          athleteName={profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')}
          referralCode={myReferralCode}
          prestigeGradeRoman={prestigioNivel > 0 ? String(prestigioNivel) : '0'}
          prestigeLevel={prestigeLvl}
          prestigeRankTitle={prestigeRankTitle}
          rachaDias={Math.max(1, Number(rachaDias) || Math.round(streakXp / 25) || 1)}
          ovr={ovr}
          fuerza={Number(userStats?.fuerza || 40)}
          cardio={Number(userStats?.cardio || 38)}
          agilidad={Number(userStats?.agilidad || 38)}
          zen={Number(userStats?.zen || 38)}
        />
        <View style={rpgStyles.bottomSplitActions}>
          <TouchableOpacity {...({ dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } } as any)} activeOpacity={0.86} style={[rpgStyles.trainHalfBtn, { flex: 1 }, NO_SEL]} onPress={onGoToTrain}>
            <Text selectable={false} style={rpgStyles.trainHalfText}>{tx('IR A ENTRENAR (+XP) ›', 'GO TRAIN (+XP) ›')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </>
    );
  }
);

export const RpgModal = React.memo((props: any) => {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const { isLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  return (
    <ReactNativeModal
      isVisible={Boolean(props.showRpgModal)}
      onBackdropPress={props.onClose}
      onBackButtonPress={props.onClose}
      propagateSwipe={true}
      animationInTiming={200}
      animationOutTiming={180}
      useNativeDriver={Platform.OS !== 'web'}
      useNativeDriverForBackdrop={Platform.OS !== 'web'}
      backdropColor="#050505"
      backdropOpacity={isLightMode ? 0.5 : 0.92}
      backdropTransitionOutTiming={0}
      backdropTransitionInTiming={0}
      hideModalContentWhileAnimating={false}
      style={{ margin: 0, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}
    >
      <View
        style={[
          globalStyles.bottomSheet,
          KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS,
          { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : '#050505', borderTopColor: isLightMode ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)', paddingBottom: insets.bottom > 0 ? insets.bottom + 18 : 24 },
        ]}
      >
        <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={props.onClose} />
        <RpgModalBody {...props} />
      </View>
    </ReactNativeModal>
  );
});

    // === src/components/kineticlub/squads/SquadsChatSection.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  FlatList, Platform, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View,
} from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import {
  IDirectMessageThread, matchesUserIdentity, normalizeChatIdentity,
} from '../../../services/kineticRealtimeChatBridge';
import { isUserSquadLeader } from '../../../services/kineticlubSquadsService';
import { COLORS } from '../../../styles/globalStyles';
import { IEquipoKinetic, IMensajeEquipo } from '../../../types';
import { SmartImage, triggerHaptic } from '../../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;
const DARK_INK_PROPS: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } } : {};

const MEMBER_AVATAR_IMG_STYLE = { width: '100%' as const, height: '100%' as const, borderRadius: 20 };
const TEAMMATE_AVATAR_IMG_STYLE = { width: '100%' as const, height: '100%' as const, borderRadius: 15 };
const _avatarSourceCache = new Map<string, { uri: string }>();
const getStableAvatarSource = (rawUri: string): { uri: string } => {
  const clean = String(rawUri || '').trim();
  let cached = _avatarSourceCache.get(clean);
  if (!cached) {
    cached = { uri: clean };
    _avatarSourceCache.set(clean, cached);
  }
  return cached;
};

const formatMessageTime = (iso?: string): string => {
  try {
    const d = iso ? new Date(iso) : new Date();
    return `${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
};

export const SquadsChatSection = React.memo(
  ({
    sq, chatScrollRef, myRealId, myRealName, primarySquad, misEquipos: _misEquipos = [], dmThreads: _dmThreads = [],

    onInspectMember, onSendChatMessage, onDeleteSquad, onLeaveSquad, onDeleteDm,

    chatDraft: string; setChatDraft: (val: string) => void;
    isSendingSquadMsg: boolean; isSendingDmLive: boolean; isSquadActionBusy: boolean;
    resolvePartnerForDm: (dm: IDirectMessageThread) => { id: string; name: string; avatar: string | null };
    onAcceptDmAndChat: (dm: IDirectMessageThread) => void;

    onSelectSquadRoom?: (eq: IEquipoKinetic, realMsgsCount: number) => void;

                    <Text style={[sq.msgTimeTxt, isLightMode && { color: '#64748B' }]}>{timeStr}</Text>
                  </View>

        <View style={sq.chatInputBar}>
          <TextInput
            style={[

            ]}
            placeholder={

            }

          <TouchableOpacity

            onPress={onSendChatMessage}
          >
            <Feather name="send" size={16} color="#050505" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
        </>
        )}

        {/* Overlay absoluto inline anti-freeze iOS (cero <Modal> anidado en ReactNativeModal) */}
        {showMembersModal && (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, zIndex: 999, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.72)', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 20, elevation: 0 }}
            activeOpacity={1}

          >
            <View style={[sq.memberSheetCard, { width: '100%', maxWidth: 400 }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#0284C7' }]} onStartShouldSetResponder={() => true}>

                </Text>

                  <Feather name="x" size={18} color={isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF'} />

                style={{ maxHeight: 280 }}
                renderItem={({ item, index }) => (
                  <TouchableOpacity

                  >
                    <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>

  ({

    incomingPendingDms, dmThreads, allRoomMessagesMap, suggestedAthletes, squadMembersSet, pendingSentSet,

    resolvePartnerForDm, onAcceptDmAndChat, onRespondInviteSafe, onConnectByCodeSafe, onCopyCode,

    myRealId, editingSquadId, onRequestCreateNewSquad, onRequestEditSquad, onRequestDeleteSquad, onRequestLeaveSquad, onRequestDeleteDm,
  }: {
    sq: any; hubScrollRef: React.RefObject<ScrollView | null>;
    activeSection: 'hub' | 'invitar' | 'chat'; setActiveSection: (sec: 'hub' | 'invitar' | 'chat') => void;
    primarySquad: any; misEquipos: IEquipoKinetic[]; solicitudesPendientes: IMiembroEquipo[];
    incomingPendingDms: IDirectMessageThread[]; dmThreads: IDirectMessageThread[];
    allRoomMessagesMap: Record<string, IMensajeEquipo[]>; suggestedAthletes: any[];
    squadMembersSet: Set<string>; pendingSentSet: Set<string>;
    isEditingSquadConfig: boolean; setIsEditingSquadConfig: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
    squadNameDraft: string; setSquadNameDraft: (val: string) => void;
    squadDiscDraft: string; setSquadDiscDraft: (val: string) => void;
    joinCodeInput: string; setJoinCodeInput: (val: string) => void;
    isCreatingSquad: boolean; isSquadActionBusy: boolean;
    resolvePartnerForDm: (dm: IDirectMessageThread) => { id: string; name: string; avatar: string | null };
    onAcceptDmAndChat: (dm: IDirectMessageThread) => void;
    onRespondInviteSafe: (id: string, estado: 'activo' | 'rechazado') => void;
    onConnectByCodeSafe: () => void; onCopyCode: (code: string) => void;
    onShareSquadInvite: () => void; onSaveSquadConfig: () => void;
    onOpenSquadRoomChat: (eq: IEquipoKinetic) => void; onOpenDmRoomChat: (dmCode: string) => void;
    onInspectMember: (ath: any) => void; onInviteSuggestedAthlete: (ath: any) => void;
    myRealId?: string; editingSquadId?: string | null;
    onRequestCreateNewSquad?: () => void; onRequestEditSquad?: (eq: IEquipoKinetic) => void;
    onRequestDeleteSquad?: (eq: IEquipoKinetic) => void; onRequestLeaveSquad?: (eq: IEquipoKinetic) => void;
    onRequestDeleteDm?: (dm: IDirectMessageThread) => void;
  }) => {
    const { isLightMode, language, tx, tDisc } = useKineticPreferences();

    const [copiedInline, setCopiedInline] = useState(false);

    const copyTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
    useEffect(() => () => { if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current); }, []);
    useEffect(() => subscribeUgcModerationChanged(() => setUgcTick((n) => n + 1)), []);
    const handleInlineCopy = useCallback((code: string) => {
      triggerHaptic('Success'); onCopyCode(code); setCopiedInline(true);
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
      copyTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setCopiedInline(false), 2200);
    }, [onCopyCode]);

    const cyanText = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;
    const purpleText = isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#E0AAFF';
    const isHubTab = activeSection === 'hub';
    const isInvTab = activeSection === 'invitar';
    const lightInactiveTab = { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' };

    const filteredSuggestedAthletes = useMemo(() => {
      void ugcTick;
      const blockedSet = getBlockedUserIdsSet();
      const q = athleteSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
      const base = (suggestedAthletes || []).filter((ath: any, idx: number) => {
        if (isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete(ath, myRealId, null, null, blockedSet)) return false;
        const cleanLow = String(ath?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const isMem = squadMembersSet.has(cleanLow);
        const isPend = !isMem && pendingSentSet.has(cleanLow);
        if (athleteFilter === 'available' && (isMem || isPend)) return false;
        if (athleteFilter === 'pending' && !isPend) return false;
        if (athleteFilter === 'member' && !isMem) return false;
        if (!q) return true;
        const sqTag = `SQ-${String(ath?.id || idx + 101).replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 6).toUpperCase()}`;
        return `${ath?.nombre || ''} ${ath?.gimnasio || ''} ${ath?.disciplina || ''} ${sqTag}`.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      });
      if (athleteSort === 'az') return [...base].sort((a, b) => String(a?.nombre || '').localeCompare(String(b?.nombre || '')));
      if (athleteSort === 'streak') return [...base].sort((a, b) => (Number(b?.racha) || 0) - (Number(a?.racha) || 0));
      return [...base].sort((a, b) => (Number(b?.ovr) || 0) - (Number(a?.ovr) || 0) || (Number(b?.xpTotal) || 0) - (Number(a?.xpTotal) || 0));
    }, [suggestedAthletes, myRealId, squadMembersSet, pendingSentSet, athleteSearch, athleteFilter, athleteSort, ugcTick]);

    return (

        <Text style={[sq.mainModalTitle, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>{tx('EQUIPOS Y CHAT GRUPAL', 'TEAMS & GROUP CHAT')}</Text>

          {tx('Configura tu Equipo (1 equipo propio, máx. 50 integrantes), invita atletas y coordina entrenamientos en el chat grupal.', 'Configure your Team (1 personal team, max 50 members), invite athletes, and coordinate workouts in group chat.')}
        </Text>

        <View style={sq.topTabsRow}>

            activeOpacity={0.85} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setActiveSection('hub'); }}
          >
            <Feather name="users" size={13} color={isHubTab ? (isLightMode ? '#050505' : COLORS.cyan) : isLightMode ? '#334155' : COLORS.textLight} />
            <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[sq.topTabBtnTxt, isLightMode && { color: '#334155' }, isHubTab && { color: isLightMode ? '#050505' : COLORS.cyan, fontWeight: '900' }]}>{tx('MI EQUIPO', 'MY TEAM')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[sq.topTabBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && !isInvTab && lightInactiveTab, isInvTab && (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF', borderColor: '#7C3AED', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#5B21B6' } : sq.topTabBtnActivePurple)]}
            activeOpacity={0.85} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setActiveSection('invitar'); }}
          >
            <Feather name="user-plus" size={13} color={isInvTab ? (isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : COLORS.purpleLight) : isLightMode ? '#334155' : COLORS.textLight} />
            <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[sq.topTabBtnTxt, isLightMode && { color: '#334155' }, isInvTab && { color: isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : COLORS.purpleLight, fontWeight: '900' }]}>{tx('INVITAR / CÓDIGO', 'INVITE / CODE')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            {...DARK_INK_PROPS}
            style={[sq.topTabBtn, sq.topTabBtnDirectChat, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#00E5FF', borderColor: '#0284C7', borderTopColor: '#B8FFFF', borderBottomColor: '#0369A1' }]}
            activeOpacity={0.85} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); if (primarySquad) onOpenSquadRoomChat(primarySquad); else setActiveSection('chat'); }}
          >
            <Feather name="message-circle" size={13} color="#050505" />
            <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[sq.topTabBtnTxt, { color: '#050505', fontWeight: '900' }]}>{tx('ABRIR CHAT', 'OPEN CHAT')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <ScrollView ref={hubScrollRef as any} style={{ flex: 1 }} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={true} nestedScrollEnabled={true} bounces={true} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 18 }}>
          {incomingPendingDms.length > 0 && (
            <View style={[sq.invitesInboxBox, isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4' } : { borderColor: COLORS.cyan, borderTopColor: '#B8FFFF', borderBottomColor: '#006B78', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.11)', elevation: 0 }]}>
              <Text style={[sq.invitesInboxTitle, { color: cyanText }]}>
                {tx(`💬 SOLICITUDES DE MENSAJE DIRECTO 1 A 1 (${incomingPendingDms.length})`, `💬 1-ON-1 DIRECT MESSAGE REQUESTS (${incomingPendingDms.length})`)}
              </Text>
              {incomingPendingDms.map((dmReq) => (

          <View style={sq.sectionTitleRow}>

          ) : misEquipos.length === 0 ? (

            activeFilter={athleteFilter} onSelectFilter={(k) => setAthleteFilter(k as any)}
            sortOptions={[

            ]}
            activeSort={athleteSort} onSelectSort={(k) => setAthleteSort(k as any)}
          />
          {filteredSuggestedAthletes.map((ath: any, idx: number) => {
            const cleanLow = String(ath?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            const isAlreadyMember = squadMembersSet.has(cleanLow);
            const isPendingInvite = !isAlreadyMember && pendingSentSet.has(cleanLow);
            const sqTag = `SQ-${String(ath?.id || idx + 101).replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 6).toUpperCase()}`;
            const venueLabel = translateClubTerm(ath?.gimnasio || tx('Red Oficial Kinetic', 'Official Kinetic Network'), language);
            const pillStyle = isAlreadyMember ? (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#D1FAE5', borderColor: '#10B981', borderTopColor: '#A7F3D0', borderBottomColor: '#059669' } : sq.inviteActionPillPurple)
              : isPendingInvite ? (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#FEF3C7', borderColor: '#F59E0B', borderTopColor: '#FDE68A', borderBottomColor: '#D97706' } : sq.inviteActionPillPending)
              : (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#00E5FF', borderColor: '#0284C7', borderTopColor: '#B8FFFF', borderBottomColor: '#0369A1' } : sq.inviteActionPillCyan);
            const pillTxtColor = isAlreadyMember ? (isLightMode ? '#047857' : COLORS.purpleLight) : isPendingInvite ? (isLightMode ? '#B45309' : COLORS.yellow) : '#050505';
            return (

'#10B981' : 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.45)' }]} activeOpacity={0.88} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); onInspectMember(ath); }}>
                <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, paddingRight: 10 }}>

                  <Text selectable={false} style={[sq.sugMeta, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }]} numberOfLines={2}>{tx(`Ha entrenado en el mismo lugar que tú (${venueLabel}) • Toca para ver perfil`, `Trained at the same venue as you (${venueLabel}) • Tap to view profile`)}</Text>
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity {...(!isAlreadyMember && !isPendingInvite ? DARK_INK_PROPS : {})} style={[sq.inviteActionPill, NO_SEL, pillStyle]} onPress={(e: any) => { e?.stopPropagation?.(); if (isAlreadyMember) { if (primarySquad) onOpenSquadRoomChat(primarySquad); else setActiveSection('chat'); } else if (!isPendingInvite) onInviteSuggestedAthlete(ath); }}>

    // === src/components/kineticlub/StreakModal.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Platform, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import ReactNativeModal from 'react-native-modal';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { computeLevel99State, formatStreakDaysBadge } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { COLORS, globalStyles } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { KineticLoader, triggerArcadeHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { WeeklySteelContractCard } from '../shared/KineticDisruptiveWidgets';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from '../shared/KineticModalHeader3D';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as unknown as ViewStyle) : null;

export interface IStreakModalBodyProps {
  rachaDias?: number;
  completedSessionsCount?: number;
  isStreakFrozenToday?: boolean;
  onCongelarRacha?: () => Promise<{ ok: boolean; errorMsg?: string } | void> | void;
  isFreezing?: boolean;
  prestigeInfo?: ReturnType<typeof computeLevel99State> | null;
}

export interface IStreakModalProps extends IStreakModalBodyProps {
  showStreakModal?: boolean;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

export const StreakModalBody = React.memo(
  ({ rachaDias = 1, completedSessionsCount = 0, isStreakFrozenToday = false, onCongelarRacha, isFreezing = false, prestigeInfo }: IStreakModalBodyProps) => {
    const { user, profile } = useAuth();
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const shieldScaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
    const mountedRef = useRef(true);
    const [shieldFeedback, setShieldFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);
    useEffect(() => () => { mountedRef.current = false; }, []);
    const totalKcLive = (Number(profile?.kc_membresia) || 0) + (Number(profile?.kc_topup) || 0);
    const lvlState = useMemo(
      () => prestigeInfo || computeLevel99State(Number(profile?.xp_total) || 0, language, Number(profile?.prestigio_nivel) || 0),
      [prestigeInfo, profile?.xp_total, profile?.prestigio_nivel, language]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
      if (!isStreakFrozenToday) return;
      setShieldFeedback(null);
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.spring(shieldScaleAnim, { toValue: 1.14, friction: 4, tension: 140, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
        Animated.spring(shieldScaleAnim, { toValue: 1, friction: 6, tension: 110, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
      ]).start();
    }, [isStreakFrozenToday, shieldScaleAnim]);

    const stStyles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStStyles, resolvedTheme, ['shieldActionText']), [resolvedTheme]);
    const daysNum = Math.max(1, Number(rachaDias) || 1);
    const streakSteps = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((day) => ({ day, xp: '+25 XP' }));

    const handleActivateShield = async () => {
      if (mountedRef.current) setShieldFeedback(null);
      triggerArcadeHaptic('reward');
      const res = await onCongelarRacha?.();
      if (mountedRef.current && res && res.ok === false && res.errorMsg) setShieldFeedback(String(res.errorMsg));
    };

    return (
      <ScrollView style={{ flex: 1 }} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 8 }}>
        <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <Animated.View
            style={[
              stStyles.streakBigCircle,
              { transform: [{ scale: shieldScaleAnim }] },
              isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#E0F2FE', borderColor: '#0284C7' },
              isStreakFrozenToday && {
                borderColor: isLightMode ? '#7C3AED' : COLORS.purple,
                backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F3E8FF' : 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.14)',
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 28 }}>{isStreakFrozenToday ? '🛡️' : '🔥'}</Text>
          </Animated.View>
          <Text style={[stStyles.kickerMeta, { color: isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan }]}>
            {`${totalKcLive} KC • ${lvlState.prestigeShortLabel || tx(`NIVEL ${lvlState.prestigeLevel}/99`, `LEVEL ${lvlState.prestigeLevel}/99`)}`}
          </Text>
          <Text style={[stStyles.modalTitle, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>
            {isStreakFrozenToday
              ? tx('ESCUDO PROTECTOR ACTIVO', 'PROTECTIVE SHIELD ACTIVE')
              : `${tx('RACHA ACTIVA:', 'ACTIVE STREAK:')} ${formatStreakDaysBadge(daysNum, language)}`}
          </Text>
          <Text style={[stStyles.modalSub, isLightMode && { color: '#334155' }]}>
            {tx(
              'Cada día consecutivo suma +25 XP constantes a tu Nivel y protege tu progreso en KinetiClub.',
              'Each consecutive day adds a unified +25 XP to your Level and protects your KinetiClub progress.'
            )}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View style={stStyles.weekStreakRow}>
          {streakSteps.map((st) => {

                <Text style={[stStyles.dayStreakXp, isLightMode && { color: '#006B82' }, reached && { color: '#050505', fontWeight: '900' }]}>{st.xp}</Text>

        <WeeklySteelContractCard userId={user?.id} completedSessionsCount={completedSessionsCount} />

        <View
          style={[

          ]}
        >
          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, marginBottom: 8 }}>

            <Text style={[stStyles.shieldTitle, isLightMode && { color: '#6D28D9' }]}>
              {tx('ESCUDO PROTECTOR DE 24 HORAS', '24-HOUR STREAK SHIELD')}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <Text style={[stStyles.shieldDesc, isLightMode && { color: '#334155' }]}>
            {tx(
              'Congela tu racha durante 24 horas en días de descanso sin perder tus días acumulados. Incluye 1 escudo gratis al mes; escudos adicionales en el mismo mes cuestan 25 KC.',
              'Freeze your streak for 24 hours on rest days without losing accumulated days. Includes 1 free shield per month; extra shields in the same month cost 25 KC.'
            )}
          </Text>
          {shieldFeedback ? (
            <View style={[stStyles.feedbackPill, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FEF2F2', borderColor: '#EF4444' }]}>
              <Text style={[stStyles.feedbackTxt, isLightMode && { color: '#B91C1C' }]}>{shieldFeedback}</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          <TouchableOpacity
            {...(!isStreakFrozenToday ? ({ dataSet: { kineticInk: 'light' } } as Record<string, unknown>) : {})}
            style={[
              stStyles.shieldActionBtn,
              NO_SEL,
              !isStreakFrozenToday && isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#6D28D9', borderColor: '#7C3AED', borderTopColor: '#A78BFA', borderBottomColor: '#4C1D95' },
              isStreakFrozenToday && (isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: '#D1FAE5', borderColor: '#10B981', borderTopColor: '#ECFDF5', borderBottomColor: '#059669' } : stStyles.shieldActionBtnDone),
            ]}
            disabled={isStreakFrozenToday || isFreezing}
            onPress={handleActivateShield}
          >
            {isFreezing ? (
              <KineticLoader size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
            ) : (
              <Text
                selectable={false}
                style={[stStyles.shieldActionText, { color: isStreakFrozenToday ? (isLightMode ? '#047857' : COLORS.green) : '#FFFFFF' }]}
              >
                {isStreakFrozenToday
                  ? tx('RACHA BLINDADA HOY (24H) ✓', 'STREAK SHIELDED TODAY (24H) ✓')
                  : tx('ACTIVAR ESCUDO 24H (1 GRATIS/MES • 25 KC)', 'ACTIVATE 24H SHIELD (1 FREE/MO • 25 KC)')}
              </Text>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }
);

    // === src/components/KinetiClubModals.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import ReactNativeModal from 'react-native-modal';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES } from '../constants/exploreData';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { resolveMysteryBoxTierConfig } from '../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { COLORS, globalStyles } from '../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { TacticalAlertModal } from './BovedaModals';
import {
  InspectedAthleteModal,
  MONTHLY_SEASON_STEPS,
  PRESTIGE_RANKS_LADDER,
  RPG_PILLARS_META,
  RpgModal,
  StreakModal,
} from './KinetiClubProfileModals';
import { SquadsModal } from './KinetiClubSquadsModal';
import { KineticLoader } from './SharedUI';
import { KineticInteractiveLootBoxStage } from './kineticlub/KineticLootBoxStage';
import { KinetiClubTrophyVaultView } from './kineticlub/KinetiClubTrophyVaultView';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from './shared/KineticModalHeader3D';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;

export {
  InspectedAthleteModal,
  KineticLoader,
  MONTHLY_SEASON_STEPS,
  PRESTIGE_RANKS_LADDER,
  RPG_PILLARS_META,
  RpgModal,
  SquadsModal,
  StreakModal,
  TacticalAlertModal,
};

export const RECOMPENSAS_RETOS = KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES;

export const evaluateKinetic250Challenges = ({
  claimedChallengeIds = [],
  completedSessionsCount = 0,
  activeReservationsCount = 0,
  uniqueClubsCount = 0,
  uniqueDisciplinesCount = 0,
  maxDisciplineSessionsCount = 0,
  sessionsByDiscipline = {},
  hasConfiguredSquad = false,
  rachaActual = 1,
}: {
  claimedChallengeIds?: string[];
  completedSessionsCount?: number;
  activeReservationsCount?: number;
  uniqueClubsCount?: number;
  uniqueDisciplinesCount?: number;
  maxDisciplineSessionsCount?: number;
  sessionsByDiscipline?: Record<string, number>;
  hasConfiguredSquad?: boolean;
  rachaActual?: number;
}) => {
  const claimedSet = new Set(Array.isArray(claimedChallengeIds) ? claimedChallengeIds : []);
  const realCompletedQr = Math.max(0, Number(completedSessionsCount) || 0);
  const realActiveRes = Math.max(0, Number(activeReservationsCount) || 0);
  const realClubsVisited = Math.max(0, Number(uniqueClubsCount) || 0);
  const realUniqueDisciplines = Math.max(0, Number(uniqueDisciplinesCount) || 0);
  const realMaxDiscSessions = Math.max(0, Number(maxDisciplineSessionsCount) || 0);
  const realStreak = Math.max(1, Number(rachaActual) || 1);

  return (KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES || []).map((reto: any) => {
    let currentVal = 0;
    if (reto.tipo === 'habito_app') currentVal = 1;
    else if (reto.tipo === 'equipo') currentVal = hasConfiguredSquad || claimedSet.has(reto.id) ? 1 : 0;
    else if (reto.tipo === 'racha') currentVal = realStreak;
    else if (reto.tipo === 'sesiones') currentVal = realCompletedQr;
    else if (reto.tipo === 'clubes_visitados') currentVal = reto.id === 'reto_4' && (realClubsVisited > 0 || realActiveRes > 0) ? 1 : realClubsVisited;
    else if (reto.tipo === 'disciplinas') currentVal = realUniqueDisciplines;
    else if (reto.tipo === 'disciplina_especifica') currentVal = Number(sessionsByDiscipline?.[String(reto.disciplinaClave || '').trim()] || 0);
    else if (reto.tipo === 'experto_disciplina') currentVal = realMaxDiscSessions;
    else currentVal = realCompletedQr;
    const isClaimed = claimedSet.has(reto.id);
    const isUnlocked = isClaimed || currentVal >= reto.meta;
    const clampedVal = isUnlocked ? reto.meta : Math.min(reto.meta, currentVal);
    return { ...reto, currentVal: clampedVal, pct: Math.min(100, Math.round((clampedVal / reto.meta) * 100)), isUnlocked, isClaimed };
  });
};

export const RewardModalBody = React.memo(
  ({
    activeRewardModal, claimingId, dailyClaimedToday = false, claimedChallengeIds = [],
    completedSessionsCount = 0, activeReservationsCount = 0, uniqueDisciplinesCount = 0,
    uniqueClubsCount = 0, maxDisciplineSessionsCount = 0, sessionsByDiscipline = {},
    hasConfiguredSquad = false, rachaActual = 1, prestigeInfo, nivelRaw, isAdmin,
    onAbrirCajaNivel, onReclamarRecompensa,
  }: any) => {
    const { user, profile } = useAuth();
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, tx, tChallenge } = useKineticPreferences();
    const rw = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(rwStyles, resolvedTheme, ['tierBoxPillTxt']), [resolvedTheme]);
    const effectiveNivel = nivelRaw ?? profile?.nivel ?? null;
    const rawEmail = String(profile?.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const pRol = String(profile?.rol || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const pTipo = String(profile?.tipo_cuenta || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const appRol = String(user?.app_metadata?.rol || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const authMail = String(user?.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const adminMails = ['administrador@kinetic.com.mx', 'administrador@kinetic.com', 'kinetic@kinetic.com', 'admin@kinetic.com'];
    const authIsAdmin = Boolean(user?.id) && (adminMails.includes(authMail) || adminMails.includes(rawEmail) || ['admin', 'fundador'].includes(pRol) || ['admin', 'fundador'].includes(pTipo) || ['admin', 'fundador'].includes(appRol));
    const effectiveIsAdmin = isAdmin === false ? false : Boolean(typeof isAdmin === 'boolean' ? (isAdmin && authIsAdmin) : authIsAdmin);
    const tierCfg = useMemo(() => resolveMysteryBoxTierConfig(effectiveNivel), [effectiveNivel]);

    const lastValidDataRef = useRef<'misteriosa' | 'retos'>('retos');
    if (activeRewardModal) lastValidDataRef.current = activeRewardModal;
    const displayType = activeRewardModal || lastValidDataRef.current;

    const [liveToastBanner, setLiveToastBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [isOpeningLevelCrateStage, setIsOpeningLevelCrateStage] = useState(false);
    const [isChestDragging, setIsChestDragging] = useState(false);
    const toastTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (activeRewardModal) {
        if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
        setLiveToastBanner(null);
        setIsOpeningLevelCrateStage(false);
        setIsChestDragging(false);
      }
      return () => { if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current); };
    }, [activeRewardModal]);

    const all250Enriched = useMemo(
      () => evaluateKinetic250Challenges({
        claimedChallengeIds, completedSessionsCount, activeReservationsCount, uniqueClubsCount,
        uniqueDisciplinesCount, maxDisciplineSessionsCount, sessionsByDiscipline, hasConfiguredSquad, rachaActual,
      }),
      [claimedChallengeIds, completedSessionsCount, activeReservationsCount, uniqueClubsCount, uniqueDisciplinesCount, maxDisciplineSessionsCount, sessionsByDiscipline, hasConfiguredSquad, rachaActual]
    );

    const executeLevelCrateClaim = useCallback(async () => {
      if (!onAbrirCajaNivel) return 0;
      const kcWon = await onAbrirCajaNivel();
      if (kcWon === -1) return -1;
      const num = typeof kcWon === 'number' && Number.isFinite(kcWon) ? kcWon : 0;
      if (num <= 0) {
        setLiveToastBanner(tx('No se pudo reclamar el cofre en este momento.', 'Could not claim this level chest right now.'));
        if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
        toastTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setLiveToastBanner(null), 3200);
      }
      return num;
    }, [onAbrirCajaNivel, tx]);

    const handleClaimRetoWithLiveFeedback = useCallback(
      async (reto: { id?: string; titulo?: string; recompensaKc?: number; recompensaXp?: number; isUnlocked?: boolean; isClaimed?: boolean; [key: string]: unknown } | null | undefined) => {
        if (!reto || reto.isClaimed) return;
        const loc = tChallenge(reto);
        const res = await onReclamarRecompensa?.(String(reto.id || ''), reto.recompensaKc || 0, reto.recompensaXp || 20, Boolean(reto.isUnlocked));
        if (res === false) {
          setLiveToastBanner(tx('No se pudo guardar el trofeo en la nube.', 'Could not save trophy in cloud.'));
          if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
          toastTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setLiveToastBanner(null), 3200);
          return;
        }
        if (reto.isUnlocked) {
          setLiveToastBanner(tx(`¡Trofeo "${loc.titulo}" reclamado! +${reto.recompensaXp || 20} XP sumados.`, `Trophy "${loc.titulo}" claimed! +${reto.recompensaXp || 20} XP added.`));
          if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
          toastTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setLiveToastBanner(null), 3200);
        }
      },
      [onReclamarRecompensa, tChallenge, tx]
    );

    const executeDailyMysteryClaim = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (dailyClaimedToday || claimingId || !onReclamarRecompensa) return false;
      const res = await onReclamarRecompensa('misteriosa_diaria', 0, tierCfg.xpReward, true);
      if (res === false) {
        setLiveToastBanner(tx('No se pudo reclamar tu cofre diario. Intenta de nuevo.', 'Could not claim your daily chest. Please try again.'));
        if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
        toastTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setLiveToastBanner(null), 3200);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    }, [dailyClaimedToday, claimingId, onReclamarRecompensa, tierCfg, tx]);

    const prestigeLvl = Number(prestigeInfo?.prestigeLevel || 1);
    const cyanText = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;

    return (
      <>
        {liveToastBanner && (
          <View style={[rw.liveToastBox, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderBottomWidth: 3.5, borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4' }]}>
            <Feather name="zap" size={14} color={cyanText} />
            <Text style={[rw.liveToastText, { color: cyanText }]}>{liveToastBanner}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
        {displayType === 'misteriosa' || isOpeningLevelCrateStage ? (
          <ScrollView style={{ flex: 1 }} scrollEnabled={!isChestDragging} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingTop: 6, paddingBottom: 12 }}>
            <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
              <Text style={[rw.modalBigTitle, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>
                {isOpeningLevelCrateStage ? tx('CAJA DE RECOMPENSA DE NIVEL', 'LEVEL REWARD CHEST') : tx('CAJA MISTERIOSA DIARIA', 'DAILY MYSTERY CHEST')}
              </Text>
              {isOpeningLevelCrateStage ? (
                <Text style={[rw.modalSubDesc, { color: themeColors.textSecondary }]}>
                  {tx('Toca 3 veces el Cofre Cyber-Obsidian 3D para sobrecargarlo y liberar tus Kineticoins (10 a 20 KC) + 30 XP.', 'Tap the 3D Cyber-Obsidian Chest 3 times to supercharge it and unleash your Kineticoins (10 to 20 KC) + 30 XP.')}
                </Text>
              ) : (
                <View style={[rw.tierBoxPill, isLightMode ? { backgroundColor: tierCfg.bgLight, borderColor: tierCfg.borderLight, borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: tierCfg.borderLight } : { backgroundColor: '#0B101B', borderColor: tierCfg.accentDark, borderTopColor: tierCfg.accentDark, borderBottomColor: '#04070D' }]}>
                  <Feather name="award" size={12} color={isLightMode ? tierCfg.accentLight : tierCfg.accentDark} />
                  <Text style={[rw.tierBoxPillTxt, { color: isLightMode ? tierCfg.accentLight : tierCfg.accentDark }]}>{tx(tierCfg.pillEs, tierCfg.pillEn)}</Text>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>
            <KineticInteractiveLootBoxStage
              mode={isOpeningLevelCrateStage ? 'crate' : 'daily'}
              isActive={Boolean(activeRewardModal)}
              dailyClaimedToday={isOpeningLevelCrateStage ? false : dailyClaimedToday}
              disabled={Boolean(claimingId)}
              rachaActual={Math.max(1, Number(rachaActual) || 1)}
              prestigeLevel={prestigeLvl}
              nivelRaw={effectiveNivel}
              isAdmin={effectiveIsAdmin}
              onDragActiveChange={setIsChestDragging}
              onExecuteClaim={isOpeningLevelCrateStage ? executeLevelCrateClaim : executeDailyMysteryClaim}
              onContinueToVault={isOpeningLevelCrateStage ? () => setIsOpeningLevelCrateStage(false) : undefined}
            />
            {isOpeningLevelCrateStage && (
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[rw.backBtn, NO_SEL, { marginBottom: 6 }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#7DD3FC', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#0284C7', shadowOpacity: 0.1 }]}
                onPress={() => setIsOpeningLevelCrateStage(false)}
              >
                <Feather name="grid" size={14} color={cyanText} />
                <Text selectable={false} style={[rw.backBtnText, { color: cyanText }]}>
                  {tx('VOLVER A LA VITRINA DE TROFEOS Y RETOS', 'BACK TO TROPHY & QUEST VAULT')}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </ScrollView>
        ) : (
          <KinetiClubTrophyVaultView
            all250Enriched={all250Enriched}
            claimingId={claimingId}
            prestigeInfo={prestigeInfo}
            onOpenLevelCrateStage={() => setIsOpeningLevelCrateStage(true)}
            onClaimChallenge={handleClaimRetoWithLiveFeedback}
          />
        )}
      </>
    );
  }
);

export const RewardModal = React.memo((props: any) => {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const { isLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  return (
    <ReactNativeModal
      isVisible={Boolean(props.activeRewardModal)}

      useNativeDriver={Platform.OS !== 'web'}

    >
      <View
        style={[
          globalStyles.bottomSheet,

          { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : '#050505', paddingBottom: insets.bottom > 0 ? insets.bottom + 14 : 24 },
        ]}
      >
        <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={props.onClose} />
        <RewardModalBody {...props} />

  );
});

const rwStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  liveToastBox: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12)', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: COLORS.cyan, borderRadius: 12, padding: 10, marginBottom: 10, elevation: 0 },
