import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import ReactNativeModal from 'react-native-modal';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { useSquadsModalController } from '../hooks/kineticlub/useSquadsModalController';
import { IDirectMessageThread } from '../services/kineticRealtimeChatBridge';
import { COLORS, globalStyles } from '../styles/globalStyles';
import { IEquipoKinetic, IMensajeEquipo, IMiembroEquipo } from '../types';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { createSwipeDownToCloseHandlers } from '../utils/kineticEliteHelpers';
import { InspectedAthleteModal } from './KinetiClubProfileModals';
import { triggerHaptic } from './SharedUI';
import { SquadsChatSection } from './kineticlub/squads/SquadsChatSection';
import { SquadsHubSection } from './kineticlub/squads/SquadsHubSection';
import { baseSq } from './kineticlub/squads/squadsModalStyles';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from './shared/KineticModalHeader3D';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;

export const SquadsModal = React.memo(
  ({
    visible, onClose, userId, initialSection = 'hub', misEquipos = [], hasConfiguredSquad = false,
    solicitudesPendientes = [], sentPendingNames = [], suggestedAthletes = [], activeSquadChat,
    setActiveSquadChat, squadMessages = [], isCreatingSquad = false, isSendingSquadMsg = false,
    onCrearEquipo, onInviteSuggestedAthlete, onConectarPorCodigo, onCopiarCodigo,
    onResponderSolicitud, onAbrirChatEquipo, onEnviarMensaje, myStats, initialDmThread = null,
  }: {
    visible: boolean; onClose: () => void; userId?: string; initialSection?: 'hub' | 'invitar' | 'chat';
    misEquipos: IEquipoKinetic[]; hasConfiguredSquad?: boolean; solicitudesPendientes: IMiembroEquipo[];
    sentPendingNames?: string[]; suggestedAthletes: any[]; activeSquadChat: IEquipoKinetic | null;
    setActiveSquadChat: (eq: IEquipoKinetic | null) => void; squadMessages: IMensajeEquipo[];
    isCreatingSquad: boolean; isSendingSquadMsg: boolean;
    onCrearEquipo: (nombre: string, disc: string) => void;
    onInviteSuggestedAthlete: (athlete: any) => void;
    onConectarPorCodigo: (code: string) => void;
    onCopiarCodigo: (code: string) => void;
    onResponderSolicitud: (miembroId: string, estado: 'activo' | 'rechazado') => void;
    onAbrirChatEquipo: (eq: IEquipoKinetic) => void;
    onEnviarMensaje: (equipoId: string, texto: string) => void;
    myStats?: any; initialDmThread?: IDirectMessageThread | null;
  }) => {
    const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const sq = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseSq, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
    const { user: authUser, profile: authProfile } = useAuth();
    const myRealId = String(userId || authUser?.id || '');
    const myRealName = String(authProfile?.nombre || myStats?.userName || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')).trim();
    const myRealAvatar = authProfile?.avatar_url || myStats?.userAvatar || null;

    const c = useSquadsModalController({
      visible, onClose, initialSection, myRealId, myRealName, myRealAvatar,
      misEquipos, sentPendingNames, suggestedAthletes, activeSquadChat, setActiveSquadChat,
      squadMessages, isSendingSquadMsg, onCrearEquipo: onCrearEquipo as any, onConectarPorCodigo,
      onResponderSolicitud, onAbrirChatEquipo, onEnviarMensaje, initialDmThread, tx,
    });
    const swipeCloseHandlers = useMemo(() => createSwipeDownToCloseHandlers(onClose), [onClose]);

    return (
      <ReactNativeModal
        isVisible={Boolean(visible)} onBackButtonPress={() => (c.activeSection === 'chat' ? c.handleBackToHub() : onClose())}
        onBackdropPress={onClose} style={{ margin: 0, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}
        backdropColor="#050505" backdropOpacity={isLightMode ? 0.5 : 0.92}
        backdropTransitionOutTiming={0} backdropTransitionInTiming={0}
        animationInTiming={200} animationOutTiming={180} hideModalContentWhileAnimating={false}
        useNativeDriver={Platform.OS !== 'web'} useNativeDriverForBackdrop={Platform.OS !== 'web'} avoidKeyboard={false}
      >
        <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'} style={{ flex: 1, width: '100%', maxWidth: '100%', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
          <View
            style={[
              globalStyles.bottomSheet, sq.sheetContainer, KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS,
              isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderTopColor: '#0284C7' },
              { paddingBottom: insets.bottom > 0 ? insets.bottom + 10 : 16, paddingTop: c.activeSection === 'chat' ? 12 : undefined },
            ]}
          >
            {c.activeSection !== 'chat' && <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={onClose} />}

            {c.activeSection === 'chat' ? (
              <SquadsChatSection
                sq={sq} chatScrollRef={c.chatScrollRef} myRealId={myRealId} myRealName={myRealName}
                primarySquad={c.primarySquad} misEquipos={misEquipos} dmThreads={c.dmThreads}
                activeDmThread={c.activeDmThread} incomingPendingDms={c.incomingPendingDms}
                allRoomMessagesMap={c.allRoomMessagesMap} seenRoomCountMap={c.seenRoomCountMap}
                setSeenRoomCountMap={c.updateSeenRoomCounts} squadMembersRoster={c.squadMembersRoster}
                suggestedAthletes={suggestedAthletes} displayedMessages={c.displayedMessages}
                chatDraft={c.chatDraft} setChatDraft={c.setChatDraft}
                isSendingSquadMsg={isSendingSquadMsg} isSendingDmLive={c.isSendingDmLive}
                isSquadActionBusy={c.isSquadActionBusy} resolvePartnerForDm={c.resolvePartnerForDm}
                onAcceptDmAndChat={c.handleAcceptDmAndChat} onBackToHub={c.handleBackToHub}
                onCopyCode={onCopiarCodigo} onSelectSquadRoom={c.handleSelectSquadRoom} onSelectDmRoom={c.handleSelectDmRoom}
                onInspectMember={c.setInspectedMember} onSendChatMessage={c.handleSendChatMessage}
                onDeleteSquad={(sqId) => c.setDialogState({ kind: 'delete_squad', targetId: sqId, targetName: c.primarySquad?.nombre || tx('Equipo Kinetic', 'Kinetic Team') })}
                onLeaveSquad={(sqId) => c.setDialogState({ kind: 'leave_squad', targetId: sqId, targetName: c.primarySquad?.nombre || tx('Equipo Kinetic', 'Kinetic Team') })}
                onDeleteDm={(dmCode) => c.setDialogState({ kind: 'delete_dm', targetId: dmCode, targetName: c.activeDmThread ? c.resolvePartnerForDm(c.activeDmThread).name : tx('Atleta', 'Athlete') })}
                onGoCreateSquad={() => { c.setActiveSection('hub'); c.handleRequestCreateNewSquad(); }}
                onGoJoinByCode={() => { c.setActiveSection('invitar'); }}
              />
            ) : (
              <SquadsHubSection
                sq={sq} hubScrollRef={c.hubScrollRef} activeSection={c.activeSection} setActiveSection={c.setActiveSection}
                primarySquad={c.primarySquad} misEquipos={misEquipos} solicitudesPendientes={solicitudesPendientes}
                incomingPendingDms={c.incomingPendingDms} dmThreads={c.dmThreads} allRoomMessagesMap={c.allRoomMessagesMap}
                suggestedAthletes={suggestedAthletes} squadMembersSet={c.squadMembersSet} pendingSentSet={c.pendingSentSet}
                isEditingSquadConfig={c.isEditingSquadConfig} setIsEditingSquadConfig={c.setIsEditingSquadConfig}
                squadNameDraft={c.squadNameDraft} setSquadNameDraft={c.setSquadNameDraft}
                squadDiscDraft={c.squadDiscDraft} setSquadDiscDraft={c.setSquadDiscDraft}
                joinCodeInput={c.joinCodeInput} setJoinCodeInput={c.setJoinCodeInput}
                isCreatingSquad={isCreatingSquad} isSquadActionBusy={c.isSquadActionBusy}
                resolvePartnerForDm={c.resolvePartnerForDm} onAcceptDmAndChat={c.handleAcceptDmAndChat}
                onRespondInviteSafe={c.handleRespondInviteSafe} onConnectByCodeSafe={c.handleConnectByCodeSafe}
                onCopyCode={onCopiarCodigo} onShareSquadInvite={c.handleShareSquadInvite}
                onSaveSquadConfig={c.handleSaveSquadConfig}
                onOpenSquadRoomChat={c.handleOpenSquadRoomChat} onOpenDmRoomChat={c.handleOpenDmRoomChat}
                onInspectMember={c.setInspectedMember} onInviteSuggestedAthlete={onInviteSuggestedAthlete}
                myRealId={myRealId} editingSquadId={c.editingSquadId}
                onRequestCreateNewSquad={c.handleRequestCreateNewSquad}
                onRequestEditSquad={c.handleRequestEditSquad}
                onRequestDeleteSquad={(eq) => { triggerHaptic('Warning'); c.setDialogState({ kind: 'delete_squad', targetId: String(eq.id), targetName: eq.nombre || tx('Equipo Kinetic', 'Kinetic Team') }); }}
                onRequestLeaveSquad={(eq) => { triggerHaptic('Warning'); c.setDialogState({ kind: 'leave_squad', targetId: String(eq.id), targetName: eq.nombre || tx('Equipo Kinetic', 'Kinetic Team') }); }}
                onRequestDeleteDm={(dm) => { triggerHaptic('Warning'); c.setDialogState({ kind: 'delete_dm', targetId: dm.dmCode, targetName: c.resolvePartnerForDm(dm).name }); }}
              />
            )}

            {c.activeSection !== 'chat' && (
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[sq.footerBackBtn, NO_SEL, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }]}
                onPress={onClose} {...swipeCloseHandlers}
              >
                <Feather name="arrow-left" size={14} color={isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : COLORS.textPrimary} />
                <Text selectable={false} style={[sq.footerBackBtnTxt, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>{tx('VOLVER A KINETICLUB', 'BACK TO KINETICLUB')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}

            {Boolean(c.dialogState) && (
              <TouchableOpacity style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, sq.confirmOverlay, { zIndex: 999, elevation: 0 }]} activeOpacity={1} onPress={() => c.setDialogState(null)}>
                <View style={[sq.confirmCard, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#0284C7', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#0369A1' }]} onStartShouldSetResponder={() => true}>
                  <Text style={[sq.confirmTitle, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>{c.dialogTitle}</Text>
                  <Text style={[sq.confirmBody, isLightMode && { color: '#334155' }]}>{c.dialogBody}</Text>
                  <View style={sq.confirmBtnsRow}>
                    {c.dialogState?.kind !== 'leader_limit' && (
                      <TouchableOpacity style={[sq.confirmCancelBtn, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9', borderColor: '#CBD5E1' }]} onPress={() => c.setDialogState(null)}>
                        <Text selectable={false} style={[sq.confirmCancelTxt, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>{tx('CANCELAR', 'CANCEL')}</Text>
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    )}
                    <TouchableOpacity style={sq.confirmDangerBtn} onPress={c.executeConfirmedAction}>
                      <Text selectable={false} style={sq.confirmDangerTxt}>{c.dialogBtn}</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
                </View>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}

            <InspectedAthleteModal
              inspectedAthlete={c.inspectedMember} onClose={() => c.setInspectedMember(null)} myStats={myStats} inlineOverlayMode={true}
              isAlreadyInMySquad={c.inspectedMember ? c.squadMembersSet.has(String(c.inspectedMember?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase()) : false}
              onOpenTeamChat={() => { c.setInspectedMember(null); c.setActiveDmThreadCode(null); if (c.primarySquad) onAbrirChatEquipo(c.primarySquad); c.setActiveSection('chat'); }}
              onOpenDirectChat={(dmThread: any) => {
                c.setInspectedMember(null);
                if (dmThread?.dmCode) { c.setDmThreads((prev) => { const next = [dmThread, ...prev.filter((x) => x.dmCode !== dmThread.dmCode)]; c.dmsSigRef.current = JSON.stringify(next); return next; }); c.setActiveDmThreadCode(dmThread.dmCode); }
                c.setActiveSection('chat');
              }}
              onLink={(atl: any) => { onInviteSuggestedAthlete(atl); c.setInspectedMember(null); }}
            />
          </View>
        </KeyboardAvoidingView>
      </ReactNativeModal>
    );
  }
);
export default SquadsModal;

import React, { memo, useMemo } from 'react';
import Svg, {
  Circle,

  Ellipse,
  G,
  Line,
  LinearGradient,
  Path,
  Polygon,
  RadialGradient,

export const normalizeOrbitalChestAngles = (
  rawYawDeg: number,
  rawPitchDeg = -18
): { yawDeg: number; pitchDeg: number; yawRad: number; pitchRad: number } => {
  const safeYaw = Number.isFinite(rawYawDeg) ? ((rawYawDeg % 360) + 360) % 360 : 332;
  const safePitch = Number.isFinite(rawPitchDeg) ? Math.max(-34, Math.min(10, rawPitchDeg)) : -18;
  return {
    yawDeg: safeYaw,
    pitchDeg: safePitch,
    yawRad: (safeYaw * Math.PI) / 180,
    pitchRad: (safePitch * Math.PI) / 180,
  };
};

export interface KineticSolidChest3DProps {
  chargeStep: number;
  rarityStep: number;
  isOpened: boolean;
  trimMain: string;
  trimBevel: string;
  trimDark: string;
  coreGlow: string;
  yawDeg?: number;
  pitchDeg?: number;
  hingeAngleDeg?: number;
  hopHeightPx?: number;
  shadowScale?: number;
  shadowOpacity?: number;
  keyLightBoost?: number;
  rimLightBoost?: number;
  pedestalGlow01?: number;
  rewardVisualKind?: 'kc' | 'xp';
  spinSpeedDegPerSec?: number;
  burstProgress01?: number;
}

export const KineticSolidChest3DEngine = memo(
  ({
    chargeStep,
    rarityStep,
    isOpened,
    trimMain,
    trimBevel,
    trimDark,
    coreGlow,
    yawDeg = -28,
    pitchDeg = -18,
    hingeAngleDeg,
    hopHeightPx = 0,
    shadowScale = 1,
    shadowOpacity = 0.62,
    keyLightBoost = 1,
    rimLightBoost = 1,
    pedestalGlow01 = 0.55,
    rewardVisualKind = 'xp',
    spinSpeedDegPerSec = 0,
    burstProgress01 = 0,
  }: KineticSolidChest3DProps) => {
    const effectiveHinge = typeof hingeAngleDeg === 'number' && Number.isFinite(hingeAngleDeg)
      ? Math.max(0, Math.min(118, hingeAngleDeg))
      : isOpened
        ? 108
        : 0;

    const { yawDeg: safeYaw, pitchDeg: safePitch } = normalizeOrbitalChestAngles(yawDeg, pitchDeg);
    const manifold = useMemo(
      () =>
        buildArticulatedChestManifold({
          yawDeg: safeYaw,
          pitchDeg: safePitch,
          hingeAngleDeg: effectiveHinge,
          chargeStep,
          rarityStep,
          isOpened,
          trimMain,
          trimBevel,
          trimDark,
          coreGlow,
          keyLightBoost,
          rimLightBoost,
        }),
      [
        safeYaw,
        safePitch,
        effectiveHinge,
        chargeStep,
        rarityStep,
        isOpened,
        trimMain,
        trimBevel,
        trimDark,
        coreGlow,
        keyLightBoost,
        rimLightBoost,
      ]
    );

    const safeShadowScale = Math.max(0.35, Math.min(1.15, Number.isFinite(shadowScale) ? shadowScale : 1));
    const safeShadowOpacity = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(0.8, Number.isFinite(shadowOpacity) ? shadowOpacity : 0.62));
    const safeHop = Math.max(0, Math.min(96, Number.isFinite(hopHeightPx) ? hopHeightPx : 0));
    const pedGlow = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number.isFinite(pedestalGlow01) ? pedestalGlow01 : 0.55));
    const emblemHex = rewardVisualKind === 'kc' ? '#FFD700' : '#00F0FF';
    const emblemDark = rewardVisualKind === 'kc' ? '#B45309' : '#007C91';
    const orbitalFx = computeOrbitalChestFrame360({
      angleDeg: safeYaw,
      omegaDegPerSec: spinSpeedDegPerSec,
      dtMs: 16,
      isClaimBurst: isOpened,
      burstProgress01,
    });

    return (
      <Svg width={256} height={206} viewBox="0 0 256 206" style={{ overflow: 'visible' }}>
        <Defs>
          <LinearGradient id="solidBeam" x1="0.5" y1="1" x2="0.5" y2="0">
            <Stop offset="0%" stopColor="#FFD700" stopOpacity="0.88" />
            <Stop offset="50%" stopColor={trimMain} stopOpacity="0.42" />
            <Stop offset="100%" stopColor="#00F0FF" stopOpacity="0" />
          </LinearGradient>
          <RadialGradient id="solidCore" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <Stop offset="0%" stopColor="#FFFFFF" stopOpacity="0.96" />
            <Stop offset="55%" stopColor={trimMain} stopOpacity="0.76" />
            <Stop offset="100%" stopColor={trimDark} stopOpacity="0" />
          </RadialGradient>
        </Defs>

        <Ellipse
          cx="128"
          cy="176"
          rx={Number((86 * safeShadowScale).toFixed(1))}
          ry={Number((15.5 * safeShadowScale).toFixed(1))}
          fill={`rgba(0,0,0,${safeShadowOpacity.toFixed(2)})`}
        />
        <Ellipse
          cx="128"
          cy="174"
          rx={Number((62 + pedGlow * 18).toFixed(1))}
          ry={Number((9.5 + pedGlow * 2.5).toFixed(1))}
          fill={coreGlow}
          fillOpacity={Number((0.35 + pedGlow * 0.65).toFixed(2))}
        />

        <G transform={`translate(0, ${(-safeHop).toFixed(1)})`}>
          {manifold.polys.map((p, idx) => (
            <Polygon
              key={idx}
              points={p.points}
              fill={p.fill}
              stroke={p.stroke}
              strokeWidth={0.5}
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />
          ))}

          {isOpened && effectiveHinge > 32 && (
            <G>
              <Polygon points="84,104 44,10 112,4 122,100" fill="url(#solidBeam)" />
              <Polygon points="116,102 114,2 168,4 156,102" fill="url(#solidBeam)" />
              <Polygon points="148,104 176,12 222,22 178,104" fill="url(#solidBeam)" />
              <Ellipse
                cx={manifold.coreCenterScreen.x.toFixed(1)}
                cy={manifold.coreCenterScreen.y.toFixed(1)}
                rx="40"
                ry="11"
                fill="url(#solidCore)"
              />
            </G>
          )}

          {manifold.cracks3D.map((c, idx) => (
            <Line
              key={`cr-${idx}`}
              x1={c.x1.toFixed(1)}
              y1={c.y1.toFixed(1)}
              x2={c.x2.toFixed(1)}
              y2={c.y2.toFixed(1)}
              stroke={trimBevel}
              strokeWidth={c.width}
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
          ))}

          {manifold.ejectedEmblemPos.visible && (
            <G
              transform={`translate(${manifold.ejectedEmblemPos.x.toFixed(1)}, ${manifold.ejectedEmblemPos.y.toFixed(1)}) rotate(${manifold.ejectedEmblemPos.rotDeg}) scale(${manifold.ejectedEmblemPos.scale})`}
            >
              <Circle cx="0" cy="2" r="14.5" fill={emblemDark} />
              <Circle cx="0" cy="0" r="14" fill={emblemHex} stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="1.6" />
              <Path d="M2 -8 L-5 1 H1 L-2 8 L6 -1 H0 Z" fill="#05070C" />
            </G>
          )}
          {orbitalFx.particles.map((pt) => (
            <Circle
              key={`orb-${pt.id}`}
              cx={(128 + pt.x).toFixed(1)}
              cy={(98 + pt.y).toFixed(1)}
              r={(pt.size * pt.scale * 0.52).toFixed(2)}
              fill={pt.id % 2 === 0 ? trimBevel : '#00F0FF'}
              opacity={pt.opacity}
            />
          ))}
        </G>
      </Svg>
    );
  }
);

    // === src/components/shared/KineticStoriesModal.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { KeyboardAvoidingView, Modal, Platform, StatusBar, Text, TouchableOpacity, useWindowDimensions, View } from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useKineticStoriesViewer } from '../../hooks/kineticlub/useKineticStoriesViewer';
import {
  formatStoryRelativeTime,
  KineticStoriesModalProps,
  STORY_TAG_PRESETS,
} from '../../services/kineticStoriesService';
import { KineticFullscreenLightboxModal } from './KineticFullscreenLightboxModal';
import { styles } from './KineticStoriesModal.styles';
import { KineticStoryEmptyProfileView, KineticStoryStudioView, KineticStoryViewerStage } from './KineticStoryStudioAndSheets';

export {
  checkHasActiveCustomStory, emitKineticStoriesUpdated, getActiveStoriesForOwner, hasActiveStoriesForOwner,
  IKineticStoryItem, IKineticStoryOwner, IKineticStorySlide,
  KINETIC_STORIES_STORAGE_KEY, KineticStoriesModalProps, STORIES_STORAGE_KEY,
  subscribeKineticStoriesUpdated, subscribeKineticStoriesUpdates,
} from '../../services/kineticStoriesService';

export const KineticStoriesModal: React.FC<KineticStoriesModalProps & { inlineOverlay?: boolean }> = (props) => {
  const closeActionTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => () => {
    if (closeActionTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(closeActionTimerRef.current);
  }, []);
  if (!props.visible) return null;
  return <KineticStoriesModalActive {...props} closeActionTimerRef={closeActionTimerRef} />;
};

const KineticStoriesModalActive: React.FC<KineticStoriesModalProps & {
  inlineOverlay?: boolean;
  closeActionTimerRef?: React.MutableRefObject<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>;
}> = (props) => {
  const { visible, onClose, owner, inlineOverlay, closeActionTimerRef } = props;
  const v = useKineticStoriesViewer(props);
  const { width: winW, height: winH } = useWindowDimensions();
  const stageW = Math.max(320, Math.round(winW));
  const stageH = Math.max(480, Math.round(winH));
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const topSafePadding = Math.max(insets.top + 14, Platform.OS === 'android' ? (StatusBar.currentHeight || 24) + 14 : 0, 48);

  useEffect(() => {
    const urls = (v.stories || []).map((s: any) => String(s?.imageUrl || '').trim()).filter((u: string) => /^https?:\/\//i.test(u));
    if (urls.length > 0 && typeof (Image as any).prefetch === 'function') {
      try { void (Image as any).prefetch(urls); } catch {}
    }
  }, [v.stories]);

  const mediaLockProps: any = {
    dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' },
    ...(Platform.OS === 'web' ? { onContextMenu: (e: any) => e?.preventDefault?.() } : {}),
  };

  const storyStage = (
    <View style={[styles.backdrop, { backgroundColor: '#05060A', width: stageW, height: stageH }]} {...mediaLockProps}>
        <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined} style={[styles.stageContainer, { backgroundColor: '#05060A', height: stageH }]} {...mediaLockProps}>
          {!(v.isStudioOpen && v.canUpload) && (
            <View style={[styles.topSafeHeaderWrap, { paddingTop: topSafePadding }]}>
              {v.stories.length > 0 && (
                <View style={styles.progressRow}>
                  {v.stories.map((st, idx) => {
                    const fill = idx < v.currentIndex ? 1 : idx === v.currentIndex ? v.progress : 0;
                    return (
                      <View key={st.id} style={styles.progressTrack}>
                        <View style={[styles.progressFill, { width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, fill * 100))}%`, backgroundColor: v.finalAccent }]} />
                      </View>
                    );
                  })}
                </View>
              )}
              <View style={styles.headerBar}>
                <View style={styles.ownerInfoRow}>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    activeOpacity={0.85}
                    disabled={!v.resolvedAvatar}
                    onPress={() => {
                      if (!v.resolvedAvatar) return;
                      v.setIsPaused(true);
                      v.setIsAvatarZoomOpen(true);
                    }}
                    style={[styles.avatarRing, { borderColor: v.finalAccent }]}
                  >
                    {v.resolvedAvatar ? (
                      <Image source={{ uri: v.resolvedAvatar }} style={styles.avatarImg} contentFit="cover" cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} />
                    ) : (
                      <View style={styles.avatarFallback}>
                        <Text style={[styles.avatarInitial, { color: v.finalAccent }]}>{String(v.resolvedName || 'K').charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</Text>
                      </View>
                    )}
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <View style={styles.ownerTextCol}>
                    <View style={styles.nameAndPauseRow}>
                      <Text style={styles.ownerNameText} numberOfLines={1}>{v.resolvedName}</Text>
                      {v.isPaused && !v.isStudioOpen && (
                        <View style={styles.pausePill}><Text style={styles.pausePillText}>{v.isEn ? 'PAUSED' : 'PAUSA'}</Text></View>
                      )}
                    </View>
                    <Text style={styles.ownerSubText} numberOfLines={1}>
                      {v.activeStory ? `${formatStoryRelativeTime(v.activeStory.createdAtMs, v.isEn)} • ${v.resolvedSubtitle}` : v.resolvedSubtitle}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.headerActions}>
                  {v.canUpload && !v.isStudioOpen && v.activeStory && !v.activeStory.id.startsWith('slide_') && (
                    <TouchableOpacity disabled={v.isDeletingStory} onPress={() => { v.setIsPaused(true); v.setConfirmDeleteStory(true); }} style={[styles.deleteBtn, v.isDeletingStory && { opacity: 0.5 }]} activeOpacity={0.8}>
                      <Feather name="trash-2" size={15} color="#FF3B5C" />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  )}
                  {v.canUpload && !v.isStudioOpen && (
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      onPress={() => {
                        v.setConfirmDeleteStory(false); v.setIsPaused(true); v.setDraftImageUri('');
                        v.setDraftCaption(''); v.setDraftTag(STORY_TAG_PRESETS[0]);
                        v.setSelectedPromoEvent(owner?.linkedEvent || owner?.promoEvent || null);
                        v.setIsStudioOpen(true);
                      }}
                      style={[styles.uploadPillBtn, { borderColor: v.finalAccent }]} activeOpacity={0.85} {...({ dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } } as any)}
                    >
                      <Feather name="plus" size={12} color="#050505" style={{ color: '#050505' }} />
                      <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.uploadPillText, { color: '#050505' }]}>{v.isEn ? 'STORY' : 'HISTORIA'}</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  )}
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={onClose} style={styles.closeBtn} activeOpacity={0.8} hitSlop={{ top: 12, bottom: 12, left: 12, right: 12 }}>
                    <Feather name="x" size={20} color="#FFFFFF" />
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              </View>
              {v.confirmDeleteStory && v.canUpload && !v.isStudioOpen && v.activeStory && (
                <View style={{ marginTop: 10, paddingHorizontal: 12, paddingVertical: 9, borderRadius: 12, backgroundColor: 'rgba(15,23,42,0.92)', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: 'rgba(255,59,92,0.45)', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 8, elevation: 0 }}>
                  <Text selectable={false} style={{ color: '#F8FAFC', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800', flex: 1 }}>{v.isEn ? 'Delete this 24h story?' : '¿Eliminar esta historia 24h?'}</Text>
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => { v.setConfirmDeleteStory(false); v.setIsPaused(false); }} style={{ paddingHorizontal: 10, paddingVertical: 5, borderRadius: 8, backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)', elevation: 0 }}>
                    <Text selectable={false} style={{ color: '#E2E8F0', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800' }}>{v.isEn ? 'Cancel' : 'Cancelar'}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity disabled={v.isDeletingStory} onPress={() => { v.setConfirmDeleteStory(false); v.handleDeleteCurrentStory(); }} style={{ paddingHorizontal: 11, paddingVertical: 5, borderRadius: 8, backgroundColor: '#DC2626', borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#F87171', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                    <Feather name="trash-2" size={12} color="#FFFFFF" />
                    <Text selectable={false} style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '900' }}>{v.isEn ? 'Delete' : 'Eliminar'}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>
          )}

          {v.isStudioOpen && v.canUpload ? (
            <KineticStoryStudioView
              draftImageUri={v.draftImageUri} draftCaption={v.draftCaption} setDraftCaption={v.setDraftCaption}
              draftTag={v.draftTag} setDraftTag={v.setDraftTag} isPickingOrSaving={v.isPickingOrSaving}
              resolvedAccent={v.finalAccent} isEn={v.isEn} handlePickPhoto={v.handlePickPhoto}
              handlePublishStory={v.handlePublishStory} onCloseStudio={v.handleCloseStudio}
              availableEvents={owner?.availableEvents} selectedPromoEvent={v.selectedPromoEvent} setSelectedPromoEvent={v.setSelectedPromoEvent}
            />
          ) : v.activeStory ? (
            <KineticStoryViewerStage
              activeStory={v.activeStory} storiesCount={v.stories.length} currentIndex={v.currentIndex}
              setCurrentIndex={v.setCurrentIndex} setProgress={v.setProgress} setIsPaused={v.setIsPaused}
              reactionToast={v.reactionToast} resolvedAccent={v.finalAccent} isEn={v.isEn} canUpload={v.canUpload}
              hasReactedFire={v.hasReactedFire} hasReactedBolt={v.hasReactedBolt} handleToggleReaction={v.handleToggleReaction}
              onClose={onClose} onPrimaryAction={v.effectivePrimaryAction} primaryActionLabel={v.effectivePrimaryLabel}
              closeActionTimerRef={closeActionTimerRef}
            />
          ) : (
            <KineticStoryEmptyProfileView
              resolvedAvatar={v.resolvedAvatar} resolvedName={v.resolvedName} resolvedAccent={v.finalAccent}
              isEn={v.isEn} onClose={onClose} onPrimaryAction={v.effectivePrimaryAction} primaryActionLabel={v.effectivePrimaryLabel}
              closeActionTimerRef={closeActionTimerRef}
            />
          )}

          <KineticFullscreenLightboxModal
            inlineOverlay={true}
            visible={v.isAvatarZoomOpen && Boolean(v.resolvedAvatar)}
            images={v.resolvedAvatar ? [v.resolvedAvatar] : []}
            caption={`${v.resolvedName} • ${v.resolvedSubtitle}`}
            onClose={() => { v.setIsAvatarZoomOpen(false); v.setIsPaused(false); }}
          />
        </KeyboardAvoidingView>
      </View>
  );

  if (inlineOverlay) {
    return (
      <View
        {...(Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ dataSet: { kineticSheetOpen: 'true' } } as any) : {})}
        style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, zIndex: 995 }}
      >
        {storyStage}
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose} statusBarTranslucent>
      {storyStage}
    </Modal>
  );
};

    import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  PanResponder,
  Platform,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
  type TextStyle,
  type ViewProps,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { styles } from './KineticStoriesModal.styles';

export interface KineticStoryAvatarZoomProps {
  resolvedAvatar?: string;
  resolvedName: string;
  resolvedAccent: string;
  isEn: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onPrimaryAction?: () => void;
  primaryActionLabel?: string;
  closeActionTimerRef?: React.MutableRefObject<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>;
}

interface WebWheelEventLike {
  deltaY?: number;
  preventDefault?: () => void;
  stopPropagation?: () => void;
}

export const KineticStoryEmptyProfileView: React.FC<KineticStoryAvatarZoomProps> = ({
  resolvedAvatar,
  resolvedName,
  resolvedAccent,
  isEn,
  onClose,
  onPrimaryAction,
  primaryActionLabel,
  closeActionTimerRef,
}) => {
  const { isLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [zoomState, setZoomState] = useState({ scale: 1, x: 0, y: 0 });
  const gestureRef = useRef({ baseScale: 1, baseX: 0, baseY: 0, startDist: 0, moved: false, lastTap: 0 });
  const zoomRef = useRef(zoomState);
  zoomRef.current = zoomState;
  const fallbackCtaTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (fallbackCtaTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(fallbackCtaTimerRef.current);
    },
    []
  );

  const clampPan = (val: number, sc: number) => {
    const limit = Math.max(0, ((sc - 1) * 244) / 2);
    return Math.max(-limit, Math.min(limit, val));
  };

  const panResponder = useRef(
    PanResponder.create({
      onStartShouldSetPanResponder: () => true,
      onStartShouldSetPanResponderCapture: () => true,
      onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: () => true,
      onMoveShouldSetPanResponderCapture: () => true,
      onPanResponderTerminationRequest: () => false,
      onPanResponderGrant: (evt) => {
        const touches = evt.nativeEvent.touches || [];
        const cur = zoomRef.current;
        gestureRef.current = {
          ...gestureRef.current,
          baseScale: cur.scale,
          baseX: cur.x,
          baseY: cur.y,
          moved: false,
          startDist:
            touches.length >= 2
              ? Math.hypot(touches[0].pageX - touches[1].pageX, touches[0].pageY - touches[1].pageY) || 1
              : 0,
        };
      },
      onPanResponderMove: (evt, gs) => {
        const touches = evt.nativeEvent.touches || [];
        if (touches.length >= 2) {
          gestureRef.current.moved = true;
          const dist = Math.hypot(touches[0].pageX - touches[1].pageX, touches[0].pageY - touches[1].pageY) || 1;
          if (!gestureRef.current.startDist) gestureRef.current.startDist = dist;
          const nextScale = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, gestureRef.current.baseScale * (dist / gestureRef.current.startDist)));
          setZoomState((prev) => ({
            scale: nextScale,
            x: clampPan(prev.x, nextScale),
            y: clampPan(prev.y, nextScale),
          }));
        } else if (zoomRef.current.scale > 1.02 && (Math.abs(gs.dx) > 3 || Math.abs(gs.dy) > 3)) {
          gestureRef.current.moved = true;
          const sc = zoomRef.current.scale;
          setZoomState({
            scale: sc,
            x: clampPan(gestureRef.current.baseX + gs.dx, sc),
            y: clampPan(gestureRef.current.baseY + gs.dy, sc),
          });
        }
      },
      onPanResponderRelease: () => {
        if (!gestureRef.current.moved) {
          const now = Date.now();
          const isDouble = now - gestureRef.current.lastTap < 320;
          gestureRef.current.lastTap = now;
          setZoomState((prev) =>
            prev.scale > 1.05 ? { scale: 1, x: 0, y: 0 } : isDouble || prev.scale === 1 ? { scale: 2.2, x: 0, y: 0 } : prev
          );
        }
      },
    })
  ).current;

  const handlePrimaryCtaPress = () => {
    if (!onPrimaryAction) return;
    const timerRef = closeActionTimerRef || fallbackCtaTimerRef;
    if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    onPrimaryAction();
    onClose();
  };

  const webZoomProps =
    Platform.OS === 'web'
      ? ({
          onWheel: (e: WebWheelEventLike) => {
            e?.preventDefault?.();
            e?.stopPropagation?.();
            const delta = Number(e?.deltaY || 0) < 0 ? 0.25 : -0.25;
            setZoomState((prev) => {
              const nextScale = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Number((prev.scale + delta).toFixed(2))));
              return nextScale <= 1.02
                ? { scale: 1, x: 0, y: 0 }
                : { scale: nextScale, x: clampPan(prev.x, nextScale), y: clampPan(prev.y, nextScale) };
            });
          },
        } as unknown as ViewProps)
      : {};

  const surfaceInk = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const hintInk = isLightMode ? '#334155' : '#CBD5E1';
  const accentLip = isLightMode ? '#0369A1' : resolvedAccent;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.emptyProfileViewer,
        { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : '#05060A' },
      ]}
    >
      {resolvedAvatar ? (
        <View
          {...panResponder.panHandlers}
          {...webZoomProps}
          style={[
            styles.largeAvatarFrame,
            {
              width: 244,
              height: 244,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              borderColor: accentLip,
              borderBottomColor: isLightMode ? '#94A3B8' : accentLip,
              borderBottomWidth: 3.5,
              position: 'relative',
            },
            Platform.OS === 'web'
              ? ({ touchAction: 'none', overscrollBehavior: 'contain', cursor: zoomState.scale > 1 ? 'grab' : 'zoom-in' } as unknown as ViewStyle)
              : null,
          ]}
        >
          <Image
            source={{ uri: resolvedAvatar }}
            style={[
              styles.largeAvatarImg,
              { transform: [{ translateX: zoomState.x }, { translateY: zoomState.y }, { scale: zoomState.scale }] },
            ]}
            contentFit="cover"
            cachePolicy="memory-disk"
            transition={0}
          />
          <View
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              right: 8,
              bottom: 8,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(5,7,12,0.86)',
              borderRadius: 8,
              paddingHorizontal: 7,
              paddingVertical: 3,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)',
              flexDirection: 'row',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 4,
              elevation: 0,
            }}
          >
            <Feather name={zoomState.scale > 1.05 ? 'minimize-2' : 'zoom-in'} size={11} color="#00F0FF" />
            <Text selectable={false} style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: '900' }}>{`${zoomState.scale.toFixed(1)}x`}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View style={[styles.largeAvatarFallback, { borderColor: accentLip, backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#ECFEFF' : '#070C14' }]}>
          <Text style={[styles.largeAvatarInitial, { color: accentLip }]}>{String(resolvedName || 'K').charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</Text>
        </View>
      )}
      <Text style={[styles.emptyOwnerTitle, { color: surfaceInk }]}>{resolvedName}</Text>
      <Text style={[styles.emptyOwnerDesc, { color: hintInk }]}>
        {isEn
          ? 'This profile has no stories posted in the last 24 hours. (Tap the photo above to enlarge)'
          : 'Este perfil no tiene historias publicadas en las últimas 24 horas. (Toca la foto superior para ampliar)'}
      </Text>
      {onPrimaryAction && primaryActionLabel && (
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={handlePrimaryCtaPress}
          style={[
            styles.primaryCyanBtn,
            { backgroundColor: '#00F0FF', borderBottomColor: '#0369A1', borderBottomWidth: 3.5, marginBottom: 14 },
          ]}
        >
          <Text style={[styles.primaryCyanBtnText, { color: '#050505' } as TextStyle]}>{primaryActionLabel}</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      )}
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={onClose}
        style={[
          styles.closeViewerGhostBtn,
          isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8', borderBottomWidth: 3 },
        ]}
      >
        <Text style={[styles.closeViewerGhostText, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>
          {isEn ? 'CLOSE VIEW' : 'CERRAR VISTA'}
        </Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>
  );
};

export const KineticAvatarZoomModal = KineticStoryEmptyProfileView;

export interface KineticStoryInsightsSheetProps {

export const KineticStoryInsightsSheet: React.FC<KineticStoryInsightsSheetProps> = ({

  return (

            <Text style={styles.insightsKpiLabel}>{isEn ? 'ENERGY' : 'ENERGÍA'}</Text>
          </View>

};

    import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Dimensions, Platform, Pressable, ScrollView, StatusBar, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, useWindowDimensions, View, type ViewProps } from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { IKineticStoryItem, STORY_TAG_EN_MAP, STORY_TAG_PRESETS } from '../../services/kineticStoriesService';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from './KineticModalHeader3D';
import { KineticStoryInsightsSheet } from './KineticStoryInsightsSheet';
import { styles } from './KineticStoriesModal.styles';

interface PromoEventRef {
  id?: string;
  nombre_servicio?: string;
  titulo?: string;
  precio_kc?: number;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface StudioViewProps {
  draftImageUri: string; draftCaption: string; setDraftCaption: (val: string) => void;
  draftTag: string; setDraftTag: (val: string) => void; isPickingOrSaving: boolean;
  resolvedAccent: string; isEn: boolean; handlePickPhoto: () => void;
  handlePublishStory: () => void; onCloseStudio?: () => void;
  availableEvents?: PromoEventRef[]; selectedPromoEvent?: PromoEventRef | null; setSelectedPromoEvent?: (ev: PromoEventRef | null) => void;
}

export const KineticStoryStudioView: React.FC<StudioViewProps> = ({
  draftImageUri, draftCaption, setDraftCaption, draftTag, setDraftTag,
  isPickingOrSaving, resolvedAccent, isEn, handlePickPhoto, handlePublishStory, onCloseStudio,
  availableEvents, selectedPromoEvent, setSelectedPromoEvent,
}) => {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const { isLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  const safeTopPad = Math.max(insets.top + 14, Platform.OS === 'android' ? (StatusBar.currentHeight || 24) + 14 : 0, 48);
  const displayDraftTag = isEn ? STORY_TAG_EN_MAP[draftTag] || draftTag : draftTag;
  const mediaLockProps: Record<string, unknown> = { dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } };
  const darkInkProps: Record<string, unknown> = { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };
  const studioAccentInk = isLightMode ? '#0369A1' : resolvedAccent;
  const studioPrimaryTxt = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const studioMutedTxt = isLightMode ? '#334155' : '#CBD5E1';

  return (
    <View style={[styles.studioOverlayWrap, { paddingTop: safeTopPad }, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.42)' }]}>
      {onCloseStudio && <Pressable style={styles.sheetBackdropTap} onPress={onCloseStudio} />}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.studioSheet,
          KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS,
          { borderTopColor: studioAccentInk },
          isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8', borderBottomWidth: 3, shadowColor: '#0369A1', shadowOpacity: 0.16 },
        ]}
      >
        <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={onCloseStudio} accentColor={studioAccentInk} />
        <View style={[styles.studioPreviewArea, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC' }]}>
          {draftImageUri ? (
            <View style={[styles.studioPreviewFrame916, { borderColor: resolvedAccent }]} {...mediaLockProps}>
              <Image source={{ uri: draftImageUri }} style={styles.fullStoryImage} contentFit="cover" cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} />
              <View style={[styles.studioPreviewOverlayBadge, { borderColor: resolvedAccent }]}>
                <Text style={[styles.studioPreviewOverlayText, { color: resolvedAccent }]}>⚡ {displayDraftTag}</Text>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.studioPreviewCaptionGhost}>
                <Text style={styles.studioPreviewCaptionGhostTxt} numberOfLines={2}>
                  {draftCaption.trim() || (isEn ? 'Training today in the Kinetic network ⚡' : 'Entrenando hoy en la red Kinetic ⚡')}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={[styles.emptyBlackCanvas, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderRadius: 20, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderBottomWidth: 3.5, borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }]}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.cameraCircleIcon,
                  { borderColor: studioAccentInk },
                  isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF' },
                ]}
              >
                <Feather name="camera" size={34} color={studioAccentInk} />
              </View>
              <Text style={[styles.studioTitle, { color: studioPrimaryTxt }]}>{isEn ? '24H STORY STUDIO' : 'ESTUDIO DE HISTORIA 24H'}</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.studioSubtitle, { color: studioMutedTxt }]}>
                {isEn
                  ? 'Choose a photo from your gallery or camera to preview it in crisp 9:16 format with your custom tag and message.'
                  : 'Selecciona una fotografía de tu galería o cámara para previsualizarla en formato 9:16 nítido con tu etiqueta y mensaje.'}
              </Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={handlePickPhoto} disabled={isPickingOrSaving} style={[styles.primaryCyanBtn, { backgroundColor: '#00F0FF', borderBottomColor: '#0369A1', borderBottomWidth: 3.5 }]} activeOpacity={0.85} {...darkInkProps}>
                {isPickingOrSaving ? <ActivityIndicator color="#050505" size="small" /> : (
                  <>
                    <Feather name="image" size={16} color="#050505" style={{ color: '#050505' }} />
                    <Text style={[styles.primaryCyanBtnText, { color: '#050505' }]}>{isEn ? '+ CHOOSE PHOTO FROM GALLERY' : '+ ELEGIR FOTOGRAFÍA DE GALERÍA'}</Text>
                  </>
                )}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {Boolean(draftImageUri) && (
          <View style={[styles.editorBottomSheet, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8', borderBottomWidth: 3 }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.editorSheetTitle, isLightMode && { color: '#0369A1' }]}>
              {isEn ? 'CUSTOMIZE YOUR 24H STORY (9:16 PREVIEW)' : 'PERSONALIZA TU HISTORIA 24H (VISTA 9:16)'}
            </Text>
            {Array.isArray(availableEvents) && availableEvents.length > 0 && setSelectedPromoEvent && (
              <>
                <Text style={[styles.editorLabel, isLightMode && { color: '#475569' }]}>
                  {isEn ? 'LINK EVENT (OPTIONAL PROMO)' : 'VINCULAR EVENTO (PROMO OPCIONAL)'}
                </Text>
                <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} style={styles.tagsScroll} contentContainerStyle={styles.tagsScrollContent}>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    onPress={() => { setSelectedPromoEvent(null); if (draftTag === '⚡ PROMO CLUB') setDraftTag(STORY_TAG_PRESETS[0]); }}
                    style={[
                      styles.tagChip,
                      isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8', elevation: 0 },
                      !selectedPromoEvent && { backgroundColor: COLORS.cyan, borderColor: '#0369A1', borderBottomColor: '#0369A1' },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.tagChipText, isLightMode && { color: '#0F172A' }, !selectedPromoEvent && { color: '#050505', fontWeight: '900' }]}>
                      {isEn ? 'Normal Story (Cyan)' : 'Historia Normal (Cian)'}
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  {availableEvents.map((ev: PromoEventRef) => {
                    const isLinked = String(selectedPromoEvent?.id || '') === String(ev?.id || '');
                    const evTitle = String(ev?.nombre_servicio || ev?.titulo || 'Kinetic').trim();
                    return (
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        key={String(ev?.id || evTitle)}
                        onPress={() => { setSelectedPromoEvent(isLinked ? null : ev); setDraftTag(isLinked ? STORY_TAG_PRESETS[0] : '⚡ PROMO CLUB'); }}
                        style={[
                          styles.tagChip,

'#F59E0B' : COLORS.cyan, borderBottomColor: selectedPromoEvent ? '#B45309' : '#0369A1', borderBottomWidth: 3.5, opacity: isPickingOrSaving ? 0.78 : 1 }]} {...darkInkProps}>

export const KineticStoryViewerStage = ({
  activeStory, storiesCount, currentIndex, setCurrentIndex, setProgress, setIsPaused,
  reactionToast, resolvedAccent, isEn, canUpload, hasReactedFire, hasReactedBolt,
  handleToggleReaction, onClose, onPrimaryAction, primaryActionLabel, closeActionTimerRef,
}: {
  activeStory: IKineticStoryItem; storiesCount: number; currentIndex: number;
  setCurrentIndex: (n: number) => void; setProgress: (n: number) => void; setIsPaused: (b: boolean) => void;
  reactionToast: string | null; resolvedAccent: string; isEn: boolean; canUpload: boolean;
  hasReactedFire: boolean; hasReactedBolt: boolean; handleToggleReaction: (t: 'fire' | 'bolt') => void;
  onClose: () => void; onPrimaryAction?: () => void; primaryActionLabel?: string;
  closeActionTimerRef?: React.MutableRefObject<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>;
}) => {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const safeTopPad = Math.max(insets.top + 14, Platform.OS === 'android' ? (StatusBar.currentHeight || 24) + 14 : 0, 48);
  const { width: winW, height: winH } = useWindowDimensions();
  const stageW = Math.max(320, Math.round(winW));
  const stageH = Math.max(480, Math.round(winH));
  const [isInsightsOpen, setIsInsightsOpen] = useState(false);
  const fallbackCtaTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    if (fallbackCtaTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(fallbackCtaTimerRef.current);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const uri = String(activeStory?.imageUrl || '').trim();
    const prefetchFn = (Image as unknown as { prefetch?: (u: string) => Promise<boolean> }).prefetch;
    if (uri && /^https?:\/\//i.test(uri) && typeof prefetchFn === 'function') {
      try { void prefetchFn(uri); } catch {}
    }
  }, [activeStory?.imageUrl]);

  const handlePrimaryCtaPress = () => {
    if (!onPrimaryAction) return;
    const actionFn = onPrimaryAction;
    const timerRef = closeActionTimerRef || fallbackCtaTimerRef;
    if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    // Ejecutar apertura destino y cierre en el mismo commit para cero flash fantasma al saltar al Muro
    actionFn();
    onClose();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsInsightsOpen(false);
  }, [activeStory?.id, currentIndex]);

  const viewsTotal = Math.max(Number(activeStory.viewCount || 0), (activeStory.viewedBy || []).length);
  const viewersList = activeStory.viewedBy || [];
  const closeInsights = () => {
    setIsInsightsOpen(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
  };

  return (
    <View style={[styles.viewerStage, { backgroundColor: '#05060A', width: Math.min(stageW, 480), height: stageH }]} {...({ dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } as unknown as ViewProps)}>
      <Pressable
        onPressIn={() => setIsPaused(true)}
        onPressOut={() => { if (!isInsightsOpen) setIsPaused(false); }}
        onPress={(evt) => {
          if (isInsightsOpen) return;
          const screenW = Dimensions.get('window').width;
          const tapX = evt.nativeEvent.locationX || screenW * 0.6;
          if (tapX < screenW * 0.33) {
            if (currentIndex > 0) setCurrentIndex(currentIndex - 1);
            setProgress(0);
          } else if (currentIndex < storiesCount - 1) {
            setCurrentIndex(currentIndex + 1);
            setProgress(0);
          } else {
            onClose();
          }
        }}
        style={styles.storyTapArea}
      >
        <Image source={{ uri: activeStory.imageUrl }} style={[styles.fullStoryImage, { width: Math.min(stageW, 480), height: stageH }]} contentFit="cover" cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} />
      </Pressable>
      {reactionToast && (
        <View style={styles.reactionToastBox} pointerEvents="none">
          <Text style={styles.reactionToastText}>{reactionToast}</Text>
        </View>
      )}
      <View style={[styles.bottomCaptionCard, !activeStory.caption?.trim() && { backgroundColor: 'rgba(6, 10, 18, 0.62)', paddingVertical: 10 }]}>
        <View style={styles.tagAndCounterRow}>
          <View style={[styles.storyTagBadge, { borderColor: resolvedAccent }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.storyTagBadgeText, { color: resolvedAccent }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              ⚡ {isEn ? STORY_TAG_EN_MAP[activeStory.tag] || (activeStory.tag === 'ENTRENAMIENTO DEL DÍA' ? 'TODAY’S WORKOUT' : activeStory.tag) : (activeStory.tag === 'TODAY’S WORKOUT' || activeStory.tag === "TODAY'S WORKOUT" ? 'ENTRENAMIENTO DEL DÍA' : activeStory.tag)}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.navArrowsRow}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => { if (currentIndex > 0) { setCurrentIndex(currentIndex - 1); setProgress(0); } }}
              disabled={currentIndex === 0}
              style={[styles.arrowCircleBtn, currentIndex === 0 && { opacity: 0.35 }]}
            >
              <Feather name="chevron-left" size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text style={styles.storyIndexCounter}>{currentIndex + 1}/{storiesCount}</Text>
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => {
                if (currentIndex < storiesCount - 1) { setCurrentIndex(currentIndex + 1); setProgress(0); }
                else onClose();
              }}
              style={styles.arrowCircleBtn}
            >
              <Feather name="chevron-right" size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
        {Boolean(activeStory.caption && activeStory.caption.trim()) && (
          <Text style={styles.captionBodyText} numberOfLines={2}>{activeStory.caption.trim()}</Text>
        )}
        <View style={styles.reactionsRow}>
          {canUpload && (
            <TouchableOpacity
              activeOpacity={0.82}
              onPress={() => { setIsPaused(true); setIsInsightsOpen(true); }}
              style={[styles.reactionBtn, { borderColor: COLORS.cyan, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.14)', elevation: 0 }]}
            >
              <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.reactionBtnText, { fontSize: 12.5, color: COLORS.cyan }]}>
                👁️ {viewsTotal} {isEn ? 'Views' : 'Vistas'}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => handleToggleReaction('fire')}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            style={[styles.reactionBtn, { elevation: 0 }, hasReactedFire && { borderColor: '#FF6B35', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.16)' }]}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={styles.reactionBtnText}>🔥 {Number(activeStory.fireCount || 0)}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => handleToggleReaction('bolt')}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            style={[styles.reactionBtn, { elevation: 0 }, hasReactedBolt && { borderColor: COLORS.cyan, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.16)' }]}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={styles.reactionBtnText}>⚡ {Number(activeStory.boltCount || 0)}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
        {onPrimaryAction && primaryActionLabel && (
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={handlePrimaryCtaPress}
            activeOpacity={0.86}
            {...((primaryActionLabel.includes('EVENT') || primaryActionLabel.includes('EVENTO')) ? ({ dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } } as Record<string, unknown>) : {})}
            style={[
              styles.primaryCtaBtn,
              { borderColor: resolvedAccent },
              (primaryActionLabel.includes('EVENT') || primaryActionLabel.includes('EVENTO')) && {
                backgroundColor: '#F59E0B', borderColor: '#FDE68A', borderTopColor: '#FEF3C7', borderBottomColor: '#FF6B00', elevation: 6,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Text selectable={false} style={[styles.primaryCtaBtnText, { color: (primaryActionLabel.includes('EVENT') || primaryActionLabel.includes('EVENTO')) ? '#050505' : resolvedAccent }]}>
              {primaryActionLabel}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>

      {isInsightsOpen && canUpload && (
        <KineticStoryInsightsSheet
          activeStory={activeStory}
          safeTopPad={safeTopPad}
          resolvedAccent={resolvedAccent}
          isEn={isEn}
          onClose={closeInsights}
        />
      )}
    </View>
  );
};

export { KineticStoryEmptyProfileView, KineticAvatarZoomModal } from './KineticStoryAvatarZoomLeaf';

export const KineticBounceSplashOverlay = ({
  visible = false,
  size = 150,
}: {
  visible?: boolean;
  size?: number;
  style?: Record<string, unknown>;
}) => {
  const bounce = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return;
    const loop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(bounce, { toValue: 1, duration: 900, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: false }),
        Animated.timing(bounce, { toValue: 0, duration: 900, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: false }),
      ])
    );
    loop.start();
    return () => loop.stop();
  }, [visible, bounce]);

  if (!visible) return null;
  const scale = bounce.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.96, 1.05] });

  return (
    <View style={baseSt.splashOverlayFull}>
      <Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ scale }], alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
        <Image source={KINETIC_LOGO} style={{ width: size, height: size }} contentFit="contain" />
      </Animated.View>
    </View>
  );
};

export const KineticSplashVault3D = ({ size = 185 }: { size?: number }) => {
  return <KineticBounceSplashOverlay visible={true} size={size} />;
};

/** Acota squashX suavemente a [0.96, 1.08] sin aplastamiento horizontal ni NaN (#23). */
export const clampChestSquashX = (value: unknown): number => {
  const n = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 1;
  return Math.max(0.96, Math.min(1.08, n));
};

// COFRE MISTERIOSO 3D POLIÉDRICO SÓLIDO CERRADO (PAINTER'S Z-BUFFER + PBR)
export const KineticVolumetricChest3D = ({
  tapCount = 0, chargeStage, isOpened = false, isActive = true, onTapChest, onPress, onReplay, isAdmin, hideRarityBadge = false,
  lockedTier, lockedPillLabel, rewardVisualKind = 'xp', onDragActiveChange, compactMode = false,
}: {
  tapCount?: number; chargeStage?: number; isOpened?: boolean; isActive?: boolean;
  onTapChest?: () => void; onPress?: () => void; onReplay?: () => void; isAdmin?: boolean; hideRarityBadge?: boolean;
  lockedTier?: 'bronze' | 'silver' | 'gold' | 'platinum'; lockedPillLabel?: string;
  rewardVisualKind?: 'kc' | 'xp'; onDragActiveChange?: (active: boolean) => void; compactMode?: boolean; [key: string]: unknown;
}) => {
  const { user: authUser, profile: authProfile } = useAuth();
  const { tx, isLightMode, resolvedTheme } = useKineticPreferences();
  const st = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseSt, resolvedTheme, CHEST_MEDIA_LOCK), [resolvedTheme]);
  const uMail = String(authUser?.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const pMail = String(authProfile?.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const pRol = String(authProfile?.rol || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const pTipo = String(authProfile?.tipo_cuenta || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const appRol = String(authUser?.app_metadata?.rol || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const authIsAdmin = Boolean(authUser?.id) && (ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(uMail) || ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(pMail) || ADMIN_ROLES.includes(pRol) || ADMIN_ROLES.includes(pTipo) || ADMIN_ROLES.includes(appRol));
  const effectiveIsAdmin = isAdmin === false ? false : Boolean(typeof isAdmin === 'boolean' ? (isAdmin && authIsAdmin) : authIsAdmin);
  const rawStage = typeof chargeStage === 'number' ? chargeStage : tapCount;
  const chargeStep = isOpened || rawStage >= 3 ? 3 : rawStage === 2 ? 2 : rawStage === 1 ? 1 : 0;
  const rarityStep = chargeStep === 3 ? 3 : chargeStep === 2 ? 2 : 1;

  const shakeX = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const tiltZ = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const shockwaveAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const particlesLoop = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const raysPulse = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const wasOpenedRef = useRef(Boolean(isOpened));
  const onDragActiveChangeRef = useRef(onDragActiveChange);
  onDragActiveChangeRef.current = onDragActiveChange;

  const baseYaw = chargeStep === 2 ? -24 : chargeStep === 3 ? -32 : -28;
  const physicsRef = useRef({
    yawDeg: baseYaw,
    pitchDeg: -18,
    omegaYaw: 14,
    omegaPitch: 0,
    hingeAngleDeg: isOpened ? CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG : 0,
    hingeOmegaDeg: 0,
    hopHeightPx: 0,
    velY: 0,
    squashY: 1,
    squashVel: 0,
    revealProgress01: isOpened ? 1 : 0,
    isDragging: false,
  });
  const [renderFrame, setRenderFrame] = useState(() => ({
    yawDeg: baseYaw,
    pitchDeg: -18,
    hingeAngleDeg: isOpened ? CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG : 0,
    hopHeightPx: 0,
    scaleX: 1,
    scaleY: 1,
    shadowScale: 1,
    shadowOpacity: 0.62,
    revealProgress01: isOpened ? 1 : 0,
    spinSpeedDegPerSec: 14,
  }));

  useEffect(() => () => { onDragActiveChangeRef.current?.(false); }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isActive === false) return;
    const rLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(raysPulse, { toValue: 1, duration: 920, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.sin), useNativeDriver: false }),
        Animated.timing(raysPulse, { toValue: 0, duration: 920, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.sin), useNativeDriver: false }),
      ])
    );
    rLoop.start();
    return () => rLoop.stop();
  }, [isActive, raysPulse]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isActive === false || !isOpened) return;
    particlesLoop.setValue(0);
    const pLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.timing(particlesLoop, { toValue: 1, duration: 1850, easing: Easing.linear, useNativeDriver: false })
    );
    pLoop.start();
    return () => pLoop.stop();
  }, [isActive, isOpened, particlesLoop]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const p = physicsRef.current;
    if (rawStage === 0 && !isOpened) {
      wasOpenedRef.current = false;
      p.hingeAngleDeg = 0; p.hingeOmegaDeg = 0; p.hopHeightPx = 0; p.velY = 0;
      p.squashY = 1; p.squashVel = -0.2; p.revealProgress01 = 0;
      shakeX.setValue(0); tiltZ.setValue(0); shockwaveAnim.setValue(0);
      return;
    }
    if (isOpened && !wasOpenedRef.current) {
      p.revealProgress01 = 0.02;
      p.velY = 235;
      p.squashVel = -2.4;
      p.omegaYaw = 140;
    } else if (rawStage > 0 && !isOpened) {
      p.velY = Math.max(p.velY, 120 + rawStage * 28);
      p.squashVel = -1.6 - rawStage * 0.4;
      p.omegaYaw += rawStage % 2 === 0 ? -95 : 95;
    }
    wasOpenedRef.current = Boolean(isOpened);
    if (rawStage > 0 || isOpened) {
      const mult = isOpened || rawStage >= 3 ? 1.25 : rawStage === 2 ? 1 : 0.72;
      shockwaveAnim.setValue(0);
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.timing(shockwaveAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 520, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), useNativeDriver: false }),
        Animated.sequence([
          Animated.parallel([Animated.timing(shakeX, { toValue: -11 * mult, duration: 30, useNativeDriver: false }), Animated.timing(tiltZ, { toValue: -1 * mult, duration: 30, useNativeDriver: false })]),
          Animated.parallel([Animated.timing(shakeX, { toValue: 11 * mult, duration: 30, useNativeDriver: false }), Animated.timing(tiltZ, { toValue: 1 * mult, duration: 30, useNativeDriver: false })]),
          Animated.parallel([Animated.timing(shakeX, { toValue: -6 * mult, duration: 28, useNativeDriver: false }), Animated.timing(tiltZ, { toValue: -0.6 * mult, duration: 28, useNativeDriver: false })]),
          Animated.parallel([Animated.timing(shakeX, { toValue: 6 * mult, duration: 28, useNativeDriver: false }), Animated.timing(tiltZ, { toValue: 0.5 * mult, duration: 28, useNativeDriver: false })]),
          Animated.parallel([Animated.timing(shakeX, { toValue: 0, duration: 32, useNativeDriver: false }), Animated.timing(tiltZ, { toValue: 0, duration: 32, useNativeDriver: false })]),
        ]),
      ]).start();
    }
  }, [rawStage, isOpened, shakeX, tiltZ, shockwaveAnim]);

  const tierPaletteMap: Record<string, { main: string; bevel: string; dark: string; glow: string; pTxt: string; pBg: string }> = {
    bronze: { main: '#F4A261', bevel: '#FFEDD5', dark: '#9A3412', glow: 'rgba(244, 162, 97, 0.28)', pTxt: '#9A3412', pBg: '#FFEDD5' },
    silver: { main: '#CBD5E1', bevel: '#F8FAFC', dark: '#475569', glow: 'rgba(203, 213, 225, 0.24)', pTxt: '#334155', pBg: '#F1F5F9' },
    gold: { main: '#FFD700', bevel: '#FEF08A', dark: '#B45309', glow: 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.28)', pTxt: '#B45309', pBg: '#FEF3C7' },
    platinum: { main: '#00F0FF', bevel: '#CFFAFE', dark: '#007C91', glow: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.26)', pTxt: '#0369A1', pBg: '#E0F2FE' },
  };
  const lockedPal = lockedTier ? tierPaletteMap[lockedTier] : null;
  const trimMain = lockedPal ? lockedPal.main : rarityStep === 3 ? '#FFD700' : rarityStep === 2 ? '#C77DFF' : '#00F0FF';
  const trimBevel = lockedPal ? lockedPal.bevel : rarityStep === 3 ? '#FEF08A' : rarityStep === 2 ? '#F3E8FF' : '#CFFAFE';
  const trimDark = lockedPal ? lockedPal.dark : rarityStep === 3 ? '#B45309' : rarityStep === 2 ? '#6D28D9' : '#007C91';
  const coreGlow = lockedPal ? lockedPal.glow : rarityStep === 3 ? 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.28)' : rarityStep === 2 ? 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.26)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.22)';
  const pillText = isLightMode ? (lockedPal ? lockedPal.pTxt : rarityStep === 3 ? '#92400E' : rarityStep === 2 ? '#6D28D9' : '#006B82') : trimMain;
  const pillBg = isLightMode ? (lockedPal ? lockedPal.pBg : rarityStep === 3 ? '#FFFBEB' : rarityStep === 2 ? '#F5F3FF' : '#ECFEFF') : '#070B14';

  const rarityLabel = lockedPillLabel
    ? `${tx(`CARGA ${chargeStep}/3`, `CHARGE ${chargeStep}/3`)} • ${lockedPillLabel}`
    : chargeStep === 3
      ? tx('CARGA 3/3 • LEGENDARIO DORADO', 'CHARGE 3/3 • LEGENDARY GOLD')
      : chargeStep === 2
        ? tx('CARGA 2/3 • ÉPICO PÚRPURA', 'CHARGE 2/3 • EPIC PURPLE')
        : chargeStep === 1
          ? tx('CARGA 1/3 • COMÚN CIAN', 'CHARGE 1/3 • COMMON CYAN')
          : tx('CARGA 0/3 • TOCA EL COFRE', 'CHARGE 0/3 • TAP CHEST');

  const ejectLeftY = particlesLoop.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [6, -24] });
  const ejectCenterY = particlesLoop.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [4, -28] });
  const ejectRightY = particlesLoop.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [8, -22] });
  const ejectOpacity = particlesLoop.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 0.18, 0.82, 1], outputRange: [0, 1, 1, 0] });
  const raysScale = raysPulse.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.95, 1.07] });
  const shockScale = shockwaveAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.65, 1.55] });
  const shockScale2 = shockwaveAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.45, 1.95] });
  const shockOpacity = shockwaveAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 0.25, 1], outputRange: [0, 0.85, 0] });
  const shockOpacity2 = shockwaveAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 0.35, 1], outputRange: [0, 0.65, 0] });
  const tiltRotateZ = tiltZ.interpolate({ inputRange: [-1.5, 1.5], outputRange: ['-9deg', '9deg'] });
  const handlePress = onTapChest || onPress;

  const dragStartRef = useRef<{ yaw: number; pitch: number; moved: boolean }>({ yaw: baseYaw, pitch: -18, moved: false });
  const dragSamplesRef = useRef<IOrbitalSample[]>([]);
  const handlePressRef = useRef(handlePress);
  handlePressRef.current = handlePress;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isActive === false) return;
    let rafId = 0;
    let lastTs = Date.now();
    const tick = () => {
      const now = Date.now();
      const dtMs = Math.max(8, Math.min(48, now - lastTs));
      lastTs = now;
      const p = physicsRef.current;
      if (isOpened && p.revealProgress01 < 1) {
        p.revealProgress01 = Math.min(1, p.revealProgress01 + dtMs / 720);
      }
      const beat = compute5BeatRevealStage(p.revealProgress01, Boolean(isOpened));
      if (!p.isDragging) {
        const orb = stepOrbitalTurntablePhysics(
          { yawDeg: p.yawDeg, pitchDeg: p.pitchDeg, omegaYaw: p.omegaYaw, omegaPitch: p.omegaPitch },
          dtMs,
          { turntableHold: !isOpened || beat.turntableHoldActive, restPitchDeg: -18, minPitchDeg: -34, maxPitchDeg: 8 }
        );
        const orb360 = computeOrbitalChestFrame360({ angleDeg: orb.yawDeg, omegaDegPerSec: orb.omegaYaw, dtMs: 1 });
        p.yawDeg = orb360.angleDeg; p.pitchDeg = orb.pitchDeg; p.omegaYaw = orb.omegaYaw; p.omegaPitch = orb.omegaPitch;
      }
      const hinge = stepArticulatedHingeSpring({ angleDeg: p.hingeAngleDeg, omegaDeg: p.hingeOmegaDeg }, beat.targetHingeDeg, dtMs);
      p.hingeAngleDeg = hinge.angleDeg; p.hingeOmegaDeg = hinge.omegaDeg;
      const hop = stepBallisticHopAndSquash({ hopHeightPx: p.hopHeightPx, velY: p.velY, squashY: p.squashY, squashVel: p.squashVel }, dtMs);
      p.hopHeightPx = hop.hopHeightPx; p.velY = hop.velY; p.squashY = hop.squashY; p.squashVel = hop.squashVel;
      const liveSpinSpeed = p.isDragging
        ? computeSlidingWindowOrbitalVelocity(dragSamplesRef.current, now, 75).omegaYaw
        : p.omegaYaw;
      setRenderFrame({
        yawDeg: p.yawDeg,
        pitchDeg: p.pitchDeg,
        hingeAngleDeg: p.hingeAngleDeg,
        hopHeightPx: p.hopHeightPx,
        scaleX: clampChestSquashX(hop.scaleX),
        scaleY: hop.scaleY,
        shadowScale: hop.shadowScale,
        shadowOpacity: hop.shadowOpacity,
        revealProgress01: p.revealProgress01,
        spinSpeedDegPerSec: liveSpinSpeed,
      });
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
  }, [isActive, isOpened]);

  const chestPanResponder = useMemo(
    () =>
      PanResponder.create({
        onStartShouldSetPanResponder: () => true,
        onStartShouldSetPanResponderCapture: () => false,
        onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: (_evt, gs) => Math.abs(gs.dx) >= 7 || Math.abs(gs.dy) >= 7,
        onMoveShouldSetPanResponderCapture: (_evt, gs) => Math.abs(gs.dx) >= 7 || Math.abs(gs.dy) >= 7,
        onPanResponderTerminationRequest: () => false,
        onPanResponderGrant: () => {
          onDragActiveChangeRef.current?.(true);
          const p = physicsRef.current;
          p.isDragging = true; p.omegaYaw = 0; p.omegaPitch = 0;
          dragStartRef.current = { yaw: p.yawDeg, pitch: p.pitchDeg, moved: false };
          dragSamplesRef.current = [{ dx: 0, dy: 0, t: Date.now() }];
        },
        onPanResponderMove: (_evt, gs) => {
          const now = Date.now();
          dragSamplesRef.current.push({ dx: gs.dx, dy: gs.dy, t: now });
          if (dragSamplesRef.current.length > 10) dragSamplesRef.current.shift();
          if (Math.abs(gs.dx) >= 7 || Math.abs(gs.dy) >= 7) {
            dragStartRef.current.moved = true;
            physicsRef.current.yawDeg = ((dragStartRef.current.yaw + gs.dx * 0.9) % 360 + 360) % 360;
            physicsRef.current.pitchDeg = Math.max(-34, Math.min(8, dragStartRef.current.pitch + gs.dy * 0.22));
          }
        },
        onPanResponderRelease: (_evt, gs) => {
          onDragActiveChangeRef.current?.(false);
          const p = physicsRef.current;
          p.isDragging = false;
          const vel = computeSlidingWindowOrbitalVelocity(dragSamplesRef.current, Date.now(), 75);
          p.omegaYaw = vel.omegaYaw; p.omegaPitch = vel.omegaPitch;
          if (!dragStartRef.current.moved && Math.abs(gs.dx) < 7 && Math.abs(gs.dy) < 7) {
            handlePressRef.current?.();
          }
          dragStartRef.current.moved = false;
        },
        onPanResponderTerminate: () => {
          physicsRef.current.isDragging = false;
          onDragActiveChangeRef.current?.(false);
          dragStartRef.current.moved = false;
        },
      }),
    []
  );

  const activeBeat = compute5BeatRevealStage(renderFrame.revealProgress01, Boolean(isOpened));
  const showKcGoldBubbles = rewardVisualKind === 'kc';

  return (
    <View style={[st.chestOuterTouch, compactMode && { paddingTop: 12, paddingBottom: 2 }]}>
      {!hideRarityBadge && (
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.85}
          onPress={handlePress}
          disabled={!handlePress}
          style={[st.chestRarityPill, compactMode && { marginBottom: 8 }, { backgroundColor: pillBg, borderColor: trimMain, borderTopColor: trimBevel, borderBottomColor: trimDark }]}
        >
          <Ionicons name="flash" size={11} color={pillText} />
          <Text style={[st.chestRarityTxt, { color: pillText }]}>{rarityLabel}</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      )}

      <Animated.View
        {...chestPanResponder.panHandlers}
        onTouchEnd={() => onDragActiveChangeRef.current?.(false)}
        onTouchCancel={() => onDragActiveChangeRef.current?.(false)}
        style={[
          st.chestStage,
          compactMode && { height: 192 },
          Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ cursor: 'grab', touchAction: 'none', userSelect: 'none' } as unknown as ViewStyle) : null,
          { transform: [{ translateX: shakeX }, { rotateZ: tiltRotateZ }, { scaleX: renderFrame.scaleX }, { scaleY: renderFrame.scaleY }] },
        ]}
      >
        <Animated.View pointerEvents="none" style={[st.auraCircle, { borderColor: trimMain, backgroundColor: coreGlow, transform: [{ scale: raysScale }] }]} />
        <Animated.View pointerEvents="none" style={[st.shockwaveRing, { borderColor: trimMain, opacity: shockOpacity, transform: [{ scale: shockScale }] }]} />
        <Animated.View pointerEvents="none" style={[st.shockwaveRing, { borderColor: rarityStep === 3 ? '#00F0FF' : '#FFD700', borderWidth: 2, opacity: shockOpacity2, transform: [{ scale: shockScale2 }] }]} />

        {isOpened && (
          <View pointerEvents="none" style={st.floatingCoinsLayer}>
            {showKcGoldBubbles ? (
              <Animated.View style={[st.coinBubbleGold, { left: 42, top: 10, opacity: ejectOpacity, transform: [{ translateY: ejectLeftY }] }]}>
                <Text style={st.coinBubbleTxt}>KC</Text>
              </Animated.View>
            ) : (
              <Animated.View style={[st.coinBubbleCyan, { left: 42, top: 10, opacity: ejectOpacity, transform: [{ translateY: ejectLeftY }] }]}>
                <Text style={st.coinBubbleTxt}>+XP</Text>
              </Animated.View>
            )}
            <Animated.View style={[st.coinBubbleCyan, { left: 86, top: 0, opacity: ejectOpacity, transform: [{ translateY: ejectCenterY }] }]}>
              <Ionicons name="flash" size={13} color="#050505" />
            </Animated.View>
            <Animated.View style={[st.coinBubbleCyan, { right: 86, top: 0, opacity: ejectOpacity, transform: [{ translateY: ejectCenterY }] }]}>
              <Ionicons name="sparkles" size={11} color="#050505" />
            </Animated.View>
            <Animated.View style={[showKcGoldBubbles ? st.coinBubbleGold : st.coinBubblePurple, { right: 42, top: 12, opacity: ejectOpacity, transform: [{ translateY: ejectRightY }] }]}>
              <Text style={[st.coinBubbleTxt, !showKcGoldBubbles && { color: '#FFFFFF' }]}>+XP</Text>
            </Animated.View>
          </View>
        )}

        <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.92} disabled={!handlePress} onPress={() => { if (!dragStartRef.current.moved) handlePressRef.current?.(); }}>
          <KineticSolidChest3DEngine
            chargeStep={chargeStep}
            rarityStep={rarityStep}
            isOpened={Boolean(isOpened)}
            trimMain={trimMain}
            trimBevel={trimBevel}
            trimDark={trimDark}
            coreGlow={coreGlow}
            yawDeg={renderFrame.yawDeg}
            pitchDeg={renderFrame.pitchDeg}
            hingeAngleDeg={renderFrame.hingeAngleDeg}
            hopHeightPx={renderFrame.hopHeightPx}
            shadowScale={renderFrame.shadowScale}
            shadowOpacity={renderFrame.shadowOpacity}
            keyLightBoost={activeBeat.keyLightBoost}
            rimLightBoost={activeBeat.rimBoost}
            pedestalGlow01={activeBeat.pedestalGlow01}
            rewardVisualKind={rewardVisualKind}
            spinSpeedDegPerSec={renderFrame.spinSpeedDegPerSec}
            burstProgress01={renderFrame.revealProgress01}
          />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </Animated.View>

      <Text selectable={false} style={{ fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: '800', letterSpacing: 0.7, color: isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8', marginTop: compactMode ? 2 : 4 }}>
        {isOpened
          ? tx('↻ ARRASTRA 360° PARA INSPECCIONAR', '↻ DRAG 360° TO INSPECT')
          : tx('↻ ARRASTRA 360° • TOCA PARA ABRIR', '↻ DRAG 360° • TAP TO OPEN')}
      </Text>

      {effectiveIsAdmin === true && onReplay ? (
        <TouchableOpacity style={[st.chestRarityPill, { marginTop: 8, marginBottom: 0, backgroundColor: pillBg, borderColor: trimMain, borderTopColor: trimBevel, borderBottomColor: trimDark }]} activeOpacity={0.85} onPress={onReplay}>
          <Feather name="refresh-cw" size={11} color={pillText} />
          <Text style={[st.chestRarityTxt, { color: pillText }]}>{tx('VOLVER A REPRODUCIR ANIMACIÓN', 'REPLAY ANIMATION')}</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
};
