import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {
  BONUS_XP_KEY_PREFIX,
  CLAIMED_RETOS_KEY_PREFIX,
  DAILY_BOX_KEY_PREFIX,
  OPENED_BOXES_KEY_PREFIX,
  STREAK_SHIELD_KEY_PREFIX,
} from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';

export async function runRewardRpcWithRetry(fnName: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
    const res = await supabase.rpc(fnName, args);
    const code = String((res.error as { code?: unknown } | null)?.code || '').trim();
    const msg = String(res.error?.message || '');
    const isTransient = Boolean(res.error && !code && /network|fetch|timeout|tempor/i.test(msg));
    if (!res.error || !isTransient || attempt === 1) return res;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 350));
  }
  return supabase.rpc(fnName, args);
}

export function mergeClaimKeys(prevList: unknown, keys: string[]): string[] {
  const base = Array.isArray(prevList) ? prevList.map((v) => String(v)) : [];
  return Array.from(new Set([...base, ...keys.map((k) => String(k || '').trim()).filter(Boolean)]));
}

export function extractClaimedLevelBoxNumbers(claimedList: unknown): Set<number> {
  const out = new Set<number>();
  if (!Array.isArray(claimedList)) return out;
  for (const item of claimedList) {
    const m = /^caja_nivel_(\d+)$/i.exec(String(item || '').trim());
    if (m) {
      const n = Number(m[1]);
      if (Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 990) out.add(n);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export function findNextUnclaimedLevelBoxNum(claimedList: unknown, totalBoxesEarned: number): number | null {
  const maxN = Math.max(0, Math.min(990, Math.floor(Number(totalBoxesEarned) || 0)));
  const claimed = extractClaimedLevelBoxNumbers(claimedList);
  for (let n = 1; n <= maxN; n++) {
    if (!claimed.has(n)) return n;
  }
  return null;
}

export async function persistDailyRewardStorage(uid: string, today: string, xp: number): Promise<void> {
  await Promise.all([
    AsyncStorage.setItem(`${DAILY_BOX_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`, today),
    AsyncStorage.setItem(`${STREAK_SHIELD_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`, today),
    AsyncStorage.setItem(`${BONUS_XP_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`, String(xp)),
  ]);
}

export async function persistTrophyRewardStorage(uid: string, claimed: string[], xp: number): Promise<void> {
  await Promise.all([
    AsyncStorage.setItem(`${CLAIMED_RETOS_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`, JSON.stringify(claimed)),
    AsyncStorage.setItem(`${BONUS_XP_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`, String(xp)),
  ]);
}

export async function persistBoxRewardStorage(uid: string, opened: number, xp: number): Promise<void> {
  await Promise.all([
    AsyncStorage.setItem(`${OPENED_BOXES_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`, String(opened)),
    AsyncStorage.setItem(`${BONUS_XP_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`, String(xp)),
  ]);
}

export type RewardHapticFn = (type?: string) => void;
export type TacticalAlertCallback = (title: string, msg: string, type?: string) => void;

export function toRewardErrMsg(err: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (err && typeof err === 'object' && 'message' in err) {
    const m = String((err as { message?: unknown }).message || '').trim();
    if (m) return m;
  }
  return fallback;
}

export function resolveShieldErrorMessage(
  payload: Record<string, unknown> | null,
  error: { message?: string } | null,
  tx: (es: string, en: string) => string
): string {
  const rawErr = String(payload?.error || payload?.message || error?.message || '');
  if (/kc|saldo|balance|insufic/i.test(rawErr)) {
    return tx(
      'Ya usaste tu escudo mensual gratis. Necesitas 25 KC en tu Bóveda para activar un escudo adicional.',
      'You already used your free monthly shield. You need 25 KC in your Wallet for an extra shield.'
    );
  }
  return rawErr || tx('No se pudo activar el escudo de racha. Intenta de nuevo.', 'Could not activate streak shield. Please try again.');
}

export function buildShieldActivatedProfilePatch<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  prevProfile: T,
  payload: Record<string, unknown> | null,
  claimedKeys: string[]
): T {
  const activeUntil =
    typeof payload?.activo_hasta === 'string' ? payload.activo_hasta : (prevProfile.escudo_activo_hasta as string | undefined);
  return {
    ...prevProfile,
    is_streak_frozen: true,
    escudo_activo_hasta: activeUntil,
    escudo_racha_activo_hasta: activeUntil,
    escudo_mes_iso: typeof payload?.escudo_mes_iso === 'string' ? payload.escudo_mes_iso : prevProfile.escudo_mes_iso,
    escudos_usados_mes:
      payload?.escudos_usados_mes !== undefined ? Number(payload.escudos_usados_mes) : prevProfile.escudos_usados_mes,
    kc_membresia: payload?.kc_membresia !== undefined ? Number(payload.kc_membresia) : prevProfile.kc_membresia,
    kc_topup: payload?.kc_topup !== undefined ? Number(payload.kc_topup) : prevProfile.kc_topup,
    saldo_kc: payload?.saldo_kc !== undefined ? Number(payload.saldo_kc) : prevProfile.saldo_kc,
    recompensas_reclamadas: claimedKeys,
  };
}

export function buildClaimedProfilePatch<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  prevProfile: T,
  opts: { kcDelta?: number; kcTopupOverride?: number; xpTotal: number; claimedKeys: string[]; freezeStreak?: boolean }
): T {
  return {
    ...prevProfile,
    kc_topup:
      opts.kcTopupOverride !== undefined
        ? opts.kcTopupOverride
        : Math.max(0, Number(prevProfile.kc_topup) || 0) + (opts.kcDelta || 0),
    xp_total: Math.max(Number(prevProfile.xp_total) || 0, opts.xpTotal),
    ...(opts.freezeStreak ? { is_streak_frozen: true } : {}),
    recompensas_reclamadas: mergeClaimKeys(prevProfile.recompensas_reclamadas, opts.claimedKeys),
  };
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

const getFutureIsoOffset = (daysAhead: number): string => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + daysAhead);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

const toPromoItem = (srv: any, bookedBySrv?: Map<string, number>) => {
  const clubName = String(srv?.negocio_nombre || 'Kinetic Oficial').trim();
  const aff = (KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES || []).find((a: any) => String(a?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase() === clubName.toLowerCase()) || null;
  const cat = String(srv?.categoria || srv?.disciplina || aff?.disciplina || 'Fuerza').trim();
  const titulo = String(srv?.nombre_servicio || srv?.titulo || 'Sesión Élite Kinetic').trim();
  const cover = srv?.imagen_url || srv?.portada_url || aff?.portada_url || resolveCategoryImage(cat, titulo);
  const { precio_kc: precioKc, escrow40 } = computePromoPricingKc(srv?.precio_kc ?? srv?.precio ?? 180);
  const cupoMax = Math.max(1, Number(srv?.cupo_maximo) || 12);
  const srvCount = bookedBySrv?.get(titulo.toLowerCase()) || 0;
  const cuposOcupados = Math.min(cupoMax, Math.max(Number(srv?.cupo_actual ?? srv?.cupos_ocupados) || 0, srvCount));
  const loc = srv?.ubicacion || aff?.ubicacion || 'Ubicación Verificada';
  const fecha = String(srv?.fecha || getFutureIsoOffset(1)).slice(0, 10);
  const hora_inicio = srv?.hora_inicio || '08:00';
  const instructor_nombre = srv?.instructor_nombre || 'Coach Oficial Kinetic';
  const rating = Number(srv?.rating || aff?.rating || 5.0);
  const rawService = { ...srv, id: String(srv.id), nombre_servicio: titulo, titulo, negocio_nombre: clubName, categoria: cat, disciplina: cat, fecha, hora_inicio, precio_kc: precioKc, cupo_maximo: cupoMax, cupo_actual: cuposOcupados, reservadosCount: cuposOcupados, ubicacion: loc, portada_url: cover, imagen_url: cover, instructor_nombre, rating, estado: 'aprobado', avatar_club: aff?.avatar_url || null };
  return { id: String(srv.id), titulo, nombre_servicio: titulo, negocio_nombre: clubName, categoria: cat, disciplina: cat, fecha, hora_inicio, precio_kc: precioKc, escrow40, cupo_maximo: cupoMax, cupos_ocupados: cuposOcupados, ubicacion: loc, portada_url: cover, imagen_url: cover, instructor_nombre, nivel_acceso: srv?.nivel_acceso || 'Acceso Base', rating, affiliate: aff, rawService };
};

const mapServicesToClubPromos = (rawServices: any[], mergedReservas: any[]): any[] => {
  const bookedBySrv = new Map<string, number>();
  mergedReservas.forEach((r: any) => {
    if (String(r?.estado || '').toLowerCase() === 'cancelada') return;
    const key = String(r?.servicio || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (key) bookedBySrv.set(key, (bookedBySrv.get(key) || 0) + 1);
  });
  const todayIso = getTodayISO();
  const approved = (rawServices || []).filter((s: any) => ['aprobado', 'activo'].includes(String(s?.estado || 'aprobado').toLowerCase()));
  if (approved.length === 0) return [];
  const sorted = [...approved].sort((a, b) => {
    const fa = String(a?.fecha || '').slice(0, 10), fb = String(b?.fecha || '').slice(0, 10);
    const aUp = fa >= todayIso ? 0 : 1, bUp = fb >= todayIso ? 0 : 1;
    return aUp !== bUp ? aUp - bUp : fa.localeCompare(fb);
  });
  return sorted.slice(0, 12).map((srv: any) => toPromoItem(srv, bookedBySrv));
};

export interface IUseKinetiClubHydrationParams {
  user: any; profile: any; refreshProfile?: () => Promise<void>; isMountedRef: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  rachaRef: MutableRefObject<number>; levelRef: MutableRefObject<number>;
  bonusXpRef: MutableRefObject<number>; claimedIdsRef: MutableRefObject<string[]>; openedBoxesRef: MutableRefObject<number>;
  syncSquadsRef: MutableRefObject<(preferredSquadId?: string) => Promise<void>>;
  setClaimedChallengeIds: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string[]>>; setDailyClaimedToday: Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  setIsStreakFrozenToday: Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>; setBonusXp: Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>;
  setOpenedBoxesCount: Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>;
}

export function useKinetiClubHydration(p: IUseKinetiClubHydrationParams) {
  const { user, profile, refreshProfile, isMountedRef, rachaRef, levelRef, bonusXpRef, claimedIdsRef, openedBoxesRef, syncSquadsRef, setClaimedChallengeIds, setDailyClaimedToday, setIsStreakFrozenToday, setBonusXp, setOpenedBoxesCount } = p;
  const [isFetching, setIsFetching] = useState(false);
  const [hasInitialLoaded, setHasInitialLoaded] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [rawPerfilesCache, setRawPerfilesCache] = useState<any[]>(() => memoryClubCache?.rawPerfilesCache || []);
  const [rawReservasCache, setRawReservasCache] = useState<any[]>(() => memoryClubCache?.rawReservasCache || []);
  const [servCatMapCache, setServCatMapCache] = useState<Map<string, string>>(() => new Map(memoryClubCache?.servCatEntries || []));
  const [clubPromos, setClubPromos] = useState<any[]>(() => memoryClubCache?.clubPromos || []);
  const [userStats, setUserStats] = useState<any>(() => memoryClubCache?.userStats || defaultClubStats);
  const [completedSessionsCount, setCompletedSessionsCount] = useState<number>(() => memoryClubCache?.completedSessionsCount ?? 0);
  const [activeReservationsCount, setActiveReservationsCount] = useState<number>(() => memoryClubCache?.activeReservationsCount ?? 0);
  const [uniqueDisciplinesCount, setUniqueDisciplinesCount] = useState<number>(() => memoryClubCache?.uniqueDisciplinesCount ?? 0);
  const [uniqueClubsCount, setUniqueClubsCount] = useState<number>(() => memoryClubCache?.uniqueClubsCount ?? 0);
  const [maxDisciplineSessionsCount, setMaxDisciplineSessionsCount] = useState<number>(() => memoryClubCache?.maxDisciplineSessionsCount ?? 0);
  const [sessionsByDiscipline, setSessionsByDiscipline] = useState<Record<string, number>>(() => memoryClubCache?.sessionsByDiscipline || {});

  const hasLoadedInitialRef = useRef<boolean>(Boolean(memoryClubCache));
  const isFetchingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const lastValidDataRef = useRef(memoryClubCache);
  useEffect(() => { if (hasInitialLoaded) hasLoadedInitialRef.current = true; }, [hasInitialLoaded]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id || !refreshProfile) return;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    const ch = supabase.channel(`kc_perfil_sync_${String(user.id).slice(0, 8)}_${++kcChanSeq}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'perfiles', filter: `id=eq.${user.id}` }, () => {
        if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = setTimeout(() => { refreshProfile().catch(() => {}); }, 160);
      }).subscribe();
    return () => { if (timer) clearTimeout(timer); supabase.removeChannel(ch).catch(() => {}); };
  }, [user?.id, refreshProfile]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const uid = user.id, today = getTodayISO();
    Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(`${CLAIMED_RETOS_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`), AsyncStorage.getItem(`${DAILY_BOX_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(`${STREAK_SHIELD_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`), AsyncStorage.getItem(`${BONUS_XP_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(`${OPENED_BOXES_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`),
    ]).then(([rawClaimed, rawDaily, rawShield, rawXp, rawBoxes]) => {
      if (!isMountedRef.current || cancelled) return;
      const dbClaimed: string[] = Array.isArray(profile?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? profile.recompensas_reclamadas.map(String) : [];
      let parsedLocal: string[] = [];
      if (rawClaimed) { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(rawClaimed); if (Array.isArray(parsed)) parsedLocal = parsed.map(String); } catch {} }
      const combinedReal = filterRealChallengeClaimKeys([...claimedIdsRef.current, ...dbClaimed, ...parsedLocal]);
      const finalClaimed = combinedReal.length > 0 ? combinedReal : ['reto_1'];
      claimedIdsRef.current = finalClaimed; setClaimedChallengeIds(finalClaimed);
      const isDailyClaimed = rawDaily === today || dbClaimed.includes(`recompensa_diaria_${today}`);
      setDailyClaimedToday(isDailyClaimed);
      setIsStreakFrozenToday(rawShield === today || dbClaimed.includes(`escudo_racha_${today}`) || isDailyClaimed);
      const dbXp = Math.max(0, Number(profile?.xp_total) || 0);
      const val = rawXp && !Number.isNaN(Number(rawXp)) ? Math.max(dbXp, Number(rawXp)) : dbXp;
      bonusXpRef.current = val; setBonusXp(val);
      const localBoxes = rawBoxes && !Number.isNaN(Number(rawBoxes)) ? Math.max(0, Number(rawBoxes)) : 0;
      const mergedBoxes = Math.max(localBoxes, dbClaimed.filter((k) => k.startsWith('caja_nivel_')).length);
      openedBoxesRef.current = mergedBoxes; setOpenedBoxesCount(mergedBoxes);
    }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [user?.id, profile?.recompensas_reclamadas, profile?.xp_total]);

  const fetchGenRef = useRef(0);
  const fetchCommunityData = useCallback(async (_page = 0, isSilent = false, force = false) => {
    if (isFetchingRef.current && !force) return;
    const hasCached = Boolean(memoryClubCache || lastValidDataRef.current);
    if (!force && hasCached && Date.now() - memoryClubLastFetchedAt < CLUB_EGRESS_TTL_MS) {
      hasLoadedInitialRef.current = true;
      if (isMountedRef.current) { setIsFetching((v) => (v ? false : v)); setHasInitialLoaded((v) => (v ? v : true)); setRefreshing((v) => (v ? false : v)); }
      return;
    }
    const myGen = ++fetchGenRef.current;
    isFetchingRef.current = true;
    if (!isSilent && !hasLoadedInitialRef.current && !hasCached && isMountedRef.current) setIsFetching(true);
    try {
      const pageIdx = Math.max(0, Number(_page) || 0), resFrom = pageIdx * PAGE_SIZE, resTo = resFrom + PAGE_SIZE * 6 - 1;
      const reservasCols = 'id, usuario_id, servicio, negocio_id, estado, created_at';
      const srvCols = 'id, negocio_nombre, nombre_servicio, duracion_minutos, precio_kc, cupo_maximo, hora_inicio, descripcion, imagen_url, portada_url, fecha, estado, categoria, ubicacion, instructor_nombre';
      const [perfilesPub, reservasRes, misReservasRes, serviciosRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetchPublicSquadLeaderboardProfiles(PAGE_SIZE * 4, user?.id, pageIdx),
        supabase.from('reservas').select(reservasCols).neq('estado', 'cancelada').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).range(resFrom, resTo),
        user?.id ? supabase.from('reservas').select(reservasCols).eq('usuario_id', user.id).neq('estado', 'cancelada').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).range(0, PAGE_SIZE * 3 - 1) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
        supabase.from('servicios').select(srvCols).order('fecha', { ascending: true }).range(0, PAGE_SIZE * 2 - 1),
      ]);
      if (!isMountedRef.current || myGen !== fetchGenRef.current) return;
      const servErr = Boolean((serviciosRes as any)?.error), resErr = Boolean((reservasRes as any)?.error) || Boolean((misReservasRes as any)?.error);
      const catMap = new Map<string, string>(servErr ? (memoryClubCache?.servCatEntries || []) : []);
      if (!servErr) (serviciosRes.data || []).forEach((s: any) => { if (s?.nombre_servicio && s?.categoria) catMap.set(String(s.nombre_servicio).trim().toLowerCase(), s.categoria); });
      const mergedReservasMap = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
      const srcRes = resErr && memoryClubCache?.rawReservasCache?.length ? memoryClubCache.rawReservasCache : [...(reservasRes.data || []), ...(misReservasRes.data || [])];
      srcRes.forEach((row: Record<string, unknown>) => { if (row?.id) mergedReservasMap.set(String(row?.id), row); });
      const mergedReservas = Array.from(mergedReservasMap.values());
      const nextPerfiles = (perfilesPub && perfilesPub.length > 0) ? perfilesPub : (memoryClubCache?.rawPerfilesCache || []);
      const nextPromos = servErr && memoryClubCache?.clubPromos?.length ? memoryClubCache.clubPromos : mapServicesToClubPromos(serviciosRes.data || [], mergedReservas);
      setServCatMapCache(catMap); setRawPerfilesCache(nextPerfiles); setRawReservasCache(mergedReservas); setClubPromos(nextPromos);

      let compLen = memoryClubCache?.completedSessionsCount ?? 0, actLen = memoryClubCache?.activeReservationsCount ?? 0;
      let uClubs = memoryClubCache?.uniqueClubsCount ?? 0, uDiscs = memoryClubCache?.uniqueDisciplinesCount ?? 0, maxDisc = memoryClubCache?.maxDisciplineSessionsCount ?? 0;
      let discCounts: Record<string, number> = memoryClubCache?.sessionsByDiscipline || {};
      let computedStats: any = memoryClubCache?.userStats;
      if (user?.id && (!resErr || !memoryClubCache?.userStats)) {
        discCounts = {};
        const misRes = mergedReservas.filter((r: any) => String(r.usuario_id) === String(user.id));
        const completadas = misRes.filter((r: any) => String(r.estado || '').toLowerCase() === 'completada');
        const activas = misRes.filter((r: any) => ['activa', 'pendiente'].includes(String(r.estado || '').toLowerCase()));
        const clubsSet = new Set<string>(), discSet = new Set<string>();
        completadas.forEach((r: any) => {
          if (r.negocio_id) clubsSet.add(String(r.negocio_id));
          const d = catMap.get(String(r.servicio || '').trim().toLowerCase()) || 'Fuerza';
          discSet.add(d); discCounts[d] = (discCounts[d] || 0) + 1;
        });
        compLen = completadas.length; actLen = activas.length; uClubs = clubsSet.size; uDiscs = discSet.size;
        maxDisc = Object.values(discCounts).length > 0 ? Math.max(...Object.values(discCounts)) : 0;
        computedStats = computeAthleteRpgStats([...completadas, ...activas], rachaRef.current, levelRef.current, countRealClaimedTrophies(claimedIdsRef.current));
        setCompletedSessionsCount(compLen); setActiveReservationsCount(actLen); setUniqueClubsCount(uClubs);
        setUniqueDisciplinesCount(uDiscs); setMaxDisciplineSessionsCount(maxDisc);
        setSessionsByDiscipline(discCounts); setUserStats(computedStats);
      }
      memoryClubCache = {
        allFeedAthletes: memoryClubCache?.allFeedAthletes || [], rawPerfilesCache: nextPerfiles,
        rawReservasCache: mergedReservas, servCatEntries: Array.from(catMap.entries()), clubPromos: nextPromos,
        completedSessionsCount: compLen, activeReservationsCount: actLen, uniqueDisciplinesCount: uDiscs,
        uniqueClubsCount: uClubs, maxDisciplineSessionsCount: maxDisc, sessionsByDiscipline: discCounts, userStats: computedStats,
      };
      lastValidDataRef.current = memoryClubCache; memoryClubLastFetchedAt = Date.now();
      await syncSquadsRef.current();
    } catch {} finally {
      if (myGen === fetchGenRef.current) {
        isFetchingRef.current = false; hasLoadedInitialRef.current = true;
        if (isMountedRef.current) { setIsFetching((v) => (v ? false : v)); setHasInitialLoaded((v) => (v ? v : true)); setRefreshing((v) => (v ? false : v)); }
      }
    }
  }, [user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchCommunityData(0, Boolean(memoryClubCache), false);
    const debouncedMutate = createDebouncedEventRunner(() => { memoryClubLastFetchedAt = 0; fetchCommunityData(0, true, true); }, 150);
    const unsubRadar = subscribeKineticRadarUpdated(debouncedMutate.trigger);
    const unsubRoot = subscribeKineticRootRefresh(debouncedMutate.trigger);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') {
      window.addEventListener('kinetic:boveda-updated', debouncedMutate.trigger);
      window.addEventListener('kinetic:stories-updated', debouncedMutate.trigger);
      return () => {
        fetchGenRef.current += 1; isFetchingRef.current = false;
        debouncedMutate.cancel(); unsubRadar(); unsubRoot();
        window.removeEventListener('kinetic:boveda-updated', debouncedMutate.trigger);
        window.removeEventListener('kinetic:stories-updated', debouncedMutate.trigger);
      };
    }
    return () => { fetchGenRef.current += 1; isFetchingRef.current = false; debouncedMutate.cancel(); unsubRadar(); unsubRoot(); };
  }, [fetchCommunityData]);

  return {
    isFetching, hasInitialLoaded, refreshing, setRefreshing, rawPerfilesCache, rawReservasCache, servCatMapCache, clubPromos,
    userStats, completedSessionsCount, activeReservationsCount, uniqueDisciplinesCount, uniqueClubsCount,
    maxDisciplineSessionsCount, sessionsByDiscipline, fetchCommunityData,
  };
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { MutableRefObject, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { triggerArcadeHaptic, triggerHaptic } from '../../components/SharedUI';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { invalidateAdminDashboardFetcherCache } from '../../services/adminDashboardFetcher';
import type { KineticAuthProfile, KineticAuthUser } from '../../services/kineticAuthContextHelpers';
import { patchKinetiClubTabAlertState } from '../../services/kineticlubTabAlertStore';
import { getMazatlanNowParts } from '../../services/kineticVenueCanonicalGeoAndHours';
import {
  STREAK_SHIELD_KEY_PREFIX,
  pickLevelBoxRewardKc,
  resolveMysteryBoxTierConfig,
  sumClaimedChallengesXp,
} from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import {
  buildClaimedProfilePatch,
  buildShieldActivatedProfilePatch,
  extractClaimedLevelBoxNumbers,
  findNextUnclaimedLevelBoxNum,
  mergeClaimKeys,
  persistBoxRewardStorage,
  persistDailyRewardStorage,
  persistTrophyRewardStorage,
  resolveShieldErrorMessage,
  runRewardRpcWithRetry,
  toRewardErrMsg,
  type RewardHapticFn,
  type TacticalAlertCallback,
} from './kineticClubRewardsCloudHelper';

export interface IRewardsUserLike {
  id?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
}

export interface IRewardsProfileLike {
  id?: string | null;
  nivel?: string | null;
  prestigio_nivel?: number | null;
  prestigio_grado?: number | null;
  xp_total?: number | null;
  recompensas_reclamadas?: unknown;
  [k: string]: unknown;
}

interface IUseKinetiClubRewardsParams {
  user?: IRewardsUserLike | null;
  profile?: IRewardsProfileLike | null;
  userLevelRank?: string | number | null;
  isGhostMode: boolean;
  setIsGhostMode: (val: boolean) => void;
  isFreezing: boolean;
  setIsFreezing: (val: boolean) => void;
  isStreakFrozenToday: boolean;
  setIsStreakFrozenToday: (val: boolean) => void;
  setClaimingId: (id: string | null) => void;
  dailyClaimedToday: boolean;
  setDailyClaimedToday: (val: boolean) => void;
  setClaimedChallengeIds: (ids: string[]) => void;
  setBonusXp: (xp: number) => void;
  setOpenedBoxesCount: (count: number) => void;
  bonusXpRef: MutableRefObject<number>;
  claimedIdsRef: MutableRefObject<string[]>;
  openedBoxesRef: MutableRefObject<number>;
  isMountedRef: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  completedSessionsCount: number;
  rachaActual: number;
  availableBoxesCount: number;
  totalBoxesEarned: number;
  refreshProfile?: () => Promise<void>;
  tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
}

export type { TacticalAlertCallback };

export function useKinetiClubRewards({
  user,
  profile,
  userLevelRank,
  isGhostMode,
  setIsGhostMode,
  isFreezing,
  setIsFreezing,
  isStreakFrozenToday,
  setIsStreakFrozenToday,
  setClaimingId,
  dailyClaimedToday,
  setDailyClaimedToday,
  setClaimedChallengeIds,
  setBonusXp,
  setOpenedBoxesCount,
  bonusXpRef,
  claimedIdsRef,
  openedBoxesRef,
  isMountedRef,
  completedSessionsCount,
  rachaActual,
  availableBoxesCount,
  totalBoxesEarned,
  refreshProfile,
  tx,
}: IUseKinetiClubRewardsParams) {
  const { profile: authProfile, activateResilientSession } = useAuth();
  const effectiveProfile = (profile || authProfile || null) as IRewardsProfileLike | null;
  const uid = String(user?.id || '').trim();
  const authUser = uid ? (user as unknown as KineticAuthUser) : null;
  const syncSession = useCallback(
    (nextProf: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      if (authUser) activateResilientSession(authUser, nextProf as unknown as KineticAuthProfile);
    },
    [authUser, activateResilientSession]
  );
  const tierXp = resolveMysteryBoxTierConfig(effectiveProfile?.nivel || userLevelRank).xpReward;
  const isClaimingRef = useRef(false);
  const isFreezingRef = useRef(false);
  const totalBoxesEarnedRef = useRef(totalBoxesEarned);
  totalBoxesEarnedRef.current = totalBoxesEarned;

  const toggleGhostMode = useCallback(
    async (hapticFn?: RewardHapticFn, alertFn?: TacticalAlertCallback) => {
      (hapticFn || triggerHaptic)('Medium');
      const nextGhost = !isGhostMode;
      setIsGhostMode(nextGhost);
      if (uid) {
        try {
          await supabase.from('perfiles').update({ radar_publico: !nextGhost }).eq('id', uid);
        } catch {}
      }
      alertFn?.(
        nextGhost ? tx('PERFIL EN MODO PRIVADO', 'PRIVATE MODE ENABLED') : tx('PERFIL PÚBLICO EN RADAR', 'PUBLIC PROFILE ON RADAR'),
        nextGhost
          ? tx('Tu actividad ha quedado oculta del ranking público.', 'Your activity is now hidden from the public leaderboard.')
          : tx('Tu perfil ahora es visible en el Ranking de KinetiClub.', 'Your profile is now visible on the KinetiClub Leaderboard.'),
        'success'
      );
    },
    [isGhostMode, setIsGhostMode, uid, tx]
  );

  const congelarRacha = useCallback(
    async (_hapticFn?: RewardHapticFn, alertFn?: TacticalAlertCallback): Promise<{ ok: boolean; errorMsg?: string }> => {
      if (!uid || isFreezing || isFreezingRef.current || isStreakFrozenToday) return { ok: false };
      isFreezingRef.current = true;
      setIsFreezing(true);
      const today = getMazatlanNowParts().isoDate;
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('congelar_racha_kineti', { p_user_id: uid });
        const payload = (data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : null) as Record<string, unknown> | null;
        if (error || !payload || payload.ok === false) {
          const msg = resolveShieldErrorMessage(payload, error, tx);
          triggerHaptic('Warning');
          alertFn?.(tx('ESCUDO NO DISPONIBLE', 'SHIELD UNAVAILABLE'), msg, 'warning');
          return { ok: false, errorMsg: msg };
        }
        if (isMountedRef.current) setIsStreakFrozenToday(true);
        const nextClaimedArr = Array.isArray(payload?.recompensas_reclamadas)
          ? payload.recompensas_reclamadas.map(String)
          : mergeClaimKeys(effectiveProfile?.recompensas_reclamadas, [`escudo_racha_${today}`]);
        if (effectiveProfile) syncSession(buildShieldActivatedProfilePatch(effectiveProfile, payload, nextClaimedArr));
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(`${STREAK_SHIELD_KEY_PREFIX}${uid}`, today).catch(() => {});
        await refreshProfile?.();
        triggerArcadeHaptic('reward');
        const wasFree = Boolean(payload?.gratis ?? payload?.free ?? false);
        alertFn?.(
          tx('ESCUDO DE RACHA ACTIVADO', 'STREAK SHIELD ACTIVATED'),
          wasFree
            ? tx(`Escudo mensual gratuito activado. Tu racha de ${rachaActual} ${rachaActual === 1 ? 'día' : 'días'} está blindada 24h.`, `Free monthly shield activated. Your ${rachaActual}-day streak is shielded for 24h.`)
            : tx(`Escudo adicional (25 KC) activado. Tu racha de ${rachaActual} ${rachaActual === 1 ? 'día' : 'días'} está blindada 24h.`, `Extra shield (25 KC) activated. Your ${rachaActual}-day streak is shielded for 24h.`),
          'success'
        );
        return { ok: true };
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const msg = toRewardErrMsg(err, tx('Error de red al activar escudo.', 'Network error activating shield.'));
        triggerHaptic('Warning');
        alertFn?.(tx('ERROR DE ESCUDO', 'SHIELD ERROR'), msg, 'error');
        return { ok: false, errorMsg: msg };
      } finally {
        isFreezingRef.current = false;
        if (isMountedRef.current) setIsFreezing(false);
      }
    },
    [uid, effectiveProfile, syncSession, isFreezing, isStreakFrozenToday, rachaActual, refreshProfile, setIsFreezing, setIsStreakFrozenToday, isMountedRef, tx]
  );

  const ascenderPrestigioNivel99 = useCallback(
    async (alertFn?: TacticalAlertCallback): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (!uid || isClaimingRef.current) return false;
      isClaimingRef.current = true;
      try {
        const { data, error } = await runRewardRpcWithRetry('ascender_prestigio_kineti', { p_user_id: uid });
        const payload = (data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : null) as Record<string, unknown> | null;
        if (error || (payload && payload.ok === false)) {
          const msg = String(payload?.error || payload?.message || error?.message || tx('Aún no alcanzas Nivel 99 para ascender.', 'Reach Level 99 to unlock Prestige ascension.'));
          triggerHaptic('Warning');
          alertFn?.(tx('ASCENSO NO DISPONIBLE', 'ASCENSION UNAVAILABLE'), msg, 'warning');
          return false;
        }
        if (effectiveProfile && payload) {
          syncSession({
            ...effectiveProfile,
            prestigio_nivel: Number(payload.prestigio_nivel) || (Number(effectiveProfile.prestigio_nivel) || 0) + 1,
            prestigio_grado: Number(payload.prestigio_grado) || (Number(effectiveProfile.prestigio_grado) || 0) + 1,
            xp_total: Math.max(Number(effectiveProfile.xp_total) || 0, Number(payload.xp_total) || 0),
          });
        }
        await refreshProfile?.();
        triggerArcadeHaptic('levelUp');
        return true;
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        triggerHaptic('Warning');
        alertFn?.(tx('ERROR AL ASCENDER', 'ASCENSION ERROR'), toRewardErrMsg(err, tx('Intenta de nuevo.', 'Please try again.')), 'error');
        return false;
      } finally {
        isClaimingRef.current = false;
      }
    },
    [uid, effectiveProfile, syncSession, refreshProfile, tx]
  );

  const reclamarRecompensa = useCallback(
    async (
      id: string,
      _kc: number,
      xp: number,
      isUnlocked: boolean,
      hapticFn?: RewardHapticFn,
      alertFn?: TacticalAlertCallback
    ): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (!uid || isClaimingRef.current) return false;
      if (!isUnlocked) {
        (hapticFn || triggerHaptic)('Warning');
        alertFn?.(
          tx('Misión en Progreso', 'Quest in Progress'),
          tx(
            'Completa el requisito indicado en la tarjeta para desbloquear este trofeo y reclamar su experiencia.',
            'Complete the requirement shown on the card to unlock this trophy and claim its XP.'
          ),
          'warning'
        );
        return false;
      }
      const isDaily = id === 'misteriosa_diaria' || id.startsWith('m');
      if ((isDaily && id === 'misteriosa_diaria' && dailyClaimedToday) || (!isDaily && claimedIdsRef.current.includes(id))) return false;
      isClaimingRef.current = true;
      const rawXp = Number(xp);
      const xpGain = id === 'misteriosa_diaria' ? (rawXp > 0 ? rawXp : tierXp) : Math.max(5, rawXp || 20);
      const kcReward = Math.max(0, Number(_kc) || 0);
      const prevProfile = effectiveProfile ? { ...effectiveProfile } : null;
      const prevDaily = dailyClaimedToday;
      const prevFrozen = isStreakFrozenToday;
      const prevBonus = bonusXpRef.current;
      const prevClaimed = [...claimedIdsRef.current];

      if (isDaily) {
        const today = getMazatlanNowParts().isoDate;
        const dailyBoxXp = id === 'misteriosa_diaria' ? xpGain || tierXp : tierXp;
        const awardedXp = id === 'misteriosa_diaria' ? dailyBoxXp : xpGain;
        const formulaDailyXp = completedSessionsCount * 50 + rachaActual * 25 + sumClaimedChallengesXp(prevClaimed) + dailyBoxXp + openedBoxesRef.current * 30;
        const resolvedXp = Math.max(prevBonus + awardedXp, formulaDailyXp);
        const dailyKey = id === 'misteriosa_diaria' ? `recompensa_diaria_${today}` : `${id}_${today}`;
        const optClaimedArr = mergeClaimKeys(prevProfile?.recompensas_reclamadas, [dailyKey, `escudo_racha_${today}`]);
        setDailyClaimedToday(true); setIsStreakFrozenToday(true); bonusXpRef.current = resolvedXp; setBonusXp(resolvedXp);
        if (availableBoxesCount <= 0) patchKinetiClubTabAlertState({ hasUnclaimedReadyReward: false }, uid);
        if (prevProfile) syncSession(buildClaimedProfilePatch(prevProfile, { kcDelta: kcReward, xpTotal: resolvedXp, claimedKeys: optClaimedArr, freezeStreak: true }));
        triggerArcadeHaptic('reward');
        try {
          const { data: rpcDailyData, error: rpcDailyErr } = await runRewardRpcWithRetry('reclamar_recompensa_kineti', {
            p_user_id: uid, p_reto_id: dailyKey, p_kc_reward: kcReward, p_xp_reward: awardedXp,
          });
          if (rpcDailyErr) throw rpcDailyErr;
          const dPay = (rpcDailyData && typeof rpcDailyData === 'object' ? rpcDailyData : null) as Record<string, unknown> | null;
          const mergedServer = Array.isArray(dPay?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? mergeClaimKeys(dPay.recompensas_reclamadas, optClaimedArr) : optClaimedArr;
          const serverXp = Math.max(Number(dPay?.xp_total) || 0, resolvedXp);
          bonusXpRef.current = serverXp;
          if (isMountedRef.current) setBonusXp(serverXp);
          if (prevProfile) syncSession(buildClaimedProfilePatch(prevProfile, { kcTopupOverride: dPay?.kc_topup !== undefined ? Number(dPay.kc_topup) : undefined, kcDelta: kcReward, xpTotal: serverXp, claimedKeys: mergedServer, freezeStreak: true }));
          await persistDailyRewardStorage(uid, today, serverXp);
          if (kcReward > 0 || awardedXp > 0) await refreshProfile?.();
          return true;
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          bonusXpRef.current = prevBonus;
          if (isMountedRef.current) { setDailyClaimedToday(prevDaily); setIsStreakFrozenToday(prevFrozen); setBonusXp(prevBonus); }
          if (prevProfile) syncSession(prevProfile);
          patchKinetiClubTabAlertState({ hasUnclaimedReadyReward: true }, uid);
          triggerHaptic('Warning');
          alertFn?.(tx('NO SE PUDO RECLAMAR', 'CLAIM FAILED'), toRewardErrMsg(err, tx('No se pudo guardar en la nube. Intenta de nuevo.', 'Could not save to cloud. Please try again.')), 'error');
          return false;
        } finally { isClaimingRef.current = false; }
      } else {
        const nextClaimed = Array.from(new Set([...prevClaimed, id]));
        claimedIdsRef.current = nextClaimed; setClaimedChallengeIds(nextClaimed);
        const formulaTrophyXp = completedSessionsCount * 50 + rachaActual * 25 + sumClaimedChallengesXp(nextClaimed) + (dailyClaimedToday ? tierXp : 0) + openedBoxesRef.current * 30;
        const nextTotalXp = Math.max(prevBonus + xpGain, formulaTrophyXp);
        bonusXpRef.current = nextTotalXp; setBonusXp(nextTotalXp);
        const optClaimedArr = mergeClaimKeys(prevProfile?.recompensas_reclamadas, [id]);
        if (prevProfile) syncSession(buildClaimedProfilePatch(prevProfile, { kcDelta: kcReward, xpTotal: nextTotalXp, claimedKeys: optClaimedArr }));
        triggerArcadeHaptic('levelUp');
        try {
          const { data: rpcTrophyData, error: rpcTrophyErr } = await runRewardRpcWithRetry('reclamar_recompensa_kineti', {
            p_user_id: uid, p_reto_id: id, p_kc_reward: kcReward, p_xp_reward: xpGain,
          });
          if (rpcTrophyErr) throw rpcTrophyErr;
          const tPay = (rpcTrophyData && typeof rpcTrophyData === 'object' ? rpcTrophyData : null) as Record<string, unknown> | null;
          const mergedServer = Array.isArray(tPay?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? mergeClaimKeys(tPay.recompensas_reclamadas, nextClaimed) : optClaimedArr;
          const serverXp = Math.max(Number(tPay?.xp_total) || 0, nextTotalXp);
          bonusXpRef.current = serverXp;
          if (isMountedRef.current) setBonusXp(serverXp);
          if (prevProfile) syncSession(buildClaimedProfilePatch(prevProfile, { kcTopupOverride: tPay?.kc_topup !== undefined ? Number(tPay.kc_topup) : undefined, kcDelta: kcReward, xpTotal: serverXp, claimedKeys: mergedServer }));
          await persistTrophyRewardStorage(uid, nextClaimed, serverXp);
          if (kcReward > 0 || xpGain > 0) await refreshProfile?.();
          return true;
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          claimedIdsRef.current = prevClaimed; bonusXpRef.current = prevBonus;
          if (isMountedRef.current) { setClaimedChallengeIds(prevClaimed); setBonusXp(prevBonus); }
          if (prevProfile) syncSession(prevProfile);
          await persistTrophyRewardStorage(uid, prevClaimed, prevBonus).catch(() => {});
          patchKinetiClubTabAlertState({ hasUnclaimedReadyReward: true }, uid);
          triggerHaptic('Warning');
          alertFn?.(tx('NO SE PUDO RECLAMAR', 'CLAIM FAILED'), toRewardErrMsg(err, tx('No se pudo guardar el trofeo en la nube.', 'Could not save trophy in cloud.')), 'error');
          return false;
        } finally { isClaimingRef.current = false; }
      }
    },
    [uid, effectiveProfile, syncSession, availableBoxesCount, dailyClaimedToday, isStreakFrozenToday, completedSessionsCount, rachaActual, tierXp, refreshProfile, bonusXpRef, claimedIdsRef, openedBoxesRef, isMountedRef, setBonusXp, setClaimedChallengeIds, setDailyClaimedToday, setIsStreakFrozenToday, tx]
  );

  const abrirCajaRetoNivel = useCallback(
    async (alertFn?: TacticalAlertCallback): Promise<number> => {
      if (!uid || isClaimingRef.current || availableBoxesCount <= 0 || openedBoxesRef.current >= totalBoxesEarnedRef.current) return 0;
      isClaimingRef.current = true;
      const randomKc = pickLevelBoxRewardKc();
      const prevOpened = openedBoxesRef.current;
      const prevBonus = bonusXpRef.current;
      const prevProfile = effectiveProfile ? { ...effectiveProfile } : null;
      const nextCrateNum = findNextUnclaimedLevelBoxNum(effectiveProfile?.recompensas_reclamadas, totalBoxesEarnedRef.current);
      if (!nextCrateNum) { isClaimingRef.current = false; return 0; }
      const crateKey = `caja_nivel_${nextCrateNum}`;
      const claimedSetNow = extractClaimedLevelBoxNumbers(effectiveProfile?.recompensas_reclamadas);
      claimedSetNow.add(nextCrateNum);
      const nextOpened = Math.max(prevOpened + 1, claimedSetNow.size);

      try {
        const { data: crateData, error: crateErr } = await runRewardRpcWithRetry('reclamar_recompensa_kineti', {
          p_user_id: uid, p_reto_id: crateKey, p_kc_reward: randomKc, p_xp_reward: 30,
        });
        if (crateErr) throw crateErr;
        const cPay = (crateData && typeof crateData === 'object' ? crateData : null) as Record<string, unknown> | null;
        const isDuplicate = Boolean(cPay?.duplicate);
        const rawGranted = Number(cPay?.kc_granted);
        const safeServerKc = isDuplicate ? 0 : rawGranted === 10 || rawGranted === 20 ? rawGranted : randomKc;
        const mergedServer = Array.isArray(cPay?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? mergeClaimKeys(cPay.recompensas_reclamadas, [crateKey]) : mergeClaimKeys(prevProfile?.recompensas_reclamadas, [crateKey]);
        const exactBoxCount = Math.max(extractClaimedLevelBoxNumbers(mergedServer).size, Number(cPay?.cajas_nivel_reclamadas) || 0, isDuplicate ? prevOpened : nextOpened);
        const formulaBoxXp = completedSessionsCount * 50 + rachaActual * 25 + sumClaimedChallengesXp(claimedIdsRef.current) + (dailyClaimedToday ? tierXp : 0) + exactBoxCount * 30;
        const serverXp = Math.max(Number(cPay?.xp_total) || 0, isDuplicate ? prevBonus : Math.max(prevBonus + 30, formulaBoxXp));

        openedBoxesRef.current = exactBoxCount;
        bonusXpRef.current = serverXp;
        if (isMountedRef.current) { setOpenedBoxesCount(exactBoxCount); setBonusXp(serverXp); }
        if (prevProfile) {
          syncSession({
            ...buildClaimedProfilePatch(prevProfile, { kcTopupOverride: cPay?.kc_topup !== undefined ? Number(cPay.kc_topup) : undefined, kcDelta: safeServerKc, xpTotal: serverXp, claimedKeys: mergedServer }),
            cajas_nivel_reclamadas: exactBoxCount,
          });
        }
        await persistBoxRewardStorage(uid, exactBoxCount, serverXp);
        invalidateAdminDashboardFetcherCache();
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:boveda-updated'));
        }
        await refreshProfile?.();
        if (isDuplicate) {
          triggerHaptic('Warning');
          alertFn?.(tx('COFRE YA RECLAMADO', 'CHEST ALREADY CLAIMED'), tx('Este cofre de nivel ya estaba acreditado en tu cuenta.', 'This level chest was already credited to your account.'), 'alert');
          return -1;
        }
        triggerArcadeHaptic('levelUp');
        return safeServerKc;
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        openedBoxesRef.current = prevOpened; bonusXpRef.current = prevBonus;
        if (isMountedRef.current) { setOpenedBoxesCount(prevOpened); setBonusXp(prevBonus); }
        if (prevProfile) syncSession(prevProfile);
        await persistBoxRewardStorage(uid, prevOpened, prevBonus).catch(() => {});
        triggerHaptic('Warning');
        alertFn?.(tx('NO SE PUDO ABRIR COFRE', 'BOX CLAIM FAILED'), toRewardErrMsg(err, tx('No se pudo guardar tu cofre en la nube.', 'Could not save your chest in the cloud.')), 'error');
        return 0;
      } finally { isClaimingRef.current = false; }
    },
    [uid, effectiveProfile, syncSession, availableBoxesCount, completedSessionsCount, rachaActual, dailyClaimedToday, tierXp, refreshProfile, bonusXpRef, claimedIdsRef, openedBoxesRef, isMountedRef, setBonusXp, setOpenedBoxesCount, tx]
  );

  return {
    toggleGhostMode,
    congelarRacha,
    ascenderPrestigioNivel99,
    reclamarRecompensa,
    abrirCajaRetoNivel,
  };
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { evaluateKinetic250Challenges } from '../../components/KinetiClubModals';
import { buildUserNotificationsList } from '../../components/kineticlub/KinetiClubNotificationsModal';

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { adminService } from '../../services/adminService';
import { bovedaService } from '../../services/bovedaService';
import { exploreService } from '../../services/exploreService';
import { resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing } from '../../services/kineticFlashSaleHelper';
import { IDirectMessageThread, buildDeterministicDmCode, isUuid, loadLocalDmThreads, matchesUserIdentity, syncDirectMessagesFromCloud } from '../../services/kineticRealtimeChatBridge';
import { getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot } from '../../services/kineticDirectMessagesBridge';
import { getActiveStoriesMapSync, subscribeKineticStoriesUpdated } from '../../services/kineticStoriesService';
import { subscribeCommunityWallUpdated } from '../../services/kineticlubFeedAndSquadHelpers';
import { countRealClaimedTrophies, isMasterAdmin, translateClubTerm } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { subscribeSquadsDataChanged } from '../../services/kineticlubSquadsService';
import { NOTIF_SEEN_KEY_PREFIX, countUnseenNotifications } from '../../services/kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
import { expandSocialIdSet, isSocialIdMatched } from '../../services/kineticlubSocialGraphHelper';
import { getBlockedUserIdsSet, getRestrictedUserIdsSet, subscribeUgcModerationChanged } from '../../services/kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import { subscribeKinetiClubChatsRealtimeAndFocus, subscribeMemoryWallSnapshot } from '../../services/kineticlubWallCloudService';
import { fetchPendingSplitInvites } from '../../services/splitEscrowInvitesService';
import { patchKinetiClubTabAlertState } from '../../services/kineticlubTabAlertStore';

const ATHLETE_FIRES_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_athlete_fires_v25';
const SEEN_CHAT_ALERTS_PREFIX = '@kinetic_seen_chat_alerts_v1_';
let lastDmBadgeCloudSyncAt = 0;

const readSyncStorage = (key: string): string | null => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
    try { return window.localStorage.getItem(key); } catch {}
  }
  return null;
};

const writeSyncStorage = (key: string, val: string): void => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
    try { window.localStorage.setItem(key, val); } catch {}
  }
};

export interface IUseKinetiClubScreenActionsParams {
  user: any; profile: any; language: 'es' | 'en'; tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
  router: any; refreshProfile?: () => Promise<void>; fetchCommunityData: any;
  clubPromos: any[]; misEquipos: any[]; top10Elite: any[]; visibleData: any[];
  solicitudesEquipoPendientes: any[]; sentPendingNames: string[];
  claimedChallengeIds: string[]; completedSessionsCount: number; activeReservationsCount: number;
  uniqueDisciplinesCount: number; uniqueClubsCount: number; maxDisciplineSessionsCount: number;
  sessionsByDiscipline: Record<string, number>; hasConfiguredSquad: boolean; rachaActual: number;
  inspectedAthlete: any | null; setInspectedAthlete: (v: any) => void;
  setShowRpgModal: (v: boolean) => void; setShowSquadsModal: (v: boolean) => void;
  setInitialSquadSection: (v: 'hub' | 'invitar' | 'chat') => void;
  setActiveFilter: (v: string) => void; setSelectedPromoEvent: (v: any) => void;
  showSquadsModal: boolean; hasOverlayModalRef: React.MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  closeAllOverlays: () => void; handleVinculacion: any;
}

export function useKinetiClubScreenActions(p: IUseKinetiClubScreenActionsParams) {
  const { user, profile, language, tx, router, refreshProfile, fetchCommunityData, clubPromos, misEquipos, top10Elite, visibleData, solicitudesEquipoPendientes, sentPendingNames } = p;
  const [rankingSearch, setRankingSearch] = useState('');
  const [rankingFilterKey, setRankingFilterKey] = useState('all');
  const [rankingSortKey, setRankingSortKey] = useState('trofeos');
  const [notifSeenTsMs, setNotifSeenTsMs] = useState(() => {
    const s = readSyncStorage(`${NOTIF_SEEN_KEY_PREFIX}${String(user?.id || 'anon').toLowerCase()}`);
    return s ? Number(s) || 0 : 0;
  });
  const [seenChatSigs, setSeenChatSigs] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    const raw = user?.id ? readSyncStorage(`${SEEN_CHAT_ALERTS_PREFIX}${user.id}`) : null;
    if (raw) { try { const arr = JSON.parse(raw); return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr.map(String) : []; } catch {} }
    return [];
  });
  const [fireMap, setFireMap] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [storyOwner, setStoryOwner] = useState<IKineticStoryOwner | null>(null);
  const [pendingDmCount, setPendingDmCount] = useState(0);
  const [pendingDmList, setPendingDmList] = useState<IDirectMessageThread[]>([]);
  const [pendingDmToOpen, setPendingDmToOpen] = useState<IDirectMessageThread | null>(null);
  const [pendingSplitInvitesCount, setPendingSplitInvitesCount] = useState(0);
  const [hasFetchedSplitInvites, setHasFetchedSplitInvites] = useState(false);
  const updatePendingSplitInvitesCount = useCallback((c: number) => {
    setPendingSplitInvitesCount(c);
    setHasFetchedSplitInvites(true);
  }, []);
  const [liveSyncTick, setLiveSyncTick] = useState(0);
  const [alertConfig, setAlertConfig] = useState({ visible: false, title: '', message: '', type: 'alert', onConfirm: null as any, confirmText: '', cancelText: '' });

  const showSquadsModalRef = useRef(p.showSquadsModal);
  showSquadsModalRef.current = p.showSquadsModal;
  const reservingPromoRef = useRef(false);
  const uiTimersRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>[]>([]);

  const scheduleUi = useCallback((fn: () => void, ms: number) => {
    uiTimersRef.current.push(setTimeout(fn, ms));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => () => { uiTimersRef.current.forEach(clearTimeout); uiTimersRef.current = []; }, []);
  useEffect(() => { AsyncStorage.getItem(ATHLETE_FIRES_STORAGE_KEY).then((raw) => { if (raw) setFireMap(JSON.parse(raw) || {}); }).catch(() => {}); }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const uidLower = String(user?.id || 'anon').toLowerCase();
    const syncNotifSeen = readSyncStorage(`${NOTIF_SEEN_KEY_PREFIX}${uidLower}`);
    setNotifSeenTsMs(syncNotifSeen ? Number(syncNotifSeen) || 0 : 0);
    AsyncStorage.getItem(`${NOTIF_SEEN_KEY_PREFIX}${uidLower}`)
      .then((r) => { setNotifSeenTsMs(r ? Number(r) || 0 : 0); })
      .catch(() => {});
    if (user?.id) {
      const syncChatSeen = readSyncStorage(`${SEEN_CHAT_ALERTS_PREFIX}${user.id}`);
      if (syncChatSeen) {
        try { const arr = JSON.parse(syncChatSeen); setSeenChatSigs(Array.isArray(arr) ? arr.map(String) : []); }
        catch { setSeenChatSigs([]); }
      } else {
        setSeenChatSigs([]);
      }
      AsyncStorage.getItem(`${SEEN_CHAT_ALERTS_PREFIX}${user.id}`).then((r) => {
        if (r) { try { const arr = JSON.parse(r); if (Array.isArray(arr)) setSeenChatSigs(arr.map(String)); } catch {} }
      }).catch(() => {});
      bovedaService.fetchReservasAtleta(user.id).catch(() => {});
    } else {
      setSeenChatSigs([]);
    }
    const bump = () => setLiveSyncTick((v) => v + 1);
    const unsubs = [bovedaService.subscribePassesSnapshot(bump), subscribeKineticStoriesUpdated(bump), subscribeCommunityWallUpdated(bump), subscribeMemoryWallSnapshot(bump), subscribeUgcModerationChanged(bump)];
    return () => unsubs.forEach((fn) => fn());
  }, [user?.id]);

  const syncHookFilter = useCallback((fKey: string, sKey: string) => {
    p.setActiveFilter(`${fKey === 'hoy' ? 'hoy' : 'all'}:${sKey === 'checkins' ? 'checkins' : 'trofeos'}`);
  }, [p.setActiveFilter]);

  const handleSelectRankingFilter = useCallback((k: string) => { setRankingFilterKey(k); syncHookFilter(k, rankingSortKey); }, [rankingSortKey, syncHookFilter]);
  const handleSelectRankingSort = useCallback((k: string) => { setRankingSortKey(k); syncHookFilter(rankingFilterKey, k); }, [rankingFilterKey, syncHookFilter]);

  const { filteredTop10, filteredVisibleData } = useMemo(() => {
    const q = rankingSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    const apply = (arr: any[]) => {
      let list = arr.filter((a: any) => {
        if (rankingFilterKey === 'hoy' && !a?.esHoy) return false;
        if (rankingFilterKey === 'racha3' && (Number(a?.racha) || 0) < 3) return false;
        if (!q) return true;
        return `${a?.nombre || ''} ${a?.disciplina || ''} ${a?.gimnasio || ''} ${a?.rango || ''} ${a?.titulo || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      });
      if (rankingSortKey === 'ovr') return [...list].sort((a, b) => (Number(b?.ovr) || 0) - (Number(a?.ovr) || 0) || (Number(b?.xpTotal) || 0) - (Number(a?.xpTotal) || 0));
      if (rankingSortKey === 'racha') return [...list].sort((a, b) => (Number(b?.racha) || 0) - (Number(a?.racha) || 0) || (Number(b?.xpTotal) || 0) - (Number(a?.xpTotal) || 0));
      if (rankingSortKey === 'checkins') return [...list].sort((a, b) => (Number(b?.checkinsCount) || 0) - (Number(a?.checkinsCount) || 0) || (Number(b?.xpTotal) || 0) - (Number(a?.xpTotal) || 0));
      return list;
    };
    return { filteredTop10: apply(top10Elite), filteredVisibleData: apply(visibleData) };
  }, [top10Elite, visibleData, rankingSearch, rankingFilterKey, rankingSortKey]);

  const activeStoriesMap = useMemo(() => getActiveStoriesMapSync(), [liveSyncTick]);
  const notificationItems = useMemo(
    () => buildUserNotificationsList({ userId: user?.id, userName: profile?.nombre, squadInvites: solicitudesEquipoPendientes, pendingDms: pendingDmList }),
    [user?.id, profile?.nombre, solicitudesEquipoPendientes, pendingDmList, liveSyncTick]
  );
  const unseenNotificationsCount = useMemo(
    () => countUnseenNotifications(notificationItems, notifSeenTsMs, Date.now(), getBlockedUserIdsSet()),
    [notificationItems, notifSeenTsMs, liveSyncTick]
  );

  const handleToggleAthleteFire = useCallback((atl: any) => {
    const key = String(atl?.id || atl?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!key) return;
    setFireMap((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev, [key]: !prev[key] };
      AsyncStorage.setItem(ATHLETE_FIRES_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next)).catch(() => {});
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const showTacticalAlert = useCallback((title: string, message: string, type = 'alert', onConfirm: any = null, confirmText?: string, cancelText?: string) => {
    if (p.hasOverlayModalRef.current && !onConfirm && type === 'success') return;
    if (p.hasOverlayModalRef.current) {
      p.closeAllOverlays();
      scheduleUi(() => setAlertConfig({ visible: true, title, message, type, onConfirm, confirmText: confirmText || '', cancelText: cancelText || '' }), 220);
      return;
    }
    setAlertConfig({ visible: true, title, message, type, onConfirm, confirmText: confirmText || '', cancelText: cancelText || '' });
  }, [p.hasOverlayModalRef, p.closeAllOverlays, scheduleUi]);

  const squadMembersSet = useMemo(() => {
    const names: string[] = [];
    misEquipos.forEach((eq: any) => { if (Array.isArray(eq?.integrantes_nombres)) eq.integrantes_nombres.forEach((n: string) => names.push(n)); });
    return new Set(names.map((n) => String(n).trim().toLowerCase()));
  }, [misEquipos]);
  const pendingSentSet = useMemo(() => new Set((sentPendingNames || []).map((n) => String(n).trim().toLowerCase())), [sentPendingNames]);

  const isMyIdentity = useCallback((a: any) => {
    const myId = String(user?.id || '').trim(), aId = String(a?.id || '').trim();
    if (aId) return Boolean(myId && aId === myId);
    const myNameLow = String(profile?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return Boolean(!myId && myNameLow && String(a?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase() === myNameLow);
  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre]);

  const handleOpenMyStory = useCallback(() => {
    triggerHaptic('Light');
    const myRank = translateClubTerm(profile?.nivel || 'Acceso Base', language);
    setStoryOwner({ id: String(user?.id || profile?.nombre || 'me'), name: profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'), subtitle: `${myRank} • ${p.rachaActual} 🔥`, avatarUrl: profile?.avatar_url || null, isAthleteAccount: true, discipline: 'Fuerza', canUpload: true });
  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre, profile?.avatar_url, profile?.nivel, p.rachaActual, language, tx]);

  const handleOpenStory = useCallback((atl: any) => {
    if (!atl) return;
    triggerHaptic('Light');
    const isPromoEntry = Boolean(atl.isPromo || atl.rawService || atl.linkedEvent);
    const rankLabel = translateClubTerm(atl.rango || atl.categoria || tx('Miembro', 'Member'), language);
    const discLabel = translateClubTerm(atl.disciplina || tx('Fuerza', 'Strength'), language);
    setStoryOwner({
      id: String(atl.storyOwnerKey || atl.id || atl.negocio_nombre || atl.nombre),
      name: atl.nombre || atl.negocio_nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'),
      subtitle: isPromoEntry ? `${rankLabel} • ⚡ Kinetic Club` : `${rankLabel} • ${discLabel}`,
      avatarUrl: atl.avatar_url || atl.portada_url || null, isAthleteAccount: !atl.isB2B && !isPromoEntry,
      isB2B: Boolean(atl.isB2B || isPromoEntry), isPromo: isPromoEntry, linkedEvent: atl.rawService || atl.linkedEvent,
      discipline: discLabel, canUpload: isMyIdentity(atl),
    });
  }, [isMyIdentity, language, tx]);

  const handleInspectAthlete = useCallback((a: any) => {
    triggerHaptic('Light');
    if (isMyIdentity(a)) p.setShowRpgModal(true); else p.setInspectedAthlete(a);
  }, [isMyIdentity, p.setShowRpgModal, p.setInspectedAthlete]);

  const handleLinkAthlete = useCallback((atl: any) => {
    if (!atl) return;
    if (squadMembersSet.has(String(atl?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase())) {
      triggerHaptic('Light');
      const hadModal = Boolean(p.inspectedAthlete);
      p.setInspectedAthlete(null); setPendingDmToOpen(null); p.setInitialSquadSection('chat');
      if (hadModal) scheduleUi(() => p.setShowSquadsModal(true), 180); else p.setShowSquadsModal(true);
      return;
    }
    p.handleVinculacion(atl, triggerHaptic, showTacticalAlert);
  }, [squadMembersSet, p, showTacticalAlert, scheduleUi]);

  const handleOpenDirectDmWithAthlete = useCallback(async (atl: any) => {
    if (!atl) return;
    if (isMyIdentity(atl)) { setPendingDmToOpen(null); p.setInitialSquadSection('chat'); p.setShowSquadsModal(true); return; }
    const hadModal = Boolean(p.inspectedAthlete);
    const dmCode = buildDeterministicDmCode(user?.id, profile?.nombre, atl?.id, atl?.nombre);
    const draftThread: IDirectMessageThread = {
      threadId: dmCode, dmCode, requesterId: String(user?.id || 'me'), requesterName: profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'),
      requesterAvatar: profile?.avatar_url || null, targetId: String(atl?.id || atl?.nombre), targetName: atl?.nombre || tx('Atleta', 'Athlete'),
      targetAvatar: atl?.avatar_url || null, status: 'pending', updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), messages: [],
    };
    const memList = getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot(user?.id, profile?.nombre);
    const localList = await loadLocalDmThreads(user?.id, profile?.nombre);
    const mergedList = [...memList, ...localList];
    const targetPeerLow = String(atl?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const myLow = String(user?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const existing = mergedList.find((t) => {
      if (t.dmCode === dmCode || t.threadId === dmCode) return true;
      if (isUuid(targetPeerLow) && isUuid(myLow)) {
        const r = String(t.requesterId || '').toLowerCase();
        const g = String(t.targetId || '').toLowerCase();
        return (r === myLow && g === targetPeerLow) || (r === targetPeerLow && g === myLow);
      }
      return false;
    });
    p.setInspectedAthlete(null); setPendingDmToOpen(existing || draftThread); p.setInitialSquadSection('chat');
    if (hadModal) scheduleUi(() => p.setShowSquadsModal(true), 180); else p.setShowSquadsModal(true);
  }, [isMyIdentity, p, user?.id, profile?.nombre, profile?.avatar_url, tx, scheduleUi]);

  const { claimableCount, claimedTotal } = useMemo(() => {
    const enriched250 = evaluateKinetic250Challenges({
      claimedChallengeIds: p.claimedChallengeIds, completedSessionsCount: p.completedSessionsCount,
      activeReservationsCount: p.activeReservationsCount, uniqueClubsCount: p.uniqueClubsCount,
      uniqueDisciplinesCount: p.uniqueDisciplinesCount, maxDisciplineSessionsCount: p.maxDisciplineSessionsCount,
      sessionsByDiscipline: p.sessionsByDiscipline, hasConfiguredSquad: p.hasConfiguredSquad, rachaActual: p.rachaActual,
    });
    return { claimableCount: enriched250.filter((r: any) => r.isUnlocked && !r.isClaimed).length, claimedTotal: countRealClaimedTrophies(p.claimedChallengeIds) };
  }, [p.claimedChallengeIds, p.completedSessionsCount, p.activeReservationsCount, p.uniqueDisciplinesCount, p.uniqueClubsCount, p.maxDisciplineSessionsCount, p.sessionsByDiscipline, p.hasConfiguredSquad, p.rachaActual]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setHasFetchedSplitInvites(false);
    if (!user?.id) { lastDmBadgeCloudSyncAt = 0; setPendingDmList([]); setPendingDmCount(0); setPendingSplitInvitesCount(0); return; }
    let mounted = true, latestCached: IDirectMessageThread[] = [];
    const applyIncoming = (list: IDirectMessageThread[]) => {
      latestCached = list;
      const blockedExp = expandSocialIdSet([...getBlockedUserIdsSet(), ...getRestrictedUserIdsSet()]);
      const inc = list.filter((dm) => dm.status === 'pending' && matchesUserIdentity(user?.id, profile?.nombre, dm.targetId, dm.targetName) && !matchesUserIdentity(user?.id, profile?.nombre, dm.requesterId, dm.requesterName) && !isSocialIdMatched(blockedExp, dm.requesterId));
      setPendingDmList(inc); setPendingDmCount(inc.length);
    };
    const refreshDmBadge = async (forceCloud = false) => {
      try {
        const local = await loadLocalDmThreads(user?.id, profile?.nombre);
        if (mounted) applyIncoming(local);
        if (user?.id) {
          fetchPendingSplitInvites(user.id)
            .then((rows) => {
              if (mounted) {
                setPendingSplitInvitesCount(Array.isArray(rows) ? rows.length : 0);
                setHasFetchedSplitInvites(true);
              }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        }
        if (!forceCloud && (showSquadsModalRef.current || (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.hidden))) return;
        const now = Date.now();
        if (!forceCloud && lastDmBadgeCloudSyncAt > 0 && now - lastDmBadgeCloudSyncAt < 30_000) return;
        lastDmBadgeCloudSyncAt = now;
        const list = await syncDirectMessagesFromCloud(user?.id, profile?.nombre);
        if (mounted) applyIncoming(list);
      } catch {}
    };
    refreshDmBadge(false);
    const unsubSq = subscribeSquadsDataChanged(() => {
      applyIncoming(getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot(user?.id, profile?.nombre));
      refreshDmBadge(false);
    });
    const unsubRt = subscribeKinetiClubChatsRealtimeAndFocus(user?.id, () => { refreshDmBadge(true); });
    const unsubUgc = subscribeUgcModerationChanged(() => { if (mounted) applyIncoming(latestCached); });
    return () => { mounted = false; unsubSq(); unsubRt(); unsubUgc(); };
  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre]);

  const buildChatSig = useCallback((dm: IDirectMessageThread) => `dm:${dm.dmCode}:${dm.updatedAt || dm.messages?.length || 0}`, []);
  const seenChatSet = useMemo(() => new Set(seenChatSigs), [seenChatSigs]);
  const unseenPendingDmCount = useMemo(
    () => pendingDmList.filter((dm) => !seenChatSet.has(buildChatSig(dm))).length,
    [pendingDmList, seenChatSet, buildChatSig]
  );
  const unseenSquadInvitesCount = useMemo(
    () => (solicitudesEquipoPendientes || []).filter((inv) => !seenChatSet.has(`sq:${String(inv?.id || '')}`)).length,
    [solicitudesEquipoPendientes, seenChatSet]
  );
  const unseenSplitInvitesCount = useMemo(
    () => (pendingSplitInvitesCount > 0 && !seenChatSet.has(`split:${pendingSplitInvitesCount}`) ? pendingSplitInvitesCount : 0),
    [pendingSplitInvitesCount, seenChatSet]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasFetchedSplitInvites || pendingSplitInvitesCount !== 0) return;
    setSeenChatSigs((prev) => {
      if (!prev.some((s) => s.startsWith('split:'))) return prev;
      const next = prev.filter((s) => !s.startsWith('split:'));
      if (user?.id) {
        const serialized = JSON.stringify(next);
        writeSyncStorage(`${SEEN_CHAT_ALERTS_PREFIX}${user.id}`, serialized);
        AsyncStorage.setItem(`${SEEN_CHAT_ALERTS_PREFIX}${user.id}`, serialized).catch(() => {});
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, [hasFetchedSplitInvites, pendingSplitInvitesCount, user?.id]);

  const markChatAlertsSeen = useCallback((overrideSplitCount?: number) => {
    const uid = user?.id;
    const uidLower = String(uid || 'anon').toLowerCase();
    const shouldReplaceSplit = typeof overrideSplitCount === 'number' || hasFetchedSplitInvites;
    const nextSigs = new Set(shouldReplaceSplit ? seenChatSigs.filter((s) => !s.startsWith('split:')) : seenChatSigs);
    pendingDmList.forEach((dm) => nextSigs.add(buildChatSig(dm)));
    (solicitudesEquipoPendientes || []).forEach((inv) => {
      if (inv?.id) nextSigs.add(`sq:${String(inv.id)}`);
    });
    const effectiveSplit = typeof overrideSplitCount === 'number' ? overrideSplitCount : pendingSplitInvitesCount;
    if (effectiveSplit > 0) nextSigs.add(`split:${effectiveSplit}`);
    const arr = Array.from(nextSigs).slice(-120);
    const maxItemTs = notificationItems.reduce((acc, it) => Math.max(acc, Number(it?.timestampMs) || 0), 0);
    const seenTs = Math.max(Date.now(), maxItemTs) + 1;
    const notifKey = `${NOTIF_SEEN_KEY_PREFIX}${uidLower}`;
    writeSyncStorage(notifKey, String(seenTs));
    AsyncStorage.setItem(notifKey, String(seenTs)).catch(() => {});
    setNotifSeenTsMs(seenTs);
    setSeenChatSigs(arr);
    if (uid) {
      const serialized = JSON.stringify(arr);
      writeSyncStorage(`${SEEN_CHAT_ALERTS_PREFIX}${uid}`, serialized);
      AsyncStorage.setItem(`${SEEN_CHAT_ALERTS_PREFIX}${uid}`, serialized).catch(() => {});
      patchKinetiClubTabAlertState(
        { unseenNotificationsCount: 0, pendingDmCount: 0, pendingSquadInvitesCount: 0, pendingSplitInvitesCount: 0 },
        uid
      );
    }
  }, [user?.id, seenChatSigs, pendingDmList, buildChatSig, solicitudesEquipoPendientes, pendingSplitInvitesCount, hasFetchedSplitInvites, notificationItems]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    patchKinetiClubTabAlertState({
      unseenNotificationsCount,
      pendingDmCount: unseenPendingDmCount,
      pendingSquadInvitesCount: unseenSquadInvitesCount,
      pendingSplitInvitesCount: unseenSplitInvitesCount,
    }, user.id);
  }, [user?.id, unseenNotificationsCount, unseenPendingDmCount, unseenSquadInvitesCount, unseenSplitInvitesCount]);

  const handleCopiarCodigo = useCallback(async (code: string) => {
    triggerHaptic('Success');
    await adminService.copiarAlPortapapeles(code);
    if (!showSquadsModalRef.current) showTacticalAlert(tx('CÓDIGO COPIADO', 'CODE COPIED'), tx(`Código (${code}) copiado al portapapeles.`, `Code (${code}) copied to clipboard.`), 'success');
  }, [showTacticalAlert, tx]);

  const handleReservePromoEvent = useCallback(async (ev: any): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (!user?.id || !ev?.id || reservingPromoRef.current) return false;
    reservingPromoRef.current = true;
    try {
      const promoMatch = (clubPromos || []).find((m: any) => String(m?.rawService?.id || m?.id) === String(ev.id));
      let canonicalEv = promoMatch?.rawService || promoMatch || null;
      if (!canonicalEv) { const { data: dbSvc } = await supabase.from('servicios').select('*').eq('id', String(ev.id)).maybeSingle(); if (dbSvc) canonicalEv = dbSvc; }
      if (!canonicalEv) throw new Error(tx('Evento no disponible.', 'Event unavailable.'));
      const isAdminOp = isMasterAdmin(user, profile);
      const targetDate = ev.fecha_proyectada || canonicalEv.fecha || ev.fecha || null;
      const fp = resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing({
        event: { ...canonicalEv, fecha: targetDate, hora_inicio: ev.hora_inicio || canonicalEv.hora_inicio },
        vipLevel: profile?.nivel,
        kcMembresia: profile?.kc_membresia,
        isAdmin: isAdminOp,
        isEn: language === 'en',
      });
      const esc = isAdminOp ? 0 : fp.escrow40;
      const pta = isAdminOp ? 0 : fp.puerta60;
      if (!isAdminOp && (Number(profile?.kc_membresia) || 0) + (Number(profile?.kc_topup) || 0) < esc) {
        triggerHaptic('Warning'); p.setSelectedPromoEvent(null);
        scheduleUi(() => showTacticalAlert(tx('SALDO INSUFICIENTE', 'INSUFFICIENT BALANCE'), tx(`Necesitas ${esc} KC disponibles en Bóveda para apartar esta sesión (40%).`, `You need ${esc} KC available in your Vault to book this session (40%).`), 'warning', () => router.push('/(tabs)/boveda'), tx('IR A BÓVEDA', 'OPEN VAULT')), 180);
        return false;
      }
      await exploreService.procesarReservaEscrow(
        user.id,
        { ...canonicalEv, fecha: targetDate },
        esc,
        pta,
        {
          fechaClase: targetDate,
          esPaseMaestro: isAdminOp,
          spotNumber: ev.spot_number ?? ev.selectedSpot ?? null,
          splitCount: ev.split_count ?? ev.splitCount ?? 1,
          lang: language,
        }
      );
      await Promise.all([refreshProfile?.(), fetchCommunityData(0, true, true)]);
      p.setSelectedPromoEvent(null); triggerHaptic('Success'); return true;
    } catch (err: any) {
      p.setSelectedPromoEvent(null);
      scheduleUi(() => showTacticalAlert(tx('ERROR AL RESERVAR', 'BOOKING ERROR'), err?.message || tx('Intenta nuevamente.', 'Please try again.'), 'error'), 180);
      return false;
    } finally { reservingPromoRef.current = false; }
  }, [user, profile, clubPromos, refreshProfile, fetchCommunityData, showTacticalAlert, tx, router, scheduleUi, p.setSelectedPromoEvent, language]);

  return {
    rankingSearch, setRankingSearch, rankingFilterKey, rankingSortKey, handleSelectRankingFilter, handleSelectRankingSort,
    filteredTop10, filteredVisibleData, activeStoriesMap, notificationItems, unseenNotificationsCount, setNotifSeenTsMs,
    fireMap, handleToggleAthleteFire, storyOwner, setStoryOwner, pendingDmCount, unseenPendingDmCount, unseenSquadInvitesCount,
    pendingDmToOpen, setPendingDmToOpen, pendingSplitInvitesCount, setPendingSplitInvitesCount: updatePendingSplitInvitesCount,
    alertConfig, setAlertConfig, showTacticalAlert, scheduleUi, squadMembersSet, pendingSentSet, claimableCount, claimedTotal,
    handleOpenMyStory, handleOpenStory, handleInspectAthlete, handleLinkAthlete, handleOpenDirectDmWithAthlete,
    handleCopiarCodigo, handleReservePromoEvent, markChatAlertsSeen,
  };
}

    // === src/hooks/kineticlub/useKinetiClubSquads.ts === //
import { MutableRefObject, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { triggerArcadeHaptic, triggerHaptic } from '../../components/SharedUI';
import { publishSquadMessageCloud, resolveSquadCloudRoomKey } from '../../services/kineticRealtimeChatBridge';
import {
  deleteSquadAndMessages, fetchSquadMessagesForTeam, leaveSquadAndClean,
  loadUnifiedSquadsAndMessages, persistSharedSquadRecord, subscribeSquadsDataChanged,
} from '../../services/kineticlubSquadsService';
import {
  connectTeamByCodeCloudMutation, createOrUpdateTeamCloudMutation,
  inviteAthleteToTeamCloudMutation, respondTeamInviteCloudMutation,
} from '../../services/kineticlubTeamMutationsHelper';
import { subscribeKinetiClubChatsRealtimeAndFocus } from '../../services/kineticlubWallCloudService';
import { IEquipoKinetic, IMensajeEquipo, IMiembroEquipo } from '../../types';

interface IUseKinetiClubSquadsParams {
  user: any; profile: any; suggestedAthletes: any[];
  isMountedRef: MutableRefObject<boolean>; language: 'es' | 'en'; tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
}

export function useKinetiClubSquads({
  user, profile, suggestedAthletes, isMountedRef, language, tx,
}: IUseKinetiClubSquadsParams) {
  const [linkingId, setLinkingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showSquadsModal, setShowSquadsModal] = useState(false);
  const [initialSquadSection, setInitialSquadSection] = useState<'hub' | 'invitar' | 'chat'>('hub');
  const [misEquipos, setMisEquipos] = useState<IEquipoKinetic[]>([]);
  const [hasConfiguredSquad, setHasConfiguredSquad] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [solicitudesEquipoPendientes, setSolicitudesEquipoPendientes] = useState<IMiembroEquipo[]>([]);
  const [sentPendingNames, setSentPendingNames] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [activeSquadChat, setActiveSquadChat] = useState<IEquipoKinetic | null>(null);
  const [squadMessages, setSquadMessages] = useState<IMensajeEquipo[]>([]);
  const [isCreatingSquad, setIsCreatingSquad] = useState(false);
  const [isSendingSquadMsg, setIsSendingSquadMsg] = useState(false);

  const activeSquadIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const squadsSigRef = useRef<string>('');
  const invitesSigRef = useRef<string>('');
  const sentSigRef = useRef<string>('');
  const activeSquadSigRef = useRef<string>('');
  const msgsSigRef = useRef<string>('');
  const squadOpRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());

  useEffect(() => { activeSquadIdRef.current = activeSquadChat?.id ? String(activeSquadChat.id) : null; }, [activeSquadChat?.id]);

  const syncSquadsAndChatData = useCallback(async (preferredSquadId?: string) => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    const uid = String(user.id), myName = String(profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')).trim();
    try {
      const res = await loadUnifiedSquadsAndMessages(uid, myName);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      setHasConfiguredSquad((prev) => (prev === res.hasConfigured ? prev : res.hasConfigured));

      const nextEquipos = res.allUserSquads, nextSquadsSig = JSON.stringify(nextEquipos);
      if (nextSquadsSig !== squadsSigRef.current) { squadsSigRef.current = nextSquadsSig; setMisEquipos(nextEquipos); }
      const nextInvitesSig = JSON.stringify(res.pendingInvites);
      if (nextInvitesSig !== invitesSigRef.current) { invitesSigRef.current = nextInvitesSig; setSolicitudesEquipoPendientes(res.pendingInvites); }
      const nextSentSig = JSON.stringify(res.sentPendingNames);
      if (nextSentSig !== sentSigRef.current) { sentSigRef.current = nextSentSig; setSentPendingNames(res.sentPendingNames); }

      if (nextEquipos.length === 0) {
        activeSquadSigRef.current = ''; activeSquadIdRef.current = null; setActiveSquadChat(null);
        msgsSigRef.current = '[]'; setSquadMessages([]); return;
      }
      const targetId = preferredSquadId || activeSquadIdRef.current;
      const matchedSquad = res.allUserSquads.find((s) => String(s.id) === String(targetId)) || res.activeSquad || nextEquipos[0];
      const nextActiveSig = JSON.stringify(matchedSquad);
      if (nextActiveSig !== activeSquadSigRef.current) {
        activeSquadSigRef.current = nextActiveSig; activeSquadIdRef.current = String(matchedSquad.id); setActiveSquadChat(matchedSquad);
      }
      const resolvedMsgs = String(matchedSquad.id) !== String(res.activeSquad?.id || '')
        ? await fetchSquadMessagesForTeam(String(matchedSquad.id), matchedSquad.creador_nombre || myName, matchedSquad.nombre, matchedSquad)
        : res.messages;
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      const nextMsgsSig = JSON.stringify(resolvedMsgs);
      if (nextMsgsSig !== msgsSigRef.current) { msgsSigRef.current = nextMsgsSig; setSquadMessages(resolvedMsgs); }
    } catch {}
  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre, isMountedRef, tx]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    syncSquadsAndChatData();
    const unsubLocal = subscribeSquadsDataChanged(() => { syncSquadsAndChatData(); });
    const unsubRt = subscribeKinetiClubChatsRealtimeAndFocus(user.id, () => { syncSquadsAndChatData(); });
    const fallbackTimer = setInterval(() => { if (typeof document === 'undefined' || document.hidden === false) syncSquadsAndChatData(); }, 30_000);
    return () => { unsubLocal(); unsubRt(); clearInterval(fallbackTimer); };
  }, [user?.id, syncSquadsAndChatData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showSquadsModal || !user?.id) return;
    const isPageVisible = () => typeof document === 'undefined' || document.hidden === false;
    if (isPageVisible()) syncSquadsAndChatData();
    const pollInterval = setInterval(() => { if (showSquadsModal && isPageVisible()) syncSquadsAndChatData(); }, 30_000);
    return () => clearInterval(pollInterval);
  }, [showSquadsModal, user?.id, syncSquadsAndChatData]);

  const crearEquipoKinetic = useCallback(async (nombre: string, disciplina: string, descripcion?: string, hapticFn?: any, alertFn?: any) => {
    const cleanName = String(nombre || '').trim();
    if (!cleanName) {
      (hapticFn || triggerHaptic)('Error');
      alertFn?.(tx('Nombre Requerido', 'Name Required'), tx('Escribe un nombre para tu equipo.', 'Enter a name for your team.'), 'warning');
      return false;
    }
    if (squadOpRef.current.has('create')) return false;
    squadOpRef.current.add('create'); setIsCreatingSquad(true);
    try {
      const uid = String(user?.id || 'admin'), myName = profile?.nombre || tx('Kinetic Oficial', 'Kinetic Official');
      const res = await createOrUpdateTeamCloudMutation({ uid, myName, cleanName, disciplina, descripcion, misEquipos, language, tx });
      if (!res.ok) { (hapticFn || triggerHaptic)('Error'); if (res.alert) alertFn?.(res.alert.title, res.alert.body, res.alert.kind); return false; }
      setHasConfiguredSquad(true);
      await syncSquadsAndChatData(res.finalSquadId);
      (hapticFn || triggerHaptic)('Success');
      if (res.alert) alertFn?.(res.alert.title, res.alert.body, res.alert.kind);
      return true;
    } finally { squadOpRef.current.delete('create'); if (isMountedRef.current) setIsCreatingSquad(false); }
  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre, misEquipos, syncSquadsAndChatData, isMountedRef, language, tx]);

  const invitarAtletaAEquipo = useCallback(async (athlete: any, hapticFn?: any, alertFn?: any) => {
    if (!athlete || squadOpRef.current.has('invite')) return false;
    squadOpRef.current.add('invite');
    try {
      (hapticFn || triggerHaptic)('Medium');
      const res = await inviteAthleteToTeamCloudMutation({
        uid: String(user?.id || 'admin'), myName: String(profile?.nombre || tx('Kinetic Oficial', 'Kinetic Official')).trim(),
        myEmail: user?.email || profile?.email || '', athlete, misEquipos, tx,
      });
      if (!res.ok) { if (res.alert) alertFn?.(res.alert.title, res.alert.body, res.alert.kind); return false; }
      if (res.athleteName) {
        setSentPendingNames((prev) => {
          const next = Array.from(new Set([...prev, res.athleteName!.toLowerCase()])).sort();
          sentSigRef.current = JSON.stringify(next); return next;
        });
      }
      await syncSquadsAndChatData(res.dbSquadId);
      triggerArcadeHaptic('checkIn');
      if (res.alert) alertFn?.(res.alert.title, res.alert.body, res.alert.kind);
      return true;
    } finally { squadOpRef.current.delete('invite'); }
  }, [misEquipos, user?.id, user?.email, profile?.nombre, profile?.email, syncSquadsAndChatData, tx]);

  const conectarPorCodigoEquipo = useCallback(async (rawCode: string, hapticFn?: any, alertFn?: any) => {
    const cleanCode = String(rawCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!/^(EQ|SQ)-[A-Z0-9]{4,16}$/.test(cleanCode)) {
      alertFn?.(tx('CÓDIGO INVÁLIDO', 'INVALID CODE'), tx('Ingresa un código válido EQ-XXXXXX o SQ-XXXXXX.', 'Enter a valid EQ-XXXXXX or SQ-XXXXXX code.'), 'warning');
      return false;
    }
    if (squadOpRef.current.has('code')) return false;
    squadOpRef.current.add('code');
    try {
      const uid = String(user?.id || 'anon'), myName = String(profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')).trim();
      const joined = await connectTeamByCodeCloudMutation({ cleanCode, uid, myName, tx });
      if (joined.ok && joined.teamId) {
        await syncSquadsAndChatData(joined.teamId);
        triggerArcadeHaptic('checkIn');
        alertFn?.(tx('¡UNIDO AL EQUIPO!', 'JOINED TEAM!'), tx(`Te has integrado a "${joined.teamName}". Ya puedes escribir en el Chat Grupal.`, `You joined "${joined.teamName}". You can now chat in the Group Channel.`), 'success');
