      }
      const matchedSuggested = suggestedAthletes.find((a: any) => `SQ-${String(a?.id || '101').replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 6).toUpperCase()}` === cleanCode);
      if (matchedSuggested) return await invitarAtletaAEquipo(matchedSuggested, hapticFn, alertFn);
      alertFn?.(tx('CÓDIGO NO ENCONTRADO', 'CODE NOT FOUND'), tx('No se encontró un equipo o atleta activo con ese código.', 'No active team or athlete was found with that code.'), 'warning');

  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre, suggestedAthletes, invitarAtletaAEquipo, syncSquadsAndChatData, tx]);

  const handleVinculacion = useCallback(async (athlete: any, hapticFn?: any, alertFn?: any) => {
    if (!athlete) return; setLinkingId(athlete.id);

  }, [invitarAtletaAEquipo]);

    const lockKey = `resp_${miembroId}`;

    squadOpRef.current.add(lockKey);
    try {
      (hapticFn || triggerHaptic)('Medium');

      const myName = String(profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')).trim();
      const targetEqId = await respondTeamInviteCloudMutation({ miembroId, estado, targetInv, userId: user?.id, myName, tx });
      if (targetEqId && targetInv) {
        await syncSquadsAndChatData(targetEqId);
        triggerArcadeHaptic('checkIn');
        alertFn?.(tx('¡INTEGRADO AL EQUIPO!', 'TEAM JOINED!'), tx(`Te has unido a "${targetInv.equipo_nombre || 'Equipo Kinetic'}". Ahora están conectados en el mismo Chat Grupal.`, `You joined "${targetInv.equipo_nombre || 'Kinetic Team'}". You are now connected in the Group Chat.`), 'success');
      }
    } finally { squadOpRef.current.delete(lockKey); }
  }, [solicitudesEquipoPendientes, profile?.nombre, user?.id, syncSquadsAndChatData, tx]);

  const abrirChatEquipo = useCallback(async (equipo: IEquipoKinetic, hapticFn?: any) => {
    if (!equipo?.id || String(equipo.id).startsWith('sq_')) return;
    (hapticFn || triggerHaptic)('Light');
    activeSquadIdRef.current = String(equipo.id);
    const nextEqSig = JSON.stringify(equipo);
    if (nextEqSig !== activeSquadSigRef.current) { activeSquadSigRef.current = nextEqSig; setActiveSquadChat(equipo); }
    const msgs = await fetchSquadMessagesForTeam(String(equipo.id), equipo.creador_nombre || tx('Kinetic Oficial', 'Kinetic Official'), equipo.nombre, equipo);
    if (isMountedRef.current) { const nextSig = JSON.stringify(msgs); if (nextSig !== msgsSigRef.current) { msgsSigRef.current = nextSig; setSquadMessages(msgs); } }
  }, [isMountedRef, tx]);

  const enviarMensajeEquipo = useCallback(async (equipoId: string, texto: string, hapticFn?: any) => {
    const clean = String(texto || '').trim();
    if (!clean || isSendingSquadMsg || squadOpRef.current.has('msg')) return;
    const targetSquad = misEquipos.find((s) => String(s.id) === String(equipoId)) || (misEquipos.length > 0 ? activeSquadChat || misEquipos[0] : null);
    if (!targetSquad?.id || String(targetSquad.id).startsWith('sq_')) return;
    squadOpRef.current.add('msg'); (hapticFn || triggerHaptic)('Light'); setIsSendingSquadMsg(true);
    try {
      const uid = String(user?.id || 'anon'), myName = String(profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')).trim();
      const finalEquipoId = String(targetSquad.id), nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      const newMsg: IMensajeEquipo = {
        id: `msg_${Date.now()}`, equipo_id: finalEquipoId, usuario_id: uid, usuario_nombre: myName,
        usuario_avatar: profile?.avatar_url || undefined, mensaje: clean, created_at: nowIso,
      } as any;
      setSquadMessages((prev) => { const next = [...prev, newMsg]; msgsSigRef.current = JSON.stringify(next); return next; });
      await persistSharedSquadRecord(targetSquad, newMsg);
      await publishSquadMessageCloud({
        id: String(newMsg.id), equipoId: finalEquipoId, squadCode: targetSquad.codigo_invitacion,
        roomKey: resolveSquadCloudRoomKey(targetSquad), senderId: uid, senderName: myName,
        senderAvatar: profile?.avatar_url || null, text: clean, createdAt: nowIso,

  }, [isSendingSquadMsg, user?.id, profile?.nombre, profile?.avatar_url, misEquipos, activeSquadChat, tx]);

  const eliminarEquipoKinetic = useCallback(async (equipoId: string) => {
    if (squadOpRef.current.has('leave_del')) return;
    squadOpRef.current.add('leave_del');

  const salirDeEquipoKinetic = useCallback(async (equipoId: string) => {
    if (squadOpRef.current.has('leave_del')) return;
    squadOpRef.current.add('leave_del');

    finally { squadOpRef.current.delete('leave_del'); }
  }, [user?.id, profile?.nombre, syncSquadsAndChatData]);

  return {
    linkingId, showSquadsModal, setShowSquadsModal, initialSquadSection, setInitialSquadSection,
    misEquipos, hasConfiguredSquad, solicitudesEquipoPendientes, sentPendingNames,
    activeSquadChat, setActiveSquadChat, squadMessages, isCreatingSquad, isSendingSquadMsg,
    syncSquadsAndChatData, crearEquipoKinetic, invitarAtletaAEquipo, conectarPorCodigoEquipo,
    handleVinculacion, responderSolicitudEquipo, abrirChatEquipo, enviarMensajeEquipo,
    eliminarEquipoKinetic, salirDeEquipoKinetic,

}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import * as ImagePicker from 'expo-image-picker';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import {
  emitKineticStoriesUpdated,
  getSyncStoriesForOwner,
  IKineticStoryItem,
  IKineticStoryOwner,
  KineticStoriesModalProps,
  normalizeStoryOwnerKey,
  publishStoryEventToCloud,
  readLocalStoriesMap,
  STORY_DURATION_MS,
  STORY_TAG_EN_MAP,
  STORY_TAG_PRESETS,
  STORY_TTL_MS,
  syncStoriesFromCloud,
  uploadStoryImageToStorageCdn,
  writeLocalStoriesMap,
} from '../../services/kineticStoriesService';
import { isMasterAdmin, translateClubTerm } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { compressWebImageUri } from '../../utils/externalLinks';

function mapSlideFallback(
  owner: IKineticStoryOwner | null | undefined,
  normalizedOwner: string,
  resolvedName: string,
  resolvedSubtitle: string,
  resolvedAvatar: string | undefined,
  isEn: boolean
): IKineticStoryItem[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(owner?.slides) || owner.slides.length === 0) return [];
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  return owner.slides
    .filter((sl) => sl?.imageUrl && (/^https?:\/\//i.test(sl.imageUrl) || sl.imageUrl.startsWith('data:image/')))
    .map((sl, idx) => {
      const ts = typeof sl.createdAt === 'number' ? sl.createdAt : Date.parse(String(sl.createdAt || '')) || nowMs;
      return {
        id: String(sl.id || `slide_${idx}`),
        ownerId: owner.id ? String(owner.id) : undefined,
        ownerKey: normalizedOwner,
        ownerName: resolvedName,
        ownerSubtitle: resolvedSubtitle,
        ownerAvatar: resolvedAvatar,
        imageUrl: sl.imageUrl,
        caption: String(sl.caption || '').trim(),
        tag: sl.tag || (owner?.isPromo || owner?.linkedEvent ? (isEn ? '⚡ CLUB PROMO' : '⚡ PROMO CLUB') : (isEn ? 'TODAY’S WORKOUT' : 'ENTRENAMIENTO DEL DÍA')),
        createdAtMs: ts,
        fireCount: Number(sl.fireCount || 0),
        boltCount: Number(sl.boltCount || 0),
        isPromo: Boolean(owner?.isPromo || owner?.linkedEvent || owner?.promoEvent),
        linkedEvent: owner?.linkedEvent || owner?.promoEvent,
      };
    })
    .filter((sl) => nowMs - sl.createdAtMs < STORY_TTL_MS);
}

export function useKineticStoriesViewer(props: KineticStoriesModalProps) {
  const {
    visible, onClose, owner, ownerKey, ownerName, ownerSubtitle, ownerAvatar, accentColor,
    canUpload: canUploadProp, startInUploadMode = false, autoOpenPicker = false, viewerId,
    onStoriesChanged, onStoriesUpdated, onPrimaryAction, primaryActionLabel, onOpenLinkedEvent,
  } = props;
  const { user, profile } = useAuth();
  const { language } = useKineticPreferences();
  const isEn = language === 'en';

  const resolvedName = useMemo(() => {
    const raw = String(owner?.name || ownerName || (isEn ? 'Kinetic Athlete' : 'Atleta Kinetic')).trim();
    return raw === 'Terminal Global Kinetic' ? 'Kinetic Oficial' : raw;
  }, [owner?.name, ownerName, isEn]);
  const resolvedKeyRaw = useMemo(() => String(owner?.id || ownerKey || resolvedName).trim(), [owner?.id, ownerKey, resolvedName]);
  const resolvedSubtitle = useMemo(
    () => translateClubTerm(String(owner?.subtitle || ownerSubtitle || (isEn ? 'Kinetic Member' : 'Miembro Kinetic')).trim(), language),
    [owner?.subtitle, ownerSubtitle, isEn, language]
  );
  const resolvedAvatar = useMemo(() => (owner?.avatarUrl || owner?.avatar || ownerAvatar || undefined) as string | undefined, [owner?.avatarUrl, owner?.avatar, ownerAvatar]);
  const resolvedAccent = useMemo(() => accentColor || owner?.accentColor || COLORS.cyan, [accentColor, owner?.accentColor]);
  const normalizedOwner = useMemo(() => normalizeStoryOwnerKey(resolvedKeyRaw, resolvedName), [resolvedKeyRaw, resolvedName]);
  const normalizedByName = useMemo(() => normalizeStoryOwnerKey(resolvedName, resolvedKeyRaw), [resolvedName, resolvedKeyRaw]);

  const canUpload = useMemo(() => {
    if (typeof canUploadProp === 'boolean') return canUploadProp;
    if (typeof owner?.canUpload === 'boolean') return owner.canUpload;
    if (typeof owner?.allowUpload === 'boolean') return owner.allowUpload;
    const isMaster = isMasterAdmin(user, profile);
    const isOfficialTarget = Boolean(owner?.isOfficialKinetic || normalizeStoryOwnerKey(resolvedName) === 'kineticoficial');
    if (isOfficialTarget) return isMaster;
    if (isMaster && owner?.isB2B) return true;
    const myUserId = String(user?.id || '').trim();
    const ownerIdClean = String(owner?.id || '').trim();
    if (ownerIdClean) return Boolean(myUserId && ownerIdClean === myUserId);
    const myProfileName = String(profile?.nombre || '').trim();
    return Boolean(!myUserId && myProfileName && normalizeStoryOwnerKey(myProfileName) === normalizeStoryOwnerKey(resolvedName));
  }, [canUploadProp, owner?.canUpload, owner?.allowUpload, owner?.id, owner?.isOfficialKinetic, owner?.isB2B, user, profile, resolvedName]);

  const shouldAutoTriggerPicker = Boolean(autoOpenPicker || owner?.autoOpenPicker || owner?.autoStartUpload);
  const shouldStartInUpload = Boolean(startInUploadMode || shouldAutoTriggerPicker);

  const initialSyncStories = useMemo(() => {
    const syncCached = getSyncStoriesForOwner(normalizedOwner, normalizedByName);
    if (syncCached.length > 0) return syncCached;
    return !shouldStartInUpload
      ? mapSlideFallback(owner, normalizedOwner, resolvedName, resolvedSubtitle, resolvedAvatar, isEn)
      : [];
  }, [normalizedOwner, normalizedByName, shouldStartInUpload, owner, resolvedName, resolvedSubtitle, resolvedAvatar, isEn]);

  const [stories, setStories] = useState<IKineticStoryItem[]>(() => initialSyncStories);
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [isStudioOpen, setIsStudioOpen] = useState(() => Boolean((initialSyncStories.length === 0 || shouldStartInUpload) && canUpload));
  const [isAvatarZoomOpen, setIsAvatarZoomOpen] = useState(false);
  const [draftImageUri, setDraftImageUri] = useState('');
  const [draftCaption, setDraftCaption] = useState('');
  const [draftTag, setDraftTag] = useState<string>(STORY_TAG_PRESETS[0]);
  const [selectedPromoEvent, setSelectedPromoEvent] = useState<any | null>(() => owner?.linkedEvent || owner?.promoEvent || null);
  const [isPickingOrSaving, setIsPickingOrSaving] = useState(false);
  const [isDeletingStory, setIsDeletingStory] = useState(false);
  const [confirmDeleteStory, setConfirmDeleteStory] = useState(false);
  const [reactionToast, setReactionToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [localViewerId, setLocalViewerId] = useState('viewer-anon');

  const isPickingRef = useRef(false);
  const isPublishingRef = useRef(false);
  const isDeletingStoryRef = useRef(false);
  const isReactingStoryRef = useRef(false);
  const draftBlobRef = useRef('');
  draftBlobRef.current = draftImageUri;
  const autoPickedOnceRef = useRef(false);
  const storyTimersRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>[]>([]);

  const scheduleStoryTimeout = useCallback((fn: () => void, ms: number) => {
    const tid = setTimeout(fn, ms);
    storyTimersRef.current.push(tid);
    return tid;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    storyTimersRef.current.forEach((t) => clearTimeout(t));
    storyTimersRef.current = [];
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && draftBlobRef.current.startsWith('blob:')) {
      try { URL.revokeObjectURL(draftBlobRef.current); } catch {}
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { setConfirmDeleteStory(false); }, [currentIndex, visible]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    (async () => {
      if (viewerId) { if (mounted) setLocalViewerId(String(viewerId)); return; }
      if (user?.id) { if (mounted) setLocalViewerId(String(user.id)); return; }
      try {
        let anon = await AsyncStorage.getItem('@kinetic_story_viewer_id');
        if (!anon) {
          anon = `v_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
          await AsyncStorage.setItem('@kinetic_story_viewer_id', anon);
        }
        if (mounted) setLocalViewerId(anon);
      } catch {}
    })();
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, [viewerId, user?.id]);

  const notifyCallbacks = useCallback((count: number) => { onStoriesChanged?.(count); onStoriesUpdated?.(count > 0); }, [onStoriesChanged, onStoriesUpdated]);

  const handlePickPhoto = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isPickingRef.current) return;
    isPickingRef.current = true;
    setIsPickingOrSaving(true);
    try {
      const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({ mediaTypes: ['images'], allowsEditing: Platform.OS !== 'web', quality: 0.84 });
      if (!result.canceled && result.assets && result.assets.length > 0) {
        const pickedUri = result.assets[0].uri;
        const persistentUri = await compressWebImageUri(pickedUri, 720, 0.68);
        if (Platform.OS === 'web' && pickedUri.startsWith('blob:') && persistentUri !== pickedUri) { try { URL.revokeObjectURL(pickedUri); } catch {} }
        if (Platform.OS === 'web' && draftBlobRef.current.startsWith('blob:') && draftBlobRef.current !== persistentUri) { try { URL.revokeObjectURL(draftBlobRef.current); } catch {} }
        setDraftImageUri(persistentUri);
        setIsStudioOpen(true);
      }
    } catch {} finally {
      setIsPickingOrSaving(false);
      scheduleStoryTimeout(() => { isPickingRef.current = false; }, 350);
    }
  }, [scheduleStoryTimeout]);

  const loadOwnerStories = useCallback(async () => {
    const map = await syncStoriesFromCloud();
    const listA = map[normalizedOwner] || [];
    const listB = normalizedByName !== normalizedOwner ? map[normalizedByName] || [] : [];
    const combinedMap = new Map<string, IKineticStoryItem>();
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    [...listA, ...listB].forEach((item) => { if (item && item.id && nowMs - item.createdAtMs < STORY_TTL_MS && item.imageUrl) combinedMap.set(item.id, item); });
    let list = Array.from(combinedMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.createdAtMs - b.createdAtMs);
    if (list.length === 0 && !shouldStartInUpload) {
      list = mapSlideFallback(owner, normalizedOwner, resolvedName, resolvedSubtitle, resolvedAvatar, isEn);
    }
    setStories(list);
    notifyCallbacks(list.length);
    setIsStudioOpen(Boolean((list.length === 0 || shouldStartInUpload) && canUpload));
  }, [normalizedOwner, normalizedByName, owner, resolvedName, resolvedSubtitle, resolvedAvatar, canUpload, shouldStartInUpload, isEn, notifyCallbacks]);

  const progressRef = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => { progressRef.current = 0; setCurrentIndex(0); setProgress(0); loadOwnerStories(); }, [loadOwnerStories]);
  useEffect(() => { progressRef.current = 0; setProgress(0); }, [currentIndex]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (shouldAutoTriggerPicker && canUpload && !autoPickedOnceRef.current) { autoPickedOnceRef.current = true; scheduleStoryTimeout(() => { handlePickPhoto(); }, 120); }
  }, [shouldAutoTriggerPicker, canUpload, handlePickPhoto, scheduleStoryTimeout]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isStudioOpen || isPaused || isAvatarZoomOpen || stories.length === 0) return;
    const stepMs = 60;
    const increment = stepMs / STORY_DURATION_MS;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const next = progressRef.current + increment;
      if (next >= 1) {
        progressRef.current = 0;
        if (currentIndex < stories.length - 1) { setProgress(0); setCurrentIndex((idx) => idx + 1); }
        else { clearInterval(interval); setProgress(1); onClose(); }
        return;
      }
      progressRef.current = next;
      setProgress(next);
    }, stepMs);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isStudioOpen, isPaused, isAvatarZoomOpen, stories.length, currentIndex, onClose]);

  const handlePublishStory = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!draftImageUri || isPickingOrSaving || isPublishingRef.current) return;
    isPublishingRef.current = true;
    setIsPickingOrSaving(true);
    try {
      const preparedUri = draftImageUri.startsWith('data:image/') ? draftImageUri : await compressWebImageUri(draftImageUri, 720, 0.68);
      const rawEv = selectedPromoEvent || owner?.linkedEvent || owner?.promoEvent || undefined;
      const evTarget = rawEv ? {
        id: rawEv.id, nombre_servicio: rawEv.nombre_servicio || rawEv.titulo, titulo: rawEv.titulo || rawEv.nombre_servicio,
        negocio_nombre: rawEv.negocio_nombre || resolvedName, categoria: rawEv.categoria, fecha: rawEv.fecha,
        hora_inicio: rawEv.hora_inicio, duracion_minutos: rawEv.duracion_minutos, precio_kc: rawEv.precio_kc,
        cupo_maximo: rawEv.cupo_maximo, ubicacion: rawEv.ubicacion, instructor_nombre: rawEv.instructor_nombre, descripcion: rawEv.descripcion,
      } : undefined;
      const isPromoFlag = Boolean(evTarget || owner?.isPromo);
      const defaultTag = isPromoFlag ? (isEn ? '⚡ CLUB PROMO' : '⚡ PROMO CLUB') : (isEn ? 'TODAY’S WORKOUT' : 'ENTRENAMIENTO DEL DÍA');
      const resolvedTag = !draftTag || draftTag === 'ENTRENAMIENTO DEL DÍA' ? defaultTag : (isEn ? STORY_TAG_EN_MAP[draftTag] || draftTag : draftTag);
      const canonicalOwnerId = String(owner?.id || user?.id || normalizedOwner).trim();
      const storyId = `story_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
      const optimisticStory: IKineticStoryItem = {
        id: storyId,
        ownerId: canonicalOwnerId,
        ownerKey: normalizedOwner, ownerName: resolvedName, ownerSubtitle: resolvedSubtitle, ownerAvatar: resolvedAvatar,
        imageUrl: preparedUri || draftImageUri, caption: draftCaption.trim(), tag: resolvedTag,
        createdAtMs: Date.now(), createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        fireCount: 0, boltCount: 0, viewCount: 0, viewedBy: [], reactedFireBy: [], reactedBoltBy: [],
        isPromo: isPromoFlag, isB2B: Boolean(owner?.isB2B),
        eventId: evTarget?.id ? String(evTarget.id) : undefined, linkedEvent: evTarget,
      };
      const mapImmediate = await readLocalStoriesMap();
      const optimisticList = [...(mapImmediate[normalizedOwner] || []), optimisticStory];
      mapImmediate[normalizedOwner] = optimisticList;
      if (normalizedByName && normalizedByName !== normalizedOwner) mapImmediate[normalizedByName] = optimisticList;
      await writeLocalStoriesMap(mapImmediate);
      emitKineticStoriesUpdated();
      setStories(optimisticList); setCurrentIndex(optimisticList.length - 1);
      setDraftImageUri(''); setDraftCaption(''); setSelectedPromoEvent(owner?.linkedEvent || owner?.promoEvent || null);

      const finalizedStory: IKineticStoryItem = { ...optimisticStory, imageUrl: finalImageUri };
      const mapUpdated = await readLocalStoriesMap();

      isPublishingRef.current = false;
      setIsPickingOrSaving(false);

  }, [draftImageUri, isPickingOrSaving, owner?.id, owner?.isB2B, owner?.isPromo, owner?.linkedEvent, owner?.promoEvent, selectedPromoEvent, user?.id, normalizedOwner, normalizedByName, resolvedName, resolvedSubtitle, resolvedAvatar, draftCaption, draftTag, isEn, notifyCallbacks]);

  const handleDeleteCurrentStory = useCallback(async () => {
    const activeStory = stories[currentIndex];

    isDeletingStoryRef.current = true;
    setIsDeletingStory(true);

      const map = await readLocalStoriesMap();
      const nextList = stories.filter((s) => s.id !== activeStory.id);
      Object.keys(map).forEach((k) => {
        const filtered = (map[k] || []).filter((s) => s.id !== activeStory.id);
        if (filtered.length > 0) map[k] = filtered; else delete map[k];
      });
      if (nextList.length > 0) {
        map[normalizedOwner] = nextList;
        if (normalizedByName) map[normalizedByName] = nextList;
      }
      await writeLocalStoriesMap(map);
      emitKineticStoriesUpdated();
      await publishStoryEventToCloud({ type: 'DELETE_STORY', storyId: activeStory.id, ownerId: activeStory.ownerId, ownerKey: normalizedOwner, ownerName: resolvedName }).catch(() => {});
      emitKineticStoriesUpdated();
      setStories(nextList); notifyCallbacks(nextList.length);
      if (nextList.length === 0) { if (canUpload) setIsStudioOpen(true); else onClose(); }
      else { setCurrentIndex(Math.max(0, currentIndex - 1)); setProgress(0); }
    } finally {
      isDeletingStoryRef.current = false;
      setIsDeletingStory(false);
    }
  }, [stories, currentIndex, isDeletingStory, normalizedOwner, normalizedByName, resolvedName, canUpload, onClose, notifyCallbacks]);

  const handleToggleReaction = useCallback(async (type: 'fire' | 'bolt') => {
    const activeStory = stories[currentIndex];
    if (!activeStory || isReactingStoryRef.current) return;
    if (canUpload) {
      setReactionToast(isEn ? 'You cannot react to your own story' : 'No puedes reaccionar a tu propia historia');
      scheduleStoryTimeout(() => setReactionToast(null), 1600);
      return;
    }
    isReactingStoryRef.current = true;
    try {
      const fireUsers = new Set<string>(activeStory.reactedFireBy || []);
      const boltUsers = new Set<string>(activeStory.reactedBoltBy || []);
      const uid = localViewerId || 'viewer-anon';
      let toastText = '';
      if (type === 'fire') {
        if (fireUsers.has(uid)) { fireUsers.delete(uid); toastText = isEn ? 'Reaction removed' : 'Reacción retirada'; }
        else { fireUsers.add(uid); boltUsers.delete(uid); toastText = isEn ? '🔥 Reaction sent!' : '🔥 ¡Reacción enviada!'; }
      } else if (boltUsers.has(uid)) {
        boltUsers.delete(uid); toastText = isEn ? 'Reaction removed' : 'Reacción retirada';
      } else {
        boltUsers.add(uid); fireUsers.delete(uid); toastText = isEn ? '⚡ Energy sent!' : '⚡ ¡Energía enviada!';
      }
      const updatedStory: IKineticStoryItem = {
        ...activeStory, reactedFireBy: Array.from(fireUsers), reactedBoltBy: Array.from(boltUsers),
        fireCount: fireUsers.size, boltCount: boltUsers.size,
      };
      const nextList = stories.map((s, idx) => (idx === currentIndex ? updatedStory : s));
      setStories(nextList);
      const map = await readLocalStoriesMap();
      map[normalizedOwner] = nextList;
      if (normalizedByName) map[normalizedByName] = nextList;
      await writeLocalStoriesMap(map);
      publishStoryEventToCloud({
        type: 'REACTION_STORY', storyId: updatedStory.id, ownerKey: normalizedOwner, ownerName: resolvedName,
        fireCount: updatedStory.fireCount, boltCount: updatedStory.boltCount,
        reactedFireBy: updatedStory.reactedFireBy, reactedBoltBy: updatedStory.reactedBoltBy,
      }).catch(() => {});
      setReactionToast(toastText);
      scheduleStoryTimeout(() => setReactionToast(null), 1400);
    } finally {
      isReactingStoryRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [stories, currentIndex, canUpload, isEn, localViewerId, normalizedOwner, normalizedByName, resolvedName, scheduleStoryTimeout]);

  const activeStory = stories[currentIndex] || null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isStudioOpen || !activeStory || canUpload) return;
    const viewerKey = normalizeStoryOwnerKey(profile?.nombre || user?.id || localViewerId, localViewerId);
    if (!viewerKey || viewerKey === normalizedOwner) return;
    const prevViewed = new Set<string>(activeStory.viewedBy || []);
    if (prevViewed.has(viewerKey)) return;
    prevViewed.add(viewerKey);
    const nextViewedArr = Array.from(prevViewed);
    const nextViewCount = Math.max(Number(activeStory.viewCount || 0) + 1, nextViewedArr.length);
    const updatedStory: IKineticStoryItem = { ...activeStory, viewedBy: nextViewedArr, viewCount: nextViewCount };
    const nextList = stories.map((s, idx) => (idx === currentIndex ? updatedStory : s));
    setStories(nextList);
    (async () => {
      const map = await readLocalStoriesMap();
      map[normalizedOwner] = nextList;
      if (normalizedByName) map[normalizedByName] = nextList;
      await writeLocalStoriesMap(map);
      publishStoryEventToCloud({ type: 'VIEW_STORY', storyId: updatedStory.id, ownerKey: normalizedOwner, ownerName: resolvedName, viewerKey, viewedBy: nextViewedArr, viewCount: nextViewCount }).catch(() => {});
    })();
  }, [isStudioOpen, activeStory?.id, canUpload, profile?.nombre, user?.id, localViewerId, normalizedOwner, normalizedByName, resolvedName]);

  const handleCloseStudio = useCallback(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && draftBlobRef.current.startsWith('blob:')) {
      try { URL.revokeObjectURL(draftBlobRef.current); } catch {}
      draftBlobRef.current = '';
    }
    setDraftImageUri('');
    if (stories.length > 0 && !shouldStartInUpload) { setIsStudioOpen(false); setIsPaused(false); }
    else onClose();
  }, [stories.length, shouldStartInUpload, onClose]);

  const linkedEvent = isStudioOpen ? (selectedPromoEvent || owner?.linkedEvent || owner?.promoEvent) : (activeStory?.linkedEvent || activeStory?.promoEvent || owner?.linkedEvent || owner?.promoEvent);
  const isPromoStory = Boolean(linkedEvent || (!isStudioOpen && activeStory?.isPromo) || owner?.isPromo);
  const finalAccent = isPromoStory ? '#F59E0B' : resolvedAccent;
  const effectivePrimaryAction = linkedEvent
    ? () => { if (onOpenLinkedEvent) onOpenLinkedEvent(linkedEvent); else if (onPrimaryAction) onPrimaryAction(); }
    : onPrimaryAction;
  const effectivePrimaryLabel = linkedEvent ? (isEn ? '⚡ GO TO EVENT' : '⚡ IR AL EVENTO') : primaryActionLabel;

  return {
    isEn, resolvedName, resolvedSubtitle, resolvedAvatar, finalAccent, canUpload,
    stories, currentIndex, setCurrentIndex, isPaused, setIsPaused, progress, setProgress,
    isStudioOpen, setIsStudioOpen, isAvatarZoomOpen, setIsAvatarZoomOpen,
    draftImageUri, setDraftImageUri, draftCaption, setDraftCaption, draftTag, setDraftTag,
    selectedPromoEvent, setSelectedPromoEvent, isPickingOrSaving, isDeletingStory,
    confirmDeleteStory, setConfirmDeleteStory, reactionToast, activeStory,
    hasReactedFire: Boolean(activeStory?.reactedFireBy?.includes(localViewerId)),
    hasReactedBolt: Boolean(activeStory?.reactedBoltBy?.includes(localViewerId)),
    effectivePrimaryAction, effectivePrimaryLabel,
    handlePickPhoto, handlePublishStory, handleDeleteCurrentStory, handleToggleReaction, handleCloseStudio,
  };
}

    // === src/hooks/kineticlub/useSquadsModalController.ts === //
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Keyboard, Share } from 'react-native';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../../components/SharedUI';
import { getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot, getSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot, setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot } from '../../services/kineticDirectMessagesBridge';
import { mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap } from '../../services/kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import {
  acceptCloudDirectMessage, deleteDirectMessageThread, deleteSquadCloud, fetchAllCloudSquadMessages,
  IDirectMessageThread, isStrictDmParticipant, leaveSquadCloud, markDmSeenCountInStorage, matchesUserIdentity,
  normalizeChatIdentity, sendCloudDirectMessage, syncDirectMessagesFromCloud,
} from '../../services/kineticRealtimeChatBridge';
import { sanitizeOfficialKineticShareText } from '../../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import {
  checkUserAlreadyLeadsSquad, LEADER_LIMIT_MSG_EN, LEADER_LIMIT_MSG_ES,
  markPendingSquadEditId, subscribeSquadsDataChanged,
} from '../../services/kineticlubSquadsService';
import { loadPersistedSeenRoomCounts, persistSeenRoomCounts, subscribeKinetiClubChatsRealtimeAndFocus } from '../../services/kineticlubWallCloudService';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { IEquipoKinetic, IMensajeEquipo } from '../../types';

export type SquadsDialogState = {
  kind: 'delete_squad' | 'leave_squad' | 'delete_dm' | 'leader_limit';
  targetId?: string;
  targetName?: string;
} | null;

export interface IUseSquadsModalControllerParams {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  initialSection: 'hub' | 'invitar' | 'chat';
  myRealId: string;
  myRealName: string;
  myRealAvatar: string | null;
  misEquipos: IEquipoKinetic[];
  sentPendingNames: string[];
  suggestedAthletes: any[];
  activeSquadChat: IEquipoKinetic | null;
  setActiveSquadChat: (eq: IEquipoKinetic | null) => void;
  squadMessages: IMensajeEquipo[];
  isSendingSquadMsg: boolean;
  onCrearEquipo: (nombre: string, disc: string, editId?: string) => void;
  onConectarPorCodigo: (code: string) => void;
  onResponderSolicitud: (miembroId: string, estado: 'activo' | 'rechazado') => void;
  onAbrirChatEquipo: (eq: IEquipoKinetic) => void;
  onEnviarMensaje: (equipoId: string, texto: string) => void;
  initialDmThread: IDirectMessageThread | null;
  tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
}

export function useSquadsModalController(p: IUseSquadsModalControllerParams) {
  const {
    visible, onClose, initialSection, myRealId, myRealName, myRealAvatar,
    misEquipos, sentPendingNames, suggestedAthletes, activeSquadChat, setActiveSquadChat,
    squadMessages, isSendingSquadMsg, onCrearEquipo, onConectarPorCodigo,
    onResponderSolicitud, onAbrirChatEquipo, onEnviarMensaje, initialDmThread, tx,
  } = p;

  const hubScrollRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const chatScrollRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState<'hub' | 'invitar' | 'chat'>(initialSection);
  const [isEditingSquadConfig, setIsEditingSquadConfig] = useState(false);
  const [editingSquadId, setEditingSquadId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dialogState, setDialogState] = useState<SquadsDialogState>(null);
  const primarySquad: any = misEquipos.length > 0 ? (activeSquadChat || misEquipos[0]) : null;
  const [squadNameDraft, setSquadNameDraft] = useState(primarySquad?.nombre || '');
  const [squadDiscDraft, setSquadDiscDraft] = useState(primarySquad?.disciplina || 'Fuerza');
  const [joinCodeInput, setJoinCodeInput] = useState('');
  const [chatDraft, setChatDraft] = useState('');
  const [inspectedMember, setInspectedMember] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [allRoomMessagesMap, setAllRoomMessagesMap] = useState<Record<string, IMensajeEquipo[]>>(() => getSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot() as any);
  const [seenRoomCountMap, setSeenRoomCountMap] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [dmThreads, setDmThreads] = useState<IDirectMessageThread[]>(() => getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot(myRealId, myRealName));
  const [activeDmThreadCode, setActiveDmThreadCode] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSendingDmLive, setIsSendingDmLive] = useState(false);
  const [isSquadActionBusy, setIsSquadActionBusy] = useState(false);

  const isSendingChatRef = useRef(false);
  const isSquadActionRef = useRef(false);
  const prevMsgCountRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const scrollTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const wasVisibleRef = useRef(false);
  const enteredFromHubRef = useRef(false);
  const lastInitDmCodeRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const misEquiposRef = useRef<IEquipoKinetic[]>(misEquipos);
  misEquiposRef.current = misEquipos;
  const roomsSigRef = useRef<string>('');
  const dmsSigRef = useRef<string>('');

  useEffect(() => () => { if (scrollTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(scrollTimerRef.current); }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) { wasVisibleRef.current = false; lastInitDmCodeRef.current = null; setDialogState(null); return; }
    const justOpened = !wasVisibleRef.current;
    const validInitDm = initialDmThread && isStrictDmParticipant(myRealId, myRealName, initialDmThread.requesterId, initialDmThread.requesterName, initialDmThread.targetId, initialDmThread.targetName) ? initialDmThread : null;
    const nextInitDm = validInitDm?.dmCode || null;
    const dmChanged = Boolean(nextInitDm && nextInitDm !== lastInitDmCodeRef.current);
    wasVisibleRef.current = true; lastInitDmCodeRef.current = nextInitDm;
    if (justOpened || dmChanged) {
      if (nextInitDm && validInitDm) {
        enteredFromHubRef.current = false;
        setDmThreads((prev) => {
          const map = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
          [...prev, validInitDm].forEach((t) => { if (t) mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(map, t); });
          const merged = Array.from(map.values());
          dmsSigRef.current = JSON.stringify(merged);
          return merged;
        });
        setActiveDmThreadCode(nextInitDm);
        setActiveSection('chat');
        void markDmSeenCountInStorage(myRealId, validInitDm);
      } else {
        enteredFromHubRef.current = (initialSection || 'hub') !== 'chat';
        setActiveDmThreadCode(null);
        setActiveSection(initialSection || 'hub');
      }
      setIsEditingSquadConfig(false); setEditingSquadId(null); prevMsgCountRef.current = 0;
    }
  }, [visible, initialSection, initialDmThread, myRealId, myRealName]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditingSquadConfig && editingSquadId && primarySquad) {
      if (primarySquad?.nombre) setSquadNameDraft(primarySquad.nombre);
      if (primarySquad?.disciplina) setSquadDiscDraft(primarySquad.disciplina);
    }
  }, [isEditingSquadConfig, editingSquadId, primarySquad]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!myRealId) return;
    let active = true;
    loadPersistedSeenRoomCounts(myRealId).then((saved) => { if (active && Object.keys(saved).length > 0) setSeenRoomCountMap((prev) => ({ ...saved, ...prev })); });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [myRealId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const isPageVisible = () => typeof document === 'undefined' || document.hidden === false;
    const runRealtimePoll = async () => {
      if (!visible || cancelled || !isPageVisible()) return;
      try {
        const currentTeams = misEquiposRef.current;
        const [roomsMap, syncedDms] = await Promise.all([
          currentTeams.length > 0 ? fetchAllCloudSquadMessages(currentTeams) : Promise.resolve({}),
          myRealId ? syncDirectMessagesFromCloud(myRealId, myRealName) : Promise.resolve([]),
        ]);
        if (cancelled) return;
        const nextRoomsSig = JSON.stringify(roomsMap);
        if (nextRoomsSig !== roomsSigRef.current) {
          roomsSigRef.current = nextRoomsSig;
          setAllRoomMessagesMap(roomsMap);
          setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot(roomsMap);
        }
        const nextDmsSig = JSON.stringify(syncedDms);
        if (nextDmsSig !== dmsSigRef.current) { dmsSigRef.current = nextDmsSig; setDmThreads(syncedDms); }
      } catch {}
    };
    runRealtimePoll();
    const unsubLocal = subscribeSquadsDataChanged(() => { runRealtimePoll(); });
    const unsubRt = subscribeKinetiClubChatsRealtimeAndFocus(myRealId, runRealtimePoll);
    const timer = setInterval(runRealtimePoll, 30_000);
    return () => { cancelled = true; unsubLocal(); unsubRt(); clearInterval(timer); };
  }, [visible, myRealId, myRealName]);

  const activeDmThread = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeDmThreadCode) return null;
    const codeUp = String(activeDmThreadCode).trim().toUpperCase();
    const initMatch = initialDmThread && String(initialDmThread.dmCode || '').trim().toUpperCase() === codeUp ? initialDmThread : null;
    const listMatch = dmThreads.find((d) => String(d.dmCode || '').trim().toUpperCase() === codeUp) || null;
    if (!listMatch && !initMatch) return null;
    const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
    if (listMatch) mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, listMatch);
    if (initMatch) mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, initMatch);
    const found = byCode.get(codeUp) || Array.from(byCode.values())[0] || listMatch || initMatch;
    return found && isStrictDmParticipant(myRealId, myRealName, found.requesterId, found.requesterName, found.targetId, found.targetName) ? found : null;
  }, [activeDmThreadCode, dmThreads, initialDmThread, myRealId, myRealName]);

  const incomingPendingDms = useMemo(
    () => dmThreads.filter((t) => t.status === 'pending' && matchesUserIdentity(myRealId, myRealName, t.targetId, t.targetName) && !matchesUserIdentity(myRealId, myRealName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName)),
    [dmThreads, myRealId, myRealName]
  );

  const displayedMessages = useMemo<IMensajeEquipo[]>(() => {
    if (activeDmThread) {
      return (activeDmThread.messages || []).map((m) => ({
        id: m.id, equipo_id: activeDmThread.dmCode, usuario_id: m.senderId, usuario_nombre: m.senderName,
        usuario_avatar: m.senderAvatar || undefined, mensaje: m.text, created_at: m.createdAt,
      } as any));
    }
    if (!primarySquad?.id) return [];
    const pId = String(primarySquad.id), map = new Map<string, IMensajeEquipo>();
    [...squadMessages, ...(allRoomMessagesMap[pId] || [])].forEach((m) => {
      if (!m?.mensaje) return;
      const dup = Array.from(map.values()).some((ex) => ex.id === m.id || (normalizeChatIdentity(ex.usuario_nombre) === normalizeChatIdentity(m.usuario_nombre) && String(ex.mensaje).trim() === String(m.mensaje).trim() && String(ex.created_at || '').slice(0, 15) === String(m.created_at || '').slice(0, 15)));
      if (!dup) map.set(String(m.id || `${m.usuario_nombre}_${m.created_at}`), m);
    });
    return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => String(a.created_at || '').localeCompare(String(b.created_at || '')));
  }, [activeDmThread, primarySquad?.id, squadMessages, allRoomMessagesMap]);

  const updateSeenRoomCounts = useCallback<React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Record<string, number>>>>(
    (updater) => setSeenRoomCountMap((prev) => { const next = typeof updater === 'function' ? updater(prev) : updater; if (next !== prev) persistSeenRoomCounts(myRealId, next); return next; }),
    [myRealId]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSection !== 'chat') return;
    const roomKey = activeDmThread ? activeDmThread.dmCode : String(primarySquad?.id || '');
    const currentLen = displayedMessages.length;
    if (roomKey) updateSeenRoomCounts((prev) => (prev[roomKey] === currentLen ? prev : { ...prev, [roomKey]: currentLen }));
    if (activeDmThread) void markDmSeenCountInStorage(myRealId, activeDmThread);
    if (currentLen > prevMsgCountRef.current) {
      prevMsgCountRef.current = currentLen;
      if (scrollTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(scrollTimerRef.current);
      scrollTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => { chatScrollRef.current?.scrollToEnd({ animated: true }); }, 120);
    }
  }, [activeSection, activeDmThread, primarySquad?.id, displayedMessages.length, updateSeenRoomCounts, myRealId]);

  const squadMembersNames = useMemo<string[]>(() => {
    if (!primarySquad) return [];
    const raw = primarySquad.integrantes_nombres;
    return Array.isArray(raw) && raw.length > 0 ? raw : [primarySquad.creador_nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')];
  }, [primarySquad, tx]);

  const squadMembersSet = useMemo(() => new Set(squadMembersNames.map((n) => String(n).trim().toLowerCase())), [squadMembersNames]);
  const pendingSentSet = useMemo(() => new Set((sentPendingNames || []).map((n) => String(n).trim().toLowerCase())), [sentPendingNames]);

  const squadMembersRoster = useMemo(() => squadMembersNames.map((nameStr, idx) => {
    const cleanLow = String(nameStr).trim().toLowerCase();
    const matched = suggestedAthletes.find((a: any) => String(a?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanLow);
    if (matched) return matched;
    return {
      id: `roster_${idx}`, nombre: nameStr,
      titulo: idx === 0 ? tx('LÍDER DE EQUIPO', 'TEAM LEADER') : tx('MIEMBRO DE EQUIPO', 'TEAM MEMBER'),
      rango: 'Platinum', nivel: tx('Leyenda VIP', 'VIP Legend'), disciplina: primarySquad?.disciplina || 'Fuerza',
      gimnasio: tx('Red Oficial Kinetic', 'Official Kinetic Network'), ovr: 52, xpTotal: 150, racha: 4, trofeosCount: 5, checkinsCount: 3,
      auraColor: idx % 2 === 0 ? COLORS.cyan : COLORS.purple,
    };
  }), [squadMembersNames, suggestedAthletes, primarySquad?.disciplina, tx]);

  const handleShareSquadInvite = useCallback(async () => {
    triggerHaptic('Light');
    const sqTitle = primarySquad?.nombre || tx('Equipo Kinetic', 'Kinetic Team');
    const sqCode = primarySquad?.codigo_invitacion || 'EQ-KINETIC';
    const rawMsg = tx(
      `⚡ Únete a mi equipo "${sqTitle}" en KINETIC.\n🔑 Código directo de equipo: *${sqCode}*\n📲 Ingresa el código en KinetiClub > Equipos:`,
      `⚡ Join my team "${sqTitle}" on KINETIC.\n🔑 Direct team code: *${sqCode}*\n📲 Enter the code in KinetiClub > Teams:`
    );
    try { await Share.share({ title: tx(`Invitación a ${sqTitle}`, `Invite to ${sqTitle}`), message: sanitizeOfficialKineticShareText(rawMsg) }); } catch {}
  }, [primarySquad?.nombre, primarySquad?.codigo_invitacion, tx]);

  const handleRequestCreateNewSquad = useCallback(async () => {
    triggerHaptic('Selection');
    const check = await checkUserAlreadyLeadsSquad(myRealId, misEquiposRef.current, null);
    if (check.isLeader) { triggerHaptic('Error'); setDialogState({ kind: 'leader_limit' }); return; }
    setEditingSquadId(null); setSquadNameDraft(''); setSquadDiscDraft('Fuerza'); setIsEditingSquadConfig(true);
  }, [myRealId]);

  const handleRequestEditSquad = useCallback((eqItem: IEquipoKinetic) => {
    triggerHaptic('Selection'); setEditingSquadId(String(eqItem.id)); setSquadNameDraft(eqItem.nombre || ''); setSquadDiscDraft(eqItem.disciplina || 'Fuerza'); setIsEditingSquadConfig(true);
  }, []);

  const handleSaveSquadConfig = useCallback(async () => {
    Keyboard.dismiss();
    if (!editingSquadId) {
      const check = await checkUserAlreadyLeadsSquad(myRealId, misEquiposRef.current, null);
      if (check.isLeader) { triggerHaptic('Error'); setIsEditingSquadConfig(false); setDialogState({ kind: 'leader_limit' }); return; }
      markPendingSquadEditId(null);
    } else markPendingSquadEditId(editingSquadId);
    onCrearEquipo(squadNameDraft, squadDiscDraft, editingSquadId || undefined);
    setIsEditingSquadConfig(false); setEditingSquadId(null);
  }, [onCrearEquipo, squadNameDraft, squadDiscDraft, editingSquadId, myRealId]);

  const executeConfirmedAction = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!dialogState || isSquadActionRef.current) return;
    const { kind, targetId } = dialogState;
    setDialogState(null);
    if (kind === 'leader_limit' || !targetId) return;
    isSquadActionRef.current = true; setIsSquadActionBusy(true);
    try {
      if (kind === 'delete_squad' || kind === 'leave_squad') {
        if (kind === 'delete_squad') await deleteSquadCloud(targetId, myRealId);
        else await leaveSquadCloud(targetId, myRealId, myRealName);
        triggerHaptic('Success');
        misEquiposRef.current = misEquiposRef.current.filter((s) => String(s.id) !== String(targetId));
        setActiveSquadChat(misEquiposRef.current[0] || null); setActiveSection('hub');
      } else if (kind === 'delete_dm') {
        await deleteDirectMessageThread(targetId, myRealId, myRealName);
        triggerHaptic('Success');
        setDmThreads((prev) => prev.filter((d) => d.dmCode !== targetId));
        setActiveDmThreadCode(null);
        if (enteredFromHubRef.current) setActiveSection('hub'); else onClose();
      }
    } catch {} finally { isSquadActionRef.current = false; setIsSquadActionBusy(false); }
  }, [dialogState, myRealId, myRealName, setActiveSquadChat, onClose]);

  const resolvePartnerForDm = useCallback((dm: IDirectMessageThread) => {
    const amReq = matchesUserIdentity(myRealId, myRealName, dm.requesterId, dm.requesterName);
    return { id: amReq ? dm.targetId : dm.requesterId, name: amReq ? dm.targetName : dm.requesterName, avatar: (amReq ? dm.targetAvatar : dm.requesterAvatar) || null };
  }, [myRealId, myRealName]);

  const handleAcceptDmAndChat = useCallback(async (dm: IDirectMessageThread) => {
    if (isSquadActionRef.current || isSquadActionBusy) return;
    isSquadActionRef.current = true; setIsSquadActionBusy(true);
    try {
      triggerHaptic('Success');
      const updated = await acceptCloudDirectMessage(dm.dmCode, myRealId, myRealName, dm);
      const acceptedThread: IDirectMessageThread = updated ? { ...updated, status: 'accepted' } : { ...dm, status: 'accepted' };
      setDmThreads((prev) => {
        const has = prev.some((item) => item.dmCode === dm.dmCode || item.dmCode === acceptedThread.dmCode);
        const next = has
          ? prev.map((item) => (item.dmCode === dm.dmCode || item.dmCode === acceptedThread.dmCode ? acceptedThread : item))
          : [acceptedThread, ...prev];
        dmsSigRef.current = JSON.stringify(next);
        return next;
      });
      prevMsgCountRef.current = 0; setActiveDmThreadCode(acceptedThread.dmCode); setActiveSection('chat');
      void markDmSeenCountInStorage(myRealId, acceptedThread);
    } catch {} finally { isSquadActionRef.current = false; setIsSquadActionBusy(false); }
  }, [isSquadActionBusy, myRealId, myRealName]);

  const handleRespondInviteSafe = useCallback(async (invId: string, estado: 'activo' | 'rechazado') => {
    if (isSquadActionRef.current || isSquadActionBusy) return;
    isSquadActionRef.current = true; setIsSquadActionBusy(true);
    try { await Promise.resolve(onResponderSolicitud(invId, estado)); } finally { isSquadActionRef.current = false; setIsSquadActionBusy(false); }
  }, [isSquadActionBusy, onResponderSolicitud]);

  const handleConnectByCodeSafe = useCallback(async () => {
    const cleanCode = joinCodeInput.trim();
    if (!cleanCode || isSquadActionRef.current || isSquadActionBusy) return;
    isSquadActionRef.current = true; setIsSquadActionBusy(true); setJoinCodeInput('');
    try { await Promise.resolve(onConectarPorCodigo(cleanCode)); } finally { isSquadActionRef.current = false; setIsSquadActionBusy(false); }
  }, [joinCodeInput, isSquadActionBusy, onConectarPorCodigo]);

  const handleSendChatMessage = useCallback(async () => {
    const clean = chatDraft.trim();
    if (!clean || isSendingChatRef.current || isSendingSquadMsg || isSendingDmLive) return;
    isSendingChatRef.current = true; setChatDraft(''); setIsSendingDmLive(true);
    try {
      if (activeDmThread) {

        const res = await sendCloudDirectMessage({
          senderId: myRealId || 'anon', senderName: myRealName, senderAvatar: myRealAvatar,
          targetId: partner.id || partner.name, targetName: partner.name || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'),

        if (res.thread.dmCode !== activeDmThreadCode) setActiveDmThreadCode(res.thread.dmCode);
        void markDmSeenCountInStorage(myRealId, res.thread);

      await Promise.resolve(onEnviarMensaje(String(primarySquad.id), clean));

  }, [chatDraft, isSendingSquadMsg, isSendingDmLive, activeDmThread, activeDmThreadCode, resolvePartnerForDm, myRealId, myRealName, myRealAvatar, tx, primarySquad?.id, onEnviarMensaje]);

  const dialogTitle = dialogState?.kind === 'leader_limit' ? tx('LÍMITE DE LIDERAZGO', 'LEADERSHIP LIMIT')
    : dialogState?.kind === 'delete_squad' ? tx('¿ELIMINAR EQUIPO?', 'DELETE TEAM?')
    : dialogState?.kind === 'leave_squad' ? tx('¿SALIR DEL EQUIPO?', 'LEAVE TEAM?') : tx('¿ELIMINAR CHAT?', 'DELETE CHAT?');
  const dialogBody = dialogState?.kind === 'leader_limit' ? tx(LEADER_LIMIT_MSG_ES, LEADER_LIMIT_MSG_EN)
    : dialogState?.kind === 'delete_squad' ? tx(`Se eliminará "${dialogState?.targetName}" y todos sus mensajes grupales.`, `"${dialogState?.targetName}" and all its group messages will be deleted.`)
    : dialogState?.kind === 'leave_squad' ? tx(`Saldrás de "${dialogState?.targetName}" y de su canal grupal.`, `You will leave "${dialogState?.targetName}" and its group channel.`)
    : tx(`Se eliminará esta conversación privada 1 a 1 con ${dialogState?.targetName}.`, `This private 1-on-1 chat with ${dialogState?.targetName} will be deleted.`);
  const dialogBtn = dialogState?.kind === 'leader_limit' ? tx('ENTENDIDO', 'GOT IT')
    : dialogState?.kind === 'delete_squad' ? tx('ELIMINAR EQUIPO', 'DELETE TEAM')
    : dialogState?.kind === 'leave_squad' ? tx('SALIR DEL EQUIPO', 'LEAVE TEAM') : tx('ELIMINAR CHAT', 'DELETE CHAT');

  return {

    joinCodeInput, setJoinCodeInput, chatDraft, setChatDraft, inspectedMember, setInspectedMember,
    allRoomMessagesMap, seenRoomCountMap, updateSeenRoomCounts, dmThreads, setDmThreads, setActiveDmThreadCode,
    activeDmThread, incomingPendingDms, displayedMessages, squadMembersSet, pendingSentSet, squadMembersRoster,
    isSendingDmLive, isSquadActionBusy, dmsSigRef, dialogTitle, dialogBody, dialogBtn,
    handleShareSquadInvite, handleRequestCreateNewSquad, handleRequestEditSquad, handleSaveSquadConfig,
    executeConfirmedAction, resolvePartnerForDm, handleAcceptDmAndChat, handleRespondInviteSafe,
    handleConnectByCodeSafe, handleSendChatMessage,
    handleBackToHub: useCallback(() => { if (enteredFromHubRef.current) setActiveSection('hub'); else onClose(); }, [onClose]),

    handleSelectDmRoom: useCallback((dmCode: string) => { prevMsgCountRef.current = 0; setActiveDmThreadCode(dmCode); }, []),

    handleOpenDmRoomChat: useCallback((dmCode: string) => { enteredFromHubRef.current = true; prevMsgCountRef.current = 0; setActiveDmThreadCode(dmCode); setActiveSection('chat'); }, []),

// === src/hooks/useKinetiClub.ts === //
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../components/SharedUI';
import { KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES } from '../constants/exploreData';
import { getLevelNumericWeight } from '../constants/memberships';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete } from '../services/kineticAthleteDeduplication';
import { buildEnrichedCommunityFeed } from '../services/kineticlubFeedAndSquadHelpers';
import {
  BONUS_XP_KEY_PREFIX, CLAIMED_RETOS_KEY_PREFIX, DAILY_BOX_KEY_PREFIX, OPENED_BOXES_KEY_PREFIX,
  PAGE_SIZE, STREAK_SHIELD_KEY_PREFIX, applySmartGhostModeRanking,
  computeAthleteRpgStats, computePrestigeInfo, computeSeasonInfo, countRealClaimedTrophies,
  filterRealChallengeClaimKeys, getAuraColorForLevel, getTodayISO, isB2BOrAdminAccount,
  isMasterAdmin, setActiveClubLanguage,
} from '../services/kineticlubHelpers';
import { expandSocialIdSet } from '../services/kineticlubSocialGraphHelper';
import {
  getBlockedUserIdsSet, getRestrictedUserIdsSet, hydrateUgcModerationState,
  subscribeUgcBlocksRealtime, subscribeUgcModerationChanged,
} from '../services/kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import {
  getMemoryClubFeedAthletes, readWebLocalSync, resetClubHydrationMemoryForUser,
  setMemoryClubFeedAthletes, useKinetiClubHydration,
} from './kineticlub/useKinetiClubHydration';
import { useKinetiClubRewards } from './kineticlub/useKinetiClubRewards';
import { useKinetiClubSquads } from './kineticlub/useKinetiClubSquads';

export { computeAthleteRpgStats, getAuraColorForLevel, isB2BOrAdminAccount, isMasterAdmin };

interface IKinetiClubUserSubject {
  id?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
}
interface IKinetiClubProfileSubject {
  id?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  nombre?: string | null;
  avatar_url?: string | null;
  nivel?: string | null;
  rol?: string | null;
  tipo_cuenta?: string | null;
  radar_publico?: boolean | null;
  prestigio_nivel?: number | null;
  kc_membresia?: number | null;
  kc_topup?: number | null;
  racha_dias?: number | null;
  xp_total?: number | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}
interface ISquadRowSubject {
  id?: string | null;
  creador_id?: string | null;
  lider_id?: string | null;
  esLider?: boolean;
  rol_equipo?: string | null;
}

export function useKinetiClub(
  user: IKinetiClubUserSubject | null | undefined,
  profile: IKinetiClubProfileSubject | null | undefined,
  refreshProfile?: () => Promise<void>
) {
  const currentUid = String(user?.id || '');
  resetClubHydrationMemoryForUser(currentUid);

  const { language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  setActiveClubLanguage(language);
  void isMasterAdmin(user, profile);

  const [isGhostMode, setIsGhostMode] = useState<boolean>(profile?.radar_publico === false);
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<string>('all:trofeos');
  const [pageCount, setPageCount] = useState<number>(1);
  const [showStreakModal, setShowStreakModal] = useState(false);
  const [isFreezing, setIsFreezing] = useState(false);
  const [isStreakFrozenToday, setIsStreakFrozenToday] = useState(() => {
    if (!currentUid) return false;
    const today = getTodayISO();
    const dbArr: string[] = Array.isArray(profile?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? profile.recompensas_reclamadas.map(String) : [];
    return readWebLocalSync(`${STREAK_SHIELD_KEY_PREFIX}${currentUid}`) === today || readWebLocalSync(`${DAILY_BOX_KEY_PREFIX}${currentUid}`) === today || dbArr.includes(`escudo_racha_${today}`) || dbArr.includes(`recompensa_diaria_${today}`);
  });
  const [showRpgModal, setShowRpgModal] = useState(false);
  const [inspectedAthlete, setInspectedAthlete] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [activeRewardModal, setActiveRewardModal] = useState<'misteriosa' | 'retos' | null>(null);
  const [claimingId, setClaimingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dailyClaimedToday, setDailyClaimedToday] = useState(() => {
    if (!currentUid) return false;
    const today = getTodayISO();
    const dbArr: string[] = Array.isArray(profile?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? profile.recompensas_reclamadas.map(String) : [];
    return readWebLocalSync(`${DAILY_BOX_KEY_PREFIX}${currentUid}`) === today || dbArr.includes(`recompensa_diaria_${today}`);
  });

  const initialClaimedFromProfile = useMemo(() => {
    let webArr: string[] = [];
    if (currentUid) {
      const raw = readWebLocalSync(`${CLAIMED_RETOS_KEY_PREFIX}${currentUid}`);
      if (raw) { try { const p = JSON.parse(raw); if (Array.isArray(p)) webArr = p.map(String); } catch {} }
    }
    const clean = filterRealChallengeClaimKeys([...(Array.isArray(profile?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? profile.recompensas_reclamadas : []), ...webArr]);
    return clean;
  }, [profile?.recompensas_reclamadas, currentUid]);

  const initialSyncXp = useMemo(() => {
    const webXp = currentUid ? Number(readWebLocalSync(`${BONUS_XP_KEY_PREFIX}${currentUid}`)) || 0 : 0;
    return Math.max(0, Number(profile?.xp_total) || 0, webXp);
  }, [profile?.xp_total, currentUid]);

  const [claimedChallengeIds, setClaimedChallengeIds] = useState<string[]>(initialClaimedFromProfile);
  const [bonusXp, setBonusXp] = useState<number>(initialSyncXp);
  const [openedBoxesCount, setOpenedBoxesCount] = useState<number>(() => {
    const dbArr = Array.isArray(profile?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? profile.recompensas_reclamadas : [];
    const dbBoxNums = new Set(dbArr.filter((k: unknown) => /^caja_nivel_\d+$/i.test(String(k || '').trim())).map(String));
    const profileRec = profile && typeof profile === 'object' ? (profile as { cajas_nivel_reclamadas?: unknown }) : null;
    const dbColBoxes = Math.max(0, Number(profileRec?.cajas_nivel_reclamadas) || 0);
    if (profile?.id) return Math.max(dbBoxNums.size, dbColBoxes);
    const webBoxes = currentUid ? Math.max(0, Number(readWebLocalSync(`${OPENED_BOXES_KEY_PREFIX}${currentUid}`)) || 0) : 0;
    return webBoxes;
  });

  const bonusXpRef = useRef<number>(initialSyncXp);
  const claimedIdsRef = useRef<string[]>(initialClaimedFromProfile);
  const openedBoxesRef = useRef<number>(openedBoxesCount);
  const prevUidRef = useRef<string>(currentUid);
  const isMountedRef = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => { isMountedRef.current = true; return () => { isMountedRef.current = false; }; }, []);
  useEffect(() => { setActiveClubLanguage(language); }, [language]);
  useEffect(() => { if (profile?.radar_publico !== undefined) setIsGhostMode(profile.radar_publico === false); }, [profile?.radar_publico]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevUidRef.current !== currentUid) {
      prevUidRef.current = currentUid;
      claimedIdsRef.current = initialClaimedFromProfile; setClaimedChallengeIds(initialClaimedFromProfile);
      bonusXpRef.current = initialSyncXp; setBonusXp(initialSyncXp);
      openedBoxesRef.current = 0; setOpenedBoxesCount(0); setDailyClaimedToday(false); setIsStreakFrozenToday(false);
    }
    if (!currentUid) return;
    const dbArr: string[] = Array.isArray(profile?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? profile.recompensas_reclamadas.map(String) : [];
    const profileRec = profile && typeof profile === 'object' ? (profile as { cajas_nivel_reclamadas?: unknown }) : null;
    const dbColBoxes = Math.max(0, Number(profileRec?.cajas_nivel_reclamadas) || 0);
    const dbBoxSet = new Set(dbArr.filter((k: string) => /^caja_nivel_\d+$/i.test(k.trim())));
    const authoritativeBoxes = Math.max(dbBoxSet.size, dbColBoxes);
    if (profile?.id) {
      openedBoxesRef.current = authoritativeBoxes;
      setOpenedBoxesCount(authoritativeBoxes);
    }
    if (dbArr.length > 0) {
      const today = getTodayISO();
      const mergedReal = filterRealChallengeClaimKeys([...claimedIdsRef.current, ...dbArr]);
      if (mergedReal.length > 0) { claimedIdsRef.current = mergedReal; setClaimedChallengeIds(mergedReal); }
      const dbDaily = dbArr.includes(`recompensa_diaria_${today}`);
      if (dbDaily) setDailyClaimedToday(true);
      if (dbDaily || dbArr.includes(`escudo_racha_${today}`)) setIsStreakFrozenToday(true);
    }
    if (Number(profile?.xp_total) > bonusXpRef.current) { const dbXp = Number(profile?.xp_total); bonusXpRef.current = dbXp; setBonusXp(dbXp); }
  }, [currentUid, initialClaimedFromProfile, initialSyncXp, profile?.id, profile?.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, profile?.recompensas_reclamadas, profile?.xp_total]);

  const rachaActual = useMemo(() => Math.max(1, Number(profile?.racha_dias ?? profile?.racha ?? 1)), [profile?.racha_dias, profile?.racha]);
  const userLevelRank = useMemo(() => getLevelNumericWeight(profile?.nivel || 'Acceso Base'), [profile?.nivel]);
  const rachaRef = useRef<number>(rachaActual);
  const levelRef = useRef<number>(userLevelRank);
  useEffect(() => { rachaRef.current = rachaActual; }, [rachaActual]);
  useEffect(() => { levelRef.current = userLevelRank; }, [userLevelRank]);

  const syncSquadsRef = useRef<(preferredSquadId?: string) => Promise<void>>(async () => {});
  const hyd = useKinetiClubHydration({
    user, profile, refreshProfile, isMountedRef, rachaRef, levelRef, bonusXpRef, claimedIdsRef, openedBoxesRef,
    syncSquadsRef, setClaimedChallengeIds, setDailyClaimedToday, setIsStreakFrozenToday, setBonusXp, setOpenedBoxesCount,
  });

  const prestigioNivel = Number(profile?.prestigio_nivel) || 0;
  const prestigeInfo = useMemo(
    () => computePrestigeInfo(hyd.completedSessionsCount, rachaActual, bonusXp, openedBoxesCount, claimedChallengeIds, dailyClaimedToday, language, profile?.nivel, prestigioNivel),
    [hyd.completedSessionsCount, rachaActual, bonusXp, openedBoxesCount, claimedChallengeIds, dailyClaimedToday, language, profile?.nivel, prestigioNivel]
  );
  const seasonInfo = useMemo(() => computeSeasonInfo(prestigeInfo.totalXp, language), [prestigeInfo.totalXp, language]);
  const realClaimedTrophiesCount = useMemo(() => countRealClaimedTrophies(claimedChallengeIds), [claimedChallengeIds]);

  const allFeedAthletes = useMemo(() => {
    const cachedFeed = getMemoryClubFeedAthletes();
    if (hyd.rawPerfilesCache.length === 0 && cachedFeed.length > 0) return cachedFeed;
    return buildEnrichedCommunityFeed(
      hyd.rawPerfilesCache, hyd.rawReservasCache, hyd.servCatMapCache, user?.id,
      { totalXp: prestigeInfo.totalXp, claimedCount: realClaimedTrophiesCount, ovr: hyd.userStats?.ovr || 47, stats: hyd.userStats, racha: rachaActual, completedQrCount: hyd.completedSessionsCount },
      language
    );
  }, [hyd.rawPerfilesCache, hyd.rawReservasCache, hyd.servCatMapCache, user?.id, prestigeInfo.totalXp, realClaimedTrophiesCount, hyd.userStats, rachaActual, hyd.completedSessionsCount, language]);

  useEffect(() => { setMemoryClubFeedAthletes(allFeedAthletes); }, [allFeedAthletes]);

  const [ugcModTick, setUgcModTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    hydrateUgcModerationState(user?.id).catch(() => {});
    const unsubLocal = subscribeUgcModerationChanged(() => setUgcModTick((n) => n + 1));
    const unsubRt = subscribeUgcBlocksRealtime(user?.id);
    return () => { unsubLocal(); unsubRt(); };
  }, [user?.id]);

  const suggestedAthletes = useMemo(() => {
    void ugcModTick;
    const blockedExp = expandSocialIdSet([...getBlockedUserIdsSet(), ...getRestrictedUserIdsSet()]);
    const myEmail = user?.email || profile?.email || '';
    return allFeedAthletes.filter((a) => a && a.radar_publico !== false && !isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete(a, user?.id, myEmail, profile?.nombre, blockedExp)).slice(0, 12);
  }, [allFeedAthletes, user?.id, user?.email, profile?.email, profile?.nombre, ugcModTick]);

  const squadsApi = useKinetiClubSquads({ user, profile, suggestedAthletes, isMountedRef, language, tx });
  useEffect(() => { syncSquadsRef.current = squadsApi.syncSquadsAndChatData; }, [squadsApi.syncSquadsAndChatData]);

  const rewardsApi = useKinetiClubRewards({
    user, profile, userLevelRank, isGhostMode, setIsGhostMode, isFreezing, setIsFreezing, isStreakFrozenToday, setIsStreakFrozenToday,
    setClaimingId, dailyClaimedToday, setDailyClaimedToday, setClaimedChallengeIds, setBonusXp, setOpenedBoxesCount,
    bonusXpRef, claimedIdsRef, openedBoxesRef, isMountedRef, completedSessionsCount: hyd.completedSessionsCount, rachaActual,
    availableBoxesCount: prestigeInfo.availableBoxesCount, totalBoxesEarned: prestigeInfo.totalBoxesEarned, refreshProfile, tx,
  });

  const filteredAndSortedAthletes = useMemo(() => {
    let list = applySmartGhostModeRanking(allFeedAthletes, isGhostMode, user?.id);
    const filterKey = String(activeFilter || 'all:trofeos').toLowerCase();
    if (filterKey.startsWith('hoy') || filterKey.includes('today')) list = list.filter((a) => a.esHoy);
    if (filterKey.includes('checkins') || filterKey.includes('check')) return list.sort((a, b) => b.checkinsCount - a.checkinsCount || b.xpTotal - a.xpTotal || b.ovr - a.ovr);
    return list.sort((a, b) => b.trofeosCount - a.trofeosCount || b.xpTotal - a.xpTotal || b.ovr - a.ovr);
  }, [allFeedAthletes, activeFilter, isGhostMode, user?.id]);

  const top10Elite = useMemo(() => filteredAndSortedAthletes.slice(0, 10), [filteredAndSortedAthletes]);
  const visibleData = useMemo(() => filteredAndSortedAthletes.slice(0, Math.min(100, pageCount * PAGE_SIZE)), [filteredAndSortedAthletes, pageCount]);
  const loadMoreData = useCallback(() => setPageCount((prev) => Math.min(4, prev + 1)), []);
  const onRefresh = useCallback(async () => { hyd.setRefreshing(true); await hyd.fetchCommunityData(0, true, true); }, [hyd]);

  const crearEquipoKinetic = useCallback(async (
    nombre: string,
    disciplina: string,
    descripcion?: string,
    hapticFn?: (type?: string) => void,
    alertFn?: (title: string, msg: string, type?: string) => void,
    squadIdToEdit?: string
  ) => {
    const uid = String(user?.id || '').trim();
    const leaderSquad = (squadsApi.misEquipos as ISquadRowSubject[]).find((eq) => Boolean(uid && (String(eq?.creador_id || '') === uid || String(eq?.lider_id || '') === uid || eq?.esLider === true || eq?.rol_equipo === 'lider')));
    const isUpdatingSame = Boolean(squadIdToEdit && leaderSquad && String(leaderSquad.id) === String(squadIdToEdit));
    let alreadyLeading = Boolean(leaderSquad && !isUpdatingSame && squadsApi.hasConfiguredSquad);
    if (!alreadyLeading && uid) {
      try {
        const [ownedRes, roleRes] = await Promise.all([
          supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select('id').eq('creador_id', uid).neq('codigo_invitacion', 'STORIES-V25').limit(1),
          supabase.from('equipo_miembros').select('equipo_id').eq('usuario_id', uid).eq('rol_equipo', 'lider').in('estado', ['activo', 'aceptado']).limit(1),
        ]);
        const foundId = String(ownedRes.data?.[0]?.id || roleRes.data?.[0]?.equipo_id || '').trim();
        if (foundId && (!squadIdToEdit || foundId !== String(squadIdToEdit))) alreadyLeading = true;
      } catch {}
    }
    if (alreadyLeading) {
      (hapticFn || triggerHaptic)('Error');
      const title = language === 'en' ? 'Leadership Limit' : 'Límite de Liderazgo';
      const msg = language === 'en' ? 'You are already leading a team. You must leave or delete that team before leading another one.' : 'Ya eres líder de un equipo. Necesitas dejar o eliminar ese equipo para poder ser líder de otro.';
      if (typeof alertFn === 'function') alertFn(title, msg, 'warning');
      else if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof (window as unknown as { alert?: (m: string) => void }).alert === 'function') {
        (window as unknown as { alert: (m: string) => void }).alert(msg);
      }
      return false;
    }
    return squadsApi.crearEquipoKinetic(nombre, disciplina, descripcion, hapticFn, alertFn);
  }, [user?.id, squadsApi, language]);

  const enrichedUserStats = useMemo(() => ({ ...hyd.userStats, userId: user?.id || '', userName: profile?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'), userAvatar: profile?.avatar_url || null }), [hyd.userStats, user?.id, profile?.nombre, profile?.avatar_url, tx]);

  return {
    isFetching: hyd.isFetching, hasInitialLoaded: hyd.hasInitialLoaded, refreshing: hyd.refreshing, isGhostMode, activeFilter, setActiveFilter,
    top10Elite, visibleData, allFeedAthletes, clubPromos: hyd.clubPromos, showStreakModal, setShowStreakModal, isFreezing, isStreakFrozenToday,
    showRpgModal, setShowRpgModal, inspectedAthlete, setInspectedAthlete, activeRewardModal, setActiveRewardModal, claimingId, linkingId: squadsApi.linkingId,
    userStats: enrichedUserStats, dailyClaimedToday, claimedChallengeIds, completedSessionsCount: hyd.completedSessionsCount,
    activeReservationsCount: hyd.activeReservationsCount, uniqueDisciplinesCount: hyd.uniqueDisciplinesCount, uniqueClubsCount: hyd.uniqueClubsCount,
    maxDisciplineSessionsCount: hyd.maxDisciplineSessionsCount, sessionsByDiscipline: hyd.sessionsByDiscipline, userLevelRank, rachaActual,
    bonusXp, seasonInfo, prestigeInfo, abrirCajaRetoNivel: rewardsApi.abrirCajaRetoNivel, ascenderPrestigioNivel99: rewardsApi.ascenderPrestigioNivel99,
    showSquadsModal: squadsApi.showSquadsModal, setShowSquadsModal: squadsApi.setShowSquadsModal, initialSquadSection: squadsApi.initialSquadSection,
    setInitialSquadSection: squadsApi.setInitialSquadSection, misEquipos: squadsApi.misEquipos, hasConfiguredSquad: squadsApi.hasConfiguredSquad,
    solicitudesEquipoPendientes: squadsApi.solicitudesEquipoPendientes, sentPendingNames: squadsApi.sentPendingNames, suggestedAthletes,
    activeSquadChat: squadsApi.activeSquadChat, setActiveSquadChat: squadsApi.setActiveSquadChat, squadMessages: squadsApi.squadMessages,
    isCreatingSquad: squadsApi.isCreatingSquad, isSendingSquadMsg: squadsApi.isSendingSquadMsg, crearEquipoKinetic,
    invitarAtletaAEquipo: squadsApi.invitarAtletaAEquipo, handleInviteSuggestedAthlete: squadsApi.invitarAtletaAEquipo,
    conectarPorCodigoEquipo: squadsApi.conectarPorCodigoEquipo, responderSolicitudEquipo: squadsApi.responderSolicitudEquipo,
    abrirChatEquipo: squadsApi.abrirChatEquipo, enviarMensajeEquipo: squadsApi.enviarMensajeEquipo,
    fetchCommunityData: hyd.fetchCommunityData, loadMoreData, onRefresh, toggleGhostMode: rewardsApi.toggleGhostMode,
    congelarRacha: rewardsApi.congelarRacha, reclamarRecompensa: rewardsApi.reclamarRecompensa, handleVinculacion: squadsApi.handleVinculacion,
    retosCatalogCount: KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES.length,
  };
}

export default useKinetiClub;

export type ConciergeSemanticIntent =
  | 'kinetic_identity'
  | 'kineticlub_community'
  | 'levels_xp'
  | 'four_pillars'
  | 'trophies_chests_crates'
  | 'streaks_shield'
  | 'b2b_affiliation'
  | 'kc_topups'
  | 'no_show_late_penalty'
  | 'cancel_window_4h_72h'
  | 'flash_vip_discounts'
  | 'qr_totp_checkin'
  | 'sat_cfdi_spei_b2b'
  | 'tech_support'
  | 'memberships_topup'
  | 'team_chat_kinetisquad'
  | 'venue_contact_directory'
  | 'escrow_40_60'
  | 'how_to_book'
  | 'greeting_help'
  | 'general_fallback';

const normalizeConciergeInput = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

export const detectConciergeQueryLanguage = (
  queryRaw: string,
  fallbackLang: 'es' | 'en' = 'es'
): 'es' | 'en' => {
  const raw = String(queryRaw || '');
  const low = normalizeConciergeInput(raw);
  if (/[¿¡áéíóúñ]/i.test(raw)) return 'es';
  const esTokens = (
    low.match(
      /\b(que|como|donde|cuando|cual|cuales|quien|puedo|reservar|reserva|clase|clases|ayuda|hola|pase|boveda|equipo|equipos|cancelar|problema|funciona|funcionan|escanear|inscribir|inscribirme|recargar|recargas|membresia|membresias|quiero|tengo|gracias|soporte|tarde|penalizacion|falta|descuento|reembolso|inasistencia|contacto|telefono|ubicacion|direccion|sede|sedes|nivel|niveles|pilares|trofeos|cofre|cofres|cajas|racha|rachas|escudo|afiliacion|afiliarse|mensual|comision|bronce|plata|oro|platino|para|los|las|del)\b/g
    ) || []
  ).length;
  const enTokens = (
    low.match(
      /\b(how|what|where|when|which|who|can|could|book|booking|class|classes|help|hello|hi|pass|wallet|vault|team|teams|cancel|refund|issue|scan|join|topup|topups|membership|memberships|want|need|thanks|support|why|do|does|work|works|my|the|for|with|late|penalty|discount|missed|contact|phone|location|address|venue|level|levels|pillars|trophies|chest|chests|crate|crates|streak|streaks|shield|affiliate|affiliation|bronze|silver|gold|platinum)\b/g
    ) || []
  ).length;
  if (enTokens > esTokens) return 'en';
  if (esTokens > enTokens) return 'es';
  return fallbackLang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es';
};

export const classifyConciergeSemanticIntent = (queryRaw: string): ConciergeSemanticIntent => {
  const q = normalizeConciergeInput(queryRaw);
  if (!q) return 'greeting_help';

  if (
    /\b(no[\s-]?show|inasistencia|no\s+asist|no\s+se\s+present|no\s+lleg|lleg[oa]?\s+tarde|llegue\s+tarde|late\s+arrival|arriving\s+late|miss(ed)?\s+(a\s+|my\s+)?class|client\s+no[\s-]?show|penaliz|infraccion|falta\s+(a|del\s+(cliente|atleta))|tarde\s+a\s+la\s+clase)\b/i.test(
      q
    ) ||
    (q.includes('tarde') && (q.includes('clase') || q.includes('sesion') || q.includes('pasa'))) ||
    (q.includes('late') && (q.includes('class') || q.includes('session') || q.includes('what')))
  ) {
    return 'no_show_late_penalty';
  }

  if (
    /\b(4\s*pilares|cuatro\s*pilares|four\s*pillars|pilares\s+de\s+evolucion|evolution\s+pillars|pillar|pilares|ovr)\b/i.test(
      q
    )
  ) {
    return 'four_pillars';
  }

  if (
    /\b(trofeo|trofeos|trophy|trophies|cofre|cofres|chest|chests|caja\s+de\s+nivel|cajas\s+de\s+nivel|level\s+crate|crates|misteriosa|3d)\b/i.test(
      q
    )
  ) {
    return 'trophies_chests_crates';
  }

  if (
    /\b(escudo\s+de\s+racha|streak\s+shield|racha|rachas|streak|streaks|congelar\s+racha|freeze\s+streak)\b/i.test(
      q
    )
  ) {
    return 'streaks_shield';
  }

  if (
    /\b(nivel|niveles|level|levels|xp|experiencia|prestigio|prestige)\b/i.test(q) &&
    !/\b(membresia|membership|vip|bronce|bronze|plata|silver|oro|gold|platino|platinum|flash)\b/i.test(q)
  ) {
    return 'levels_xp';
  }

  if (
    (/\b(que\s+es|what\s+is|como\s+funciona|how\s+does|acerca\s+de|about|explica)\b/i.test(q) ||
      q === 'kineticlub') &&
    /\bkineticlub\b/i.test(q)
  ) {
    return 'kineticlub_community';
  }

  if (
    /\b(que\s+es\s+kinetic|what\s+is\s+kinetic|para\s+que\s+sirve\s+kinetic|como\s+funciona\s+kinetic|how\s+does\s+kinetic\s+work|acerca\s+de\s+kinetic|about\s+kinetic|kineticapp)\b/i.test(
      q
    ) ||
    q === 'kinetic'
  ) {
    return 'kinetic_identity';
  }

  if (
    /\b(afiliacion\s+b2b|afiliar|afiliarme|b2b\s+affiliation|partner\s+b2b|socio\s+b2b|soy\s+(dueno|club|gym|estudio)|fijo\s+mensual|cuota\s+mensual\s+b2b|join\s+as\s+a?\s*(club|studio|partner|venue))\b/i.test(
      q
    )
  ) {
    return 'b2b_affiliation';
  }

  if (
    /\b(sat|cfdi|fiscal|rfc|factur|isr|iva|spei|clabe|dispers|payout|corte\s+semanal|imss|80\/20)\b/i.test(q) ||
    /\bretencion(es)?\s+(sat|fiscal|iva|isr)/i.test(q)
  ) {
    return 'sat_cfdi_spei_b2b';
  }

  if (
    /\b(cancel|reembols|refund|perdon|forgiv|72\s*h|4\s*h|menos\s+de\s+4|under\s+4|ventana|retencion\b|grace|5\s*min)/i.test(
      q
    )
  ) {
    return 'cancel_window_4h_72h';
  }

  if (/\b(flash|descuento|discount|promo|ultima\s+hora|last\s+minute|oferta)\b/i.test(q)) {
    return 'flash_vip_discounts';
  }

  if (/\b(qr|totp|check[\s-]?in|recepcion|llave\s+dinamica|boarding)\b/i.test(q) || /\b(escan|scan)/i.test(q)) {
    return 'qr_totp_checkin';
  }

  if (/\b(no\s+funciona|falla|error|traba|bug|problema|soporte|support|technical|issue|crash|congel)\b/i.test(q)) {
    return 'tech_support';
  }

  if (
    /\b(membresia|membresias|membership|memberships|vip|bronce|bronze|plata|silver|oro|gold|platino|platinum|subir\s+de\s+nivel)\b/i.test(
      q
    )
  ) {
    return 'memberships_topup';
  }

  if (/\b(recarg|top[\s-]?up|multiplo|kineticoin|kineticoins|kc\b|boveda\s+dual|rollover|paridad|1\s*kc)\b/i.test(q)) {
    return 'kc_topups';
  }

  if (/\b(equipo|equipos|squad|chat|mensaje|mensajes|tribu|amigos|team|split[\s-]?escrow|kinetisquad|kineticlub|muro)\b/i.test(q)) {
    return 'team_chat_kinetisquad';
  }

  if (
    /\b(contacto|contactar|telefono|celular|llamar|whatsapp|instagram|redes\s+sociales|direccion|ubicacion|como\s+llegar|phone|call|address|location|directions|social\s+media|venue\s+contact|studio\s+contact)\b/i.test(
      q
    )
  ) {
    return 'venue_contact_directory';
  }

  if (/\b(escrow|40\/60|60\/40|apartado|garantia|custodia|deposit)\b/i.test(q)) {
    return 'escrow_40_60';
  }

  if (/\b(inscrib|reserv|agend|horario|mapa|estacion|book|schedule|station)/i.test(q)) {
    return 'how_to_book';
  }

  if (/^(hola|hello|hi|hey)\b/.test(q) || /\b(ayuda|help)\b/.test(q)) {
    return 'greeting_help';
  }

  return 'general_fallback';
};

export const buildConciergePureReply = (
  queryRaw: string,

  isB2B: boolean,

  const intent = classifyConciergeSemanticIntent(queryRaw);

            `• **Billetera Dual y Escrow 40/60:** Paridad directa **1 KC = \$1.00 MXN**. Apartas hoy el **40%** en garantía protegida y liquidas el **60%** en recepción al escanear tu **QR TOTP de 60s**.\n` +
            `• **Mapa 3D, KinetiClub y Red B2B:** Elige tu estación exacta en 3D, sube niveles RPG 1–99 y entrena en sedes afiliadas con **\$0 fijo mensual** y liquidación semanal **80/20** vía SPEI.`;

            `• **Feed, 24h Stories & Rankings:** Share workouts, view live 24h studio/athlete stories, and track elite OVR & XP leaderboards.\n` +
            `• **Teams (KinetiSquads) & Private Chat:** Join or lead training teams, chat 1-on-1 or in groups, and split bookings via **Split-Escrow (2–4 athletes)**.`

    case 'levels_xp':

        : `¡Claro que sí, **${safeName}**! Desliza hacia abajo para sincronizar el estado Realtime en vivo, revisa **Bóveda -> Ajustes -> Seguridad**, toca **HUMANO ›** arriba a la derecha o escribe directo a **soporte@kineticapp.com.mx**.`;

    case 'memberships_topup':
