import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { resolveCategoryImage } from '../constants/exploreData';
import { getLevelNumericWeight } from '../constants/memberships';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl } from '../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';
import { validateKineticUgcPayload } from '../utils/kineticUgcContentGuardLeaf';
import { deduplicateCanonicalAthletes } from './kineticAthleteDeduplication';
import { resolveOfficialChatDisplayName } from './kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import {
  computeAthleteRpgStats,
  countRealClaimedTrophies,
  filterRealChallengeClaimKeys,
  getActiveKineticLanguage,
  getAuraColorForLevel,
  getTodayISO,
  isB2BOrAdminAccount,
  sanitizeWallPostBody,
  sumClaimedChallengesXp,
  td,
} from './kineticlubHelpers';
import { isUserBlockedUgc } from './kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import {
  purgePostFromMemoryWallSnapshot,
  registerPendingWallFlushHook,
  uploadWallMediaBatchToStorageCdn,
} from './kineticlubWallCloudService';

// ============================================================================
// 4. CONSTRUCTOR UNIFICADO DEL RANKING (TOP 10 Y TOP 100 CON DEDUPLICACIÓN ESTRICTA)
// ============================================================================
type FeedRow = Record<string, unknown>;
type FeedAthleteStats = { ovr: number; fuerza: number; cardio: number; agilidad: number; zen: number; [k: string]: unknown };

export const buildEnrichedCommunityFeed = (
  perfiles: FeedRow[] = [], reservas: FeedRow[] = [], servCatByName: Map<string, string> = new Map(),
  currentUserId?: string | null,
  liveUserProgress?: { totalXp: number; claimedCount: number; ovr: number; stats: FeedAthleteStats; racha: number; completedQrCount?: number },
  lang?: string | null
) => {
  const activeLang = lang || getActiveKineticLanguage();
  const todayIso = getTodayISO();
  const canonicalPerfiles = deduplicateCanonicalAthletes(perfiles || [], currentUserId) as FeedRow[];
  return canonicalPerfiles
    .filter((p) => !isB2BOrAdminAccount(p) && !isUserBlockedUgc(p?.id as string | undefined))
    .map((p) => {
      const pid = String(p.id || '');
      const isCurrentUser = Boolean(currentUserId && pid === String(currentUserId));
      const userRes = (reservas || []).filter(
        (r) => String(r.usuario_id) === pid && ['completada', 'activa', 'confirmada', 'pendiente'].includes(String(r.estado || '').toLowerCase())
      );
      const completedRes = userRes.filter((r) => String(r.estado || '').toLowerCase() === 'completada');
      const realCheckinsCount = isCurrentUser && typeof liveUserProgress?.completedQrCount === 'number' ? liveUserProgress.completedQrCount : completedRes.length;
      const dbClaimedRealArr = filterRealChallengeClaimKeys(p.recompensas_reclamadas as string[] | undefined);
      const dbRealTrophies = countRealClaimedTrophies(dbClaimedRealArr);
      const realStreak = isCurrentUser && liveUserProgress?.racha ? liveUserProgress.racha : Math.max(1, Number(p.racha_dias ?? p.racha ?? 1));
      const fallbackRealTrophies = 1 + (realStreak >= 1 ? 1 : 0) + (realCheckinsCount >= 1 ? 1 : 0);
      const unifiedTrophiesCount =
        isCurrentUser && typeof liveUserProgress?.claimedCount === 'number'
          ? Math.max(1, Math.min(250, liveUserProgress.claimedCount))
          : dbRealTrophies > 0 ? dbRealTrophies : fallbackRealTrophies;
      const nivelWeight = getLevelNumericWeight(String(p.nivel || 'Acceso Base'));
      const computedRpg = isCurrentUser && liveUserProgress?.stats ? liveUserProgress.stats : computeAthleteRpgStats(userRes, realStreak, nivelWeight, unifiedTrophiesCount);
      const calculatedXp = realCheckinsCount * 50 + realStreak * 25 + (dbClaimedRealArr.length > 0 ? sumClaimedChallengesXp(dbClaimedRealArr) : unifiedTrophiesCount * 20);
      const unifiedXpTotal = isCurrentUser && typeof liveUserProgress?.totalXp === 'number' ? liveUserProgress.totalXp : Math.max(calculatedXp, Number(p.xp_total) || 0);
      const lastRes = userRes[0];
      const servName = String(lastRes?.servicio || lastRes?.nombre_servicio || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const disciplina = String(lastRes?.categoria || servCatByName.get(servName) || 'Fuerza');
      const gimnasio = String(lastRes?.negocio_nombre || td('Red Oficial Kinetic', 'Official Kinetic Network', activeLang));
      const esHoy = userRes.some((r) => String(r.fecha_clase || r.created_at || '').startsWith(todayIso));
      const codeClean = pid.replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 6).toUpperCase() || 'KNT001';
      const nivelStr = String(p.nivel || 'Acceso Base');
      const isVip = ['Gold', 'Platinum', 'Black', 'Leyenda VIP', 'VIP Legend'].includes(nivelStr);
      const roleLabel = isVip ? td('LEYENDA VIP', 'VIP LEGEND', activeLang) : td('ATLETA ACTIVO', 'ACTIVE ATHLETE', activeLang);
      const pEmail = typeof p.email === 'string' ? p.email : '';
      return {
        id: pid,
        nombre: String(p.nombre || (isCurrentUser && pEmail ? pEmail.split('@')[0] : '') || td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete', activeLang)),
        email: isCurrentUser ? pEmail : '', avatar_url: (p.avatar_url as string | null) || null, nivel: nivelStr, rango: roleLabel, titulo: roleLabel,
        auraColor: getAuraColorForLevel(nivelStr), racha: realStreak, xpTotal: unifiedXpTotal, ovr: computedRpg.ovr,
        stats: computedRpg, fuerza: computedRpg.fuerza, cardio: computedRpg.cardio, agilidad: computedRpg.agilidad, zen: computedRpg.zen,
        trofeosCount: unifiedTrophiesCount, checkinsCount: realCheckinsCount, disciplina, categoria: disciplina, gimnasio,
        callingCard: resolveCategoryImage(disciplina, gimnasio), esHoy: esHoy || realStreak > 0,
        radar_publico: p.radar_publico !== false, codigoSquad: `SQ-${codeClean}`,
      };
    });
};

export const REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY = '@kinetic_real_wall_posts_v26';
export const LEGACY_WALL_POSTS_KEYS = ['@kinetic_social_feed_posts_v25', '@kinetic_community_feed_cache'];

const wallListeners = new Set<() => void>();

export const subscribeCommunityWallUpdated = (fn: () => void): (() => void) => {
  wallListeners.add(fn);
  return () => { wallListeners.delete(fn); };
};

export const emitCommunityWallUpdated = (): void => {
  wallListeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try { fn(); } catch {}
  });
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:wall-updated')); } catch {}
  }
};

export function formatPostRelativeTime(timestamp?: string | number | null, isEn = false): string {
  if (!timestamp) return isEn ? 'Just now' : 'Hace instantes';
  let time = typeof timestamp === 'number' ? timestamp : Date.parse(String(timestamp));
  if (isNaN(time)) {
    const digits = String(timestamp).match(/\d{12,14}/)?.[0];
    if (digits) time = Number(digits);
  }
  if (!time || isNaN(time)) return isEn ? 'Just now' : 'Hace instantes';
  const diffSec = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - time) / 1000));
  if (diffSec < 60) return isEn ? 'Just now' : 'Hace instantes';
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffSec / 60);
  if (diffMin < 60) return isEn ? `${diffMin} min ago` : `Hace ${diffMin} min`;
  const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
  if (diffHours < 24) return isEn ? `${diffHours} h ago` : `Hace ${diffHours} h`;
  const d = new Date(time);
  const hh = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const mm = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  const mesesEs = ['ene', 'feb', 'mar', 'abr', 'may', 'jun', 'jul', 'ago', 'sep', 'oct', 'nov', 'dic'];
  const mesesEn = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
  const dia = d.getDate();
  const mes = isEn ? mesesEn[d.getMonth()] : mesesEs[d.getMonth()];
  return isEn ? `${mes} ${dia} • ${hh}:${mm}` : `${dia} ${mes} • ${hh}:${mm}`;
}

export function formatPromoDateLocalized(isoDate?: string | null, isEn = false): string {
  const clean = String(isoDate || '').slice(0, 10);
  const parts = clean.split('-');
  if (parts.length === 3) {
    const mIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(11, Number(parts[1]) - 1));
    const day = Number(parts[2]) || 1;
    const mesesEs = ['ene', 'feb', 'mar', 'abr', 'may', 'jun', 'jul', 'ago', 'sep', 'oct', 'nov', 'dic'];
    const mesesEn = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
    return isEn ? `${mesesEn[mIdx]} ${day}` : `${day} ${mesesEs[mIdx]}`;
  }
  return isEn ? 'Upcoming' : 'Próximo';
}

async function ensureActiveCloudSessionUid(fallbackUser?: { id?: string } | null): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const { data } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    const sess = data?.session;
    const nowSec = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    if (sess?.user?.id && (!sess.expires_at || sess.expires_at > nowSec + 30)) {
      return String(sess.user.id);
    }
    const refreshed = await supabase.auth.refreshSession();
    if (refreshed?.data?.session?.user?.id) {
      return String(refreshed.data.session.user.id);
    }
    if (sess?.user?.id) return String(sess.user.id);
  } catch {}
  return String(fallbackUser?.id || '').trim();
}

async function insertWallPostCloudResilient(payload: {
  authUid: string;
  authorName: string;
  authorAvatar: string | null;
  authorRank: string;
  discipline: string;
  venue: string;
  sedeId: string | null;
  zona: string;
  safeBodyText: string;
  cloudMediaUrls: string[];
  createdAtIso: string;
}): Promise<string | null> {
  const ugcCheck = validateKineticUgcPayload(payload.safeBodyText, { allowEmptyText: payload.cloudMediaUrls.length > 0, extraFields: [payload.discipline, payload.venue] });
  if (!ugcCheck.allowed) return null;
  const safeUrls = payload.cloudMediaUrls.filter((u) => isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(u));
  const safeAvatar = isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(payload.authorAvatar) ? payload.authorAvatar : null;
  const baseRow = {
    usuario_id: payload.authUid,
    autor_nombre: payload.authorName,
    autor_avatar: safeAvatar,
    autor_nivel: payload.authorRank,
    disciplina: payload.discipline,
    sede: payload.venue,
    contenido: payload.safeBodyText,
    imagen_url: safeUrls[0] || null,
    galeria: safeUrls,
    created_at: payload.createdAtIso,
  };
  const hybridRow = { ...baseRow, sede_id: payload.sedeId, zona: payload.zona };

  const attemptInsert = async (uid: string) => {
    const rFull = await supabase.from('comunidad_posts').insert([{ ...hybridRow, usuario_id: uid }]).select('id').maybeSingle();
    if (!rFull.error && rFull.data?.id) return { id: String(rFull.data.id), err: null };
    if (rFull.error && /sede_id|zona|column/i.test(String(rFull.error.message || ''))) {
      const rBase = await supabase.from('comunidad_posts').insert([{ ...baseRow, usuario_id: uid }]).select('id').maybeSingle();
      if (!rBase.error && rBase.data?.id) return { id: String(rBase.data.id), err: null };
      return { id: null, err: rBase.error };
    }
    return { id: null, err: rFull.error };
  };

  try {
    let res = await attemptInsert(payload.authUid);
    if (!res.id && res.err && /jwt|token|expired|unauthorized|row-level/i.test(String(res.err.message || ''))) {
      const refreshed = await supabase.auth.refreshSession().catch(() => null);
      const rUid = String(refreshed?.data?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
      if (rUid) res = await attemptInsert(rUid);
    }
    return res.id;
  } catch { return null; }
}

let _flushPendingInflight: Promise<number> | null = null;

export async function flushPendingLocalWallPostsToCloud(
  user?: { id?: string; email?: string | null } | null,
  profile?: { email?: string | null; rol?: unknown; nombre?: string | null; avatar_url?: string | null; nivel?: string | null } | null
): Promise<number> {
  if (_flushPendingInflight) return _flushPendingInflight;
  _flushPendingInflight = (async () => {
    try {
      const authUid = await ensureActiveCloudSessionUid(user);
      if (!authUid) return 0;
      const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY);
      if (!raw) return 0;
      const list = JSON.parse(raw) as FeedRow[];
      if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) return 0;

      const pendingItems = list.filter((p) => p?.id && String(p.id).startsWith('upost_') && String(p.userId || '') === authUid);
      if (pendingItems.length === 0) return 0;

      let syncedCount = 0;
      const replacedMap = new Map<string, FeedRow>();

      for (const item of pendingItems) {
        const rawSources: string[] = Array.isArray(item.pendingMediaUris) ? (item.pendingMediaUris as string[]) : Array.isArray(item.mediaUris) ? (item.mediaUris as string[]) : [];
        const cleanSources = rawSources.map((u) => String(u || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const uploadedUrls = cleanSources.length > 0 ? await uploadWallMediaBatchToStorageCdn(cleanSources, authUid) : [];
        if (cleanSources.length > 0 && uploadedUrls.length < cleanSources.length) continue;

        const latestRawBeforeInsert = await AsyncStorage.getItem(REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY);
        const latestBeforeInsert = (latestRawBeforeInsert ? JSON.parse(latestRawBeforeInsert) : []) as FeedRow[];
        if (!Array.isArray(latestBeforeInsert) || !latestBeforeInsert.some((x) => String(x?.id) === String(item.id))) continue;

        const safeText = sanitizeWallPostBody(String(item.bodyEs ?? item.contenido ?? ''));
        if (!safeText && uploadedUrls.length === 0) continue;
        if (!validateKineticUgcPayload(safeText, { allowEmptyText: uploadedUrls.length > 0, extraFields: [item.discipline, item.venue] }).allowed) continue;

        const authorName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({
          id: authUid, email: user?.email || profile?.email, rol: String(profile?.rol || ''),
          name: String(item.authorName || profile?.nombre || ''), fallback: 'Atleta Kinetic',
        });
        const cloudId = await insertWallPostCloudResilient({
          authUid, authorName, authorAvatar: (item.authorAvatar as string | null) || profile?.avatar_url || null,
          authorRank: String(item.authorRank || profile?.nivel || 'Acceso Base'),
          discipline: String(item.discipline || item.disciplina || 'Fuerza'), venue: String(item.venue || item.sede || 'Kinetic Oficial'),
          sedeId: (item.sedeId ?? item.sede_id ?? null) as string | null, zona: String(item.zona || 'Los Cabos'),
          safeBodyText: safeText, cloudMediaUrls: uploadedUrls, createdAtIso: String(item.created_at || new Date().toISOString()),
        });
        if (cloudId) {
          replacedMap.set(String(item.id), {
            ...item, id: cloudId, userId: authUid, authorId: authUid, authorName,
            mediaUris: uploadedUrls, pendingMediaUris: undefined, pendingCloudSync: false,
          });
          syncedCount++;
        }
      }

      if (syncedCount > 0) {
        const freshRaw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY);
        const freshList = (freshRaw ? JSON.parse(freshRaw) : []) as FeedRow[];
        const seenFinalIds = new Set<string>();
        const nextList: FeedRow[] = [];
        for (const p of Array.isArray(freshList) ? freshList : []) {
          const mapped = replacedMap.get(String(p?.id)) || p;
          const mid = String(mapped?.id || '');
          if (!mid || seenFinalIds.has(mid)) continue;
          seenFinalIds.add(mid);
          nextList.push(mapped);
        }
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextList.slice(0, 35))).catch(() => {});
      }
      return syncedCount;
    } catch { return 0; } finally { _flushPendingInflight = null; }
  })();
  return _flushPendingInflight;
}

registerPendingWallFlushHook(async (userId, authorFallback) => {
  if (!userId) return;
  await flushPendingLocalWallPostsToCloud({ id: userId }, { nombre: authorFallback });
});

export async function publishCommunityWallPostEverywhere(params: {
  user: { id?: string; email?: string | null } | null | undefined;
  profile: { email?: string | null; rol?: unknown; nombre?: string | null; avatar_url?: string | null; nivel?: string | null } | null | undefined;
  cleanText: string; mediaUris: string[]; fallbackAuthorLabel: string;
  discipline?: string; venue?: string; sedeId?: string | null; zona?: string;
}): Promise<FeedRow> {
  const { user, profile, cleanText, mediaUris, fallbackAuthorLabel } = params;
  const safeBodyText = sanitizeWallPostBody(cleanText);
  const ugcCheck = validateKineticUgcPayload(safeBodyText, { allowEmptyText: mediaUris.length > 0, extraFields: [params.discipline, params.venue] });
  if (!ugcCheck.allowed) {
    throw new Error('KINETIC_UGC_BLOCKED');
  }
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  let finalId = `upost_${nowMs}`;

  const authUid = await ensureActiveCloudSessionUid(user);
  const authorName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({
    id: authUid || user?.id, email: user?.email || profile?.email, rol: String(profile?.rol || ''),
    name: profile?.nombre, fallback: fallbackAuthorLabel,
  });
  const authorAvatar = isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(profile?.avatar_url) ? (profile?.avatar_url || null) : null;
  const authorRank = profile?.nivel || 'Acceso Base';
  const disciplineVal = String(params.discipline || 'Fuerza').trim() || 'Fuerza';
  const venueVal = String(params.venue || 'Kinetic Oficial').trim() || 'Kinetic Oficial';
  const sedeIdVal = params.sedeId ? String(params.sedeId).trim() : null;
  const zonaVal = String(params.zona || 'Los Cabos').trim() || 'Los Cabos';

  const cleanInputMedia = (Array.isArray(mediaUris) ? mediaUris : []).map((u) => String(u || '').trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 5);
  const uploadedCloudUrls = await uploadWallMediaBatchToStorageCdn(cleanInputMedia, authUid || user?.id);
  const allMediaSyncedToHttps = cleanInputMedia.length === 0 || (uploadedCloudUrls.length === cleanInputMedia.length && uploadedCloudUrls.every((u) => isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(u)));

  if (authUid && allMediaSyncedToHttps && (safeBodyText.length > 0 || uploadedCloudUrls.length > 0)) {
    const insertedId = await insertWallPostCloudResilient({
      authUid, authorName, authorAvatar, authorRank, discipline: disciplineVal, venue: venueVal,
      sedeId: sedeIdVal, zona: zonaVal, safeBodyText, cloudMediaUrls: uploadedCloudUrls, createdAtIso: nowIso,
    });
    if (insertedId) finalId = insertedId;
  }

  const isPendingLocal = finalId.startsWith('upost_');
  const displayMedia = !isPendingLocal ? uploadedCloudUrls : uploadedCloudUrls.length === cleanInputMedia.length ? uploadedCloudUrls : cleanInputMedia;

  const newPost: FeedRow = {
    id: finalId, kind: 'athlete_post',
    isMine: true, canDelete: true, userId: authUid || user?.id || null, authorId: authUid || user?.id || null,
    category: 'post', authorName, authorAvatar, authorRank,
    discipline: disciplineVal, disciplina: disciplineVal, venue: venueVal, sede: venueVal, sedeId: sedeIdVal, sede_id: sedeIdVal, zona: zonaVal,
    bodyEs: safeBodyText, bodyEn: safeBodyText, mediaUris: displayMedia,
    pendingMediaUris: isPendingLocal && cleanInputMedia.length > 0 ? cleanInputMedia : undefined,
    pendingCloudSync: isPendingLocal, created_at: nowIso, createdAt: nowIso, createdAtMs: nowMs,
    baseFire: 0, basePower: 0, baseRespect: 0, isSavedByMe: false, savedCount: 0, baseSaved: 0,
  };

  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY);
    const prev = (raw ? JSON.parse(raw) || [] : []) as FeedRow[];
    const next = [newPost, ...prev.filter((p) => String(p?.id) !== finalId)].slice(0, 35);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(next)).catch(async () => {
      const lite = next.map((pp) => ({
        ...pp,
        mediaUris: ((pp.mediaUris as string[]) || []).filter((u) => !String(u).startsWith('data:')),
        pendingMediaUris: Array.isArray(pp.pendingMediaUris) ? (pp.pendingMediaUris as string[]).filter((u) => !String(u).startsWith('data:')) : undefined,
      }));
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(lite)).catch(() => {});
    });
  } catch {}
  emitCommunityWallUpdated();
  return newPost;
}

export async function deleteCommunityWallPostEverywhere(postId: string, userId?: string | null, isAdminOverride = false): Promise<void> {
  const pid = String(postId || '').trim();
  if (!pid) return;
  purgePostFromMemoryWallSnapshot(pid);
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (!pid.startsWith('upost_') && (uid || isAdminOverride)) {
    try {
      let q = supabase.from('comunidad_posts').delete().eq('id', pid);
      if (!isAdminOverride) q = q.eq('usuario_id', uid);
      await q;
    } catch {}
  }
  await Promise.all([REAL_WALL_POSTS_KEY, ...LEGACY_WALL_POSTS_KEYS].map(async (k) => {
    try {
      const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(k);
      if (!raw) return;
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) await AsyncStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(parsed.filter((p: FeedRow) => String(p?.id) !== pid)));
    } catch {}
  }));
  emitCommunityWallUpdated();
}

const BLACK_OFFICIAL_ALIASES = new Set([
  'black', 'kinetic black', 'membresía black', 'membresia black',
  'nivel black', 'black member', '⚡ oficial kinetic', '⚡ kinetic official',
]);

const matchCaseStyle = (source: string, target: string): string =>
  source === source.toUpperCase() && source !== source.toLowerCase() ? target.toUpperCase() : target;

export const translateClubTerm = (raw?: string | null, lang?: string | null): string => {
  const clean = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return '';
  const activeLang = (lang || _activeClubLang) === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es';
  if (clean.includes('•')) {
    return clean.split('•').map((seg) => translateClubTerm(seg, activeLang)).join(' • ');
  }
  const isEn = activeLang === 'en';
  const low = clean.toLowerCase();
  if (BLACK_OFFICIAL_ALIASES.has(low)) return isEn ? '⚡ Kinetic Official' : '⚡ Oficial Kinetic';
  for (const [esVal, enVal] of TERM_PAIRS_ES_EN) {
    if (isEn && low === esVal.toLowerCase()) return matchCaseStyle(clean, enVal);
    if (!isEn && low === enVal.toLowerCase()) return matchCaseStyle(clean, esVal);
  }
  if (isEn && /^(?:escuadr[oó]n|equipo) de /i.test(clean)) {
    const owner = clean.replace(/^(?:escuadr[oó]n|equipo) de /i, '').trim();
    return owner ? `${owner}'s Team` : 'Kinetic Team';
  }
  if (!isEn && /'s (?:squad|team)$/i.test(clean)) {
    const owner = clean.replace(/'s (?:squad|team)$/i, '').trim();
    return owner ? `Equipo de ${owner}` : 'Equipo Kinetic';
  }
  return clean;
};

export const formatOfficialOrTierLabel = (rawTier?: string | null, lang?: 'es' | 'en'): string => {
  const activeLang = (lang || _activeClubLang) === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es';
  const clean = String(rawTier || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return activeLang === 'en' ? 'Base Access' : 'Acceso Base';
  return translateClubTerm(clean, activeLang);
};

  if (n === 1) return lang === 'en' ? '1 DAY' : '1 DÍA';
  return `${n} ${lang === 'en' ? 'DAYS' : 'DÍAS'}`;
};

): T[] {

export function formatNextMidnightCountdown(lang: 'es' | 'en' = 'es'): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const nextMidnight = new Date(now);
  nextMidnight.setHours(24, 0, 0, 0);
  const diffMs = Math.max(0, nextMidnight.getTime() - now.getTime());
  const totalMins = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(diffMs / 60000));
  const hh = String(Math.floor(totalMins / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
  const mm = String(totalMins % 60).padStart(2, '0');
  return lang === 'en'
    ? `⏳ NEXT REWARD IN ${hh} H ${mm} MIN`
    : `⏳ PRÓXIMA RECOMPENSA EN ${hh} H ${mm} MIN`;
}

export const isMasterAdmin = (
  userOrProfile?: StrictB2BAccountSubject | null,
  fallbackProfile?: StrictB2BAccountSubject | null
): boolean => {
  const email = normalizeRoleToken(userOrProfile?.email || fallbackProfile?.email);
  const rol = normalizeRoleToken(userOrProfile?.rol || userOrProfile?.tipo_cuenta || fallbackProfile?.rol || fallbackProfile?.tipo_cuenta);
  return isKineticMasterAdminRole(rol, email);
};

export const isB2BOrAdminAccount = (perfil?: StrictB2BAccountSubject | null): boolean => {
  if (!perfil) return false;
  if (isMasterAdmin(perfil)) return true;
  const email = normalizeRoleToken(perfil.email);
  const rol = normalizeRoleToken(perfil.rol || perfil.tipo_cuenta);
  const nombre = normalizeRoleToken(perfil.nombre);
  if (
    isMasterAdminEmailOnly(email) ||
    email.startsWith('club@') ||
    email.startsWith('especialista@') ||
    rol === 'admin' ||
    rol === 'fundador' ||
    rol === 'ceo' ||
    isKineticB2BRoleText(rol) ||
    String(perfil.nivel || '').toLowerCase().includes('partner') ||
    nombre === 'kinetic oficial' ||
    nombre === 'kinetic sports club' ||
    nombre === 'kinetic especialista'
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};

export const isStrictB2BPartnerAccount = (
  userOrProfile?: StrictB2BAccountSubject | null,
  fallbackProfile?: StrictB2BAccountSubject | null
): boolean => {
  if (!userOrProfile && !fallbackProfile) return false;
  if (isMasterAdmin(userOrProfile, fallbackProfile)) return false;
  const emailCandidates = [userOrProfile?.email, fallbackProfile?.email]
    .map((e) => normalizeRoleToken(e))
    .filter(Boolean);
  if (emailCandidates.some((em) => em.startsWith('club@') || em.startsWith('especialista@'))) {
    return true;
  }
  const roleCandidates = [
    userOrProfile?.rol,
    userOrProfile?.tipo_cuenta,
    userOrProfile?.app_metadata?.rol,
    userOrProfile?.app_metadata?.tipo_cuenta,
    userOrProfile?.user_metadata?.rol,
    fallbackProfile?.rol,
    fallbackProfile?.tipo_cuenta,
  ]
    .map((r) => normalizeRoleToken(r))
    .filter(Boolean);
  if (roleCandidates.some((r) => isKineticB2BRoleText(r))) return true;
  const nivelStr = String(fallbackProfile?.nivel || userOrProfile?.nivel || '').toLowerCase();
  if (nivelStr.includes('partner b2b') || nivelStr === 'partner') return true;
  return Boolean(fallbackProfile?.es_afiliado === true || userOrProfile?.es_afiliado === true);
};

// ============================================================================
// 1. CÁLCULO PURO DE ESTADÍSTICAS RPG (ESCALA 0-99) BASADO EN ACTIVIDAD REAL
// ============================================================================
export const computeAthleteRpgStats = (
  reservasAtleta: ReadonlyArray<{ categoria?: unknown; servicio?: unknown }> = [],
  rachaDias: number = 1,
  nivelWeight: number = 1,
  extraTrophiesCount: number = 0
) => {
  let fuerzaSessions = 0;
  let cardioSessions = 0;
  let agilidadSessions = 0;
  let zenSessions = 0;
  (reservasAtleta || []).forEach((r) => {
    const cat = String(r?.categoria || r?.servicio || '').toLowerCase();
    if (['pilates', 'yoga', 'barre', 'plunge', 'medita', 'stretch', 'fisioterapia'].some((k) => cat.includes(k))) {
      zenSessions += 1;
    } else if (['padel', 'pádel', 'surf', 'tenis', 'box', 'artes', 'futbol', 'fútbol'].some((k) => cat.includes(k))) {
      agilidadSessions += 1;
    } else if (['hiit', 'ciclismo', 'indoor', 'run', 'nado', 'natacion', 'cardio'].some((k) => cat.includes(k))) {
      cardioSessions += 1;
    } else {
      fuerzaSessions += 1;
    }
  });
  const baseFromRank = Math.min(12, Math.max(0, (Number(nivelWeight) || 1) * 2));
  const streakBonus = Math.min(14, Math.max(1, Number(rachaDias) || 1) * 2);
  const trophyBonus = Math.min(15, Math.floor((Number(extraTrophiesCount) || 0) * 0.6));
  const fuerza = Math.min(99, 40 + baseFromRank + Math.floor(trophyBonus * 0.5) + fuerzaSessions * 7);
  const cardio = Math.min(99, 38 + baseFromRank + streakBonus + cardioSessions * 7);
  const agilidad = Math.min(99, 38 + baseFromRank + Math.floor(trophyBonus * 0.5) + agilidadSessions * 7);
  const zen = Math.min(99, 38 + baseFromRank + Math.floor(streakBonus * 0.5) + zenSessions * 7);
  const ovr = Math.min(99, Math.round((fuerza + cardio + agilidad + zen) / 4));
  return { fuerza, cardio, agilidad, zen, ovr, fuerzaSessions, cardioSessions, agilidadSessions, zenSessions };
};

import { KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES, IKineticAffiliateCatalogItem } from '../constants/affiliatesCatalog';
import { isOffTopicGamingSpamPost } from './kineticlubWallSnapshotStore';

export const STORY_STRICT_TTL_MS = 86_400_000; // 24h exactas
export const STORY_TTL_24H_MS = STORY_STRICT_TTL_MS;
export const NOTIF_DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
export const NOTIF_WEEK_MS = 7 * 86_400_000;
export const NOTIF_MONTH_MS = 30 * 86_400_000;
export const NOTIF_SEEN_KEY_PREFIX = '@kinetic_notif_seen_ts_v265_';

export type KineticCabosZoneFilter = 'all' | 'Cabo San Lucas' | 'Corredor Turístico' | 'San José del Cabo';
export type KineticWallFeedMode = 'for_you' | 'my_tribe';

export interface IKineticNotificationItem {
  id: string;
  kind: 'reaction' | 'comment' | 'squad_invite' | 'dm_request';
  actorId?: string | null;
  actorName: string;
  actorAvatar?: string | null;
  titleEs: string;
  titleEn: string;
  subtitleEs: string;
  subtitleEn: string;
  timestampMs: number;
  postId?: string;
  rawPayload?: any;
}

const PROTO_POISON_KEYS = new Set(['constructor', 'prototype', '__proto__', 'proto', 'tostring', 'valueof', 'hasownproperty']);

export function normalizeStoryLookupKey(raw?: string | null, fallback?: string | null): string {
  const clean = String(raw || fallback || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
  return PROTO_POISON_KEYS.has(clean) ? '' : clean;
}

function expandBlockedStoryKeys(blockedIds?: ReadonlySet<string>): Set<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  if (!blockedIds) return out;
  blockedIds.forEach((id) => {
    const low = String(id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!low) return;
    out.add(low);
    const stripped = normalizeStoryLookupKey(low);
    if (stripped) out.add(stripped);
  });
  return out;
}

export function isValidStoryMediaUrl(raw?: string | null): boolean {
  const s = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (s.length < 11) return false;
  if (/^(blob:|file:|content:|ph:|assets-library:|javascript:|vbscript:)/i.test(s)) return false;
  if (/^data:image\/(jpeg|jpg|png|webp|heic|heif);base64,/i.test(s)) {
    const commaIdx = s.indexOf(',');
    return commaIdx > 0 && s.slice(commaIdx + 1).trim().length >= 8;
  }
  if (/^https:\/\//i.test(s)) {
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(s);
      const host = String(parsed.hostname || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!host || host === 'undefined' || host === 'null') return false;
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

export function isValidActiveStorySlide(story: any, nowMs = Date.now()): boolean {
  if (!story || typeof story !== 'object') return false;
  if (!isValidStoryMediaUrl(story.imageUrl)) return false;
  const createdMs = Number(story.createdAtMs);
  if (!Number.isFinite(createdMs) || createdMs <= 0) return false;
  const ageMs = nowMs - createdMs;
  if (ageMs >= STORY_STRICT_TTL_MS) return false;
  if (ageMs < -300_000) return false;
  return true;
}

const ownStoriesArray = (map: Record<string, any[]>, key: string): any[] =>
  Boolean(key) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, key) && Array.isArray(map[key]) ? map[key] : [];

export function filterActiveStoriesMapStrict(
  rawMap: Record<string, any[]> | null | undefined,
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  blockedIds?: ReadonlySet<string>
): Record<string, any[]> {
  const out: Record<string, any[]> = Object.create(null);
  if (!rawMap || typeof rawMap !== 'object') return out;
  const blockedExpanded = expandBlockedStoryKeys(blockedIds);
  Object.keys(rawMap).forEach((key) => {
    const kLow = String(key || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const kNorm = normalizeStoryLookupKey(kLow);
    if (!kLow || PROTO_POISON_KEYS.has(kLow) || blockedExpanded.has(kLow) || (kNorm && blockedExpanded.has(kNorm))) return;
    const list = ownStoriesArray(rawMap, key);
    const valid = list.filter((s) => {
      if (!isValidActiveStorySlide(s, nowMs)) return false;
      const ok = String(s?.ownerKey || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const okNorm = normalizeStoryLookupKey(ok);
      return !(ok && (blockedExpanded.has(ok) || (okNorm && blockedExpanded.has(okNorm))));
    });
    if (valid.length > 0) out[key] = valid;
  });
  return out;
}

export function hasActiveStoryInMap(
  activeMap: Record<string, any[]> | null | undefined,
  ownerId?: string | null,
  ownerName?: string | null,
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  blockedIds?: ReadonlySet<string>
): boolean {
  if (!activeMap || typeof activeMap !== 'object') return false;
  const blockedExpanded = expandBlockedStoryKeys(blockedIds);
  const rawIdLow = String(ownerId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const k1 = normalizeStoryLookupKey(ownerId, ownerName);
  const k2 = normalizeStoryLookupKey(ownerName, ownerId);
  if ((rawIdLow && blockedExpanded.has(rawIdLow)) || (k1 && blockedExpanded.has(k1))) return false;
  if (!k1 && !k2) return false;
  const candidates = [
    ...ownStoriesArray(activeMap, k1),
    ...(k2 && k2 !== k1 ? ownStoriesArray(activeMap, k2) : []),
    ...(ownerId && !PROTO_POISON_KEYS.has(rawIdLow) ? ownStoriesArray(activeMap, String(ownerId)) : []),
  ];
  return candidates.some((s) => isValidActiveStorySlide(s, nowMs));
}

export function buildRealActiveStoryCarouselEntries(params: {
  activeMap: Record<string, any[]>;
  storyAthletes?: any[];
  clubPromos?: any[];
  nowMs?: number;
  blockedIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  excludeOwnerId?: string | null;
  excludeOwnerName?: string | null;
}): { kind: 'athlete' | 'promo'; data: any; key: string }[] {
  const nowMs = params.nowMs ?? Date.now();
  const cleanMap = filterActiveStoriesMapStrict(params.activeMap, nowMs, params.blockedIds);
  const exclIdNorm = normalizeStoryLookupKey(params.excludeOwnerId);
  const exclNameNorm = normalizeStoryLookupKey(params.excludeOwnerName);
  const groupedByAuthor = new Map<string, any[]>();
  const keyToAuthor = new Map<string, string>();

  Object.values(cleanMap).forEach((list) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) return;
    const latest = list[list.length - 1];
    const oid = normalizeStoryLookupKey(latest?.ownerId);
    const ok = normalizeStoryLookupKey(latest?.ownerKey, latest?.ownerName);
    const nk = normalizeStoryLookupKey(latest?.ownerName, latest?.ownerKey);
    const candidates = [oid, ok, nk].filter(Boolean);
    if (candidates.length === 0) return;
    if ((exclIdNorm && candidates.includes(exclIdNorm)) || (exclNameNorm && candidates.includes(exclNameNorm))) return;

    let canonical = candidates.find((k) => keyToAuthor.has(k));
    canonical = canonical ? keyToAuthor.get(canonical)! : candidates[0];
    candidates.forEach((k) => keyToAuthor.set(k, canonical!));

    const prev = groupedByAuthor.get(canonical) || [];
    const mergedMap = new Map<string, any>();
    [...prev, ...list].forEach((s) => { if (s?.id) mergedMap.set(String(s.id), s); });
    groupedByAuthor.set(canonical, Array.from(mergedMap.values()).sort((a, b) => Number(a.createdAtMs || 0) - Number(b.createdAtMs || 0)));
  });

  const uniqueLists = Array.from(groupedByAuthor.values());
  uniqueLists.sort((a, b) => Number(b[b.length - 1]?.createdAtMs || 0) - Number(a[a.length - 1]?.createdAtMs || 0));
  const isStoryPromo = (st: any) => Boolean(st?.isPromo || st?.linkedEvent || st?.promoEvent || st?.eventId);
  const seenCanonOut = new Set<string>();
  const out: { kind: 'athlete' | 'promo'; data: any; key: string }[] = [];

  uniqueLists.forEach((list, idx) => {
    const latest = list[list.length - 1];
    if (!isValidActiveStorySlide(latest, nowMs)) return;
    const cleanName = latest.ownerName === 'Terminal Global Kinetic' ? 'Kinetic Oficial' : String(latest.ownerName || 'Kinetic Oficial');
    const oid = normalizeStoryLookupKey(latest.ownerId);
    const ok = normalizeStoryLookupKey(latest.ownerKey, cleanName);
    const nk = normalizeStoryLookupKey(cleanName, latest.ownerKey);
    const matchedAtl = (params.storyAthletes || []).find((a: any) => {
      const ak = normalizeStoryLookupKey(a?.id, a?.nombre);
      const ank = normalizeStoryLookupKey(a?.nombre, a?.id);
      return (oid && ak === oid) || (ak && (ak === ok || ak === nk)) || (ank && (ank === ok || ank === nk));
    });
    const finalAuthorKey = String(matchedAtl?.id || oid || ok || nk).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!finalAuthorKey || seenCanonOut.has(finalAuthorKey)) return;
    seenCanonOut.add(finalAuthorKey);
    const promoSlide = [...list].reverse().find((s) => isStoryPromo(s) && isValidActiveStorySlide(s, nowMs));
    const matchedPromo = (params.clubPromos || []).find((cp: any) => {
      const cpk = normalizeStoryLookupKey(cp?.affiliate?.id || cp?.id, cp?.negocio_nombre);
      const cpn = normalizeStoryLookupKey(cp?.negocio_nombre, cp?.id);
      return (promoSlide?.eventId && String(cp?.id) === String(promoSlide.eventId)) || cpk === ok || cpk === nk || cpn === ok || cpn === nk;
    });

    if (promoSlide) {
      out.push({
        kind: 'promo',
        data: {
          ...(matchedPromo || {}),
          id: promoSlide.eventId || matchedPromo?.id || latest.ownerKey,
          storyOwnerKey: latest.ownerKey,
          negocio_nombre: cleanName,
          portada_url: promoSlide.imageUrl,
          rawService: promoSlide.linkedEvent || promoSlide.promoEvent || matchedPromo?.rawService || matchedPromo || null,
        },
        key: `st_live_prm_${latest.id || idx}`,
      });
    } else {
      const isOfficialOrB2B = Boolean(latest.isB2B || nk === 'kineticoficial' || matchedPromo);
      out.push({
        kind: 'athlete',
        data: {
          ...(matchedAtl || {}),
          id: matchedAtl?.id || latest.ownerKey,
          storyOwnerKey: latest.ownerKey,
          nombre: cleanName,
          avatar_url: latest.ownerAvatar || matchedAtl?.avatar_url || latest.imageUrl,
          isB2B: isOfficialOrB2B,
        },
        key: `st_live_nrm_${latest.id || idx}`,
      });
    }
  });
  return out;
}

export function resolveLosCabosZona(
  rawUbicacionOrZona?: string | null,
  latOrVenueFallback?: number | string | null,
  lng?: number | null
): 'Cabo San Lucas' | 'Corredor Turístico' | 'San José del Cabo' | 'Los Cabos' {
  const parseOne = (val?: string | null) => {
    const norm = String(val || '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase();
    if (norm.includes('corredor') || norm.includes('tourist corridor') || norm.includes('el tule') || norm.includes('chileno') || norm.includes('palmilla')) {
      return 'Corredor Turístico' as const;
    }
    if (norm.includes('san jose') || norm.includes('sjc') || norm.includes('sjd') || norm.includes('fonatur')) {
      return 'San José del Cabo' as const;
    }
    if (norm.includes('cabo san lucas') || norm.includes('csl') || norm.includes('el tezal') || norm.includes('medano') || norm.includes('pedregal')) {
      return 'Cabo San Lucas' as const;
    }
    return null;
  };
  const primary = parseOne(rawUbicacionOrZona);
  if (primary) return primary;
  if (typeof latOrVenueFallback === 'string') {
    const fallbackParsed = parseOne(latOrVenueFallback);
    if (fallbackParsed) return fallbackParsed;
  }
  if (typeof lng === 'number' && Number.isFinite(lng)) {
    if (lng <= -109.86) return 'Cabo San Lucas';
    if (lng >= -109.74) return 'San José del Cabo';
    return 'Corredor Turístico';
  }
  return 'Los Cabos';
}

export function matchVerifiedAffiliateForPost(post: any): IKineticAffiliateCatalogItem | null {
  if (!post) return null;
  const sid = String(post.sedeId || post.sede_id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const sName = String(post.venue || post.sede || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const aName = post.isB2B ? String(post.authorName || '').trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  return (
    KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES.find((aff) => {
      const idLow = String(aff.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const nomLow = String(aff.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (sid && idLow === sid) return true;
      if (sName && sName !== 'kinetic oficial' && nomLow === sName) return true;
      if (sName === 'kinetic oficial' && idLow === 'kinetic-oficial' && sid === 'kinetic-oficial') return true;
      if (aName && aName !== 'kinetic oficial' && nomLow === aName) return true;
      return false;
    }) || null
  );
}

export function stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost(raw?: string | null): string {
  if (!raw) return '';
  return String(raw)
    .replace(/(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:www\.)?(?:google\.[a-z.]+\/maps|maps\.google\.[a-z.]+|maps\.app\.goo\.gl|goo\.gl\/maps)\S*/gi, '')
    .replace(/\(\s*\)/g, '')
    .replace(/[ \t]{2,}/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

export function buildOrganicHyperlocalWallStream(params: {
  posts: any[];
  blockedIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  zoneFilter?: KineticCabosZoneFilter | string;
  feedMode?: KineticWallFeedMode;
  tribeMemberKeys?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  searchQuery?: string;
}): any[] {
  const rawList = Array.isArray(params.posts) ? params.posts : [];
  const blocked = params.blockedIds || new Set<string>();
  const zf = String(params.zoneFilter || 'all').trim();
  const isSpecificZone = zf === 'Cabo San Lucas' || zf === 'Corredor Turístico' || zf === 'San José del Cabo';
  const mode = params.feedMode || 'for_you';
  const tribe = params.tribeMemberKeys || new Set<string>();
  const q = String(params.searchQuery || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  const out: any[] = [];
  for (const item of rawList) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
    const rawIdStr = String(item.id || '');
    if (item.kind === 'club_promo' || item.isPromo || rawIdStr.startsWith('fpromo_') || rawIdStr.startsWith('promo_')) continue;

    const uidLow = String(item.userId || item.authorId || item.usuario_id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (uidLow && blocked.has(uidLow)) continue;

    const resolvedZona = resolveLosCabosZona(item.zona, item.venue || item.sede);
    if (isSpecificZone && resolvedZona !== zf) continue;

    if (mode === 'my_tribe') {
      const normAuthor = String(item.authorName || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const inTribe = Boolean(item.isMine || (uidLow && tribe.has(uidLow)) || (normAuthor && tribe.has(normAuthor)));
      if (!inTribe) continue;
    }

    const cleanEs = stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost(item.bodyEs ?? item.contenido ?? '');
    const cleanEn = stripGoogleMapsUrlsFromPost(item.bodyEn ?? item.bodyEs ?? item.contenido ?? '');
    if (isOffTopicGamingSpamPost({ ...item, bodyEs: cleanEs, bodyEn: cleanEn })) {
      continue;
    }

    if (q) {
      const hay = `${item.authorName || ''} ${item.discipline || item.disciplina || ''} ${item.venue || item.sede || ''} ${resolvedZona} ${cleanEs} ${cleanEn}`.toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(q)) continue;
    }

    out.push({
      ...item,
      kind: 'athlete_post',
      zona: resolvedZona,
      bodyEs: cleanEs,
      bodyEn: cleanEn,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

export function partitionNotificationsByWindow(
  items: IKineticNotificationItem[],
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  blockedIds?: ReadonlySet<string>
): {
  today: IKineticNotificationItem[];
  week: IKineticNotificationItem[];
  month: IKineticNotificationItem[];
  allValid: IKineticNotificationItem[];
} {
  const seenIds = new Set<string>();
  const valid: IKineticNotificationItem[] = [];
  for (const it of Array.isArray(items) ? items : []) {
    if (!it || !it.id) continue;
    const idStr = String(it.id);
    if (seenIds.has(idStr)) continue;
    const actorLow = String(it.actorId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (actorLow && blockedIds?.has(actorLow)) continue;
    const ts = Number(it.timestampMs);
    if (!Number.isFinite(ts) || ts <= 0) continue;
    const ageMs = nowMs - ts;
    if (ageMs >= NOTIF_MONTH_MS || ageMs < -300_000) continue;
    seenIds.add(idStr);
    valid.push(it);
  }

  valid.sort((a, b) => Number(b.timestampMs) - Number(a.timestampMs));
  const today: IKineticNotificationItem[] = [];
  const week: IKineticNotificationItem[] = [];
  const month: IKineticNotificationItem[] = [];

  for (const it of valid) {
    const ageMs = nowMs - Number(it.timestampMs);
    if (ageMs < NOTIF_DAY_MS) today.push(it);
    else if (ageMs < NOTIF_WEEK_MS) week.push(it);
    else month.push(it);
  }
  return { today, week, month, allValid: valid };
}

export function countUnseenNotifications(
  items: IKineticNotificationItem[],
  lastSeenTsMs: number,
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  blockedIds?: ReadonlySet<string>
): number {
  const { allValid } = partitionNotificationsByWindow(items, nowMs, blockedIds);
  const cutoff = Number.isFinite(lastSeenTsMs) ? lastSeenTsMs : 0;
  return allValid.filter((it) => Number(it.timestampMs) > cutoff).length;
}

import { KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES } from '../constants/exploreData';
import { filterRealChallengeClaimKeys, resolveMysteryBoxTierConfig } from './kineticlubPureClaimGuards';
import { getMazatlanNowParts } from './kineticVenueCanonicalGeoAndHours';

export const PRESTIGE_GRADES_META = [
  { grade: 1, arabic: '1', roman: '1', divisionTitle: 'Prestigio Nivel 1 • División Iniciado', divisionTitleEn: 'Prestige Level 1 • Initiate Division', badgeColor: '#00F0FF' },
  { grade: 2, arabic: '2', roman: '2', divisionTitle: 'Prestigio Nivel 2 • División Vanguardia', divisionTitleEn: 'Prestige Level 2 • Vanguard Division', badgeColor: '#9D4EDD' },
  { grade: 3, arabic: '3', roman: '3', divisionTitle: 'Prestigio Nivel 3 • División Comandante', divisionTitleEn: 'Prestige Level 3 • Commander Division', badgeColor: '#00FF66' },
  { grade: 4, arabic: '4', roman: '4', divisionTitle: 'Prestigio Nivel 4 • División Maestro', divisionTitleEn: 'Prestige Level 4 • Master Division', badgeColor: '#FFCC00' },
  { grade: 5, arabic: '5', roman: '5', divisionTitle: 'Prestigio Nivel 5 • División Inmortal', divisionTitleEn: 'Prestige Level 5 • Immortal Division', badgeColor: '#FF3B30' },
];

export const getLevelTitleIn99Ladder = (
  level: number,
  prestigioNivel: number = 0,
  lang?: string | null
): string => {
  const cleanP = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(prestigioNivel) || 0));
  const prefix = cleanP > 0 ? `[P-${cleanP}] ` : '';
  const isEn = lang === 'en';
  if (level <= 5) return `${prefix}${isEn ? 'Radar Recruit' : 'Recluta del Radar'}`;
  if (level <= 12) return `${prefix}${isEn ? 'Kinetic Initiate' : 'Iniciado Kinetic'}`;
  if (level <= 22) return `${prefix}${isEn ? 'Impact Athlete' : 'Atleta de Impacto'}`;
  if (level <= 35) return `${prefix}${isEn ? 'Tactical Operator' : 'Operador Táctico'}`;
  if (level <= 50) return `${prefix}${isEn ? 'Corridor Vanguard' : 'Vanguardia del Corredor'}`;
  if (level <= 65) return `${prefix}${isEn ? 'Iron Specialist' : 'Especialista de Hierro'}`;
  if (level <= 80) return `${prefix}${isEn ? 'Elite Commander' : 'Comandante Élite'}`;
  if (level <= 92) return `${prefix}${isEn ? 'Kinetic Master' : 'Maestro Kinetic'}`;
  if (level < 99) return `${prefix}${isEn ? 'Kinetic Grandmaster' : 'Gran Maestro Kinetic'}`;
  return `${prefix}${isEn ? 'Immortal Legend Lvl 99' : 'Leyenda Inmortal Nv. 99'}`;
};

export const getXpRequiredForSingleLevel = (level: number): number => {
  const cleanLvl = Math.max(1, Math.min(99, Math.floor(level)));
  const raw = 100 + (cleanLvl - 1) * 6 + Math.pow(cleanLvl - 1, 1.38) * 1.45;
  return Math.round(raw / 10) * 10;
};

const buildCumulative99Thresholds = (): number[] => {
  const thresholds: number[] = [0];
  let acc = 0;
  for (let lvl = 1; lvl <= 99; lvl++) {
    acc += getXpRequiredForSingleLevel(lvl);
    thresholds.push(acc);
  }
  return thresholds;
};

export const LEVEL_99_CUMULATIVE_XP = buildCumulative99Thresholds();
export const TOTAL_XP_PER_PRESTIGE_GRADE = LEVEL_99_CUMULATIVE_XP[99];

const CHALLENGE_XP_MAP = new Map<string, number>(
  (KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES || []).map((c) => [String(c.id), Number(c.recompensaXp) || 20])
);

export const countRealClaimedTrophies = (claimedIds: unknown): number => {
  const validIds = filterRealChallengeClaimKeys(claimedIds);
  let total = 0;
  for (const id of validIds) {
    if (CHALLENGE_XP_MAP.has(id)) total += 1;
  }
  return Math.min(250, total);
};

export const sumClaimedChallengesXp = (claimedIds: string[] = []): number => {
  const validIds = filterRealChallengeClaimKeys(claimedIds);
  if (validIds.length === 0) return 0;
  return validIds.reduce((acc, id) => acc + (CHALLENGE_XP_MAP.get(id) ?? 0), 0);
};

export const computeLevel99State = (
  totalXpInput: number = 0,
  lang?: string | null,
  prestigioNivel: number = 0
) => {
  const isEn = lang === 'en';
  const cleanPrestige = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(prestigioNivel) || 0));
  const totalXp = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(totalXpInput) || 0));
  const xpCycleCost = TOTAL_XP_PER_PRESTIGE_GRADE;
  const xpInLadder = cleanPrestige > 0 && totalXp >= cleanPrestige * xpCycleCost
    ? totalXp - cleanPrestige * xpCycleCost
    : totalXp;

  let currentLevel = 1;
  for (let lvl = 1; lvl <= 99; lvl++) {
    if (xpInLadder >= LEVEL_99_CUMULATIVE_XP[lvl - 1]) currentLevel = lvl;
    else break;
  }

  const levelStartXp = LEVEL_99_CUMULATIVE_XP[currentLevel - 1] || 0;
  const levelEndXp = LEVEL_99_CUMULATIVE_XP[currentLevel] || levelStartXp + 100;
  const xpPerPrestigeLevel = Math.max(50, levelEndXp - levelStartXp);
  const rawXpInLevel = Math.max(0, xpInLadder - levelStartXp);
  const isCapped99 = currentLevel >= 99 && xpInLadder >= xpCycleCost;
  const xpInCurrentPrestige = isCapped99 ? xpPerPrestigeLevel : Math.min(xpPerPrestigeLevel, rawXpInLevel);
  const xpRemainingForNext = isCapped99 ? 0 : Math.max(0, xpPerPrestigeLevel - xpInCurrentPrestige);
  const prestigeProgressPct = isCapped99 ? 100 : Math.min(100, Math.round((xpInCurrentPrestige / xpPerPrestigeLevel) * 100));
  const canAscendPrestige = currentLevel === 99;
  const totalLevelsCompleted = cleanPrestige * 99 + Math.max(0, currentLevel - 1);

  const gradeIdx = cleanPrestige > 0 ? Math.min(cleanPrestige - 1, PRESTIGE_GRADES_META.length - 1) : 0;
  const gradeMeta = PRESTIGE_GRADES_META[gradeIdx];
  const prestigeDisplayLabel = cleanPrestige > 0
    ? (isEn ? `Prestige Level ${cleanPrestige} • Level ${currentLevel}/99` : `Prestigio Nivel ${cleanPrestige} • Nivel ${currentLevel}/99`)
    : (isEn ? `Level ${currentLevel}/99` : `Nivel ${currentLevel}/99`);
  const prestigeShortLabel = cleanPrestige > 0
    ? (isEn ? `PRESTIGE ${cleanPrestige} • LVL ${currentLevel}/99` : `PRESTIGIO ${cleanPrestige} • NV. ${currentLevel}/99`)
    : (isEn ? `LEVEL ${currentLevel}/99` : `NIVEL ${currentLevel}/99`);
  const prestigeGradeTitle = cleanPrestige > 0
    ? (isEn ? `Prestige Level ${cleanPrestige} • ${gradeMeta.divisionTitleEn.split('• ')[1] || 'Elite'}` : `Prestigio Nivel ${cleanPrestige} • ${gradeMeta.divisionTitle.split('• ')[1] || 'Élite'}`)
    : (isEn ? `Kinetic Progression • Level ${currentLevel}/99` : `Progresión Kinetic • Nivel ${currentLevel}/99`);

  return {
    totalXp,
    prestigioNivel: cleanPrestige,
    canAscendPrestige,
    prestigeGrade: cleanPrestige,
    prestigeGradeRoman: cleanPrestige > 0 ? String(cleanPrestige) : '0',
    prestigeGradeTitle,
    prestigeDisplayLabel,
    prestigeShortLabel,
    prestigeLevel: currentLevel,
    maxPrestigeLevel: 99,
    prestigeRankTitle: getLevelTitleIn99Ladder(currentLevel, cleanPrestige, lang),
    xpInCurrentPrestige,
    xpPerPrestigeLevel,
    xpRemainingForNext,
    prestigeProgressPct,
    totalLevelsCompleted,
  };
};

export const computePrestigeInfo = (
  completedSessionsCount: number = 0, rachaActual: number = 1, bonusXp: number = 0,
  openedBoxesCount: number = 0, claimedChallengeIds: string[] = [], dailyClaimedToday: boolean = false,
  lang?: string | null, nivelRawOrRank?: string | number | null, prestigioNivel: number = 0
) => {
  const isLangArg = !lang || lang === 'es' || lang === 'en';
  const activeLang = isLangArg ? (lang || 'es') : 'es';
  const effectiveNivel = nivelRawOrRank !== undefined ? nivelRawOrRank : isLangArg ? undefined : lang;
  const qrXp = Math.max(0, Number(completedSessionsCount) || 0) * 50;
  const streakXp = Math.max(1, Number(rachaActual) || 1) * 25;
  const challengesXp = sumClaimedChallengesXp(claimedChallengeIds);
  const dailyXp = dailyClaimedToday ? resolveMysteryBoxTierConfig(effectiveNivel).xpReward : 0;
  const cratesXp = Math.max(0, Number(openedBoxesCount) || 0) * 30;
  const calculatedXp = qrXp + streakXp + challengesXp + dailyXp + cratesXp;
  const totalXp = Math.max(calculatedXp, Number(bonusXp) || 0);
  const lvlState = computeLevel99State(totalXp, activeLang, prestigioNivel);
  const availableBoxesCount = Math.max(0, lvlState.totalLevelsCompleted - (Number(openedBoxesCount) || 0));

  return {
    ...lvlState,
    qrXp,
    streakXp,
    challengesXp: challengesXp + dailyXp + cratesXp,
    totalBoxesEarned: lvlState.totalLevelsCompleted,
    openedBoxesCount: Number(openedBoxesCount) || 0,
    availableBoxesCount,
  };
};

export const computeSeasonInfo = (totalXp: number = 0, lang?: string | null) => {
  const isEn = lang === 'en';
  const mz = getMazatlanNowParts();
  const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(mz.year, mz.month, 0)).getUTCDate();
  const daysLeftInMonth = Math.max(1, lastDay - mz.day);
  const monthNames = isEn
    ? ['JANUARY', 'FEBRUARY', 'MARCH', 'APRIL', 'MAY', 'JUNE', 'JULY', 'AUGUST', 'SEPTEMBER', 'OCTOBER', 'NOVEMBER', 'DECEMBER']
    : ['ENERO', 'FEBRERO', 'MARZO', 'ABRIL', 'MAYO', 'JUNIO', 'JULIO', 'AGOSTO', 'SEPTIEMBRE', 'OCTUBRE', 'NOVIEMBRE', 'DICIEMBRE'];
  const monthLabel = `${monthNames[Math.max(0, mz.month - 1)]} ${mz.year}`;
  const seasonXp = Math.min(2500, Math.max(0, Number(totalXp) || 0));
  const maxSeasonXp = 2500;
  const progressPct = Math.min(100, Math.round((seasonXp / maxSeasonXp) * 100));
  let currentStep = 0;
  for (const step of MONTHLY_SEASON_TIERS) {
    if (seasonXp >= step.requiredXp) currentStep = step.level;
  }
  return { seasonXp, maxSeasonXp, progressPct, currentStep, daysLeftInMonth, monthLabel, steps: MONTHLY_SEASON_TIERS };
};

  recompensas_reclamadas?: unknown;
  cajas_nivel_reclamadas?: unknown;
  racha_dias?: unknown;
  racha?: unknown;

  xp?: unknown;
  prestigio_nivel?: unknown;
  nivel?: string | null;
}

export const resolveUnifiedAthleteProgression = (
  profile: IAthleteProgProfile | null | undefined,
  completedSessionsCount: number = 0,
  lang?: string | null
) => {
  const dbArr: string[] = Array.isArray(profile?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? profile.recompensas_reclamadas.map(String) : [];
  const claimedChallengeIds = filterRealChallengeClaimKeys(dbArr);
  const dbBoxSet = new Set(dbArr.filter((k) => /^caja_nivel_\d+$/i.test(k.trim())));
  const openedBoxesCount = Math.max(dbBoxSet.size, Number(profile?.cajas_nivel_reclamadas) || 0);
  const today = getMazatlanNowParts().isoDate;
  const uid = String(profile?.id || '').trim();
  let webXp = 0;
  let webDaily = false;
  if (uid && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
    try {
      webXp = Number(window.localStorage.getItem(`@kinetic_bonus_xp_v25_${uid}`)) || 0;
      webDaily = window.localStorage.getItem(`@kinetic_daily_box_v25_${uid}`) === today;
    } catch {}
  }
  const dailyClaimedToday = webDaily || dbArr.includes(`recompensa_diaria_${today}`);
  const rachaActual = Math.max(1, Number(profile?.racha_dias ?? profile?.racha ?? 1));
  const bonusXp = Math.max(0, Number(profile?.xp_total) || 0, Number(profile?.puntos_xp) || 0, Number(profile?.xp) || 0, webXp);
  const prestigioNivel = Math.max(0, Number(profile?.prestigio_nivel) || 0);
  return computePrestigeInfo(
    Math.max(0, Number(completedSessionsCount) || 0), rachaActual, bonusXp,
    openedBoxesCount, claimedChallengeIds, dailyClaimedToday, lang, profile?.nivel, prestigioNivel
  );
};

export const isSystemRewardClaimKey = (id?: string | null): boolean => {
  const k = String(id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return (
    k.startsWith('recompensa_diaria') ||
    k.startsWith('misteriosa_diaria') ||
    k.startsWith('escudo_racha_') ||
    k.startsWith('caja_nivel_') ||
    /^m\d+_/i.test(k)
  );
};

export const filterRealChallengeClaimKeys = (ids: unknown): string[] => {
  if (!Array.isArray(ids)) return [];
  const out = new Set<string>();
  for (const raw of ids) {
    const clean = String(raw || '').trim();
    if (clean && !isSystemRewardClaimKey(clean)) out.add(clean);
  }
  return Array.from(out);
};

export function resolveMysteryBoxTierConfig(nivelRaw?: string | number | null): IMysteryBoxTierConfig {
  if (typeof nivelRaw === 'number') {
    if (nivelRaw >= 4) return MYSTERY_BOX_TIERS_BY_KEY.platinum;
    if (nivelRaw === 3) return MYSTERY_BOX_TIERS_BY_KEY.gold;
    if (nivelRaw === 2) return MYSTERY_BOX_TIERS_BY_KEY.silver;
    return MYSTERY_BOX_TIERS_BY_KEY.bronze;
  }
  const low = String(nivelRaw || '').toLowerCase();
  if (
    low.includes('platinum') ||
    low.includes('platino') ||
    low.includes('leyenda') ||
    low.includes('legend') ||
    low.includes('black')
  ) {
    return MYSTERY_BOX_TIERS_BY_KEY.platinum;
  }
  if (low.includes('gold') || low.includes('oro')) return MYSTERY_BOX_TIERS_BY_KEY.gold;
  if (low.includes('silver') || low.includes('plata')) return MYSTERY_BOX_TIERS_BY_KEY.silver;
  return MYSTERY_BOX_TIERS_BY_KEY.bronze;
}

import { KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID, deduplicateCanonicalAthletes, isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete } from './kineticAthleteDeduplication';
import { IDirectMessageThread, isMasterAdminChatIdentity, isUuid, matchesUserIdentity, normalizeChatIdentity } from './kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import { isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow } from './kineticlubSquadsDeterministicEngine';
import { resolveLosCabosZona } from './kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
export type MessengerFilterTab = 'all' | 'unread' | 'squads';
export type SocialGraphZoneFilter = 'ALL' | 'CABO SAN LUCAS' | 'CORREDOR TURÍSTICO' | 'SAN JOSÉ DEL CABO' | 'LA PAZ';
export interface IUnifiedMessengerRow {
  id: string; kind: 'dm' | 'squad'; title: string; subtitlePreview: string; avatarUrl: string | null;
  lastActivityMs: number; unreadCount: number; isOfficialKinetic: boolean;
  peerId?: string; peerName?: string; dmCode?: string; rawThread?: IDirectMessageThread; rawSquad?: any; memberCount?: number;
}
export interface ISocialGraphSuggestion {
  athlete: any; id: string; nombre: string; avatarUrl: string | null; score: number; reasonLabel: string; zone: SocialGraphZoneFilter | 'LOS CABOS';
}
const PROTO_POISON = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);
const hasOwn = (obj: unknown, k: string): boolean => Boolean(obj && typeof obj === 'object' && !PROTO_POISON.has(k) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, k));

export const expandSocialIdSet = (set?: ReadonlySet<string> | Iterable<string> | null): Set<string> => {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  if (!set) return out;
  for (const raw of set) {
    const low = String(raw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (low && !PROTO_POISON.has(low)) { out.add(low); out.add(low.replace(/-/g, '')); }
  }
  return out;
};
export const isSocialIdMatched = (set: Set<string>, id?: string | null): boolean => {
  const low = String(id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!low) return false;
  if (PROTO_POISON.has(low)) return true;
  return set.has(low) || set.has(low.replace(/-/g, ''));
};
const expandIdSet = expandSocialIdSet;
const isInIdSet = isSocialIdMatched;
const parseSafeMs = (raw: unknown): number => {
  if (typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw) && raw > 0) return raw;
  const p = Date.parse(String(raw || '').trim());
  return Number.isFinite(p) && p > 0 ? p : 0;
};
const lookupSeen = (seenMap: Record<string, number> | undefined | null, k1: string, k2: string): number | null => {
  if (!seenMap || typeof seenMap !== 'object') return null;
  if (hasOwn(seenMap, k1)) return Math.max(0, Math.trunc(Number(seenMap[k1]) || 0));
  return hasOwn(seenMap, k2) ? Math.max(0, Math.trunc(Number(seenMap[k2]) || 0)) : null;
};

const LOS_CABOS_CENTER = { lat: 22.976, lng: -109.807 };
const MAX_SUGGESTION_RADIUS_KM = 40;

const haversineKm = (lat1: number, lng1: number, lat2: number, lng2: number): number => {
  const toRad = (deg: number) => (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLat = toRad(lat2 - lat1);
  const dLng = toRad(lng2 - lng1);
  const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos(toRad(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRad(lat2)) * Math.sin(dLng / 2) ** 2;
  return 6371 * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
};

export function resolveExtendedSocialZone(rawLocation?: string | null, fallbackVenue?: string | null): SocialGraphZoneFilter | 'LOS CABOS' {
  const c = `${rawLocation || ''} ${fallbackVenue || ''}`.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  if (c.includes('la paz') || c.includes('malecon la paz')) return 'LA PAZ';
  const b = resolveLosCabosZona(rawLocation, fallbackVenue);
  return b === 'Cabo San Lucas' ? 'CABO SAN LUCAS' : b === 'Corredor Turístico' ? 'CORREDOR TURÍSTICO' : b === 'San José del Cabo' ? 'SAN JOSÉ DEL CABO' : 'LOS CABOS';
}

const resolveMyDmRole = (dm: IDirectMessageThread, myUid: string, myName: string): { ok: boolean; iAmReq: boolean } => {
  const dmCode = String(dm?.dmCode || dm?.threadId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const reqId = String(dm?.requesterId || '').trim().toLowerCase(), tgtId = String(dm?.targetId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!dmCode || PROTO_POISON.has(dmCode) || (reqId && tgtId && reqId === tgtId)) return { ok: false, iAmReq: false };
  if (myUid && (reqId || tgtId)) return reqId === myUid ? { ok: true, iAmReq: true } : tgtId === myUid ? { ok: true, iAmReq: false } : { ok: false, iAmReq: false };
  if (myUid || myName) {
    if (matchesUserIdentity(myUid, myName, dm.requesterId, dm.requesterName)) return { ok: true, iAmReq: true };
    if (matchesUserIdentity(myUid, myName, dm.targetId, dm.targetName)) return { ok: true, iAmReq: false };
    return { ok: false, iAmReq: false };
  }
  return { ok: true, iAmReq: true };
};

export function buildUnifiedMessengerStream(params: {
  dmThreads?: IDirectMessageThread[] | null; misEquipos?: any[] | null;
  squadRoomsMessagesMap?: Record<string, any[]> | null; seenCountsMap?: Record<string, number> | null;
  blockedIdsSet?: ReadonlySet<string> | Iterable<string> | null; restrictedIdsSet?: ReadonlySet<string> | Iterable<string> | null;
  myUserId?: string | null; myUserName?: string | null; filterTab?: MessengerFilterTab; searchQuery?: string | null; lang?: 'es' | 'en';
}): IUnifiedMessengerRow[] {
  const isEn = params.lang === 'en', myUid = String(params.myUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const myName = String(params.myUserName || '').trim();
  const blocked = expandIdSet(params.blockedIdsSet), restricted = expandIdSet(params.restrictedIdsSet);
  const byRowId = new Map<string, IUnifiedMessengerRow>();

  for (const dm of params.dmThreads || []) {
    const dmCode = String(dm?.dmCode || dm?.threadId || '').trim();
    const { ok, iAmReq } = resolveMyDmRole(dm, myUid, myName);
    if (!ok) continue;

    const peerIdRaw = String((iAmReq ? dm.targetId : dm.requesterId) || '').trim(), peerIdLow = peerIdRaw.toLowerCase();
    const peerName = String((iAmReq ? dm.targetName : dm.requesterName) || '').trim();
    if ((!peerIdLow && !peerName) || (myUid && peerIdLow === myUid) || isInIdSet(blocked, peerIdLow) || isInIdSet(restricted, peerIdLow)) continue;
    if (dm.status === 'pending' && !iAmReq) continue;

    const msgs = Array.isArray(dm.messages) ? dm.messages : [];
    const lastMsg = msgs.length > 0 ? msgs[msgs.length - 1] : null;
    const lastActivityMs = parseSafeMs(lastMsg?.createdAt) || parseSafeMs(dm.updatedAt);
    if ((msgs.length === 0 && dm.status !== 'accepted') || (msgs.length === 0 && lastActivityMs <= 0)) continue;

    const rowId = isUuid(peerIdLow) ? `dm:peer:${peerIdLow}` : `dm:${dmCode.toLowerCase()}`;
    const seenVal = lookupSeen(params.seenCountsMap, rowId, dmCode);
    const unreadCount = seenVal !== null ? Math.max(0, msgs.length - seenVal) : msgs.filter((m) => !myUid || String(m?.senderId || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== myUid).length;
    const isOfficial = isMasterAdminChatIdentity({ id: peerIdLow, name: peerName });
    const displayTitle = isOfficial ? (isEn ? 'Kinetic Official' : 'Kinetic Oficial') : peerName || (isEn ? 'Kinetic Athlete' : 'Atleta Kinetic');
    const preview = String(lastMsg?.text || '').trim() || (isEn ? 'Direct conversation active' : 'Conversación directa activa');
    const row: IUnifiedMessengerRow = {
      id: rowId, kind: 'dm', title: displayTitle, subtitlePreview: preview, avatarUrl: (iAmReq ? dm.targetAvatar : dm.requesterAvatar) || null,
      lastActivityMs, unreadCount, isOfficialKinetic: isOfficial, peerId: peerIdRaw, peerName: displayTitle, dmCode, rawThread: dm,
    };
    const prev = byRowId.get(rowId);
    if (!prev || row.lastActivityMs >= prev.lastActivityMs) byRowId.set(rowId, row);
  }

  for (const sq of params.misEquipos || []) {
    const sqId = String(sq?.id || '').trim();
    const sqName = String(sq?.nombre || '').trim();
    if (!sqId || !sqName || PROTO_POISON.has(sqId.toLowerCase()) || isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow(sq)) continue;

    const rawMsgs = params.squadRoomsMessagesMap && hasOwn(params.squadRoomsMessagesMap, sqId) && Array.isArray(params.squadRoomsMessagesMap[sqId])
      ? params.squadRoomsMessagesMap[sqId] : [];
    const roomMsgs = rawMsgs.filter((m: any) => !isInIdSet(blocked, m?.usuario_id || m?.senderId));
    const hasAnchor = Boolean(
      roomMsgs.length > 0 || sq?.codigo_invitacion || sq?.creador_id || sq?.created_at || sq?.updated_at ||
      (Array.isArray(sq?.integrantes_nombres) && sq.integrantes_nombres.length > 0)
    );
    if (!hasAnchor) continue;

    const lastRoomMsg = roomMsgs.length > 0 ? roomMsgs[roomMsgs.length - 1] : null;
    const lastActivityMs = parseSafeMs(lastRoomMsg?.created_at || lastRoomMsg?.createdAt) || parseSafeMs(sq?.updated_at || sq?.created_at) || 1;
    const rowId = `sq:${sqId.toLowerCase()}`;
    const seenVal = lookupSeen(params.seenCountsMap, rowId, sqId);
    const unreadCount = seenVal !== null ? Math.max(0, roomMsgs.length - seenVal)
      : roomMsgs.filter((m: any) => !myUid || String(m?.usuario_id || m?.senderId || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== myUid).length;

    const memberCount = Array.isArray(sq?.integrantes_nombres) ? Math.max(1, sq.integrantes_nombres.length) : 1;
    const lastAuthor = String(lastRoomMsg?.usuario_nombre || lastRoomMsg?.senderName || '').trim();
    const lastTxt = String(lastRoomMsg?.mensaje || lastRoomMsg?.contenido || lastRoomMsg?.text || '').trim();
    const subtitlePreview = lastTxt
      ? `${lastAuthor ? `${lastAuthor.split(' ')[0]}: ` : ''}${lastTxt}`
      : isEn ? `Team • ${memberCount} athletes` : `Equipo • ${memberCount} atletas`;

    const row: IUnifiedMessengerRow = {
      id: rowId, kind: 'squad', title: sqName, subtitlePreview, avatarUrl: sq?.avatar_url || null,
      lastActivityMs, unreadCount, isOfficialKinetic: false, rawSquad: sq, memberCount,
    };
    const prev = byRowId.get(rowId);
    if (!prev || row.lastActivityMs >= prev.lastActivityMs) byRowId.set(rowId, row);
  }

  const ordered = Array.from(byRowId.values()).sort((a, b) => b.lastActivityMs - a.lastActivityMs || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  const tab = params.filterTab || 'all';
  const q = String(params.searchQuery || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return ordered.filter((r) => {
    if (tab === 'unread' && r.unreadCount <= 0) return false;
    if (tab === 'squads' && r.kind !== 'squad') return false;
    return !q || `${r.title} ${r.subtitlePreview} ${r.dmCode || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });
}

export function extractMessengerRequestsAndRestricted(params: {
  dmThreads?: IDirectMessageThread[] | null; solicitudesEquipoPendientes?: any[] | null;
  blockedIdsSet?: ReadonlySet<string> | Iterable<string> | null; restrictedIdsSet?: ReadonlySet<string> | Iterable<string> | null;
  myUserId?: string | null; myUserName?: string | null;
}) {
  const myUid = String(params.myUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const myName = String(params.myUserName || '').trim();
  const blocked = expandIdSet(params.blockedIdsSet);
  const restricted = expandIdSet(params.restrictedIdsSet);
  const incomingPendingDms: IDirectMessageThread[] = [];
  const restrictedThreads: IDirectMessageThread[] = [];

  for (const dm of params.dmThreads || []) {
    const { ok, iAmReq } = resolveMyDmRole(dm, myUid, myName);
    if (!ok) continue;
    const peerId = String((iAmReq ? dm.targetId : dm.requesterId) || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const peerName = String((iAmReq ? dm.targetName : dm.requesterName) || '').trim();
    if ((!peerId && !peerName) || (myUid && peerId === myUid) || isInIdSet(blocked, peerId)) continue;
    if (isInIdSet(restricted, peerId)) { restrictedThreads.push(dm); continue; }
    if (dm.status === 'pending' && !iAmReq) incomingPendingDms.push(dm);
  }

  const validSquadInvites = (params.solicitudesEquipoPendientes || []).filter(
    (inv: any) => !isInIdSet(blocked, inv?.creador_id || inv?.inviter_id || inv?.usuario_id)
  );
  return { incomingPendingDms, restrictedThreads, validSquadInvites, totalRequestsBadge: incomingPendingDms.length + validSquadInvites.length };
}

export function computeSocialGraphSuggestions(params: {
  athletes?: any[] | null; misEquipos?: any[] | null; dmThreads?: IDirectMessageThread[] | null;
  blockedIdsSet?: ReadonlySet<string> | Iterable<string> | null; restrictedIdsSet?: ReadonlySet<string> | Iterable<string> | null;
  myUserId?: string | null; myUserName?: string | null; myEmail?: string | null; myVenue?: string | null; myDiscipline?: string | null;
  myLat?: number | null; myLng?: number | null; zoneFilter?: SocialGraphZoneFilter; lang?: 'es' | 'en'; limit?: number;
}): ISocialGraphSuggestion[] {
  const isEn = params.lang === 'en';
  const myUid = String(params.myUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const myName = String(params.myUserName || '').trim();
  const blocked = expandIdSet(params.blockedIdsSet);
  const restricted = expandIdSet(params.restrictedIdsSet);
  const squadmateKeys = new Set<string>();
  const mySquadNames = new Set<string>();
  for (const sq of params.misEquipos || []) {
    const s = normalizeChatIdentity(sq?.nombre); if (s) mySquadNames.add(s);
    if (sq?.creador_id) squadmateKeys.add(String(sq.creador_id).trim().toLowerCase());
    if (Array.isArray(sq?.integrantes_ids)) sq.integrantes_ids.forEach((id: any) => squadmateKeys.add(String(id || '').trim().toLowerCase()));
    if (Array.isArray(sq?.integrantes_nombres)) sq.integrantes_nombres.forEach((nm: any) => squadmateKeys.add(normalizeChatIdentity(nm)));
  }
  const peerIds = new Set<string>();
  const peerNames = new Set<string>();
  for (const dm of params.dmThreads || []) {
    const role = resolveMyDmRole(dm, myUid, myName);
    const pId = role.ok ? (role.iAmReq ? dm?.targetId : dm?.requesterId) : (String(dm?.requesterId || '').trim().toLowerCase() === myUid ? dm?.targetId : dm?.requesterId);
    const pNm = role.ok ? (role.iAmReq ? dm?.targetName : dm?.requesterName) : (String(dm?.requesterId || '').trim().toLowerCase() === myUid ? dm?.targetName : dm?.requesterName);
    if (pId) peerIds.add(String(pId).trim().toLowerCase());
    const pSlug = normalizeChatIdentity(pNm);
    if (!isUuid(String(pId || '')) && pSlug) peerNames.add(pSlug);
  }
  const deduped = deduplicateCanonicalAthletes(params.athletes || [], params.myUserId);
  const secondDegSquads = new Set<string>();
  for (const a of deduped) {
    const aid = String(a?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const aSq = normalizeChatIdentity(a?.escuadron || a?.equipo_nombre);
    if (aSq && (squadmateKeys.has(aid) || squadmateKeys.has(normalizeChatIdentity(a?.nombre)) || peerIds.has(aid))) secondDegSquads.add(aSq);
  }

  const myVenueNorm = normalizeChatIdentity(params.myVenue);
  const myDiscNorm = normalizeChatIdentity(params.myDiscipline);
  const myZone = resolveExtendedSocialZone(params.myVenue, params.myVenue);
  const zoneTarget = params.zoneFilter || 'ALL';
  const refLat = Number.isFinite(Number(params.myLat)) ? Number(params.myLat) : LOS_CABOS_CENTER.lat;
  const refLng = Number.isFinite(Number(params.myLng)) ? Number(params.myLng) : LOS_CABOS_CENTER.lng;
  const out: ISocialGraphSuggestion[] = [];

  for (const a of deduped) {
    if (!a || a.radar_publico === false) continue;
    const aid = String(a?.id || '').trim();
    const aidLow = aid.toLowerCase();
    const nSlug = normalizeChatIdentity(a?.nombre);
    if (!aidLow || aidLow === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID || PROTO_POISON.has(aidLow) || (myUid && aidLow === myUid)) continue;
    if (peerIds.has(aidLow) || (nSlug && peerNames.has(nSlug))) continue;
    if (isInIdSet(blocked, aidLow) || isInIdSet(restricted, aidLow)) continue;
    if (isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete(a, params.myUserId, params.myEmail, params.myUserName, blocked)) continue;

    const aZone = resolveExtendedSocialZone(a?.zona || a?.ubicacion, a?.gimnasio || a?.sede);
    if (zoneTarget !== 'ALL' && aZone !== zoneTarget) continue;
    if (zoneTarget === 'ALL' && aZone === 'LA PAZ' && myZone !== 'LA PAZ') continue;

    const rawDist = Number(a?.distancia_km ?? a?.distance_km ?? a?.distanceKm);
    if (Number.isFinite(rawDist) && rawDist > MAX_SUGGESTION_RADIUS_KM) continue;
    const aLat = Number(a?.lat ?? a?.latitud);
    const aLng = Number(a?.lng ?? a?.longitud);
    if (Number.isFinite(aLat) && Number.isFinite(aLng) && Math.abs(aLat) > 1 && Math.abs(aLng) > 1) {
      if (haversineKm(refLat, refLng, aLat, aLng) > MAX_SUGGESTION_RADIUS_KM) continue;
    }

    const aSq = normalizeChatIdentity(a?.escuadron || a?.equipo_nombre);
    const inSquad = squadmateKeys.has(aidLow) || (Boolean(nSlug) && squadmateKeys.has(nSlug)) || (Boolean(aSq) && mySquadNames.has(aSq));
    const inSecond = !inSquad && Boolean(aSq) && secondDegSquads.has(aSq);
    const sameVenue = Boolean(myVenueNorm && myVenueNorm !== 'kineticoficial' && normalizeChatIdentity(a?.gimnasio || a?.sede) === myVenueNorm);
    const sameDisc = Boolean(myDiscNorm && normalizeChatIdentity(a?.disciplina) === myDiscNorm);
    const streak = Math.max(0, Number(a?.racha ?? a?.racha_dias ?? 0));

    let score = 0;
    let reasonLabel = isEn ? 'Active in Kinetic' : 'Activo en Kinetic';
    if (inSquad) { score += 50; reasonLabel = isEn ? 'In your team' : 'En tu equipo'; }
    else if (inSecond) { score += 25; reasonLabel = isEn ? 'Mutual team connection' : 'Conexión en común'; }
    if (sameVenue || sameDisc) {
      score += 15;
      if (!inSquad && !inSecond) reasonLabel = sameVenue ? (isEn ? 'Trains at your venue' : 'Entrena en tu misma sede') : (isEn ? 'Same discipline' : 'Misma disciplina');
    }
    if (streak > 0) { score += 5; if (score === 5) reasonLabel = isEn ? 'Active streak' : 'En racha activa'; }

    out.push({
      athlete: a, id: aid, nombre: String(a?.nombre || (isEn ? 'Kinetic Athlete' : 'Atleta Kinetic')).trim(),
      avatarUrl: a?.avatar_url || a?.foto_url || null, score, reasonLabel, zone: aZone,
    });
  }
  return out
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || Number(b.athlete?.racha || 0) - Number(a.athlete?.racha || 0) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
    .slice(0, Math.max(1, params.limit || 24));
}
