import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

const _stableTeamMembersRegistry = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
let _onSquadsCacheInvalidate: (() => void) | null = null;
const _squadsDataListeners = new Set<() => void>();
let _pendingSquadEditId: string | null = null;

export const LEADER_LIMIT_MSG_ES =
  'Ya eres líder de un equipo. Necesitas dejar o eliminar ese equipo para poder ser líder de otro.';
export const LEADER_LIMIT_MSG_EN =
  'You are already the leader of a team. You must leave or delete that team before leading another one.';

export function subscribeSquadsDataChanged(listener: () => void): () => void {
  _squadsDataListeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    _squadsDataListeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

export function emitSquadsDataChanged(): void {
  _onSquadsCacheInvalidate?.();
  _squadsDataListeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try {
      fn();
    } catch {}
  });
}

export function markPendingSquadEditId(squadId: string | null): void {
  _pendingSquadEditId = squadId ? String(squadId).trim() : null;
}

export function consumePendingSquadEditId(): string | null {
  const val = _pendingSquadEditId;
  _pendingSquadEditId = null;
  return val;
}

interface ISquadDetRow {
  id?: string | null;
  codigo_invitacion?: string | null;
  code?: string | null;
  disciplina?: string | null;
  nombre?: string | null;
  name?: string | null;
  creador_nombre?: string | null;
  creador_id?: string | null;
  lider_id?: string | null;
  esLider?: boolean;
  rol_equipo?: string | null;
}

interface ISquadMemberDetRow {
  nombre?: string | null;
  usuario_nombre?: string | null;
  name?: string | null;
  id?: string | null;
}

export function isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow(row?: ISquadDetRow | null): boolean {
  if (!row) return true;
  const code = String(row.codigo_invitacion || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const disc = String(row.disciplina || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  return (
    code.startsWith('DM-') ||
    code === 'STORIES-V25' ||
    disc === 'DM_1A1' ||
    disc === 'STORIES_24H'
  );
}

export function isUserSquadLeader(squad?: ISquadDetRow | null, userId?: string | null): boolean {
  if (!squad) return false;
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (squad.esLider === true) return true;
  if (String(squad.rol_equipo || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'lider') return true;
  if (!uid) return false;
  return (
    String(squad.creador_id || '').trim() === uid ||
    String(squad.lider_id || '').trim() === uid
  );
}

export function clearStableSquadRegistry(ownerKey?: string | null): void {
  const oKey = normalizeAthleteIdentityKey(ownerKey) || 'default_owner';
  _stableTeamMembersRegistry.delete(oKey);
}

export async function checkUserAlreadyLeadsSquad(
  userId?: string | null,
  localSquads?: ISquadDetRow[] | null,
  excludeSquadId?: string | null
): Promise<{ isLeader: boolean; existingSquadId?: string }> {
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  const excl = excludeSquadId ? String(excludeSquadId).trim() : '';

  if (Array.isArray(localSquads)) {
    const localFound = localSquads.find((sq) => {
      if (!sq || isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow(sq)) return false;
      const sqId = String(sq.id || '').trim();
      if (excl && sqId === excl) return false;
      return isUserSquadLeader(sq, uid);
    });
    if (localFound?.id) {
      return { isLeader: true, existingSquadId: String(localFound.id) };
    }
  }

  if (!uid || uid === 'anon' || uid === 'admin') {
    return { isLeader: false };
  }

  try {
    const [ownedRes, memberRes] = await Promise.all([
      supabase
        .from('equipos_kinetic')
        .select('id, codigo_invitacion, disciplina')
        .eq('creador_id', uid),
      supabase
        .from('equipo_miembros')
        .select('id, equipo_id, rol_equipo, estado')
        .eq('usuario_id', uid)
        .eq('rol_equipo', 'lider'),
    ]);

    const validOwned = (Array.isArray(ownedRes.data) ? ownedRes.data : []).find((r) => {
      if (isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow(r)) return false;
      return !excl || String(r.id) !== excl;
    });
    if (validOwned?.id) {
      return { isLeader: true, existingSquadId: String(validOwned.id) };
    }

    const candidateTeamIds = (Array.isArray(memberRes.data) ? memberRes.data : [])
      .filter((m) => String(m.estado || '').toLowerCase() !== 'rechazado')
      .map((m) => String(m.equipo_id || '').trim())
      .filter((id) => Boolean(id) && (!excl || id !== excl));

    if (candidateTeamIds.length > 0) {
      const { data: realTeams } = await supabase
        .from('equipos_kinetic')
        .select('id, codigo_invitacion, disciplina')
        .in('id', candidateTeamIds);
      const validMemberLed = (Array.isArray(realTeams) ? realTeams : []).find(
        (t) => !isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow(t)
      );
      if (validMemberLed?.id) {
        return { isLeader: true, existingSquadId: String(validMemberLed.id) };
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  return { isLeader: false };
}

export function setSquadsDeterministicCacheInvalidator(fn: () => void): void {
  _onSquadsCacheInvalidate = fn;
}

export function triggerSquadsDeterministicCacheInvalidation(): void {
  _onSquadsCacheInvalidate?.();
}

export function normalizeAthleteIdentityKey(rawNameOrId?: string | null): string {
  return String(rawNameOrId || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')
    .trim();
}

export function resolveCanonicalSquadChannelKey(squadOrId?: string | ISquadDetRow | null): string {
  if (!squadOrId) return 'squad_kinetic_oficial';
  const rawName =
    typeof squadOrId === 'string'
      ? squadOrId
      : String(
          squadOrId?.nombre ||
            squadOrId?.name ||
            squadOrId?.creador_nombre ||
            squadOrId?.id ||
            ''
        );
  const lower = rawName
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .trim();
  // canonical squad channel resolution
  // institutional squad fallback
  if (lower.includes('kinetic') || lower.includes('oficial')) {
    return 'squad_channel_kinetic_oficial';
  }
  const code =
    typeof squadOrId === 'object'
      ? String(squadOrId?.codigo_invitacion || squadOrId?.code || '')
      : '';
  if (code.trim().length > 3) return 'squad_channel_' + code.trim().toLowerCase();
  return 'squad_channel_' + (lower.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_') || 'general');
}

export function registerStableSquadMember(
  ownerKey: string,
  memberNameOrId: string
): void {
  const oKey = normalizeAthleteIdentityKey(ownerKey) || 'default_owner';
  const mKey = normalizeAthleteIdentityKey(memberNameOrId);
  if (!mKey) return;
  if (!_stableTeamMembersRegistry.has(oKey)) {
    _stableTeamMembersRegistry.set(oKey, new Set<string>());
  }
  _stableTeamMembersRegistry.get(oKey)!.add(mKey);
}

export function isAthleteInPrimarySquadStable(
  ownerKey: string | undefined | null,
  athleteNameOrId: string | undefined | null,
  currentSquadMembers?: Array<string | ISquadMemberDetRow> | null
): boolean {
  const oKey = normalizeAthleteIdentityKey(ownerKey) || 'default_owner';
  const targetKey = normalizeAthleteIdentityKey(athleteNameOrId);
  if (!targetKey) return false;

  if (Array.isArray(currentSquadMembers)) {
    for (const m of currentSquadMembers) {
      const mName =
        typeof m === 'string'
          ? m
          : m?.nombre || m?.usuario_nombre || m?.name || m?.id || '';
      const mKey = normalizeAthleteIdentityKey(mName);
      if (mKey) {
        registerStableSquadMember(oKey, mKey);
      }
    }
  }
  return _stableTeamMembersRegistry.get(oKey)?.has(targetKey) || false;
}

export async function acceptSquadInvitationInCloud(
  equipoId: string,
  userId?: string,
  userName?: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    if (userName) registerStableSquadMember(equipoId, userName);
    if (equipoId && !equipoId.startsWith('local_')) {
      if (userId && userId.length > 10) {
        await supabase
          .from('equipo_miembros')
          .update({ estado: 'activo' })
          .eq('equipo_id', equipoId)
          .eq('usuario_id', userId);
      } else if (userName) {
        await supabase
          .from('equipo_miembros')
          .update({ estado: 'activo' })
          .eq('equipo_id', equipoId)
          .ilike('usuario_nombre', '%' + userName.trim() + '%');
      }
    }
    _onSquadsCacheInvalidate?.();
    return true;
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}

const VALID_UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const UNIFIED_SQUADS_CACHE_TTL_MS = 2000;
interface UnifiedSquadsSnapshot {
  hasConfigured: boolean;
  activeSquad: IEquipoKinetic;
  allUserSquads: IEquipoKinetic[];
  pendingInvites: IMiembroEquipo[];
  sentPendingNames: string[];
  messages: IMensajeEquipo[];
}
let _unifiedSquadsEpoch = 0;
const _unifiedSquadsCacheMap = new Map<string, { ts: number; epoch: number; val: UnifiedSquadsSnapshot }>();
const _unifiedSquadsInflightMap = new Map<string, Promise<UnifiedSquadsSnapshot>>();

export function invalidateUnifiedSquadsCache(): void {
  _unifiedSquadsEpoch += 1;
  _unifiedSquadsCacheMap.clear();
  invalidateRealtimeChatBridgeCache();
}

setSquadsDeterministicCacheInvalidator(invalidateUnifiedSquadsCache);

export async function fetchPublicSquadLeaderboardProfiles(
  limit = PAGE_SIZE * 4,
  currentUserId?: string | null,
  pageIndex = 0
): Promise<any[]> {
  const uid = String(currentUserId || '').trim();
  const safeLimit = Math.max(1, limit);
  const from = Math.max(0, pageIndex) * safeLimit;
  const to = from + safeLimit - 1;
  const finalizeRows = (rows: any[]) => {
    const publicOnly = rows.filter(
      (p: any) =>
        (p?.radar_publico !== false || (uid && String(p?.id || '') === uid)) &&
        !isUserBlockedUgc(p?.id)
    );
    return deduplicateCanonicalAthletes(publicOnly, uid);
  };

  const pubRes = await supabase
    .from('perfiles_publicos')
    .select('id, nombre, avatar_url, nivel, xp_total, racha_dias, radar_publico')
    .or('radar_publico.is.null,radar_publico.eq.true')
    .order('xp_total', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false })
    .range(from, to);
  if (!pubRes.error && Array.isArray(pubRes.data)) {
    return finalizeRows(pubRes.data);
  }
  const fallbackRes = await supabase
    .from('perfiles')
    .select('id, nombre, avatar_url, nivel, xp_total, racha_dias, radar_publico, rol')
    .or('radar_publico.is.null,radar_publico.eq.true')
    .order('xp_total', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false })
    .range(from, to);
  return Array.isArray(fallbackRes.data) ? finalizeRows(fallbackRes.data) : [];
}

export const GLOBAL_SHARED_SQUADS_KEY = '@kinetic_shared_squads_v3';
export const GLOBAL_SHARED_MESSAGES_KEY = '@kinetic_shared_squad_msgs_v3';
export const GLOBAL_SHARED_INVITES_KEY = '@kinetic_shared_squad_invites_v3';

const normalizeText = (v?: string | null): string =>
  String(v || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

export const persistSharedSquadRecord = async (
  squad?: IEquipoKinetic | null, newMessage?: IMensajeEquipo | null, newInvite?: any | null
): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    if (squad?.id) {
      const rawSq = await AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_SQUADS_KEY);
      const mapSq: Record<string, any> = rawSq ? JSON.parse(rawSq) : {};
      mapSq[String(squad.id)] = squad;
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_SQUADS_KEY, JSON.stringify(mapSq));
    }
    if (newMessage?.equipo_id) {
      const eqId = String(newMessage.equipo_id);
      const rawMsg = await AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_MESSAGES_KEY);
      const mapMsg: Record<string, IMensajeEquipo[]> = rawMsg ? JSON.parse(rawMsg) : {};
      const currentList = Array.isArray(mapMsg[eqId]) ? mapMsg[eqId] : [];
      if (!currentList.some((m) => String(m.id) === String(newMessage.id))) {
        mapMsg[eqId] = [...currentList, newMessage].slice(-100);
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_MESSAGES_KEY, JSON.stringify(mapMsg));
      }
    }
    if (newInvite?.id) {
      const rawInv = await AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_INVITES_KEY);
      const listInv: any[] = rawInv ? JSON.parse(rawInv) : [];
      const filtered = listInv.filter((i) => String(i.id) !== String(newInvite.id));
      filtered.unshift(newInvite);
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_INVITES_KEY, JSON.stringify(filtered.slice(0, 80)));
    }
  } catch {}
  invalidateUnifiedSquadsCache();
};

export async function deleteSquadAndMessages(equipoId: string, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const ok = await deleteSquadCloud(equipoId, userId);
  invalidateUnifiedSquadsCache();
  return ok;
}

export async function leaveSquadAndClean(
  equipoId: string,
  userId: string,
  userName?: string | null
): Promise<boolean> {
  const ok = await leaveSquadCloud(equipoId, userId, userName);
  invalidateUnifiedSquadsCache();
  return ok;
}

export const fetchSquadMessagesForTeam = async (
  equipoId: string,
  fallbackLeaderName = td('Kinetic Oficial', 'Kinetic Official'),
  fallbackSquadName = td('Equipo Kinetic', 'Kinetic Team'),
  squadObj?: IEquipoKinetic | null
): Promise<IMensajeEquipo[]> => {
  if (!equipoId) return [];
  const mergedMap = new Map<string, IMensajeEquipo>();

  try {
    const rawMsg = await AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_MESSAGES_KEY);
    if (rawMsg) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawMsg);
      const localList: IMensajeEquipo[] = Array.isArray(parsed?.[equipoId])
        ? parsed[equipoId]
        : [];
      localList.forEach((m) => {
        if (m && m.id) mergedMap.set(String(m.id), m);
      });
    }
  } catch {}

  try {
    const targetSq: IEquipoKinetic =
      squadObj ||
      ({
        id: equipoId,
        nombre: fallbackSquadName,
        creador_nombre: fallbackLeaderName,
      } as any);
    const cloudMap = await fetchAllCloudSquadMessages([targetSq]);
    (cloudMap[String(equipoId)] || []).forEach((m) => {
      if (m && m.id) mergedMap.set(String(m.id), m);
    });
  } catch {}

  const finalMessages = Array.from(mergedMap.values()).sort(
    (a, b) =>
      String(a.created_at || '').localeCompare(String(b.created_at || '')) ||
      String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id))
  );

  if (finalMessages.length === 0) {
    return [
      {
        id: `welcome_${equipoId}`,
        equipo_id: equipoId,
        usuario_id: 'system',
        usuario_nombre: fallbackLeaderName,
        mensaje: td(
          `⚡ Canal táctico activo para ${fallbackSquadName}. Coordina aquí tus entrenamientos grupales.`,
          `⚡ Tactical channel active for ${fallbackSquadName}. Coordinate your group workouts here.`
        ),
        created_at: (squadObj as any)?.created_at || '2026-01-01T08:00:00.000Z',
      },
    ];
  }

  return finalMessages;
};

export const loadUnifiedSquadsAndMessages = async (
  userId: string,
  userName: string
): Promise<UnifiedSquadsSnapshot> => {
  const cacheKey = `${String(userId || 'anon')}|${normalizeText(userName)}`;
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  const cachedEntry = _unifiedSquadsCacheMap.get(cacheKey);
  if (cachedEntry && cachedEntry.epoch === _unifiedSquadsEpoch && nowMs - cachedEntry.ts < UNIFIED_SQUADS_CACHE_TTL_MS) {
    return cachedEntry.val;
  }
  const existingInflight = _unifiedSquadsInflightMap.get(cacheKey);
  if (existingInflight) return existingInflight;
  const reqEpoch = _unifiedSquadsEpoch;
  const pendingPromise: Promise<UnifiedSquadsSnapshot> = (async () => {
    try {
      const uid = String(userId || 'anon');
      const hasValidUid = VALID_UUID_RE.test(uid);
      const cleanMyName = String(userName || td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')).trim();
      const myNameLower = normalizeText(cleanMyName);
      const defaultCode = `EQ-${uid.replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 6).toUpperCase()}`;

      let localSquadsMap: Record<string, any> = {};
      let localInvitesList: any[] = [];

      try {
        const [rawSq, rawInv] = await Promise.all([
          AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_SQUADS_KEY),
          AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_INVITES_KEY),
        ]);
        if (rawSq) localSquadsMap = JSON.parse(rawSq) || {};
        if (rawInv) localInvitesList = JSON.parse(rawInv) || [];
      } catch {}

      const squadsById = new Map<string, IEquipoKinetic>();
      const pendingInvitesMap = new Map<string, IMiembroEquipo>();
      const sentPendingNamesSet = new Set<string>();

      let dbQueryFailed = false;
      try {
        const SQUAD_COLS = 'id, nombre, creador_id, creador_nombre, disciplina, cupo_maximo, codigo_invitacion, created_at';
        const MEMBER_COLS = 'id, equipo_id, usuario_id, usuario_nombre, rol_equipo, estado, invitado_por_id, invitado_por_nombre';
        const emptyRes = { data: [] as Record<string, unknown>[], error: null as Error | null };
        const [ownedReq, myUidReq] = hasValidUid
          ? await Promise.all([
              supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select(SQUAD_COLS).eq('creador_id', uid),
              supabase.from('equipo_miembros').select(MEMBER_COLS).eq('usuario_id', uid),
            ])
          : [emptyRes, emptyRes];
        if (ownedReq.error) dbQueryFailed = true;

        const myMemberRowsMap = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
        (myUidReq.data || []).forEach((r: Record<string, unknown>) => {
          if (r?.id) myMemberRowsMap.set(String(r.id), r);
        });
        const myMemberRows = Array.from(myMemberRowsMap.values());

        const relatedTeamIds = new Set<string>();
        (ownedReq.data || []).forEach((eq: any) => {
          if (eq?.id) relatedTeamIds.add(String(eq.id));
        });
        myMemberRows.forEach((m: any) => {
          if (m?.equipo_id) relatedTeamIds.add(String(m.equipo_id));
        });

        const allTeamsMap = new Map<string, any>();
        (ownedReq.data || []).forEach((eq: any) => {
          allTeamsMap.set(String(eq.id), eq);
        });

        const dbTeamIds = Array.from(relatedTeamIds).filter((id) => !id.startsWith('sq_') && !id.startsWith('local_'));
        const missingTeamIds = dbTeamIds.filter((id) => !allTeamsMap.has(id));
        const [extraTeamsReq, teamMembersReq] = await Promise.all([
          missingTeamIds.length > 0
            ? supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select(SQUAD_COLS).in('id', missingTeamIds)
            : Promise.resolve({ data: [] as any[] }),
          dbTeamIds.length > 0
            ? supabase.from('equipo_miembros').select(MEMBER_COLS).in('equipo_id', dbTeamIds)
            : Promise.resolve({ data: [] as any[] }),
        ]);
        (extraTeamsReq.data || []).forEach((eq: any) => {
          allTeamsMap.set(String(eq.id), eq);
        });
        const allMemberRows: any[] = Array.isArray(teamMembersReq.data) ? teamMembersReq.data : [];

        allTeamsMap.forEach((teamRow, teamId) => {
          if (isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow(teamRow)) return;
          const acceptedMembers = allMemberRows.filter((m) => String(m.equipo_id) === teamId && (m.estado === 'aceptado' || m.estado === 'activo' || m.rol_equipo === 'lider'));

          const namesSet = new Set<string>();
          if (teamRow.creador_nombre) namesSet.add(String(teamRow.creador_nombre).trim());
          acceptedMembers.forEach((m) => {
            if (m.usuario_nombre) namesSet.add(String(m.usuario_nombre).trim());
          });
          if (String(teamRow.creador_id) === uid) namesSet.add(cleanMyName);

          const isCreator = hasValidUid && String(teamRow.creador_id) === uid;
          const myAcceptedRow = hasValidUid
            ? acceptedMembers.find((m) => String(m.usuario_id || '') === uid)
            : undefined;
          const isLeader = isCreator || String(myAcceptedRow?.rol_equipo || '').toLowerCase() === 'lider';

          if (isCreator || Boolean(myAcceptedRow)) {
            const rawNames = Array.from(namesSet);
            const leaderLabel = String(teamRow.creador_nombre || cleanMyName).trim();
            const namesArr = [
              ...rawNames.filter((n) => normalizeText(n) === normalizeText(leaderLabel)),
              ...rawNames.filter((n) => normalizeText(n) !== normalizeText(leaderLabel)).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)),
            ];
            squadsById.set(teamId, {
              id: teamId,
              nombre:
                teamRow.nombre ||
                td(
                  `Equipo de ${teamRow.creador_nombre || cleanMyName}`,
                  `${teamRow.creador_nombre || cleanMyName}'s Team`
                ),
              creador_id: String(teamRow.creador_id || uid),
              creador_nombre: teamRow.creador_nombre || cleanMyName,
              disciplina: teamRow.disciplina || 'Fuerza',
              miembros_count: Math.max(1, namesArr.length),
              max_miembros: Number(teamRow.cupo_maximo) || 50,
              codigo_invitacion: teamRow.codigo_invitacion || defaultCode,
              integrantes_nombres: namesArr,
              esLider: isLeader,
              rol_equipo: isLeader ? 'lider' : 'miembro',
              created_at: teamRow.created_at || '2026-01-01T08:00:00.000Z',
            } as any);
          }

          if (isLeader) {
            allMemberRows
              .filter((m) => String(m.equipo_id) === teamId && m.estado === 'pendiente')
              .forEach((m) => {
                if (m.usuario_nombre) {
                  sentPendingNamesSet.add(normalizeText(m.usuario_nombre));
                }
              });
          }
        });

        myMemberRows
          .filter((m) => m.estado === 'pendiente' && String(m.invitado_por_id || '') !== uid)
          .forEach((m) => {
            const teamInfo = allTeamsMap.get(String(m.equipo_id));
            if (teamInfo && isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow(teamInfo)) return;
            const invId = String(m.id);
            const resolvedTeamName = String(
              teamInfo?.nombre ||
                td(
                  `Equipo de ${m.invitado_por_nombre || 'Atleta'}`,
                  `${m.invitado_por_nombre || 'Athlete'}'s Team`
                )
            );
            const inviteRow: IMiembroEquipo = {
              id: invId,
              equipo_id: String(m.equipo_id),
              equipo_nombre: resolvedTeamName,
              usuario_id: uid,
              usuario_nombre: cleanMyName,
              invitado_por_id: m.invitado_por_id ? String(m.invitado_por_id) : undefined,
              invitado_por_nombre: String(
                m.invitado_por_nombre ||
                  teamInfo?.creador_nombre ||
                  td('Capitán Kinetic', 'Kinetic Captain')
              ),
              rol_equipo: 'miembro',
              estado: 'pendiente',
            };
            pendingInvitesMap.set(invId, inviteRow);
          });
      } catch {
        dbQueryFailed = true;
      }

      localInvitesList.forEach((inv: any) => {
        if (!inv || inv.estado !== 'pendiente') return;
        const isForMe =
          (inv.usuario_id && String(inv.usuario_id) === uid) ||
          (myNameLower && normalizeText(inv.usuario_nombre) === myNameLower);
        const isFromMe =
          String(inv.invitado_por_id || '') === uid ||
          (myNameLower && normalizeText(inv.invitado_por_nombre) === myNameLower);

        if (isForMe && !isFromMe) {
          pendingInvitesMap.set(String(inv.id), inv);
        } else if (isFromMe && inv.usuario_nombre) {
          sentPendingNamesSet.add(normalizeText(inv.usuario_nombre));
        }
      });

      if (squadsById.size === 0 && dbQueryFailed) {
        const offlineOwn = Object.values(localSquadsMap).find(
          (s: any) =>
            s &&
            (s.isOfflineCreated === true || String(s.id || '').startsWith('local_')) &&
            !String(s.id || '').startsWith('sq_') &&
            !isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow(s) &&
            String(s.creador_id) === uid
        );
        if (offlineOwn?.id) squadsById.set(String(offlineOwn.id), { ...offlineOwn, esLider: true, rol_equipo: 'lider' });
      }

      const allUserSquads = Array.from(squadsById.values()).sort((a, b) => {
        const aOwn = isUserSquadLeader(a, uid) ? 0 : 1;
        const bOwn = isUserSquadLeader(b, uid) ? 0 : 1;
        if (aOwn !== bOwn) return aOwn - bOwn;
        return String((b as any).created_at || '').localeCompare(String((a as any).created_at || '')) || String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id));
      });
      const multiMemberSquad = allUserSquads.find((s) => (s.integrantes_nombres?.length || 1) > 1);
      const activeSquad = allUserSquads.length > 0 ? (multiMemberSquad || allUserSquads[0]) : (null as any);
      const messages = activeSquad?.id
        ? await fetchSquadMessagesForTeam(String(activeSquad.id), activeSquad.creador_nombre || cleanMyName, activeSquad.nombre, activeSquad)
        : [];

      const resultPayload: UnifiedSquadsSnapshot = {
        hasConfigured: Boolean(allUserSquads.length > 0),
        activeSquad,
        allUserSquads,
        pendingInvites: Array.from(pendingInvitesMap.values()).sort((a, b) => String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id))),
        sentPendingNames: Array.from(sentPendingNamesSet).sort(),
        messages,
      };
      if (reqEpoch === _unifiedSquadsEpoch) {
        _unifiedSquadsCacheMap.set(cacheKey, { ts: Date.now(), epoch: reqEpoch, val: resultPayload });
      }
      return resultPayload;
    } finally {
      _unifiedSquadsInflightMap.delete(cacheKey);
    }
  })();
  _unifiedSquadsInflightMap.set(cacheKey, pendingPromise);
  return pendingPromise;
};

export async function regenerateSquadInviteCode(equipoId: string, userId?: string): Promise<string> {
  const randomSuffix = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase();
  const newCode = 'EQ-' + randomSuffix;
  try {
    if (VALID_UUID_RE.test(String(equipoId || ''))) {
      const uid = userId || (await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user?.id;
      if (uid && VALID_UUID_RE.test(String(uid))) {
        await supabase
          .from('equipos_kinetic')
          .update({ codigo_invitacion: newCode })
          .eq('id', equipoId)
          .eq('creador_id', uid);
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  return newCode;
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { registerSessionCleanupHook } from './kineticSessionPersistence';

export interface IKinetiClubTabAlertSnapshot {
  unseenNotificationsCount: number;
  pendingDmCount: number;
  pendingSquadInvitesCount: number;
  pendingSplitInvitesCount: number;
  hasUnclaimedReadyReward: boolean;
  racha_dias?: number;
}

const INITIAL_ALERT_STATE: IKinetiClubTabAlertSnapshot = {
  unseenNotificationsCount: 0,
  pendingDmCount: 0,
  pendingSquadInvitesCount: 0,
  pendingSplitInvitesCount: 0,
  hasUnclaimedReadyReward: false,
};

const safeNonNegInt = (val: unknown): number => {
  const n = Number(val);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? Math.floor(n) : 0;
};

/**
 * Función pura de verdad única (#89): jamás depende de racha_dias > 0;
 * activa el punto únicamente cuando hay notificaciones no vistas, DMs/invitaciones
 * pendientes reales o una recompensa lista por reclamar.
 */
export function computeHasKinetiClubTabAlert(
  input: Partial<IKinetiClubTabAlertSnapshot> | null | undefined
): boolean {
  if (!input || typeof input !== 'object') return false;
  return (
    safeNonNegInt(input.unseenNotificationsCount) >= 1 ||
    safeNonNegInt(input.pendingDmCount) >= 1 ||
    safeNonNegInt(input.pendingSquadInvitesCount) >= 1 ||
    safeNonNegInt(input.pendingSplitInvitesCount) >= 1 ||
    input.hasUnclaimedReadyReward === true
  );
}

let _ownerUserId: string | null = null;
let _currentState: IKinetiClubTabAlertSnapshot = { ...INITIAL_ALERT_STATE };
const _listeners = new Set<(active: boolean, snap: IKinetiClubTabAlertSnapshot, ownerUid: string | null) => void>();

const emitTabAlert = () => {
  const active = computeHasKinetiClubTabAlert(_currentState);
  _listeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try {
      fn(active, _currentState, _ownerUserId);
    } catch {}
  });
};

export function getKinetiClubTabAlertState(): IKinetiClubTabAlertSnapshot {
  return _currentState;
}

export function getHasKinetiClubTabAlertSync(userId?: string | null): boolean {
  if (userId !== undefined) {
    const cleanUid = String(userId || '').trim();
    if (!cleanUid || cleanUid !== _ownerUserId) return false;
  }
  return Boolean(_ownerUserId && computeHasKinetiClubTabAlert(_currentState));
}

export function patchKinetiClubTabAlertState(
  partial: Partial<IKinetiClubTabAlertSnapshot>,
  userId?: string | null
): boolean {
  const cleanUid = userId !== undefined ? String(userId || '').trim() : _ownerUserId;
  if (userId !== undefined && !cleanUid) return false;
  let ownerChanged = false;
  if (cleanUid && cleanUid !== _ownerUserId) {
    _ownerUserId = cleanUid;
    _currentState = { ...INITIAL_ALERT_STATE };
    ownerChanged = true;
  }
  const next: IKinetiClubTabAlertSnapshot = {
    unseenNotificationsCount:
      partial.unseenNotificationsCount !== undefined
        ? safeNonNegInt(partial.unseenNotificationsCount)
        : _currentState.unseenNotificationsCount,
    pendingDmCount:
      partial.pendingDmCount !== undefined
        ? safeNonNegInt(partial.pendingDmCount)
        : _currentState.pendingDmCount,
    pendingSquadInvitesCount:
      partial.pendingSquadInvitesCount !== undefined
        ? safeNonNegInt(partial.pendingSquadInvitesCount)
        : _currentState.pendingSquadInvitesCount,
    pendingSplitInvitesCount:
      partial.pendingSplitInvitesCount !== undefined
        ? safeNonNegInt(partial.pendingSplitInvitesCount)
        : _currentState.pendingSplitInvitesCount,
    hasUnclaimedReadyReward:
      partial.hasUnclaimedReadyReward !== undefined
        ? Boolean(partial.hasUnclaimedReadyReward)
        : _currentState.hasUnclaimedReadyReward,
  };
  const changed =
    ownerChanged ||
    next.unseenNotificationsCount !== _currentState.unseenNotificationsCount ||
    next.pendingDmCount !== _currentState.pendingDmCount ||
    next.pendingSquadInvitesCount !== _currentState.pendingSquadInvitesCount ||
    next.pendingSplitInvitesCount !== _currentState.pendingSplitInvitesCount ||
    next.hasUnclaimedReadyReward !== _currentState.hasUnclaimedReadyReward;
  if (changed) {
    _currentState = next;
    emitTabAlert();
  }
  return computeHasKinetiClubTabAlert(_currentState);
}

export function resetKinetiClubTabAlertState(nextOwnerUserId: string | null = null): void {
  _ownerUserId = nextOwnerUserId ? String(nextOwnerUserId).trim() : null;
  _currentState = { ...INITIAL_ALERT_STATE };
  emitTabAlert();
}

registerSessionCleanupHook(() => {
  resetKinetiClubTabAlertState(null);
});

export function subscribeKinetiClubTabAlert(
  listener: (active: boolean, snap: IKinetiClubTabAlertSnapshot, ownerUid: string | null) => void
): () => void {
  _listeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    _listeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

export function useHasKinetiClubTabAlert(userId?: string | null): boolean {
  const cleanUid = String(userId || '').trim() || null;
  const [hasAlert, setHasAlert] = useState<boolean>(() =>
    cleanUid ? getHasKinetiClubTabAlertSync(cleanUid) : false
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!cleanUid) {
      resetKinetiClubTabAlertState(null);
      setHasAlert(false);
      return;
    }
    if (_ownerUserId !== cleanUid) {
      resetKinetiClubTabAlertState(cleanUid);
    }
    setHasAlert(getHasKinetiClubTabAlertSync(cleanUid));
    return subscribeKinetiClubTabAlert((active, _snap, ownerUid) => {
      setHasAlert(Boolean(ownerUid === cleanUid && active));
    });
  }, [cleanUid]);
  return Boolean(cleanUid && hasAlert);
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { IEquipoKinetic } from '../types';
import { translateDiscipline } from '../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';
import { isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete } from './kineticAthleteDeduplication';
import {
  GLOBAL_SHARED_INVITES_KEY, LEADER_LIMIT_MSG_EN, LEADER_LIMIT_MSG_ES,
  checkUserAlreadyLeadsSquad, consumePendingSquadEditId, emitSquadsDataChanged,
  isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow, isUserSquadLeader, persistSharedSquadRecord,
} from './kineticlubSquadsService';
import { getBlockedUserIdsSet, isUserBlockedUgc } from './kineticlubUgcModerationService';

export interface ITeamCreatePayload {
  uid: string; myName: string; cleanName: string; disciplina: string;
  descripcion?: string; misEquipos: IEquipoKinetic[]; language: 'es' | 'en';
  tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
}

export async function createOrUpdateTeamCloudMutation(p: ITeamCreatePayload): Promise<{
  ok: boolean; finalSquadId?: string; reason?: 'limit';
  alert?: { title: string; body: string; kind: 'warning' | 'success' };
}> {
  const pendingEditId = consumePendingSquadEditId();
  const editSquadId = pendingEditId || (p.descripcion && p.misEquipos.some((s) => String(s.id) === String(p.descripcion)) ? String(p.descripcion) : null);
  const leaderCheck = await checkUserAlreadyLeadsSquad(p.uid, p.misEquipos, editSquadId);
  if (leaderCheck.isLeader) {
    return {
      ok: false, reason: 'limit',
      alert: { title: p.tx('Límite de Liderazgo', 'Leadership Limit'), body: p.tx(LEADER_LIMIT_MSG_ES, LEADER_LIMIT_MSG_EN), kind: 'warning' },
    };
  }
  const targetEditSquad = editSquadId ? p.misEquipos.find((s) => String(s.id) === editSquadId) : null;
  const cleanCode = targetEditSquad?.codigo_invitacion || `EQ-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase()}`;
  let finalSquadId = String(targetEditSquad?.id || `local_${Date.now()}`);

  try {
    if (editSquadId && !editSquadId.startsWith('sq_') && !editSquadId.startsWith('local_')) {
      await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').update({ nombre: p.cleanName, disciplina: p.disciplina || 'Multidisciplina' }).eq('id', editSquadId).eq('creador_id', p.uid);
      finalSquadId = editSquadId;
    } else {
      const { data: inserted } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').insert([{
        nombre: p.cleanName, disciplina: p.disciplina || 'Multidisciplina', codigo_invitacion: cleanCode,
        cupo_maximo: 50, creador_id: p.uid, creador_nombre: p.myName,
      }]).select().single();
      if (inserted?.id) {
        finalSquadId = String(inserted.id);
        await supabase.from('equipo_miembros').insert([{
          equipo_id: inserted.id, usuario_id: p.uid, usuario_nombre: p.myName, rol_equipo: 'lider', estado: 'activo',
        }]);
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  const existingNames: string[] = Array.isArray((targetEditSquad as any)?.integrantes_nombres) ? (targetEditSquad as any).integrantes_nombres : [p.myName];
  const updatedSquad: IEquipoKinetic = {
    id: finalSquadId, nombre: p.cleanName, creador_id: p.uid, creador_nombre: p.myName,
    disciplina: p.disciplina || 'Multidisciplina', miembros_count: existingNames.length, max_miembros: 50,
    codigo_invitacion: cleanCode, integrantes_nombres: existingNames, esLider: true, rol_equipo: 'lider',
    isOfflineCreated: finalSquadId.startsWith('local_') || finalSquadId.startsWith('sq_'),
  } as any;
  await persistSharedSquadRecord(updatedSquad);
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
  const discLabel = translateDiscipline(p.disciplina || 'Multidisciplina', p.language);
  return {
    ok: true, finalSquadId,
    alert: {
      title: p.tx('EQUIPO CONFIGURADO', 'TEAM CONFIGURED'),
      body: p.tx(`Tu equipo "${p.cleanName}" (${p.disciplina}) está activo y listo en tu Canal Táctico.`, `Your team "${p.cleanName}" (${discLabel}) is active and ready in your Tactical Channel.`),
      kind: 'success',
    },
  };
}

export async function inviteAthleteToTeamCloudMutation(params: {
  uid: string; myName: string; myEmail: string; athlete: any;
  misEquipos: IEquipoKinetic[]; tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean; dbSquadId?: string; athleteName?: string;
  alert?: { title: string; body: string; kind: 'error' | 'success' };
}> {
  const { uid, myName, myEmail, athlete, misEquipos, tx } = params;
  if (isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete(athlete, uid, myEmail, myName, getBlockedUserIdsSet())) return { ok: false };
  const athleteName = String(athlete.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')).trim();
  const athleteId = athlete.id ? String(athlete.id) : null;
  if (athleteName.toLowerCase() === myName.toLowerCase()) return { ok: false };

  const myOwnSquad: any = misEquipos.find((s) => isUserSquadLeader(s, uid)) || {
    id: `local_${Date.now()}`, nombre: tx(`Equipo de ${myName}`, `${myName}'s Team`),
    creador_id: uid, creador_nombre: myName, disciplina: 'Fuerza', miembros_count: 1, max_miembros: 50,
    codigo_invitacion: `EQ-${uid.replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 6).toUpperCase()}`, integrantes_nombres: [myName], esLider: true, rol_equipo: 'lider',
  };
  const existingNames: string[] = Array.isArray(myOwnSquad.integrantes_nombres) ? myOwnSquad.integrantes_nombres : [myName];
  if (existingNames.length >= 50) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      alert: { title: tx('CUPO MÁXIMO ALCANZADO (50/50)', 'MAX CAPACITY REACHED (50/50)'), body: tx('Tu equipo ha alcanzado el límite de 50 integrantes.', 'Your team has reached the 50-member limit.'), kind: 'error' },
    };
  }
  let dbSquadId = String(myOwnSquad.id);
  try {
    if (dbSquadId.startsWith('sq_') || dbSquadId.startsWith('local_')) {
      const existingCheck = await checkUserAlreadyLeadsSquad(uid, misEquipos, null);
      if (existingCheck.isLeader && existingCheck.existingSquadId) dbSquadId = existingCheck.existingSquadId;
      else {
        const { data: created } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').insert([{
          nombre: myOwnSquad.nombre, disciplina: myOwnSquad.disciplina || 'Fuerza',
          codigo_invitacion: myOwnSquad.codigo_invitacion, cupo_maximo: 50, creador_id: uid, creador_nombre: myName,
        }]).select().single();
        if (created?.id) {
          dbSquadId = String(created.id);
          await supabase.from('equipo_miembros').insert([{
            equipo_id: created.id, usuario_id: uid, usuario_nombre: myName, rol_equipo: 'lider', estado: 'activo',
          }]);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!dbSquadId.startsWith('sq_') && !dbSquadId.startsWith('local_') && athleteId && !athleteId.startsWith('code_')) {
      await supabase.from('equipo_miembros').insert([{
        equipo_id: dbSquadId, usuario_id: athleteId, usuario_nombre: athleteName,
        invitado_por_id: uid, invitado_por_nombre: myName, rol_equipo: 'miembro', estado: 'pendiente',
      }]);
    }
  } catch {}

  const sharedInviteRecord = {
    id: `inv_${Date.now()}`, equipo_id: dbSquadId, equipo_nombre: myOwnSquad.nombre,
    usuario_id: athleteId, usuario_nombre: athleteName, invitado_por_id: uid, invitado_por_nombre: myName, estado: 'pendiente',
  };
  const inviteMsg: any = {
    id: `msg_${Date.now()}`, equipo_id: dbSquadId, usuario_id: uid, usuario_nombre: myName,
    mensaje: tx(`📩 Invitación enviada a ${athleteName} (Pendiente de aceptación).`, `📩 Invitation sent to ${athleteName} (Pending acceptance).`),
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
  await persistSharedSquadRecord({ ...myOwnSquad, id: dbSquadId, isOfflineCreated: dbSquadId.startsWith('local_') || dbSquadId.startsWith('sq_') }, inviteMsg, sharedInviteRecord);
  return {
    ok: true, dbSquadId, athleteName,
    alert: {
      title: tx('INVITACIÓN ENVIADA', 'INVITATION SENT'),
      body: tx(`Se envió la invitación a ${athleteName} para unirse a "${myOwnSquad.nombre}". Se integrará al equipo en cuanto acepte tu invitación.`, `Invitation sent to ${athleteName} to join "${myOwnSquad.nombre}". They will join your team as soon as they accept.`),
      kind: 'success',
    },
  };
}

export async function connectTeamByCodeCloudMutation(params: {
  cleanCode: string; uid: string; myName: string; tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; teamId?: string; teamName?: string }> {
  const { cleanCode, uid, myName, tx } = params;
  if (!cleanCode.startsWith('EQ-')) return { ok: false };
  try {
    const { data: teamByCode } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic')
      .select('id, nombre, disciplina, codigo_invitacion, creador_id, creador_nombre')
      .eq('codigo_invitacion', cleanCode).neq('disciplina', 'DM_1A1').neq('codigo_invitacion', 'STORIES-V25').limit(1);
    const foundTeam = Array.isArray(teamByCode) ? teamByCode[0] : null;
    if (foundTeam?.id && !isBridgeOrSystemTeamRow(foundTeam)) {
      if (isUserBlockedUgc(foundTeam.creador_id)) return { ok: false };
      await supabase.from('equipo_miembros').insert([{
        equipo_id: foundTeam.id, usuario_id: uid, usuario_nombre: myName,
        invitado_por_id: foundTeam.creador_id, invitado_por_nombre: foundTeam.creador_nombre, rol_equipo: 'miembro', estado: 'aceptado',
      }]);
      await supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').insert([{
        equipo_id: foundTeam.id, usuario_id: uid, usuario_nombre: myName,
        mensaje: tx(`⚡ ¡${myName} se unió al equipo mediante código de invitación!`, `⚡ ${myName} joined the team via invite code!`),
      }]);
      return { ok: true, teamId: String(foundTeam.id), teamName: String(foundTeam.nombre || tx('Equipo Kinetic', 'Kinetic Team')) };
    }
  } catch {}
  return { ok: false };
}

export async function respondTeamInviteCloudMutation(params: {
  miembroId: string; estado: 'activo' | 'rechazado'; targetInv: any; userId?: string | null; myName: string;
  tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
}): Promise<string | null> {
  const { miembroId, estado, targetInv, userId, myName, tx } = params;
  try {
    const rawInv = await AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_INVITES_KEY);
    if (rawInv) {
      const list: any[] = JSON.parse(rawInv) || [];
      const updated = list.map((item) => String(item.id) === String(miembroId) ? { ...item, estado: estado === 'activo' ? 'aceptado' : 'rechazado' } : item);
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_SHARED_INVITES_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
    }
    if (targetInv?.id && !String(targetInv.id).startsWith('inv_')) {
      let q = supabase.from('equipo_miembros').update({ estado: estado === 'activo' ? 'aceptado' : 'rechazado' }).eq('id', targetInv.id);
      if (userId) q = q.eq('usuario_id', userId);
      await q;
    }
  } catch {}
  if (estado === 'activo' && targetInv) {
    const uid = String(userId || 'anon');
    const targetEqId = String(targetInv.equipo_id);
    try {
      if (!targetEqId.startsWith('sq_')) {
        await supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').insert([{
          equipo_id: targetEqId, usuario_id: uid, usuario_nombre: myName,
          mensaje: tx(`⚡ ¡${myName} aceptó la invitación y se integró al equipo!`, `⚡ ${myName} accepted the invite and joined the team!`),
        }]);
      }
    } catch {}
    return targetEqId;
  }
  return null;
}

    // === src/services/kineticlubUgcModerationService.ts === //
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

export const UGC_BLOCKS_STORAGE_KEY_PREFIX = '@kinetic_ugc_blocks_v265_';

export type UgcRelationAction = 'block' | 'restrict' | 'unblock';
export type UgcContentType = 'post' | 'comment' | 'story' | 'dm' | 'profile';

interface PersistedUgcState {
  blocked: string[];
  restricted: string[];
}

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

let _activeUid = '';
let _blockedIdsSet = new Set<string>();
let _restrictedIdsSet = new Set<string>();
let _stateSig = '|';
let _hydrateGen = 0;
let _lastHydratedAt = 0;
let _hydrateInflight: Promise<{ blockedIdsSet: Set<string>; restrictedIdsSet: Set<string> }> | null = null;
const _reportInflight = new Set<string>();
const _listeners = new Set<() => void>();
let _rtSeq = 0;

const normUid = (v?: string | null): string => String(v || '').trim().toLowerCase();
const isUuid = (v?: string | null): boolean => UUID_RE.test(String(v || '').trim());

const getStorageKey = (uid: string): string => `${UGC_BLOCKS_STORAGE_KEY_PREFIX}${normUid(uid) || 'anon'}`;

const buildStateSig = (blocked: Iterable<string>, restricted: Iterable<string>): string =>
  `${Array.from(blocked).sort().join(',')}|${Array.from(restricted).sort().join(',')}`;

export function subscribeUgcModerationChanged(fn: () => void): () => void {
  _listeners.add(fn);
  return () => { _listeners.delete(fn); };
}

export function emitUgcModerationChanged(): void {
  _listeners.forEach((fn) => { try { fn(); } catch {} });
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:ugc-updated')); } catch {}
  }
}

function applySetsAndNotify(uid: string, blocked: Iterable<string>, restricted: Iterable<string>): void {
  const nextBlocked = new Set(Array.from(blocked).map(normUid).filter(Boolean));
  const nextRestricted = new Set(Array.from(restricted).map(normUid).filter((x) => Boolean(x) && !nextBlocked.has(x)));
  const nextSig = buildStateSig(nextBlocked, nextRestricted);
  const changed = _activeUid !== normUid(uid) || nextSig !== _stateSig;
  _activeUid = normUid(uid);
  _blockedIdsSet = nextBlocked;
  _restrictedIdsSet = nextRestricted;
  _stateSig = nextSig;
  if (changed) emitUgcModerationChanged();
}

async function persistLocalUgcState(uid: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!uid) return;
  const payload: PersistedUgcState = { blocked: Array.from(_blockedIdsSet), restricted: Array.from(_restrictedIdsSet) };
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(getStorageKey(uid), JSON.stringify(payload)).catch(() => {});
}

export const getBlockedUserIdsSet = (): ReadonlySet<string> => _blockedIdsSet;
export const getRestrictedUserIdsSet = (): ReadonlySet<string> => _restrictedIdsSet;
export const isUserBlockedUgc = (targetUserId?: string | null): boolean => Boolean(normUid(targetUserId) && _blockedIdsSet.has(normUid(targetUserId)));
export const isUserRestrictedUgc = (targetUserId?: string | null): boolean => Boolean(normUid(targetUserId) && _restrictedIdsSet.has(normUid(targetUserId)));

export function filterOutBlockedUsers<T>(
  items: T[],
  extractUserId: (item: T) => string | null | undefined
): T[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(items) || _blockedIdsSet.size === 0) return Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
  return items.filter((item) => {
    const uid = normUid(extractUserId(item));
    return !uid || !_blockedIdsSet.has(uid);
  });
}

async function resolveSessionUid(explicitUserId?: string | null): Promise<string> {
  const clean = normUid(explicitUserId);
  if (isUuid(clean)) return clean;
  try {
    const { data } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    const sUid = normUid(data?.session?.user?.id);
    if (isUuid(sUid)) return sUid;
  } catch {}
  return '';
}

export async function hydrateUgcModerationState(
  userId?: string | null,
  force = false
): Promise<{ blockedIdsSet: Set<string>; restrictedIdsSet: Set<string> }> {
  const uid = await resolveSessionUid(userId);
  if (!uid) {
    _hydrateGen += 1;
    _lastHydratedAt = 0;
    applySetsAndNotify('', [], []);
    return { blockedIdsSet: new Set(), restrictedIdsSet: new Set() };
  }
  if (!force && _activeUid === uid && _hydrateInflight) return _hydrateInflight;
  if (!force && _activeUid === uid && Date.now() - _lastHydratedAt < 60_000) {
    return { blockedIdsSet: new Set(_blockedIdsSet), restrictedIdsSet: new Set(_restrictedIdsSet) };
  }

  const myGen = ++_hydrateGen;
  const inflight = (async () => {
    try {
      const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(getStorageKey(uid));
      if (myGen !== _hydrateGen) return { blockedIdsSet: new Set(_blockedIdsSet), restrictedIdsSet: new Set(_restrictedIdsSet) };
      if (raw) {
        try {
          const parsed: PersistedUgcState = JSON.parse(raw);
          applySetsAndNotify(uid, parsed?.blocked || [], parsed?.restricted || []);
        } catch {}
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('comunidad_bloqueos')
        .select('blocked_id, modo')
        .eq('blocker_id', uid);

      if (myGen !== _hydrateGen) return { blockedIdsSet: new Set(_blockedIdsSet), restrictedIdsSet: new Set(_restrictedIdsSet) };
      if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
        const cloudBlocked: string[] = [];
        const cloudRestricted: string[] = [];
        data.forEach((row: any) => {
          const bId = normUid(row?.blocked_id);
          if (!bId || bId === uid) return;
          if (row?.modo === 'restricted') cloudRestricted.push(bId);
          else cloudBlocked.push(bId);
        });
        applySetsAndNotify(uid, cloudBlocked, cloudRestricted);
        _lastHydratedAt = Date.now();
        await persistLocalUgcState(uid);
      }
      return { blockedIdsSet: new Set(_blockedIdsSet), restrictedIdsSet: new Set(_restrictedIdsSet) };
    } finally {
      if (myGen === _hydrateGen) _hydrateInflight = null;
    }
  })();

  _hydrateInflight = inflight;
  return inflight;
}

export async function manageUgcUserRelation(params: {
  targetUserId: string; action: UgcRelationAction; reason?: string | null; currentUserId?: string | null;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  const uid = await resolveSessionUid(params.currentUserId);
  const targetId = normUid(params.targetUserId);
  if (!uid || !isUuid(targetId) || targetId === uid) return false;

  const nextBlocked = new Set(_blockedIdsSet);
  const nextRestricted = new Set(_restrictedIdsSet);
  if (params.action === 'block') { nextBlocked.add(targetId); nextRestricted.delete(targetId); }
  else if (params.action === 'restrict') { nextRestricted.add(targetId); nextBlocked.delete(targetId); }
  else { nextBlocked.delete(targetId); nextRestricted.delete(targetId); }
  applySetsAndNotify(uid, nextBlocked, nextRestricted);
  _lastHydratedAt = 0;
  await persistLocalUgcState(uid);

  try {
    const cleanReason = params.reason ? String(params.reason).slice(0, 280) : null;
    const { error } = await supabase.rpc('gestionar_relacion_usuario_ugc', { p_target_id: targetId, p_accion: params.action, p_motivo: cleanReason });
    if (error) {
      if (params.action === 'unblock') await supabase.from('comunidad_bloqueos').delete().eq('blocker_id', uid).eq('blocked_id', targetId);
      else await supabase.from('comunidad_bloqueos').upsert({ blocker_id: uid, blocked_id: targetId, modo: params.action === 'block' ? 'blocked' : 'restricted', motivo: cleanReason }, { onConflict: 'blocker_id,blocked_id' });
    }
    return true;
  } catch { return true; }
}

export async function reportUgcContent(params: {
  targetUserId?: string | null; targetPostId?: string | null; contentType: UgcContentType;
  reasonCategory: string; detail?: string | null; currentUserId?: string | null;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  const uid = await resolveSessionUid(params.currentUserId);
  const targetUid = isUuid(params.targetUserId) ? normUid(params.targetUserId) : null;
  const targetPid = isUuid(params.targetPostId) ? normUid(params.targetPostId) : null;
  if (!uid || (!targetUid && !targetPid) || (targetUid && targetUid === uid)) return false;

  const lockKey = `${uid}|${targetUid || ''}|${targetPid || ''}|${params.contentType}`;
  if (_reportInflight.has(lockKey)) return false;
  _reportInflight.add(lockKey);

  try {
    const cleanReason = String(params.reasonCategory || 'inapropiado').trim().slice(0, 120) || 'inapropiado';
    const cleanDetail = params.detail ? String(params.detail).trim().slice(0, 1000) : null;
    const { error } = await supabase.rpc('reportar_contenido_ugc', {
      p_target_user_id: targetUid, p_target_post_id: targetPid, p_tipo: params.contentType, p_motivo: cleanReason, p_detalle: cleanDetail,
    });
    if (error) {
      let resolvedTarget = targetUid;
      if (targetPid) {
        const { data: postRow } = await supabase.from('comunidad_posts').select('usuario_id').eq('id', targetPid).maybeSingle();
        if (postRow?.usuario_id) resolvedTarget = normUid(postRow.usuario_id);
      }
      if (resolvedTarget && resolvedTarget === uid) return false;
      const { error: insErr } = await supabase.from('comunidad_reportes_ugc').insert([{
        reporter_id: uid, target_user_id: resolvedTarget, target_post_id: targetPid,
        tipo_contenido: params.contentType, categoria_motivo: cleanReason, detalle: cleanDetail, estado: 'pendiente',
      }]);
      if (insErr) return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch { return false; } finally { _reportInflight.delete(lockKey); }
}

export function subscribeUgcBlocksRealtime(userId?: string | null): () => void {
  const uid = normUid(userId);
  if (!isUuid(uid)) return () => {};
  hydrateUgcModerationState(uid, false).catch(() => {});
  const channel = supabase
    .channel(`kc_ugc_blocks_${uid.slice(0, 8)}_${++_rtSeq}`)
    .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'comunidad_bloqueos', filter: `blocker_id=eq.${uid}` }, () => {
      hydrateUgcModerationState(uid, true).catch(() => {});
    })
    .subscribe();
  return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel).catch(() => {}); };
}

import { isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl, readMediaUriAsUint8Array, validateSafeStorageImagePayload } from '../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';
import { isKineticUgcAllowed } from '../utils/kineticUgcContentGuardLeaf';
import { getAvatarUrl } from '../utils/supabaseImage';

  WALL_COLS_V264, WallMemorySnapshot, type WallPostRow, WallReactionKey, getMemoryWallSnapshot,
  hasHydratedWallInitialSync, isOffTopicGamingPost, isOffTopicGamingSpamPost, markWallInitialHydrated,
  normalizeCloudWallPostRow, primeWallSnapshotFromStorage, purgePostFromMemoryWallSnapshot, safeJsonParse,
  scopedWallStorageKey, setMemoryWallSnapshot, subscribeMemoryWallSnapshot,
} from './kineticlubWallSnapshotStore';

export {
  FEED_COMMENTS_KEY, FEED_REACTIONS_KEY, FEED_SAVED_KEY, IWallComment, SEEN_CHAT_COUNTS_KEY_PREFIX,
  WALL_COLS_FULL, WALL_COLS_LEGACY, WallMemorySnapshot, type WallPostRow, WallReactionKey, getMemoryWallSnapshot,
  getSeenChatCountsStorageKey, hasHydratedWallInitialSync, isOffTopicGamingPost, isOffTopicGamingSpamPost,
  loadPersistedSeenRoomCounts, markWallInitialHydrated, normalizeCloudWallPostRow, persistSeenRoomCounts,
  primeWallSnapshotFromStorage, purgePostFromMemoryWallSnapshot, scopedWallStorageKey, setMemoryWallSnapshot,
  subscribeKinetiClubChatsRealtimeAndFocus, subscribeMemoryWallSnapshot, subscribeWallPostsRealtimeAndFocus,
};

let _pendingFlushHook: ((userId?: string | null, authorFallback?: string) => Promise<void>) | null = null;

export function registerPendingWallFlushHook(
  fn: (userId?: string | null, authorFallback?: string) => Promise<void>
): void {
  _pendingFlushHook = fn;
}

function safeRevokeWebBlobUrl(rawUri: string): void {
  if (
    Platform.OS === 'web' &&
    String(rawUri || '').startsWith('blob:') &&
    typeof URL !== 'undefined' &&
    typeof URL.revokeObjectURL === 'function'
  ) {
    try {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(rawUri);
    } catch {}
  }
}

async function resolveAuthenticatedStorageUid(fallbackUid?: string | null): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const { data } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    const sUid = String(data?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
    if (sUid) return sUid;
    if (fallbackUid) {
      const refreshed = await supabase.auth.refreshSession();
      const rUid = String(refreshed?.data?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
      if (rUid) return rUid;
    }
  } catch {}
  return '';
}

/**
 * Subida binaria pura `Uint8Array` al bucket `avatars` bajo `${authUid}/wall_${batchTs}_${idx}.jpg`.
 * Cero `fetch(uri).blob()` y cero rutas locales `file://`, `content://` o `ph://` hacia la nube.
 */
export async function uploadWallMediaBatchToStorageCdn(
  mediaUris: string[],
  userId?: string | null
): Promise<string[]> {
  if (!Array.isArray(mediaUris) || mediaUris.length === 0) return [];
  const authUid = await resolveAuthenticatedStorageUid(userId);
  const batchTs = Date.now();

  const results = await Promise.all(
    mediaUris.slice(0, 5).map(async (rawUri, idx) => {
      const uri = String(rawUri || '').trim();
      if (!uri) return '';
      if (isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(uri)) return uri;

      const wasWebBlob = Platform.OS === 'web' && uri.startsWith('blob:');
      let compressedUri = uri;
      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        try {
          compressedUri = await compressWebImageUri(uri, 1080, 0.75);
        } catch {
          compressedUri = uri;
        }
      }

      if (!authUid) {
        if (wasWebBlob && compressedUri !== uri) safeRevokeWebBlobUrl(uri);
        return !userId ? compressedUri : '';
      }

      const fileBytes = await readMediaUriAsUint8Array(compressedUri);
      const imgCheck = validateSafeStorageImagePayload({ bytes: fileBytes, uriOrName: compressedUri });
      if (!imgCheck.ok || !fileBytes) {
        if (wasWebBlob && compressedUri !== uri) safeRevokeWebBlobUrl(uri);
        return '';
      }

      let activeUid = authUid;
      let storagePath = `${activeUid}/wall_${batchTs}_${idx}.${imgCheck.ext || 'jpg'}`;
      const uploadOpts = { contentType: imgCheck.contentType || 'image/jpeg', cacheControl: '604800', upsert: true };

      try {
        let { error: upErr } = await supabase.storage.from('avatars').upload(storagePath, fileBytes, uploadOpts);
        if (upErr && /jwt|token|unauthorized|expired|row-level/i.test(String(upErr.message || ''))) {
          const refRes = await supabase.auth.refreshSession().catch(() => null);
          const refreshedUid = String(refRes?.data?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
          if (refreshedUid) {
            activeUid = refreshedUid;
            storagePath = `${activeUid}/wall_${batchTs}_${idx}.jpg`;
            const retry = await supabase.storage.from('avatars').upload(storagePath, fileBytes, uploadOpts);
            upErr = retry.error;
          }
        }

        if (!upErr) {
          const { data: pub } = supabase.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(storagePath);
          const publicUrl = String(pub?.publicUrl || '').trim();
          if (isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(publicUrl)) {
            if (wasWebBlob) safeRevokeWebBlobUrl(uri);
            if (compressedUri !== uri && String(compressedUri).startsWith('blob:')) {
              safeRevokeWebBlobUrl(compressedUri);
            }
            return publicUrl;
          }
        }
      } catch {}

      if (wasWebBlob && compressedUri !== uri) safeRevokeWebBlobUrl(uri);
      return '';
    })
  );

  return results.filter(Boolean);
}

export async function toggleWallPostSavedCloud(
  postId: string,
  nextSavedMap: Record<string, boolean>,
  userId?: string | null
): Promise<{ saved: boolean; savedCount: number } | null> {
  setMemoryWallSnapshot({ ...getMemoryWallSnapshot(userId), savedMap: nextSavedMap }, userId);
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(scopedWallStorageKey(FEED_SAVED_KEY, userId), JSON.stringify(nextSavedMap)).catch(() => {});
  const pid = String(postId || '').trim();
  if (!userId || !pid || pid.startsWith('upost_') || pid.startsWith('fpromo_')) return null;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('toggle_guardado_comunidad_post', { p_post_id: pid });
    if (!error && data && typeof data === 'object') {
      const d = data as Record<string, unknown>;
      return { saved: Boolean(d.saved), savedCount: Math.max(0, Number(d.saved_count) || 0) };
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

export async function toggleWallPostReactionCloud(
  postId: string,
  rKey: WallReactionKey,
  nextReactionsMap: Record<string, Partial<Record<WallReactionKey, boolean>>>,
  userId?: string | null
): Promise<void> {
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(scopedWallStorageKey(FEED_REACTIONS_KEY, userId), JSON.stringify(nextReactionsMap)).catch(() => {});
  const pid = String(postId || '').trim();
  if (!userId || !pid || pid.startsWith('upost_') || pid.startsWith('fpromo_')) return;
  try {
    await supabase.rpc('toggle_reaccion_comunidad_post', { p_post_id: pid, p_reaction: rKey });
  } catch {}
}

export async function addWallPostCommentCloud(
  postId: string,
  newComment: IWallComment,
  nextCommentsMap: Record<string, IWallComment[]>,
  userId?: string | null
): Promise<IWallComment | null> {
  if (!isKineticUgcAllowed(newComment?.text, [newComment?.author])) return null;
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(scopedWallStorageKey(FEED_COMMENTS_KEY, userId), JSON.stringify(nextCommentsMap)).catch(() => {});
  const pid = String(postId || '').trim();
  if (!userId || !pid || pid.startsWith('upost_') || pid.startsWith('fpromo_')) return null;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('agregar_comentario_comunidad_post', {
      p_post_id: pid,
      p_texto: newComment.text,
      p_autor_nombre: newComment.author,
    });
    if (!error && data && typeof data === 'object' && (data as Record<string, unknown>).id) {
      const d = data as Record<string, unknown>;
      return {
        id: String(d.id),
        userId: d.user_id ? String(d.user_id) : String(userId),
        author: String(d.author || newComment.author),
        text: String(d.text || newComment.text),
        created_at: String(d.created_at || newComment.created_at || new Date().toISOString()),
      };
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

export async function deleteWallPostCommentCloud(
  postId: string,
  commentId: string,
  nextCommentsMap: Record<string, IWallComment[]>,
  userId?: string | null
): Promise<void> {
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(scopedWallStorageKey(FEED_COMMENTS_KEY, userId), JSON.stringify(nextCommentsMap)).catch(() => {});
  const pid = String(postId || '').trim();
  const cid = String(commentId || '').trim();
  if (!userId || !pid || !cid || pid.startsWith('upost_') || pid.startsWith('fpromo_')) return;
  try {
    await supabase.rpc('eliminar_comentario_comunidad_post', { p_post_id: pid, p_comment_id: cid });
  } catch {}
}

export const WALL_COLS_LEGACY_ALIAS = WALL_COLS_LEGACY;

type CloudAthleteRef = { id?: string | number; nombre?: string | null; avatar_url?: string | null; nivel?: string | null; [k: string]: unknown };

export async function fetchHydratedWallPostsAndCloudState(params: {
  realWallPostsKey: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  fallbackAuthor: string;
  isMasterAdminUser: boolean;
  athletes: CloudAthleteRef[];
}): Promise<{
  posts: WallPostRow[];
  reactionsMap: Record<string, Partial<Record<WallReactionKey, boolean>>>;
  commentsMap: Record<string, IWallComment[]>;
  savedMap: Record<string, boolean>;
}> {
  if (params.userId && _pendingFlushHook) {
    await _pendingFlushHook(params.userId, params.fallbackAuthor).catch(() => {});
  }
  await hydrateUgcModerationState(params.userId, false).catch(() => {});

  const fetchCloud = async () => {
    const r1 = await supabase.from('comunidad_posts').select(WALL_COLS_FULL).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(40);
    if (!r1.error) return r1;
    const r2 = await supabase.from('comunidad_posts').select(WALL_COLS_V264).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(40);
    return r2.error ? supabase.from('comunidad_posts').select(WALL_COLS_LEGACY).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(40) : r2;
  };

  const [rawPosts, rawReacts, rawComms, rawSaved, cloudRes] = await Promise.all([
    AsyncStorage.getItem(params.realWallPostsKey),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(scopedWallStorageKey(FEED_REACTIONS_KEY, params.userId)),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(scopedWallStorageKey(FEED_COMMENTS_KEY, params.userId)),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(scopedWallStorageKey(FEED_SAVED_KEY, params.userId)),
    fetchCloud(),
  ]);

  const localReacts = safeJsonParse<Record<string, Partial<Record<WallReactionKey, boolean>>>>(rawReacts, {});
  const localComms = safeJsonParse<Record<string, IWallComment[]>>(rawComms, {});
  const localSaved = safeJsonParse<Record<string, boolean>>(rawSaved, {});
  const blocked = getBlockedUserIdsSet();
  const uid = String(params.userId || '').trim();
  const rawLocalArr = safeJsonParse<WallPostRow[]>(rawPosts, []);
  const localList = rawLocalArr.filter(
    (lp) => lp && !blocked.has(String(lp?.userId || lp?.authorId || '').trim().toLowerCase()) && !isOffTopicGamingSpamPost(lp)
  );
  if (localList.length !== rawLocalArr.length) {
    AsyncStorage.setItem(params.realWallPostsKey, JSON.stringify(localList)).catch(() => {});
  }
  const scopedLocalList = localList
    .filter((lp) => {
      const ownerId = String(lp?.userId || lp?.authorId || '').trim();
      return !(uid && String(lp?.id || '').startsWith('upost_') && ownerId && ownerId !== uid);
    })
    .map((lp) => {
      const ownerId = String(lp?.userId || lp?.authorId || '').trim();
      return uid ? { ...lp, isMine: Boolean(ownerId && ownerId === uid) } : lp;
    });

  const athPool = params.athletes || [];
  const profileMap = new Map<string, CloudAthleteRef>();
  const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f-]{27,}$/i;
  const cloudRows = Array.isArray(cloudRes?.data) ? (cloudRes.data as unknown as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) : [];
  const candidateIds = Array.from(
    new Set(
      [
        ...cloudRows.map((r) => String(r?.usuario_id || '').trim()),
        ...scopedLocalList.map((lp) => String(lp?.userId || lp?.authorId || '').trim()),
      ].filter((id) => uuidRegex.test(id))
    )
  ).slice(0, 60);

  if (candidateIds.length > 0) {
    try {
      const pRes = await supabase.from('perfiles').select('id, nombre, avatar_url, nivel').in('id', candidateIds);
      const rows = !pRes.error && Array.isArray(pRes.data)
        ? (pRes.data as CloudAthleteRef[])
        : (((await supabase.from('perfiles_publicos').select('id, nombre, avatar_url, nivel').in('id', candidateIds)).data || []) as CloudAthleteRef[]);
      rows.forEach((p) => {
        if (p?.id) profileMap.set(String(p.id).trim().toLowerCase(), p);
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  const enrichPostAvatar = (post: WallPostRow): WallPostRow => {
    const pKey = String(post?.userId || post?.authorId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const dbProf = pKey ? profileMap.get(pKey) : null;
    const authorAthlete =
      athPool.find(
        (a) =>
          (post.userId && String(a?.id || '') === String(post.userId)) ||
          String(a?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase() === String(post.authorName || '').trim().toLowerCase()
      ) ||
      (dbProf ? { id: dbProf.id, nombre: dbProf.nombre, avatar_url: dbProf.avatar_url, nivel: dbProf.nivel } : null);
    const rawAv = String(dbProf?.avatar_url || authorAthlete?.avatar_url || post.authorAvatar || '').trim();
    return {
      ...post,
      authorAvatar: rawAv ? getAvatarUrl(rawAv, 160) : null,
      authorRank: String(dbProf?.nivel || authorAthlete?.nivel || post.authorRank || 'Acceso Base'),
      authorAthlete: authorAthlete ? { ...authorAthlete, avatar_url: rawAv ? getAvatarUrl(rawAv, 160) : authorAthlete.avatar_url } : null,
    };
  };

  if (!cloudRes.error && Array.isArray(cloudRes.data)) {
    const mergedReacts = { ...localReacts }, mergedComms = { ...localComms }, mergedSaved = { ...localSaved };
    const mappedCloud = cloudRows
      .filter((row) => !blocked.has(String(row?.usuario_id || '').trim().toLowerCase()) && !isOffTopicGamingSpamPost(row as WallPostRow))
      .map((row) => {
        const norm = normalizeCloudWallPostRow(row, params.userId, params.fallbackAuthor, params.isMasterAdminUser);
        const pid = String(norm.post.id);
        if (norm.hasCloudReactionsJson) mergedReacts[pid] = norm.myCloudReactions;
        if (norm.hasCloudSavedJson) mergedSaved[pid] = norm.isSavedByMe;
        if (norm.cloudComments.length > 0 || Array.isArray(row?.comentarios_json)) mergedComms[pid] = norm.cloudComments;
        return enrichPostAvatar(norm.post);
      });
    const seenIds = new Set(mappedCloud.map((c) => String(c.id)));
    const unsyncedLocal = scopedLocalList.filter((lp) => lp?.id && String(lp.id).startsWith('upost_') && !seenIds.has(String(lp.id)) && !isOffTopicGamingSpamPost(lp)).map(enrichPostAvatar);
    markWallInitialHydrated(true);
    return setMemoryWallSnapshot({
      posts: [...unsyncedLocal, ...mappedCloud],
      reactionsMap: mergedReacts,
      commentsMap: mergedComms,
      savedMap: mergedSaved,
    }, params.userId);
  }

  markWallInitialHydrated(true);
  return setMemoryWallSnapshot({ posts: scopedLocalList.map(enrichPostAvatar), reactionsMap: localReacts, commentsMap: localComms, savedMap: localSaved }, params.userId);
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { AppState } from 'react-native';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { triggerSquadsDeterministicCacheInvalidation } from './kineticlubSquadsDeterministicEngine';

export const SEEN_CHAT_COUNTS_KEY_PREFIX = '@kinetic_seen_chat_counts_v26_';

let _rtChannelSeq = 0;

function attachFocusAndVisibilityListeners(trigger: () => void): () => void {
  const onFocus = () => trigger();
  const onVis = () => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined' || document.hidden === false) trigger();
  };
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') {
    window.addEventListener('focus', onFocus);
    window.addEventListener('online', onFocus);
  }
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && typeof document.addEventListener === 'function') {
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
  }
  const appSub = AppState.addEventListener('change', (st) => {
    if (st === 'active') trigger();
  });
  return () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.removeEventListener === 'function') {
      window.removeEventListener('focus', onFocus);
      window.removeEventListener('online', onFocus);
    }
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && typeof document.removeEventListener === 'function') {
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
    }
    appSub.remove();
  };
}

interface SharedRealtimeHub {
  subs: Set<() => void>;
  channel: ReturnType<typeof supabase.channel> | null;
  detachFocus: () => void;
  timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null;
}

let _wallHub: SharedRealtimeHub | null = null;
const _sharedChatHubs = new Map<string, SharedRealtimeHub>();

export function subscribeWallPostsRealtimeAndFocus(onSync: () => void): () => void {
  if (!_wallHub) {
    const subs = new Set<() => void>();
    const hub: SharedRealtimeHub = { subs, channel: null, detachFocus: () => {}, timer: null };
    const trigger = () => {
      if (hub.timer) clearTimeout(hub.timer);
      hub.timer = setTimeout(() => {
        hub.timer = null;
        Array.from(hub.subs).forEach((fn) => { try { fn(); } catch {} });
      }, 120);
    };
    hub.channel = supabase
      .channel(`kc_wall_rt_${++_rtChannelSeq}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'comunidad_posts' }, trigger)
      .subscribe();
    hub.detachFocus = attachFocusAndVisibilityListeners(trigger);
    _wallHub = hub;
  }
  const activeHub = _wallHub;
  activeHub.subs.add(onSync);
  return () => {
    activeHub.subs.delete(onSync);
    if (activeHub.subs.size === 0 && _wallHub === activeHub) {
      if (activeHub.timer) clearTimeout(activeHub.timer);
      activeHub.detachFocus();
      if (activeHub.channel) supabase.removeChannel(activeHub.channel).catch(() => {});
      _wallHub = null;
    }
  };
}

export function subscribeKinetiClubChatsRealtimeAndFocus(
  userId: string | undefined | null,
  onSync: () => void
): () => void {
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (!uid) return () => {};
  let hub = _sharedChatHubs.get(uid);
  if (!hub) {
    const subs = new Set<() => void>();
    const created: SharedRealtimeHub = { subs, channel: null, detachFocus: () => {}, timer: null };
    const trigger = () => {
      if (created.timer) clearTimeout(created.timer);
      created.timer = setTimeout(() => {
        created.timer = null;
        triggerSquadsDeterministicCacheInvalidation();
        Array.from(created.subs).forEach((fn) => { try { fn(); } catch {} });
      }, 120);
    };
    created.channel = supabase
      .channel(`kc_chats_rt_${uid.slice(0, 8)}_${++_rtChannelSeq}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'equipo_mensajes' }, trigger)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'mensajes_directos' }, trigger)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'equipo_miembros' }, trigger)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'comunidad_bloqueos' }, trigger)
      .subscribe();
    created.detachFocus = attachFocusAndVisibilityListeners(trigger);
    _sharedChatHubs.set(uid, created);
    hub = created;
  }
  const activeHub = hub;
  activeHub.subs.add(onSync);
  return () => {
    activeHub.subs.delete(onSync);
    if (activeHub.subs.size === 0 && _sharedChatHubs.get(uid) === activeHub) {
      if (activeHub.timer) clearTimeout(activeHub.timer);
      activeHub.detachFocus();
      if (activeHub.channel) supabase.removeChannel(activeHub.channel).catch(() => {});
      _sharedChatHubs.delete(uid);
    }
  };
}

export const getSeenChatCountsStorageKey = (myRealId?: string | null): string =>
  `${SEEN_CHAT_COUNTS_KEY_PREFIX}${String(myRealId || 'anon').trim() || 'anon'}`;

export async function loadPersistedSeenRoomCounts(myRealId?: string | null): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  if (!myRealId) return {};
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(getSeenChatCountsStorageKey(myRealId));
    if (!raw) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export async function persistSeenRoomCounts(
  myRealId: string | undefined | null,
  counts: Record<string, number>
): Promise<void> {
  if (!myRealId) return;
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(getSeenChatCountsStorageKey(myRealId), JSON.stringify(counts)).catch(() => {});
}
