import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl } from '../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';
import { getAvatarUrl } from '../utils/supabaseImage';
import { detectBlockedUgcCategory, isKineticUgcAllowed } from '../utils/kineticUgcContentGuardLeaf';
import { resolveOfficialChatDisplayName } from './kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import { registerSessionCleanupHook } from './kineticSessionPersistence';
import { getBlockedUserIdsSet, isUserBlockedUgc } from './kineticlubUgcModerationService';

export const FEED_REACTIONS_KEY = '@kinetic_real_wall_reactions_v26';
export const FEED_COMMENTS_KEY = '@kinetic_real_wall_comments_v26';
export const FEED_SAVED_KEY = '@kinetic_real_wall_saved_v265';

export function scopedWallStorageKey(baseKey: string, userId?: string | null): string {
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return uid ? `${baseKey}_${uid}` : baseKey;
}

export type WallReactionKey = 'fire' | 'power' | 'respect';

export interface IWallComment {
  id: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  author: string;
  text: string;
  created_at?: string;
  timeLabel?: string;
}

export type WallPostRow = Record<string, unknown> & {
  id?: string | number;
  userId?: string | null;
  authorId?: string | null;
  contenido?: string | null;
  texto?: string | null;
  caption?: string | null;
  bodyEs?: string | null;
  bodyEn?: string | null;
  titulo?: string | null;
  disciplina?: string | null;
  discipline?: string | null;
  sede?: string | null;
  venue?: string | null;
  isMine?: boolean;
};

export interface WallMemorySnapshot {
  posts: WallPostRow[];
  reactionsMap: Record<string, Partial<Record<WallReactionKey, boolean>>>;
  commentsMap: Record<string, IWallComment[]>;
  savedMap: Record<string, boolean>;
}

export const WALL_COLS_LEGACY =
  'id,usuario_id,categoria,autor_nombre,autor_avatar,autor_nivel,disciplina,sede,contenido,galeria,imagen_url,created_at,fuego_count,poder_count,respeto_count';
export const WALL_COLS_V264 = `${WALL_COLS_LEGACY},reacciones_json,comentarios_json`;
export const WALL_COLS_FULL = `${WALL_COLS_V264},sede_id,zona,guardados_json`;

export const safeJsonParse = <T,>(raw: string | null, fallback: T): T => {
  if (!raw) return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

let _hasHydratedWallInitial = false;
let _memoryWallOwnerUid: string | null = null;
let _memoryWallSnapshot: WallMemorySnapshot = {
  posts: [],
  reactionsMap: {},
  commentsMap: {},
  savedMap: {},
};
const _wallSnapshotListeners = new Set<() => void>();

const emitWallSnapshotListeners = () => {
  _wallSnapshotListeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try { fn(); } catch {}
  });
};

export function subscribeMemoryWallSnapshot(listener: () => void): () => void {
  _wallSnapshotListeners.add(listener);
  return () => { _wallSnapshotListeners.delete(listener); };
}

const LEGACY_WALL_SPAM_PURGE_KEYS = [
  '@kinetic_social_feed_posts_v25',
  '@kinetic_community_feed_cache',
  '@kinetic_wall_posts_v1',
];

export const hasHydratedWallInitialSync = (): boolean => _hasHydratedWallInitial;
export const markWallInitialHydrated = (val = true): void => {
  _hasHydratedWallInitial = Boolean(val);
};

registerSessionCleanupHook(() => {
  _hasHydratedWallInitial = false;
  _memoryWallOwnerUid = null;
  _memoryWallSnapshot = { posts: [], reactionsMap: {}, commentsMap: {}, savedMap: {} };
  emitWallSnapshotListeners();
  if (typeof AsyncStorage?.getAllKeys === 'function' && typeof AsyncStorage?.multiRemove === 'function') {
    AsyncStorage.getAllKeys()
      .then((keys) => {
        const wallKeys = (keys || []).filter(
          (k) =>
            k.startsWith('@kinetic_real_wall_') ||
            k.startsWith('@kinetic_social_feed_') ||
            k.startsWith('@kinetic_community_feed_')
        );
        if (wallKeys.length > 0) return AsyncStorage.multiRemove(wallKeys);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }
});

export function getMemoryWallSnapshot(userId?: string | null): WallMemorySnapshot {
  if (userId !== undefined) {
    const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
    if (!uid || _memoryWallOwnerUid !== uid) {
      return { posts: [], reactionsMap: {}, commentsMap: {}, savedMap: {} };
    }
  }
  return _memoryWallSnapshot;
}

export function isOffTopicGamingSpamPost(postOrText: WallPostRow | string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!postOrText) return false;
  const txt =
    typeof postOrText === 'string'
      ? postOrText
      : `${postOrText?.contenido || ''} ${postOrText?.texto || ''} ${postOrText?.caption || ''} ${postOrText?.bodyEs || ''} ${postOrText?.bodyEn || ''} ${postOrText?.titulo || ''} ${postOrText?.disciplina || ''} ${postOrText?.discipline || ''} ${postOrText?.sede || ''} ${postOrText?.venue || ''}`;
  const blocked = detectBlockedUgcCategory(txt);
  return blocked !== null && blocked !== 'EMPTY';
}

export const isOffTopicGamingPost = isOffTopicGamingSpamPost;

export function setMemoryWallSnapshot(next: WallMemorySnapshot, userId?: string | null): WallMemorySnapshot {
  if (userId !== undefined) {
    _memoryWallOwnerUid = String(userId || '').trim() || null;
  }
  const cleanPosts = Array.isArray(next?.posts)
    ? next.posts.filter((p) => p && !isOffTopicGamingSpamPost(p))
    : [];
  _memoryWallSnapshot = { ...next, posts: cleanPosts };
  emitWallSnapshotListeners();
  return _memoryWallSnapshot;
}

export function purgePostFromMemoryWallSnapshot(postId: string): void {
  const pid = String(postId || '').trim();
  if (!pid) return;
  const nextComments = { ..._memoryWallSnapshot.commentsMap };
  delete nextComments[pid];
  const nextReacts = { ..._memoryWallSnapshot.reactionsMap };
  delete nextReacts[pid];
  const nextSaved = { ..._memoryWallSnapshot.savedMap };
  delete nextSaved[pid];
  _memoryWallSnapshot = {
    posts: _memoryWallSnapshot.posts.filter((p) => String(p?.id || '') !== pid),
    reactionsMap: nextReacts,
    commentsMap: nextComments,
    savedMap: nextSaved,
  };
  emitWallSnapshotListeners();
}

export async function primeWallSnapshotFromStorage(
  realWallPostsKey: string,
  userId?: string | null
): Promise<WallMemorySnapshot> {
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (userId !== undefined && !uid) {
    return { posts: [], reactionsMap: {}, commentsMap: {}, savedMap: {} };
  }
  if (_memoryWallSnapshot.posts.length > 0 && (userId === undefined || _memoryWallOwnerUid === uid)) {
    return _memoryWallSnapshot;
  }
  try {
    AsyncStorage.multiRemove(LEGACY_WALL_SPAM_PURGE_KEYS).catch(() => {});
    const [rawPosts, rawReacts, rawComms, rawSaved] = await Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(realWallPostsKey),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(scopedWallStorageKey(FEED_REACTIONS_KEY, userId)),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(scopedWallStorageKey(FEED_COMMENTS_KEY, userId)),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(scopedWallStorageKey(FEED_SAVED_KEY, userId)),
    ]);
    const blocked = getBlockedUserIdsSet();
    const parsedPosts = safeJsonParse<WallPostRow[]>(rawPosts, []);
    const safePostsForStorage = parsedPosts.filter(
      (p) => p && !blocked.has(String(p?.userId || p?.authorId || '').trim().toLowerCase()) && !isOffTopicGamingSpamPost(p)
    );
    if (safePostsForStorage.length !== parsedPosts.length) {
      AsyncStorage.setItem(realWallPostsKey, JSON.stringify(safePostsForStorage)).catch(() => {});
    }
    const posts = safePostsForStorage
      .filter((p) => {
        const ownerId = String(p?.userId || p?.authorId || '').trim();
        return !(uid && String(p?.id || '').startsWith('upost_') && ownerId && ownerId !== uid);
      })
      .map((p) => {
        const ownerId = String(p?.userId || p?.authorId || '').trim();
        return uid ? { ...p, isMine: Boolean(ownerId && ownerId === uid) } : p;
      });
    _memoryWallOwnerUid = uid || null;
    _memoryWallSnapshot = {
      posts,
      reactionsMap: safeJsonParse(rawReacts, {}),
      commentsMap: safeJsonParse(rawComms, {}),
      savedMap: safeJsonParse(rawSaved, {}),
    };
  } catch {}
  return _memoryWallSnapshot;
}

export function normalizeCloudWallPostRow(
  row: Record<string, unknown>,
  currentUserId?: string | null,
  fallbackAuthor = 'Atleta Kinetic',
  isMasterAdminUser = false
) {
  const uid = String(currentUserId || '').trim();
  const rxRaw = row?.reacciones_json && typeof row.reacciones_json === 'object' ? (row.reacciones_json as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  const fireArr = Array.isArray(rxRaw.fire) ? rxRaw.fire.map(String) : null;
  const powerArr = Array.isArray(rxRaw.power) ? rxRaw.power.map(String) : null;
  const respectArr = Array.isArray(rxRaw.respect) ? rxRaw.respect.map(String) : null;
  const myCloudReactions: Partial<Record<WallReactionKey, boolean>> = {
    fire: Boolean(uid && fireArr?.includes(uid)),
    power: Boolean(uid && powerArr?.includes(uid)),
    respect: Boolean(uid && respectArr?.includes(uid)),
  };
  const rawFire = fireArr ? fireArr.length : Math.max(0, Number(row?.fuego_count) || 0);
  const rawPower = powerArr ? powerArr.length : Math.max(0, Number(row?.poder_count) || 0);
  const rawRespect = respectArr ? respectArr.length : Math.max(0, Number(row?.respeto_count) || 0);
  const savedArr = Array.isArray(row?.guardados_json) ? Array.from(new Set(row.guardados_json.map(String).filter(Boolean))) : null;
  const isSavedByMe = Boolean(uid && savedArr?.includes(uid));
  const savedCount = savedArr ? savedArr.length : 0;

  const cloudComments: IWallComment[] = Array.isArray(row?.comentarios_json)
    ? row.comentarios_json
        .filter((c): c is Record<string, unknown> => {
          if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return false;
          const rec = c as Record<string, unknown>;
          const txt = String(rec.text ?? rec.texto ?? '').trim();
          return Boolean(txt) && !isUserBlockedUgc(rec.user_id as string | undefined) && isKineticUgcAllowed(txt, [rec.author, rec.autor_nombre]);
        })
        .map((c, idx) => ({
          id: String(c.id || `cm_cloud_${row?.id}_${idx}`),
          userId: c.user_id ? String(c.user_id) : null,
          author: resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: c.user_id as string | undefined, name: (c.author || c.autor_nombre) as string | undefined, fallback: fallbackAuthor }),
          text: String(c.text ?? c.texto ?? '').trim(),
          created_at: String(c.created_at || row?.created_at || ''),
        }))
    : [];

  const isOwner = Boolean(uid && String(row?.usuario_id || '') === uid);
  const rawGaleria = Array.isArray(row?.galeria) && row.galeria.length > 0 ? row.galeria : row?.imagen_url ? [row.imagen_url] : [];
  const safeCloudMedia = rawGaleria.map((u) => String(u || '').trim()).filter((u) => isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(u));
  const disciplinaVal = String(row?.disciplina || 'Fuerza').trim() || 'Fuerza';
  const sedeVal = String(row?.sede || 'Kinetic Oficial').trim() || 'Kinetic Oficial';
  const sedeIdVal = row?.sede_id ? String(row.sede_id).trim() : null;
  const zonaVal = String(row?.zona || 'Los Cabos').trim() || 'Los Cabos';
  const post: WallPostRow = {
    id: String(row.id), kind: 'athlete_post', isMine: isOwner, canDelete: isOwner || isMasterAdminUser,
    userId: (row.usuario_id as string) || null, authorId: (row.usuario_id as string) || null, category: String(row.categoria || 'post'),
    authorName: resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: row.usuario_id as string | undefined, name: (row.autor_nombre || row.nombre_autor) as string | undefined, fallback: fallbackAuthor }),
    authorAvatar: row.autor_avatar ? getAvatarUrl(String(row.autor_avatar), 160) : null,
    authorRank: String(row.autor_nivel || 'Acceso Base'), discipline: disciplinaVal, disciplina: disciplinaVal,
    venue: sedeVal, sede: sedeVal, sedeId: sedeIdVal, sede_id: sedeIdVal, zona: zonaVal,
    bodyEs: String(row.contenido || ''), bodyEn: String(row.contenido || ''), mediaUris: safeCloudMedia,
    created_at: String(row.created_at || ''), createdAt: String(row.created_at || ''),
    createdAtMs: row.created_at ? new Date(String(row.created_at)).getTime() : Date.now(),
    baseFire: Math.max(0, rawFire - (myCloudReactions.fire ? 1 : 0)),
    basePower: Math.max(0, rawPower - (myCloudReactions.power ? 1 : 0)),
    baseRespect: Math.max(0, rawRespect - (myCloudReactions.respect ? 1 : 0)),
    isSavedByMe, savedCount, baseSaved: Math.max(0, savedCount - (isSavedByMe ? 1 : 0)),
  };
  return { post, myCloudReactions, hasCloudReactionsJson: Boolean(fireArr || powerArr || respectArr), isSavedByMe, hasCloudSavedJson: savedArr !== null, cloudComments };
}

  'TODAY’S WORKOUT': 'TODAY’S WORKOUT',
  "TODAY'S WORKOUT": 'TODAY’S WORKOUT',
  'RACHA ACTIVA 🔥': 'ACTIVE STREAK 🔥',
  'KINETIC CLUB ⚡': 'KINETIC CLUB ⚡',
  'SESIÓN VERIFICADA': 'VERIFIED SESSION',
  'WELLNESS & RECOVERY': 'WELLNESS & RECOVERY',
  '⚡ PROMO CLUB': '⚡ CLUB PROMO',
};

const STORY_POISON_KEYS = new Set(['constructor', 'prototype', '__proto__', 'proto', 'tostring', 'valueof', 'hasownproperty']);

export function normalizeStoryOwnerKey(raw?: string | null, fallbackName?: string | null): string {
  const base = String(raw || fallbackName || 'kinetic-user')
    .trim().toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
  return !base || STORY_POISON_KEYS.has(base) ? 'kineticuser' : base;
}

export function formatStoryRelativeTime(createdAtMs: number, isEn = false): string {
  const diffSec = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - createdAtMs) / 1000));
  if (diffSec < 60) return isEn ? 'Just now' : 'Hace instantes';
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffSec / 60);
  if (diffMin < 60) return isEn ? `${diffMin} min ago` : `Hace ${diffMin} min`;
  const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
  return isEn ? `${Math.min(23, diffHours)} h ago` : `Hace ${Math.min(23, diffHours)} h`;
}

export const trimStoriesPayloadToLatest = (jsonStr: string, maxStories = 15): string => {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return JSON.stringify(parsed.slice(-maxStories));
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
      const uniqueById = new Map<string, { item: any; keys: Set<string> }>();
      Object.keys(parsed).forEach((ownerKey) => {
        const list = Array.isArray(parsed[ownerKey]) ? parsed[ownerKey] : [];
        list.forEach((st: any) => {
          const sid = String(st?.id || '');
          if (!sid) return;
          const existing = uniqueById.get(sid);
          if (existing) existing.keys.add(ownerKey);
          else uniqueById.set(sid, { item: st, keys: new Set([ownerKey]) });
        });
      });
      const latestEntries = Array.from(uniqueById.values())
        .sort((a, b) => Number(b.item?.createdAtMs || 0) - Number(a.item?.createdAtMs || 0))
        .slice(0, maxStories);
      const prunedMap: Record<string, any[]> = Object.create(null);
      latestEntries.reverse().forEach(({ item, keys }) => {
        keys.forEach((k) => {
          if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(prunedMap, k)) prunedMap[k] = [];
          prunedMap[k].push(item);
        });
      });
      return JSON.stringify(prunedMap);
    }
  } catch {}
  return jsonStr;
};

export const saveStoriesQuotaSafe = async (key: string, jsonStr: string) => {
  if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined') (globalThis as any).__kineticStoriesMemoryCacheV25 = jsonStr;
  let safePayload = jsonStr;
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
    try {
      for (let i = window.localStorage.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const k = window.localStorage.key(i);
        if (k && (k.startsWith('@kinetic_stories_24h_v3_') || k === '@kinetic_custom_stories_v2')) {
          window.localStorage.removeItem(k);
        }
      }
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, safePayload);
    } catch {
      try {
        safePayload = trimStoriesPayloadToLatest(jsonStr, 12);
        window.localStorage.setItem(key, safePayload);
        if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined') (globalThis as any).__kineticStoriesMemoryCacheV25 = safePayload;
      } catch {}
    }
  }
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, safePayload);
  } catch {
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, trimStoriesPayloadToLatest(jsonStr, 12));
    } catch {}
  }
};

let memoryStoriesCache: Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]> = Object.create(null);
let _hasHydratedMemorySync = false;
const storiesListeners = new Set<() => void>();
// Pre-hidratación silenciosa en memoria al cargar módulo para frame-0 en nativo (#20)
Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  if (_hasHydratedMemorySync && Object.keys(memoryStoriesCache).length > 0) return;
  AsyncStorage.getItem(STORIES_STORAGE_KEY).then((raw) => {
    if (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trim() && Object.keys(memoryStoriesCache).length === 0) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      memoryStoriesCache = filterActiveStoriesMapStrict(parsed, Date.now(), getBlockedUserIdsSet()) as Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>;
    }
  }).catch(() => {});
});

function hydrateMemoryStoriesCacheSync(): void {
  if (_hasHydratedMemorySync && Object.keys(memoryStoriesCache).length > 0) return;
  _hasHydratedMemorySync = true;
  try {
    const rawGlobal = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? (globalThis as any).__kineticStoriesMemoryCacheV25 : null;
    const rawLs =
      !rawGlobal && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage
        ? window.localStorage.getItem(STORIES_STORAGE_KEY)
        : null;
    const raw = rawGlobal || rawLs;
    if (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trim()) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      memoryStoriesCache = filterActiveStoriesMapStrict(
        parsed,
        Date.now(),
        getBlockedUserIdsSet()
      ) as Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>;
    }
  } catch {}
}

export function getActiveStoriesMapSync(): Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]> {
  hydrateMemoryStoriesCacheSync();
  return filterActiveStoriesMapStrict(
    memoryStoriesCache,
    Date.now(),
    getBlockedUserIdsSet()
  ) as Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>;
}

export function getSyncStoriesForOwner(
  ownerKey?: string | null,
  ownerName?: string | null
): IKineticStoryItem[] {
  const map = getActiveStoriesMapSync();
  const k1 = normalizeStoryOwnerKey(ownerKey, ownerName);
  const k2 = normalizeStoryOwnerKey(ownerName, ownerKey);
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  const dedup = new Map<string, IKineticStoryItem>();
  [...(map[k1] || []), ...(k2 !== k1 ? map[k2] || [] : [])].forEach((s) => {
    if (s && s.id && isValidActiveStorySlide(s, nowMs)) dedup.set(s.id, s);
  });
  return Array.from(dedup.values()).sort((a, b) => a.createdAtMs - b.createdAtMs);
}

export function setMemoryStoriesCache(map: Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>): void {
  memoryStoriesCache = map;
  _hasHydratedMemorySync = true;
}

export function subscribeKineticStoriesUpdated(fn: () => void): () => void {
  storiesListeners.add(fn);
  return () => { storiesListeners.delete(fn); };
}
export const subscribeKineticStoriesUpdates = subscribeKineticStoriesUpdated;

export function emitKineticStoriesUpdated(): void {
  storiesListeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try { fn(); } catch {}
  });
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:stories-updated')); } catch {}
  }
}

export async function readLocalStoriesMap(): Promise<Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>> {
  hydrateMemoryStoriesCacheSync();
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORIES_STORAGE_KEY);
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    const cleaned = filterActiveStoriesMapStrict(parsed, Date.now(), getBlockedUserIdsSet()) as Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>;
    if (Object.keys(cleaned).length > 0 || !Object.keys(memoryStoriesCache).length) {
      memoryStoriesCache = cleaned;
    }
    return memoryStoriesCache;
  } catch {
    return memoryStoriesCache;
  }
}

let _lastSerializedStories = '';
export async function writeLocalStoriesMap(map: Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>): Promise<void> {
  memoryStoriesCache = map;
  _hasHydratedMemorySync = true;
  const serialized = JSON.stringify(map);
  if (serialized !== _lastSerializedStories) {
    _lastSerializedStories = serialized;
    try { await saveStoriesQuotaSafe(STORIES_STORAGE_KEY, serialized); } catch {}
  }
  emitKineticStoriesUpdated();
}

let _cachedStoriesTeamId: string | null = null;
async function ensureStoriesCloudHubId(createIfMissing = false): Promise<string | null> {
  if (_cachedStoriesTeamId) return _cachedStoriesTeamId;
  try {
    const { data: rows } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select('id').eq('codigo_invitacion', 'STORIES-V25').limit(1);
    if (Array.isArray(rows) && rows[0]?.id) {
      _cachedStoriesTeamId = String(rows[0].id);
      return _cachedStoriesTeamId;
    }
    if (!createIfMissing) return null;
    const { data: created } = await supabase
      .from('equipos_kinetic')
      .insert([{
        nombre: 'Kinetic Stories 24h Cloud Hub',
        disciplina: 'STORIES_24H',
        codigo_invitacion: 'STORIES-V25',
        cupo_maximo: 500,
        creador_nombre: 'Kinetic Oficial',
      }])
      .select('id')
      .single();
    if (created?.id) {
      _cachedStoriesTeamId = String(created.id);
      return _cachedStoriesTeamId;
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

let _lastCloudStoriesSyncMs = 0;
let _inflightCloudStoriesPromise: Promise<Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>> | null = null;

export async function syncStoriesFromCloud(force = true): Promise<Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>> {
  const localMap = await readLocalStoriesMap();
  if (!force && Date.now() - _lastCloudStoriesSyncMs < 6000) return localMap;
  if (_inflightCloudStoriesPromise) return _inflightCloudStoriesPromise;
  _inflightCloudStoriesPromise = (async () => {
    _lastCloudStoriesSyncMs = Date.now();
    try {
      const sinceIso = new Date(Date.now() - STORY_TTL_MS).toISOString();
      const hubId = await ensureStoriesCloudHubId();
      const [auditRes, hubMsgsRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabase.from('admin_audit_logs').select('accion, created_at').ilike('accion', `${CLOUD_STORY_PREFIX}%`).gte('created_at', sinceIso).order('created_at', { ascending: true }).limit(100),
        hubId
          ? supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').select('mensaje, created_at').eq('equipo_id', hubId).gte('created_at', sinceIso).order('created_at', { ascending: true }).limit(120)
          : Promise.resolve({ data: [] as any[] }),
      ]);

      const rawEvents: Array<{ rawText: string; created_at?: string }> = [];
      if (Array.isArray(hubMsgsRes.data)) {
        hubMsgsRes.data.forEach((r: any) => { if (r?.mensaje) rawEvents.push({ rawText: String(r.mensaje), created_at: r.created_at }); });
      }
      if (Array.isArray(auditRes.data)) {
        auditRes.data.forEach((r: any) => { if (r?.accion) rawEvents.push({ rawText: String(r.accion), created_at: r.created_at }); });
      }

      if (rawEvents.length > 0) {
        let changed = false;
        const merged: Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]> = Object.assign(Object.create(null), localMap);
        const ownArr = (k: string) => (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(merged, k) && Array.isArray(merged[k]) ? merged[k] : []);
        for (const row of rawEvents) {
          if (!row.rawText.startsWith(CLOUD_STORY_PREFIX)) continue;
          try {
            const payload = JSON.parse(row.rawText.slice(CLOUD_STORY_PREFIX.length));
            const keys = Array.from(new Set([
              payload?.ownerId ? normalizeStoryOwnerKey(payload.ownerId) : '',
              payload?.ownerKey ? normalizeStoryOwnerKey(payload.ownerKey) : '',
              payload?.ownerName ? normalizeStoryOwnerKey(payload.ownerName) : '',
            ].filter(Boolean)));
            if (payload?.type === 'DELETE_STORY' && payload?.storyId && keys.length > 0) {
              keys.forEach((k) => {
                const prev = ownArr(k);
                const next = prev.filter((s) => s.id !== payload.storyId);
                if (next.length !== prev.length) {
                  if (next.length > 0) merged[k] = next; else delete merged[k];
                  changed = true;
                }
              });
            } else if (payload?.type === 'VIEW_STORY' && payload?.storyId) {
              keys.forEach((k) => {
                const list = ownArr(k);
                const idx = list.findIndex((s) => s.id === payload.storyId);
                if (idx >= 0) {
                  const prevViewed = new Set<string>(list[idx].viewedBy || []);
                  if (Array.isArray(payload.viewedBy)) payload.viewedBy.forEach((v: string) => prevViewed.add(String(v)));
                  if (payload.viewerKey) prevViewed.add(String(payload.viewerKey));
                  const nextCount = Math.max(Number(list[idx].viewCount || 0), Number(payload.viewCount || 0), prevViewed.size);
                  if (nextCount !== Number(list[idx].viewCount || 0) || prevViewed.size !== (list[idx].viewedBy || []).length) {
                    list[idx] = { ...list[idx], viewedBy: Array.from(prevViewed), viewCount: nextCount };
                    changed = true;
                  }
                }
              });
            } else if (payload?.type === 'REACTION_STORY' && payload?.storyId) {
              keys.forEach((k) => {
                const list = ownArr(k);
                const idx = list.findIndex((s) => s.id === payload.storyId);
                if (idx >= 0) {
                  list[idx] = {
                    ...list[idx],
                    fireCount: Number(payload.fireCount ?? list[idx].fireCount ?? 0),
                    boltCount: Number(payload.boltCount ?? list[idx].boltCount ?? 0),
                    reactedFireBy: Array.isArray(payload.reactedFireBy) ? payload.reactedFireBy : list[idx].reactedFireBy || [],
                    reactedBoltBy: Array.isArray(payload.reactedBoltBy) ? payload.reactedBoltBy : list[idx].reactedBoltBy || [],
                  };
                  changed = true;
                }
              });
            } else if (payload?.id && payload?.imageUrl && (payload?.ownerId || payload?.ownerKey || payload?.ownerName)) {
              const cleanOwnerName = payload.ownerName === 'Terminal Global Kinetic' ? 'Kinetic Oficial' : String(payload.ownerName || 'Atleta Kinetic');
              const canonicalId = String(payload.ownerId || payload.ownerKey || '').trim() || undefined;
              const normKey = normalizeStoryOwnerKey(canonicalId || payload.ownerKey, cleanOwnerName);
              const normNameKey = normalizeStoryOwnerKey(cleanOwnerName, normKey);
              const story: IKineticStoryItem = {
                id: String(payload.id),
                ownerId: canonicalId,
                ownerKey: normKey,
                ownerName: cleanOwnerName,
                ownerSubtitle: payload.ownerSubtitle ? String(payload.ownerSubtitle) : undefined,
                ownerAvatar: isValidStoryMediaUrl(payload.ownerAvatar) ? String(payload.ownerAvatar) : undefined,
                imageUrl: String(payload.imageUrl),
                caption: String(payload.caption || ''),
                tag: String(payload.tag || 'ENTRENAMIENTO DEL DÍA'),
                createdAtMs: Number(payload.createdAtMs || Date.now()),
                fireCount: Number(payload.fireCount || 0),
                boltCount: Number(payload.boltCount || 0),
                viewCount: Number(payload.viewCount || 0),
                viewedBy: Array.isArray(payload.viewedBy) ? payload.viewedBy : [],
                reactedFireBy: Array.isArray(payload.reactedFireBy) ? payload.reactedFireBy : [],
                reactedBoltBy: Array.isArray(payload.reactedBoltBy) ? payload.reactedBoltBy : [],
                isPromo: Boolean(payload.isPromo || payload.linkedEvent || payload.promoEvent || payload.eventId),
                isB2B: Boolean(payload.isB2B),
                eventId: payload.eventId ? String(payload.eventId) : undefined,
                linkedEvent: payload.linkedEvent || payload.promoEvent || undefined,
              };
              if (isValidActiveStorySlide(story, Date.now())) {
                [normKey, normNameKey].forEach((k) => {
                  if (!k) return;
                  const list = [...ownArr(k)];
                  if (!list.some((s) => s.id === story.id)) {
                    list.push(story);
                    merged[k] = list;
                    changed = true;
                  }
                });
              }
            }
          } catch {}
        }
        const cleanedMerged = filterActiveStoriesMapStrict(merged, Date.now(), getBlockedUserIdsSet()) as Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>;
        if (changed) {
          await writeLocalStoriesMap(cleanedMerged);
          return cleanedMerged;
        }
        return cleanedMerged;
      }
    } catch {}
    return filterActiveStoriesMapStrict(localMap, Date.now(), getBlockedUserIdsSet()) as Record<string, IKineticStoryItem[]>;
  })();
  try {
    return await _inflightCloudStoriesPromise;
  } finally {
    _inflightCloudStoriesPromise = null;
  }
}

export async function uploadStoryImageToStorageCdn(compressedUri: string, ownerIdRaw: string): Promise<string> {
  if (!compressedUri) return '';
  if (isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(compressedUri)) return compressedUri;
  if (/^http:\/\//i.test(compressedUri)) return '';
  try {
    const fileBytes = await readMediaUriAsUint8Array(compressedUri);
    const imgCheck = validateSafeStorageImagePayload({ bytes: fileBytes, uriOrName: compressedUri });
    if (!imgCheck.ok || !fileBytes) {
      return '';
    }
    let authUid = '';
    const { data: sessData } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    authUid = String(sessData?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
    if (!authUid && ownerIdRaw) {
      const refreshed = await supabase.auth.refreshSession().catch(() => null);
      authUid = String(refreshed?.data?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
    }
    if (!authUid) {
      return isValidStoryMediaUrl(compressedUri) && compressedUri.startsWith('data:image/') ? compressedUri : '';
    }
    const storagePath = `${authUid}/story_${Date.now()}.${imgCheck.ext || 'jpg'}`;
    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
      .from(STORIES_STORAGE_BUCKET)
      .upload(storagePath, fileBytes, { contentType: imgCheck.contentType || 'image/jpeg', cacheControl: '604800', upsert: true });
    if (uploadError) {
      return '';
    }
    const { data: publicUrlData } = supabase.storage.from(STORIES_STORAGE_BUCKET).getPublicUrl(storagePath);
    const publicUrl = String(publicUrlData?.publicUrl || '').trim();
    return isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(publicUrl) ? publicUrl : '';
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

export async function publishStoryEventToCloud(payload: Record<string, any>): Promise<void> {
  const serialized = `${CLOUD_STORY_PREFIX}${JSON.stringify(payload)}`;
  try {
    const hubId = await ensureStoriesCloudHubId(true);
    const tasks: Promise<any>[] = [
      Promise.resolve(supabase.from('admin_audit_logs').insert({ accion: serialized, cantidad_kc: 0 })).catch(() => {}),
    ];
    if (hubId) {
      tasks.push(
        Promise.resolve(
          supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').insert([{ equipo_id: hubId, usuario_nombre: String(payload.ownerName || 'Kinetic'), mensaje: serialized }]),
        ).catch(() => {}),
      );
    }
    await Promise.allSettled(tasks);
  } catch {}
}

export async function getActiveStoriesForOwner(ownerKey?: string | null, ownerName?: string | null): Promise<IKineticStoryItem[]> {
  const map = await syncStoriesFromCloud(false);
  const k1 = normalizeStoryOwnerKey(ownerKey, ownerName);
  const k2 = normalizeStoryOwnerKey(ownerName, ownerKey);
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  const dedup = new Map<string, IKineticStoryItem>();
  [...(map[k1] || []), ...(k2 !== k1 ? map[k2] || [] : [])].forEach((s) => {
    if (s && s.id && isValidActiveStorySlide(s, nowMs)) dedup.set(s.id, s);
  });
  return Array.from(dedup.values()).sort((a, b) => a.createdAtMs - b.createdAtMs);
}

export async function hasActiveStoriesForOwner(ownerKey?: string | null, ownerName?: string | null): Promise<boolean> {
  const list = await getActiveStoriesForOwner(ownerKey, ownerName);
  return list.length > 0;
}

export async function checkHasActiveCustomStory(
  ownerOrId?: string | IKineticStoryOwner | null,
  fallbackName?: string | null,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!ownerOrId) return false;
  if (typeof ownerOrId === 'object') return hasActiveStoriesForOwner(ownerOrId.id, ownerOrId.name);
  return hasActiveStoriesForOwner(String(ownerOrId), fallbackName);
}

    // === src/utils/kineticPermissionsOrchestratorLeaf.ts === //

export const LOCATION_INITIAL_DELAY_MS = 1200;
export const NOTIFICATIONS_AFTER_LOCATION_DELAY_MS = 2500;

export interface IPermissionsStaggerSnapshot {
  locationScheduled: boolean;
  locationSettled: boolean;
  notificationsScheduled: boolean;
  notificationsSettled: boolean;
}

export function createPermissionsStaggerScheduler(delays?: {
  locationDelayMs?: number;
  notificationsDelayMs?: number;
}) {
  const locDelay = Math.max(LOCATION_INITIAL_DELAY_MS, Number(delays?.locationDelayMs) || LOCATION_INITIAL_DELAY_MS);
  const notifDelay = Math.max(
    NOTIFICATIONS_AFTER_LOCATION_DELAY_MS,
    Number(delays?.notificationsDelayMs) || NOTIFICATIONS_AFTER_LOCATION_DELAY_MS
  );

  let locationScheduled = false;
  let locationSettled = false;
  let notificationsScheduled = false;
  let notificationsSettled = false;
  let locationTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  let notifTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  let locationWaiters: Array<() => void> = [];

  const markLocationSettled = () => {
    if (locationSettled) return;
    locationSettled = true;
    const waiters = locationWaiters;
    locationWaiters = [];
    waiters.forEach((resolve) => resolve());
  };

  const waitForLocationSettled = (maxWaitMs = locDelay + 6000): { promise: Promise<void>; cancelWait: () => void } => {
    if (locationSettled) return { promise: Promise.resolve(), cancelWait: () => {} };
    let safety: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    let doneFn: (() => void) | null = null;
    const promise = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      doneFn = () => {
        if (safety) {
          clearTimeout(safety);
          safety = null;
        }
        resolve();
      };
      safety = setTimeout(() => { doneFn?.(); }, Math.max(500, maxWaitMs));
      locationWaiters.push(doneFn);
    });
    const cancelWait = () => {
      if (safety) {
        clearTimeout(safety);
        safety = null;
      }
      if (doneFn) {
        locationWaiters = locationWaiters.filter((fn) => fn !== doneFn);
      }
    };
    return { promise, cancelWait };
  };

  const scheduleLocationPrompt = (runLocationPrompt: () => Promise<unknown> | unknown): (() => void) => {
    if (locationScheduled || locationSettled) return () => {};
    locationScheduled = true;
    locationTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      locationTimer = null;
      Promise.resolve()
        .then(() => runLocationPrompt())
        .catch(() => undefined)
        .finally(markLocationSettled);
    }, locDelay);
    return () => {
      if (locationTimer) {
        clearTimeout(locationTimer);
        locationTimer = null;
        locationScheduled = false;
      }
    };
  };

  const scheduleNotificationsPrompt = (
    runNotificationsPrompt: () => Promise<unknown> | unknown
  ): (() => void) => {
    if (notificationsScheduled || notificationsSettled) return () => {};
    notificationsScheduled = true;
    let cancelled = false;
    const waiter = waitForLocationSettled();
    void waiter.promise.then(() => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      notifTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        notifTimer = null;
        if (cancelled) return;
        Promise.resolve()
          .then(() => runNotificationsPrompt())
          .catch(() => undefined)
          .finally(() => {
            notificationsSettled = true;
          });
      }, notifDelay);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      waiter.cancelWait();
      if (notifTimer) {
        clearTimeout(notifTimer);
        notifTimer = null;
      }
      notificationsScheduled = false;
    };
  };

  const reset = () => {
    if (locationTimer) clearTimeout(locationTimer);
    if (notifTimer) clearTimeout(notifTimer);
    locationTimer = null;
    notifTimer = null;
    locationScheduled = false;
    locationSettled = false;
    notificationsScheduled = false;
    notificationsSettled = false;
    locationWaiters = [];
  };

  const getSnapshot = (): IPermissionsStaggerSnapshot => ({
    locationScheduled,
    locationSettled,
    notificationsScheduled,
    notificationsSettled,
  });

  return {
    locationDelayMs: locDelay,
    notificationsDelayMs: notifDelay,
    scheduleLocationPrompt,
    waitForLocationSettled,
    scheduleNotificationsPrompt,
    markLocationSettled,
    reset,
    getSnapshot,
  };
}

export const kineticPermissionsOrchestrator = createPermissionsStaggerScheduler();

    FILE: supabase/migrations/20261104120000_supabase_pro_pg_cron_indexes.sql

    -- =====================================================================================
-- KINETIC OS v2.5 — MIGRACIÓN SUPABASE PRO: PG_CRON Y OPTIMIZACIÓN MICRO COMPUTE
-- Misión: Automatización diaria de expiración y reducción drástica de CPU/I/O.
-- Proyecto Supabase: KineticApp S.A.S. | Entorno: Producción Supabase Pro
-- Propiedades: 100% Idempotente, Zero-Downtime, ACID-Safe.
-- =====================================================================================

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. ACTIVACIÓN DE EXTENSIÓN PG_CRON
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_cron;

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. ARMONIZACIÓN PREVIA DE COLUMNAS DE AUDITORÍA Y VIGENCIA
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS public.reservas
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW();

ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS public.reservas
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fecha_clase DATE;

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. FUNCIÓN DETERMINÍSTICA DE EXPIRACIÓN DE PASES / RESERVAS OBSOLETAS
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.k_cron_expirar_reservas_y_pases()
RETURNS INTEGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_total_expiradas INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Actualizar reservas transitorias o no canjeadas cuya fecha de clase haya caducado
  UPDATE public.reservas
     SET estado = 'expirada',
         updated_at = NOW()
   WHERE estado IN ('activa', 'confirmada', 'pendiente')
     AND (
       (fecha_clase IS NOT NULL AND fecha_clase < CURRENT_DATE)
       OR (fecha_hora IS NOT NULL AND fecha_hora < (NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours'))
       OR (fecha IS NOT NULL AND fecha < CURRENT_DATE)
       OR (created_at < (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'))
     );

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_total_expiradas = ROW_COUNT;

  -- Bitácora forense de auditoría en admin_audit_logs si existe la tabla
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables
     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'admin_audit_logs'
  ) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.admin_audit_logs (accion, detalle, created_at)
    VALUES (
      'CRON_EXPIRACION_PASES_PRO',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'expiradas', v_total_expiradas,
        'ejecutado_en', NOW(),
        'motor', 'pg_cron_supabase_pro'
      ),
      NOW()
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN v_total_expiradas;
END;
$$;

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. PROGRAMACIÓN RECURRENTE DEL CRON JOB (04:00 AM UTC DIARIO)
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DO $$
BEGIN
  -- Desprogramar job anterior si ya existiera para evitar duplicación
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = 'kinetic_pro_expiracion_pases_diaria') THEN
    PERFORM cron.unschedule('kinetic_pro_expiracion_pases_diaria');
  END IF;

  -- Programar ejecución diaria a las 04:00 AM UTC ('0 4 * * *')
  PERFORM cron.schedule(
    'kinetic_pro_expiracion_pases_diaria',
    '0 4 * * *',
    'SELECT public.k_cron_expirar_reservas_y_pases();'
  );
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RAISE NOTICE 'pg_cron job schedule warning: %', SQLERRM;
END $$;

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. ÍNDICES COMPUESTOS B-TREE DE ALTA FRECUENCIA (MINIMIZACIÓN MICRO COMPUTE CPU)
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Terminal B2B y sensor láser: filtrado instantáneo por club, estado y antigüedad
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reservas_negocio_estado_created
  ON public.reservas(negocio_id, estado, created_at DESC);

-- Bóveda Atleta y Radar Anti No-Show: resolución sub-milisegundo de reservas activas
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reservas_usuario_estado_fecha
  ON public.reservas(usuario_id, estado, fecha_clase);

-- Optimización de barrido pg_cron: erradica escaneo secuencial en UPDATE nocturno
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reservas_cron_sweep
  ON public.reservas(estado, fecha_clase, created_at)
  WHERE estado IN ('activa', 'confirmada', 'pendiente');

-- Cartelera y disponibilidad en tiempo real: conteo de cupos por servicio y estado
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reservas_servicio_estado
  ON public.reservas(servicio_id, estado);

-- Sensor óptico B2B: verificación instantánea de QR por negocio
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reservas_negocio_qr_token
  ON public.reservas(negocio_id, qr_token);

    EXECUTE 'DELETE FROM public.admin_audit_logs';

  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'comunidad_comentarios') THEN
    EXECUTE 'DELETE FROM public.comunidad_comentarios';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'comunidad_posts') THEN
    EXECUTE 'DELETE FROM public.comunidad_posts';

    EXECUTE 'DELETE FROM public.mensajes_directos';
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Resetear KinetiCoins de prueba en todos los perfiles para iniciar pruebas limpias
UPDATE public.perfiles
SET kc_membresia = 0,
    kc_topup = 0,
    saldo_kc = 0,
    perdones_mensuales_usados = 0,
    cajas_nivel_reclamadas = 0,
    kc_ganados_cajas = 0,
    recompensas_reclamadas = '{}';

-- Eliminar los 3 registros basura del directorio de afiliados conservando los prospectos reales
DELETE FROM public.afiliados
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(nombre)) IN ('atleta 5975', 'kinetic oficial', 'sede kinetic');

-- 2. [V1-02] RESTAURAR LECTURA RLS DE PERFILES PARA ADMIN HUB (TESORERÍA, RADIOGRAFÍA Y DIRECTORIO)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Lectura de perfiles para usuarios autenticados y admin" ON public.perfiles;
CREATE POLICY "Lectura de perfiles para usuarios autenticados y admin"
ON public.perfiles FOR SELECT
USING ((SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL);

-- 3. [V11-06 & V12-02] AISLAMIENTO ESTRICTO DE PRIVACIDAD EN CHATS 1 A 1 Y GRUPALES
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.mensajes_directos (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  sender_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  recipient_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sender_nombre TEXT,
  recipient_nombre TEXT,
  mensaje TEXT NOT NULL,
  leido BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Índices B-Tree obligatorios en FKs y compuesto de conversación (Pilar Big-Tech)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mensajes_directos_sender_id
  ON public.mensajes_directos (sender_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mensajes_directos_recipient_id
  ON public.mensajes_directos (recipient_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mensajes_directos_conv_created
  ON public.mensajes_directos (sender_id, recipient_id, created_at DESC);

ALTER TABLE public.mensajes_directos ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Candado inquebrantable: NADIE (ni siquiera Admin) puede leer un chat 1 a 1 donde no sea sender_id o recipient_id
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Privacidad absoluta 1 a 1 lectura" ON public.mensajes_directos;
CREATE POLICY "Privacidad absoluta 1 a 1 lectura"
ON public.mensajes_directos FOR SELECT
USING ((SELECT auth.uid()) = sender_id OR (SELECT auth.uid()) = recipient_id);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Privacidad absoluta 1 a 1 envio" ON public.mensajes_directos;
CREATE POLICY "Privacidad absoluta 1 a 1 envio"
ON public.mensajes_directos FOR INSERT
WITH CHECK ((SELECT auth.uid()) = sender_id);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Privacidad absoluta 1 a 1 borrado" ON public.mensajes_directos;
CREATE POLICY "Privacidad absoluta 1 a 1 borrado"
ON public.mensajes_directos FOR DELETE
USING ((SELECT auth.uid()) = sender_id OR (SELECT auth.uid()) = recipient_id);

-- Candado RLS en chats grupales: solo miembros aceptados del escuadrón o su creador ven los mensajes del grupo
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Lectura de equipo_mensajes" ON public.equipo_mensajes;
CREATE POLICY "Lectura de equipo_mensajes"
ON public.equipo_mensajes FOR SELECT
USING (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.equipo_miembros em
    WHERE em.equipo_id = equipo_mensajes.equipo_id
      AND em.usuario_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
      AND em.estado IN ('aceptado', 'activo')
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.equipos_kinetic eq
    WHERE eq.id = equipo_mensajes.equipo_id
      AND eq.creador_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
  )
);

-- Permitir al líder eliminar su propio equipo [V11-05] y al Admin moderar equipos [V12-01]

CREATE POLICY "Eliminacion creador o admin equipos_kinetic"
ON public.equipos_kinetic FOR DELETE
USING (
  (SELECT auth.uid()) = creador_id
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.perfiles p
    WHERE p.id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND LOWER(COALESCE(p.rol, '')) IN ('admin', 'fundador')
  )
);

-- 1) [P0-01] Sello columnar de qr_token en public.reservas + RPCs de minimo privilegio
REVOKE SELECT ON TABLE public.reservas FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
DO $$
DECLARE v_cols TEXT;
BEGIN
  SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(column_name), ', ' ORDER BY ordinal_position) INTO v_cols
  FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'reservas' AND column_name <> 'qr_token';
  IF v_cols IS NOT NULL THEN EXECUTE format('GRANT SELECT (%s) ON TABLE public.reservas TO authenticated', v_cols); END IF;
  IF to_regprocedure('public.resolver_reserva_escaneo_b2b(text, text)') IS NOT NULL THEN
    ALTER FUNCTION public.resolver_reserva_escaneo_b2b(TEXT, TEXT) SET search_path = public;
  END IF;
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.obtener_semilla_qr_reserva_propia(p_reserva_id UUID)
RETURNS TEXT LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE v_uid UUID := (SELECT auth.uid()); v_tok TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL OR p_reserva_id IS NULL OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(v_uid)), FALSE) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT r.qr_token INTO v_tok FROM public.reservas r WHERE r.id = p_reserva_id AND r.usuario_id = v_uid LIMIT 1;
  RETURN v_tok;
END;
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.obtener_semilla_qr_reserva_propia(UUID) FROM PUBLIC, anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.obtener_semilla_qr_reserva_propia(UUID) TO authenticated;

RETURNS TABLE (id UUID, qr_token TEXT) LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE SET search_path = public AS $$
  SELECT r.id, r.qr_token FROM public.reservas r WHERE (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner((SELECT auth.uid()))), FALSE)
    AND r.usuario_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND r.qr_token IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 60;
$$;
