  AND LOWER(name) ~ '\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|heic|heif|mp4|mov)$' AND NOT (LOWER(name) ~ '\.(svg|svgz|html|htm|xhtml|xml|js|mjs|cjs|php|exe|sh)(\.|$)')
);
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "avatars_auth_update_v282" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "avatars_auth_update_v282" ON storage.objects FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
USING (bucket_id = 'avatars' AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (SELECT auth.uid())::text OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE)))
WITH CHECK (
  bucket_id = 'avatars' AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (SELECT auth.uid())::text OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE))
  AND LOWER(name) ~ '\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|heic|heif|mp4|mov)$' AND NOT (LOWER(name) ~ '\.(svg|svgz|html|htm|xhtml|xml|js|mjs|cjs|php|exe|sh)(\.|$)')
);

-- 3) [P1-02] Ventas Flash <3h en America/Mazatlan + cuantizacion estricta a 10 KC
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.procesar_reserva_escrow(
  p_usuario_id UUID, p_negocio_nombre TEXT, p_servicio_nombre TEXT, p_precio_kc NUMERIC,
  p_servicio_id UUID DEFAULT NULL, p_fecha_clase TEXT DEFAULT NULL, p_spot_number INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
  p_split_count INTEGER DEFAULT 1, p_es_pase_maestro BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE
) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid()); v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_precio_base NUMERIC := 0; v_total_kc INTEGER := 0; v_escrow INTEGER := 0; v_puerta INTEGER := 0;
  v_srv_negocio TEXT := ''; v_srv_titulo TEXT := ''; v_srv_estado TEXT := ''; v_srv_activo BOOLEAN := TRUE;
  v_srv_fecha DATE; v_srv_hora TIME; v_srv_freq TEXT := ''; v_srv_desc TEXT := ''; v_srv_attrs JSONB := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_cupo_max INTEGER := 30; v_ocupados INTEGER := 0; v_mem NUMERIC := 0; v_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_use_mem NUMERIC := 0; v_use_top NUMERIC := 0; v_nivel TEXT := ''; v_tier_pct INTEGER := 0;
  v_club_flash_pct INTEGER := 0; v_pct INTEGER := 0; v_is_flash BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_srv_flash_col BOOLEAN := FALSE; v_srv_flash_pct_col INTEGER := 0; v_srv_afiliado_id UUID;
  v_afiliado_estado TEXT; v_ev_ts TIMESTAMPTZ; v_f_eff TEXT; v_h_parts TEXT[]; v_h_eff TEXT; v_h_full TEXT;
  v_reserva_id UUID; v_qr_token TEXT; v_sched JSONB; v_is_official BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_split INTEGER := LEAST(10, GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_split_count, 1))); v_fecha TEXT := NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(p_fecha_clase, '')), 10), '');
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (p_usuario_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para reservar a nombre de otro atleta.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  IF (NOT v_is_admin AND COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(v_caller)), FALSE)) OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(p_usuario_id)), FALSE) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ACCOUNT_ATHLETE_BOOKING_FORBIDDEN: Las cuentas operativas B2B no pueden realizar reservas de atleta.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_servicio_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(s.precio_kc, 0), COALESCE(s.cupo_maximo, 30), TRIM(COALESCE(s.negocio_nombre, '')), TRIM(COALESCE(s.nombre_servicio, '')),
      LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.estado, 'aprobado'))), COALESCE(s.activo, TRUE), COALESCE(s.fecha, NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(to_jsonb(s)->>'fecha_clase', '')), 10), '')::date),
      s.hora_inicio, COALESCE(s.frecuencia, ''), COALESCE(s.descripcion, ''), COALESCE(s.atributos, '{}'::jsonb),
      COALESCE(s.es_venta_flash, FALSE), COALESCE(s.descuento_flash_pct, 0), s.afiliado_id
    INTO v_precio_base, v_cupo_max, v_srv_negocio, v_srv_titulo, v_srv_estado, v_srv_activo, v_srv_fecha,
      v_srv_hora, v_srv_freq, v_srv_desc, v_srv_attrs, v_srv_flash_col, v_srv_flash_pct_col, v_srv_afiliado_id
    FROM public.servicios s WHERE s.id = p_servicio_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICIO_INEXISTENTE: La experiencia seleccionada ya no existe.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
    IF NOT v_srv_activo OR v_srv_estado NOT IN ('activo', 'aprobado', '') OR COALESCE((v_srv_attrs->>'eliminado')::boolean, FALSE) OR COALESCE((v_srv_attrs->>'cancelado')::boolean, FALSE) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICIO_RETIRADO: La experiencia seleccionada fue pausada o retirada.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
    END IF;
    v_is_official := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_negocio, ''))) IN ('kinetic oficial', 'kinetic sports club', '');
    IF v_srv_afiliado_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_attrs->>'afiliado_id', '')), '') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
      v_srv_afiliado_id := (v_srv_attrs->>'afiliado_id')::uuid;
    END IF;
    IF NOT v_is_official AND v_srv_afiliado_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, ''))) INTO v_afiliado_estado FROM public.afiliados a WHERE a.id = v_srv_afiliado_id;
      IF FOUND AND v_afiliado_estado IN ('inactivo', 'prospecto', 'oculto', 'pendiente', 'suspendido', 'eliminado', 'rechazado') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICIO_RETIRADO: Esta sede se encuentra temporalmente inactiva.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    v_sched := public.es_fecha_valida_servicio_mazatlan(v_fecha, v_srv_fecha, v_srv_hora, v_srv_freq, v_srv_desc, v_srv_attrs);
    IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT COALESCE((v_sched->>'valid')::boolean, FALSE) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '%', COALESCE(NULLIF(v_sched->>'reason', ''), 'HORARIO_NO_DISPONIBLE: Fecha u horario fuera de vigencia.') USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    v_fecha := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_sched->>'resolved_date', ''), v_fecha, to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD'));
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_ocupados FROM public.reservas r WHERE r.servicio_id = p_servicio_id AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')
      AND COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(r.fecha_clase, '')), 10), ''), to_char(COALESCE(r.created_at, NOW()) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = v_fecha;
    IF v_ocupados >= v_cupo_max THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CUPO_AGOTADO: No quedan lugares disponibles en esta sesion.'; END IF;
    IF p_spot_number IS NOT NULL THEN
      IF p_spot_number < 1 OR p_spot_number > v_cupo_max THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Estacion #% fuera del rango permitido (%).', p_spot_number, v_cupo_max USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas r WHERE r.servicio_id = p_servicio_id AND r.spot_number = p_spot_number AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')
        AND COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(r.fecha_clase, '')), 10), ''), to_char(COALESCE(r.created_at, NOW()) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = v_fecha
      ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SPOT_OCUPADO: La estacion #% ya fue reservada.', p_spot_number USING ERRCODE = '23505'; END IF;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF NOT v_is_admin THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reserva sin servicio de catalogo prohibida para clientes.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
    v_precio_base := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_precio_kc, 0)); v_fecha := COALESCE(v_fecha, to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD'));
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0), LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(nivel, ''))) INTO v_mem, v_top, v_nivel FROM public.perfiles WHERE id = p_usuario_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil de atleta no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  v_f_eff := COALESCE(v_fecha, to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD'));
  v_h_parts := REGEXP_MATCH(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_hora::text, '')), '^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?');
  v_h_eff := CASE WHEN v_h_parts IS NOT NULL THEN LPAD(v_h_parts[1], 2, '0') || ':' || v_h_parts[2] ELSE '08:00' END;
  v_h_full := CASE WHEN v_h_parts IS NOT NULL THEN v_h_eff || ':' || COALESCE(v_h_parts[3], '00') ELSE '08:00:00' END;

  IF COALESCE(p_es_pase_maestro, FALSE) THEN
    IF NOT v_is_admin THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para emitir Pase Maestro Admin 0 KC.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
    v_total_kc := 0; v_escrow := 0; v_puerta := 0;
  ELSE
    IF v_precio_base < 0 OR (v_precio_base > 0 AND MOD(v_precio_base, 10) <> 0) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Precio base invalido (debe ser multiplo de 10 KC).'; END IF;
    IF v_f_eff ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' AND v_h_full ~ '^\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$' THEN
      v_ev_ts := ((LEFT(TRIM(v_f_eff), 10) || ' ' || v_h_full)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan');
      IF v_ev_ts > NOW() AND v_ev_ts <= (NOW() + INTERVAL '180 minutes') THEN v_is_flash := TRUE; END IF;
    END IF;
    IF v_srv_flash_col OR COALESCE((v_srv_attrs->>'es_venta_flash')::boolean, FALSE) THEN v_is_flash := TRUE; END IF;
    IF v_is_flash AND v_precio_base > 0 THEN
      v_tier_pct := CASE WHEN v_nivel ~ '(platinum|platino|leyenda|black)' THEN 20 WHEN v_nivel ~ '(gold|oro)' THEN 15 WHEN v_nivel ~ '(silver|plata)' THEN 10 WHEN v_nivel ~ '(bronze|bronce)' THEN 5
        WHEN v_nivel = '' OR v_nivel ~ '(acceso\s*base|base\s*access|free|ninguno|top[\s_-]*up)' THEN
          CASE WHEN v_mem >= 3600 THEN 20 WHEN v_mem >= 2500 THEN 15 WHEN v_mem >= 1500 THEN 10 WHEN v_mem >= 600 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END;
      v_club_flash_pct := LEAST(40, GREATEST(0, GREATEST(v_srv_flash_pct_col, COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(v_srv_attrs->>'descuento_flash_pct', ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::int, 0))));
      v_pct := CASE WHEN v_tier_pct > 0 THEN LEAST(40, GREATEST(v_tier_pct, v_club_flash_pct)) ELSE 0 END;
    END IF;
    IF v_precio_base = 0 THEN v_total_kc := 0; v_escrow := 0; v_puerta := 0;
    ELSE
      v_total_kc := GREATEST(10, (ROUND(((v_precio_base * (100 - v_pct)) / 100.0) / 10.0)::integer * 10));
      v_escrow := CASE WHEN v_total_kc >= 20 THEN GREATEST(10, LEAST(v_total_kc - 10, (ROUND((v_total_kc * 0.40) / 10.0)::integer * 10))) ELSE 10 END;
      v_puerta := v_total_kc - v_escrow;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true); PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  IF v_escrow > 0 THEN
    IF (v_mem + v_top) < v_escrow THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SALDO_INSUFICIENTE: Tu boveda no cubre el 40%% de custodia (% KC).', v_escrow; END IF;
    v_use_mem := LEAST(v_mem, v_escrow); v_use_top := v_escrow - v_use_mem;
    UPDATE public.perfiles SET kc_membresia = v_mem - v_use_mem, kc_topup = v_top - v_use_top, saldo_kc = (v_mem - v_use_mem) + (v_top - v_use_top) WHERE id = p_usuario_id;
  END IF;
  v_qr_token := md5(gen_random_uuid()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || random()::text);
  INSERT INTO public.reservas (usuario_id, servicio_id, negocio_nombre, servicio, precio_kc, costo_total, monto_escrow, monto_puerta, escrow_membresia, escrow_topup,
    estado, qr_token, fecha_clase, hora_inicio, spot_number, split_count, es_pase_maestro, es_venta_flash, descuento_flash_pct)
  VALUES (p_usuario_id, p_servicio_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(v_srv_negocio, ''), TRIM(COALESCE(p_negocio_nombre, ''))),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(v_srv_titulo, ''), TRIM(COALESCE(p_servicio_nombre, ''))), v_total_kc, v_total_kc, v_escrow, v_puerta, v_use_mem, v_use_top,
    'confirmada', v_qr_token, v_fecha, v_h_eff, p_spot_number, v_split, COALESCE(p_es_pase_maestro, FALSE), v_is_flash, v_pct)
  RETURNING id INTO v_reserva_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_reserva_id, 'reserva_id', v_reserva_id, 'qr_token', v_qr_token, 'precio_kc', v_total_kc, 'es_venta_flash', v_is_flash,
    'descuento_flash_pct', v_pct, 'monto_escrow', v_escrow, 'monto_puerta', v_puerta, 'escrow_membresia', v_use_mem, 'escrow_topup', v_use_top,
    'fecha_clase', v_fecha, 'hora_inicio', v_h_eff, 'spot_number', p_spot_number, 'split_count', v_split, 'es_pase_maestro', COALESCE(p_es_pase_maestro, FALSE));
END;
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.procesar_reserva_escrow(UUID, TEXT, TEXT, NUMERIC, UUID, TEXT, INTEGER, INTEGER, BOOLEAN) FROM PUBLIC, anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.procesar_reserva_escrow(UUID, TEXT, TEXT, NUMERIC, UUID, TEXT, INTEGER, INTEGER, BOOLEAN) TO authenticated;

-- 4) [P1-04a] Split-Escrow 1/N Atomico + trigger 10 KC + listado seguro sin qr_token
ALTER TABLE public.split_escrow_invitaciones
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS monto_liquidado_kc NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS liquidado_membresia_kc NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS liquidado_topup_kc NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reembolsada BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS liquidada_at TIMESTAMPTZ, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reembolsada_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_split_escrow_invitado_id ON public.split_escrow_invitaciones (invitado_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_split_escrow_anfitrion_created ON public.split_escrow_invitaciones (anfitrion_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_split_escrow_insert_v282()
RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE v_res RECORD; v_eff_split INT; v_existing_cnt INT := 0; v_dup_guest BOOLEAN := FALSE; v_cap_share NUMERIC; v_existing_sum NUMERIC := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT id, usuario_id, monto_escrow, split_count, estado INTO v_res FROM public.reservas WHERE id = NEW.reserva_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_res.estado, ''))) NOT IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESERVA_INACTIVA: No se pueden emitir invitaciones sobre esta reserva.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  IF NEW.anfitrion_id IS NULL OR NEW.anfitrion_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_res.usuario_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solo el titular de la reserva puede emitir invitaciones Split-Escrow.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.invitado_id IS NULL OR NEW.invitado_id IN (NEW.anfitrion_id, v_res.usuario_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invitado Split-Escrow invalido (no puede ser el mismo anfitrion).' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
  IF COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(NEW.invitado_id)), FALSE) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ACCOUNT_ATHLETE_BOOKING_FORBIDDEN: Cuentas B2B no pueden recibir Split-Escrow.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  IF COALESCE(NEW.monto_kc_parte, 0) < 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Monto Split-Escrow invalido.' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
  SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(monto_kc_parte), 0), COALESCE(BOOL_OR(invitado_id = NEW.invitado_id), FALSE) INTO v_existing_cnt, v_existing_sum, v_dup_guest FROM public.split_escrow_invitaciones WHERE reserva_id = NEW.reserva_id AND LOWER(COALESCE(estado, 'pendiente')) NOT IN ('rechazada', 'cancelada');
  IF v_dup_guest THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Este aliado ya tiene una invitacion activa en esta reserva.' USING ERRCODE = '23505'; END IF;
  IF v_existing_cnt >= 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Limite maximo de 3 invitados Split-Escrow alcanzado.' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
  v_eff_split := LEAST(4, GREATEST(2, COALESCE(v_res.split_count, 1), v_existing_cnt + 2));
  v_cap_share := FLOOR((GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_res.monto_escrow, 0)) / v_eff_split::numeric) / 10.0) * 10;
  NEW.monto_kc_parte := LEAST(v_cap_share, FLOOR(COALESCE(NEW.monto_kc_parte, 0) / 10.0) * 10);
  IF NEW.monto_kc_parte > 0 AND (v_existing_sum + NEW.monto_kc_parte) > GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_res.monto_escrow, 0) - GREATEST(10, v_cap_share)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SPLIT_OVERFLOW: Las invitaciones exceden la proporcion Split-Escrow permitida.' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
  NEW.estado := 'pendiente'; NEW.monto_liquidado_kc := 0; NEW.liquidado_membresia_kc := 0; NEW.liquidado_topup_kc := 0; NEW.reembolsada := FALSE; NEW.liquidada_at := NULL; NEW.reembolsada_at := NULL;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_guard_split_escrow_insert_v282 ON public.split_escrow_invitaciones;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_split_escrow_insert_v282 BEFORE INSERT ON public.split_escrow_invitaciones FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_split_escrow_insert_v282();

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.responder_split_escrow_invitacion(UUID, TEXT);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.responder_split_escrow_invitacion(p_invitacion_id UUID, p_aceptar BOOLEAN)
RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid()); v_res_id UUID; v_inv_guest UUID; v_res_ok BOOLEAN := FALSE; v_inv RECORD; v_res RECORD;
  v_guest RECORD; v_host RECORD; v_parte NUMERIC := 0; v_use_mem NUMERIC := 0; v_use_top NUMERIC := 0; v_settled_sum NUMERIC := 0; v_host_mem_rem NUMERIC := 0; v_host_add_mem NUMERIC := 0; v_host_add_top NUMERIC := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida para responder Split-Escrow.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  IF COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(v_caller)), FALSE) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ACCOUNT_ATHLETE_BOOKING_FORBIDDEN: Cuentas B2B no pueden aceptar Split-Escrow.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  SELECT reserva_id, invitado_id INTO v_res_id, v_inv_guest FROM public.split_escrow_invitaciones WHERE id = p_invitacion_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invitacion Split-Escrow no encontrada.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  IF v_inv_guest IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solo el atleta invitado puede responder esta invitacion.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_res FROM public.reservas WHERE id = v_res_id FOR UPDATE; v_res_ok := FOUND;
  SELECT * INTO v_inv FROM public.split_escrow_invitaciones WHERE id = p_invitacion_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invitacion Split-Escrow no encontrada.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  IF LOWER(COALESCE(v_inv.estado, 'pendiente')) <> 'pendiente' THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'idempotent', TRUE, 'id', p_invitacion_id, 'estado', LOWER(COALESCE(v_inv.estado, 'pendiente')), 'monto_liquidado_kc', COALESCE(v_inv.monto_liquidado_kc, 0)); END IF;
  IF NOT v_res_ok OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_res.estado, ''))) NOT IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESERVA_INACTIVA: La reserva principal ya no esta activa.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  IF v_inv.anfitrion_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_res.usuario_id OR v_inv.invitado_id IN (v_inv.anfitrion_id, v_res.usuario_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SPLIT_INVALID_PARTICIPANTS: Invitacion Split-Escrow invalida para esta reserva.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  IF NOT COALESCE(p_aceptar, FALSE) THEN
    UPDATE public.split_escrow_invitaciones SET estado = 'rechazada', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_invitacion_id;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'idempotent', FALSE, 'id', p_invitacion_id, 'estado', 'rechazada', 'monto_liquidado_kc', 0);
  END IF;
  v_parte := TRUNC(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_inv.monto_kc_parte, 0)));
  IF v_parte > 0 AND MOD(v_parte, 10) <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Monto Split-Escrow debe ser multiplo exacto de 10 KC.' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
  IF v_parte > 0 THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(monto_liquidado_kc), 0) INTO v_settled_sum FROM public.split_escrow_invitaciones WHERE reserva_id = v_inv.reserva_id AND LOWER(COALESCE(estado, '')) = 'aceptada' AND id <> p_invitacion_id;
    IF (v_settled_sum + v_parte) > COALESCE(v_res.monto_escrow, 0) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SPLIT_OVERFLOW: Excede el monto Escrow original.' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.perfiles WHERE id IN (v_inv.invitado_id, v_inv.anfitrion_id) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT id, COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) AS kc_membresia, COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) AS kc_topup INTO v_guest FROM public.perfiles WHERE id = v_inv.invitado_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil de invitado no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
    SELECT id, COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) AS kc_membresia, COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) AS kc_topup INTO v_host FROM public.perfiles WHERE id = v_inv.anfitrion_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil de anfitrion no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
    IF (v_guest.kc_membresia + v_guest.kc_topup) < v_parte THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SALDO_INSUFICIENTE: Tu boveda no cubre tu parte del Split-Escrow (% KC).', v_parte; END IF;
    v_use_mem := LEAST(v_guest.kc_membresia, v_parte); v_use_top := v_parte - v_use_mem;
    v_host_mem_rem := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_res.escrow_membresia, 0) - v_settled_sum); v_host_add_mem := LEAST(v_parte, v_host_mem_rem); v_host_add_top := v_parte - v_host_add_mem;
    PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true); PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
    UPDATE public.perfiles SET kc_membresia = COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) - v_use_mem, kc_topup = COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) - v_use_top, saldo_kc = GREATEST(0, (COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) - v_use_mem) + (COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) - v_use_top)) WHERE id = v_inv.invitado_id;
    UPDATE public.perfiles SET kc_membresia = COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) + v_host_add_mem, kc_topup = COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + v_host_add_top, saldo_kc = (COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) + v_host_add_mem) + (COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + v_host_add_top) WHERE id = v_inv.anfitrion_id;
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.split_escrow_invitaciones SET estado = 'aceptada', monto_liquidado_kc = v_parte, liquidado_membresia_kc = v_use_mem, liquidado_topup_kc = v_use_top, liquidada_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_invitacion_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'idempotent', FALSE, 'id', p_invitacion_id, 'estado', 'aceptada', 'monto_liquidado_kc', v_parte);
END;
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.responder_split_escrow_invitacion(UUID, BOOLEAN) FROM PUBLIC, anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.responder_split_escrow_invitacion(UUID, BOOLEAN) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.listar_mis_invitaciones_split_escrow()
RETURNS TABLE (
  id UUID, reserva_id UUID, anfitrion_id UUID, anfitrion_nombre TEXT, anfitrion_avatar TEXT, invitado_id UUID, invitado_nombre TEXT, invitado_avatar TEXT,
  monto_kc_parte NUMERIC, monto_liquidado_kc NUMERIC, reembolsada BOOLEAN, estado TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  servicio_nombre TEXT, negocio_nombre TEXT, fecha_clase TEXT, hora_inicio TEXT, spot_number INTEGER
) LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE SET search_path = public AS $$
  SELECT s.id, s.reserva_id, s.anfitrion_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pa.nombre), ''), 'Atleta Kinetic') AS anfitrion_nombre, pa.avatar_url AS anfitrion_avatar,
    s.invitado_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pi.nombre), ''), 'Atleta Kinetic') AS invitado_nombre, pi.avatar_url AS invitado_avatar,
    s.monto_kc_parte, COALESCE(s.monto_liquidado_kc, 0) AS monto_liquidado_kc, COALESCE(s.reembolsada, FALSE) AS reembolsada, s.estado, s.created_at,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.servicio), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(r.nombre_servicio), ''), 'Sesion Split-Escrow') AS servicio_nombre,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.negocio_nombre), ''), 'Club Kinetic') AS negocio_nombre, r.fecha_clase, r.hora_inicio, r.spot_number
  FROM public.split_escrow_invitaciones s LEFT JOIN public.reservas r ON r.id = s.reserva_id LEFT JOIN public.perfiles pa ON pa.id = s.anfitrion_id LEFT JOIN public.perfiles pi ON pi.id = s.invitado_id
  WHERE (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL AND (s.anfitrion_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) OR s.invitado_id = (SELECT auth.uid())) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 60;
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.listar_mis_invitaciones_split_escrow() FROM PUBLIC, anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.listar_mis_invitaciones_split_escrow() TO authenticated;

-- 5) [P1-03 + P1-04b] Cancelacion 72h/4h exacta en America/Mazatlan + reembolso neto sin doble reembolso
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cancelar_reserva_escrow_72h(p_reserva_id UUID)
RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid()); v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_res RECORD; v_perf RECORD; v_srv_fecha DATE; v_srv_hora TIME; v_srv_estado TEXT := ''; v_srv_activo BOOLEAN := TRUE; v_srv_attrs JSONB := '{}'::jsonb; v_srv_orphan BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_raw_fecha TEXT; v_hora_raw TEXT; v_h_parts TEXT[]; v_hora_full TEXT; v_event_ts TIMESTAMPTZ; v_hours_until NUMERIC := 0; v_mins_created NUMERIC := 999;
  v_month_key TEXT := TO_CHAR((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan'), 'YYYY-MM'); v_used_forgive INTEGER := 0; v_max_forgive INTEGER := 0; v_should_refund BOOLEAN := FALSE; v_use_forgive BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_total_refund NUMERIC := 0; v_sum_partes NUMERIC := 0; v_host_net NUMERIC := 0; v_mem_refund NUMERIC := 0; v_top_refund NUMERIC := 0; v_lock_ids UUID[]; r_inv RECORD;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_res FROM public.reservas WHERE id = p_reserva_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'refunded', FALSE, 'refundAmount', 0, 'newState', 'cancelada', 'orphanService', FALSE); END IF;
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (v_res.usuario_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para cancelar esta reserva.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  IF LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_res.estado, ''))) IN ('cancelada', 'completada', 'usada', 'no_show', 'penalizada', 'expirada', 'rechazada', 'eliminada') THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'refunded', FALSE, 'refundAmount', 0, 'newState', v_res.estado, 'orphanService', FALSE); END IF;
  IF v_res.servicio_id IS NULL THEN
    IF NOT COALESCE(v_res.es_pase_maestro, FALSE) THEN v_srv_orphan := TRUE; END IF;
  ELSE
    SELECT s.fecha, s.hora_inicio, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.estado, ''))), COALESCE(s.activo, TRUE), COALESCE(s.atributos, '{}'::jsonb) INTO v_srv_fecha, v_srv_hora, v_srv_estado, v_srv_activo, v_srv_attrs FROM public.servicios s WHERE s.id = v_res.servicio_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_srv_activo OR v_srv_estado IN ('eliminado','eliminada','borrado','cancelado','cancelada','rechazado','inactivo','oculto') OR COALESCE((v_srv_attrs->>'eliminado')::boolean, FALSE) OR COALESCE((v_srv_attrs->>'cancelado')::boolean, FALSE) THEN v_srv_orphan := TRUE; END IF;
  END IF;
  v_raw_fecha := COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(v_res.fecha_clase::text, '')), 10), ''), TO_CHAR(v_srv_fecha, 'YYYY-MM-DD'));
  v_hora_raw := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(v_res.hora_inicio::text, '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_hora::text, '')), ''), '08:00:00');
  v_h_parts := REGEXP_MATCH(v_hora_raw, '^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?');
  v_hora_full := CASE WHEN v_h_parts IS NOT NULL THEN LPAD(v_h_parts[1], 2, '0') || ':' || v_h_parts[2] || ':' || COALESCE(v_h_parts[3], '00') ELSE '08:00:00' END;
  BEGIN
    IF v_raw_fecha IS NULL THEN v_event_ts := COALESCE(v_res.created_at, NOW());
    ELSIF v_raw_fecha ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN v_event_ts := ((v_raw_fecha || ' ' || v_hora_full)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan');
    ELSE v_event_ts := v_raw_fecha::timestamptz; END IF;
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_event_ts := COALESCE(v_res.created_at, NOW()); END;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.split_escrow_invitaciones WHERE reserva_id = p_reserva_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT uid FROM (SELECT v_res.usuario_id AS uid UNION ALL SELECT s.invitado_id AS uid FROM public.split_escrow_invitaciones s WHERE s.reserva_id = p_reserva_id AND s.invitado_id IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(COALESCE(s.estado, '')) = 'aceptada') t WHERE uid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY uid) INTO v_lock_ids;
  IF array_length(v_lock_ids, 1) > 0 THEN PERFORM 1 FROM public.perfiles WHERE id = ANY(v_lock_ids) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_perf FROM public.perfiles WHERE id = v_res.usuario_id;
  v_hours_until := EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (v_event_ts - NOW())) / 3600.0; v_mins_created := EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - COALESCE(v_res.created_at, NOW()))) / 60.0;
  v_max_forgive := CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%plat%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%leyenda%' THEN 3 WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%gold%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%oro%' THEN 2 WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%silver%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%plata%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
  v_used_forgive := CASE WHEN COALESCE(v_perf.mes_perdones_control, '') = v_month_key THEN GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_perf.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0)) ELSE 0 END;
  v_total_refund := TRUNC(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_res.monto_escrow, 0)));
  IF v_total_refund <= 0 OR v_is_admin OR v_srv_orphan OR v_mins_created <= 5 OR v_hours_until >= 72 THEN v_should_refund := TRUE;
  ELSIF v_hours_until >= 4 AND v_hours_until < 72 AND v_used_forgive < v_max_forgive THEN v_should_refund := TRUE; v_use_forgive := TRUE; END IF;
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true); PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  UPDATE public.reservas SET estado = 'cancelada', perdon_vip_aplicado = CASE WHEN v_use_forgive THEN TRUE ELSE COALESCE(perdon_vip_aplicado, FALSE) END, monto_escrow = CASE WHEN v_should_refund THEN 0 ELSE monto_escrow END WHERE id = p_reserva_id;
  IF v_should_refund THEN
    FOR r_inv IN SELECT id, invitado_id, COALESCE(monto_liquidado_kc, 0) AS liq_kc, COALESCE(liquidado_membresia_kc, 0) AS liq_mem, COALESCE(liquidado_topup_kc, 0) AS liq_top FROM public.split_escrow_invitaciones WHERE reserva_id = p_reserva_id AND LOWER(COALESCE(estado, '')) = 'aceptada' AND NOT COALESCE(reembolsada, FALSE) LOOP
      IF r_inv.liq_kc > 0 AND r_inv.invitado_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE public.perfiles SET kc_membresia = COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) + r_inv.liq_mem, kc_topup = COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + r_inv.liq_top, saldo_kc = COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) + r_inv.liq_mem + COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + r_inv.liq_top WHERE id = r_inv.invitado_id;
        v_sum_partes := v_sum_partes + r_inv.liq_kc;
      END IF;
      UPDATE public.split_escrow_invitaciones SET reembolsada = TRUE, reembolsada_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = r_inv.id;
    END LOOP;
    v_host_net := GREATEST(0, v_total_refund - v_sum_partes); v_top_refund := LEAST(TRUNC(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_res.escrow_topup, 0))), v_host_net); v_mem_refund := v_host_net - v_top_refund;
    UPDATE public.perfiles SET kc_membresia = COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) + v_mem_refund, kc_topup = COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + v_top_refund, saldo_kc = COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) + v_mem_refund + COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + v_top_refund,
      perdones_mensuales_usados = CASE WHEN v_use_forgive THEN v_used_forgive + 1 ELSE v_used_forgive END, mes_perdones_control = v_month_key WHERE id = v_res.usuario_id;
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.split_escrow_invitaciones SET estado = 'cancelada', updated_at = NOW() WHERE reserva_id = p_reserva_id AND LOWER(COALESCE(estado, 'pendiente')) = 'pendiente';
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'refunded', v_should_refund, 'refundAmount', CASE WHEN v_should_refund THEN v_host_net ELSE 0 END, 'guestsRefundedAmount', CASE WHEN v_should_refund THEN v_sum_partes ELSE 0 END,
    'usedVipForgiveness', v_use_forgive, 'orphanService', v_srv_orphan, 'remainingForgiveness', GREATEST(0, v_max_forgive - (CASE WHEN v_use_forgive THEN v_used_forgive + 1 ELSE v_used_forgive END)), 'newState', 'cancelada');
END;
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.cancelar_reserva_escrow_72h(UUID) FROM PUBLIC, anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.cancelar_reserva_escrow_72h(UUID) TO authenticated;

-- 6) [P1-05] Regla SAT 36% obligatoria sin RFC valido (LISR 113-A Fracc. III + LIVA 18-J)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calcular_tasas_retencion_sat(p_rfc TEXT, p_regimen_fiscal TEXT, p_csf_validada BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE)
RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE
  v_rfc TEXT := UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_rfc, ''))); v_is_pm BOOLEAN := v_rfc ~ '^[A-Z&Ñ]{3}\d{6}[A-Z0-9]{3}$';
  v_is_pf BOOLEAN := v_rfc ~ '^[A-Z&Ñ]{4}\d{6}[A-Z0-9]{3}$'; v_off INT := CASE WHEN v_is_pm THEN 4 ELSE 5 END;
  v_yy INT := 0; v_mm INT := 0; v_dd INT := 0; v_max_d INT := 0; v_valid BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
  IF (v_is_pm OR v_is_pf) AND v_rfc NOT IN ('XAXX010101000', 'XEXX010101000') THEN
    v_yy := SUBSTRING(v_rfc FROM v_off FOR 2)::int; v_mm := SUBSTRING(v_rfc FROM v_off + 2 FOR 2)::int; v_dd := SUBSTRING(v_rfc FROM v_off + 4 FOR 2)::int;
    v_max_d := CASE WHEN v_mm IN (4, 6, 9, 11) THEN 30 WHEN v_mm = 2 THEN (CASE WHEN (v_yy % 4) = 0 THEN 29 ELSE 28 END) ELSE 31 END;
    v_valid := (v_mm BETWEEN 1 AND 12) AND (v_dd BETWEEN 1 AND v_max_d);
  END IF;
  IF NOT v_valid THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('regimen_fiscal', 'sin_rfc', 'tasa_isr', 20.0, 'tasa_iva', 16.0, 'tasa_total', 36.0, 'rfc_valido', FALSE);
  ELSIF v_is_pm THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('regimen_fiscal', 'persona_moral', 'tasa_isr', 0.0, 'tasa_iva', 0.0, 'tasa_total', 0.0, 'rfc_valido', TRUE);
  ELSE RETURN jsonb_build_object('regimen_fiscal', 'persona_fisica_con_rfc', 'tasa_isr', 2.1, 'tasa_iva', 8.0, 'tasa_total', 10.1, 'rfc_valido', TRUE); END IF;
END;
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.calcular_tasas_retencion_sat(TEXT, TEXT, BOOLEAN) FROM PUBLIC, anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.calcular_tasas_retencion_sat(TEXT, TEXT, BOOLEAN) TO authenticated;

-- 7) [P1-06] Anti-Downgrade Boveda Sandbox + TopUp +20% Base + Idempotencia recibo Stripe
UPDATE public.kinetic_system_flags SET enabled = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE flag_key = 'allow_pre_stripe_sandbox';
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox(p_plan_id TEXT, p_tipo TEXT DEFAULT 'topup')
RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE
  v_uid UUID := (SELECT auth.uid()); v_sandbox_ok BOOLEAN := FALSE; v_plan TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_plan_id, '')));
  v_tipo TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_tipo, 'topup'))); v_kc NUMERIC := 0; v_mxn NUMERIC := 0; v_tier TEXT := NULL;
  v_mem NUMERIC := 0; v_top NUMERIC := 0; v_curr_nivel TEXT := 'Acceso Base'; v_curr_weight INT := 0; v_next_weight INT := 0; v_curr_base_kc NUMERIC := 0; v_curr_base_mxn NUMERIC := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida para operar Boveda.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  IF COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(v_uid)), FALSE) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ACCOUNT_WALLET_PURCHASE_FORBIDDEN: Las cuentas B2B no pueden comprar membresias ni Kineticoins.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(enabled, FALSE) INTO v_sandbox_ok FROM public.kinetic_system_flags WHERE flag_key = 'allow_pre_stripe_sandbox';
  IF NOT v_sandbox_ok AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SANDBOX_DESHABILITADO: Modo pre-Stripe desactivado en servidor.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  CASE
    WHEN v_plan IN ('free', 'acceso_base', 'acceso base', 'base') THEN v_kc := 0; v_mxn := 0; v_tier := 'Acceso Base'; v_next_weight := 0;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('bronze', 'memb_bronze', 'membresia_bronze', 'plan_bronze') THEN v_kc := 600; v_mxn := 699; v_tier := 'Bronze'; v_next_weight := 1;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('silver', 'memb_silver', 'membresia_silver', 'plan_silver') THEN v_kc := 1500; v_mxn := 1549; v_tier := 'Silver'; v_next_weight := 2;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('gold', 'memb_gold', 'membresia_gold', 'plan_gold') THEN v_kc := 2500; v_mxn := 2529; v_tier := 'Gold'; v_next_weight := 3;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('platinum', 'memb_platinum', 'membresia_platinum', 'plan_platinum') THEN v_kc := 3600; v_mxn := 3600; v_tier := 'Platinum'; v_next_weight := 4;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_50', '50', 'pkg_50') THEN v_kc := 50; v_mxn := 50; WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_100', '100', 'pkg_100') THEN v_kc := 100; v_mxn := 100;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_250', '250', 'pkg_250') THEN v_kc := 250; v_mxn := 250; WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_500', '500', 'pkg_500') THEN v_kc := 500; v_mxn := 500;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_1000', '1000', 'pkg_1000') THEN v_kc := 1000; v_mxn := 1000; ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Plan o paquete sandbox desconocido: %', p_plan_id;
  END CASE;
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true); PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  SELECT COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0), COALESCE(nivel, 'Acceso Base') INTO v_mem, v_top, v_curr_nivel FROM public.perfiles WHERE id = v_uid FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil de atleta no encontrado.'; END IF;
  v_curr_weight := CASE WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%plat%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%leyenda%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%black%' THEN 4 WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%gold%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%oro%' THEN 3
    WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%silver%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%plata%' THEN 2 WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%bronze%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%bronce%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
  v_curr_base_kc := CASE v_curr_weight WHEN 1 THEN 600 WHEN 2 THEN 1500 WHEN 3 THEN 2500 WHEN 4 THEN 3600 ELSE 0 END;
  v_curr_base_mxn := CASE v_curr_weight WHEN 1 THEN 699 WHEN 2 THEN 1549 WHEN 3 THEN 2529 WHEN 4 THEN 3600 ELSE 0 END;
  IF v_tier IS NOT NULL OR v_tipo IN ('membresia', 'membership') THEN
    IF v_next_weight <= v_curr_weight THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MEMBERSHIP_DOWNGRADE_OR_SAME_TIER_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
    IF v_curr_weight >= 1 THEN v_kc := GREATEST(0, v_kc - v_curr_base_kc); v_mxn := GREATEST(0, v_mxn - v_curr_base_mxn); END IF;
    v_mem := v_mem + v_kc;
    UPDATE public.perfiles SET kc_membresia = v_mem, saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top, nivel = COALESCE(v_tier, v_curr_nivel), fecha_activacion_membresia = NOW() WHERE id = v_uid;
  ELSE
    v_mxn := CASE WHEN v_curr_weight = 0 THEN ROUND(v_kc * 1.20, 2) ELSE v_kc END;
    v_top := v_top + v_kc; UPDATE public.perfiles SET kc_topup = v_top, saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top WHERE id = v_uid;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.transacciones_pagos (usuario_id, tipo_operacion, paquete_id, monto_mxn, kc_inyectados, stripe_payment_intent_id, estado)
  VALUES (v_uid, CASE WHEN v_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 'membresia' ELSE 'topup' END, v_plan, v_mxn, v_kc, 'sandbox_' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 'sandbox_completado');
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'plan_id', v_plan, 'monto_mxn', v_mxn, 'kc_inyectados', v_kc, 'kc_membresia', v_mem, 'kc_topup', v_top, 'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top, 'nivel', COALESCE(v_tier, v_curr_nivel));
END;
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox(TEXT, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox(TEXT, TEXT) TO authenticated;

DELETE FROM public.transacciones_pagos t WHERE t.stripe_payment_intent_id IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM(t.stripe_payment_intent_id) <> ''
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.transacciones_pagos t2 WHERE t2.stripe_payment_intent_id = t.stripe_payment_intent_id AND t2.ctid < t.ctid);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transacciones_pagos_stripe_pi_uniq ON public.transacciones_pagos (stripe_payment_intent_id) WHERE stripe_payment_intent_id IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM(stripe_payment_intent_id) <> '';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.procesar_webhook_stripe_kc(
  p_event_id TEXT, p_event_type TEXT, p_user_id UUID, p_cantidad_kc NUMERIC,
  p_billetera TEXT DEFAULT 'topup', p_nuevo_nivel TEXT DEFAULT NULL, p_metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');
  v_is_backend BOOLEAN := ((v_jwt_role = 'service_role' AND current_setting('role', true) = 'service_role')
    OR (session_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('role', true), ''), 'none') IN ('none', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')));
  v_mem NUMERIC; v_top NUMERIC; v_nivel TEXT; v_cur_weight INTEGER := 0; v_new_weight INTEGER := 0;
  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := NOW(); v_wal TEXT := LOWER(COALESCE(p_billetera, 'topup')); v_pi_id TEXT; v_paq_id TEXT; v_mxn NUMERIC := p_cantidad_kc;
BEGIN
  IF NOT v_is_backend THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_RPC' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  IF p_event_id IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(p_event_id)) < 4 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Identificador de evento Stripe invalido.'; END IF;
  IF COALESCE(p_cantidad_kc, 0) <= 0 OR p_cantidad_kc <> TRUNC(p_cantidad_kc) OR MOD(p_cantidad_kc, 10) <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Candado financiero Kinetic: p_cantidad_kc debe ser positivo y multiplo exacto de 10.'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0), COALESCE(nivel, 'Acceso Base') INTO v_mem, v_top, v_nivel FROM public.perfiles WHERE id = p_user_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Usuario % no existe en public.perfiles.', p_user_id; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.stripe_processed_events (event_id, event_type, user_id, billetera_destino, monto_kc, nivel_asignado, metadata, processed_at)
  VALUES (TRIM(p_event_id), COALESCE(p_event_type, 'payment_intent.succeeded'), p_user_id, v_wal, p_cantidad_kc, p_nuevo_nivel, COALESCE(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb), v_now) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'duplicate_ignored', 'event_id', TRIM(p_event_id)); END IF;
  v_cur_weight := CASE WHEN LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%plat%' OR LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%leyenda%' OR LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%black%' THEN 4 WHEN LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%gold%' OR LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%oro%' THEN 3
    WHEN LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%silver%' OR LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%plata%' THEN 2 WHEN LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%bronze%' OR LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%bronce%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
  IF v_wal = 'membresia' THEN v_mem := v_mem + p_cantidad_kc; ELSE v_top := v_top + p_cantidad_kc; END IF;
  IF p_nuevo_nivel IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(p_nuevo_nivel)) > 0 THEN
    v_new_weight := CASE WHEN LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%plat%' OR LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%leyenda%' OR LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%black%' THEN 4 WHEN LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%gold%' OR LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%oro%' THEN 3
      WHEN LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%silver%' OR LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%plata%' THEN 2 WHEN LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%bronze%' OR LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%bronce%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    IF v_new_weight > v_cur_weight THEN v_nivel := TRIM(p_nuevo_nivel); END IF;
  END IF;
  v_pi_id := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_metadata->>'payment_intent_id', '')), ''), TRIM(p_event_id));
  v_paq_id := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_metadata->>'plan_id', '')), ''), CASE WHEN v_wal = 'membresia' THEN LOWER(v_nivel) ELSE 'topup_' || TRUNC(p_cantidad_kc)::text END);
  IF COALESCE(p_metadata->>'amount_received', '') ~ '^\d+(\.\d+)?$' THEN v_mxn := ROUND(((p_metadata->>'amount_received')::numeric / 100.0), 2);
  ELSIF v_wal <> 'membresia' AND v_cur_weight = 0 THEN v_mxn := ROUND(p_cantidad_kc * 1.20, 2); END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.transacciones_pagos (usuario_id, tipo_operacion, paquete_id, monto_mxn, kc_inyectados, stripe_payment_intent_id, estado)
  VALUES (p_user_id, v_wal, v_paq_id, v_mxn, p_cantidad_kc, v_pi_id, 'completado') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'duplicate_ignored', 'event_id', TRIM(p_event_id), 'payment_intent_id', v_pi_id); END IF;
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true); PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  UPDATE public.perfiles SET kc_membresia = v_mem, kc_topup = v_top, saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top, nivel = v_nivel,
    fecha_activacion_membresia = CASE WHEN v_wal = 'membresia' THEN v_now ELSE fecha_activacion_membresia END WHERE id = p_user_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'processed', 'event_id', TRIM(p_event_id), 'user_id', p_user_id, 'kc_membresia', v_mem, 'kc_topup', v_top, 'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top, 'nivel', v_nivel);
END;
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.procesar_webhook_stripe_kc(TEXT, TEXT, UUID, NUMERIC, TEXT, TEXT, JSONB) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.procesar_webhook_stripe_kc(TEXT, TEXT, UUID, NUMERIC, TEXT, TEXT, JSONB) TO service_role;

COMMIT;

    FILE: supabase/migrations/20261121190000_migration_v282_ola2_account_deletion_clean.sql

    -- ============================================================================
-- KINETIC OS v2.8.2 — OLA 2 (P1-08): BORRADO TOTAL DE CUENTA APPLE 5.1.1(v)
-- Transaccional + 100% Idempotente + ON DELETE SET NULL en Contabilidad
-- ============================================================================
BEGIN;

-- 1. Hacer nullable usuario_id / propietario_id en tablas financieras y de catálogo B2B
--    para conservar la contabilidad histórica anonimizada cuando el usuario se elimina.
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'transacciones_pagos' AND column_name = 'usuario_id'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.transacciones_pagos ALTER COLUMN usuario_id DROP NOT NULL;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'reservas' AND column_name = 'usuario_id'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.reservas ALTER COLUMN usuario_id DROP NOT NULL;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'afiliados' AND column_name = 'propietario_id'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.afiliados ALTER COLUMN propietario_id DROP NOT NULL;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'servicios' AND column_name = 'propietario_id'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.servicios ALTER COLUMN propietario_id DROP NOT NULL;
  END IF;
END $$;

-- 2. Reconfigurar dinámicamente todas las llaves foráneas en public.* hacia auth.users o public.perfiles
--    - Tablas contables/B2B: ON DELETE SET NULL (preserva historial financiero anónimo).
--    - Resto de tablas propiedad del usuario con NO ACTION / RESTRICT: ON DELETE CASCADE.
DO $$
DECLARE
  rec RECORD;
  v_col_list TEXT;
  v_ref_cols TEXT;
  v_target_action TEXT;
BEGIN
  FOR rec IN
    SELECT
      c.conname,
      c.conrelid,
      rel.relname AS table_name,
      c.confrelid::regclass::text AS ref_table,
      c.confdeltype,
      (
        SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(a.attname), ', ' ORDER BY u.ord)
        FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(attnum, ord)
        JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = u.attnum
      ) AS col_names,
      (
        SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(a.attname), ', ' ORDER BY u.ord)
        FROM unnest(c.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(attnum, ord)
        JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.confrelid AND a.attnum = u.attnum
      ) AS ref_col_names
    FROM pg_constraint c
    JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid = c.conrelid
    JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON nsp.oid = rel.relnamespace
    WHERE nsp.nspname = 'public'
      AND c.contype = 'f'
      AND c.confrelid IN ('auth.users'::regclass, 'public.perfiles'::regclass)
  LOOP
    IF rec.table_name IN (
      'transacciones_pagos', 'reservas', 'afiliados', 'servicios',
      'ledger_kineticoins', 'ledger_kc', 'facturas_cfdi',
      'cortes_semanales_b2b', 'cortes_b2b', 'solicitudes_retiro_b2b', 'retiros_b2b'
    ) THEN
      v_target_action := 'SET NULL';
      IF rec.confdeltype <> 'n' THEN
        -- Asegurar nulabilidad en cada columna FK simple
        IF rec.col_names NOT LIKE '%,%' THEN
          EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I ALTER COLUMN %s DROP NOT NULL', rec.table_name, rec.col_names);
        END IF;
        EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS %I', rec.table_name, rec.conname);
        EXECUTE format(
          'ALTER TABLE public.%I ADD CONSTRAINT %I FOREIGN KEY (%s) REFERENCES %s(%s) ON DELETE %s',
          rec.table_name, rec.conname, rec.col_names, rec.ref_table, rec.ref_col_names, v_target_action
        );
      END IF;
    ELSIF rec.confdeltype IN ('a', 'r') THEN
      EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS %I', rec.table_name, rec.conname);
      EXECUTE format(
        'ALTER TABLE public.%I ADD CONSTRAINT %I FOREIGN KEY (%s) REFERENCES %s(%s) ON DELETE CASCADE',
        rec.table_name, rec.conname, rec.col_names, rec.ref_table, rec.ref_col_names
      );
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  -- Garantizar explícitamente la FK ON DELETE SET NULL en transacciones_pagos.usuario_id -> auth.users(id)
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'transacciones_pagos' AND column_name = 'usuario_id'
  ) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_constraint c
    JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid = c.conrelid
    JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON nsp.oid = rel.relnamespace
    JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = c.conkey[1]
    WHERE nsp.nspname = 'public'
      AND rel.relname = 'transacciones_pagos'
      AND c.contype = 'f'
      AND a.attname = 'usuario_id'
      AND c.confdeltype = 'n'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.transacciones_pagos
      ADD CONSTRAINT fk_transacciones_pagos_usuario_set_null
      FOREIGN KEY (usuario_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
  END IF;
END $$;

-- 3. Permitir a RPCs confiables desvinculación anónima controlada de reservas en cierre de cuenta
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_reservas_owner_v277()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');
  v_is_priv BOOLEAN := (
    (v_jwt_role = 'service_role' AND current_setting('role', true) = 'service_role')
    OR (session_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('role', true), ''), 'none') IN ('none', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin'))
    OR COALESCE(current_setting('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', true), '') = 'true'
    OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE)
  );
BEGIN
  IF NOT v_is_priv THEN
    NEW.usuario_id := OLD.usuario_id;
    NEW.negocio_nombre := OLD.negocio_nombre;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- 4. RPC atómica SECURITY DEFINER (solo service_role): cancelar pases, liberar cupos y preparar cierre
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.preparar_cierre_definitivo_cuenta_propia();
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.preparar_cierre_definitivo_cuenta_propia(UUID);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preparar_cierre_definitivo_cuenta_propia(p_user_id UUID)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_uid UUID;
  v_email TEXT;
  v_rol TEXT := '';
  v_tipo TEXT := '';
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');
  v_cancelled_reservas INTEGER := 0;
  v_srv RECORD;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (
    (v_jwt_role = 'service_role' AND current_setting('role', true) = 'service_role')
    OR (session_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('role', true), ''), 'none') IN ('none', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role'))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN_SERVICE_ROLE_ONLY' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_uid := p_user_id;
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_USER_ID';
  END IF;

  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(email, '')))
    INTO v_email
    FROM auth.users
   WHERE id = v_uid;

  IF to_regclass('public.perfiles') IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(rol, ''))), LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(tipo_cuenta, '')))
      INTO v_rol, v_tipo
      FROM public.perfiles
     WHERE id = v_uid;
  END IF;

  IF v_rol = 'admin' OR v_tipo = 'admin'
     OR v_email IN (
       'admin@kineticapp.com.mx',
       'administrador@kinetic.com.mx',
       'administrador@kinetic.com',
       'kinetic@kinetic.com',
       'admin@kinetic.com'
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'MASTER_ADMIN_PROTECTED' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  IF to_regclass('public.reservas') IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF to_regclass('public.servicios') IS NOT NULL THEN
      FOR v_srv IN
        SELECT r.servicio_id, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS qty
          FROM public.reservas r
         WHERE r.usuario_id = v_uid
           AND r.servicio_id IS NOT NULL
           AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, '')) IN ('pendiente', 'activa', 'confirmada')
         GROUP BY r.servicio_id
      LOOP
        UPDATE public.servicios
           SET cupo_actual = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(cupo_actual, 0) - v_srv.qty)
         WHERE id = v_srv.servicio_id;
      END LOOP;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.reservas
       SET estado = 'cancelada',
           usuario_id = NULL,
           qr_token = NULL
     WHERE usuario_id = v_uid
       AND LOWER(COALESCE(estado, '')) IN ('pendiente', 'activa', 'confirmada');
    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_cancelled_reservas = ROW_COUNT;

    UPDATE public.reservas
       SET usuario_id = NULL,
           qr_token = NULL
     WHERE usuario_id = v_uid;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.split_escrow_invitaciones') IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.split_escrow_invitaciones
       SET estado = 'cancelada'
     WHERE (anfitrion_id = v_uid OR invitado_id = v_uid)
       AND LOWER(COALESCE(estado, '')) = 'pendiente';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.transacciones_pagos') IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.transacciones_pagos
       SET usuario_id = NULL
     WHERE usuario_id = v_uid;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.servicios') IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.servicios
       SET estado = 'inactivo',
           propietario_id = NULL
     WHERE propietario_id = v_uid;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.afiliados') IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.afiliados
       SET estado = 'inactivo',
           propietario_id = NULL
     WHERE propietario_id = v_uid;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.perfiles') IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.perfiles
       SET kc_membresia = 0,
           kc_topup = 0,
           email = NULL,
           telefono = NULL,
           avatar_url = NULL,
           radar_publico = FALSE,
           nombre = 'Cuenta Eliminada'
     WHERE id = v_uid;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', TRUE,
    'user_id', v_uid,
    'cancelled_reservas', v_cancelled_reservas
  );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.preparar_cierre_definitivo_cuenta_propia(UUID) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.preparar_cierre_definitivo_cuenta_propia(UUID) TO service_role;

COMMIT;

    FILE: supabase/migrations/20261121230000_migration_v282_ola4_wallet_companion_and_store_ready.sql

    -- === supabase/migrations/20261121230000_migration_v282_ola4_wallet_companion_and_store_ready.sql === --
-- KINETIC OS v2.8.2 — OLA 4:
-- 1) Tabla public.app_config con RLS + candado enable_native_wallet_passes = false y allow_pre_stripe_sandbox = true intacto
-- 2) Indice compuesto en public.reservas (usuario_id, servicio_id, estado) para consultas B2C / Wallet Companion O(log N)
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.app_config (

  updated_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_app_config_updated_by
  ON public.app_config (updated_by);

ALTER TABLE public.app_config ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

  ON public.app_config
  FOR SELECT
  TO anon, authenticated
  USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "app_config_admin_write" ON public.app_config;
CREATE POLICY "app_config_admin_write"
  ON public.app_config
  FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING ((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()))
  WITH CHECK ((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()));

INSERT INTO public.app_config (config_key, bool_value, description, updated_at)
VALUES

    'enable_native_wallet_passes',
    false,
    'Candado Fase 14C: oculta y bloquea emision Apple/Google Wallet hasta configurar certificados emisores.',

  ),
  (

ON CONFLICT (config_key) DO UPDATE
SET

    WHEN public.app_config.config_key = 'allow_pre_stripe_sandbox' THEN true
    ELSE EXCLUDED.bool_value
  END,

    false,

    NOW()
  ),
  (
    'allow_pre_stripe_sandbox',
    true,
    'Habilita recargas y membresias en modo sandbox antes de activar Stripe Live.',
    NOW()
  )
ON CONFLICT (flag_key) DO UPDATE
SET
  enabled = CASE
    WHEN public.kinetic_system_flags.flag_key = 'enable_native_wallet_passes' THEN false
    WHEN public.kinetic_system_flags.flag_key = 'allow_pre_stripe_sandbox' THEN true
    ELSE EXCLUDED.enabled
  END,
  description = EXCLUDED.description,
