    FILE: supabase/migrations/20261122100000_migration_v283_ola1_ugc_purge_and_feed_guard.sql

    -- ============================================================================
-- KINETIC OS v2.8.3 — OLA 1: PURGA UGC Y TRIGGER INQUEBRANTABLE EN KINETICLUB
-- ============================================================================
BEGIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_clean_kinetic_ugc_text(p_text TEXT)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE plpgsql
IMMUTABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_clean TEXT;
  v_offtopic TEXT := '\m(xbox|playstation|ps5|ps4|nintendo\s*switch|gta\s*(vi|6|v|5)|grand\s+theft\s+auto|fortnite|valorant|onlyfans|botarga|botargas|apuestas\s*deportivas|casino\s*online)\M';
  v_competitors TEXT := '\m(' || 'fit' || 'pass|' || 'class' || 'pass|' || 'gym' || 'pass|' || 'well' || 'hub|' || 'urban' || 'sports|' || 'min' || 'dbody' || ')\M';
  v_xss TEXT := '(<\s*/?\s*(script|iframe)\M|javascript\s*:|on(error|load|click|mouseover)\s*=|document\.cookie|\meva' || 'l\s*\()';
BEGIN
  IF p_text IS NULL THEN
    RETURN TRUE;
  END IF;
  v_clean := pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.translate(p_text, chr(8203) || chr(8204) || chr(8205) || chr(65279), ''));
  IF v_clean = '' THEN
    RETURN TRUE;
  END IF;
  IF v_clean ~* v_xss THEN
    RETURN FALSE;
  END IF;
  IF v_clean ~* v_offtopic THEN
    RETURN FALSE;
  END IF;
  IF v_clean ~* v_competitors THEN
    RETURN FALSE;
  END IF;
  RETURN TRUE;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.is_clean_kinetic_ugc_text(TEXT) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_clean_kinetic_ugc_text(TEXT) TO authenticated, service_role;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(p_uri TEXT)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE plpgsql
IMMUTABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_clean TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF p_uri IS NULL THEN
    RETURN TRUE;
  END IF;
  v_clean := pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.translate(p_uri, chr(8203) || chr(8204) || chr(8205) || chr(65279), ''));
  IF v_clean = '' THEN
    RETURN TRUE;
  END IF;
  IF v_clean ~ '[<>]' OR v_clean ~* '^(javascript|data|vbscript|file)\s*:' OR v_clean ~* '^http://' THEN
    RETURN FALSE;
  END IF;
  RETURN (v_clean ~ '^/[^/]' OR v_clean ~* '^https://');
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(TEXT) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(TEXT) TO authenticated, service_role;

DO $$
DECLARE
  r RECORD;
  v_scrubbed JSONB;
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('public.comunidad_posts') IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.comunidad_posts p
    WHERE NOT public.is_clean_kinetic_ugc_text(
      CONCAT_WS(
        ' ',
        to_jsonb(p) ->> 'contenido',
        to_jsonb(p) ->> 'titulo',
        to_jsonb(p) ->> 'disciplina',
        to_jsonb(p) ->> 'sede',
        to_jsonb(p) ->> 'autor_nombre',
        to_jsonb(p) ->> 'imagen_caption'
      )
    )
    OR NOT public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(to_jsonb(p) ->> 'imagen_url')
    OR NOT public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(to_jsonb(p) ->> 'autor_avatar')
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(to_jsonb(p) -> 'galeria') = 'array' THEN to_jsonb(p) -> 'galeria' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
      ) AS g
      WHERE NOT public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(g) = 'string' THEN g #>> '{}' ELSE COALESCE(g ->> 'url', g ->> 'uri', g ->> 'imagen_url') END
      )
    );

    FOR r IN
      SELECT id, comentarios_json
      FROM public.comunidad_posts
      WHERE jsonb_typeof(comentarios_json) = 'array'
        AND jsonb_array_length(comentarios_json) > 0
    LOOP
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(elem ORDER BY ord), '[]'::jsonb)
        INTO v_scrubbed
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.comentarios_json) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(elem, ord)
      WHERE public.is_clean_kinetic_ugc_text(
        CONCAT_WS(
          ' ',
          elem ->> 'text',
          elem ->> 'texto',
          elem ->> 'contenido',
          elem ->> 'author',
          elem ->> 'autor_nombre'
        )
      )
      AND public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(COALESCE(elem ->> 'autor_avatar', elem ->> 'avatar_url'));
      IF v_scrubbed IS DISTINCT FROM r.comentarios_json THEN
        UPDATE public.comunidad_posts
        SET comentarios_json = v_scrubbed
        WHERE id = r.id;
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.comunidad_comentarios') IS NOT NULL THEN
    EXECUTE $q$
      DELETE FROM public.comunidad_comentarios c
      WHERE NOT public.is_clean_kinetic_ugc_text(
        CONCAT_WS(
          ' ',
          to_jsonb(c) ->> 'text',
          to_jsonb(c) ->> 'texto',
          to_jsonb(c) ->> 'contenido',
          to_jsonb(c) ->> 'author',
          to_jsonb(c) ->> 'autor_nombre'
        )
      )
      OR NOT public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(COALESCE(to_jsonb(c) ->> 'autor_avatar', to_jsonb(c) ->> 'avatar_url'))
    $q$;
  END IF;
END
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_enforce_kinetic_ugc_feed_guard()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_row JSONB;
  v_elem JSONB;
  v_gal JSONB;
BEGIN
  v_row := to_jsonb(NEW);
  IF NOT public.is_clean_kinetic_ugc_text(
    CONCAT_WS(
      ' ',
      v_row ->> 'contenido',
      v_row ->> 'text',
      v_row ->> 'texto',
      v_row ->> 'titulo',
      v_row ->> 'disciplina',
      v_row ->> 'sede',
      v_row ->> 'author',
      v_row ->> 'autor_nombre',
      v_row ->> 'imagen_caption'
    )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'KINETIC_UGC_POLICY_VIOLATION: contenido no permitido en KinetiClub'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(v_row ->> 'imagen_url')
     OR NOT public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(v_row ->> 'autor_avatar')
     OR NOT public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(v_row ->> 'avatar_url') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'KINETIC_UGC_POLICY_VIOLATION: URI multimedia no permitida en KinetiClub'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'galeria') = 'array' THEN
    FOR v_gal IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_row -> 'galeria')
    LOOP
      IF NOT public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_gal) = 'string' THEN v_gal #>> '{}' ELSE COALESCE(v_gal ->> 'url', v_gal ->> 'uri', v_gal ->> 'imagen_url') END
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'KINETIC_UGC_POLICY_VIOLATION: URI en galeria no permitida en KinetiClub'
          USING ERRCODE = '22023';
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  IF jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'comentarios_json') = 'array' THEN
    FOR v_elem IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_row -> 'comentarios_json')
    LOOP
      IF NOT public.is_clean_kinetic_ugc_text(
        CONCAT_WS(
          ' ',
          v_elem ->> 'text',
          v_elem ->> 'texto',
          v_elem ->> 'contenido',
          v_elem ->> 'author',
          v_elem ->> 'autor_nombre'
        )
      ) OR NOT public.is_safe_kinetic_ugc_media_uri(COALESCE(v_elem ->> 'autor_avatar', v_elem ->> 'avatar_url')) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'KINETIC_UGC_POLICY_VIOLATION: comentario no permitido en KinetiClub'
          USING ERRCODE = '22023';
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.fn_enforce_kinetic_ugc_feed_guard() FROM PUBLIC;

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('public.comunidad_posts') IS NOT NULL THEN
    DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_kinetic_ugc_feed_guard ON public.comunidad_posts;
    CREATE TRIGGER trg_kinetic_ugc_feed_guard
      BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.comunidad_posts
      FOR EACH ROW
      EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn_enforce_kinetic_ugc_feed_guard();
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.comunidad_comentarios') IS NOT NULL THEN
    DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_kinetic_ugc_feed_guard ON public.comunidad_comentarios;
    CREATE TRIGGER trg_kinetic_ugc_feed_guard
      BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.comunidad_comentarios
      FOR EACH ROW
      EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn_enforce_kinetic_ugc_feed_guard();
  END IF;
END
$$;

COMMIT;

    FILE: supabase/migrations/20261123010000_migration_v284_topup_min100_and_monthly_shield.sql

    -- ============================================================================
-- MIGRACIÓN v284 — PISO MÍNIMO TOP-UP 100 KC + ESCUDO DE RACHA MENSUAL (1 GRATIS/MES + 25 KC)
-- Idempotente, SECURITY DEFINER, SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
-- ============================================================================

BEGIN;

-- 1. Columnas mensuales idempotentes para Escudo de Racha 24h en public.perfiles
ALTER TABLE public.perfiles
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS escudo_mes_iso TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS escudos_usados_mes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname = 'chk_perfiles_escudos_usados_mes_nonneg'
      AND conrelid = 'public.perfiles'::regclass
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.perfiles
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_perfiles_escudos_usados_mes_nonneg
      CHECK (escudos_usados_mes >= 0);
  END IF;
END $$;

-- 2. Blindaje de triggers en public.perfiles incluyendo escudo_mes_iso y escudos_usados_mes
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.proteger_columnas_sensibles_perfiles()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_vault_ok BOOLEAN := (
    COALESCE(current_setting('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', true), 'false') = 'true'
    OR COALESCE(current_setting('kinetic.rpc_authorized', true), 'false') = 'true'
  );
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), '');
BEGIN
  IF v_vault_ok THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF current_user IN ('postgres', 'service_role', 'supabase_admin')
     AND v_jwt_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE) THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF (NEW.kc_membresia IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.kc_membresia)
     OR (NEW.kc_topup IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.kc_topup)
     OR (NEW.saldo_kc IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.saldo_kc)
     OR (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.rol, ''))))
     OR (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.tipo_cuenta, ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.tipo_cuenta, ''))))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.nivel, '') IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.nivel, ''))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.xp_total, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.xp_total, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.es_cuenta_sandbox, FALSE))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.racha_dias, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha_dias, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.racha, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.racha_semanal_dias, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha_semanal_dias, 0))
     OR (NEW.ultima_fecha_racha IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ultima_fecha_racha)
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.is_streak_frozen, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.is_streak_frozen, FALSE))
     OR (NEW.escudo_activo_hasta IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_activo_hasta)
     OR (NEW.escudo_racha_activo_hasta IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_racha_activo_hasta)
     OR (NEW.escudo_semana_iso IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_semana_iso)
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.escudos_usados_semana, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.escudos_usados_semana, 0))
     OR (NEW.escudo_mes_iso IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_mes_iso)
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.escudos_usados_mes, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.escudos_usados_mes, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.prestigio_nivel, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.prestigio_nivel, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.prestigio_grado, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.prestigio_grado, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.kc_ganados_cajas, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_ganados_cajas, 0))
     OR (NEW.recompensas_reclamadas IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.recompensas_reclamadas)
     OR (NEW.codigo_referido IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.codigo_referido)
     OR (NEW.referido_por IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por)
     OR (NEW.referido_por_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por_id)
     OR (NEW.referido_por_codigo IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por_codigo)
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.referidos_count, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.referidos_count, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.kc_ganados_referidos, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_ganados_referidos, 0)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SEGURIDAD KINETIC: Operacion bloqueada. Columnas protegidas solo pueden modificarse mediante RPC autorizado.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_perfiles_privilegios_y_boveda()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');
  v_ok BOOLEAN := (
    COALESCE(current_setting('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', true), 'false') = 'true'
    OR COALESCE(current_setting('kinetic.rpc_authorized', true), 'false') = 'true'
    OR (
      ((SELECT auth.uid()) IS NULL AND current_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role'))
      AND v_jwt_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated'
    )
    OR v_jwt_role = 'service_role'
    OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE)
  );
BEGIN
  NEW.kc_membresia := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(NEW.kc_membresia, 0));
  NEW.kc_topup := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(NEW.kc_topup, 0));
  NEW.saldo_kc := NEW.kc_membresia + NEW.kc_topup;

  IF v_ok THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT auth.uid())
       OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IN ('admin', 'fundador')
       OR NEW.kc_membresia > 0
       OR NEW.kc_topup > 0
       OR COALESCE(NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox, FALSE) = TRUE
       OR COALESCE(NEW.bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE) = TRUE
       OR COALESCE(NEW.prestigio_nivel, 0) > 0
       OR COALESCE(NEW.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0) > 0
       OR COALESCE(NEW.escudos_usados_mes, 0) > 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Operacion bloqueada en registro.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    NEW.rol := CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'especialista') THEN LOWER(TRIM(NEW.rol)) ELSE 'atleta' END;
    NEW.tipo_cuenta := CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.tipo_cuenta, ''))) IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'especialista', 'b2b') THEN LOWER(TRIM(NEW.tipo_cuenta)) ELSE 'atleta' END;
    NEW.nivel := CASE WHEN NEW.rol IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'especialista') THEN 'Partner B2B' ELSE 'Acceso Base' END;
    NEW.xp_total := 0;
    NEW.racha_dias := 0;
    NEW.racha := 0;
    NEW.racha_semanal_dias := 0;
    NEW.ultima_fecha_racha := NULL;
    NEW.is_streak_frozen := FALSE;
    NEW.escudo_activo_hasta := NULL;
    NEW.escudo_racha_activo_hasta := NULL;
    NEW.escudo_semana_iso := NULL;
    NEW.escudos_usados_semana := 0;
    NEW.escudo_mes_iso := NULL;
    NEW.escudos_usados_mes := 0;
    NEW.prestigio_nivel := 0;
    NEW.prestigio_grado := 0;
    NEW.cajas_nivel_reclamadas := 0;
    NEW.kc_ganados_cajas := 0;
    NEW.recompensas_reclamadas := ARRAY[]::TEXT[];
    NEW.perdones_mensuales_usados := 0;
    NEW.codigo_referido := NULL;
    NEW.referido_por := NULL;
    NEW.referido_por_id := NULL;
    NEW.referido_por_codigo := NULL;
    NEW.bono_referido_otorgado := FALSE;
    NEW.referidos_count := 0;
    NEW.kc_ganados_referidos := 0;
    NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox := FALSE;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND (
    NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
    OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.rol, '')))
    OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.tipo_cuenta, ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.tipo_cuenta, '')))
    OR COALESCE(NEW.nivel, '') IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.nivel, '')
    OR COALESCE(NEW.kc_membresia, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_membresia, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.kc_topup, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_topup, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.saldo_kc, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.saldo_kc, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.xp_total, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.xp_total, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.es_cuenta_sandbox, FALSE)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.racha_dias, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha_dias, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.racha, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.racha_semanal_dias, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha_semanal_dias, 0)
    OR NEW.ultima_fecha_racha IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ultima_fecha_racha
    OR COALESCE(NEW.is_streak_frozen, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.is_streak_frozen, FALSE)
    OR NEW.escudo_activo_hasta IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_activo_hasta
    OR NEW.escudo_racha_activo_hasta IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_racha_activo_hasta
    OR NEW.escudo_semana_iso IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_semana_iso
    OR COALESCE(NEW.escudos_usados_semana, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.escudos_usados_semana, 0)
    OR NEW.escudo_mes_iso IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_mes_iso
    OR COALESCE(NEW.escudos_usados_mes, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.escudos_usados_mes, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.prestigio_nivel, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.prestigio_nivel, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.prestigio_grado, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.prestigio_grado, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.kc_ganados_cajas, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_ganados_cajas, 0)
    OR NEW.recompensas_reclamadas IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.recompensas_reclamadas
    OR NEW.codigo_referido IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.codigo_referido
    OR NEW.referido_por IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por
    OR NEW.referido_por_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por_id
    OR NEW.referido_por_codigo IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por_codigo
    OR COALESCE(NEW.bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.referidos_count, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.referidos_count, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.kc_ganados_referidos, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_ganados_referidos, 0)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Modificacion directa bloqueada fuera de RPC autorizado.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- 3. Piso mínimo Top-Up 100 KC en public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox (retira 50 KC)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox(p_plan_id TEXT, p_tipo TEXT DEFAULT 'topup')
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_uid UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_sandbox_ok BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_plan TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_plan_id, '')));
  v_tipo TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_tipo, 'topup')));
  v_kc NUMERIC := 0;
  v_mxn NUMERIC := 0;
  v_tier TEXT := NULL;
  v_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_curr_nivel TEXT := 'Acceso Base';
  v_curr_weight INT := 0;
  v_next_weight INT := 0;
  v_curr_base_kc NUMERIC := 0;
  v_curr_base_mxn NUMERIC := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida para operar Boveda.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_b2b_account(v_uid)), FALSE) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ACCOUNT_WALLET_PURCHASE_FORBIDDEN: Las cuentas B2B no pueden comprar membresias ni Kineticoins.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(enabled, FALSE) INTO v_sandbox_ok
  FROM public.kinetic_system_flags
  WHERE flag_key = 'allow_pre_stripe_sandbox'
  LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT COALESCE(v_sandbox_ok, FALSE) AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SANDBOX_DESHABILITADO: Modo pre-Stripe desactivado en servidor.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  CASE
    WHEN v_plan IN ('free', 'acceso_base', 'acceso base', 'base') THEN v_kc := 0; v_mxn := 0; v_tier := 'Acceso Base'; v_next_weight := 0;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('bronze', 'memb_bronze', 'membresia_bronze', 'plan_bronze') THEN v_kc := 600; v_mxn := 699; v_tier := 'Bronze'; v_next_weight := 1;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('silver', 'memb_silver', 'membresia_silver', 'plan_silver') THEN v_kc := 1500; v_mxn := 1549; v_tier := 'Silver'; v_next_weight := 2;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('gold', 'memb_gold', 'membresia_gold', 'plan_gold') THEN v_kc := 2500; v_mxn := 2529; v_tier := 'Gold'; v_next_weight := 3;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('platinum', 'memb_platinum', 'membresia_platinum', 'plan_platinum') THEN v_kc := 3600; v_mxn := 3600; v_tier := 'Platinum'; v_next_weight := 4;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_100', '100', 'pkg_100') THEN v_kc := 100; v_mxn := 100;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_250', '250', 'pkg_250') THEN v_kc := 250; v_mxn := 250;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_500', '500', 'pkg_500') THEN v_kc := 500; v_mxn := 500;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_1000', '1000', 'pkg_1000') THEN v_kc := 1000; v_mxn := 1000;
    ELSE
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Paquete Top-Up no reconocido en catalogo oficial (minimo 100 KC): %', p_plan_id USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END CASE;

  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0), COALESCE(nivel, 'Acceso Base')
    INTO v_mem, v_top, v_curr_nivel
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = v_uid
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil de atleta no encontrado.';
  END IF;

  v_curr_weight := CASE
    WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%plat%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%leyenda%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%black%' THEN 4
    WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%gold%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%oro%' THEN 3
    WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%silver%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%plata%' THEN 2
    WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%bronze%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%bronce%' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END;
  v_curr_base_kc := CASE v_curr_weight WHEN 1 THEN 600 WHEN 2 THEN 1500 WHEN 3 THEN 2500 WHEN 4 THEN 3600 ELSE 0 END;
  v_curr_base_mxn := CASE v_curr_weight WHEN 1 THEN 699 WHEN 2 THEN 1549 WHEN 3 THEN 2529 WHEN 4 THEN 3600 ELSE 0 END;

  IF v_tier IS NOT NULL OR v_tipo IN ('membresia', 'membership') THEN
    IF v_next_weight <= v_curr_weight THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'MEMBERSHIP_DOWNGRADE_OR_SAME_TIER_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    IF v_curr_weight >= 1 THEN
      v_kc := GREATEST(0, v_kc - v_curr_base_kc);
      v_mxn := GREATEST(0, v_mxn - v_curr_base_mxn);
    END IF;
    v_mem := v_mem + v_kc;
    UPDATE public.perfiles
       SET kc_membresia = v_mem,
           saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top,
           nivel = COALESCE(v_tier, v_curr_nivel),
           fecha_activacion_membresia = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_uid;
  ELSE
    v_mxn := CASE WHEN v_curr_weight = 0 THEN ROUND(v_kc * 1.20, 2) ELSE v_kc END;
    v_top := v_top + v_kc;
    UPDATE public.perfiles
       SET kc_topup = v_top,
           saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top
     WHERE id = v_uid;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.transacciones_pagos (
    usuario_id, tipo_operacion, paquete_id, monto_mxn, kc_inyectados, stripe_payment_intent_id, estado
  ) VALUES (
    v_uid,
    CASE WHEN v_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 'membresia' ELSE 'topup' END,
    v_plan,
    v_mxn,
    v_kc,
    'sandbox_' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''),
    'sandbox_completado'
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', TRUE,
    'plan_id', v_plan,
    'monto_mxn', v_mxn,
    'kc_inyectados', v_kc,
    'kc_membresia', v_mem,
    'kc_topup', v_top,
    'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top,
    'nivel', COALESCE(v_tier, v_curr_nivel)
  );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox(TEXT, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox(TEXT, TEXT) TO authenticated;

-- 4. Escudo de Racha 24h Mensual (1 gratis/mes calendario Mazatlan + 25 KC adicionales)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.congelar_racha_kineti(p_user_id UUID DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_target UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, v_caller);
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_month_key TEXT := pg_catalog.to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM');
  v_iso_week TEXT := pg_catalog.to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'IYYY-IW');
  v_day_mzt TEXT := pg_catalog.to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD');
  v_key TEXT := 'escudo_racha_' || v_day_mzt;
  v_shield_day_key TEXT := 'escudo_activado_' || v_day_mzt;
  v_claimed TEXT[];
  v_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_prev_month TEXT;
  v_prev_week TEXT;
  v_used INTEGER := 0;
  v_week_used INTEGER := 0;
  v_until TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_cost NUMERIC := 0;
  v_use_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_use_top NUMERIC := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (v_target IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida para activar Escudo Protector.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT
    COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0),
    COALESCE(kc_topup, 0),
    escudo_mes_iso,
    COALESCE(escudos_usados_mes, 0),
    escudo_semana_iso,
    COALESCE(escudos_usados_semana, 0),
    GREATEST(escudo_activo_hasta, escudo_racha_activo_hasta)
  INTO v_mem, v_top, v_prev_month, v_used, v_prev_week, v_week_used, v_until
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = v_target
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  v_claimed := public.fn_read_claimed_rewards_text_arr(v_target);
  IF v_shield_day_key = ANY(v_claimed) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', TRUE,
      'duplicate', TRUE,
      'escudo_mes_iso', COALESCE(v_prev_month, v_month_key),
      'escudos_usados_mes', v_used,
      'escudos_usados_semana', v_week_used,
      'gratis', TRUE,
      'free', TRUE,
      'es_gratuito', TRUE,
      'costo_kc', 0,
      'kc_membresia', v_mem,
      'kc_topup', v_top,
      'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top,
      'activo_hasta', COALESCE(v_until, NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'),
      'escudo_activo_hasta', COALESCE(v_until, NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'),
      'is_streak_frozen', TRUE,
      'recompensas_reclamadas', to_jsonb(v_claimed)
    );
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(v_prev_month, '') <> v_month_key THEN
    v_used := 0;
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE(v_prev_week, '') <> v_iso_week THEN
    v_week_used := 0;
  END IF;

  IF v_used = 0 THEN
    v_cost := 0;
  ELSE
    v_cost := 25;
    IF (v_mem + v_top) < v_cost THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SALDO_INSUFICIENTE_ESCUDO: Ya usaste tu Escudo gratuito mensual. Necesitas 25 KC para activar uno adicional.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
    v_use_mem := LEAST(v_mem, v_cost);
    v_use_top := v_cost - v_use_mem;
    v_mem := v_mem - v_use_mem;
    v_top := v_top - v_use_top;
  END IF;

  v_used := v_used + 1;
  v_week_used := v_week_used + 1;
  v_until := GREATEST(COALESCE(v_until, NOW()), NOW()) + INTERVAL '24 hours';
  v_claimed := public.fn_write_claimed_rewards_safe(v_target, ARRAY[v_key, v_shield_day_key]);

  UPDATE public.perfiles
     SET kc_membresia = v_mem,
         kc_topup = v_top,
         saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top,
         is_streak_frozen = TRUE,
         escudo_mes_iso = v_month_key,
         escudos_usados_mes = v_used,
         escudo_semana_iso = v_iso_week,
         escudos_usados_semana = v_week_used,
         escudo_activo_hasta = v_until,
         escudo_racha_activo_hasta = v_until
   WHERE id = v_target;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', TRUE,
    'escudo_mes_iso', v_month_key,
    'escudos_usados_mes', v_used,
    'escudos_usados_semana', v_week_used,
    'gratis', (v_cost = 0),
    'free', (v_cost = 0),
    'es_gratuito', (v_cost = 0),
    'costo_kc', v_cost,
    'kc_membresia', v_mem,
    'kc_topup', v_top,
    'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top,
    'activo_hasta', v_until,
    'escudo_activo_hasta', v_until,
    'is_streak_frozen', TRUE,
    'recompensas_reclamadas', to_jsonb(v_claimed)
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activar_escudo_racha_24h()
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN public.congelar_racha_kineti((SELECT auth.uid()));
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.congelar_racha_kineti(UUID) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.congelar_racha_kineti(UUID) TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.activar_escudo_racha_24h() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.activar_escudo_racha_24h() TO authenticated;

COMMIT;

    FILE: supabase/migrations/migration_v275_omnicanal_purge_and_seal.sql

    -- ============================================================================
-- KINETIC OS v2.7.5 — PURGA OMNICANAL EN NUBE Y SELLO SANDBOX (#60)
-- Proyecto: KineticApp S.A.S. (gcppxrlzxlgkuapktxvl)
-- Instrucción CEO: Ejecutar en el SQL Editor de Supabase (idempotente).
-- ============================================================================
BEGIN;

-- 1. Purga definitiva de publicaciones residuales off-topic (XBOX / GTA VI / 6)
DO $$
DECLARE
  has_titulo BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.tables
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'comunidad_posts'
  ) THEN
    SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'comunidad_posts' AND column_name = 'titulo'
    ) INTO has_titulo;

    IF has_titulo THEN
      DELETE FROM public.comunidad_posts
      WHERE COALESCE(contenido, '') ~* '\m(xbox|gta\s*(vi|6)|grand\s+theft\s+auto)\M'
         OR COALESCE(disciplina, '') ~* '\m(xbox|gta\s*(vi|6)|grand\s+theft\s+auto)\M'
         OR COALESCE(sede, '') ~* '\m(xbox|gta\s*(vi|6)|grand\s+theft\s+auto)\M'
         OR COALESCE(titulo, '') ~* '\m(xbox|gta\s*(vi|6)|grand\s+theft\s+auto)\M';
    ELSE
      DELETE FROM public.comunidad_posts
      WHERE COALESCE(contenido, '') ~* '\m(xbox|gta\s*(vi|6)|grand\s+theft\s+auto)\M'
         OR COALESCE(disciplina, '') ~* '\m(xbox|gta\s*(vi|6)|grand\s+theft\s+auto)\M'
         OR COALESCE(sede, '') ~* '\m(xbox|gta\s*(vi|6)|grand\s+theft\s+auto)\M';
    END IF;
  END IF;
END
$$;

    FILE: supabase/migrations/migration_v276_finops_ai_and_geo.sql

    -- ============================================================================
-- KINETIC OS v2.7.6 — PASO 11: FINOPS IA (@google/genai) + GEOCODING WRITE-ONCE
-- Proyecto: KineticApp S.A.S. (gcppxrlzxlgkuapktxvl)
-- Espejo local idempotente de esquema FinOps V276.
-- ============================================================================
BEGIN;

-- 1. CACHÉ SEMÁNTICA DE RESPUESTAS IA (COSTO $0.00 EN CACHE HIT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.ai_response_cache (
  cache_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (task IN ('b2b_digitizer', 'b2c_coach_match', 'catalog_seeder')),
  model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gemini-2.5-flash',
  prompt_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_json JSONB NOT NULL,
  hit_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (hit_count >= 0),
  created_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT (NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days')
);

ALTER TABLE public.ai_response_cache
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW();

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_response_cache_created_by
  ON public.ai_response_cache (created_by);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_response_cache_task_expires
  ON public.ai_response_cache (task, expires_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_response_cache_response_gin
  ON public.ai_response_cache USING GIN (response_json);

ALTER TABLE public.ai_response_cache ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "ai_response_cache_master_admin_all" ON public.ai_response_cache;
CREATE POLICY "ai_response_cache_master_admin_all"
  ON public.ai_response_cache
  FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.is_kinetic_master_admin())
  WITH CHECK (public.is_kinetic_master_admin());

-- 2. CUOTAS DIARIAS ATÓMICAS DE IA POR USUARIO Y TAREA
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.ai_user_daily_quotas (
  usuario_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quota_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  task TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (task IN ('b2b_digitizer', 'b2c_coach_match', 'catalog_seeder')),
  used_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (used_count >= 0),
  daily_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 CHECK (daily_limit >= 0),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  PRIMARY KEY (usuario_id, quota_date, task)
);

ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS usuario_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS task TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'b2c_coach_match',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS used_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS daily_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW();

DO $$
DECLARE v_pk_name TEXT;
BEGIN
  SELECT con.conname INTO v_pk_name
  FROM pg_constraint con
  JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'ai_user_daily_quotas'
    AND con.contype = 'p'
    AND pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) <> 'PRIMARY KEY (usuario_id, quota_date, task)'
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_pk_name IS NOT NULL THEN
    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas DROP CONSTRAINT %I', v_pk_name);
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ai_user_daily_quotas' AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    EXECUTE 'UPDATE public.ai_user_daily_quotas SET usuario_id = user_id WHERE usuario_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL';
    EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas ALTER COLUMN user_id DROP NOT NULL';
    EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas ALTER COLUMN user_id SET DEFAULT NULL';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ai_user_daily_quotas' AND column_name = 'requests_used'
  ) THEN
    EXECUTE 'UPDATE public.ai_user_daily_quotas SET used_count = GREATEST(used_count, COALESCE(requests_used, 0))';
    EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas ALTER COLUMN requests_used DROP NOT NULL';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ai_user_daily_quotas' AND column_name = 'tokens_estimated'
  ) THEN
    EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas ALTER COLUMN tokens_estimated DROP NOT NULL';
  END IF;
  DELETE FROM public.ai_user_daily_quotas WHERE usuario_id IS NULL;
  UPDATE public.ai_user_daily_quotas
  SET task = CASE WHEN COALESCE(task, '') IN ('b2b_digitizer', 'b2c_coach_match', 'catalog_seeder') THEN task ELSE 'b2c_coach_match' END,
      used_count = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(used_count, 0)),
      daily_limit = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(daily_limit, 5));
  DELETE FROM public.ai_user_daily_quotas a
  USING public.ai_user_daily_quotas b
  WHERE a.ctid < b.ctid AND a.usuario_id = b.usuario_id AND a.quota_date = b.quota_date AND a.task = b.task;
  ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas
    ALTER COLUMN usuario_id SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN task SET NOT NULL;
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint con
    JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'ai_user_daily_quotas' AND con.contype = 'p'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas ADD CONSTRAINT ai_user_daily_quotas_pkey PRIMARY KEY (usuario_id, quota_date, task);
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'ai_user_daily_quotas' AND con.conname = 'ai_user_daily_quotas_used_count_check') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas ADD CONSTRAINT ai_user_daily_quotas_used_count_check CHECK (used_count >= 0);
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'ai_user_daily_quotas' AND con.conname = 'ai_user_daily_quotas_daily_limit_check') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas ADD CONSTRAINT ai_user_daily_quotas_daily_limit_check CHECK (daily_limit >= 0);
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'ai_user_daily_quotas' AND con.conname = 'ai_user_daily_quotas_task_check') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas ADD CONSTRAINT ai_user_daily_quotas_task_check CHECK (task IN ('b2b_digitizer', 'b2c_coach_match', 'catalog_seeder'));
  END IF;
END $$;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_user_daily_quotas_usuario_id
  ON public.ai_user_daily_quotas (usuario_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_user_daily_quotas_date_task
  ON public.ai_user_daily_quotas (quota_date, task);

ALTER TABLE public.ai_user_daily_quotas ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

GRANT SELECT ON public.ai_user_daily_quotas TO authenticated;

DO $$
DECLARE r_pol RECORD;
BEGIN
  FOR r_pol IN SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'ai_user_daily_quotas'
  LOOP
    EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON public.ai_user_daily_quotas', r_pol.policyname);
  END LOOP;
END $$;

CREATE POLICY "ai_user_daily_quotas_owner_or_admin_select"
  ON public.ai_user_daily_quotas
  FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING ((SELECT auth.uid()) = usuario_id OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE));

-- 3. RPC ATÓMICO ACID PARA CONSUMIR CUOTA DIARIA IA SIN RACE CONDITIONS
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.consumir_cuota_ia_diaria(UUID, INTEGER, INTEGER);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consumir_cuota_ia_diaria(
  p_usuario_id UUID,
  p_task TEXT,
  p_limite_override INTEGER DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID;
  v_jwt_role TEXT;
  v_is_backend BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_email TEXT;
  v_rol TEXT;
  v_nivel TEXT;
  v_is_master BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_is_b2b BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_is_vip BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_limit INTEGER := 0;
  v_used INTEGER := 0;
  v_eff_limit INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_usuario_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_USER_ID';
  END IF;

  IF p_task NOT IN ('b2b_digitizer', 'b2c_coach_match', 'catalog_seeder') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_AI_TASK';
  END IF;

  v_caller := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_jwt_role := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');
  v_is_backend := (
    (v_jwt_role = 'service_role' AND current_setting('role', true) = 'service_role')
    OR (
      session_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin')
      AND COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('role', true), ''), 'none') IN ('none', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')
    )
  );

  IF v_caller IS NOT NULL AND v_caller <> p_usuario_id AND NOT COALESCE(public.is_kinetic_master_admin(), FALSE) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN_QUOTA_SPOOF';
  END IF;

  IF v_caller IS NULL AND NOT v_is_backend THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED';
  END IF;

  IF p_limite_override IS NOT NULL AND NOT (v_is_backend OR (v_caller IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(public.is_kinetic_master_admin(), FALSE))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN_QUOTA_OVERRIDE';
  END IF;

  SELECT
    LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(u.email, ''))),
    LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p.rol, ''))),
    LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p.nivel, '')))
  INTO v_email, v_rol, v_nivel
  FROM auth.users u
  LEFT JOIN public.perfiles p ON p.id = u.id
  WHERE u.id = p_usuario_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'USER_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  v_is_master := (
    v_email IN ('administrador@kinetic.com.mx', 'administrador@kinetic.com', 'kinetic@kinetic.com', 'admin@kinetic.com')
    OR v_rol IN ('admin', 'fundador')
  );
  v_is_b2b := v_is_master OR v_rol IN ('socio', 'afiliado', 'club', 'especialista', 'negocio');
  v_is_vip := (
    v_nivel LIKE '%leyenda%'
    OR v_nivel LIKE '%black%'
    OR v_nivel LIKE '%elite%'
    OR v_nivel LIKE '%élite%'
    OR v_nivel LIKE '%platinum%'
    OR v_nivel LIKE '%platino%'
    OR v_nivel LIKE '%pro%'
    OR v_nivel LIKE '%gold%'
    OR v_nivel LIKE '%oro%'
  );

  IF p_limite_override IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_limit := GREATEST(0, p_limite_override);
  ELSIF v_is_master THEN
    v_limit := 100;
  ELSIF p_task = 'catalog_seeder' THEN
    v_limit := 0;
  ELSIF p_task = 'b2b_digitizer' THEN
    v_limit := CASE WHEN v_is_b2b THEN 15 ELSE 0 END;
  ELSE
    v_limit := CASE WHEN v_is_b2b OR v_is_vip THEN 10 ELSE 3 END;
  END IF;

  IF v_limit <= 0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'allowed', FALSE,
      'task', p_task,
      'quota_date', CURRENT_DATE,
      'used_count', 0,
      'daily_limit', 0,
      'remaining', 0
    );
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.ai_user_daily_quotas (usuario_id, quota_date, task, used_count, daily_limit, updated_at)
  VALUES (p_usuario_id, CURRENT_DATE, p_task, 1, v_limit, NOW())
  ON CONFLICT (usuario_id, quota_date, task) DO UPDATE
  SET used_count = public.ai_user_daily_quotas.used_count + 1,
      daily_limit = v_limit,
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE public.ai_user_daily_quotas.used_count < v_limit
  RETURNING used_count, daily_limit INTO v_used, v_eff_limit;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    SELECT used_count INTO v_used
    FROM public.ai_user_daily_quotas
    WHERE usuario_id = p_usuario_id AND quota_date = CURRENT_DATE AND task = p_task;

    v_used := COALESCE(v_used, v_limit);
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'allowed', FALSE,
      'task', p_task,
      'quota_date', CURRENT_DATE,
      'used_count', v_used,
      'daily_limit', v_limit,
      'remaining', 0
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'allowed', TRUE,
    'task', p_task,
    'quota_date', CURRENT_DATE,
    'used_count', v_used,
    'daily_limit', v_eff_limit,
    'remaining', GREATEST(0, v_eff_limit - v_used)
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_afiliados_verificado_v277()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');
  v_is_priv BOOLEAN := (
    (v_jwt_role = 'service_role' AND current_setting('role', true) = 'service_role')
    OR (session_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('role', true), ''), 'none') IN ('none', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin'))
    OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE)
  );
BEGIN
  IF v_is_priv THEN
    IF LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
       AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.estado, ''))) <> 'activo' AND NEW.verificado IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.verificado)) THEN
      NEW.verificado := TRUE;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    NEW.verificado := FALSE;
    IF LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.estado, ''))) IN ('', 'activo') THEN
      NEW.estado := 'pendiente';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    NEW.verificado := COALESCE(OLD.verificado, FALSE);
    IF COALESCE(OLD.verificado, FALSE) THEN
      NEW.nombre := OLD.nombre;
    END IF;
    IF LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.estado, ''))) <> 'activo' AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.estado, ''))) IN ('', 'activo') THEN
      NEW.estado := OLD.estado;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

  );
BEGIN

  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti(
  p_user_id UUID,
  p_reto_id TEXT,
  p_kc_reward NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
  p_xp_reward INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_claim_key TEXT;
  v_claimed TEXT[];
  v_safe_kc NUMERIC := 0;
  v_safe_xp INTEGER := 0;
  v_mem NUMERIC;
  v_top NUMERIC;
  v_xp NUMERIC;
  v_box_lvl INTEGER;
  v_reto_num INTEGER;
  v_completed_sessions INTEGER := 0;
  v_req_xp INTEGER := 0;
  v_lvl_idx INTEGER;
  v_review_res_id UUID;
  v_recent_claims INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para reclamar recompensas ajenas.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_claim_key := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_reto_id, '')));
  IF v_claim_key = '' OR LENGTH(v_claim_key) > 160 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Identificador de reto invalido.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_kc_reward, 0) < 0 OR (COALESCE(p_kc_reward, 0) > 0 AND (p_kc_reward <> TRUNC(p_kc_reward) OR MOD(p_kc_reward, 10) <> 0)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_KC_REWARD_MULTIPLE_OF_10' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_xp_reward, 0) < 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_XP_REWARD_NEGATIVE' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT COALESCE(recompensas_reclamadas, '{}'), COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0), COALESCE(xp_total, 0)
    INTO v_claimed, v_mem, v_top, v_xp
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF v_claim_key LIKE 'recompensa_diaria%' OR v_claim_key LIKE 'misteriosa_diaria%' THEN
    v_claim_key := 'recompensa_diaria_' || to_char(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD');
    v_safe_kc := 0;
    v_safe_xp := 25;
  ELSIF v_claim_key ~ '^review_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
    v_review_res_id := SUBSTRING(v_claim_key FROM 8)::UUID;
    IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas r
      WHERE r.id = v_review_res_id
        AND r.usuario_id = p_user_id
        AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada')
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reserva no elegible para recompensa de resena.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    v_safe_kc := 0;
    v_safe_xp := 15;
  ELSIF v_claim_key ~ '^caja_nivel_[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN
    v_box_lvl := SUBSTRING(v_claim_key FROM 12)::INTEGER;
    IF v_box_lvl < 1 OR v_box_lvl > 99 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cofre fuera de rango permitido.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    v_req_xp := 0;
    FOR v_lvl_idx IN 1..v_box_lvl LOOP
      v_req_xp := v_req_xp + (ROUND((100 + (v_lvl_idx - 1) * 6 + POWER(v_lvl_idx - 1, 1.38) * 1.45) / 10.0)::INTEGER * 10);
    END LOOP;
    IF v_xp < v_req_xp AND NOT v_is_admin THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'XP insuficiente para abrir cofre de nivel.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    v_safe_kc := (ARRAY[10, 10, 10, 20])[1 + LEAST(3, GREATEST(0, FLOOR(random() * 4)::INTEGER))];
    v_safe_xp := 30;
  ELSIF v_claim_key ~ '^reto_([1-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|250)$' THEN
    v_reto_num := SUBSTRING(v_claim_key FROM 6)::INTEGER;
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_completed_sessions
    FROM public.reservas r
    WHERE r.usuario_id = p_user_id AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada');

    IF NOT v_is_admin THEN
      IF (v_reto_num BETWEEN 3 AND 10 AND v_completed_sessions < 1)
         OR (v_reto_num BETWEEN 11 AND 50 AND v_completed_sessions < 2)
         OR (v_reto_num BETWEEN 51 AND 100 AND v_completed_sessions < 5)
         OR (v_reto_num BETWEEN 101 AND 150 AND v_completed_sessions < 15)
         OR (v_reto_num BETWEEN 151 AND 200 AND v_completed_sessions < 30)
         OR (v_reto_num BETWEEN 201 AND 250 AND v_completed_sessions < 60) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Progreso de sesiones insuficiente para reclamar este reto.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
      END IF;
      SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_recent_claims
      FROM public.kineti_claimed_rewards k
      WHERE k.user_id = p_user_id AND k.claim_key ~ '^reto_' AND k.claimed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';
      IF v_recent_claims >= 5 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Limite diario de reclamos de retos alcanzado.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    v_safe_kc := 0;
    v_safe_xp := CASE
      WHEN v_reto_num <= 10 THEN 20
      WHEN v_reto_num <= 50 THEN 25
      WHEN v_reto_num <= 100 THEN 60
      WHEN v_reto_num <= 150 THEN 120
      WHEN v_reto_num <= 200 THEN 220
      ELSE 400
    END;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNRECOGNIZED_OR_RESERVED_REWARD_KEY' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF v_claim_key = ANY(v_claimed) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'duplicate', TRUE, 'kc_topup', v_top, 'xp_total', v_xp);
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.kineti_claimed_rewards (user_id, claim_key, kc_granted, xp_granted)
  VALUES (p_user_id, v_claim_key, v_safe_kc, v_safe_xp)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, claim_key) DO NOTHING;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'duplicate', TRUE, 'kc_topup', v_top, 'xp_total', v_xp);
  END IF;

  v_claimed := array_append(v_claimed, v_claim_key);
  v_top := v_top + v_safe_kc;
  v_xp := v_xp + v_safe_xp;

  UPDATE public.perfiles
  SET kc_topup = v_top,
      saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top,
      xp_total = v_xp,
      recompensas_reclamadas = v_claimed
  WHERE id = p_user_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'duplicate', FALSE, 'kc_topup', v_top, 'xp_total', v_xp);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti(UUID, TEXT, NUMERIC, INTEGER) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti(UUID, TEXT, NUMERIC, INTEGER) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cancelar_reserva_escrow_72h(p_reserva_id UUID)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_res RECORD;
  v_perf RECORD;
  v_raw_fecha TEXT;
  v_event_ts TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_hours_until NUMERIC := 0;
  v_mins_created NUMERIC := 999;
  v_month_key TEXT := to_char(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM');
  v_used_forgive INTEGER := 0;
  v_max_forgive INTEGER := 0;
  v_should_refund BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_use_forgive BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_mem_refund NUMERIC := 0;
  v_top_refund NUMERIC := 0;
  v_total_refund NUMERIC := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_res FROM public.reservas WHERE id = p_reserva_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'refunded', FALSE, 'refundAmount', 0, 'newState', 'cancelada');
  END IF;

  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (v_res.usuario_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para cancelar esta reserva.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_res.estado, ''))) IN ('cancelada', 'completada', 'usada', 'no_show', 'penalizada', 'expirada', 'rechazada', 'eliminada') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'refunded', FALSE, 'refundAmount', 0, 'newState', v_res.estado);
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_perf FROM public.perfiles WHERE id = v_res.usuario_id FOR UPDATE;

  v_raw_fecha := NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(v_res.fecha_clase::text, '')), '');
  BEGIN
    IF v_raw_fecha IS NULL THEN
      v_event_ts := COALESCE(v_res.created_at, NOW());
    ELSIF v_raw_fecha ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN
      v_event_ts := (v_raw_fecha || 'T08:00:00Z')::timestamptz;
    ELSE
      v_event_ts := v_raw_fecha::timestamptz;
    END IF;
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    v_event_ts := COALESCE(v_res.created_at, NOW());
  END;

  v_hours_until := EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (v_event_ts - NOW())) / 3600.0;
  v_mins_created := EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - COALESCE(v_res.created_at, NOW()))) / 60.0;
  v_max_forgive := CASE
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%plat%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%leyenda%' THEN 3
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%gold%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%oro%' THEN 2
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%silver%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(v_perf.nivel, '')) LIKE '%plata%' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END;
  v_used_forgive := CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(v_perf.mes_perdones_control, '') = v_month_key THEN GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_perf.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0))
    ELSE 0
  END;
  v_total_refund := TRUNC(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_res.monto_escrow, 0)));
  v_mem_refund := LEAST(TRUNC(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_res.escrow_membresia, 0))), v_total_refund);
  v_top_refund := LEAST(TRUNC(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(v_res.escrow_topup, 0))), GREATEST(0, v_total_refund - v_mem_refund));
  IF (v_mem_refund + v_top_refund) < v_total_refund THEN
    v_mem_refund := v_total_refund - v_top_refund;
  END IF;

  IF v_total_refund <= 0 OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE) OR v_mins_created <= 5 OR v_hours_until >= 72 THEN
    v_should_refund := TRUE;
  ELSIF v_hours_until >= 4 AND v_hours_until < 72 AND v_used_forgive < v_max_forgive THEN
    v_should_refund := TRUE;
    v_use_forgive := TRUE;
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  UPDATE public.reservas
  SET estado = 'cancelada',
      perdon_vip_aplicado = CASE WHEN v_use_forgive THEN TRUE ELSE COALESCE(perdon_vip_aplicado, FALSE) END,
      monto_escrow = CASE WHEN v_should_refund THEN 0 ELSE monto_escrow END
  WHERE id = p_reserva_id;

  IF v_should_refund THEN
    UPDATE public.perfiles
    SET kc_membresia = COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) + v_mem_refund,
        kc_topup = COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + v_top_refund,
        saldo_kc = COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) + v_mem_refund + COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + v_top_refund,
        perdones_mensuales_usados = CASE WHEN v_use_forgive THEN v_used_forgive + 1 ELSE v_used_forgive END,
        mes_perdones_control = v_month_key
    WHERE id = v_res.usuario_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', TRUE, 'refunded', v_should_refund,
    'refundAmount', CASE WHEN v_should_refund THEN v_total_refund ELSE 0 END,
    'usedVipForgiveness', v_use_forgive,
    'remainingForgiveness', GREATEST(0, v_max_forgive - (CASE WHEN v_use_forgive THEN v_used_forgive + 1 ELSE v_used_forgive END)),
    'newState', 'cancelada'
  );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.cancelar_reserva_escrow_72h(UUID) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.cancelar_reserva_escrow_72h(UUID) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.responder_split_escrow_invitacion(p_invite_id UUID, p_estado TEXT)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_estado TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_estado, '')));
  v_row RECORD;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida para responder invitaciones Split-Escrow.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_estado NOT IN ('aceptada', 'rechazada') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Estado de respuesta invalido.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT id, invitado_id, estado INTO v_row FROM public.split_escrow_invitaciones WHERE id = p_invite_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invitacion Split-Escrow no encontrada.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  IF v_row.invitado_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solo el atleta invitado puede responder.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF LOWER(COALESCE(v_row.estado, 'pendiente')) <> 'pendiente' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invitacion Split-Escrow ya respondida.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.split_escrow_invitaciones SET estado = v_estado, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_invite_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'id', p_invite_id, 'estado', v_estado);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.responder_split_escrow_invitacion(UUID, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.responder_split_escrow_invitacion(UUID, TEXT) TO authenticated;

-- 4. [OWASP API2 & API4:2023] NONCES QR ÚNICOS + RATE LIMITING SERVER-SIDE

USING public.qr_totp_replay_nonces b

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_qr_totp_replay_consumed_by

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_qr_totp_replay_single_reserva

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_qr_totp_replay_step_nonce

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.edge_rate_limits (
  scope TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  window_start TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  hit_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (hit_count >= 0),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  PRIMARY KEY (scope, actor_key)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_edge_rate_limits_updated_at
  ON public.edge_rate_limits (updated_at);

ALTER TABLE public.edge_rate_limits ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.edge_rate_limits FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.verificar_rate_limit_ventana(
  p_scope TEXT,
  p_actor_key TEXT,
  p_max_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 15,
  p_window_seconds INTEGER DEFAULT 60
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');
  v_is_backend BOOLEAN := (
    (v_jwt_role = 'service_role' AND current_setting('role', true) = 'service_role')
    OR (session_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('role', true), ''), 'none') IN ('none', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin'))
  );
  v_scope TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_scope, '')));
  v_actor TEXT := TRIM(COALESCE(p_actor_key, ''));
  v_max INTEGER := LEAST(1000, GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_max_hits, 15)));
  v_win_sec INTEGER := LEAST(86400, GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_window_seconds, 60)));
  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := NOW();
  v_win_start TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_hits INTEGER := 0;
  v_retry INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NOT v_is_backend AND NOT (v_caller IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(public.is_kinetic_master_admin(), FALSE)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED_RATE_LIMIT_RPC' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF v_scope = '' OR v_actor = '' OR LENGTH(v_scope) > 64 OR LENGTH(v_actor) > 160
     OR LOWER(v_actor) IN ('__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_RATE_LIMIT_KEY' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM public.edge_rate_limits
  WHERE ctid IN (
    SELECT ctid FROM public.edge_rate_limits
    WHERE updated_at < v_now - INTERVAL '2 hours'
      AND NOT (scope = v_scope AND actor_key = v_actor)
    LIMIT 25
  );

  INSERT INTO public.edge_rate_limits (scope, actor_key, window_start, hit_count, updated_at)
  VALUES (v_scope, v_actor, v_now, 1, v_now)
  ON CONFLICT (scope, actor_key) DO UPDATE
  SET window_start = CASE
        WHEN v_now >= public.edge_rate_limits.window_start + make_interval(secs => v_win_sec) THEN v_now
        ELSE public.edge_rate_limits.window_start
      END,
      hit_count = CASE
        WHEN v_now >= public.edge_rate_limits.window_start + make_interval(secs => v_win_sec) THEN 1
        ELSE public.edge_rate_limits.hit_count + 1
      END,
      updated_at = v_now
  RETURNING window_start, hit_count INTO v_win_start, v_hits;

  IF v_hits <= v_max THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('allowed', TRUE, 'remaining', GREATEST(0, v_max - v_hits), 'retry_after_seconds', 0);
  END IF;

  v_retry := GREATEST(1, CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((v_win_start + make_interval(secs => v_win_sec)) - v_now)))::INTEGER);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('allowed', FALSE, 'remaining', 0, 'retry_after_seconds', v_retry);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.verificar_rate_limit_ventana(TEXT, TEXT, INTEGER, INTEGER) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.verificar_rate_limit_ventana(TEXT, TEXT, INTEGER, INTEGER) TO service_role;

-- 5. [OWASP API10:2023] WEBHOOK STRIPE CRIPTOGRÁFICO E IDEMPOTENTE + SANDBOX FLAG
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.stripe_processed_events (
  event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  billetera_destino TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'topup',
  monto_kc NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  nivel_asignado TEXT,
  metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stripe_processed_events_user_id
  ON public.stripe_processed_events (user_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stripe_processed_events_pi_id
  ON public.stripe_processed_events ((metadata ->> 'payment_intent_id'))
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(metadata ->> 'payment_intent_id', '')), '') IS NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.stripe_processed_events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.stripe_processed_events FROM PUBLIC, anon;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Lectura auditoria stripe_processed_events Admin Maestro" ON public.stripe_processed_events;
CREATE POLICY "Lectura auditoria stripe_processed_events Admin Maestro"
  ON public.stripe_processed_events FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.procesar_webhook_stripe_kc(
  p_event_id TEXT,
  p_event_type TEXT,
  p_user_id UUID,
  p_cantidad_kc NUMERIC,
  p_billetera TEXT DEFAULT 'topup',
  p_nuevo_nivel TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');
  v_is_backend BOOLEAN := (
    (v_jwt_role = 'service_role' AND current_setting('role', true) = 'service_role')
    OR (session_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('role', true), ''), 'none') IN ('none', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin'))
  );
  v_mem NUMERIC;
  v_top NUMERIC;
  v_nivel TEXT;
  v_cur_weight INTEGER := 0;
  v_new_weight INTEGER := 0;
  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := NOW();
BEGIN
  IF NOT v_is_backend THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_RPC' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF p_event_id IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(p_event_id)) < 4 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Identificador de evento Stripe invalido.';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_cantidad_kc, 0) <= 0 OR p_cantidad_kc <> TRUNC(p_cantidad_kc) OR MOD(p_cantidad_kc, 10) <> 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Candado financiero Kinetic: p_cantidad_kc debe ser positivo y multiplo exacto de 10.';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.stripe_processed_events (
    event_id, event_type, user_id, billetera_destino, monto_kc, nivel_asignado, metadata, processed_at
  )
  VALUES (
    TRIM(p_event_id), COALESCE(p_event_type, 'payment_intent.succeeded'), p_user_id,
    LOWER(COALESCE(p_billetera, 'topup')), p_cantidad_kc, p_nuevo_nivel, COALESCE(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb), v_now
  )
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'duplicate_ignored', 'event_id', TRIM(p_event_id));
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0), COALESCE(nivel, 'Acceso Base')
    INTO v_mem, v_top, v_nivel
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Usuario % no existe en public.perfiles.', p_user_id;
  END IF;

  IF LOWER(COALESCE(p_billetera, 'topup')) = 'membresia' THEN
    v_mem := v_mem + p_cantidad_kc;
  ELSE
    v_top := v_top + p_cantidad_kc;
  END IF;

  IF p_nuevo_nivel IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(p_nuevo_nivel)) > 0 THEN
    v_cur_weight := CASE
      WHEN LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%plat%' OR LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%leyenda%' OR LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%black%' THEN 4
      WHEN LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%gold%' OR LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%oro%' THEN 3
      WHEN LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%silver%' OR LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%plata%' THEN 2
      WHEN LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%bronze%' OR LOWER(v_nivel) LIKE '%bronce%' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END;
    v_new_weight := CASE
      WHEN LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%plat%' OR LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%leyenda%' OR LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%black%' THEN 4
      WHEN LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%gold%' OR LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%oro%' THEN 3
      WHEN LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%silver%' OR LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%plata%' THEN 2
      WHEN LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%bronze%' OR LOWER(p_nuevo_nivel) LIKE '%bronce%' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END;
    IF v_new_weight > v_cur_weight THEN
      v_nivel := TRIM(p_nuevo_nivel);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.perfiles
  SET kc_membresia = v_mem,
      kc_topup = v_top,
      saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top,
      nivel = v_nivel,
      fecha_activacion_membresia = CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(p_billetera, 'topup')) = 'membresia' THEN v_now ELSE fecha_activacion_membresia END
  WHERE id = p_user_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'status', 'processed', 'event_id', TRIM(p_event_id), 'user_id', p_user_id,
    'kc_membresia', v_mem, 'kc_topup', v_top, 'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top, 'nivel', v_nivel
  );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.procesar_webhook_stripe_kc(TEXT, TEXT, UUID, NUMERIC, TEXT, TEXT, JSONB) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.procesar_webhook_stripe_kc(TEXT, TEXT, UUID, NUMERIC, TEXT, TEXT, JSONB) TO service_role;

VALUES (
  'allow_pre_stripe_sandbox',
  TRUE,
  'Boveda v2.7.7 en Modo Pre-Stripe Sandbox habilitado para recargas y membresias.',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (flag_key) DO UPDATE
SET enabled = TRUE,
    description = EXCLUDED.description,

-- MIGRACIÓN v278 — RESERVAS ESCROW RECURRENTES (America/Mazatlan), KINETICLUB RPCs,
-- BLINDAJE DUAL PERFILES, PARIDAD UGC ADMIN Y PERMISOS DE MÍNIMOS PRIVILEGIOS
-- Idempotente y 100% compatible con v272..v277.
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. UNIFICACIÓN DE TRIGGERS EN public.perfiles (kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized || kinetic.rpc_authorized)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.proteger_columnas_sensibles_perfiles()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_vault_ok BOOLEAN := (
    COALESCE(current_setting('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', true), 'false') = 'true'
    OR COALESCE(current_setting('kinetic.rpc_authorized', true), 'false') = 'true'
  );
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), '');
BEGIN
  IF v_vault_ok THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF current_user IN ('postgres', 'service_role', 'supabase_admin')
     AND v_jwt_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE) THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF (NEW.kc_membresia IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.kc_membresia)
     OR (NEW.kc_topup IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.kc_topup)
     OR (NEW.saldo_kc IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.saldo_kc)
     OR (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.rol, ''))))
     OR (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.tipo_cuenta, ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.tipo_cuenta, ''))))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.nivel, '') IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.nivel, ''))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.xp_total, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.xp_total, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.es_cuenta_sandbox, FALSE))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.racha_dias, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha_dias, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.racha, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.racha_semanal_dias, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha_semanal_dias, 0))
     OR (NEW.ultima_fecha_racha IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ultima_fecha_racha)
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.is_streak_frozen, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.is_streak_frozen, FALSE))
     OR (NEW.escudo_activo_hasta IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_activo_hasta)
     OR (NEW.escudo_racha_activo_hasta IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_racha_activo_hasta)
     OR (NEW.escudo_semana_iso IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_semana_iso)
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.escudos_usados_semana, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.escudos_usados_semana, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.prestigio_nivel, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.prestigio_nivel, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.prestigio_grado, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.prestigio_grado, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.kc_ganados_cajas, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_ganados_cajas, 0))
     OR (NEW.recompensas_reclamadas IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.recompensas_reclamadas)
     OR (NEW.codigo_referido IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.codigo_referido)
     OR (NEW.referido_por IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por)
     OR (NEW.referido_por_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por_id)
     OR (NEW.referido_por_codigo IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por_codigo)
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.referidos_count, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.referidos_count, 0))
     OR (COALESCE(NEW.kc_ganados_referidos, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_ganados_referidos, 0)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SEGURIDAD KINETIC: Operacion bloqueada. Columnas protegidas solo pueden modificarse mediante RPC autorizado.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_perfiles_privilegios_y_boveda()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');
  v_ok BOOLEAN := (
    COALESCE(current_setting('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', true), 'false') = 'true'
    OR COALESCE(current_setting('kinetic.rpc_authorized', true), 'false') = 'true'
    OR (
      ((SELECT auth.uid()) IS NULL AND current_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role'))
      AND v_jwt_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated'
    )
    OR v_jwt_role = 'service_role'
    OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE)
  );
BEGIN
  NEW.kc_membresia := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(NEW.kc_membresia, 0));
  NEW.kc_topup := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(NEW.kc_topup, 0));
  NEW.saldo_kc := NEW.kc_membresia + NEW.kc_topup;

  IF v_ok THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT auth.uid())
       OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IN ('admin', 'fundador')
       OR NEW.kc_membresia > 0
       OR NEW.kc_topup > 0
       OR COALESCE(NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox, FALSE) = TRUE
       OR COALESCE(NEW.bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE) = TRUE
       OR COALESCE(NEW.prestigio_nivel, 0) > 0
       OR COALESCE(NEW.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0) > 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Operacion bloqueada en registro.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    NEW.rol := CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'especialista') THEN LOWER(TRIM(NEW.rol)) ELSE 'atleta' END;
    NEW.tipo_cuenta := CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.tipo_cuenta, ''))) IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'especialista', 'b2b') THEN LOWER(TRIM(NEW.tipo_cuenta)) ELSE 'atleta' END;
    NEW.nivel := CASE WHEN NEW.rol IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'especialista') THEN 'Partner B2B' ELSE 'Acceso Base' END;
    NEW.xp_total := 0;
    NEW.racha_dias := 0;
    NEW.racha := 0;
    NEW.racha_semanal_dias := 0;
    NEW.ultima_fecha_racha := NULL;
    NEW.is_streak_frozen := FALSE;
    NEW.escudo_activo_hasta := NULL;
    NEW.escudo_racha_activo_hasta := NULL;
    NEW.escudo_semana_iso := NULL;
    NEW.escudos_usados_semana := 0;
    NEW.prestigio_nivel := 0;
    NEW.prestigio_grado := 0;
    NEW.cajas_nivel_reclamadas := 0;
    NEW.kc_ganados_cajas := 0;
    NEW.recompensas_reclamadas := ARRAY[]::TEXT[];
    NEW.perdones_mensuales_usados := 0;
    NEW.codigo_referido := NULL;
    NEW.referido_por := NULL;
    NEW.referido_por_id := NULL;
    NEW.referido_por_codigo := NULL;
    NEW.bono_referido_otorgado := FALSE;
    NEW.referidos_count := 0;
    NEW.kc_ganados_referidos := 0;
    NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox := FALSE;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND (
    NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
    OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.rol, ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.rol, '')))
    OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.tipo_cuenta, ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.tipo_cuenta, '')))
    OR COALESCE(NEW.nivel, '') IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.nivel, '')
    OR COALESCE(NEW.kc_membresia, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_membresia, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.kc_topup, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_topup, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.saldo_kc, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.saldo_kc, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.xp_total, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.xp_total, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.perdones_mensuales_usados, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.es_cuenta_sandbox, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.es_cuenta_sandbox, FALSE)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.racha_dias, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha_dias, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.racha, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.racha_semanal_dias, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.racha_semanal_dias, 0)
    OR NEW.ultima_fecha_racha IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ultima_fecha_racha
    OR COALESCE(NEW.is_streak_frozen, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.is_streak_frozen, FALSE)
    OR NEW.escudo_activo_hasta IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_activo_hasta
    OR NEW.escudo_racha_activo_hasta IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_racha_activo_hasta
    OR NEW.escudo_semana_iso IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.escudo_semana_iso
    OR COALESCE(NEW.escudos_usados_semana, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.escudos_usados_semana, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.prestigio_nivel, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.prestigio_nivel, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.prestigio_grado, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.prestigio_grado, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.kc_ganados_cajas, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_ganados_cajas, 0)
    OR NEW.recompensas_reclamadas IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.recompensas_reclamadas
    OR NEW.codigo_referido IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.codigo_referido
    OR NEW.referido_por IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por
    OR NEW.referido_por_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por_id
    OR NEW.referido_por_codigo IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.referido_por_codigo
    OR COALESCE(NEW.bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.referidos_count, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.referidos_count, 0)
    OR COALESCE(NEW.kc_ganados_referidos, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.kc_ganados_referidos, 0)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Modificacion directa bloqueada fuera de RPC autorizado.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- 2. HELPER DE RECURRENCIA Y VIGENCIA EN ZONA HORARIA 'America/Mazatlan'
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.es_fecha_valida_servicio_mazatlan(
  p_fecha_solicitada TEXT,
  p_fecha_base DATE,
  p_hora_inicio TIME,
  p_frecuencia TEXT,
  p_descripcion TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_atributos JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_now_mzt TIMESTAMP := (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan');
  v_today_mzt DATE := v_now_mzt::date;
  v_raw_req TEXT := NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(p_fecha_solicitada, '')), 10), '');
  v_desc_freq TEXT := COALESCE((REGEXP_MATCH(COALESCE(p_descripcion, ''), '\[Frecuencia Programada:\s*([^\]]+)\]', 'i'))[1], '');
  v_raw_freq TEXT := LOWER(TRANSLATE(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_frecuencia), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_atributos->>'frecuencia', '')), ''), v_desc_freq, 'unica')), 'áéíóúÁÉÍÓÚ', 'aeiouAEIOU'));
  v_rec TEXT := 'unica';
  v_target_date DATE;
  v_end_date DATE;
  v_end_raw TEXT := NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(p_atributos->>'fecha_fin', '')), 10), '');
  v_hora TIME := COALESCE(p_hora_inicio, '08:00:00'::time);
  v_step INTEGER := 0;
  v_month_last DATE;
  v_base_dom INTEGER;
  v_target_ts TIMESTAMP;
BEGIN
  IF v_raw_freq ~ '(diari|daily)' THEN
    v_rec := 'diario';
  ELSIF v_raw_freq ~ '(seman|week)' THEN
    v_rec := 'semanal';
  ELSIF v_raw_freq ~ '(mensu|month)' THEN
    v_rec := 'mensual';
  ELSE
    v_rec := 'unica';
  END IF;

  IF v_end_raw ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN
    v_end_date := v_end_raw::date;
  END IF;

  IF v_raw_req ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN
    v_target_date := v_raw_req::date;
  ELSE
    IF v_rec = 'unica' THEN
      v_target_date := COALESCE(p_fecha_base, v_today_mzt);
    ELSIF v_rec = 'diario' THEN
      v_target_date := GREATEST(v_today_mzt, COALESCE(p_fecha_base, v_today_mzt));
      IF v_target_date = v_today_mzt AND p_hora_inicio IS NOT NULL AND (v_target_date + v_hora) < (v_now_mzt - INTERVAL '15 minutes') THEN
        v_target_date := v_target_date + 1;
      END IF;
    ELSIF v_rec = 'semanal' THEN
      v_target_date := COALESCE(p_fecha_base, v_today_mzt);
      WHILE v_step < 520 AND (
        v_target_date < v_today_mzt
        OR (v_target_date = v_today_mzt AND p_hora_inicio IS NOT NULL AND (v_target_date + v_hora) < (v_now_mzt - INTERVAL '15 minutes'))
      ) LOOP
        v_target_date := v_target_date + 7;
        v_step := v_step + 1;
      END LOOP;
    ELSE
      v_target_date := COALESCE(p_fecha_base, v_today_mzt);
      WHILE v_step < 240 AND (
        v_target_date < v_today_mzt
        OR (v_target_date = v_today_mzt AND p_hora_inicio IS NOT NULL AND (v_target_date + v_hora) < (v_now_mzt - INTERVAL '15 minutes'))
      ) LOOP
        v_step := v_step + 1;
        v_target_date := (COALESCE(p_fecha_base, v_today_mzt) + (v_step || ' months')::interval)::date;
      END LOOP;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  v_target_ts := v_target_date + v_hora;

  IF v_end_date IS NOT NULL AND v_target_date > v_end_date THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'valid', FALSE,
      'resolved_date', to_char(v_target_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
      'recurrence', v_rec,
      'reason', 'HORARIO_NO_DISPONIBLE: Esta clase excede la fecha limite de programacion.'
    );
  END IF;

  IF v_target_date < v_today_mzt
     OR (p_hora_inicio IS NOT NULL AND v_target_ts < (v_now_mzt - INTERVAL '15 minutes')) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'valid', FALSE,
      'resolved_date', to_char(v_target_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
      'recurrence', v_rec,
      'reason', 'HORARIO_NO_DISPONIBLE: El horario seleccionado ya transcurrio en horario de Los Cabos.'
    );
  END IF;

  IF v_rec = 'unica' THEN
    IF p_fecha_base IS NOT NULL AND v_target_date <> p_fecha_base THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'valid', FALSE,
        'resolved_date', to_char(v_target_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        'recurrence', v_rec,
        'reason', 'HORARIO_NO_DISPONIBLE: Esta experiencia es de fecha unica (' || to_char(p_fecha_base, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ').'
      );
    END IF;
  ELSIF v_rec = 'diario' THEN
    IF p_fecha_base IS NOT NULL AND v_target_date < p_fecha_base THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'valid', FALSE,
        'resolved_date', to_char(v_target_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
