        'recurrence', v_rec,
        'reason', 'HORARIO_NO_DISPONIBLE: Fecha previa al inicio de la serie diaria.'
      );
    END IF;
  ELSIF v_rec = 'semanal' THEN
    IF p_fecha_base IS NOT NULL AND (v_target_date < p_fecha_base OR EXTRACT(DOW FROM v_target_date) <> EXTRACT(DOW FROM p_fecha_base)) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'valid', FALSE,
        'resolved_date', to_char(v_target_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        'recurrence', v_rec,
        'reason', 'HORARIO_NO_DISPONIBLE: Esta clase semanal solo abre en el dia correspondiente de la semana.'
      );
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF p_fecha_base IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_base_dom := EXTRACT(DAY FROM p_fecha_base)::int;
      v_month_last := (date_trunc('month', v_target_date) + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::date;
      IF v_target_date < p_fecha_base OR (
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM v_target_date)::int <> v_base_dom
        AND NOT (v_base_dom > EXTRACT(DAY FROM v_month_last)::int AND v_target_date = v_month_last)
      ) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
          'valid', FALSE,
          'resolved_date', to_char(v_target_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
          'recurrence', v_rec,
          'reason', 'HORARIO_NO_DISPONIBLE: Esta clase mensual solo abre el mismo dia del mes.'
        );
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'valid', TRUE,
    'resolved_date', to_char(v_target_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'recurrence', v_rec,
    'start_ts', (v_target_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan'),
    'reason', 'OK'
  );
END;
$$;

-- 3. RPCs DE RESERVA ESCROW Y OCUPACIÓN POR FECHA EN 'America/Mazatlan'
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.procesar_reserva_escrow(
  p_usuario_id UUID,
  p_negocio_nombre TEXT,
  p_servicio_nombre TEXT,
  p_precio_kc NUMERIC,
  p_servicio_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
  p_fecha_clase TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_spot_number INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
  p_split_count INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  p_es_pase_maestro BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_precio_base NUMERIC := 0;
  v_precio_real NUMERIC := 0;
  v_srv_negocio TEXT := '';
  v_srv_titulo TEXT := '';
  v_srv_estado TEXT := '';
  v_srv_activo BOOLEAN := TRUE;
  v_srv_fecha DATE;
  v_srv_hora TIME;
  v_srv_freq TEXT := '';
  v_srv_desc TEXT := '';
  v_srv_attrs JSONB := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_cupo_max INTEGER := 30;
  v_ocupados INTEGER := 0;
  v_escrow NUMERIC := 0;
  v_puerta NUMERIC := 0;
  v_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_use_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_use_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_nivel TEXT := '';
  v_vip_pct INTEGER := 0;
  v_club_pct INTEGER := 0;
  v_flash_pct INTEGER := 0;
  v_is_flash BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_srv_json JSONB := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_sched JSONB;
  v_afiliado_id_txt TEXT;
  v_afiliado_estado TEXT;
  v_ev_ts TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_f_eff TEXT;
  v_h_eff TEXT;
  v_reserva_id UUID;
  v_qr_token TEXT;
  v_split INTEGER := LEAST(10, GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_split_count, 1)));
  v_fecha TEXT := NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(p_fecha_clase, '')), 10), '');
  v_is_official BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (p_usuario_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para reservar a nombre de otro atleta.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF p_servicio_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT
      COALESCE(s.precio_kc, 0),
      COALESCE(s.cupo_maximo, 30),
      TRIM(COALESCE(s.negocio_nombre, '')),
      TRIM(COALESCE(s.nombre_servicio, '')),
      LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.estado, 'aprobado'))),
      COALESCE(s.activo, TRUE),
      COALESCE(s.fecha, NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(to_jsonb(s)->>'fecha_clase', '')), 10), '')::date),
      s.hora_inicio,
      COALESCE(s.frecuencia, ''),
      COALESCE(s.descripcion, ''),
      COALESCE(s.atributos, '{}'::jsonb),
      to_jsonb(s)
    INTO
      v_precio_base, v_cupo_max, v_srv_negocio, v_srv_titulo,
      v_srv_estado, v_srv_activo, v_srv_fecha, v_srv_hora, v_srv_freq, v_srv_desc, v_srv_attrs,
      v_srv_json
    FROM public.servicios s
    WHERE s.id = p_servicio_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICIO_INEXISTENTE: La experiencia seleccionada ya no existe.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
    END IF;

    IF NOT v_srv_activo
       OR v_srv_estado NOT IN ('activo', 'aprobado', '')
       OR COALESCE((v_srv_attrs->>'eliminado')::boolean, FALSE)
       OR COALESCE((v_srv_attrs->>'cancelado')::boolean, FALSE) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICIO_RETIRADO: La experiencia seleccionada fue pausada o retirada.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
    END IF;

    v_is_official := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_negocio, ''))) IN ('kinetic oficial', 'kinetic sports club', '');
    v_afiliado_id_txt := NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_json->>'afiliado_id', v_srv_attrs->>'afiliado_id', '')), '');

    IF NOT v_is_official AND v_afiliado_id_txt ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
      SELECT LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, '')))
      INTO v_afiliado_estado
      FROM public.afiliados a
      WHERE a.id = v_afiliado_id_txt::uuid;
      IF FOUND AND v_afiliado_estado IN ('inactivo', 'suspendido', 'eliminado', 'rechazado') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICIO_RETIRADO: Esta sede se encuentra temporalmente inactiva.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
      END IF;
    END IF;

    v_sched := public.es_fecha_valida_servicio_mazatlan(v_fecha, v_srv_fecha, v_srv_hora, v_srv_freq, v_srv_desc, v_srv_attrs);
    IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT COALESCE((v_sched->>'valid')::boolean, FALSE) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '%', COALESCE(NULLIF(v_sched->>'reason', ''), 'HORARIO_NO_DISPONIBLE: Fecha u horario fuera de vigencia.')
        USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    v_fecha := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_sched->>'resolved_date', ''), v_fecha, to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD'));

    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_ocupados
    FROM public.reservas r
    WHERE r.servicio_id = p_servicio_id
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')
      AND COALESCE(
        NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(r.fecha_clase, '')), 10), ''),
        to_char(COALESCE(r.created_at, NOW()) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      ) = v_fecha;

    IF v_ocupados >= v_cupo_max THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CUPO_AGOTADO: No quedan lugares disponibles en esta sesion.';
    END IF;

    IF p_spot_number IS NOT NULL THEN
      IF p_spot_number < 1 OR p_spot_number > v_cupo_max THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Estacion #% fuera del rango permitido (%).', p_spot_number, v_cupo_max USING ERRCODE = '22023';
      END IF;
      IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas r
        WHERE r.servicio_id = p_servicio_id
          AND r.spot_number = p_spot_number
          AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')
          AND COALESCE(
            NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(r.fecha_clase, '')), 10), ''),
            to_char(COALESCE(r.created_at, NOW()) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
          ) = v_fecha
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'SPOT_OCUPADO: La estacion #% ya fue reservada.', p_spot_number USING ERRCODE = '23505';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF NOT v_is_admin THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reserva sin servicio de catalogo prohibida para clientes.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    v_precio_base := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_precio_kc, 0));
    v_fecha := COALESCE(v_fecha, to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD'));
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0), LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(nivel, '')))
  INTO v_mem, v_top, v_nivel
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = p_usuario_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil de atleta no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_es_pase_maestro, FALSE) THEN
    IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a
      WHERE a.propietario_id = v_caller
        AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(v_srv_negocio), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.nombre, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(v_srv_negocio))
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para emitir Pase Maestro 0 KC.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    v_precio_real := 0;
    v_escrow := 0;
    v_puerta := 0;
    v_h_eff := COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_hora::text, '')), 5), ''), '08:00');
  ELSE
    IF v_precio_base < 0 OR (v_precio_base > 0 AND MOD(v_precio_base, 10) <> 0) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Precio base invalido (debe ser multiplo de 10 KC).';
    END IF;
    v_f_eff := COALESCE(v_fecha, to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD'));
    v_h_eff := COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_hora::text, '')), 5), ''), '08:00');
    IF v_f_eff ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' AND v_h_eff ~ '^\d{2}:\d{2}$' THEN
      v_ev_ts := (v_f_eff || ' ' || v_h_eff || ':00')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan';
      IF v_ev_ts > NOW() AND v_ev_ts <= (NOW() + INTERVAL '180 minutes') THEN
        v_is_flash := TRUE;
      END IF;
    END IF;
    IF COALESCE((v_srv_json->>'es_venta_flash')::boolean, FALSE) THEN
      v_is_flash := TRUE;
    END IF;
    IF v_is_flash AND v_precio_base > 0 THEN
      v_vip_pct := CASE
        WHEN v_nivel ~ '(platinum|leyenda|black)' THEN 20
        WHEN v_nivel ~ '(gold|oro)' THEN 15
        WHEN v_nivel ~ '(silver|plata)' THEN 10
        WHEN v_nivel ~ '(bronze|bronce)' THEN 5
        ELSE 0
      END;
      v_club_pct := LEAST(50, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(v_srv_attrs->>'descuento_flash_pct', ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::int, 0)));
      v_flash_pct := GREATEST(v_vip_pct, v_club_pct);
    END IF;
    v_precio_real := CASE WHEN v_flash_pct > 0 THEN GREATEST(10, ROUND(v_precio_base * (100 - v_flash_pct) / 100.0)) ELSE v_precio_base END;
    v_escrow := ROUND(v_precio_real * 0.40);
    v_puerta := GREATEST(0, v_precio_real - v_escrow);
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  IF v_escrow > 0 THEN
    IF (v_mem + v_top) < v_escrow THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SALDO_INSUFICIENTE: Tu boveda no cubre el 40%% de custodia (% KC).', v_escrow;
    END IF;
    v_use_mem := LEAST(v_mem, v_escrow);
    v_use_top := v_escrow - v_use_mem;
    UPDATE public.perfiles
    SET kc_membresia = v_mem - v_use_mem,
        kc_topup = v_top - v_use_top,
        saldo_kc = (v_mem - v_use_mem) + (v_top - v_use_top)
    WHERE id = p_usuario_id;
  END IF;

  v_qr_token := md5(gen_random_uuid()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || random()::text);
  INSERT INTO public.reservas (
    usuario_id, servicio_id, negocio_nombre, servicio, precio_kc, costo_total,
    monto_escrow, monto_puerta, escrow_membresia, escrow_topup,
    estado, qr_token, fecha_clase, hora_inicio, spot_number, split_count, es_pase_maestro
  )
  VALUES (
    p_usuario_id,
    p_servicio_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(v_srv_negocio, ''), TRIM(COALESCE(p_negocio_nombre, ''))),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(v_srv_titulo, ''), TRIM(COALESCE(p_servicio_nombre, ''))),
    v_precio_real,
    v_precio_real,
    v_escrow,
    v_puerta,
    v_use_mem,
    v_use_top,
    'confirmada',
    v_qr_token,
    v_fecha,
    v_h_eff,
    p_spot_number,
    v_split,
    COALESCE(p_es_pase_maestro, FALSE)
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_reserva_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_reserva_id,
    'reserva_id', v_reserva_id,
    'qr_token', v_qr_token,
    'precio_kc', v_precio_real,
    'descuento_flash_pct', v_flash_pct,
    'monto_escrow', v_escrow,
    'monto_puerta', v_puerta,
    'escrow_membresia', v_use_mem,
    'escrow_topup', v_use_top,
    'fecha_clase', v_fecha,
    'spot_number', p_spot_number,
    'split_count', v_split,
    'es_pase_maestro', COALESCE(p_es_pase_maestro, FALSE)
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.obtener_ocupacion_spots_servicio(
  p_servicio_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
  p_servicio_nombre TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_fecha_clase TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller TEXT := COALESCE((SELECT auth.uid())::text, '');
  v_date TEXT := NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(p_fecha_clase, '')), 10), '');
  v_now_ms BIGINT := FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) * 1000);
  v_booked INTEGER[] := '{}';
  v_locked INTEGER[] := '{}';
  v_active INTEGER := 0;
  v_unassigned INTEGER := 0;
  v_locks JSONB := '{}'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  WITH res_filtradas AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(r.spot_number, substring(COALESCE(r.qr_token, '') FROM '(?i)KNT-S([0-9]{1,2})-')::INTEGER) AS sp
    FROM public.reservas r
    WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('pendiente', 'activa', 'confirmada')
      AND (
        (p_servicio_id IS NOT NULL AND r.servicio_id = p_servicio_id)
        OR (p_servicio_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(TRIM(p_servicio_nombre), '') <> ''
            AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.servicio, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(p_servicio_nombre)))
      )
      AND (
        v_date IS NULL
        OR COALESCE(
          NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(r.fecha_clase, '')), 10), ''),
          to_char(COALESCE(r.created_at, NOW()) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
        ) = v_date
      )
  )
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::INTEGER,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sp IS NULL OR sp < 1 OR sp > 50)::INTEGER,
    COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT sp ORDER BY sp) FILTER (WHERE sp BETWEEN 1 AND 50), '{}')
  INTO v_active, v_unassigned, v_booked
  FROM res_filtradas;

  IF p_servicio_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(spots_locks, '{}'::jsonb) INTO v_locks FROM public.servicios WHERE id = p_servicio_id;
    SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT (e.value->>'spot')::INTEGER ORDER BY (e.value->>'spot')::INTEGER), '{}')
    INTO v_locked
    FROM jsonb_each(v_locks) e
    WHERE COALESCE((e.value->>'expiresAt')::BIGINT, 0) > v_now_ms
      AND COALESCE((e.value->>'spot')::INTEGER, 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 50
      AND COALESCE(e.value->>'holder', '') <> ''
      AND COALESCE(e.value->>'holder', '') <> v_caller
      AND (v_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(e.value->>'dateTag', 'any') IN ('any', v_date));
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'booked_spots', v_booked,
    'locked_other_spots', v_locked,
    'unassigned_count', v_unassigned,
    'active_count', v_active
  );
END;
$$;

-- 4. KINETICLUB: HELPER TIPO-SEGURO DE RECOMPENSAS + RPCs ATÓMICOS EN NUBE
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_read_claimed_rewards_text_arr(p_user_id UUID)
RETURNS TEXT[]
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_dtype TEXT;
  v_arr TEXT[];
  v_json JSONB;
BEGIN
  SELECT data_type INTO v_dtype
  FROM information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'perfiles' AND column_name = 'recompensas_reclamadas';

  IF v_dtype = 'ARRAY' THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(recompensas_reclamadas, ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO v_arr FROM public.perfiles WHERE id = p_user_id;
    RETURN COALESCE(v_arr, ARRAY[]::text[]);
  END IF;

  EXECUTE 'SELECT to_jsonb(recompensas_reclamadas) FROM public.perfiles WHERE id = $1' INTO v_json USING p_user_id;
  IF v_json IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(v_json) <> 'array' THEN
    RETURN ARRAY[]::text[];
  END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(elem), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO v_arr FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_json) AS elem;
  RETURN COALESCE(v_arr, ARRAY[]::text[]);
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_write_claimed_rewards_safe(p_user_id UUID, p_new_keys TEXT[])
RETURNS TEXT[]
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_dtype TEXT;
  v_cur TEXT[];
  v_k TEXT;
BEGIN
  v_cur := public.fn_read_claimed_rewards_text_arr(p_user_id);
  FOREACH v_k IN ARRAY COALESCE(p_new_keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) LOOP
    v_k := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_k, '')));
    IF v_k <> '' AND NOT (v_k = ANY(v_cur)) THEN
      v_cur := array_append(v_cur, v_k);
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  SELECT data_type INTO v_dtype
  FROM information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'perfiles' AND column_name = 'recompensas_reclamadas';

  IF v_dtype = 'ARRAY' THEN
    UPDATE public.perfiles SET recompensas_reclamadas = v_cur WHERE id = p_user_id;
  ELSIF v_dtype = 'json' THEN
    EXECUTE 'UPDATE public.perfiles SET recompensas_reclamadas = to_json($1::text[]) WHERE id = $2' USING v_cur, p_user_id;
  ELSE
    EXECUTE 'UPDATE public.perfiles SET recompensas_reclamadas = to_jsonb($1::text[]) WHERE id = $2' USING v_cur, p_user_id;
  END IF;
  RETURN v_cur;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti(
  p_user_id UUID,
  p_reto_id TEXT,
  p_kc_reward NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
  p_xp_reward INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_today_mzt TEXT := to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD');
  v_claim_key TEXT;
  v_claimed TEXT[];
  v_safe_kc NUMERIC := 0;
  v_safe_xp INTEGER := 0;
  v_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_xp NUMERIC := 0;
  v_racha INTEGER := 1;
  v_cajas INTEGER := 0;
  v_nivel TEXT := 'acceso base';
  v_box_lvl INTEGER;
  v_cycles INTEGER := 0;
  v_rem_lvl INTEGER := 1;
  v_reto_num INTEGER;
  v_tier_idx INTEGER := 0;
  v_i INTEGER := 1;
  v_mod INTEGER := 0;
  v_xp_base INTEGER := 20;
  v_session_mult INTEGER := 1;
  v_req_val INTEGER := 0;
  v_target_disc TEXT := 'crossfit';
  v_completed_sessions INTEGER := 0;
  v_active_sessions INTEGER := 0;
  v_distinct_clubs INTEGER := 0;
  v_distinct_discs INTEGER := 0;
  v_disc_sessions INTEGER := 0;
  v_has_squad BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_effective_xp NUMERIC := 0;
  v_req_xp INTEGER := 0;
  v_lvl_idx INTEGER;
  v_review_res_id UUID;
  v_keys_to_save TEXT[];
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para reclamar recompensas ajenas.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_claim_key := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_reto_id, '')));
  IF v_claim_key = '' OR LENGTH(v_claim_key) > 160 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Identificador de reto invalido.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_kc_reward, 0) < 0
     OR COALESCE(p_kc_reward, 0) > 20
     OR (COALESCE(p_kc_reward, 0) > 0 AND (p_kc_reward <> TRUNC(p_kc_reward) OR MOD(p_kc_reward, 10) <> 0)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_KC_REWARD_MULTIPLE_OF_10' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_xp_reward, 0) < 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_XP_REWARD_NEGATIVE' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT
    COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0),
    COALESCE(kc_topup, 0),
    COALESCE(xp_total, 0),
    GREATEST(1, COALESCE(racha_dias, racha, 1)),
    COALESCE(cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0),
    LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(nivel, 'acceso base')))
  INTO v_mem, v_top, v_xp, v_racha, v_cajas, v_nivel
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  v_claimed := public.fn_read_claimed_rewards_text_arr(p_user_id);

  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada')),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')),
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(r.negocio_id::text, NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.negocio_nombre, ''))), '')))
      FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada')
                AND COALESCE(r.negocio_id::text, NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.negocio_nombre, ''))), '')) IS NOT NULL),
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(
      NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.categoria, ''))), ''),
      NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE((SELECT s.categoria FROM public.servicios s WHERE s.id = r.servicio_id OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.nombre_servicio, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.servicio, ''))) LIMIT 1), ''))), ''),
      'fuerza'
    )) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada'))
  INTO v_completed_sessions, v_active_sessions, v_distinct_clubs, v_distinct_discs
  FROM public.reservas r
  WHERE r.usuario_id = p_user_id;

  IF v_claim_key LIKE 'recompensa_diaria%' OR v_claim_key LIKE 'misteriosa_diaria%' THEN
    v_claim_key := 'recompensa_diaria_' || v_today_mzt;
    v_safe_kc := 0;
    v_safe_xp := CASE
      WHEN v_nivel ~ '(platinum|platino|leyenda|legend|black)' THEN 25
      WHEN v_nivel ~ '(gold|oro)' THEN 20
      WHEN v_nivel ~ '(silver|plata)' THEN 15
      ELSE 10
    END;
    v_keys_to_save := ARRAY[v_claim_key, 'escudo_racha_' || v_today_mzt];
  ELSIF v_claim_key ~ '^review_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
    v_review_res_id := SUBSTRING(v_claim_key FROM 8)::UUID;
    IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas r
      WHERE r.id = v_review_res_id
        AND r.usuario_id = p_user_id
        AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada')
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reserva no elegible para recompensa de resena.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    v_safe_kc := 0;
    v_safe_xp := 15;
    v_keys_to_save := ARRAY[v_claim_key];
  ELSIF v_claim_key ~ '^caja_nivel_([1-9][0-9]{0,2})$' THEN
    v_box_lvl := SUBSTRING(v_claim_key FROM 12)::INTEGER;
    IF v_box_lvl < 1 OR v_box_lvl > 990 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cofre fuera de rango permitido.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    v_cycles := (v_box_lvl - 1) / 99;
    v_rem_lvl := ((v_box_lvl - 1) % 99) + 1;
    v_req_xp := v_cycles * 72830;
    FOR v_lvl_idx IN 1..v_rem_lvl LOOP
      v_req_xp := v_req_xp + (ROUND((100 + (v_lvl_idx - 1) * 6 + POWER(v_lvl_idx - 1, 1.38) * 1.45) / 10.0)::INTEGER * 10);
    END LOOP;
    v_effective_xp := GREATEST(v_xp, v_completed_sessions * 50 + v_racha * 25);
    IF v_effective_xp < v_req_xp AND NOT v_is_admin THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'XP insuficiente para abrir cofre de nivel.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    v_safe_kc := CASE WHEN random() < 0.25 THEN 20 ELSE 10 END;
    v_safe_xp := 30;
    v_keys_to_save := ARRAY[v_claim_key];
  ELSIF v_claim_key ~ '^reto_([1-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|250)$' THEN
    v_reto_num := SUBSTRING(v_claim_key FROM 6)::INTEGER;
    SELECT (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.equipos_kinetic eq
        WHERE eq.creador_id = p_user_id
          AND UPPER(COALESCE(eq.codigo_invitacion, '')) NOT LIKE 'DM-%'
          AND UPPER(COALESCE(eq.codigo_invitacion, '')) <> 'STORIES-V25'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.equipo_miembros em
        WHERE em.usuario_id = p_user_id
          AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(em.estado, 'activo'))) IN ('activo', 'aceptado', 'pendiente')
      )
    ) INTO v_has_squad;

    IF v_reto_num <= 10 THEN
      IF NOT v_is_admin THEN
        IF v_reto_num = 1 THEN
          NULL;
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 2 AND v_racha < 1 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Racha insuficiente para reclamar este reto.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 3 AND v_completed_sessions < 1 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completa 1 sesion QR para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 4 AND (v_distinct_clubs + v_active_sessions) < 1 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reserva o visita 1 sede para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 5 AND NOT v_has_squad THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unete o crea un Equipo Kinetic para reclamar Espiritu de Equipo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 6 AND v_racha < 2 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Necesitas racha de 2 dias para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 7 AND v_completed_sessions < 2 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completa 2 sesiones QR para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 8 AND v_distinct_discs < 2 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completa 2 disciplinas distintas para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 9 AND v_distinct_clubs < 2 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Visita 2 sedes distintas para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 10 AND v_racha < 3 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Necesitas racha de 3 dias para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        END IF;
      END IF;
      v_safe_xp := (ARRAY[20, 25, 30, 35, 15, 20, 35, 30, 35, 15])[v_reto_num];
    ELSE
      v_tier_idx := (v_reto_num - 1) / 50;
      v_i := ((v_reto_num - 1) % 50) + 1;
      v_mod := v_i % 4;
      v_xp_base := CASE v_tier_idx WHEN 0 THEN 20 WHEN 1 THEN 55 WHEN 2 THEN 115 WHEN 3 THEN 220 ELSE 400 END;
      v_session_mult := CASE v_tier_idx WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 7 WHEN 3 THEN 14 ELSE 25 END;

      IF v_mod = 1 THEN
        v_req_val := GREATEST(2, ROUND((v_i * 0.5 + v_tier_idx * 8) * v_session_mult * 0.35)::INTEGER);
        IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_completed_sessions < v_req_val THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Progreso de sesiones insuficiente para reclamar este reto.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        END IF;
        v_safe_xp := v_xp_base + ((v_i % 5) * 5);
      ELSIF v_mod = 2 THEN
        v_req_val := GREATEST(3, v_i + v_tier_idx * 10);
        IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_racha < v_req_val THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Racha insuficiente para reclamar este trofeo de constancia.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        END IF;
        v_safe_xp := v_xp_base + 10;
      ELSIF v_mod = 3 THEN
        v_req_val := LEAST(22, GREATEST(2, CEIL(v_i / 6.0)::INTEGER + v_tier_idx * 3));
        IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_distinct_clubs < v_req_val THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Necesitas entrenar en mas sedes para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        END IF;
        v_safe_xp := v_xp_base + 15;
      ELSE
        v_req_val := GREATEST(2, CEIL(v_i / 8.0)::INTEGER + v_tier_idx * 2);
        v_target_disc := CASE WHEN (v_i % 8) = 4 THEN 'surf' ELSE 'crossfit' END;
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_disc_sessions
        FROM public.reservas r
        WHERE r.usuario_id = p_user_id
          AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada')
          AND TRANSLATE(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(
            NULLIF(r.categoria, ''),
            (SELECT s.categoria FROM public.servicios s WHERE s.id = r.servicio_id OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.nombre_servicio, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.servicio, ''))) LIMIT 1),
            r.servicio,
            ''
          ))), 'áéíóú', 'aeiou') LIKE ('%' || v_target_disc || '%');
        IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_disc_sessions < v_req_val THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Progreso de disciplina insuficiente para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        END IF;
        v_safe_xp := v_xp_base + 20;
      END IF;
    END IF;

    v_safe_kc := 0;
    v_keys_to_save := ARRAY[v_claim_key];
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNRECOGNIZED_OR_RESERVED_REWARD_KEY' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF v_claim_key = ANY(v_claimed) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', TRUE,
      'duplicate', TRUE,
      'claim_key', v_claim_key,
      'kc_granted', 0,
      'xp_granted', 0,
      'kc_topup', v_top,
      'kc_membresia', v_mem,
      'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top,
      'xp_total', v_xp,
      'recompensas_reclamadas', to_jsonb(v_claimed)
    );
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.kineti_claimed_rewards (user_id, claim_key, kc_granted, xp_granted)
  VALUES (p_user_id, v_claim_key, v_safe_kc, v_safe_xp)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, claim_key) DO NOTHING;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    v_claimed := public.fn_write_claimed_rewards_safe(p_user_id, v_keys_to_save);
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', TRUE,
      'duplicate', TRUE,
      'claim_key', v_claim_key,
      'kc_granted', 0,
      'xp_granted', 0,
      'kc_topup', v_top,
      'kc_membresia', v_mem,
      'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top,
      'xp_total', v_xp,
      'recompensas_reclamadas', to_jsonb(v_claimed)
    );
  END IF;

  v_top := v_top + v_safe_kc;
  v_xp := v_xp + v_safe_xp;
  v_claimed := public.fn_write_claimed_rewards_safe(p_user_id, v_keys_to_save);

  UPDATE public.perfiles
  SET kc_topup = v_top,
      saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top,
      xp_total = v_xp,
      cajas_nivel_reclamadas = CASE WHEN v_claim_key LIKE 'caja_nivel_%' THEN v_cajas + 1 ELSE COALESCE(cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0) END,
      kc_ganados_cajas = CASE WHEN v_claim_key LIKE 'caja_nivel_%' THEN COALESCE(kc_ganados_cajas, 0) + v_safe_kc ELSE COALESCE(kc_ganados_cajas, 0) END,
      is_streak_frozen = CASE WHEN v_claim_key LIKE 'recompensa_diaria_%' THEN TRUE ELSE COALESCE(is_streak_frozen, FALSE) END
  WHERE id = p_user_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', TRUE,
    'duplicate', FALSE,
    'claim_key', v_claim_key,
    'kc_granted', v_safe_kc,
    'xp_granted', v_safe_xp,
    'kc_topup', v_top,
    'kc_membresia', v_mem,
    'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top,
    'xp_total', v_xp,
    'recompensas_reclamadas', to_jsonb(v_claimed)
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.congelar_racha_kineti(p_user_id UUID DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_target UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, v_caller);
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_iso_week TEXT := to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'IYYY-IW');
  v_key TEXT := 'escudo_racha_' || to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD');
  v_claimed TEXT[];
  v_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_prev_week TEXT;
  v_used INTEGER := 0;
  v_until TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_cost NUMERIC := 0;
  v_use_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_use_top NUMERIC := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (v_target IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida para activar Escudo Protector.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT
    COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0),
    COALESCE(kc_topup, 0),
    escudo_semana_iso,
    COALESCE(escudos_usados_semana, 0),
    GREATEST(escudo_activo_hasta, escudo_racha_activo_hasta)
  INTO v_mem, v_top, v_prev_week, v_used, v_until
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = v_target
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(v_prev_week, '') <> v_iso_week THEN
    v_used := 0;
  END IF;
  IF v_used >= 1 THEN
    v_cost := 25;
    IF (v_mem + v_top) < v_cost THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SALDO_INSUFICIENTE_ESCUDO: Ya usaste tu Escudo gratuito semanal. Necesitas 25 KC para activar uno adicional.';
    END IF;
    v_use_mem := LEAST(v_mem, v_cost);
    v_use_top := v_cost - v_use_mem;
    v_mem := v_mem - v_use_mem;
    v_top := v_top - v_use_top;
  END IF;

  v_used := v_used + 1;
  v_until := GREATEST(COALESCE(v_until, NOW()), NOW()) + INTERVAL '24 hours';
  v_claimed := public.fn_write_claimed_rewards_safe(v_target, ARRAY[v_key]);

  UPDATE public.perfiles
  SET kc_membresia = v_mem,
      kc_topup = v_top,
      saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top,
      is_streak_frozen = TRUE,
      escudo_semana_iso = v_iso_week,
      escudos_usados_semana = v_used,
      escudo_activo_hasta = v_until,
      escudo_racha_activo_hasta = v_until
  WHERE id = v_target;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', TRUE,
    'gratis', (v_cost = 0),
    'free', (v_cost = 0),
    'es_gratuito', (v_cost = 0),
    'costo_kc', v_cost,
    'escudos_usados_semana', v_used,
    'activo_hasta', v_until,
    'escudo_activo_hasta', v_until,
    'kc_membresia', v_mem,
    'kc_topup', v_top,
    'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top,
    'is_streak_frozen', TRUE,
    'recompensas_reclamadas', to_jsonb(v_claimed)
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activar_escudo_racha_24h()
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN public.congelar_racha_kineti((SELECT auth.uid()));
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ascender_prestigio_kineti(p_user_id UUID DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_target UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, v_caller);
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_xp NUMERIC := 0;
  v_completed INTEGER := 0;
  v_racha INTEGER := 1;
  v_effective_xp NUMERIC := 0;
  v_prestigio INTEGER := 0;
  v_xp_ciclo_completo CONSTANT INTEGER := 72830;
  v_xp_nivel99_entrada CONSTANT INTEGER := 71330;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (v_target IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT COALESCE(xp_total, 0), GREATEST(COALESCE(prestigio_nivel, 0), COALESCE(prestigio_grado, 0)), GREATEST(1, COALESCE(racha_dias, racha, 1))
  INTO v_xp, v_prestigio, v_racha
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = v_target
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_completed
  FROM public.reservas r
  WHERE r.usuario_id = v_target AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada');

  v_effective_xp := GREATEST(v_xp, v_completed * 50 + v_racha * 25);
  IF v_effective_xp < (v_prestigio * v_xp_ciclo_completo + v_xp_nivel99_entrada) AND NOT v_is_admin THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Debes alcanzar el Nivel 99/99 antes de ascender al siguiente Nivel de Prestigio.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_prestigio := v_prestigio + 1;
  UPDATE public.perfiles
  SET prestigio_nivel = v_prestigio,
      prestigio_grado = v_prestigio,
      xp_total = GREATEST(v_xp, v_effective_xp, v_prestigio * v_xp_ciclo_completo)
  WHERE id = v_target;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', TRUE,
    'prestigio_nivel', v_prestigio,
    'prestigio_grado', v_prestigio,
    'xp_total', GREATEST(v_xp, v_effective_xp, v_prestigio * v_xp_ciclo_completo)
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ascender_prestigio_nivel_99()
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN public.ascender_prestigio_kineti((SELECT auth.uid()));
END;
$$;

-- 5. CIERRE SISTÉMICO DE RPCs RESTANTES + PARIDAD ADMIN UGC + REVOKE ANON
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.canjear_codigo_referido(p_user_id UUID, p_codigo TEXT)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_clean_code TEXT := UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_codigo, '')));
  v_referrer_id UUID;
  v_referrer_name TEXT;
  v_already_referred UUID;
  v_bono_ya_dado BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_my_code TEXT;
  v_my_nivel TEXT;
  v_has_paid_membership BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para canjear referidos ajenos.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_clean_code = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ingresa un codigo de invitacion valido.';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT referido_por_id, COALESCE(bono_referido_otorgado, FALSE), UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(codigo_referido, ''))), LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(nivel, 'acceso base')))
  INTO v_already_referred, v_bono_ya_dado, v_my_code, v_my_nivel
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  IF v_already_referred IS NOT NULL AND v_bono_ya_dado THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ya has canjeado un codigo de invitacion en tu cuenta anteriormente.';
  END IF;
  IF v_my_code = v_clean_code THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No puedes canjear tu propio codigo de invitacion.';
  END IF;

  SELECT id, COALESCE(nombre, 'Miembro Kinetic')
  INTO v_referrer_id, v_referrer_name
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(codigo_referido, ''))) = v_clean_code
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_referrer_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'El codigo ingresado no existe. Verifica que este bien escrito.';
  END IF;

  v_has_paid_membership := v_my_nivel IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'platinum', 'leyenda vip');
  IF v_has_paid_membership THEN
    UPDATE public.perfiles
    SET kc_topup = COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + 100,
        saldo_kc = COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) + COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + 100,
        xp_total = COALESCE(xp_total, 0) + 50,
        referido_por_id = v_referrer_id,
        referido_por_codigo = v_clean_code,
        bono_referido_otorgado = TRUE
    WHERE id = p_user_id;

    UPDATE public.perfiles
    SET kc_topup = COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + 100,
        saldo_kc = COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0) + COALESCE(kc_topup, 0) + 100,
        xp_total = COALESCE(xp_total, 0) + 50,
        referidos_count = COALESCE(referidos_count, 0) + 1,
        kc_ganados_referidos = COALESCE(kc_ganados_referidos, 0) + 100
    WHERE id = v_referrer_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'status', 'credited_now', 'kc_acredited', 100, 'xp_acredited', 50, 'anfitrion_nombre', v_referrer_name);
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.perfiles
  SET referido_por_id = v_referrer_id,
      referido_por_codigo = v_clean_code,
      bono_referido_otorgado = FALSE
  WHERE id = p_user_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'status', 'pending_membership', 'kc_acredited', 0, 'xp_acredited', 0, 'anfitrion_nombre', v_referrer_name);
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.registrar_racha_diaria_app(p_user_id UUID, p_fecha_hoy TEXT)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_today_date DATE := (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan')::date;
  v_today TEXT := to_char(v_today_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD');
  v_ultima_fecha TEXT;
  v_last_date DATE;
  v_diff_days INTEGER := 0;
  v_shield_active BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_racha_actual INTEGER := 0;
  v_racha_semanal INTEGER := 0;
  v_xp_ganado INTEGER := 15;
  v_new_xp NUMERIC := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT
    ultima_fecha_racha,
    COALESCE(racha_dias, 0),
    COALESCE(racha_semanal_dias, 0),
    COALESCE(xp_total, 0),
    (COALESCE(is_streak_frozen, FALSE) OR GREATEST(escudo_activo_hasta, escudo_racha_activo_hasta) >= NOW())
  INTO v_ultima_fecha, v_racha_actual, v_racha_semanal, v_new_xp, v_shield_active
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF v_ultima_fecha = v_today THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'already_checked_today', TRUE, 'racha_dias', v_racha_actual, 'racha_semanal_dias', v_racha_semanal, 'xp_ganado', 0, 'xp_total', v_new_xp);
  END IF;

  IF v_ultima_fecha ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN
    v_last_date := v_ultima_fecha::date;
    IF v_last_date >= v_today_date THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'already_checked_today', TRUE, 'racha_dias', v_racha_actual, 'racha_semanal_dias', v_racha_semanal, 'xp_ganado', 0, 'xp_total', v_new_xp);
    END IF;
    v_diff_days := v_today_date - v_last_date;
    IF v_diff_days = 1 OR (v_diff_days = 2 AND COALESCE(v_shield_active, FALSE)) THEN
      v_racha_actual := GREATEST(1, v_racha_actual) + 1;
      v_racha_semanal := (GREATEST(0, v_racha_semanal) % 7) + 1;
    ELSE
      v_racha_actual := 1;
      v_racha_semanal := 1;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    v_racha_actual := GREATEST(1, v_racha_actual + 1);
    v_racha_semanal := (GREATEST(0, v_racha_semanal) % 7) + 1;
  END IF;

  v_xp_ganado := CASE WHEN v_racha_semanal = 7 THEN 50 ELSE 15 END;

  UPDATE public.perfiles
  SET racha_dias = v_racha_actual,
      racha = v_racha_actual,
      racha_semanal_dias = v_racha_semanal,
      ultima_fecha_racha = v_today,
      xp_total = COALESCE(xp_total, 0) + v_xp_ganado
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  RETURNING xp_total INTO v_new_xp;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', TRUE, 'already_checked_today', FALSE, 'racha_dias', v_racha_actual, 'racha_semanal_dias', v_racha_semanal, 'xp_ganado', v_xp_ganado, 'xp_total', v_new_xp);
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.moderar_reporte_ugc(p_reporte_id UUID, p_estado TEXT)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_estado TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_estado, '')));
BEGIN
  IF NOT COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solo Admin Maestro puede moderar reportes UGC.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_estado NOT IN ('pendiente', 'revisado', 'accion_tomada', 'descartado') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Estado de moderacion invalido.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.comunidad_reportes_ugc SET estado = v_estado WHERE id = p_reporte_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', FOUND, 'id', p_reporte_id, 'estado', v_estado);
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolver_reporte_ugc(p_report_id UUID, p_estado TEXT)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN public.moderar_reporte_ugc(p_report_id, p_estado);
END;
$$;

-- Permisos estrictos: cero EXECUTE para anon/PUBLIC en mutaciones
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.fn_read_claimed_rewards_text_arr(UUID) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.fn_write_claimed_rewards_safe(UUID, TEXT[]) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.es_fecha_valida_servicio_mazatlan(TEXT, DATE, TIME, TEXT, TEXT, JSONB) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.es_fecha_valida_servicio_mazatlan(TEXT, DATE, TIME, TEXT, TEXT, JSONB) TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.procesar_reserva_escrow(UUID, TEXT, TEXT, NUMERIC, UUID, TEXT, INTEGER, INTEGER, BOOLEAN) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.procesar_reserva_escrow(UUID, TEXT, TEXT, NUMERIC, UUID, TEXT, INTEGER, INTEGER, BOOLEAN) TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.obtener_ocupacion_spots_servicio(UUID, TEXT, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.obtener_ocupacion_spots_servicio(UUID, TEXT, TEXT) TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti(UUID, TEXT, NUMERIC, INTEGER) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti(UUID, TEXT, NUMERIC, INTEGER) TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.congelar_racha_kineti(UUID) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.congelar_racha_kineti(UUID) TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.activar_escudo_racha_24h() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.activar_escudo_racha_24h() TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.ascender_prestigio_kineti(UUID) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.ascender_prestigio_kineti(UUID) TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.ascender_prestigio_nivel_99() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.ascender_prestigio_nivel_99() TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.canjear_codigo_referido(UUID, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.canjear_codigo_referido(UUID, TEXT) TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.registrar_racha_diaria_app(UUID, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.registrar_racha_diaria_app(UUID, TEXT) TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.moderar_reporte_ugc(UUID, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.moderar_reporte_ugc(UUID, TEXT) TO authenticated;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.resolver_reporte_ugc(UUID, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.resolver_reporte_ugc(UUID, TEXT) TO authenticated;

DO $$
DECLARE
  v_sig TEXT;
BEGIN
  FOR v_sig IN SELECT unnest(ARRAY[
    'public.abrir_caja_nivel_kineti(uuid, numeric)',
    'public.cancelar_reserva_escrow(uuid, uuid)',
    'public.deducir_saldo_reserva(uuid, numeric)',
    'public.liquidar_pase_puerta(uuid, uuid, numeric)',
    'public.transferir_kineticoins(uuid, uuid, numeric)',
    'public.obtener_corte_semanal_b2b(timestamptz, timestamptz)',
    'public.k_cron_expirar_reservas_y_pases()'
  ]) LOOP
    IF to_regprocedure(v_sig) IS NOT NULL THEN
      EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC, anon', v_sig);
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF to_regprocedure('public.registrar_lock_spot_temporal(uuid, integer, text, integer)') IS NOT NULL THEN
    REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.registrar_lock_spot_temporal(UUID, INTEGER, TEXT, INTEGER) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
    GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.registrar_lock_spot_temporal(UUID, INTEGER, TEXT, INTEGER) TO authenticated;
  END IF;
END $$;

    FILE: supabase/migrations/migration_v279_escrow_b2b_and_3d_rewards.sql

    -- === supabase/migrations/migration_v279_escrow_b2b_and_3d_rewards.sql === --
-- Ola 1 Unificada (V279): Columnas Flash reales, Aislamiento Estricto B2B,
-- Directorio Unico public.afiliados (Baja Fitness dedup + Cagers prospect), y Cajas de Nivel 1:1.

-- 1) Columnas e indices reales en public.servicios y public.reservas
ALTER TABLE public.servicios ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS es_venta_flash BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;
ALTER TABLE public.servicios ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS descuento_flash_pct INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE public.servicios ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fecha_fin DATE;
ALTER TABLE public.servicios ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS afiliado_id UUID REFERENCES public.afiliados(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_servicios_afiliado_id ON public.servicios (afiliado_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_servicios_estado_flash ON public.servicios (estado, es_venta_flash) WHERE activo = true;

ALTER TABLE public.reservas ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS es_venta_flash BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;
ALTER TABLE public.reservas ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS descuento_flash_pct INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

-- 2) Helper estricto de rol B2B (excluye siempre al Master Admin)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_strict_b2b_partner(p_uid UUID DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $$
  WITH ctx AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(p_uid, (SELECT auth.uid())) AS uid
  )
  SELECT
    (SELECT uid FROM ctx) IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM auth.users u
      LEFT JOIN public.perfiles p ON p.id = u.id
      WHERE u.id = (SELECT uid FROM ctx)
        AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (
          (u.email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(u.email, ''))) IN (
            'administrador@kinetic.com.mx', 'administrador@kinetic.com', 'kinetic@kinetic.com', 'admin@kinetic.com'
          ))
          OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p.rol, ''))) IN ('admin', 'fundador')
        )
    )
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.perfiles p
        LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = p.id
        WHERE p.id = (SELECT uid FROM ctx)
          AND (
            LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p.rol, ''))) IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'socio', 'especialista', 'operador_b2b', 'b2b', 'partner', 'partner b2b', 'negocio', 'estadio', 'coach_club')
            OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p.tipo_cuenta, ''))) IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'socio', 'especialista', 'operador_b2b', 'b2b', 'partner', 'partner b2b', 'negocio', 'estadio', 'coach_club')
            OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(u.raw_app_meta_data->>'rol', ''))) IN ('afiliado', 'club', 'socio', 'especialista', 'operador_b2b', 'b2b', 'partner', 'negocio', 'estadio')
            OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(u.email, COALESCE(p.email, '')))) LIKE 'club@%'
            OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(u.email, COALESCE(p.email, '')))) LIKE 'especialista@%'
          )
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a WHERE a.propietario_id = (SELECT uid FROM ctx)
      )
    );
$$;

-- 3) Endurecer procesar_reserva_escrow: bloqueo B2B estricto + columnas reales Flash/afiliados
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.procesar_reserva_escrow(
  p_usuario_id uuid,
  p_negocio_nombre text,
  p_servicio_nombre text,
  p_precio_kc numeric,
  p_servicio_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid,
  p_fecha_clase text DEFAULT NULL::text,
  p_spot_number integer DEFAULT NULL::integer,
  p_split_count integer DEFAULT 1,
  p_es_pase_maestro boolean DEFAULT false
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_precio_base NUMERIC := 0;
  v_precio_real NUMERIC := 0;
  v_srv_negocio TEXT := '';
  v_srv_titulo TEXT := '';
  v_srv_estado TEXT := '';
  v_srv_activo BOOLEAN := TRUE;
  v_srv_fecha DATE;
  v_srv_hora TIME;
  v_srv_freq TEXT := '';
  v_srv_desc TEXT := '';
  v_srv_attrs JSONB := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_cupo_max INTEGER := 30;
  v_ocupados INTEGER := 0;
  v_escrow NUMERIC := 0;
  v_puerta NUMERIC := 0;
  v_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_use_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_use_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_nivel TEXT := '';
  v_vip_pct INTEGER := 0;
  v_club_pct INTEGER := 0;
  v_flash_pct INTEGER := 0;
  v_is_flash BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_srv_flash_col BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_srv_flash_pct_col INTEGER := 0;
  v_srv_afiliado_id UUID;
  v_afiliado_estado TEXT;
  v_ev_ts TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_f_eff TEXT;
  v_h_eff TEXT;
  v_reserva_id UUID;
  v_qr_token TEXT;
  v_split INTEGER := LEAST(10, GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_split_count, 1)));
  v_fecha TEXT := NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(p_fecha_clase, '')), 10), '');
  v_sched JSONB;
  v_is_official BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (p_usuario_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para reservar a nombre de otro atleta.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF (NOT v_is_admin AND COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(v_caller)), FALSE))
     OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(p_usuario_id)), FALSE) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ACCOUNT_ATHLETE_BOOKING_FORBIDDEN: Las cuentas operativas B2B no pueden realizar reservas de atleta.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF p_servicio_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT
      COALESCE(s.precio_kc, 0),
      COALESCE(s.cupo_maximo, 30),
      TRIM(COALESCE(s.negocio_nombre, '')),
      TRIM(COALESCE(s.nombre_servicio, '')),
      LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.estado, 'aprobado'))),
      COALESCE(s.activo, TRUE),
      COALESCE(s.fecha, NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(to_jsonb(s)->>'fecha_clase', '')), 10), '')::date),
      s.hora_inicio,
      COALESCE(s.frecuencia, ''),
      COALESCE(s.descripcion, ''),
      COALESCE(s.atributos, '{}'::jsonb),
      COALESCE(s.es_venta_flash, FALSE),
      COALESCE(s.descuento_flash_pct, 0),
      s.afiliado_id
    INTO
      v_precio_base, v_cupo_max, v_srv_negocio, v_srv_titulo,
      v_srv_estado, v_srv_activo, v_srv_fecha, v_srv_hora, v_srv_freq, v_srv_desc, v_srv_attrs,
      v_srv_flash_col, v_srv_flash_pct_col, v_srv_afiliado_id
    FROM public.servicios s
    WHERE s.id = p_servicio_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICIO_INEXISTENTE: La experiencia seleccionada ya no existe.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
    END IF;

    IF NOT v_srv_activo
       OR v_srv_estado NOT IN ('activo', 'aprobado', '')
       OR COALESCE((v_srv_attrs->>'eliminado')::boolean, FALSE)
       OR COALESCE((v_srv_attrs->>'cancelado')::boolean, FALSE) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICIO_RETIRADO: La experiencia seleccionada fue pausada o retirada.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
    END IF;

    v_is_official := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_negocio, ''))) IN ('kinetic oficial', 'kinetic sports club', '');
    IF v_srv_afiliado_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_attrs->>'afiliado_id', '')), '') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
      v_srv_afiliado_id := (v_srv_attrs->>'afiliado_id')::uuid;
    END IF;

    IF NOT v_is_official AND v_srv_afiliado_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.estado, '')))
      INTO v_afiliado_estado
      FROM public.afiliados a
      WHERE a.id = v_srv_afiliado_id;
      IF FOUND AND v_afiliado_estado IN ('inactivo', 'prospecto', 'oculto', 'pendiente', 'suspendido', 'eliminado', 'rechazado') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICIO_RETIRADO: Esta sede se encuentra temporalmente inactiva.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
      END IF;
    END IF;

    v_sched := public.es_fecha_valida_servicio_mazatlan(v_fecha, v_srv_fecha, v_srv_hora, v_srv_freq, v_srv_desc, v_srv_attrs);
    IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT COALESCE((v_sched->>'valid')::boolean, FALSE) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '%', COALESCE(NULLIF(v_sched->>'reason', ''), 'HORARIO_NO_DISPONIBLE: Fecha u horario fuera de vigencia.')
        USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    v_fecha := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_sched->>'resolved_date', ''), v_fecha, to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD'));

    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_ocupados
    FROM public.reservas r
    WHERE r.servicio_id = p_servicio_id
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')
      AND COALESCE(
        NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(r.fecha_clase, '')), 10), ''),
        to_char(COALESCE(r.created_at, NOW()) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      ) = v_fecha;

    IF v_ocupados >= v_cupo_max THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CUPO_AGOTADO: No quedan lugares disponibles en esta sesion.';
    END IF;

    IF p_spot_number IS NOT NULL THEN
      IF p_spot_number < 1 OR p_spot_number > v_cupo_max THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Estacion #% fuera del rango permitido (%).', p_spot_number, v_cupo_max USING ERRCODE = '22023';
      END IF;
      IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas r
        WHERE r.servicio_id = p_servicio_id
          AND r.spot_number = p_spot_number
          AND LOWER(COALESCE(r.estado, 'activa')) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')
          AND COALESCE(
            NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(r.fecha_clase, '')), 10), ''),
            to_char(COALESCE(r.created_at, NOW()) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
          ) = v_fecha
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'SPOT_OCUPADO: La estacion #% ya fue reservada.', p_spot_number USING ERRCODE = '23505';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF NOT v_is_admin THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reserva sin servicio de catalogo prohibida para clientes.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    v_precio_base := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_precio_kc, 0));
    v_fecha := COALESCE(v_fecha, to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD'));
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0), LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(nivel, '')))
  INTO v_mem, v_top, v_nivel
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = p_usuario_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil de atleta no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_es_pase_maestro, FALSE) THEN
    IF NOT v_is_admin THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para emitir Pase Maestro Admin 0 KC.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    v_precio_real := 0;
    v_escrow := 0;
    v_puerta := 0;
    v_h_eff := COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_hora::text, '')), 5), ''), '08:00');
  ELSE
    IF v_precio_base < 0 OR (v_precio_base > 0 AND MOD(v_precio_base, 10) <> 0) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Precio base invalido (debe ser multiplo de 10 KC).';
    END IF;
    v_f_eff := COALESCE(v_fecha, to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD'));
    v_h_eff := COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(v_srv_hora::text, '')), 5), ''), '08:00');
    IF v_f_eff ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' AND v_h_eff ~ '^\d{2}:\d{2}$' THEN
      v_ev_ts := (v_f_eff || ' ' || v_h_eff || ':00')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan';
      IF v_ev_ts > NOW() AND v_ev_ts <= (NOW() + INTERVAL '180 minutes') THEN
        v_is_flash := TRUE;
      END IF;
    END IF;
    IF v_srv_flash_col OR COALESCE((v_srv_attrs->>'es_venta_flash')::boolean, FALSE) THEN
      v_is_flash := TRUE;
    END IF;
    IF v_is_flash AND v_precio_base > 0 THEN
      v_vip_pct := CASE
        WHEN v_nivel ~ '(platinum|leyenda|black)' THEN 20
        WHEN v_nivel ~ '(gold|oro)' THEN 15
        WHEN v_nivel ~ '(silver|plata)' THEN 10
        WHEN v_nivel ~ '(bronze|bronce)' THEN 5
        ELSE 0
      END;
      v_club_pct := LEAST(50, GREATEST(0, GREATEST(
        v_srv_flash_pct_col,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(v_srv_attrs->>'descuento_flash_pct', ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::int, 0)
      )));
      v_flash_pct := GREATEST(v_vip_pct, v_club_pct);
    END IF;
    v_precio_real := CASE WHEN v_flash_pct > 0 THEN GREATEST(10, ROUND(v_precio_base * (100 - v_flash_pct) / 100.0)) ELSE v_precio_base END;
    v_escrow := ROUND(v_precio_real * 0.40);
    v_puerta := GREATEST(0, v_precio_real - v_escrow);
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  IF v_escrow > 0 THEN
    IF (v_mem + v_top) < v_escrow THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SALDO_INSUFICIENTE: Tu boveda no cubre el 40%% de custodia (% KC).', v_escrow;
    END IF;
    v_use_mem := LEAST(v_mem, v_escrow);
    v_use_top := v_escrow - v_use_mem;
    UPDATE public.perfiles
    SET kc_membresia = v_mem - v_use_mem,
        kc_topup = v_top - v_use_top,
        saldo_kc = (v_mem - v_use_mem) + (v_top - v_use_top)
    WHERE id = p_usuario_id;
  END IF;

  v_qr_token := md5(gen_random_uuid()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || random()::text);
  INSERT INTO public.reservas (
    usuario_id, servicio_id, negocio_nombre, servicio, precio_kc, costo_total,
    monto_escrow, monto_puerta, escrow_membresia, escrow_topup,
    estado, qr_token, fecha_clase, hora_inicio, spot_number, split_count, es_pase_maestro,
    es_venta_flash, descuento_flash_pct
  )
  VALUES (
    p_usuario_id,
    p_servicio_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(v_srv_negocio, ''), TRIM(COALESCE(p_negocio_nombre, ''))),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(v_srv_titulo, ''), TRIM(COALESCE(p_servicio_nombre, ''))),
    v_precio_real,
    v_precio_real,
    v_escrow,
    v_puerta,
    v_use_mem,
    v_use_top,
    'confirmada',
    v_qr_token,
    v_fecha,
    v_h_eff,
    p_spot_number,
    v_split,
    COALESCE(p_es_pase_maestro, FALSE),
    v_is_flash,
    v_flash_pct
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_reserva_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_reserva_id,
    'reserva_id', v_reserva_id,
    'qr_token', v_qr_token,
    'precio_kc', v_precio_real,
    'es_venta_flash', v_is_flash,
    'descuento_flash_pct', v_flash_pct,
    'monto_escrow', v_escrow,
    'monto_puerta', v_puerta,
    'escrow_membresia', v_use_mem,
    'escrow_topup', v_use_top,
    'fecha_clase', v_fecha,
    'spot_number', p_spot_number,
    'split_count', v_split,
    'es_pase_maestro', COALESCE(p_es_pase_maestro, FALSE)
  );
END;
$function$;

-- 4) Endurecer RPCs de Boveda contra cuentas B2B estrictas
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox(p_plan_id text, p_tipo text DEFAULT 'topup'::text)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_sandbox_ok BOOLEAN := false;
  v_plan TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_plan_id, '')));
  v_tipo TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_tipo, 'topup')));
  v_kc NUMERIC := 0;
  v_mxn NUMERIC := 0;
  v_tier TEXT := NULL;
  v_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_curr_nivel TEXT := 'Acceso Base';
  v_curr_weight INT := 0;
  v_next_weight INT := 0;
  v_curr_base_kc NUMERIC := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sesion requerida para operar Boveda.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(v_uid)), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ACCOUNT_WALLET_PURCHASE_FORBIDDEN: Las cuentas B2B no pueden comprar membresias ni Kineticoins.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(enabled, false) INTO v_sandbox_ok
  FROM public.kinetic_system_flags
  WHERE flag_key = 'allow_pre_stripe_sandbox';

  IF NOT v_sandbox_ok AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SANDBOX_DESHABILITADO: Modo pre-Stripe desactivado en servidor.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  CASE
    WHEN v_plan IN ('bronze', 'memb_bronze', 'membresia_bronze', 'plan_bronze') THEN v_kc := 600; v_mxn := 699; v_tier := 'Bronze'; v_next_weight := 1;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('silver', 'memb_silver', 'membresia_silver', 'plan_silver') THEN v_kc := 1500; v_mxn := 1549; v_tier := 'Silver'; v_next_weight := 2;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('gold', 'memb_gold', 'membresia_gold', 'plan_gold') THEN v_kc := 2500; v_mxn := 2529; v_tier := 'Gold'; v_next_weight := 3;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('platinum', 'memb_platinum', 'membresia_platinum', 'plan_platinum') THEN v_kc := 3600; v_mxn := 3600; v_tier := 'Platinum'; v_next_weight := 4;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_50', '50', 'pkg_50') THEN v_kc := 50; v_mxn := 50;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_100', '100', 'pkg_100') THEN v_kc := 100; v_mxn := 100;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_250', '250', 'pkg_250') THEN v_kc := 250; v_mxn := 250;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_500', '500', 'pkg_500') THEN v_kc := 500; v_mxn := 500;
    WHEN v_plan IN ('topup_1000', '1000', 'pkg_1000') THEN v_kc := 1000; v_mxn := 1000;
    ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Plan o paquete sandbox desconocido: %', p_plan_id;
  END CASE;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0), COALESCE(nivel, 'Acceso Base')
  INTO v_mem, v_top, v_curr_nivel
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = v_uid
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil de atleta no encontrado.';
  END IF;

  v_curr_weight := CASE
    WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%platinum%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%platino%' THEN 4
    WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%gold%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%oro%' THEN 3
    WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%silver%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%plata%' THEN 2
    WHEN LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%bronze%' OR LOWER(v_curr_nivel) LIKE '%bronce%' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END;

  v_curr_base_kc := CASE v_curr_weight WHEN 1 THEN 600 WHEN 2 THEN 1500 WHEN 3 THEN 2500 WHEN 4 THEN 3600 ELSE 0 END;

  IF v_tier IS NOT NULL OR v_tipo IN ('membresia', 'membership') THEN
    IF v_curr_weight >= 1 AND v_next_weight > v_curr_weight THEN
      v_kc := GREATEST(0, v_kc - v_curr_base_kc);
    END IF;
    v_mem := v_mem + v_kc;
    UPDATE public.perfiles
    SET kc_membresia = v_mem,
        saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top,
        nivel = COALESCE(v_tier, v_curr_nivel),
        fecha_activacion_membresia = NOW()
    WHERE id = v_uid;
  ELSE
    v_top := v_top + v_kc;
    UPDATE public.perfiles
    SET kc_topup = v_top,
        saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top
    WHERE id = v_uid;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.transacciones_pagos (
    usuario_id, tipo_operacion, paquete_id, monto_mxn, kc_inyectados, stripe_payment_intent_id, estado
  ) VALUES (
    v_uid, v_tipo, v_plan, v_mxn, v_kc,
    'sandbox_' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''),
    'sandbox_completado'
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'plan_id', v_plan,
    'kc_inyectados', v_kc,
    'kc_membresia', v_mem,
    'kc_topup', v_top,
    'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top,
    'nivel', COALESCE(v_tier, v_curr_nivel)
  );
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inyectar_saldo_boveda(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_cantidad numeric,
  p_billetera text DEFAULT 'topup'::text,
  p_nuevo_nivel text DEFAULT NULL::text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_mem NUMERIC;
  v_top NUMERIC;
  v_nivel TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF NOT COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado: requiere privilegios de Admin Maestro Kinetic.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(p_user_id)), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ACCOUNT_WALLET_PURCHASE_FORBIDDEN: Cuenta B2B no elegible para saldo de atleta.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0), COALESCE(kc_topup, 0), COALESCE(nivel, 'Acceso Base')
  INTO v_mem, v_top, v_nivel
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil de atleta no encontrado.';
  END IF;

  IF LOWER(COALESCE(p_billetera, 'topup')) = 'membresia' THEN
    v_mem := GREATEST(0, v_mem + COALESCE(p_cantidad, 0));
  ELSE
    v_top := GREATEST(0, v_top + COALESCE(p_cantidad, 0));
  END IF;

  IF p_nuevo_nivel IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(p_nuevo_nivel)) > 0 THEN
    v_nivel := TRIM(p_nuevo_nivel);
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.perfiles
  SET kc_membresia = v_mem,
      kc_topup = v_top,
      saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top,
      nivel = v_nivel
  WHERE id = p_user_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'kc_membresia', v_mem,
    'kc_topup', v_top,
    'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top,
    'nivel', v_nivel
  );
END;
$function$;

-- 5) Unificacion public.afiliados + Guard verificado + Fusión Baja Fitness + Seeding Prospectos + RPC admin_upsert_afiliado_b2b
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_afiliados_verificado_v277()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_jwt_role TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');
  v_is_priv BOOLEAN := (
    (v_jwt_role = 'service_role' AND current_setting('role', true) = 'service_role')
    OR (session_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('role', true), ''), 'none') IN ('none', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin'))
    OR COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE)
  );
BEGIN
  IF v_is_priv THEN
    IF LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
       AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.estado, ''))) <> 'activo' AND NEW.verificado IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.verificado)) THEN
      NEW.verificado := TRUE;
    ELSIF LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.estado, ''))) IN ('prospecto', 'inactivo', 'oculto', 'pendiente')
       AND TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
       AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.estado, ''))) = 'activo'
       AND NEW.verificado IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.verificado THEN
      NEW.verificado := FALSE;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    NEW.verificado := FALSE;
    IF LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.estado, ''))) IN ('', 'activo') THEN
      NEW.estado := 'pendiente';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    NEW.verificado := COALESCE(OLD.verificado, FALSE);
    IF COALESCE(OLD.verificado, FALSE) THEN
      NEW.nombre := OLD.nombre;
    END IF;
    IF LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.estado, ''))) <> 'activo' AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.estado, ''))) IN ('', 'activo') THEN
      NEW.estado := OLD.estado;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$;

DECLARE
  v_baja_canonical UUID := 'cfab73c2-4659-4b36-a451-5fd2d3c5e7fe';
