      ('Lic. Ruvalcaba • Nutrición Deportiva & Antropometría', 'Fisioterapia', 'Especialista', true, 'Cabo San Lucas, B.C.S.', 22.8995, -109.8932, 'prospecto', false, 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1576091160550-2173dba999ef?q=80&w=1000&auto=format&fit=crop&sig=150', 'Lunes a Sábado • 08:00 a 19:00', '@nutriciondeportivacabo'),
      ('Baja Recovery Lab • Ice Bath & Sauna', 'Cold Plunge', 'Especialista', true, 'Corredor Turístico, Los Cabos, B.C.S.', 22.9058, -109.8812, 'prospecto', false, 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1540555700478-4be289fbecef?q=80&w=1000&auto=format&fit=crop&sig=151', 'Lunes a Domingo • 07:00 a 20:00', '@bajarecoverylab'),
      ('Cabo Sports Massage & Recovery Studio', 'Masaje Deportivo', 'Especialista', true, 'Cabo San Lucas, B.C.S.', 22.8885, -109.9135, 'prospecto', false, 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544161515-4ab6ce6db874?q=80&w=1000&auto=format&fit=crop&sig=152', 'Lunes a Sábado • 09:00 a 20:00', '@cabosportsmassage')
    ) AS v(nombre, disciplina, categoria, es_especialista, ubicacion, latitud, longitud, estado, verificado, portada_url, horarios, instagram)
  LOOP
    v_norm_seed := REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(LOWER(v_rec.nombre), 'áéíóúüñ', 'aeiouun'), '\s+', ' ', 'g');
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.afiliados a
      WHERE REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(LOWER(a.nombre), 'áéíóúüñ', 'aeiouun'), '\s+', ' ', 'g') = v_norm_seed
    ) THEN
      INSERT INTO public.afiliados (
        nombre, disciplina, categoria, es_especialista, ubicacion,
        latitud, longitud, estado, verificado, portada_url, horarios, instagram
      ) VALUES (
        v_rec.nombre, v_rec.disciplina, v_rec.categoria, v_rec.es_especialista, v_rec.ubicacion,
        v_rec.latitud, v_rec.longitud, v_rec.estado, v_rec.verificado, v_rec.portada_url, v_rec.horarios, v_rec.instagram
      );
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_norm_afiliado_alias(p_nombre TEXT)
RETURNS TEXT
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN s ~ 'baja\s+fitness.*medano' THEN 'baja fitness medano'
    WHEN s ~ 'incorfit' THEN 'incorfit'
    WHEN s ~ 'cabo\s+yoga' THEN 'cabo yoga fitness'
    WHEN s ~ 'el\s+tule' THEN 'el tule fitness'
    WHEN s ~ 'elemental\s+strength' THEN 'elemental strength'
    WHEN s ~ 'truefit\s+cabo' THEN 'truefit cabo'
    WHEN s ~ 'f45\s+training\s+san\s+jos' THEN 'f45 san jose'
    WHEN s ~ 'fitbox' THEN 'fitbox cabo'
    WHEN s ~ 'fortress\s+fitness' THEN 'fortress fitness'
    WHEN s ~ 'seal\s+crosstraining' THEN 'seal crosstraining'
    WHEN s ~ 'seis24' THEN 'seis24'
    WHEN s ~ 'tropical\s+fitness' THEN 'tropical fitness'
    WHEN s ~ 'cagers' THEN 'cagers gym mma & muay thai'
    ELSE s
  END
  FROM (SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_nombre, ''))), 'áéíóúüñ&', 'aeiouun '), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS s) t;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_upsert_afiliado_b2b(
  p_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
  p_nombre TEXT DEFAULT '',
  p_estado TEXT DEFAULT 'prospecto',
  p_disciplina TEXT DEFAULT 'Fuerza',
  p_categoria TEXT DEFAULT 'Club',
  p_es_especialista BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  p_ubicacion TEXT DEFAULT '',
  p_latitud DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT NULL,
  p_longitud DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT NULL,
  p_portada_url TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_descripcion TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_horarios TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_instagram TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_whatsapp TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_clean_nombre TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_nombre, '')), '');
  v_norm_nombre TEXT := public.fn_norm_afiliado_alias(p_nombre);
  v_target_estado TEXT := CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_estado, ''))) = 'activo' THEN 'activo' ELSE 'prospecto' END;
  v_target_verif BOOLEAN := (v_target_estado = 'activo');
  v_existing_id UUID;
  v_row public.afiliados%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF NOT COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado: requiere Master Admin Kinetic.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF p_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_existing_id FROM public.afiliados WHERE id = p_id LIMIT 1;
  END IF;

  IF v_existing_id IS NULL AND v_norm_nombre <> '' THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_existing_id
    FROM public.afiliados
    WHERE public.fn_norm_afiliado_alias(nombre) = v_norm_nombre
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;

  IF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.afiliados
    SET estado = v_target_estado,
        verificado = v_target_verif,
        disciplina = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_disciplina), ''), disciplina),
        categoria = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_categoria), ''), categoria),
        es_especialista = COALESCE(p_es_especialista, es_especialista),
        ubicacion = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_ubicacion), ''), ubicacion),
        latitud = COALESCE(p_latitud, latitud),
        longitud = COALESCE(p_longitud, longitud),
        portada_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_portada_url), ''), portada_url),
        descripcion = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_descripcion), ''), descripcion),
        horarios = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_horarios), ''), horarios),
        instagram = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_instagram), ''), instagram),
        whatsapp = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_whatsapp), ''), whatsapp)
    WHERE id = v_existing_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_row;
  ELSE
    IF v_clean_nombre IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nombre de afiliado requerido.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.afiliados (
      nombre, estado, verificado, disciplina, categoria, es_especialista,
      ubicacion, latitud, longitud, portada_url, descripcion, horarios, instagram, whatsapp
    ) VALUES (
      v_clean_nombre,
      v_target_estado,
      v_target_verif,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_disciplina), ''), 'Fuerza'),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_categoria), ''), CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_es_especialista, false) THEN 'Especialista' ELSE 'Club' END),
      COALESCE(p_es_especialista, false),
      NULLIF(TRIM(p_ubicacion), ''),
      p_latitud,
      p_longitud,
      NULLIF(TRIM(p_portada_url), ''),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_descripcion), ''), ''),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_horarios), ''), ''),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_instagram), ''), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(p_whatsapp), '')
    )
    RETURNING * INTO v_row;
  END IF;

  RETURN to_jsonb(v_row);
END;
$function$;

-- 6) Sincronizacion 1 a 1 en public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti + ledger transacciones_pagos
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_reto_id text,
  p_kc_reward numeric DEFAULT 0,
  p_xp_reward integer DEFAULT 0
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_caller UUID := (SELECT auth.uid());
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := COALESCE((SELECT public.is_kinetic_master_admin()), FALSE);
  v_today_mzt TEXT := to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mazatlan', 'YYYY-MM-DD');
  v_claim_key TEXT;
  v_claimed TEXT[];
  v_safe_kc NUMERIC := 0;
  v_safe_xp INTEGER := 0;
  v_mem NUMERIC := 0;
  v_top NUMERIC := 0;
  v_xp NUMERIC := 0;
  v_racha INTEGER := 1;
  v_cajas INTEGER := 0;
  v_cajas_exact INTEGER := 0;
  v_nivel TEXT := 'acceso base';
  v_box_lvl INTEGER;
  v_cycles INTEGER := 0;
  v_rem_lvl INTEGER := 1;
  v_reto_num INTEGER;
  v_tier_idx INTEGER := 0;
  v_i INTEGER := 1;
  v_mod INTEGER := 0;
  v_xp_base INTEGER := 20;
  v_session_mult INTEGER := 1;
  v_req_val INTEGER := 0;
  v_target_disc TEXT := 'crossfit';
  v_completed_sessions INTEGER := 0;
  v_active_sessions INTEGER := 0;
  v_distinct_clubs INTEGER := 0;
  v_distinct_discs INTEGER := 0;
  v_disc_sessions INTEGER := 0;
  v_has_squad BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_claimed_xp NUMERIC := 0;
  v_effective_xp NUMERIC := 0;
  v_req_xp INTEGER := 0;
  v_lvl_idx INTEGER;
  v_review_res_id UUID;
  v_keys_to_save TEXT[];
BEGIN
  IF v_caller IS NULL OR (p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_caller AND NOT v_is_admin) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado para reclamar recompensas ajenas.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE((SELECT public.is_strict_b2b_partner(p_user_id)), FALSE) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_ACCOUNT_REWARD_CLAIM_FORBIDDEN: Cuentas B2B no acumulan cofres de atleta.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_claim_key := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_reto_id, '')));
  IF v_claim_key = '' OR LENGTH(v_claim_key) > 160 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Identificador de reto invalido.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_kc_reward, 0) < 0
     OR COALESCE(p_kc_reward, 0) > 20
     OR (COALESCE(p_kc_reward, 0) > 0 AND (p_kc_reward <> TRUNC(p_kc_reward) OR MOD(p_kc_reward, 10) <> 0)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_KC_REWARD_MULTIPLE_OF_10' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_xp_reward, 0) < 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_XP_REWARD_NEGATIVE' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.vault_rpc_authorized', 'true', true);
  PERFORM set_config('kinetic.rpc_authorized', 'true', true);

  SELECT
    COALESCE(kc_membresia, 0),
    COALESCE(kc_topup, 0),
    COALESCE(xp_total, 0),
    GREATEST(1, COALESCE(racha_dias, racha, 1)),
    COALESCE(cajas_nivel_reclamadas, 0),
    LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(nivel, 'acceso base')))
  INTO v_mem, v_top, v_xp, v_racha, v_cajas, v_nivel
  FROM public.perfiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Perfil no encontrado.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  v_claimed := public.fn_read_claimed_rewards_text_arr(p_user_id);

  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada')),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada')),
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(r.negocio_id::text, NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.negocio_nombre, ''))), '')))
      FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada')
                AND COALESCE(r.negocio_id::text, NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.negocio_nombre, ''))), '')) IS NOT NULL),
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(
      NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.categoria, ''))), ''),
      NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE((SELECT s.categoria FROM public.servicios s WHERE s.id = r.servicio_id OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.nombre_servicio, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.servicio, ''))) LIMIT 1), ''))), ''),
      'fuerza'
    )) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada'))
  INTO v_completed_sessions, v_active_sessions, v_distinct_clubs, v_distinct_discs
  FROM public.reservas r
  WHERE r.usuario_id = p_user_id;

  IF v_claim_key LIKE 'recompensa_diaria%' OR v_claim_key LIKE 'misteriosa_diaria%' THEN
    v_claim_key := 'recompensa_diaria_' || v_today_mzt;
    v_safe_kc := 0;
    v_safe_xp := CASE
      WHEN v_nivel ~ '(platinum|platino|leyenda|legend|black)' THEN 25
      WHEN v_nivel ~ '(gold|oro)' THEN 20
      WHEN v_nivel ~ '(silver|plata)' THEN 15
      ELSE 10
    END;
    v_keys_to_save := ARRAY[v_claim_key, 'escudo_racha_' || v_today_mzt];
  ELSIF v_claim_key ~ '^review_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
    v_review_res_id := SUBSTRING(v_claim_key FROM 8)::UUID;
    IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas r
      WHERE r.id = v_review_res_id
        AND r.usuario_id = p_user_id
        AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada')
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reserva no elegible para recompensa de resena.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    v_safe_kc := 0;
    v_safe_xp := 15;
    v_keys_to_save := ARRAY[v_claim_key];
  ELSIF v_claim_key ~ '^caja_nivel_([1-9][0-9]{0,2})$' THEN
    v_box_lvl := SUBSTRING(v_claim_key FROM 12)::INTEGER;
    IF v_box_lvl < 1 OR v_box_lvl > 990 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cofre fuera de rango permitido.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    v_cycles := (v_box_lvl - 1) / 99;
    v_rem_lvl := ((v_box_lvl - 1) % 99) + 1;
    v_req_xp := v_cycles * 72830;
    FOR v_lvl_idx IN 1..v_rem_lvl LOOP
      v_req_xp := v_req_xp + (ROUND((100 + (v_lvl_idx - 1) * 6 + POWER(v_lvl_idx - 1, 1.38) * 1.45) / 10.0)::INTEGER * 10);
    END LOOP;
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(xp_granted), 0) INTO v_claimed_xp FROM public.kineti_claimed_rewards WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
    v_effective_xp := GREATEST(v_xp, v_completed_sessions * 50 + v_racha * 25 + v_claimed_xp);
    IF v_effective_xp < v_req_xp AND NOT v_is_admin THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'XP insuficiente para abrir cofre de nivel.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    v_safe_kc := CASE WHEN random() < 0.25 THEN 20 ELSE 10 END;
    v_safe_xp := 30;
    v_keys_to_save := ARRAY[v_claim_key];
  ELSIF v_claim_key ~ '^reto_([1-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|250)$' THEN
    v_reto_num := SUBSTRING(v_claim_key FROM 6)::INTEGER;
    SELECT (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.equipos_kinetic eq
        WHERE eq.creador_id = p_user_id
          AND UPPER(COALESCE(eq.codigo_invitacion, '')) NOT LIKE 'DM-%'
          AND UPPER(COALESCE(eq.codigo_invitacion, '')) <> 'STORIES-V25'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.equipo_miembros em
        WHERE em.usuario_id = p_user_id
          AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(em.estado, 'activo'))) IN ('activo', 'aceptado', 'pendiente')
      )
    ) INTO v_has_squad;

    IF v_reto_num <= 10 THEN
      IF NOT v_is_admin THEN
        IF v_reto_num = 1 THEN NULL;
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 2 AND v_racha < 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Racha insuficiente para reclamar este reto.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 3 AND v_completed_sessions < 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completa 1 sesion QR para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 4 AND (v_distinct_clubs + v_active_sessions) < 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reserva o visita 1 sede para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 5 AND NOT v_has_squad THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unete o crea un Equipo Kinetic para reclamar Espiritu de Equipo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 6 AND v_racha < 2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Necesitas racha de 2 dias para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 7 AND v_completed_sessions < 2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completa 2 sesiones QR para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 8 AND v_distinct_discs < 2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completa 2 disciplinas distintas para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 9 AND v_distinct_clubs < 2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Visita 2 sedes distintas para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        ELSIF v_reto_num = 10 AND v_racha < 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Necesitas racha de 3 dias para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
        END IF;
      END IF;
      v_safe_xp := (ARRAY[20, 25, 30, 35, 15, 20, 35, 30, 35, 15])[v_reto_num];
    ELSE
      v_tier_idx := (v_reto_num - 1) / 50;
      v_i := ((v_reto_num - 1) % 50) + 1;
      v_mod := v_i % 4;
      v_xp_base := CASE v_tier_idx WHEN 0 THEN 20 WHEN 1 THEN 55 WHEN 2 THEN 115 WHEN 3 THEN 220 ELSE 400 END;
      v_session_mult := CASE v_tier_idx WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 7 WHEN 3 THEN 14 ELSE 25 END;
      IF v_mod = 1 THEN
        v_req_val := GREATEST(2, ROUND((v_i * 0.5 + v_tier_idx * 8) * v_session_mult * 0.35)::INTEGER);
        IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_completed_sessions < v_req_val THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Progreso de sesiones insuficiente para reclamar este reto.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
        v_safe_xp := v_xp_base + ((v_i % 5) * 5);
      ELSIF v_mod = 2 THEN
        v_req_val := GREATEST(3, v_i + v_tier_idx * 10);
        IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_racha < v_req_val THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Racha insuficiente para reclamar este trofeo de constancia.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
        v_safe_xp := v_xp_base + 10;
      ELSIF v_mod = 3 THEN
        v_req_val := LEAST(22, GREATEST(2, CEIL(v_i / 6.0)::INTEGER + v_tier_idx * 3));
        IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_distinct_clubs < v_req_val THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Necesitas entrenar en mas sedes para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
        v_safe_xp := v_xp_base + 15;
      ELSE
        v_req_val := GREATEST(2, CEIL(v_i / 8.0)::INTEGER + v_tier_idx * 2);
        v_target_disc := CASE WHEN (v_i % 8) = 4 THEN 'surf' ELSE 'crossfit' END;
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_disc_sessions FROM public.reservas r
        WHERE r.usuario_id = p_user_id
          AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.estado, ''))) IN ('completada', 'usada')
          AND TRANSLATE(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(
            NULLIF(r.categoria, ''),
            (SELECT s.categoria FROM public.servicios s WHERE s.id = r.servicio_id OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(s.nombre_servicio, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.servicio, ''))) LIMIT 1),
            r.servicio, ''
          ))), 'áéíóú', 'aeiou') LIKE ('%' || v_target_disc || '%');
        IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_disc_sessions < v_req_val THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Progreso de disciplina insuficiente para reclamar este trofeo.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
        v_safe_xp := v_xp_base + 20;
      END IF;
    END IF;
    v_safe_kc := 0;
    v_keys_to_save := ARRAY[v_claim_key];
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNRECOGNIZED_OR_RESERVED_REWARD_KEY' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF v_claim_key = ANY(v_claimed) THEN
    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_cajas_exact
    FROM public.kineti_claimed_rewards WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND claim_key LIKE 'caja_nivel_%';
    v_cajas_exact := GREATEST(v_cajas, v_cajas_exact);
    UPDATE public.perfiles SET cajas_nivel_reclamadas = v_cajas_exact WHERE id = p_user_id;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', TRUE, 'duplicate', TRUE, 'claim_key', v_claim_key,
      'kc_granted', 0, 'xp_granted', 0, 'kc_topup', v_top, 'kc_membresia', v_mem,
      'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top, 'xp_total', v_xp, 'cajas_nivel_reclamadas', v_cajas_exact,
      'recompensas_reclamadas', to_jsonb(v_claimed)
    );
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.kineti_claimed_rewards (user_id, claim_key, kc_granted, xp_granted)
  VALUES (p_user_id, v_claim_key, v_safe_kc, v_safe_xp)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, claim_key) DO NOTHING;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    v_claimed := public.fn_write_claimed_rewards_safe(p_user_id, v_keys_to_save);
    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_cajas_exact
    FROM public.kineti_claimed_rewards WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND claim_key LIKE 'caja_nivel_%';
    v_cajas_exact := GREATEST(v_cajas, v_cajas_exact);
    UPDATE public.perfiles SET cajas_nivel_reclamadas = v_cajas_exact WHERE id = p_user_id;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', TRUE, 'duplicate', TRUE, 'claim_key', v_claim_key,
      'kc_granted', 0, 'xp_granted', 0, 'kc_topup', v_top, 'kc_membresia', v_mem,
      'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top, 'xp_total', v_xp, 'cajas_nivel_reclamadas', v_cajas_exact,
      'recompensas_reclamadas', to_jsonb(v_claimed)
    );
  END IF;

  v_top := v_top + v_safe_kc;
  v_xp := GREATEST(v_xp, v_effective_xp) + v_safe_xp;
  v_claimed := public.fn_write_claimed_rewards_safe(p_user_id, v_keys_to_save);
  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_cajas_exact
  FROM public.kineti_claimed_rewards WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND claim_key LIKE 'caja_nivel_%';
  IF v_claim_key LIKE 'caja_nivel_%' THEN
    v_cajas_exact := GREATEST(v_cajas + 1, v_cajas_exact);
    INSERT INTO public.transacciones_pagos (
      usuario_id, tipo_operacion, paquete_id, monto_mxn, kc_inyectados, stripe_payment_intent_id, estado
    ) VALUES (
      p_user_id, 'recompensa_caja', v_claim_key, 0, v_safe_kc,
      'crate_' || replace(p_user_id::text, '-', '') || '_' || v_claim_key, 'completado'
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  ELSE
    v_cajas_exact := GREATEST(v_cajas, v_cajas_exact);
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.perfiles
  SET kc_topup = v_top,
      saldo_kc = v_mem + v_top,
      xp_total = v_xp,
      cajas_nivel_reclamadas = v_cajas_exact,
      kc_ganados_cajas = CASE WHEN v_claim_key LIKE 'caja_nivel_%' THEN COALESCE(kc_ganados_cajas, 0) + v_safe_kc ELSE COALESCE(kc_ganados_cajas, 0) END,
      is_streak_frozen = CASE WHEN v_claim_key LIKE 'recompensa_diaria_%' THEN TRUE ELSE COALESCE(is_streak_frozen, FALSE) END
  WHERE id = p_user_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', TRUE, 'duplicate', FALSE, 'claim_key', v_claim_key,
    'kc_granted', v_safe_kc, 'xp_granted', v_safe_xp, 'kc_topup', v_top, 'kc_membresia', v_mem,
    'saldo_kc', v_mem + v_top, 'xp_total', v_xp, 'cajas_nivel_reclamadas', v_cajas_exact,
    'recompensas_reclamadas', to_jsonb(v_claimed)
  );
END;
$function$;

-- 7) Permisos OWASP estrictos
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.is_strict_b2b_partner(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_strict_b2b_partner(uuid) TO authenticated;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_upsert_afiliado_b2b(uuid, text, text, text, text, boolean, text, double precision, double precision, text, text, text, text, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_upsert_afiliado_b2b(uuid, text, text, text, text, boolean, text, double precision, double precision, text, text, text, text, text) TO authenticated;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.procesar_reserva_escrow(uuid, text, text, numeric, uuid, text, integer, integer, boolean) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.procesar_reserva_escrow(uuid, text, text, numeric, uuid, text, integer, integer, boolean) TO authenticated;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox(text, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox(text, text) TO authenticated;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.inyectar_saldo_boveda(uuid, numeric, text, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.inyectar_saldo_boveda(uuid, numeric, text, text) TO authenticated;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti(uuid, text, numeric, integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.reclamar_recompensa_kineti(uuid, text, numeric, integer) TO authenticated;
